femaleIdols.description: Bell is a Thai singer under Zenith Media Contents. She is the maknae of the international girl group Z-Girls and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.
Bell is a Azerbaijanish singer under ONO Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group A.iRiD.

Bella, also known by her real name Park Seoi and formerly known as Gina, is a South Korean-American singer, actress and model. She is a former pre-debut member of the girl group WiTCHX. She made her solo debut on February 28, 2023 with the digital single "Juice".

Shim Hye-won/Annabelle Shim, known under her stage name Belle, is a South Korean-American singer-songwriter, dancer, producer, and composer under S2 Entertainment and AURA. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group KISS OF LIFE. On May 16, 2023, Belle was revealed the second member of KISS OF LIFE. The group officially debuted on July 5th, 2023, with their self-titled mini album "KISS OF LIFE".
Ben is a South Korean singer under BRD Communications. She was a member of the disbanded girl group BeBe Mignon. She made her solo debut on September 18, 2012, with the single "Don't Go Today".
Beni is a South Korean singer under P Nation. She is a member of the girl group Baby DONT Cry, with whom debuted on June 23, 2025.
Benny is a South Korean dancer, member of the girl group NEWRED.
Berry is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Yellow Bee.
Berry is a South Korean soloist. She made her debut on December 30, 2020, with the digital single “STEP” Feat. BLESS.
Berry is a South Korean singer, model and Twitch streamer. She made her debut on February 14, 2022 with the single "Berry Peri".
Bessie is a South Korean artist under MLD Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group LAPILLUS. She made her debut with the group on June 20, 2022 with the digital single "Hit Ya!"
besweet is a South Korean folk singer and songwriter who is active since 2007 but made her official debut on June 30, 2009 with the single pAIN.

Bian, formerly known as Jiwon, is a South Korean singer, dancer, model and BJ. She was a member of the girl group MAJORS and a former member of ANS and MIDNIGHT. On May 25, 2022, ANS Entertainment shares that Bian hasn't officially left the group but is in an indefinite hiatus due to health/personal reasons.

Kim Hyung-seo, known under the stage name BIBI, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Feel GHood Music. She first gained attention as a finalist on SBS’s The Run, where she was recommended by Tiger JK and Yoonmirae after they listened to her self-produced songs on SoundCloud. She would go on to officially debut in 2019 with the R&B single "BINU" -- a quirky track about hickeys and soap. From the beginning of her career, BIBI has stood out with her candid lyricism and her ability to turn a modern vulnerability into power. With her international appeal she was picked up by 88Rising for international promotions. BIBI moves effortlessly across R&B, hip-hop, pop, and alternative ballads, often weaving dark humor into her music and videos. Her signature sound leans minimalist -- atmospheric beats, open space, and melodies that let her voice cut through with intensity. Whether she's crafting playful odes like Kazino, confessional anthems, or political allegories like Animal Farm, BIBI’s work often lingers in the uncomfortable spaces between beauty and decay, criss-crossing over a track with smoky vocals. Known for her offbeat humor, raw performances, and dark, cinematic visuals, she crafts music for the emotions people are usually too scared to admit beyond the usual school crush.
Bich Sori is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group La_TTE.

Bichen is a Chinese singer. She is a former member of the girl group Sunny Days. She joined the group in 2013 and left in 2014. She won season 3 of The Voice of China in 2014. She made her solo debut in 2016 with the album "Morning Bound for Midnight"
Bicki is a South Korean dancer and singer under MLD Entertainment. She is a member of the dance group CocaNButter, and a former member of the dance group PURPLOW (2013 - May 2017).
Bikini Cactus is a South Korean singer who debuted on February 9, 2023 with the mini album "prototype".

Bimby, formerly known as Somi is a Thai singer. She is a former member of the girl group BaBa. Bimby joined BaBa sometime in 2015, after the departure of Somi (Bomi). She officially debuted in the group on February 25, 2016 with their second digital single "Catch Me", she left the group shortly after due to visa issues and was subsequently replaced by Somi (Hyewon).
Bin Haneul was a South Korean trainee. She is known for being a contestant in the competitive reality television shows Idol School and High School Rapper 2.
Bini is a retired South Korean singer and model. She was a member of the girl group 9MUSES but left in 2011.
Binu is a South Korean singer under Logi Entertainment.
Bipa is a Korean-American singer under Bipa Company. She was a member of the girl group Lip Service.

Bitna, formerly known as Seungah is a South Korean singer. She is the leader of the girl group Sunny Hill. Originally using the stage name Seungah, she debuted as a member of Sunny Hill on September 20, 2007 with the group's first single "Love Letter". Coinciding with the group's return to activities, on April 25, 2019, it was announced she would be promoting under the new stage name Bitna.
Bitna is a South Korean singer and dancer under S Media Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group LAYSHA. She joined the group on March 30, 2023. She is also a cheerleader for Busan IPark.
Bixi is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group 4G. She debuted solo with "Stupid" on June 20, 2013.

Bling Bling, also known as Byulji is a South Korean singer, former member of the girl group BB Ahn. Her and Yoo Sung-eun left the group in December 2012. She is currently a soloist and AfreecaTV Streamer under the name Cheon So-ah.

Blovey is a South Korean singer and V-Tuber. She debuted as a member of FriA on December 23, 2022, with the single "FRIA 1st X-mas" under TA Entertainment. Due to an infidelity controversy, her official departure from the group was announced on March 20, 2024.

Jeon Ho-yeon, better known as Blue.D is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her official debut as a soloist on December 2, 2019, with the digital single "Nobody" featuring MINO. Prior to her debut, she was active on Soundcloud and YouTube, where she released covers of popular songs by DEAN, Ariana Grande and BLACKPINK. In 2018 she was recruited by YGX, a subsidiary of YG Entertainment and collaborated with artists such as MINO (“Um”) and Eun Jiwon ("I’m on Fire") Seungri, as well as Groovyroom. She parted ways with YGX in November 2020 and established her independent label, Blue.D Entertainment.
Bluefox, also known as Ageha, is a South Korean singer, member of the girl groups 8YUME and To Hermitage.
Blueny is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo OuiOui.

Kim Boa (or simply Boa) is a South Korean singer currently under ARA-LINE. She is one half of the duo KEEMBO and a former member of the girl group SPICA. Before debuting as an idol, she was the vocal trainer for the boy group INFINITE. She also worked with the music production team Sweetune as a guide vocalist. On February 10, 2020, she, alongside former fellow SPICA member Kim Bo Hyung, announced their return to promotions as a duo called KEEMBO. The duo officially debuted on April 10 with the digital single "Thank You, Anyway".

Kwon Bo-ah, known professionally as BoA, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, record producer and actress under SM Entertainment. BoA has been recognized as one of the most successful and influential Korean entertainers throughout her career, and is therefore commonly credited as the "Queen of K-pop." Since her debut in August of 2000, BoA has released many albums in a variety of languages including Korean, Japanese, English, and Mandarin. These releases have contributed to her commercial success throughout Asia. With the release of her debut Japanese studio album, 'Listen to My Heart', BoA became the first Korean pop star to break through in Japan following the fall of barriers that had restricted the import and export of entertainment between the countries since the end of World War II. One January 3, 2022, she made her debut as a member of the unit GOT the beat from the project girl group Girls On Top.
Bobae debuted as a member of the girl group 4X in 2017.
bobae is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under INPLANET MUSIC. She made her debut on September 18, 2019 with the digital single "ORMG".
Bobi is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her debut on March 31, 2022, with the digital single "Lost".
Bobin is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Pastel Girl. She was a contestant on Miss Trot 2.

Boeun is a South Korean singer under M25. On September 8, 2021, Boeun was revealed as a contestant on the MBC's survival show "My Teenage Girl". During the finale, she ranked sixth place with 201,684.4 votes, thus becoming a member of the girl group CLASS:y. CLASS:y made their debut on May 5, 2022 with the mini album "Class Is Over". On January 14, 2024, Boeun was reported as one of the member of PocketDol Studio's collaboration group, A SIX. They released the digital single "Lies All Love" on January 30, 2024.
Bogyeong is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Peach Girl.
Bogyung is a South Korean bassist, member of the girl band If Enough.

Bohme Sara is a South Korean-Canadian trainee under Source Music. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl. Her younger brother, Sean was the maknae and member of future co-ed K-pop group ChoCo.
Bohyang is a retired South Korean rapper who was part of the girl group D.U.B.

Bohye is a South Korean singer. She is a member of DESTINY and was formerly part of the groups Kiss&Cry and Bella, the latter in which she was known as Miuu. She made her solo debut on September 2, 2016 with the digital single "Overload".

Kim Bohyung is a South Korean singer currently under ARA-LINE. She is one half of the duo KEEMBO and a former member of the girl group SPICA. She made her solo debut on October 18, 2013 with her first digital single "Crazy Girl".
Boin76, born Jung Bo-in is a South Korean rapper who debuted under STG World in 2016. She debuted on April 11, 2016 with the mini-album ‘CUT-FREE’.
Bollo, formerly known as Semi, is a South Korean trainee, dancer, choreographer and dance trainer. She is a former member of the girl group BADKIZ.
Bom is a South Korean singer and a former member of the girl group Chocolate.

Bombing is a South Korean singer and V-Tuber under Sandbox Network. She debuted as a member of FriA on December 23, 2023, with the single "FRIA 1st X-mas" under TA Entertainment. Two years after their debut, FriA officially ended their group activities. After the group's disbandment, she made her solo debut on January 3, 2025, with the single "Messiah".
Bombit is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group RoseVary.
Bome is a South Korean singer under TITAN CONTENT. She is a member of the girl group AtHeart.

Yoon Bomi is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actress. She made her official debut on April 19, 2011 as the main dancer and lead vocalist of the girl group APINK under With Us Entertainment. She is also a member of the Apink CHOBOM sub-unit with Chorong. Bomi made her debut as a musical actress in 2022 with the musical "Wonder Ticket - Resurrection of the Guardian Tree". Bomi is known for her cute and quirky personality which was showcased through her appearance in different variety shows. She used to do gorilla impressions which made her memorable among viewers. She played the role of 'Secretary Na' in the drama "Queen of Tears" in 2024 for which she gained immense praise for her acting.
Bomi is a South korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Chic Angel. She left the group in July 2017.

Kim Bomi is a South Korean actress and former idol formerly under SM Entertainment and Chocolate Music. She is a former member of the girl group M.I.L.K. On December 17, 2001, Bomi debuted as the sub vocalist and visual of M.I.L.K with their debut EP "with Freshness". Bomi is best known in her role in the 2014 movie "A Pharisee".
Bomi is a South Korean singer and choreographer under HW Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group GIRL STRAW (formerly GIRL CRUSH).
Bomin is a South Korean soprano, member of the girl group M.Diva.
Bomin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group GIG.
Im Bomin, formerly known as Ji-A Min, is a South Korean singer. She used to be a member of the girl group Global Icon.
Bomin is a South Korean singer and model under HR Entertainment. She is a member of the kids girl group Rookie.

Bona is a South Korean dancer, singer, and actress under Starship Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group WSJN (also known as Cosmic Girls) and its sub-unit WJSN THE BLACK. She debuted as a part of the group on February 25, 2016, with the release of their first mini-album "Would You Like?", representing the zodiac sign Leo in the group's concept. On May 12, 2021, she debuted as a member of WJSN's sub-unit, WJSN THE BLACK, with the single album "My Attitude". Bona debuted as an actress in 2017 with her role in the drama 'The Best Hit'. Since then, she played leading role in dramas such as 'Twenty-Five Twenty-One' in 2022, 'Joseon Attorney: A Morality' in 2023, and 'Pyramid Game' in 2024.
Bona is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group TREN-D. She joined the group in 2014.
Bona is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Chakra and the supergroup BROS. She made her solo debut on February 13, 2006, with the digital single "Sky Island".

Yoon Bo-na, also known as Soon.E or Soone, is a former South Korean singer and member of the now-disbanded group S.E.T. She now works as a fitness trainer and has competed in amateur body-building contests.

Bona is an independent South Korean singer and model. She is a former member of the girl group Cupid under Narda Entertainment, with whom she debuted on April 29, 2015 with the release of their first digital single "I Feel Good". Bona made her solo debut on September 14, 2020 with the release of the digital single "Take Me Away".
Shin Bong Sun is a South Korean comedian, member of the girl group Celeb Five.
Choi Euijeong, also known as BoNi, is the Lead Vocalist and Dancer of the Girl Group DreamNote under IMe Entertainment.
Boni, born Shin Bo-kyung is a South Korean singer-songwriter who debuted under Inplanet Music in 2010.
Boni, formerly Lua is a South Korean violinist. She was a member of the girl band LA.G.
Bonnie is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl duo Shyne. She is the twin sister of Sunny.
Bora is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Kirots. She left the group after the release of their first single in 2006.
Bora is a South Korean singer and actress. She was the main rapper of the girl group SISTAR and their sub-unit SISTAR19.
Bora, also known as Ray, is a former South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups Billion and 4X.

Bora is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl duo Maronie Girls. She has been a dance trot singer since 2014, and on August 17, 2017, she released her second single, My Koya / My Love Vitamin.

Bora is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actress under FNC Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group Cherry Bullet. She is also best known for participating in the reality survival shows V-1, Girls Planet 999, GIRL'S RE:VERSE and Queendom Puzzle.

Jeon Bo-ram is a South Korean singer and actress. She is best known for being a member of the girl group T-ARA and their Japanese sub-unit QBS. She debuted as a solo artist on April 15, 2008 with her first digital single "Lucifer Project Vol 1. Love". On May 7, 2017, MBK Entertainment announced the she, along with Soyeon, would be leaving T-ara. Later in 2019 she shortly returned to acting before going on hiatus to take care of her mother. In late 2023 Boram opened her official Japan fanclub and announced that she would be hosting her own radio show.
Boram is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group YPDA. She left the group in 2018, shortly after debut.

Boramiyu is a South Korean soloist and YouTuber signed with Shofar Entertainment. She appeared on the fifth episode of I Can See Your Voice 5 aired on March 2, 2018. She made her debut with her first digital single “I Wanna Hate You” on November 21, 2018.

Boran, also known as Yang Song E is a South Korean R&B and Soul solo singer under Saeraon E&T and Boran Records. She debuted in 2014 with her first digital single “PARADISE” under Sony Music Entertainment. Her first song "PARADISE" was used for the show “We Got Married”.
Boreum is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BELLA4.

Boreum is a South Korean former singer and dancer. She is a former member of the girl group LAYSHA. On August 9, 2019, she along with Sia were announced as LAYSHA's two newest members. On March 29, 2023 it was announced that Boreum has left LAYSHA due to health reasons.
Boreum is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group TWEETY. She joined the group in 2018.
Boreum is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group CHI CHI.
Bori is a South Korean singer. She is the former leader and main vocalist of the girl group GIRLS GIRLS.
Boyeon is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Yellow Bee.
Boyoung is a singer and rapper from South Korea. She used to be a member of the girl group I-Ren.
Brittney is a Korean-American singer under MZMC Inc. She is the leader of the girl group VVS.

Brooklyn is an American trainee. She gained fame for joining the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where she was eliminated at 17th place. She officially made her solo debut on March 29, 2024 with the digital single "Selfish".

Bryn is a South Korean rapper under Kaich and Brynshomelab who debuted independently in 2018 with the single "HAZY CITY". She was the oldest and the only female member of the DiCKIDS crew, now disbanded. She started music when she was in middle school, but did not gain public recognition until 2017, when her crew became popular after the first season of Mnet's High School Rapper. She participated on Mnet rap survival show Show Me The Money on seasons 6 and 8, where she became the first ever female rapper on the show to make it to the top 8.

BUDY is a South Korean R&B solo singer-songwriter under Slow Town Music. She is a former member of the girl group GIRLS GIRLS under her birth name Gyurang. She made her solo debut on March 14, 2019 with the studio album "Budy's Midnight".
Bunhong is a South Korean singer. She is former a member of the Korean Pop girl group Blady. She left the group in 2011.
by me (바이미) is a South Korean singer under Donuts Culture. She is a member of the duo A+B. She debuted on December 15, 2018 with 말할 수 없는 비밀, OST for 내 생의 최악의 이별 (The Worst Breakup in My Life).

Byeol is a South Korean singer managed by To Hermitage. She is a member of the live idol group NTORE, which was revealed on November 18, 2024. Before joining NTORE, she was known as Star in the live idol group HIROCHU, which disbanded on July 21, 2024.

Byeol Eun, formerly known as Eun Bee, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and YouTuber signed with SPRING ENT. She was a part of the girl group The Singing Girls in 2018. She started her solo singing career on September 21, 2020, with the digital single “Certainly”. She also participated in the Mnet survival show "Artistock Game" and finished in 6th place.

Byeol Sarang is a South Korean trot singer under KMB Company and Lean Branding. She debuted as a solo artist on April 17, 2017, with her first digital single, "Tear Flower". She was a contestant on the 2020 reality survival show, Miss Trot 2.
Byeolha, also known as Thetis, is a South Korean singer under I.O Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group Rhea.

Byeolha is a South Korean singer and a pre-debut member of the project girl group Chic & Idle. She was also a former pre-debut member of MIDNIGHT under the name Seyeon. On June 26, 2020, Byeolha was introduced as the second member of Liz Entertainment's new project girl group. She officially debuted with the group on July 20, 2020, with their first digital single "3! 4!"
Byeolha is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group A.H.H.A.

Byeoljji is a South Korean singer, rapper, and dancer under Midas Entertainment. She was first revealed as a member of MIDNIGHT on November 27, 2018, but the group disbanded before debuting in April 2020. She joined We Girls in April 2021, but the group disbanded by February 2022. Later in 2022, she was introduced as a member of Ndear, which disbanded silently by July. She then joined the dance team ZERO, and was believed to have rejoined Ndear after it's Instagram account was rebranded. In May 2023, she was introduced as a member of Berryz, but the group quietly disbanded by August. On April 16, 2024, she was introduced as a member of the upcoming girl group Astell. On December 20, 2024, it was announced that Astell’s members had signed new contracts with Midas Entertainment following the termination of their previous agency agreements.
Byul is a South Korean singer. She debuted on October 10, 2002 with the album "December 32".
Byulha is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BaBa.
Byun Hyebeen is a South Korean singer who debuted on January 12, 2018 with Honey Bee (with Rabbit Punch).
Byun Jungwon is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on the upcoming survival show Find Rookie.
Byun Subin is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group A-plus.

C'SA, also known by her full name Shin Sia, is a South Korean singer and producer. She is also known for being a former contestant in the competitive reality television shows Finding Momoland and Idol School.

Cai Bing is a Chinese singer signed with Image Music. She is part of the C-Pop group KSGIRLS. She was a participant in the hit survival show, Girls Planet 999, and was known as a backup dancer for several popular Chinese and Korean artists.

Camila is a Cuban-Canadian singer under JYP Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group GIRLSET (originally known as VCHA), which was formed through the survival show "A2K". She debuted with the group on January 26, 2024, with their first single album 'Girls of the Year". Before joining A2K, Camila was a finalist on The Voice Kids in 2016 with her brother, Zion. Previously, they had made it to the finale of The Junior Voice Quebec before making their rounds to The Voice Kids: France.

CAMO, born Park Chae‑ryeong, is a bilingual South Korean rapper, singer, and songwriter under 502. Born in Hong Kong, she made her debut in 2020 with the EP Ice and quickly made her breakout with the summer anthem "Life Is Wet" featuring JMIN. CAMO expanded her sound with tracks like “Freak Like Me” and “Mapsi”, building a unique musical identity built around trap, R&B, and traditional Asian influences. This was followed by her debut album Pressure Makes Diamonds in 2023. In October 2024, she dropped the mixtape Yours Truly, venturing into pop & drum & bass influences. The title track "K‑PACK" features cameo from model & actress Hong Jin‑kyung in a cinematic video set at a kimchi factory. Her stage name CAMO is an acronym for “Cash Money”. The name was given to her during her college years by a friend, and she decided to keep it when she started pursuing music professionally.

Canaco also known as Cana is a Japanese singer and dancer, she is a member of American (USA) based Korean co-ed groups First Bite and Lalary and part of Lalary's first sub-unit BABYLALARY. On the 6th of August 2018 she debuted in First Bite with their debut song “Move Over”. She later re-debuted with two of her fellow memebers from First Bite, Hope and Eddie in Lalary on the 29th of August 2019 with their debut digital single "Lalary". She the debuted in Lalary's first sub-unit BABYLALARY with Hope and Eddie on the 29th of June. The other two members from First Bite, Youa and Lex (also known as Alexa) joined Lalary on the 12th of February 2022.

Canary is a South Korean virtual singer under HYBE Labels. She is a member of the South Korean virtual girl group SYNDI8. According to her backstory, she is a member of the Canary tribe (Serinus canaria), with her father serving as the chieftain. Additionally, her special item is a magical wand

Cao Lu, formerly known as lulu, is a Chinese singer, actress and presenter under NS ENM, EE-MEDIA and Bomnal Entertainment.. She was a member and the Lead Dancer, Vocalist and the Face of the Group of the South Korean girl group FIESTAR, under FAVE Entertainment (LOEN Entertainment/Kakao M sub-lable). She debuted in China as a soloist on June 1, 2005 with the single album "Cat" as Lulu. She debuted with FIESTAR on August 31, 2012 with the single album "Vista" and the title track of the same name. FIESTAR disbanded on May 15, 2018 after four of the members' contracts ended on April 30 and decided not to renew. On May 22, 2024, Cao Lu shared that she had bought partial copyrights of their previous singles with an intent to re-record them in Chinese.
Captain Roh is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group XoX until 2019. She rejoined the group in 2022.

Carla is a South Korean singer under Urban Entertainment. She is member of the Korean pop duo MOXIE. She was in the pre-debut lineup of WANNA.B. She left early 2015 after the release of "My Type" pre-debut single.

Carlyn is a Filipino singer. She is the former leader of the international project girl group Z-Girls and a former member of the Filipino girl group Pop Girls. Carlyn is in a relationship with basketball player and fan, Von Ordoña. In February 2021, she revealed that she was expecting her first child. She announced her departure from Z-Girls in June 2021 following the reveal of her pregnancy. She was a contestant on V-1 (Vocal No .1).
Carmen is an Indonesian singer under SM Entertainment. She is the eldest member of the South Korean girl group Hearts2Hearts.
CaRoline is a South-Korean singer who was in season 1 or the voice of Korea.
Cassie is a Chinese singer under World K-Pop Center. She is a member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China.
Cater Nine is a South Korean rapper who debuted under K Sound in 2019, her first and only album so far is "Swimming in Acid".
Cateria is a Jamaican-British trainee. She was assumed to be a member of the upcoming global girl group NWH:I. Cateria was the fifth member revealed, on January16,2025.
CCOLA is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted in 2018 with SUMMER DISCO.
Ceena is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group LIVE HIGH and MyGirl. She joined the group for their comeback “Happy Song” in 2016.

Celeste is an Argentine-Colombian trainee. She gained fame for joining the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where on the 5th of November, 2023 she was eliminated at 12th place.
Celine is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Xanadu Entertainment. She made her debut as a soloist singer on May 9, 2020 with the digital single "You'll Forget".
Celine is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Pocket Girls. She joined the group in late 2017 and left in 2020.
Celma is a South Korean singer who debuted under Soul Company in 2010.
Cha Ga Eul is a South Korean singer under Monday Kiz Company. She is one half of the duo BAMLAD. She made her solo debut on September 2, 2017.

Cha Ki is a Japanese singer and a former member of the girl group SHA SHA. She joined SHA SHA in 2018 following the departures of I An, So Yeop, and Ga Ram. Cha Ki officially debuted with the group with the single album What The Heck. She remained with the group until its disbandment on July 17, 2019.
Cha SeungAh is a South Korean dancer and singer under 4X4 Creative and Silk Music. She is a member of the girl group and dance crew 4X4.
Cha Yeju is a South Korean trainee and actress. She is a former pre-debut member of the upcoming girl group WITCHERS.

Cha Yu Mi is a South Korean singer. She debuted in 1997 as a member of the Korean Pop girl group Baby V.O.X however she left on the next year. She returned to the United States and stayed there for several years before returning to Korea with her younger brother and forming the sibling duo LFBJ under her new stage name 'Lola Fair'. She uploads songs to her SoundCloud and works as a singer-songwriter. Yumi also runs an online jewelry site.
Chae Chae is a South Korean singer under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X.
Chae Eun is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the upcoming girl group ARVVY and a former member of the girl group Beauty Box.

Chae Eunjung, formerly known as Enjel, is a South Korean singer under Zes Entertainment and New X. She is a member of the girl group CLEO.She made her solo debut on February 26, 2007 with the studio album My Name Is Enjel. She was a member of Cpop girl group Girls Kingdom in Hong Kong. She was a contestant on Sing Again 3.

Chae Joo Hwa, formerly known as Lime, is a South Korean rapper, singer, and actress. She is a former member of the girl group HELLOVENUS under Fantagio Music. She made her HELLOVENUS debut on May 9, 2012, with the release of the group's first mini album 'Venus', going by the stage name Lime. Fantagio Music announced that HELLOVENUS would be disbanding after seven years on April 26, 2019. Additionally, they revealed Lime was still discussing renewing her contract with the agency. Fantagio then announced on July 12 on that same year that Lime had chosen to extend her contract and will be carrying on with her acting career under the stage name Chae Joo Hwa. In 2021, she was removed from the company's official artists page, signaling her departure.
Chae Min-hong is a South Korean rapper signed with Talented. She debuted in 2021 with the single "Watch".
Chae Ri Na is a Korean pop singer. She is a former member of the disbanded groups Roo'Ra and Diva, the supergroup BROS, and the duo Girl Friends. In 2011 she founded the fashion store Narina.
Chae Rin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Brand New Day.

Chae Ryujin, formely known as Ryujei, is a transgender South Korean singer turned influencer. She started her career as a back-up dancer and made appearances in girl group Berry Good's music videos. She was also a participant in the MNET survival program BOYS24. In February 2022, she made her official debut as a member of the boy group JWiiver. After the group disbanded, she started being active on social media. On July 18 2025, during an Instagram live, she officially came out as transgender.
Park Su Jeong was a South Korean singer, actress and model under Rose Entertainment. She was a former member of the girl group Cats.
Chae Soyeon is a South Korean singer under We Entertainment. She is a member of the 1st generation duo B.B.

Chae Suhyun is a South Korean trot singer under Cherish Village. She made her debut as a soloist on August 26, 2024 with the digital single "Bouquet". She is best known for being the winning contestant of Miss Trot 3.

Chae Won Bin is a South Korean actress known for her rising talent in the entertainment industry. She has gained recognition for her roles in various dramas, showcasing her versatility and strong screen presence. In Who Is She, she plays Choi Ha Na, a determined and hardworking trainee striving to debut as a K-pop idol. With her natural acting skills and captivating performances, Chae Won Bin continues to establish herself as a promising actress in the industry.

Chae Yeon is a South Korean solo artist who first debuted as a member of the Japanese girl group Brand New Biscuits in 2001. She released three Japanese singles and one mini album under the stage name Jinny before making her Korean solo debut in 2003 with the album "It's My Time". She is also an active artist in China under the agency Cài Entertainment.
Chae-i is a member of the girl group ICU under Liz Entertainment.
Chaea is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group UNICA.
ChaeA is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group TWEETY. She joined the group in 2018 and left in 2019.
Chaea is a South Korean singer One Music Office and LST Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MayLiz.
ChaeA, formerly Ian is a South Korean cellist. She was a member of the girl band LA.G.
Chaebin is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the girl group NATURE. She was a contestant on Produce 101.
ChaeE is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group A-Daily. She left the group in 2015.
Chaeeun is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group Crescendo and YJIG as Chaeni.

Yoon Chaeeun is a South Korean singer, dancer, and rapper under Starting House Entertainment. She made her official debut on May 9, 2023, as a member of the girl group ADYA. In September 2025, she was announced as a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Chaeeun is a South Korean trainee and dancer under Wannabe Entertainment. She is the maknae of the upcoming girl group B-OURS.
Chaeha is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group BaBa.
Ahn Chae Hee is the main rapper and maknae of the now-disbanded girl group SOL-T.
Chaehui is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Q6IX.
Chaehyun is a korean singer under Kids Planet (ON1 Entertainment and 4D Label). She is a member of the girl group Youngest.
Chaehyun is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group BONUSbaby.

Chaehyun is a South Korean singer and dancer currently signed to WAKEONE. She is best known as the winner of the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999, which led to her becoming a member of the project girl group Kep1er. Chaehyun made her official debut as a member of Kep1er on January 3, 2022, with the mini album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The debut received positive reception both in South Korea and internationally, further solidifying her place in the global kpop scene. Prior to joining Girls Planet 999, Chaehyun was a trainee under SM Entertainment for approximately six years. She joined the company during her second year of middle school, abandoning her public school education to focus on her training. However, Chaehyun left the company between 2019 and 2020, seeking new opportunities and continuing her pursuit of a career in music. In July 2021, Chaehyun participated in Girls Planet 999 as a member of K-Group. Her departure from SM Entertainment was discussed during the show's first episode, where she expressed her desire to prove that her six years of training had not been in vain. She initially ranked 23rd in K-Group and later secured a position in the Planet Top 9. By the show's finale on October 22, 2021, Chaehyun earned first place, amassing 1,081,182 points and 363,623 votes, securing her spot in the final lineup of Kep1er. In January 2022, Chaehyun expanded her role by being announced as one of the hosts of SBS MTV's The Show, marking her debut as an MC alongside her music career.

Chaei is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group LOVEONE. She is a former member of the girl group eite under EVA Entertainment, which she left on August 18, 2024 along with all the other members. During her time with the group, she had the stage name Chaehyun, which is also her birth name.

Chaei, sometimes referred to as Chae-2 is a South Korean singer. She made her debut as a member of the girl group Baby Boo in 2015 with "Boo Boo Boo".In 2016, after several months of absence, Hyunda Company confirmed Chaei, alongside Soli had left Baby Boo.

Chaein is a South Korean singer, dancer and rapper under RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”. Prior to her debut with the group, Chaein participated in the first and third seasons of the reality TV show "K-Pop Star".

Chaejeong is a South Korean singer under NMS. In 2018, she appeared and competed on the survival show Produce 48. She eventually made her official debut in 2020 after being added to the girl group ALICE, formerly known as ELRIS.
Chaejin is a South Korean rapper and dancer under S Media Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group LAYSHA and a former member of LXIA.

Chaekyung is a South Korean singer under DSP Media. She is a former member of the girl group APRIL, Puretty and project groups C.I.V.A and I.B.I. She first debuted with the group Puretty in August 2012 in Japan but the group disbanded in 2014. In 2014 she was in the survival show KARA Project to become a member of KARA but failed. She was also in the survival show Produce 101 and ranked 16th in the final round. She then later debuted in the project groups C.I.V.A and I.B.I. On November 11, 2016, DSP Media introduced her as a new member of APRIL along with Rachel after the departure of Hyunjoo at the end of October.
ChaeLin is a South Korean trainee and model under I-Star Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group New-L.

Chaelin is a South Korean rapper and actress. She is a former member of the girl group FANATICS. She was a contestant on Produce 101. She made her solo debut on February 19, 2024, with the digital single "Let It Snow".
Chaelyn is a South korean singer. She is a member of the girl group UiU. She was a contstant on Untact Idol Unit.

Chaena is a South Korean singer under WM Entertainment. She was revealed as the fifth member of USPEER on April 3, 2025. She made her debut with the group on June 4, 2025, with the release of their first single album called "SPEED ZONE".

Chaerang is a South Korean virtual entertainer and singer under 99Major. She made her debut as a singer on September 16, 2023, with the digital single "Dame Dame". On September 13, 2023, brand new virtual talent agency 99Major revealed Chaerang as their first artist and announced that she would also be their first artist to make a debut with the digital single "Dame Dame". She eventually made her debut with the release of the digital single on September 16, which included a Twitch broadcast event to mark her debut.
Chaeree is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Vetty-L.
Chaeree is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under 2sixT (260). She made her solo debut on May 4, 2020, with the digital single "Geojitmal."
Chaerin is a South Korean soprano, member of the girl group M.Diva. She is the vocal coach of Namyangju City Boys and Girls Choir.

Jung Chae Rin is a South Korean singer under Space Music Entertainment, a member of the girl group HI CUTIE and a former member of CutieL. She debuted as a soloist on October 29, 2019, with her first digital single, "Traveler."
Chaerin is a South Korean trainee under US Media Group. She is the maknae of the upcoming girl group KELT9b.

Chaerin is a singer from South Korea who is signed under MOAI Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group E11iVyn, she is also a former member of the girl group HeyGirls, the duo 1CHU and the girl group Puzzle.
Chaerin is a South Korean singer, lyricist and composer, member of the girl group PIU.

Park Chaerin, mononymously known as Chaerin is a South Korean dancer, rapper and singer under FNC Entertainment, FNC W and KM Entertainment. She was a member and the Main Dancer, Vocalist and Rapper of the South Korean girl group Cherry Bullet. On January 21, 2019, she made her official debut as a member of the South Korean girl group Cherry Bullet with the single mini album "Let's Play Cherry Bullet" with "Q & A" serving as the title track. In 2023, Chaerin was a constant of the survival of the Mnet's survival show "Queendom Puzzle". She was eliminated as she was ranked 26th.
Chaerin is a South Korean singer under KM Entertainment. She debuted as a member of the girl group ICHILLIN' on September 8, 2021 with the digital single "Got'ya"
Chaerin is a South Korean singer, rapper, and lyricist. She is a former member of the girl group MissMatch.

Lee Chaeryeong is a South Korean dancer, singer-songwriter, and composer under JYP Entertainment. She is best known as one of the main dancers of the girl group ITZY. Before making her debut, Chaeryeong, along with her older sister Chaeyeon, appeared as a contestant on the reality television competition show K-pop Star 3 on November 24, 2013. Despite getting eliminated, both sisters were able to become JYP Entertainment trainees after the show. A year later, as official trainees, both sisters then competed on the girl group survival show SIXTEEN—the same show where TWICE was created. However, Chaeryeong was eliminated in the final episode. Following the show's conclusion, Chaeryeong continued to train under the agency. On January 20, 2019, four years after her appearance in SIXTEEN, Chaeryeong was revealed to be a member of the girl group ITZY. The group officially debuted on February 12, 2019, with their debut single album "IT'z Different". She made her solo debut with "Mine" on the 25th of December 2023 in the album 'BORN TO BE'.
Chaesol is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups cignature and GOOD DAY and the sub unit MIDNIGHT and the pre-debut team i-Teen.
Chaewon, also known as Bliss, is a South Korean singer and DJ. She is best known as to a former member of the girl group Saturday. She currently works as a DJ under the name 'Bliss'
Chaewon is a South Korean singer and a member of the girl group Burvey.

Chaewon is a South Korean singer under M25. She gained recognition as a contestant on MBC's My Teenage Girl, where she placed seventh and debuted as a member of the girl group CLASS:y on May 5, 2022. She later released her first digital single, "Americano on a Rainy Day" on May 14, 2024.

Chaewon is a South Korean singer under Janggoon Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group APRIL. She made her solo debut on December 25, 2021 with the digital single "To the Memories of April". She was a contestant on KARA Project, Sing Again 3, and Girls On Fire. Chaewon also made her acting debut in the web drama "Reply Pyeongchang, 100°F” as the female lead character. She debuted as a member of April on August 24, 2015 with the mini-album Dreaming. On January 28, 2022, DSP Media announced that April has decided to disband after 6 years and go their separate ways. Since 2022, Chaewon has also been affiliated with KZ Entertainment (Japan) for overseas promotions.
Chaewon is a Korean trainee. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar.

ChaeWon is a South Korean singer and dancer under MODHAUS. On July 17, 2023, ChaeWon was announced as a contestant on the SBS survival show "Universe Ticket". She was eliminated during the second round, in the fourth episode. ChaeWon was introduced as the twenty-first member of the girl group tripleS on April 1, 2024. She debuted with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24". As a member of tripleS, ChaeWon was placed in the sub-unit Glow, Hatchi!, Alphie, and Sun.
Chaewon is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Chaewon is a South Korean singer and rapper under BLUEMOON Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MAKAMAKA.

ChaeY, formerly known as Chaeyeon, is a South Korean singer and lyricist. She was member and maknae of the girl group CRAXY (formerly known as Wish Girls) under SAI Entertainment. Through the 2018 winter project "Wish For You" from S.A ITAINMENTS, ChaeY was first presented as a trainee together with Karin and four other trainees who have since then left the company. She was known by her birth name Chaeyeon in the group until April 2019. She debuted under her stage name ChaeY on April 11. The music video for her pre-debut solo single "Sixteen" was made available on August 30, 2019 which featured Woo-ah, Karin and Swan. On July 31, 2023, ChaeY left CRAXY due to the company’s decision.

ChaeYeon is a South Korean singer, dancer, rapper, actress, and model under MODHAUS. In 2008, ChaeYeon made her debut as a child actress in the movie "Scandal Makers". From 2014 to 2017, she was a member of the kid group CutieL under IONE Entertainment. She then debuted as a member of Busters under JTG Entertainment and Marbling E&M on November 27, 2017, with the single album "Dream On". Her departure from the group was announced by Marbling E&M on August 6, 2020. ChaeYeon was introduced as the fourth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on June 22, 2022. She debuted with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE". As a member of tripleS, ChaeYeon was placed in the sub-units +(KR)ystal Eyes, ACID EYES, EVOLution, Aria, Hatchi!, and Sun.
Chaeyeong is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group SUPA. She joined the group in 2017 for their "도도하지만" comeback.
Chaeyi is a South Korean alto. She is one of the four members of the opera girl group M.Diva, which had been active since 2011, yet officially debuted in 2021.

Lee Chaeyoung is a South Korean dancer, rapper, singer-songwriter under ASND. She was one of the main dancers and the lead rapper of the girl group fromis_9. In 2017, Chaeyoung appeared and competed in the show "Idol School" where she ranked 4th with 65,318 votes, earning a spot in the group fromis_9. Chaeyoung debuted as a member of fromis_9 on January 24, 2018, with the mini album To. Heart.

Son Chaeyoung is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and dancer under JYP Entertainment. She is best known as the main rapper of the sensational girl group TWICE. She became a contestant on JYP's survival show, SIXTEEN in May of 2015 where she secured her spot as a member of TWICE. They officially debuted on October 20, 2015, with their first mini-album, "The Story Begins". Chaeyoung became the first member to receive writing credits when she wrote the rap verse for Twice's version of J.Y Park's Precious Love, as part of their 2016 release Page Two. Moreover, Chaeyoung designed the group's limited edition Page Two album cover and also designed three different pairs of SPRIS shoes. Chaeyoung made her solo debut on September 12, 2025, with her first full album "LIL FANTASY vol.1".

Chaeyoung is a South Korean singer under Kim Youngmin Productions. She is a member of the kids girl group, Sunshine, to which she was added in 2021. Chaeyoung first release with the group was the mini album "Sunshine", released on April 9, 2021.

Chahee is a South Korean singer under Different Company. She was a member of the girl group Melody Day. In 2017, she and fellow members Yeoeun and Yoomin, participated in KBS 2TV's idol rebooting show The Unit, and finished in 16th place. She made her solo debut on May 6, 2020 with her digital single "Puzzle".
Chai, born Lee Soo-jeong is a Korean-American rapper and singer who debuted under Antenna in 2019.
Chai is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Ye-A, and GP Basic as Leah.
Park Chanhee is a member of ON1 Rookies a.k.a Sweet Villian under ON1 Entertainment, Their debut date is still unknown

Chanelle Moon Thomas is a South Korean-American singer, dancer, and composer under ATTRAKT. Best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY, she was revealed as a member on August 12, 2024, and debuted with the group on August 30, 2024, with the pre-release single "Starry Night". Prior to debuting, she competed in the survival show "R U Next?" in June 2023, placing 11th and being eliminated in episode 9.
Chanjuicy is a South Korean singer under Beautiful Noise. She debuted on October 30, 2017, with a single “Starlight”.

Mina Otomonai, known professionally as Chanmina, is a trilingual Korean-Japanese rapper, singer-songwriter and producer. She officially debuted as a soloist on April 18, 2016, independently, before releasing her major label debut album 'Miseinen' in 2017. Born to a Korean mother and Japanese father, she has a background in ballet, from her mother who was a ballerina. She cites BIGBANG as one of her major musical influences. After she discovered their song "Haru Haru", she quit piano and ballet and began to take Hip-Hop dance lessons. Due to her unique blend of languages in music, she has collaborated with many artists globally, including Rina Sawayama, Saweetie, Taeyeon, Kang Daniel, Yena and more. In May 2019 she became the first Japanese artist to appear in the Asian version of Yo! MTV Raps produced by MTV Asia. Chanmina is also active as an audition producer and judge. Between 2024-2025, she participated as a co-producer with SKY-HI & BMSG for the girl group audition program ‘No No Girls’, to form BMSG's first girl group, HANA. The audition sought out hopefuls who had been rejected or told no by the entertainment industry, society or themselves. On July 7, 2024, she announced her marriage to South Korean rapper ASH ISLAND. They welcomed their daughter in November.

Chanty is a Filipino-Argentinian singer, actress, and model under MLD Entertainment and Sparkle. On June 20, 2022, she debuted as a member of Lapillus with the single “Hit Ya!”. Prior to this, she was an actress in the Philippines, acting in shows like "Spirits, Reawaken" and "Starla". Currently, Chanty is in hiatus due to health reasons. She has been diagnosed with Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
Chany is a South Korean former singer. She was a member of the Korean Pop girl groups MOA, 4L and Ureka.
Charlott is a Hong Kongese singer under Echo Entertainment and Number K Entertainment. She debuted as a member of the project group SMORZ on May 19, 2025.

ChaTone, formerly known as Chaewon, Tina, and XOi is a South Korean singer-songwriter under DaL LaLa Network. She is a former member of the girl groups S2 and VNT.She made her solo debut on February 8, 2017 with the single "Walkin' Alone".
Chayou is a South Korean singer, model, and DJ. She is a former member of the girl group Heart.
Chealin is a South Korean singer under Midum Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group AWESOME.
Cheery is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group IROPIRO. She was a member of H!bana.

Cheetah is a South Korean rapper under XX Entertainment and MNEPLUS Media. She was a part of the duo's Blacklist and Masterpiece. She made her solo debut on June 27, 2014, with the mini album "Cheetah Itself".

Cheeze, also known as Dalchong is a South Korean singer under Magic Strawberry Sound. She is a member of the project group CSVC. She was a member of Cheeze. After all the members except her left the group, she decided to use the group’s name as her stage name. She released her first solo single on February 20, 2017.
Chehee is a South Korean singer under New Planet Entertainment. She is the main vocalist of the girl group H.U.B. She joined the group in 2018 following the departures of Gracie, Yuem, and Keina.
Chelsea is a South Korean retired singer and model. She is a former member of the girl group Tinus.
Chemi is a retired South Korean singer and former member of the girl group C-REAL.
Chen Xinwei is a Taiwanese singer under Yue Hua Entertainment, member of the girl group member of DAYLIGHT. She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999 and a contestant on Youth With You 2.

Cheng Xiao is a Chinese singer, dancer, and actress under under Yue Hua Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group WJSN and the project groups Y TEEN and Sunny Girls. Cheng Xiao debuted as a member of WJSN on February 25, 2016, with the mini album "WOULD YOU LIKE?". In the group's concept, she represented the Cancer sign. On March 3, 2023, after five years of inactivity with the group, it was announced that Cheng Xiao didn't renew her contract with Starship Entertainment and would officially leave WJSN to pursue solo activities in China. The same year as her debut, she also took part in the project group Y TEEN, which was composed of the seven MONSTA X members, as well as seven WJSN members, and debuted on August 6, 2016, with the single "Do Better". She was also a member of Inkigayo's Music Crush project Sunny Girls, with whom she released the song 'TAXI' on November 27, 2016. Cheng Xiao didn't gain popularity, however, until she competed and won gold in ISAC (Idol Championship) in their Rhythmic Gymnastics segment as well as being proclaimed the first Pitch King. She would then go on to join variety shows both in Korea and China. In 2018, Cheng Xiao went back to China to be a dance mentor on the music survival show, Idol Producer. She slowly transitioned to become an actress with her first drama projects "Legend of Awakening" and "Detective Chinatown", which were both released in 2020, and continued her acting career with the 2021 hit esports drama "Falling Into Your Smile". Cheng Xiao then made her Chinese solo debut on December 28, 2020, with the digital single "Focus-X".
Cheon Uri is a South Korean singer who debuted on February 4, 2023 with the single "Graduation".

Cheong Eum is a South Korean singer under W2 Company. She was a pre-debut member of the dance team turned Kpop group BLINDZ. She debuted as a member of the girl group Bunny.T in June 2023. In 2019, Cheong Eum debuted as a member of the girl group API. However, after years of inactivity, it is presumed that API had disbanded.
Cheong-ah is an American producer and composer under Megameta. She is part of the virtual group IXIA as leader and producer.

Cheris is a Singaporean singer, actress, and model. She was a member of the girl group GBB. She was supposed to debut in Princess (disbanded), and Lovelossom with Idol School’s Jo Youngjoo. She was the lead for “Love in Transit, Priority Seat”. Cheris was in a beauty pageant in Singapore in 2016.
Cherry is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups HINT and TURAN.

Cherry Coke is a South Korean R&B singer-songwriter and composer. In 2014, she originally debuted under her real name Sunkyung with the single "Beautiful Things" with the rapper Eun-P. She was then signed to CJ E&M where she put out the single "Up" in 2017.

Cherry Pink is a South Korean singer under Daebak Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group Melody Pink as Li-G. She left the group in early 2018. She made her solo debut on February 22, 2016 as Li-G with the single "This Again". She’s an active YouTuber and Twitch streamer under the name Nanaru. She uploads covers of anime songs since February 17, 2019.
Jeong Su-ji, better known as CherryB, is a South Korean singer. She made her solo debut on November 29, 2017 with the digital single "Her".

CherryBerry is a South Korean singer currently under 5 Corps Music. She is the former leader and main vocalist of the girl group VIVIDIVA, under the stage name Guu Me!, from 2015 until 2016 when the group disbanded. After the group's disbandment, she debuted as a soloist under the new stage name CherryBerry on March 28, 2017, with the digital single, "I'm Fine Now".
Cheryl is a South Korean-American singer and a former member of the girl group Chocolate.

Cheska is a Korean-American Twitch streamer and former singer. She is best known as a former singer of FIESTAR. She left the group in 2014 due to personal reasons. She debuted as a solo artist on October 25, 2016 with the digital single "Swish". On May 29, 2018, she revealed through her Instagram account that she would no longer be in the music industry.
Chi Chi is a South Korean rapper. She was a member of the co-ed group Play the Siren.

Chiayi is a Taiwanese singer and dancer. She is a former member of the girl group FANATICS and its sub unit FLAVOR. She is also known for participating in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999.

Chiba Erii is a Japanese singer. She is a member of AKB48. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 33rd place. She participated in Mnet reality show UHSN as a Japanese representative.
Chika, born Choi Hyun-jin is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Luminant Entertainment in 2022.
Chikko, born Chae Eun-joo is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Aliment Record in 2014.
Chio Chicano is a South Korean rapper signed with Talented. She debuted in 2023 with the single "Like What Like That".

femaleIdols.description: Riracha Phondechaphiphat, known under her stage name Chiquita, is a Thai singer, rapper and dancer under YG Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group BABYMONSTER. She made her official debut on November 27, 2023 with the group's digital single "Batter Up".

Kondou Chisa is a Japanese singer, dancer, model, and actress under XGALX. She is best known as the main vocalist, sub-leader and the oldest member of the Japanese global girl group XG. Prior to joining XGALX, Chisa was active under Kansai Collection Entertainment as an actress and model. And rather than passing the audition, Chisa felt more of a conviction to blast through it. She said that she felt that her entire life had led her to that moment. Chisa was revealed as XG's second member on January 30, 2022. The group made their debut on March 18 of the same year with their first song, "Tippy Toes".
ChiU is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group C.L.O.

Chiyo is a South Korean singer and a former member of the live idol girl group KAWANARI. She was an original member of KAWANARI and debuted with them on March 19, 2023. She graduated from the group on April 29, 2023. Her birth year is unknown, but the date is September 3.
Chloe is a Hong Kong singer and actress under Rising Sun Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group As One. She joined the group in April 2015.

Chloe is a South Korean singer formerly under C9 Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group cignature. She joined the group on June 14th, 2021, following the departure of Haeun and Sunn. She later made her debut with the group on November 30 with their second EP "Dear Diary Moment". Chloe is currently pursuing a degree in data science, she is a student at the esteemed University of Michigan, which is among the top colleges in the United States.

Chloe is a South Korean trainee under Shinwha Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group NEXTU. She is a former member of the pre-debut groups Siesta and Z GIRLS and the girl group of Melody Pink.

Chloe is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group K-Girls. She left the group shortly after the MV for Fly High was released; as a result, her parts were edited out of the official video.
Chloe is a Chinese singer under World K-Pop Center. She is a member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China.

Chloe Doung, known under her stage name Chloe Young, is a South Korean-Canadian rapper, dancer, and songwriter under BPM Entertainment. She is best known as the leader of the girl group BADVILLAIN.
