Dahae, formerly known as Chunghae is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Diawings. On May 12th, 2024 Diawings announced that she'll use her real name instead of the stage name 'Chunghae' which she used before.
Dahae is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar.
Daham is a South Korean singer born sometime in the year 1983. She was a member of the girl duo Foxy.

DAHEE is a singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Craft And Jun. She made her solo debut on February 14, 2020 with the digital single "Luh!". She has been uploading covers to her SoundCloud account since 2019.
Dahee is a South Korean singer. She used to be a member of the girl group Q.O.S. She left the group on September 1, 2020.
Dahee is a South Korean keyboardist. She was a member of the girl band LA.G.
Dahee is a member of the girl group Bambino.
Dahlia Kim is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted on December 1, 2020 with the single album Ocean Wave.

Dahye is a South Korean singer, rapper, and YouTuber. She was previously a member of the girl group BESTie. She made her debut solo with the single, "Poison," on October 10, 2020. She left Worldstar Ent. in 2021 and is currently active as an independent singer.
Dahye is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Kassia. She left the group before the official debut, in the middle of recording the debut song, for personal reasons.
Hong Dahye is a South Korean singer and songwriter, member of the co-ed rock band OurR. She was a contestant on Star Awakening.
Dahye is a South Korean singer under TigerLily Entertainment, member of the girl duo PCDM. She was a member of I.C.E.

DaHyun is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS. DaHyun was introduced as the tenth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on December 3, 2022. She made her debut with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE". As a member of tripleS, DaHyun was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Aria, and Neptune.
Dahyun is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group ILUV.

Kim Dahyun is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and dancer under JYP Entertainment. She is best known as the lead rapper of the sensational girl group TWICE. Before making her official debut, Dahyun used to be a member of their church's choir group. Besides performing in church, she also used to participate in dance festivals which was where she was scouted by a JYP Entertainment staff. After the passing the audtion, she became an official trainee. In 2015, she participated in the survival show SIXTEEN where she became one of the winners, securing her spot in the group TWICE. They officially debuted on October 20, 2015, with their first mini album "The Story Begins".

Dahyun is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. She is the maknae of the girl group Rocket Punch. On July 23, 2019, Woollim Entertainment released a concept film showing the six members of their new girl group, Rocket Punch, for the first time, with Dahyun being one of them. On July 24, her solo concept film was released. She debuted as the maknae of Rocket Punch on August 7, 2019 with the mini album Pink Punch.

Dain is a South Korean trainee under S2 Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group HOT ISSUE. She was a contestant on CAP-TEEN where she ranked #43. Dain debuted as a member of Hot Issue on April 28, 2021 with the mini album "Issue Maker". On April 22, 2022, after 4 months of no updates, S2 Entertainment announced that the group has officially disbanded, 6 days before their debut anniversary. The decision was made after a long period of discussion about their future and direction of the group.
Dain is a South Korean singer and a member of the girl duo Coda Bridge. She became part of the duo in December 2022.
Dain is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of MOA. She joined shortly after Yui and Zelli’s departure and left the group the same year.
Dain is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups S The One, SIX BOMB, and ZZBest where she went by her birth name, Dayoung.
Dain is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Wassup.
Dain is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl duo Black Eye.
Daisy is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter. She debuted as a soloist on July 14, 2021 with the digital single, "Sleigh".
Daisy, formerly known as Hayoon, is a South Korean singer, cheerleader and model under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X.

Daisy is a South Korean singer and former member of the girl group MOMOLAND, previously managed by MLD Entertainment. She joined the group in 2017 but officially departed on May 13, 2020. Daisy became a subject of public attention following a KBS News 9 interview aired on January 7, 2020. In the segment, she alleged that Finding Momoland, the survival show that formed the group, had been manipulated, claiming her inclusion was pre-decided and that members were later billed for production expenses. She also revealed a dispute with her agency, stating she was barred from group promotions since May 2019 and was asked to pay a 1.1 billion won penalty when she requested contract termination. MLD Entertainment denied these claims, labeling them one-sided. Legal proceedings followed, and on October 10, 2021, the Seoul Central District Court ruled in Daisy’s favor. The court ordered MLD to pay her over 92 million won in unpaid earnings and damages. MLD subsequently filed an appeal the next day, continuing the legal dispute.

Dajeong is a South Korean singer, rapper and model under Zes Entertainment. She is the maknae of the girl group CLEO and the former leader of the girl group Hashtag and its sub-unit PURPLE. She was a contestant on the survial show Produce 101, where she represented Hello Music Entertainment. She was a former Annyung Music Entertainment trainee.
Dakyung is a South Korean singer and model under LCH Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group PRISM.
Jung Dakyung is a South Korean singer under Kpop Live Entertainment. She made her official debut in 2021 as the main vocalist and main dancer of the girl group Hi-L.
Dal is a South Korean singer, model, actress, and lyricist member of the girl group Half Moon. She is the CEO of Estudio Klang.
Dal U (달유) is a South Korean singer who debuted on December 12, 2022 with the single "너를 위한 달".
Dalia is an Algerian-Tunisian influencer and trainee. She is currently a contestant on the upcoming survival show "TIME TURNER".
DALSIA is a South Korean streamer and singer who made her singing debut on December 15, 2021 with "WINTER LOVE".

DALsooobin is a soloist and a member of Dal Shabet under her own company DalSooobin Company and A2Z Entertainment. She debuted with the single ‘Flower’ on May 12, 2016. Subin is a member of Dal Shabet. She is best known for her height. Subin’s contract with Happy Face Entertainment expired in December 2017. She has left Happy Face entertainment, however it is possible Dalshabet may participate in activities together in the future. As of 2019 Subin is in a new one-man label called "DALSOOOBIN COMPANY" and has released her first single under the stage name DALsooobin, called "Katchup". On July 28, 2023, she had signed an exclusive contract with A2Z Entertainment to resume activities as a DJ under the name DJ SUVIN. On April 11, 2025, Subin has been identified as a member of the upcoming EDM girl group OSDS
Lee So-hyun, also known as Dalyn, is a South Korean rapper. She used to be the lead rapper and lead dancer of the girl group ANS before they eventually disbanded in 2020.
Dam E is a South Korean singer under JZ Factory Entertainment. She was a member of DICE.
Dam I is a South Korean dancer, dance teacher and former singer. She is a former member of the girl group ANS.

Damhee is a South Korean singer and dancer under AB Creative, member of the girl group ARTBEAT and the co-ed dance crew ARTBEAT. She joined the agency AB Creative in 2020 or earlier where she was active as a dancer in their dance group 'AB' (also called AB Project) and also as a soloist dance performer.

Dami is a South Korean singer under MOAI Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group HeyGirls. She joined the group in June 2020. On December 16, 2020, after the introduction of a new HeyGirls member Chaerin, it was announced that Dami, will be going on hiatus for unspecified reasons and won't be taking part in the groups upcoming release "I Cook". She hasn't been active since.

Dami is a South Korean rapper, dancer, and singer under Dreamcatcher Company. She first debuted on September 18, 2014 as the maknae of the girl group MINX with the digital single "Why Did You Come To My Home?". On November 29, 2016, it was announced that MINX would be rebranding as Dreamcatcher while keeping the five member from the original lineup. Dami redebuted with Dreamcatcher on January 13, 2017 with the release of the single "Nightmare". In October 2017, Dami participed on the YG survival show MIXNINE under her birth name, Lee Yubin. However, she left the show on December 10 due to scheduling conflicts.
Dami was a member of the pre-debut lineup of the girl group HIGH SCHOOL.
Dami is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BIKINY. She joined the group in 2013.
Dami is a South Korean BJ, singer, dancer and model. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group Just COLOR. She’s a member of the dance teams StarFruit and SOONIGROUP.
Damini is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Mine Field in 2022.
DamYui is a virtual singer and dancer under Project [i]. She debuted as a member of the group HONEYZ on August 30, 2024, with the single "Ready 2 Be Loved",
Dana is a South Korean singer and DJ under HANDMADE and KMG, member of the girl group POA.
Dana is a Korean Pop singer and actress. She has released two solo albums in and is currently part of the group Chun Sang Ji Hee The Grace and the unit Chun Sang Ji Hee Dana & Sunday.

Han Dana is a South Korean trainee under EVA Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group ViV. She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999 but got eliminated in episode 5. Her individual rank was K32.
Dana, also known as Kim Dana is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group MISS T. She’s also a solo singer. She made her solo debut in 2010 with the digital single album, "Regular Installment".

Dana is a South Korean trainee and former child actress under S2 Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group HOT ISSUE. Dana debuted as a member of Hot Issue on April 28, 2021 with the mini album "Issue Maker". On April 22, 2022, after 4 months of no updates, S2 Entertainment announced that the group has officially disbanded, 6 days before their debut anniversary. The decision was made after a long period of discussion about their future and direction of the group.
Danah is a South Korean rapper, member of the girl group New. F.O.. She is the younger sister of Mino (Winner).
DanB is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group TREN-D.
Dan Bee is a Korean singer. She is a former member of the Korean Pop girl group D.HOLIC.
Danbi is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group, "Like Me".

Danbi is a South Korean BJ and singer. She is a member of the dance crew SOONIGROUP. She was known for being a pre-debut member of the girl group Moonlight Girls as well as a pre-debut member of the YOURS project under Deep Studio Entertainment.
Danbi is a Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Dorothy. On February 13 2017, Danbi officially left the group due to personal reasons.

Danielle Kim is a Korean-American former trainee, singer, and actress. She is best known for being a contestant on the South Korean survival show Produce 101 (Season 1), represnting MBK Entertainment. Dani was eliminated in epsiode 10 ranking #24 place. In May 2012, Dani was revealed as the new member of the South Korean girl group, T-ARA. However, due to controversies, she unfortunately did not debut with the group. In 2013, Dani joined T-ARA's sub-unit, T-ARA N4 as a temporary member. Later, MBK Entertainment removed her from the group due to controversy.

Dani is a British singer and rapper under FrontRow Records. She is a former member and rapper of the London-based girl group KAACHI. Prior to joining KAACHI, Dani was a member of the London-based Kpop dance cover group, UJJN, along with fellow KAACHI members Nicole and Chunseo.

Daniela Avanzini is a Cuban/Venezuelan-American dancer, singer, and rapper under Geffen Records and HYBE Labels. She is best known as a member of the global girl group KATSEYE. Daniela is recognized for her participation in the survival show "The Debut: Dream Academy", where she ranked 3rd and qualified for debut, becoming a member of the girl group KATSEYE. On August 16, 2024, Daniela officially debuted as a member of KATSEYE with their first EP "SIS (SOFT IS STRONG)". Prior to this, she participated in America’s Got Talent Season 8, SuperKids Europe, and So You Think You Can Dance.

Danielle June Marsh is a Australian-South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and voice actress under ADOR and HYBE Labels. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group NewJeans. Although born in Australia, Danielle briefly lived in Korea where she became a child model and appeared in reality programs with her family. After her return to Australia, Danielle continued to take on entertainment challenges, such as festivals and musicals, while pursuing her education. She later moved back to Korea as an idol trainee, eventually leading to her debut as a member of NewJeans. Danielle was a former YG Entertainment during her middle school years and after leaving attended Def Dance Academy briefly in Seoul where she trained in vocals and dance. She then passed Source Music audition in July 2020, and then transferred to ADOR at the end of 2021. On July 22, 2022, Danielle officially debuted as a member of NewJeans with their self-titled mini debut album "NewJeans". Besides group activities with NewJeans, Danielle also participated in numerous brand endorsements and other solo activities. In May 2023, Danielle made her big screen debut as the Korean voice actress of the iconic character Ariel, from the Disney film "The Little Mermaid." She also released her rendition of the song "Part of Your World" as part of the movie's official soundtrack. She is also the younger sister of Olivia Marsh.
Danko is a South Korean singer and a member of the group YUBiKiRi, added on the 7th of December.
Danmi is a Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group My Darling.
Dagwoo is a South Korean singer, rapper and DJ. She was a pre-debut member of the girl group AGirls & a former member of the band Kiwi Band M.
Dany is a South Korean singer under BRICKWORKS Company. She is a member and the maknae of the girl group API.
Daon is a South Korean singer, member of the project girl group DAHLIA. She is a former member of the girl groups YULiONi and Baby Boo.

Daon is a South Korean singer under WM Entertainment. She was revealed as the third member of USPEER on April 3, 2025. She made her debut with the group on June 4, 2025, with the release of their first single album called "SPEED ZONE".

Sandara Park, also known simply as Dara, is a South Korean singer, actress, and television host. She is widely recognized for her tenure with the influential K-pop girl group 2NE1, which was managed by YG Entertainment. As of September 1, 2021, she is affiliated with ABYSS Entertainment. Dara’s foray into the entertainment industry began with her participation in the Filipino talent show “Star Circle Quest” in 2004, where she emerged as the runner-up. Capitalizing on her newfound popularity, she released her debut mini-album titled “Sandara” in April of the same year, marking her solo debut. Her career trajectory took a significant turn when she ventured into the K-pop scene with the debut of 2NE1 on May 6, 2009. The group quickly rose to prominence and became one of the most iconic names in K-pop history. Following the expiration of her contract with YG Entertainment, Dara signed with ABYSS Company on September 1, 2021. She continued to make strides in her solo career and, on June 23, 2023, announced the upcoming release of her self-titled Korean-language extended play (EP), “Sandara Park,” later released on July 12, 2023.
Darae, formerly known as Di, is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups RaNia but left in 2016.
Dareum is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group ACE.
Darin is a South Korean singer. She was a pre-debut member of the Korean pop female duo HIGHCOLOR.

Daru, also known as Jiyun is a South Korean singer under A Flat Entertainment. She is a member of the duo E.RUDA and was a member of the girl group Bloomy. She made her solo debut on October 15, 2019 with the digital single "Secret Crush".
Daseul is a South Korean singer and actress under BLUEMOON Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MAKAMAKA.

Dasom is a South Korean singer and actress. She is best known as a former member of South Korean girl group Sistar under Starship Entertainment. She has acted in films and television dramas, including Family (2012–2013), Melody of Love (2013–2014) and The Virtual Bride (2015).
Dasom is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group 2EYES.
Dasom is a South Korean singer, she was a member of the girl group HANA.
Dasom is a South Korean singer, dancer, and former member of the girl group GROW.B and the dance group BETTER SWAGG.

Davin is a South Korean trainee signed with Liz Entertainment. She was part of the upcoming pre-debut girl group ZeroSix, now known as WE-SAY. She formerly went under the name Yeji as a trainee at Deep Studio Entertainment in 2020. Unfortunately, she wasn’t able to secure a spot in the trainee group YOURS, thus leaving the company the same year.
Dawn Lee is a South Korean singer and actress under Bean Entertainment. She is a member of the girl duo MoonyCuumy. She made her solo debut on August 1, 2020.
Dawon is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group ARIAZ.

Nam Da Won is the Main Vocalist of the Girl Group Cosmic Girls under Starship Entertainment and she represents the Aries sign in the groups concept. Aside from singing, Dawon can also play the piano and guitar. She was revealed as a member of WJSN on December 31, 2015 as part of the group's Natural Unit. The group officially debuted on February 25, 2016 with their first mini album Would You Like?. In 2020, Dawon was cast as a lead in the musical movie K-School. The release of the film was originally scheduled for December of 2020, but currently there is no confirmation as to when the release will be rescheduled due to controversy involving a cast member. On December 12, 2019, Starship Entertainment released a statement stating that after receiving a detailed examination and treatment at the hospital, Dawon was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder. As a result, it was announced that she will be going on a hiatus to focus on treatment and recovery. On February 22, 2022, Starship Entertainment announced that after discussing with Dawon and hearing the opinions of specialized medical institutions, it was agreed that she should focus on treatment for her anxiety and will be taking a break from group activities to focus on her health. Because of this, Dawon was unable to participate with her groupmates in Queendom 2. On March 3, 2023, she, alongside Luda, would have their contracts ultimately terminated with Starship Entertainment following its expiration.

Dawon is a South Korean singer under Kim Youngmin Productions. She is a member of the kids girl group Sunshine, in which she was formerly known as Chaeah. She made her debut with the group on August 20, 2019 with the release of the single "Now Let's Reduce". On October 18, 2021, she debuted as a soloist with the release of the digital single "One Pick".
Dawoon is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Pastel Girl. She was a contestant on Miss Trot 2.
Day is a South Korean singer under ONO Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group A.iRiD.
Jung Daya is a South Korean singer formely under Doo Republic. She is a former member of the disbanded girl groups 84LY and A.KOR.

Daya, formerly known as Hana, is a South Korean singer, dancer, model, and live-streamer on the platform AfreecaTV. She is a member of the South Korean girl group Fly With Me and was a member and Vocalist of the South Korean girl group Black Bunny under the name Hana under LA Entertainment. She originally debuted in the South Korean girl group Black Bunny on June 3, 2019, with the digital single "Oh! My God". Black Bunny silently disbanded in 2020. On February 4, 2021, she debuted as a member of the South Korean girl group Fly With Me.
Daye is a South Korean singer under One Music Office and LST Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MayLiz.
Dayeon is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group ii.

Dayeon is a South Korean singer under Liz Entertainment. She was the maknae of the girl group Chic Angel and of project girl group Chic&Is. She, along with Sia, joined the group in 2018 following the departures of Bomi and Sya Sya. She made her solo debut on October 18, 2019 with the digital single "Re Born".

Dayeon is a South Korean dancer, singer, and rapper currently signed to Jellyfish Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the South Korean girl group Kep1er, formed through the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999. Dayeon first gained attention in 2018 when she participated in Mnet's Produce 48. Despite showcasing her skills, she was eliminated in the fifth episode, placing 70th overall. In 2021, Dayeon returned to the survival show scene by joining Girls Planet 999, where she represented the K-Group. She performed a cover of "Pop/Stars" by K/DA for her evaluation, though she was not initially selected as a TOP9 candidate. Throughout the competition, Dayeon consistently ranked highly, finishing in 4th place during the finale with 885,286 points and 219,125 votes, securing her spot as a member of Kep1er. On January 3, 2022, Dayeon officially debuted as a member of Kep1er with their first mini-album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group’s debut was well-received, marking the beginning of Dayeon’s active career in the kpop industry.
Dayeon is a South Korean singer. She is a former member and the leader of the girl group XUM and NeonPunch.
Dayoung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HADY.

Dayoung is a member of the girl group Cosmic Girls/WJSN and she represents the Taurus sign in the groups concept. Seola, Dayoung, Exy, Eunseo, Cheng Xiao, Soobin, and Yeoreum are in YTeen which is the Starship unit with Monsta X. She was a contestant on K-Pop Star 1. She debuted as a member of WJSN on February 25, 2016 and the sub unit WJSN Chocome on October 7, 2020. On September 9, 2025, she made her solo debut with the digital single 'Gonna love me, right?'.
Dayoung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Blady. She joined the group in late 2014.
Dayoung is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups A-Plus and OUIGEE as MuA.
Dayoung is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group Sunny Days.
Dayoung is a South Korean trainee known for being a pre-debut member of the YOURS project under Deep Studio Entertainment.

Dayul, formerly known as Dabin, is a South Korean singer, member of the project girl group DAHLIA. She is a former member of the pre-debut girl groups YULiONi and Crescendo, and the girl group Baby Boo.In 2017, she appeared in the South Korean television show, The Unit, as a contestant.
Dayul is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BaBa.
Dayun is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group BONUSbaby.

Dazbee is a South Korean singer under Accelers. She made her debut as a soloist singer on March 2, 2022, in Japan with the digital single "Koeno Arika". She later also debuted in Korean music with the digital single, "Bambi", released on October 11, 2022.
Daze is a South Korean singer under Forbest Entertainment and Midas Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group CrazAngel.
Dchi is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group SONOKI.

DD! is a South Korean soloist. She made her solo debut on September 20, 2017, with the album “DOT”. She is a former member of the girl group Ye-A and it's sub-unit girl duo My-B. She originally debuted as a singer in My-B duo on September 25, 2013.
DDDDragon is a singer under Project [i]. She debuted as a member of the group HONEYZ on August 30, 2024 with the single "Ready 2 Be Loved".

De_Hana is a Japanese singer under NTT Docomo Studio & Live and Sony Music Entertainment Korea. In 2023, De_Hana was a contestant on Produce 101 Japan The Girls. She was eliminated in episode 10 after ranking 30th place. She is a member of the global girl group cosmosy, with whom she debuted on December 31, 2024 in Japan and February 7, 2025 globally with the digital single "zigy=zingy", and later officially on April 11, 2025 with the digital single "Lucky=One".
December is a Swedish trainee. She was a member of the upcoming global girl group NWH:I. December was the seventh member revealed on January 20, 2025.
Deesee is a Russian dancer. She was a member of the project girl group UHSN under Stone Music Entertainment.
Deina is a South Korean singer, and member of the girl group SRZN.
Delta is a South korean singer, member of the pre-debut girl group QODES. She was a member of the girl group AZM as Yukyung.

Denise is a South Korean-American singer-songwriter signed under CDNZA Records. She is a former member of the girl group SECRET NUMBER. Denise first gained attention as a contestant on the competition show K-pop Star 5. After the show, she joined YG Entertainment as a trainee in May 2016 but left the company in 2018 after two years. She debuted as a member of SECRET NUMBER on May 19, 2020, with the single album "Who Dis?". On September 29, 2021, Vine Entertainment announced that Denise would not participate in the group’s upcoming comeback due to contract negotiations. This announcement was followed by the reveal of the group's comeback, Fire Saturday, on October 27, 2021, with the addition of two new members. On February 5, 2022, Denise confirmed her departure from SECRET NUMBER and Vine Entertainment through an Instagram post. She made her solo debut on December 29, 2022, with the EP "Me Before You".

DeVita, formerly known as Chloe DeVita is a South Korean hip-hop soloist who debuted under Jay Park's label AOMG in 2020. Her stage name, ‘DeVita’ is derived from the movie Cinema Paradiso’s main character ‘Salvatore Di Vita’ and Argentina’s former first lady ‘Evita Peron’, representing her desire to inspire and influence listeners’ lives through her vibrantly colored music. DeVita started gaining attention after releasing several unique and soulful tracks through SoundCloud. She has proven boundless artistic potential by collaborating with multiple artists such as Jay Park of AOMG, H1GHR MUSIC, Roc Nation and more, who has now signed her to his globally successful label. In 2012, she appeared in the reality show "K-POP STAR" when she was 16 years old. In 2014, she participated on the show "Kollaboration Chicago" and ended up as the runner up.
DEW is a South Korean singer. She made her debut with the single, “From The Love” on 19 July, 2022.
Dia (stylized as DIA) is a South Korean singer under Broadway. She debuted as a soloist in 2009 with her first single album "0Carat". She was also a former member of the girl group Kiss&Cry.

Dia is a South Korean dancer, singer, and rapper under ALLART Entertainment. She made her debut as a member of the girl group PIXY on February 24, 2021 with the release of their first single, "Wings".
Dia is a South Korean singer and rapper under BLUEMOON Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MAKAMAKA and sub-unit envi DIA.

Dai Meng is a Chinese idol singer. She graduated from the Chinese idol group SNH48 (Team SII) and is an active member of its sub-unit, 7SENSES, under STAR48. In 2020, she participated in the Chinese idol survival show Youth With You 2 and ranked 15th. On July 16, 2023, Dai Meng announced on her official Weibo account that on July 7, 2023, she had filed a lawsuit against her company, Siba Media, and had applied for labor dispute arbitration. She also stated that due to this lawsuit having an NDA, she cannot share more information with fans about where she stands or her future with Siba Media and STAR48.

Diana was a South Korean singer and rapper. She was a member and the rapper, vocalist, and former maknae of the South Korean girl group A-Daily under DK Entertainment. She debuted as an original member of A-Daily on the 3rd of December 2014, with their debut digital single "If You Don't Tell Me". However, sometime in early 2015, she departed from the group.

DiDi is a Burmese singer and rapper under WinnerZone Entertainment and I-Star Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Rumble-G and New-L. She made her official debut with Rumble-G on July 14, 2021, with their release 'Roopretelcham'. DiDi is a graduate of the Korea University of Media Arts in South Korea. She also earlier attended the Practising School Yangon Institute of Education in Yangon, Myanmar.
Dilli Jinn, born Sung Jin-kyung is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under SouLime Sound in 2016.

Dinda is an Indonesian singer and actress under Vine Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group SECRET NUMBER and was added ahead of the release of the group's 8th digital single "Don't Touch". She was officially revealed as a member of the group on August 17, 2025.

Dini is a South Korean singer and BJ under StarMade Entertainment andd New X. She is a member of the girl group CLEO. She made her debut as a soloist with the digital single "Roller Boy" on January 11, 2023.
Dion! is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Luminant Entertainment in 2022.

names.full: Anak Agung Ayu Puspa Aditya Karang

femaleIdols.description: Dita is an Indonesian singer and the first one from her country to enter the K-pop industry. Best known for being a former member of the girl group SECRET NUMBER, she debuted on May 19, 2020, with the single album “Who Dis?” On April 4, 2025, she, alongside members Jinny and Minji, released a collective statement announcing their departures from the group as well as Vine Entertainment.

DJ Ca$h is a South Korean singer and DJ. She was a member of the girl group ANDS as Bosun. She left the group in 2014, after promotions for Where Are You, Oppa. She then appeared and competed on the show Produce 101 where she finished 96th place. In 2016, she was in the line-up of Red-L, but they disbanded before debut. Following this, she debuted as a DJ.

DJ Heejae, or simply as Heejae, formerly known as H.Jae and Sera, is a South Korean dancer, DJ, influencer, show host, model and former singer. She is a former member of the girl groups Queendom and XoX. She is a former member of the dance teams Aighty9, DMC Crew and X-COS, under the stage name Jeje or Zeze. DooBoo is a South Korean solo singer under Raon Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group TREN-D. She made her solo debut on October 23, 2014 with the digital single "I Hate You But I Love You".

The group eventually disbanded in August 2024, after seven years together. Doyeon made her acting debut in February 2018 after getting cast in a drama titled "Short", in which she played a supporting role. In August 2023, it was announced that she was to make her big screen debut in the movie "18 youth", which was released in 2024. On May 24, 2021, Euna announced that she would be getting married and officially announced her retirement as an idol.
EunB is a South Korean singer under UMI Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group, "Precious".
EunB was a South Korean singer under Polaris Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group LADIES' CODE. On September 3, 2014, EunB, unfortunately, passed away due to a car accident.

Kwon Eunbi is a South Korean singer-songwriter, DJ, and actress under Woolim Entertainment. She debuted as a member of the girl group Ye-A in 2014 before leaving the group shortly after debuting. In 2018, she gained fame by participating in Mnet's Produce 48, finishing 7th and joining the project group IZ*ONE, which debuted in 2018. After the group's disbandment in 2021, she launched her solo career with her debut mini-album 'OPEN'. Eunbi has also appeared in various variety shows, acted in musicals, and served as a mentor on survival shows. She participated in the 2023 survival show GIRL'S REVERSE and placed 1st, earning her a spot in the group FE:VERSE. She later became a DJ for SBS's radio show Young Street. In 2024, she made her acting debut in the Japanese film series Stolen Identity.
Eunbi is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group INY.
Eunbi, formerly known as Eunbee, is a South Korean singer under Space Music Entertainment, former member of the girl groups of SIOSIJAK and Solia.
Eunbi is a South Korean singer under Gleamedia. She is a member of the girl group tracer.

Kwon Eunbin (also known simply as Eunbin) is a South Korean actress and singer under Cube Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group CLC. She was added to CLC after appearing on Mnet's survival show "Produce 101". In January 2016, Eunbin became a contestant on the survival show Produce 101, where she represented Cube Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 10 after ranking 35th place. On February 23, Cube Entertainment announced that Eunbin, alongside Elkie, would be joining CLC as the group's newest member. She made her official debut as a member of the group on February 29 with the mini album 'REFRESH'. However, she was unable to participate in the album's promotions due to her participation in Produce 101. In February 2022, it was announced that Eunbin would be playing a major role in TVING’s upcoming original sci-fi thriller, After School War Activities, based on the webtoon of the same name.
Eunbit is a South Korean singer. She made her official debut on May 2, 2019 upon joining the girl group My Darling.
Eunbyeol is a South Korean drummer, pianist and songwriter. She is a former member of the band Kiwi Band.
Eunbyeol is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group PRISMA and the pre-debut girl group Moonlight Girls.

Eunbyul is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the girl group Gangkiz. She left the group in 2013 for unknown reasons. After disbandment, she became a stewardess for Singapore Airlines.
Eunbyul is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group LPG. She was a 2nd-generation member. She joined the group in 2009 and left in 2012. She was also a member of A-Force.

Eunchae is a South Korean rapper under Carrie TV. She is a former member of the girl group bugAboo. In 2018, she appeared as a contestant on the survival show Produce 48 where she represented Million Market. She was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 32nd place.
Eunche is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group NEP.

Eungi is a South Korean singer, model, and actress under Big Ocean ENM. She is a member of the girl group iii, a former member of the girl group HI CUTIE, and was a predebut member of the group LURA LUCY. She first debuted as a soloist on December 27, 2017, with the digital single "Today". In 2018, she joined HI CUTIE and made her group debut with them on May 2, 2018, through the release of their third digital single "8th Grade Syndrome". On June 30, 2023, it was announced that Eungi had left the group, but will continue her solo activities under the agency. On July 23, 2025, she was announced as a member of the girl group iii and debuted with them on August 29, 2025.

Eunha is a South Korean singer under Big Planet Made. She is a member of the girl group VIVIZ and a member of the girl group GFRIEND. She also used to be part of the project girl group Sunny Girls. Eunha trained at Big Hit Entertainment along with SinB for 1 year. She debuted as a member of GFriend with the EP Season of Glass on January 15, 2015. GFriend disbanded on May 22, 2021, after all members left Source Music upon the completion of their six-year contract. On October 6, 2021, it was announced that Eunha, along with former GFriend members, SinB and Umji, signed a contract with BPM Entertainment to debut as a three-member group. On October 8, 2021, it was announced their new group name would be VIVIZ. VIVIZ debuted on February 9, 2022, with the mini album Beam of Prism.
Eunhee, formerly known as Neulsom, is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group D.el which debuted in 2016 and disbanded in 2017.

Eunhwa is a South Korean yanggeum player, member of the co-ed group DongyangGozupa. She made her solo debut on December 19, 2018 with "Song of Wind". She’s also a professor at the Traditional Music department at Dankook University. In September 2014, she was a guest professor at Yanbian University in China. She was a member of "Unification Ensemble".
Eunhyang is a South Korean keyboardist, member of the girl band Charari Danchu.
Eunhye is a member of the co-ed duo, NUITNUIT.
Eunhye is a South Korean trainee under Evermore Entertainment. She is a former member of the trainee girl group EVERMORE MUSE. She is also known for being a former Top 10 Student contestant.

Eunice, formerly known as Sooyeon, is a South Korean singer associated with RXM and 12ENT. She is a member of the girl group DIA and its sub-unit BCHCS. Eunice made her debut with DIA on September 14, 2015, with the release of their first studio album, "Do It Amazing." On December 29, 2016, she became part of DIA's first sub-unit, BCHCS.
Eunjeong, also known as Flora, is a South Korean singer and dancer. She is a member of SOONIEGROUP. She was a member of the girl groups Rhea and FLORIA.
Eunjeong, also known by her full name Shin Eun Jeong, is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of kid girl group HOT TEEN, HI CUTIE and CutieL.
Eun Ji is a South Korean singer-actress. She was a member of the girl group 9MUSES but she on January 29, 2014, when she graduated from the group.

Eunji is a South Korean singer, Songwriter-composer, Actress and a former Radio DJ under BILLIONS. Eunji debuted as a Main-vocalist of APINK on April 19, 2011 with the group's first mini album Seven Springs of Apink. She made her debut as an actress in the tvN drama "Reply 1997" that aired in 2012. She made her debut as a musical actress in 2012 with the musical 'Legally Blonde' She made her debut as a Solo artist on April 18, 2016 with her first mini album Dream.
Eunji is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group Global Icon.

Eunji is a South Korean singer under BBGIRLS Company and GLG. She is a member of the girl group BB GIRLS (formerly Brave Girls). On February 2, 2016, it was announced that Brave Girls would be returning as a seven-member group after a two-year hiatus. She, alongside Minyoung, Yujeong, Yuna, and Hayun, were added as new members. Eunji made her official debut as a member on February 16, 2016, with the group's fourth digital single "Deepened". In October 2017, she, alongside fellow member Yujeong, became a contestant on the rebooting project show The Unit. She was eliminated in episode 7 with an overall ranking of 48th place. In 2019, Eunji appeared as a guest performer on the competition show Queendom. She was a member of the unit Six Puzzle where she assisted Park Bom.
Eunji is a South Korean retired singer and former child actress. She is a former member of the girl group GIRLFrND.
Eun Ji is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group AZM.

Eunji is a South Korean trainee under WD Entertainment. She is a member of the trainee group WizarD and was a former member of Whiteday and its trainee group White Day Project. In 2019, Eunji was introduced as a trainee under WD Entertainment through their trainee group, White Day Project. She later became a member of their girl group Whiteday and debuted with them on June 14, 2019 with the release of their only digital single, "Shine On Light". On October 21, 2020, WD Entertainment announced that Whiteday would disband following the departures of Yujung and Jihye. As a result, Eunji was the only member to stay with the agency, but reassured fans that she will soon come back. On February 15, 2021, Eunji was introduced as a member of WD Entertainment's newest trainee group, WizarD. The agency plans to debut a new girl group at an undisclosed date in the future.
Eunji is a South Korean singer, she was a member of the girl group HANA.
Eunji (은지) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group LPG. She was a 3rd-generation member. She joined the group in 2013 and left the same year.

Eunjin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group DIA. On September 14, 2015, she debuted as a member of the girl group DIA, with the release of the studio album, Do It Amazing. On December 31, 2016, she debuted in DIA's second sub-unit, L.U.B. On May 7, 2018, she left the group and agency to focus on her health.
Eunjin is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group HIGHTEEN.

Eunjin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Playback. She made her solo debut on June 9, 2017 with the digital single "I Understand". In 2015, she was set to debut in the original line-up of Playback, however, after unconfirmed rumors that she was a sasaeng fan of the boy group EXO, she left the group right before their debut. In 2016, she was announced as a contestant on the survival show Produce 101, representing the subsidiary of Coridel Entertainment, Clear Company. She left the show during the fourth episode due to health issues. Later that same year, she also participated in K-pop Star 6: The Last Chance. In 2017, she was added to Playback's line-up once again, and made her official debut with them on April 13, 2017, for their comeback with "Want You To Say".
Eunjo is a retired South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Alice White.
Park Eunjo is the Sub-vocalist and Visual of the Girl Group DreamNote under IMe Entertainment. Before debuting, Eunjo appeared and competed on the Survival Show MIXNINE.

Eunju, formerly known as Ray.B, is a South Korean singer. She is the member of the girl group Sunny Hill. She debuted as a soloist, using the stage name Ray.B, on August 1, 2014. Following Sunny Hill's change of labels to BOD Entertainment in 2019, the agency announced Eunju would be joining the group as a new member.

Eunjung, also known as YORKIE, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actress. She was a member of the girl group Jewelry and its subunit JewelryS. She joined the group in 2006. In July 2014, it was announced Eunjung had signed a contract with Wave On Entertainment and would be focusing on acting.

Eunjung, also known as Elsie, is a South Korean singer, actress, and musical theatre actress under Mask Studio and Likey Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group T-ARA and its sub-unit T-ARA N4. In May 2015, she made her solo debut under the stage name Elsie with the mini album "I'm Good".
Eunjung is a South Korean soprano, member of the girl group M.Diva. She is a member of Busan City Choir.
Hyena is a South Korean former singer. She is a former member of the girl group MOA.She made her solo debut in August 2008 with the single album "First Single Album".
Eunsae is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group Delight.

Eunseo is a member of the girl group Cosmic Girls/WJSN and she represents the Gemini sign in the groups concept. Seola, Dayoung, Exy, Eunseo, Cheng Xiao, Soobin, and Yeoreum are in YTeen which is the Starship unit with Monsta X. She's part of the sub-unit 'Joy'. She debuted as a member of WJSN on February 25, 2016 with their first mini album Would You Like? On May 12, 2021, she debuted as a member of WJSN's sub-unit, WJSN THE BLACK, with the single album "My Attitude".
Eunseo was an original member of the girl group A-DEAN but left soon after their debut on the 26th of October 2013.
Eunsol is a South Korean singer and child model under Clevr E&M. She used to be a member of the kids girl group CooKie.
Eunsol is a South Korean drummer. She is a member of the girl band SUNNYKEY.

Eun Sol is a South Korean BJ, singer and dancer. She was a member and leader of the girl group TROPICAL and a former member of Bambino. In June 2015, she debuted as a member of the girl group Bambino with the group's first release "Oppa Oppa". She left the group sometime in 2017, for unspecified reasons. She re-debuted in August 2018 in LUK Factory's second girl group, TROPICAL, with the group's debut digital single "Mwah". On October 30, 2018, she posted a photo of her bandaged leg, explaining that she had gotten into a car accident. She elaborated that she hit a guard rail and lost control of the car, which then started to spin rapidly. Eun Sol ended the post by confirming that she was following physiotherapy and that she's thankful she only sustained minor injuries.
Eunsol is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group AMOR. She joined the group after Moa left.
Eunsom is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups WANNA.B, BADKIZ, and Luluz.
EunSong (은송) is a South Korean singer who debuted on July 2, 2019 with "너는, 빛나".

Eunsu is a South Korean singer and a member of the girl group D-art. She wrote, composed, and arranged her song "Spring Picnic", two years before its release. Additionally, she contributed vocals to GEMtopia's song "In To You."
Kim Eun-suh is a South Korean trainee. She participated in JYP Entertainment's survival program "Sixteen" and MNET's "Idol School", but did not debut.
Eunsul is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the upcoming girl group Clear:I. On August 28th it was announced that she will be leaving the group.

Eunwoo, also known as DJ Eunwoo, is a South Korean former K-Pop idol and currently an independent model and DJ under The Compass Ent. She was a former member of the girl group HINAPIA and former member of the girl group PRISTIN and its sub-unit PRISTIN V. In 2016, Eunwoo participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with other five trainees from her agency, Pledis Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 11 after ranking 21st place. On 2017, Pledis announced Eunwoo as a member of PRISTIN, which debuted on March 21, 2017 with the mini album "Hi!" and its title track, "Wee Woo". In 2024 she signed with The Compass Ent and she successfully started her DJ career at a Kpop event in Taiwan.
Song Eunyi is a South Korean comedian, actress, and radio DJ, member of the girl group Celeb Five. She debuted as an actress and comedian in 1993 on KBS. She is the daughter of Song Gwang-il.
Eunyong is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Purfles. Eunyong currently works as a chef at her own restaurant.

Eunyoul is a South Korean singer under Antenna Music, member of the co-ed gospel group Diaconia. She joined Kpop Star Season 3. She signed with AURA Company after Kpop Star and debuted as a soloist in 2015. Later, she joined Yoo Hee-yeol’s Antenna Music.
Eunyoung is a South Korean rapper. She is a former member of the girl group Two X. Before debuting with Two X, she worked as a backup dancer for acts such as BIGBANG, 2NE1, Rain, and MBLAQ.
Eunyoung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Holy Days.
Eunyoung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group ii. She left sometime in 2019.
Eunyuri is a South Korean rapper and singer. She debuted in 2017 as a member of the girl group Blah Blah.

Eve, formerly known as Yeri, is a South Korean singer, dancer, model, and live-streamer on the platform AfreecaTV under FA Entertainment. She is a member and the Vocalist, Dancer, and Maknae of the South Korean girl group FlyWithMe and was a member of Black Bunny under the name Yeri under LA Entertainment. She originally debuted in the South Korean girl group Black Bunny on June 3, 2019, with the digital single "Oh! My God". She left Black Bunny sometime in 2019 before they silently disbanded in 2020, to join FlyWithMe. On February 3, 2021, she debuted as a member of the South Korean girl group FlyWithMe. Eve went on a hiatus starting August 31st, 2022, but seems to be active with the group almost immediately.
Eve is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo SkyRabbit.

Evelynn is the co-founder and lead vocalist of the virtual girl group K/DA. She has a mesmerizing stage presence that no one can resist. She loves to be in the spotlight and enjoys the crowd’s reactions to her carefully crafted image. Together with Ahri, she pushes the group to take the most exciting creative risks.
Ever is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group ikling. She debuted on November 7th, 2020 with "Satellite".
Ever is a South Korean streamer, dancer, and singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Ever is a South Korean singer under Shine E&M, member of the girl duoEver & Lucy. She made her debut as a solo artist on May 7, 2021 with the single "It's You".

femaleIdols.description: Nattha Phapirom, better known under the stage name Evie and formerly known May, is a Thai singer formely under Big Ocean ENM. She was a member of the upcoming girl group iii. She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode. She seems to have left Big Ocean ENM and iii sometime in early to mid-2024.
EXN is a South Korean rapper and a singer under Unusual Sound. She made her debut on March 12, 2021, with a single “ANSWER”.

Chu So Jung, popularly known as EXY, is the leader, main rapper, lead dancer, and vocalist of the girl group Cosmic Girls under Starship Entertainment and she represents the Scorpio sign in the groups concept. She was originally going to be a member of the seven member group under Medialine, but due to finacial issues, the group never debuted. She was first known for appearing on the second season of Unpretty Rapstar, however got elimated in episode 8. Exy debuted as a member of WJSN in their 'Sweet' unit on February 25, 2016 with the release of their debut EP 'Would You Like?'. She also went on to join the project Y-Teen and release the single 'Do Better'. She is known to write all her own raps for all her WJSN songs. EXY debuted as a member of the group's sub unit WJSN The Black on May 12, 2021. In 2015, she debuted as an actress with a minor role in the show 'The Flatterer'. In 2021, she returned to the screen with a support role in the show 'Idol: The Coup' as a member of the group 'Cotton Candy' under the alias El.

EZE, also known as Hwilyn, is a South Korean singer under TNK Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups SHA SHA and H2L (the latter previously known as SUS4). She made her solo debut on May 14, 2021, with her first digital single "Reminisce". Originally set to use her given name for solo activities, she decided to on the name EZE shortly before debuting.
Ezrela is an Indian-Australian trainee. She gained fame for appearing on the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where she was eliminated in 8th place.

Fairy Mai, also known by her birth name Sion, formerly known as Sia, is a South Korean singer under UNC Company. She is a former member of the girl group eite. She made her solo debut on March 17, 2025 with the collaboration single with KAIOS, "Lipstick".
Fan Jiayi is a Chinese singer. She was a contestant on the canceled Chinese survival show Find Rookie.

Fatou is a Senegalese singer and model who works under DR Music. She is the leader of the multinational girl group BLACKSWAN. She used to be a model under Cineline Entertainment before being scouted by DR and becoming a trainee. She was introduced as the fourth member of BLACKSWAN on July 8, 2020. Fatou began her solo career on August 19, 2022, with the single Castle Key (Roll).
FeelDa is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted independently in 2021.

Wang Fei Fei, known by the stage name Fei, is a Chinese actress and singer under Wang Feifei Studio. She is a former member of the now-disbanded South Korean girl group, miss A. In March 2010, the group began promoting in China. Later the group debuted in South Korea in July 2010 with the song 'Bad Girl, Good Girl' under JYP Entertainment. Their debut song earned them their first win the same year, as well as many awards at the Mnet Asian Music Awards (MAMA), Golden Disk Awards (GDA), and Seoul Music Awards (SMA). In 2011, she debuted as an actress in the series 'Dream High', alongside fellow Miss A member, Bae Suzy. In 2016, Fei debuted as a solo artist with the mini album 'Fantasy'. In 2017, with the disbandment of Miss A, Fei moved back to China to continue her solo career. In 2017, she got her first proper role (she had only been making cameos in dramas) in the Chinese drama 'Swan'. In 2018, with the expiration of her contract, Fei left JYP Entertainment and joined Huayi Brothers. She continued both her solo acting and singing career in China.

Ferlyn is a Singaporean soloist and a co-founder of the record label GIF Music. She's a former member of the group SKarf. She made her solo debut on January 2, 2015 with the mini album First as Ferlyn G.
FIL is a South Korean singer signed with Xanadu Entertainment. She made her debut on December 26, 2018, marked by the release of her digital single titled “I’m Throwing You Away”.
Florea formally known as Runa is a South Korean singer and model. She is a member of Hidden Glow. She was a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Francinne is a Brazilian singer signed under Universal Music. She achieved her Korean solo debut on October 27, 2021, releasing the digital single titled “Fading Like a Moon”.
Francisca is a South Korean-Nigerian trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN. Her father is Nigerian while her mother is Korean.

Frida-Anne is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter. She is a former member of the pre-debut disbanded girl group MIDNIGHT as Eungyul. She made her solo debut on February 17, 2022 with the single "Blue Friday".

FRIENDSHIPING (also known as Ujeonging) is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer, livestreamer and content creator. She is the leader of the project girl group TDYA. She made her solo debut on August 18, 2023.
Frill is a South Korean streamer and singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier. She was a member of the live idol group Tè Labyrinth.

Fuko is a Japanese trainee under THE L1VE label. She mostly gained recognition for her participation on Mnet's survivals shows Girls Planet 999 in 2021, and I-LAND2: N/a in 2024. Unfortunately, Fuko was eliminated in both shows, making her unable to debut. It was announced July 16, 2025 that she is preparing to debut as a member of THE L1VE label's first girl group.
Funa is a Japanese trainee. She is known for being a contestant on the Japanese reality survival show Nizi Project and the South Korean survival show R U Next?.

Fwaney, also known as Lee Hwan Hee, is a South Korean influencer and retired singer. She is a former member of the girl group F.W.S.She made her debut as a soloist on April 25, 2012, with the digital album “Secret”.

femaleIdols.description: Fye also known as Faii and Fyeqoodgurl is a Thai singer-songwriter, producer and actress under D.U.M.B. Recordings. She is a former member of the girl group BNK48 and its Team BIII. She made her solo debut on June 10, 2022 with the digital single "Gone Gurl". In 2023, she participated in a Mnet survival show called "Queendom Puzzle", where she was eliminated after ranking 16th.
Kim Hyo-jin, better known as g_me, is a South Korean singer and member of the group NEEZ.

G.NA is a Korean-Canadian singer and actress. She officially debuted with her first mini-album, Draw G's First Breath, on July 14, 2010, under Cube Entertainment, but didn't renew her contract in March 2016 and left the agency on good terms.
Ga Eun, born Lee Ga-eun is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer who debuted independently in 2017.
Ga Hyeon is a South Korean singer and rapper. She was the main rapper of the girl group ALiKE.
Ga Kyung is a South Korean model and singer. She is a former leader of the girl group PPL.
Ga Ram is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group SHA SHA. She left the group on July 30, 2018.

Gabee is a South Korean dancer, member of the dance groups La Chica. She has a business called My Lashes, a brand of fake eyelashes. Gabee was a dance mentor and a judge on "A2K" for episodes 21 and 22.
Gabi is a Canadian-Korean trainee, actress and model. She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the final episode.

Gabi is a Brazilian singer of German descent who works under DR Music. She is a member of the multinational girl group BLACKSWAN. On July 28, 2021, Gabi was announced as one of the four finalists in DR Music's Global Audition, vying to become the new member of BLACKSWAN. Fast forward to January 26, 2022, and DR Music officially introduced Gabi and Sriya as the agency's newest trainees. Then, on May 26, 2022, the excitement peaked as DR Music proudly revealed Gabi and Sriya as the newest members of BLACKSWAN.
Gabin is a South Korean rapper and singer. She was a member of the girl group LIVE HIGH. She is a former Miss Korea Runner Up 2014.
Gabin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Kitten Girls. – She joined the group in October 2018 to replace Juuny but left after only one month.
Gabin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Six Bomb. She left the group in 2018 due to health reasons.
Gael is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the female duo Echovey. She made her solo debut on May 18, 2025 with the digital single "Quiet Goodbye".
Gaeul is a South Korean singer. She made her official debut in August 25, 2017 as a member of the girl group S.I.S.. She also participated in the survival show "The Unit."

Kim Gaeul is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer-songwriter under Starship Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group IVE. Gaeul's passion for dancing led her to join numerous competitions. Though initially her parents disapproved of a casting agent's offer, they later agreed to support her talent if she got scouted again. During another competition, she was discovered by Starship Entertainment. After passing the audition, she became an official trainee and eventually debuted as a member of IVE. On November 12, 2021, Gaeul was revealed as the second member of IVE. The group officially debuted on December 1, 2021, with their single album "ELEVEN".
Gaeul is a member of the girl group Favorite. Gaeul was a contestant on Produce 101.
Gaeul is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group New-A.
Gaeul is a South Korean singer. She's a former member of FLASHE and the musical trio BeBe Mingnon. She left FLASHE after the group's debut with "Drop It Pop It".

Gaeun is a South Korean dancer and singer. She is a former member of the pre-debut sub unit LIMELIGHT, from which she was revealed as a member on August 12, 2022, and released the pre-debut EP "Limelight" on September 29, 2022, before making her official debut with them on February 17, 2023, with the EP "Love & Happiness". On July 15, 2024, LIMELIGHT rebranded as MADEIN, and, on July 29, all seven members were officially announced. The group debuted on September 3, 2024, with their first EP "Rise". On November 11, 2024, it was stated by the agency that Gaeun would be on hiatus for some time due to health reasons. A few days later, on November 22, JTBC's Crime Chief reported that a rookie girl group member has been victim of SA and harassment by her company's CEO, with the rumors of it being Gaeun and 143 Entertainment's CEO respectively. On the same day, 143 Entertainment refuted the claims of SA while also confirming that the CEO had made sexual advancements with Gaeun. On November 29, 2024, Gaeun's departure of MADEIN was announced, with the reason for it being personal circumstances.

Gaeun is a South Korean singer, dancer and actress under AB Creative, member of the girl group ARTBEAT and the co-ed dance crew ARTBEAT. She joined the agency AB Creative in 2018 or earlier where she was active as a dancer in their dance group 'AB' (also called AB Project) and also as a soloist dance performer.
Gaeun is a member of the three-member girl group Asia girlS, formed by the K-pop Department at Joongbu University which debuted on the 18th of November 2021.

Kim Gaeun is a South Korean former trainee. She was announced as a member of FAVE Entertainment upcoming girl group FAVEGIRLS (later known as PlayM GIRLS and now known as Weeekly) on October 26, 2018. Ten month later, in August 2019, it was reported that she had left both the group the agency, Play M Entertainment. Not much is known about Kim Gaeun's current whereabouts, but it is strongly believed that she had pursued a non-idol life.
Gaeun is the drummer in the South Korean girl band MARMELLO.

Gaga is a South Korean dancer and singer under MLD Entertainment. She is a member of the dance group CocaNButter, and a former member of the dance group PURPLOW (2013 - May 2017). She is also a professor of Practical Dance at Seoul Hoseo Arts Practical School.
Gaga is a South Korean singer signed with Star Ent.. She is a former member of the girl group GeeGu.
Gahee is a South Korean singer and dancer. She is a former member of the girl group Blastar.
Gahee is a South Korean singer, Youtuber and BJ. She was a member of the girl duo 2NB. She left the duo in 2007 and she’s now a BJ on AfreecaTV.
Gahye is a South Korean singer. She is the leader of 1st generation girl group O-24. She is currently living in the Solomon Islands with two children.

Gahyun is a South Korean rapper and singer under Dreamcatcher Company. She is a member of the girl group Dreamcatcher, in which she was added to on December 5, 2016, when the group rebranded from MINX to Dreamcatcher. Hanroro is a South Korean singer and songwriter signed under Authentic (formerly Studio MOS). She made her debut on March 14, 2022, with the digital single album “Let Me Love My Youth”. Hanroro has contributed to the songwriting for renowned artists such as Taeyeon (SNSD), AKMU, and TXT. In 2023, she was nominated for ‘New Artist of the Year’ and ‘Best Modern Rock Song’ at the 20th Korean Popular Music Awards. Her stage name, Han RoRo, originated from her high school nickname, “Han Log,” a playful reference to her real name, Han JiSoo, and the mathematical terms exponents and logarithms. Finding “Han Log” too mathematical, she opted for the softer-sounding “Han RoRo.” In 2020, driven by her passion for music, Hanroro reached out to Studio MOS, submitting two demo songs she created using a free composition program and a ukulele. After four months, she traveled to Seoul to meet with the company representatives and was accepted as a trainee in early 2021. Initially, the company aimed for a “high teen” concept with English lyrics for her debut. However, this approach did not resonate well, prompting Hanroro to suggest a new musical direction that better reflected the messages she wanted to convey.

The group's debut was met with commercial success, marking the start of Hikaru's official career in the kpop industry. Prior to her participation in Girls Planet 999, Hikaru was involved in the J-pop scene. In 2016, she debuted as a member of the J-pop project duo +GANG under Avex Artist Academy. During her time with the duo, she was known by the stage name "Hikarun." +GANG disbanded in 2018, but Hikaru remained an artist under Avex. Hikaru also trained for the pre-debut group that later became XG, but she was eliminated from the final lineup in 2019. In 2021, Hikaru joined Girls Planet 999 as a representative of the J-Group. She performed a cover of "Boombayah" by BLACKPINK for her evaluation performance, earning praise from the judges and securing her spot as a TOP9 candidate. Hikaru ranked 1st in her initial group and remained in the Planet Top 9 throughout the season. In the finale, she finished 7th with 713,322 points and 387,709 votes, earning her place in the final lineup of Kep1er.

Huh Chan Mi (formerly known as Chanmi) is a South Korean singer currently under A-CL Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group F-ve Dolls, the co-ed group Co-ed School, and the pre-debut girl group HIGHCOLOR. Chanmi began her career in 2004 when she signed with SM Entertainment as a trainee. She trained for an extended period but did not make the final cut to be part of Girls’ Generation, as she was the youngest and only in seventh grade at the time. Rumors suggested that she didn’t make the cut due to the 9-member limit of SNSD. There have been pictures of SNSD with 11 members and more. Afterward, SM Entertainment planned to include her in their next girl group, f(x). Unfortunately, she was cut from the final lineup once again. She later signed with Core Contents Media (now known as MBK Entertainment) and made her long-awaited debut in Co-ed School. The group faced numerous scandals, leading to its division into two groups: SPEED and F-ve Dolls. Chanmi left F-ve Dolls following a bullying scandal. She was working on her solo debut while still under the company. However, MBK Entertainment’s history of bullying scandals overshadowed her solo debut plans. Chanmi then signed with Pledis Entertainment and participated in Produce 101. She was eliminated in the 10th episode, ranking 26th. After returning to Pledis, she continued training. She was nearly set to debut with PRISTIN but was cut from the lineup once again. Chanmi joined MLD Entertainment in 2016. MLD Entertainment was coming out a survival show called Finding MOMOLAND. Unfortuanantly, she did not participate and MLD Entertainment has stated that they will put her in their next girl group. Although this girl group was never mentioned again, left the company. Chanmi joined Mostable Music as part of the pre-debut project HIGHCOLOR. With little public awareness of Mostable Music, there is at least one video of HIGHCOLOR with all four members performing. The group participated in MIXNINE but was eliminated. HIGHCOLOR later debuted as a duo, without Chanmi. She made her solo debut on July 23, 2020, with the digital single “Highlight” under the name Huh Chan Mi. In February 2023, she had announced that her contact with FirstOne Entertainment had expired through her SNS account.

Pyo Hye Mi (recognized as just Hyemi) is a South Korean singer and actress under MEFLEX Entertainment. She is best known as a member of 9MUSES, its sub-group 9MUSES A, and the ballad duo Me:us. Before Hyemi's official debut, she performed at the Chin Chin Song Festival in May 2009, showcasing her vocal abilities, and later obtained a silver award. In January 2010, Hyemi reportedly signed an agreement under Star Empire Entertainment and debuted as a vocalist in the girl group 9MUSES, with the first single album, "Let's Have A Party" in August of that same year. In August 2016, Hyemi debuted as a member of 9MUSES's first sub-group, 9MUSES A, with the single album "MUSES DIARY". In October, Hyemi was appointed as the new leader of the group following the departure of Hyuna. In February 2019, Star Empire announced that 9MUSES had officially disbanded as Hyemi and fellow group members collectively chose to not renew their contracts. In November 2022, Hyemi signed an exclusive contract with MEFLEX Entertainment to explore her career as an actress advancing under her full name. In April 2022, Hyemi, alongside former 9MUSES member Hyuna, debuted as a ballad duo Me:us, under A Flat Entertainment, releasing their first single album, "Memories". Hyeri is a South Korean dancer, singer, rapper, variety star, actress, and model under SUBLIME. She is a member of the South Korean girl group Girl's Day. Hyeri, along with Yura, joined the girl group Girl's Day, under DreamT Entertainment, in September 2010 after the departures of members Jisun and Jang Hyeri (known as Ji In at the time). Her first release with the group was the digital single "Girl's Day Party #2", which was released on October 29, 2010. Despite the four members being in separate agencies now, they have stated that the group has not disbanded. In 2012, she made her acting debut in the drama "Tasty Life", which aired from April to September 2012. In August 2014, Hyeri appeared in the variety show "Real Men". After a brief clip of her went viral, she rose to fame and won "Best Female Newcomer" at the MBC Entertainment Awards for her appaerance in the variety show. In 2015, she was cast as the female lead of the drama "Reply 1988", which became one of the highest rated dramas in Korean television. Due to its success, it made her even more known, earning her a lot of praise for her acting skills. Following Girl's Day's hiatus, she pursued acting, playing main roles in various dramas, such as "Two Cops" in 2017, "Miss Lee" in 2019, "My Roommate is a Gumiho" in 2021, "Moonshine" in 2022, and "Friendly Rivalry" in 2025. She also played in movies, making her big screen debut in 2017 as the female lead of the movie "Monstrum", as well as playing in movies like "My Punch-Drunk Boxer" in 2019, and "Victory" in 2024. Aside from that, Hyeri appeared in multiple variety shows where she was apart of the main cast such as tvN's "DoReMi Market", also known as "Amazing Saturday", from 2018 to 2020, ENA's "HMLYCP", also known as "HyeMiLeeYeChaePa" in 2023, as well as the Netflix's web reality show "Agent of Mystery" in 2024. She is considered a "blue-chip" in the industry due to her personality, being easy-going and bright, as well as having flexible chemistry with her co-host and co-stars. After her exclusive contract with DreamT Entertainment ended on September 11, 2019, Hyeri joined a newly set-up agency Creative Group ING on April 30, 2019. In June 2024, it was reported that she signed with SUBLIME.
