Hyori is a South Korean singer under Pocket7 Entertainment. On September 1, 2022, Hyori was revealed as a member of the girl group mimiirose under YES IM Entertainment. They debuted on September 16, 2022, with the single "AWESOME". On November 21, 2023, it was announced that mimiirose had parted ways with YES IM Entertainment following a mutual decision and that they were in talks of signing with a new agency. On March 26, 2024, it was announced that mimiirose had signed an exclusive contract with Pocket7 Entertainment, continuing their activities as a group with the addition of two new members.
Hyorin is a South Korean singer under Daekyo Media Contents Business Division. She is a member of the co-ed kids group Play With Me Club.

Jun Hyo Seong, or simply as Hyoseong, is a South Korean singer and actress under Alien Company. She is best known for being a member of the girl group Secret. On May 12, 2014, Hyoseong made her solo debut with the single album "Top Secret".
Hyosun is a South Korean singer and rapper under New Planet Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group H.U.B and former member of Kiwi Band as Ellie.

Kim Hyoyeon is a South Korean dancer, rapper, singer-songwriter, DJ, and composer under SM Entertainment. She is best known as the main rapper and one of the main dancers of the girl group Girls' Generation. She is also a member of its second sub-unit, Girls' Generation-Oh!GG. As a DJ, she goes by the stage name HYO. Hyoyeon's formal dance training began in elementary school; she learned hip hop, jazz, and Latin dance at her neighborhood's hip-hop school. At 11 years old, she auditioned for SM Entertainment through SM's 2000 Casting System. Then, in 2004, she, alongside Super Junior's Siwon, was sent to Beijing to study Chinese. Before debuting with Girls' Generation, she worked with Janet Jackson and was BoA's silhouette dancer during a performance at Mnet Km Music Video Festival 2005. She eventually debuted as a member of the girl group Girls' Generation in August 2007, which went on to become one of the best-selling artists in South Korea and one of South Korea's most popular girl groups worldwide. She made her solo debut on December 2, 2016, with the digital single "Mystery."

Hyun Jae Yeon is a South Korean actress represented by Fantagio. In the drama Who Is She, she portrays Soo Jin, a trainee at UNIS Entertainment and a member of the fictional girl group Element. Her character is known for her determination and ambition in the competitive K-pop industry. Hyun Jae Yeon's performance adds depth to the narrative, highlighting the challenges and aspirations of aspiring idols.
Hyun Jinseo is a South Korean trainee and dancer. She is a former member of Fancy Factory's kids girl group CoCo.
Hyun Jyu-ni, previously known Juni and Ju-an, is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the girl rock band BellaMafia.
Hyun Shinyoung is a South Korean singer under n.CH Entertainment. She is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Hyun Yea is a South Korean singer and a former member of the girl group TURAN.
Hyuna is a South Korean singer. She was a member and maknae of the girl group ASHA.

HyunA is a South Korean singer and rapper under AT AREA. She debuted in 2007 with Wonder Girls but left due to health issues. She re-debuted in 2009 with 4minute and launched a solo career in 2010. She gained international attention after appearing in PSY’s "Gangnam Style" and collaborating on the female version, "Oppa Is Just My Style." HyunA has been part of various music units including Trouble Maker, Triple H, and HyunA&DAWN. In 2018, she confirmed her relationship with Dawn, leading to both being dropped from Cube Entertainment. They later joined PSY’s label, P Nation, in 2019. That same year, HyunA revealed she had been diagnosed with depression, panic disorder, and vasovagal syncope. She and Dawn got engaged in early 2022 but broke up later that year.
Hyuna is a South Korean singer under 4D_Label & On1 Entertainment. She is the youngest member of the girl group BLE.

Hyuna is a South Korean Singer, Composer and Artist under A Flat Entertainment. She is best known as a former member of Korean girl group 9MUSES. She is now a member of the duo Me:us. After Jaekyung left the group in October 2010, Star Empire Entertainment said that she will become the newest member of the 9MUSES. On August 18, 2011, she made her formal debut with the group with the release of the digital song "Figaro". Following Sera's graduation on June 23, 2014, she was then appointed as 9MUSES' leader. And on October 3, 2016, the agency announced Hyuna's graduation from the group following six years of activities. Hyuna later on debuted solo on March 22, 2017 with the digital single 'Cricket Song'. On March 22 2020 Hyuna announced on Instagram that she was pregnant with her first child. She also shared a video of her sonogram, which began with the caption “Don’t be shocked” and concluded with the words “Let’s meet in June.” On April 17, 2022 she debuted as one of the duo of the group Me:us with their first digital single 'Memories'.
Hyunah is a South Korean drummer. She was a member of the girl band Sweet Revenge and Mieum.

Kim Hyun Bin, better known as HyunBin, is a South Korean singer under TR Entertainment. She is the Main Rapper, Main Dancer, Lead Vocalist and Center of the girl group TRI.BE. She was also a former member of the disbanded trainee group Banana Culture Newkid.
Hyung Eun is a South Korean singer under KRAZY Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group PEACE and formerly the rapper and maknae of the girl group BULLDOK.

Hyungseo is a South Korean singer currently under M25. She originally debuted as a member of the girl group Busters, under JTG Entertainment and Marbling E&M, on November 27, 2017 with the single album "Dream On". However, she later announced her departure from the group on March 29, 2020. Hyungseo was revealed as a contestant on the MBC's survival show "My Teenage Girl" on September 8, 2021. During the finale, she ranked third place with 217,370.0 votes, thus becoming a member of the girl group CLASS:y. CLASS:y made their debut on May 5, 2022 with the mini album "Class Is Over".
Hyunhwa is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Starz.
Hyunji is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a member of the Korean pop girl group HeyMiss. Hyunji also used to be a member of the girl groups Fantastie and Double B.
Hyunji is a South Korean student, singer, and dancer. She is member of the girl group Ferry Blue and also a member of the GoT vocal crew.
Hyunji is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group D.el which debuted in 2016 and disbanded in 2017.
Hyunji is a South Korean singer under LUK Factory until 2024.She was a former member of the girl group Hashtag and Peach Girl.
Hyunji is a South Korean singer and musical actress under OD Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group The Pink Lady.

Kim HyunJin is a South Korean singer-songwriter under triangle ENM. She is the visual and leader of the girl group Loossemble. She is also a member of LOONA and its sub-unit LOONA 1/3, although the group is currently inactive. She was also a contestant on MIXNINE. She released her solo single album “HyunJin” on November 17, 2016. She debuted in LOONA on August 20, 2018, with their debut mini album “[+ +]”. However, she parted ways with BlockBerryCreative after a legal dispute on May 9, 2023. On June 11, 2023, it was announced that she signed an exclusive contract with CTDENM. On July 29, It was also confirmed that she would debut as a member Loossemble alongside LOONA members YeoJin, ViVi, Go Won, and HyeJu. On September 15th, 2023, she debuted as a member of Loossemble with a mini album of the same name. On November 29, 2024, CTDENM announced that its exclusive contract with the Loossemble members had ended. On December 4, it was announced that HyunJin would be releasing her first digital single "Thank You" on December 16. Following Loossemble's hiatus, HyunJin is planning a solo career, as well as a band project with former cignature members Jeewon, Haeun, and Semi, and former Hashtag member Dajeong. On July 16, it was announced that HyunJin is a part of the Studio USOG's program Another Day of Debut Training in collaboration with South Korea's Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs which will form a project girl group for a musical festival in honor of South Korea's 80th Liberation Day in August. The group's name was later revealed to be TDYA.
Hyunjin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Starz.
Hyunjin is a South Korean pianist, member of the co-ed group Jins. He’s also a member of Chocolate Note.

Hyunjin, formerly known by her stage names Rabo and Lady Owl, is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the Trot girl group Lady T and a former member of the girl group Playa and the duo Baby Sister. Hyunjin debuted as a soloist on August 16, 2010, with the digital single "Free Girl."

Hyunjoo is a South Korean singer and actress under STUDIO 1592. She is a former member of the girl group APRIL and the project girl group UNI.T.She went on hiatus in May 2016 due to health issues and ultimately left the group on October 29, 2016 to pursue an acting career. In 2017, she came back to music as a contestant in survival show The Unit. She placed 5th and became a member of UNI.T. On October 12, 2018, Uni.T disbanded after five months of promoting. Hyunjoo subsequently continued as an actress and returned to her agency. On February 28, 2021, a post was made to an online forum by someone claiming to be former member Hyunjoo's brother. In the post, he claimed that Hyunjoo's departure from the group had not been because she wanted to study acting, but because she had been forced out due to being severely bullied by the other members, at one point even attempting suicide. DSP Media has denied that any bullying took place, and announced they would be pursuing legal action against Hyunjoo and her family. As a result, the group has faced heavy backlash, up to and including having members removed from endorsement deals and acting roles. HyunJoo then posted a statement on her personal instagram on the 18th of April, 2021 backing the claims made by the two netizens which had made the accusations. She also stated that the label, DSP Media, was not allowing her to terminate her exclusive contract with them.
Hyunjoo is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group fishingirls.
Hyunjoo is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Q6IX.
Hyunjung, also known as Eseo, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group LUNARSOLAR.
Hyunjung is a South Korean guitarist. She is a member and the maknae of the rock band Rolling Quartz. She is a former member of AmberS and Rose Quartz.
Hyunjung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group RUBY.
Hyunmin was a South Korean singer under GH Entertainment. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group Apple.B, leaving sometime before the group's disbandment for unknown reasons.

Hyunny is a South Korean singer and rapper formely under EgoENT. She was the leader of the girl group VVUP. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl. Her final rank was 11th place. On August 29th 2024 EgoENT announced her departure from VVUP due to continues health issuses.
Hyunseo is a South Korean singer and member of 4UNCE.

Cho Hyun Young is a South Korean singer and actress under Mama Creative. She was a member of the girl group Rainbow and its subunits Rainbow Pixie and Rainbow Blaxx until their disbandment in 2016.

HyunYoung, formerly known as Seolha, is a South Korean singer under an unrevealed agency. She was part of a dance team while attending Kookmin University. She is a member of the girl group January and a former member of the girl group Yellow Bee.
AI is a South Korean singer, BJ and model, member of the girl group GI. She is also known for being a contestant on the survival show, Best of the Best.

I-Rohm is an independent singer who made her debut with the song "Take Back" on September 9th, 2022.

I.VIN is a South Korean rapper. She is a former member of the girl group UNICA.

Ian is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group T.O.P Girls. Ian and Minji debuted as a sub-unit on June 20, 2020.
Ian is a South Korean singer under United Creative. She is a member of the girl group CHERRY ON TOP.

Ian is a South Korean singer and rapper under WinnerZone Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group Rumble-G. On November 20, 2021, Rumble-G announced that she would be leaving the group due to health problems.
Ichika is a Japanese trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.
Ichikawa Manami is a Japanese singer, member of AKB48's Team K. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 81st place.
Ida is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group MAJORS.

Idam is a South Korean trainee under FAINIT Company. She is a former MyDoll Entertainment trainee. She debuted as a member of FAINIT on June 13, 2022. However, the group was disbanded within a month. She then, along with Liha, Seoa, and Meanu, joined Chrome Entertainment as a trainee.
Idota Yui is a Japanese trainee under MODHAUS announced as a contestant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 7th episode.

She is also known for participating in the survival shows Superstar K1 and Girls Frontier.
Iira (formerly known as Terra) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group PRISM. She was also a member of the indie folk band Orange.

IKnow, also known as Ara, is a South Korean singer and dancer under Midas Entertainment. She is also a former pre-debut member of the girl group N-DAY.
Ilee is a South Korean rapper under MZMC Inc. She is a member of the girl group VVS.

Iliya Fedartsova is a Belarusian singer-songwriter. She made her solo debut on March 24, 2019 with the EP Nestandart. She gained fame for joining the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where on the 8th of October, 2023 she was eliminated at 16th place.

Iljin Kim is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl duo Hush as Eeljin. She went onto debut as a solo singer to release her own self-titled studio album, Eeljin on March 1, 2002. She later went inactive to continue pursuing her education to earn a Masters degree from the University of Music and Performing Arts Vienna. She returned in 2009 to release classical music studio album. She returned to mainstream pop and music in 2014 when she re-branded as 'Jane', and then eventually to her real name 'Iljin Kim'. She work as singer and music producer to this day.
iLLA is a independent Korean R&B/hip-hop singer, songwriter and composer. She is a former member of the disbanded girl group VNT as Lil J. In 2015, she debuted as a soloist.
Lee Darim, better known as Im DAI, is a South Korean singer who debuted on september 19, 2018 with the single album "Just".

Im Do Hwa (formerly known as Chan Mi) is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actress under FNC Entertainment. She is the maknae of the girl group AOA and a member of its sub-unit AOA Cream. In 2023, she participated in the Kakao Entertainment virtual reality survival show "GIRL'S RE:VERSE". Her final rank was #26. Also in 2023, she participated in the Mnet survival show "Queendom Puzzle", but was eliminated at 14th place.
Im Jiyul is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.

Im Kyungha is a South Korean soloist under Red Submarine Entertainment. She was revealed to have left Produce 101 Season 1 on Episode 3, where she was a contestant under Astory Entertainment. Before her appearance on Produce 101, Kyungha appeared on Kpop Star 2. However, she was unable to make it to the finals.
Im So Hyeon is a South Korean singer under MAJOR9 Entertainment. She was a contestant on MIXNINE.
Soyoung is a South Korean singer under Hanahreum Company. She was a member of the girl group Stellar until their disbandment. She made her solo debut on August 20, 2019 with the single "Breath".
Sol A is a South Korean model and former singer. She is a former member of the girl group PPL. Sola is currently a BJ on Afreeca TV.
Imada Mina is a Japanese singer under Mercury, member of HKT48's Team KIV. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 76th place.
IMSEMO is a South Korean singer under Poclanos who debuted on December 14, 2018 with, “I Wish the World Would End”.

Imzecheon is a member of of the virtual girl group TSSJ under Parable Entertainment. She made her solo debut on January 14, 2025 with the single "Accidental Galaxy". Her concept age is 17 years old, but she is actually an adult.
In Kyung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BP POP.

In Sun (인썬) is a South Korean singer who debuted on March 18, 2011 with the digital single album 너라는 사람은. She was a member of PREMU under the stage name Lany. Her older brother is the singer and producer JUNGLS.
Ina is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Ureka. She left the group in 2016.

Yina, also known as DJ Ina is a South Korean singer and DJ under Gaon Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups AiRiSU and Pocket Girls as Yina and TWEETY under the stage name Yuriel. She made her solo debut on November 30, 2018 with her first digital single "Without You". As of July 31st, 2019, she has become a DJ under the name DJ Ina.

Jeung Yina, known under her stage name INA, is a South Korean-Australian dancer, rapper, and singer-songwriter under BPM Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the girl group BADVILLAIN. On May 15, 2024, INA was revealed as the third member of BADVILLAIN. The group officially debuted on June 3, 2024, with their debut single album "OVERSTEP".

Ireh is a South Korean dancer and singer under RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”.

Bae Joohyun, popularly known as Irene, is a South Korean singer, rapper, dancer, and actress under SM Entertainment. She is best recognized as the leader and visual of the Kpop girl group Red Velvet and a member of its sub-unit Red Velvet – Irene & Seulgi. Irene debuted with Red Velvet on August 1, 2014, with the single "Happiness". In July 2020, she and fellow member Seulgi formed the group’s first sub-unit, releasing the mini album "Monster". She later made her solo debut on November 26, 2024, with the mini album "Like A Flower". Beyond music, Irene has pursued acting and television hosting.2 She made her acting debut in the 2021 film Double Patty and starred in the 2016 web drama Women at a Game Company. She has also hosted Music Bank (2015–2016) and variety shows like Laundry Day (2016–2017). In 2022, she launched her solo reality show, Irene's Work & Holiday.
Irene is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Honey Girls.
Irene is an Indonesian trainee and content creator. She is a member of the girl group TD.

Iris, formerly known as Yelin, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer. She is a member of the producing team CIELOGROOVE and a former member of the trainee groups SG Girls and ALPHA RAY. She made her solo debut with the digital single "Tender Love" on October 28, 2022.

Isabella is a South Korean rapper-songwriter currently under Hot Dog Entertainment. She debuted on November 28, 2019 with the digital single "Get Salty". She was a contestant on High School Rapper 1, High School Rapper 2 and MIXNINE.

Isak is a Korean-American singer, TV host and actress. She was a member of the girl duo Isak 'N' Jiyeon. She is now the radio DJ for Arirang's "Kpoppin" slot. She was born in Germany to a German father and Korean mother and was raised in the United States before moving to Korea.

ISHA, also known as Gowoon, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under COSMIK RAIDERS. She is a former member of the girl group Berry Good and its sub-unit Berry Good HEART HEART. She made her solo debut on February 20, 2021, with the digital single "City Lights".
Isol (이솔) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Lusty. She made her solo debut with the trot single "미안하다 이거 보여주려고 어그로 끌었다" on December 22, 2020.

IT'S is South Korean singer-songwriter and composer currently under ODD33. She is a member of the duo BamSooSung. She made her solo debut on January 10, 2014, with the digital single "What Are You Doing Tonight?"
iTO is a South Korean live idol. She is a member of the group NEO-ASFiK.
Itzel is a South Korean singer who made her debut on August 2, 2022, with the EP ZOOM! and the title track "New Birth".

Lee Ji-eun, popularly known as IU, is a highly acclaimed South Korean singer, songwriter, philanthropist, and actress under EDAM Entertainment. She is also known in South Korea as "The Nation's Little Sister" and "The Nation's Sweetheart." Besides her talent in singing and songwriting, IU is also loved by fans worldwide for her performance as an actress in dramas such as "Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo," "Hotel Del Luna," and "My Mister." Like many other artist, IU had humble beginnings. Her love for music and natural talent made her dream of becoming a singer. For years, she attended singing and acting lessons in different places, honing her skills and abilities. She also auditioned for more than 20 companies, failing most of them. However, her hard work eventually led to her debut on September 18, 2008, when she performed the digital single 'Lost Child' on M Countdown. IU's popularity rose over the years. Following the release of her mini album 'Real' in 2010, IU solidified her career in South Korea and was nicknamed 'The Nation's Little Sister." She released more chart-topping hits and received awards left and right. Eventually, IU became one of the most sought-after artists, not just in South Korea, but all over the world. On September 1, 2020 , IU became a talk show host on her YouTube show "IU's Palette'.

Ivone is a Vietnamese singer based in South Korea. She made her solo debut on February 2, 2020 with the collaboration single Better Day (with Tera). She was a member of Vietnamese girl group LIME, where she was the main rapper. They debuted on May 26, 2015 and disbanded on May 13, 2019. She and the group as a whole gained recognition as they appeared on I Can See Your Voice 3.

She debuted as a solo artist on February 3, 2021, with her digital single Belated Regret. Her stage name is a blend of her given name and the English words "easy" and "kite."

Jang Ye-eun, known under her stage name J, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under High Up Entertainment. She is best known as the vocalist, rapper and maknae of the girl group STAYC. Between 2017 and 2019 she was a trainee at JYP Entertainment. She then joined High Up Entertainment in 2019. On October 14, 2020, J was revealed as the fifth member of STAYC. In 2004, She won 8th place in the SM Youth Best Contest hosted by SM Entertainment. Jang Hyeri originally debuted in the South Korean pop girl group Girl's Day under DreamT Entertainment as an original member and Main Vocalist with their debut single "Tilt My Head" on the 7th of July 2010 under the stage name Ji In. However, only two months after their debut, on September 12, 2010, it was announced that she and fellow member Jisun had left the group. Her reason was that she wanted to concentrate on her acting and solo singing career but also due to issues in her personal life. On the 26th of December 2012, Jang Hyeri along with another former Girl's Day member Jihae, released the duet song "Loving Day" through YouTube. In October 2013, she was revealed as the Bassist and Lead Vocalist of the South Korean pop-rock band Bebop under HMI Entertainment as she was spotted playing in the group at a club performance. Then later on the 14th of February 2014 she officially re-debuted in Bebop with their debut mini-album "Between Calm and Passion" continuing under the stage name Ji In. On the 18th of October 2015, she announced her departure from Bebop due to health problems. On the 20th of March 2018, she released her Chinese solo debut single, "Really Like You" under the name Zhi Ren. On the 6th of April 2018, she appeared on an episode of I Can See Your Voice 5 on the show it was revealed that she took numerous part-time jobs following her departure from Girl's Day but was still pursuing a career in acting as well as singing. On the 9th of April 2018, it was announced that Jang Hyeri had joined a new agency Will Entertainment. On the 5th of September 2019, she released her Korean solo debut single "난" still under the stage name Ji In. On the 17th of July 2020, it was announced that she had signed a contract with Big Daddy Entertainment. She made her official debut as a trot singer on the 6th of August 2020 with the single "서방님" under the new stage name Jang Hyeri. In an interview with OSEN, she explained that she changed her stage name as she wanted to make a fresh start with her new career as a trot singer. The name was also given to her by her current CEO as it was the first name he chose and thought it suited her as well as naming her after her senior, Jang Hyeri. On the 2nd of November 2020, she discussed her story in the industry on YouTube.

Jennie Kim, popularly known as Jennie, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and actress under ODD ATELIER and Columbia Records. She rose to global fame as the main rapper and lead vocalist of the internationally recognized kpop girl group BLACKPINK, which debuted under YG Entertainment in 2016. Jennie has since built a successful solo career, becoming one of the most prominent figures in the Korean entertainment industry. Jennie spent her formative years across South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand before returning to Seoul to train under YG Entertainment. Prior to her official debut, she gained early recognition through high-profile collaborations, including G-Dragon's "That XX" and features on tracks by Lee Hi, Seungri, and G-Dragon. Her global debut with BLACKPINK marked the beginning of her rise as a household name in kpop. Jennie launched her solo music career with the single "Solo" in 2018. The track topped South Korea’s Circle Digital Chart and the Billboard World Digital Songs chart, while its music video became the first by a Korean female soloist to surpass one billion views on YouTube. Her later releases, including "You & Me" and "One of the Girls," further cemented her position as a leading solo artist on the global stage. In 2023, Jennie made her acting debut in the HBO series The Idol under the name Jennie Ruby Jane, gaining international attention for her performance. That same year, she renewed her group contract with BLACKPINK while taking control of her solo ventures. She established her agency, ODD ATELIER, to oversee her individual projects and later signed with Columbia Records to expand her presence in the United States. Her 2024 single "Mantra" and the album Ruby (2025) achieved significant commercial success. The album sold over one million copies worldwide and produced multiple top-charting tracks, including "like JENNIE". "Mantra" made history as the highest-ranking song by a Korean female soloist on the UK Singles Chart. Jennie has earned numerous accolades, including awards from MAMA, the Circle Chart, Golden Disc, and Billboard Women in Music, where she became the first Korean soloist to win. Renowned for her influence in fashion, she serves as a global ambassador for Chanel and is frequently referred to as the "Human Chanel" in media and fan communities.

She made her solo debut on December 1, 2005 with the single album "Get Up", under the name Jessica H.O. From 2020-2022, she was the host of YouTube talk show Showterview with Jessi. In October 2024, just a month after joining DOD Entertainment, rapper-singer Jessi terminated her contract following an alleged fan assault case. DOD Entertainment announced the mutual decision on October 18, 2024, expressing gratitude for her brief time with them and support for her future endeavors. Earlier that week, Jessi was questioned by police regarding an incident on September 29, where a fan reported being assaulted by a man accompanying Jessi. Despite video evidence showing Jessi attempting to intervene, public criticism arose as she left the scene without further action. Jessi had recently signed with DOD Entertainment after her contract with Jay Park's agency, More Vision, ended.

She used to be a member of the popular girl group Girls’ Generation formed by SM Entertainment. In early 2014, she established a fashion company, Blanc & Eclare. Later that year, she departed the group Girls’ Generation due to her business commitments clashing with the group’s schedule. In 2015, she also terminated her contract with SM Entertainment and signed with Coridel Entertainment in 2016, before launching her first solo album. Jessica eventually made her debut as a soloist with the mini album “With Love, J” on May 17, 2016. She also released a novel titled “Shine” in September 2020, which became a bestseller.

Jisoo first debuted with BLACKPINK under YG Entertainment on August 8, 2016, gaining international acclaim for her performance and presence. Even before her official debut, Jisoo attracted public attention through modeling campaigns and acting appearances. As a trainee, she featured in several advertisements and television cameos. Notably, she appeared in music videos such as "Spoiler" by EPIK High and "I’m Different" by Hi Suhyun, building her pre-debut reputation and expanding her fan base. In addition to her music career, Jisoo demonstrated her versatility by making her acting debut as the female lead in the JTBC drama Snowdrop in 2021. Her performance was praised for its emotional depth and marked a successful transition into acting, further solidifying her as a multi-talented entertainer. Jisoo began her solo music career with the release of her debut single album "ME" on March 31, 2023. The album was met with strong commercial success, resonating with fans globally and showcasing her distinct vocal color and musical identity. Although she chose not to renew her solo contract with YG Entertainment, Jisoo remains an active member of BLACKPINK. On February 21, 2024, she launched her independent agency, BLISSOO, to oversee her individual projects in music, acting, and fashion, allowing her greater creative control over her solo endeavors. In 2025, she released the EP Amortage and its single "Earthquake", which became her first number one on the US Billboard World Digital Songs chart.

Prior to her debut, she took part in the 19th Hanbyul Music Festival, where she received the grand prize for her personally produced choreography in 2006. Jisun originally debuted in the South Korean pop girl group Girl's Day under DreamT Entertainment as an original member with their debut single "Tilt My Head" on the 7th of July 2010. However, only two months after their debut, on September 12, 2010, it was announced that she and fellow member Jang Hyeri (at the time known as Ji In) had left the group. Her reason being she decided to leave to pursue her own interests. Later on the 25th of November 2011, she re-debuted as an original member and Leader, Vocalist, and Dancer of the South Korean girl group New.F.O, under 6Theory and EnterArts Global with the group's debut digital single "Bounce" under the new stage name JN. Juha is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo Bubble X.
Juha is a South Korea singer, dancer under MOAI Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girlgroup E11iVyn.
Juha, formerly Mimi and Jini, is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Queen B'Z.
Juha is a South Korean singer under Kids Planet. She is a member of the girl group Burvey and was a member of trainee group ON1 Rookies.
Juhee is a South Korean singer, dancer, and DJ. She is a member of the girl group Holly Queen and the trot-idol group T-Angel.

Juhyeon is a South Korean dancer and singer under Cube Entertainment. She made her official debut in June 2021 as the leader of the girl group LIGHTSUM. As a trainee, in October 2017, Juhyeon became a contestant on the reality survival show The Unit where she represented Cube Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 14 after ranking in 25th place. In 2018, she became a contestant on another reality survival show, KBS2's Dancing High. She was eliminated in the second episode. Juhyeon debuted as a member of the girl group LIGHTSUM on June 10, 2021, with their first single "Vanilla".
Cha Juhyun is a South Korean rapper and singer. She is a former member of the girl group Bling Bling.
Juju is a South Korean singer and model signed with Star Ent.. She is a former member of the girl group GeeGu.

Julia is a South Korean-American singer under Brave Entertainment. She is a member of Candy Shop. On May 14, 2024, Candy Shop released official photos of Julia, welcoming her as the newest member of the group.

Juliane is a Korean-American singer. She gained prominence as a member of the South Korean girl group ChoColat. Juliane spent part of her childhood in Texas, United States, where she lived from the age of six until she turned 11. Later, she returned to South Korea. At the age of 16, Juliane auditioned for Paramount Entertainment. Interestingly, her connection to the entertainment industry came through Melanie’s mother, who was a friend separated from the same group. Juliane made her debut as a vocalist in ChoColat, releasing the single album “Syndrome.” The group’s name, ChoColat, was inspired by the idea that each member represented a different type of chocolate. Following ChoColat’s disbandment, Juliane now leads a normal life in the United States.

Julie is a South-Korean artist. She is former a member of the girl group April Kiss and a pre-debut member of We Girls. On September 1, 2011 Julie debuted as a member of the girl group April Kiss, with the digital single album "Wannabe". The group is presumed to have disbanded shortly after. On October 31, Aftermoon Entertainment, launched a Makestar project in order to gather funds to debut their first girl group by the name of WeGirls, Julie was introduced as one of the members. Shortly after this she left the group.

Julie Han is a South Korean-American rapper, dancer, singer-songwriter, composer, and choreographer under S2 Entertainment. She is best known as the leader, main rapper, lead dancer, and the oldest member of the girl group KISS OF LIFE. On May 17, 2023, Julie was revealed as the third member of KISS OF LIFE. The group officially debuted on July 5th, 2023, with their self-titled mini album "KISS OF LIFE".
Jun Bogyeong is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Untact Idol Unit.
Jun Seoyeon is a South Korean singer who debuted on January 3, 2023, with the digital single, "Blue Drama".
Jun is a South Korean singer. She was the leader of the girl group Awe5ome Baby.
Juney is a South Korean trainee and model. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar.

Jung Chaeyeon, or simply Chaeyeon, is a South Korean singer, dancer, actress, and model under BH Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl groups DIA and I.O.I. On September 14, 2015, she debuted as a member of the girl group DIA under MBK Entertainment with the release of their first studio album "Do It Amazing". Shortly after debuting, she and fellow group mate Huihyeon, participated in the survival show Produce 101. Ranking 7th in the finale, she secured her spot in the project girl group I.O.I. In February 2018, she was announced as one of the new MC for Inkigayo along actor Song Kang and SEVENTEEN's Mingyu. She held that position from February 18, 2018 until her last broadcast on February 3, 2019.

Jung Choha is a South Korean vocalist signed to M.O.T Entertainment. Her solo career commenced on December 29, 2023, with the release of her digital single titled “Anymore.” She has gained recognition for participating in several singing competition shows, including the notable “Show Queen.”
Jung Da Sol is a South Korean singer under JD Entertainment. She was a contestant of MIXNINE.
Jung Da Woon is a South Korean guitarist, producer, songwriter, and a member of the girl group duo J Rabbit.
Jung Dain is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.

Jung Dakyung is a South Korean solo trot singer-songwriter and composer under TOTALSET. She is a former member of the trot-pop girl group Venus. She made her debut on October 20, 2017 with digital single "I'd Love To".
Jung Hayoon is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.

Jung Hye Min is a South Korean soloist singer. She was a former member of the girl group AL from 2001 to 2002 and also a member of Gavy NJ from 2005 to 2009. She made her solo debut on October 18, 2012 with the digital single "Don't Call Me Nuna".
Jung Hye Sun is a South Korean singer and member of the girl group J Rabbit.
Jung Hyerin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HOTTIES.

Jung Ji-so is a South Korean actress and member of the project girl group WSG Wannabe. She is best known for her roles in the drama "Imitation" as Maha, a member of the fictional girl group TEAPARTY and award-winning film "Parasite" which won the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival and the Academy Award for Best Picture.
Jung Jiwon is a South Korean trainee and rhythmic gymnast announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.
Jung Minsun is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Jung Ryu Won is a South Korean singer, actress, lyricist and model under Blitzway Studios. She is a former member of the girl group Chakra. She first rose to fame in the hit television series My Name Is Kim Sam-soon. She is also known for her roles in Two Faces of My Girlfriend, Castaway on the Moon, and History of a Salaryman.
Jung Sejin (정세진) is a South Korean trot singer who debuted on July 18, 2007 with the single album "콕 찍어주세요".
Jung Sena is a South Korean trainee signed to SW Entertainment. She was a pre-debut member of the girl group UDTT.
Jung Seona is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Jung Seul is a South Korean trot singer under H&ENT. She made her solo debut as a soloist on January 14, 2025 with the digital single "Tabom". She is best known for becoming the 7th place finalist of the trot survival show Miss Trot 3.
Jung Si Woon is a South Korean dancer and former singer and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group Baby V.O.X. She's now the director of JSW Dance Studio.
Jung Siwoo is a South Korean trainee. She was a contestant on the survival shows CAP-TEEN and My Teenage Girl.
Jung Su-ra is a South Korean singer.

Jung Woo Yeon, formerly known as Ryu Hyoyoung or Hyoyoung, is a South Korean singer, rapper and actress under Big Picture Entertainment. She is a former member of the co-ed group Co-ed School and the girl group F-ve Dolls.

Jung Yoon Hye is a South Korean model, and former rapper and singer. She was a member of the girl group FANATICS and its sub-unit FLAVOR under FENT, which she presumably left when the group stopped their activities.
Jung Yoo Jung is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on MIXNINE. She ranked 143rd place.
Jung Yu Jin is a South Korean singer. She debuted in 2001 as a member of the original line-up of the Korean pop girl group Jewelry, however she left the group the following year.
Jung Yuju is a South Korean trainee under Hi-Hat Entertainment. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Jung Yuri, also known as keren is a South Korean singer. She debuted on February 2, 2024 with the digital single "2 filles". She is a contestant on Girls On Fire and she was a contestant on Blossom with Love.
Kim Jung-ah, better known by the mononym Jungah is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the South Korean girl group After School, and sub-group A.S. Red formed by Pledis Entertainment.
Jung-Yun is a South Korean-American singer. She is a former member of the girl group Sunny Days. She joined the group in 2014.
Jungbin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group TAHITI. She left the group due to health issues in 2014. There are rumors she passed away.
Yoon Jungeun is a South Korean singer and former member of the girl group D.U.B.
Junghee is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Nazca.
JungHwa is a South Korean model, musical actress and fitness player who has won several fitness competiotions in Korea and abroad. She was a member of the girl group BEBEHEAL.
Jungmin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Black Pearl. She joined the group after Mika left. She debuted as a soloist on December 20, 2003 as EE.JUNGMIN.
Jungtune is a South Korean singer who debuted on 3 June 2019 with the single, "Give a sweet smile to this world that is falling".

Uhm Jungwoo, also known as Jungwoo, is a singer and actress from South Korea. She used to be in a group called BVNDIT. She joined the group on March 12, 2019, and they debuted with the song "BVNDIT, Be Ambitious!" on April 10, 2019. But on November 11, 2022, BVNDIT disbanded after their contracts ended. Then, in April 2023, Jungwoo signed up with ShowPLAY ACTORS to start acting in musicals.

Jungwoo is a South Korean singer-songwriter primarily active in the Korean indie music scene. Renowned for her clear voice and evocative, lyrical songwriting, her musical style is often compared to that of the late Kim Kwang-seok, an influential figure in Korean folk music. She began to garner attention in 2017 through performances around Hongdae Street, a vibrant hub for indie music in Seoul. Her talent led to guest appearances at solo concerts for various artists, including Choi Go-eun, Han Kyung-rok of Crying Nut, and Kim Sa-wol. In December 2016, she signed with CTR Sound, a significant milestone in her career. On September 5, 2019, she released her debut full-length album, The Sixth Saturday. Following this, she parted ways with CTR Sound on December 16, 2022. She subsequently announced the production of her second full-length album, Cloud Cuckoo Land, which was released on November 9, 2023.
Jungyeon is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the upcoming girl group LURA LUCY.
Jinhee is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Lusty.

Junhwi is a South Korean dancer and singer under iNKODE. She is a member of the girl group SAY MY NAME. Junhwi made her debut with SAY MY NAME on October 16, 2024 with the release of their first mini album "SAY MY NAME".

Juniel is a South Korean singer-songwriter currently under K-Tigers E&C. She is a member of the co-ed indie duo Poetic Narrador. She made her Japanese debut on April 29, 2011, with the mini album Ready Go!, and her Korean debut on June 7, 2012, with the mini album My First June.
Junny is a Chinese singer. She is a former member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China.
Juri is a Korean pop singer and member of the duo JEVICE. She first made her debut as a solo singer in 2009 as Iahsi. In 2010 she joined the project group Qualifying Love.
Juri is a South Korean singer under SRP Entertainment and a member of the girl group Rocking Doll.

Juri, also known by her full name Takahashi Juri, is a Japanese singer. She was a member of the girl group Rocket Punch and a member of the Japanese supergroup AKB48. In 2011, Juri joined AKB48 after passing their 12th Generation auditions. She eventually became the captain of Team B. In 2018, she participated in Mnet's survival show Produce 48. She was eliminated in the finale after ranking 16th place. She competed on the MNET survival show Queendom Puzzle but was eliminated in 12th place. On March 4, Juri announced during her birthday event that she would be graduating from AKB48 and would be pursuing a career in Korea after signing with Woollim Entertainment. Woollim confirmed the news that same day, stating that she will debut in the agency's upcoming girl group. On July 22, the agency released a concept film showing the six members of their new girl group, Rocket Punch, for the first time, with Juri being one of them. On July 29, her individual concept film was released. The group's debut mini album, "Pink Punch", was released on August 7, 2019. On May 24, 2024, it was announced that Takahashi Juri left both Rocket Punch and Woollim Entertainment following the expiration of her contract. As of late, according to her SNS, she is currently starting her own K-POP and K_Beauty consulting company.

Ueda Juria is a Japanese singer and dancer under XGALX. She was under Good Choice Entertainment in 2014–2015. She is best known as the main vocalist of the Japanese global girl group XG. Born in Osaka, Japan, Juria was a former member of an idol group, amorecarina, until she graduated from the group on September 30, 2015. She was in the unit Juri♡Puri. After graduation, she went by the name Ueda Juria and became a special student at Avex Artist Academy Tokyo. On February 3, 2022, Juria was revealed as the sixth member of XG The group officially debuted on March 18, 2022, with their debut digital single "Tippy Toes".

Asaya Jurin, known under her stage name Jurin, is a Japanese rapper, dancer, singer, model, choreographer, and snowboarder under XGALX. She is best known as the leader, main dancer, and lead rapper of the Japanese global girl group XG. Jurin started snowboarding at a young age and her goal was to become a pro athlete, and she achieved it at the age 12, so she decided to be in a girl group and express it which led her to debut in XG. She has been a fashion model for Droptokyo, Popteen, and more since she was 15. On January 29, 2022, Jurin was revealed as the first member of XG. The group officially debuted on Mar 18, 2022, with their debut digital single "Tippy Toes".
Jururu is a virtual South Korean singer and streamer under WAK Entertainment. She is a vocalist of the virtual girl group ISEGYE IDOL.
Juun is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. She is a member of the South Korean girl group Hearts2Hearts.
Juuny is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Kitten Girls. She left the group in October 2018.

Juwon is a South Korean singer and dancer. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group Elado under AO Entertainment. In 2020, she joined Deep Studio Entertainment and became a member of the pre-debut group YOURS. She announced her departure from the group and the agency on September 1, 2021.

Juya is a South Korean model and a former singer and dancer. She was a member of the South Korean girl group Fly With Me under FA Entertainment. On June 27, 2018, she debuted as a member of Fly With Me with the release of their first digital single, "Your Face". She left the group sometime in 2020.
Juyeon is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group AZER.

Lee Juyeon is a South Korean singer signed under Yoonso Group. On January 22, 2019, she was added as a new member of the girl group Saturday as the sub-vocalist and lead dancer. Aside from singing, Juyeon also has a knack for playing the piano and the guitar.

Jvcki Wai, born Hong Ye-eun, is a South Korean rapper who debuted on November 2, 2016, with mini-album “Exposure” under The Ugly Junction and STONESHIP. As an artist, she's known for her war-like lyrics with colorful layers of synths with energetically delivered verses and post-cyberpunk styling and themes. In 2018 she signed to Swings' label 'INDIGO Music', and went on to release her first studio full-length album 'Enchanted Propaganda'. In October 2019, she left INDIGO as her contract had expired, only releasing two collaboration singles after her departure. On October 24, 2022, it was announced that Jvcki Wai had signed with Jay Park's label 'AOMG' and released her first song in two years, 'Go Back'.
K (also known as K Lu and Ke Ran) is a Chinese singer and rapper under TOV Entertainment. She is the leader of the girl group Fanxy Red and a member of the project Chinese girl group THE9.
K!TZ! is an independent singer-songwriter and composer. She made her solo debut on November 2, 2021 with the digital single "Lighting".

Kaede is a Japanese dancer and singer under MODHAUS. Kaede was introduced as the ninth member of the girl group tripleS on November 9, 2022. She made her debut with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE". As a member of tripleS, Kaede was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Aria, Visionary Vision and Moon.
Kaeun is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Dalshabet. She left the group in December 2015 and rejoined in 2019.

Park Ji-Young, best known by her promotional name Kahi, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actress. She is the former leader of the South Korean girl group After School, and their sub-group A.S. Red formed by Pledis Entertainment. Kahi is also a former member of the Korean-American girl group S.Blush. On December 10, 2021, Kahi joined the reality show Mama The Idol and debuted in the girl group Mamadol (M.M.D).

Kai'Sa is the main dancer and choreographer of the virtual girl group K/DA. She has a quiet and intense focus that drives the team to create amazing concepts and flawless details. She has a cosmopolitan outlook on life, and finds inspiration in every part of the world.
KAIAVANT, formerly known as Lala, is a South Korean singer under Mine Field. She was a member of the girl group Rubber Soul.
Kako is a Japanese singer. She was a contestant on Nizi Project. She was a member of GEM and One Chance.
Kally is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the band Kiwi Band.
Kami is a South Korean cafe maid and singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.

Kamión is a Japanese singer under NTT Docomo Studio & Live and Sony Music Entertainment Korea. In 2023, Kamión was a contestant on Produce 101 Japan The Girls. She was eliminated in episode 10 after ranking 24th place. She is a member of the global girl group cosmosy, with whom she debuted on December 31, 2024 in Japan and February 7, 2025 globally with the digital single "zigy=zingy", and later officially on April 11, 2025 with the digital single "Lucky=One".

Kan Miyoun is a South Korean singer and actress currently under STARHUE Entertainment. She originally debuted in 1997 in the girl group Baby V.O.X, after their disbandment she re-debuted as a solo artist under the stage name Miyoun with the album "Refreshing" in 2006. She went onto debuting in China and is currently active in both South Korean and Chinese media. She also created a fashion line named 'Kanderella' in 2010. She made her musical acting debut in 2017 with the musical "I Love You".

Kana was a former pre-debut member of the girl group VIVIDIVA, where she was poised to be the main vocalist and dancer. Her departure from the group occurred prior to their official debut, and the circumstances surrounding her exit remain undisclosed. Within VIVIDIVA, she was represented by the symbol of a tulip
Kana is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Kana Bathe is a South Korean singer and rapper who debuted independently in 2017.
Kanao is a South Korean live idol, she is a member of the duo C.LiTZ.

Tsuyuri Kanato, formerly known as Limu, is a South Korean singer and former member of the South Korean J-POP live idol girl group YUBiKiRi. She debuted in the group on January 20, 2024, but graduated soon after on April 27, 2024. She redebuted as a member of Reconquista later that year on December 1st.
Kanee is an Indian trainee under MissDica Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group MissDica Girls.
Kang Eunji is a South Korean singer. She participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kang Eunwoo is a South Korean trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Kang Han Kyoung, formerly known as Lua, is a South Korean actress, model and singer. She is a former member of the girl group BADKIZ.

Kang Hyewon is a South Korean actress, singer, songwriter and model. In 2018, she competed on Mnet's hit survival show Produce 48, where she ranked 8th place with 248,432 votes, earning her a spot in the project group IZ*ONE. She made her official debut as a member of the group on October 29, 2018, with the release of the mini album "COLOR*IZ". After IZ*ONE's disbandment in the spring of 2021, she made her acting debut in the drama "Best Mistakes Season 3", which aired from December 2021 to February 2022. Since then, she got main roles in dramas such as "Seasons of Blossom", which aired in 2022, "Boyhood" in 2023, and "Friendly Rivalry", in 2025. Kang Hyewon eventually debuted as a soloist on December 22, 2021, with the release of the special winter album titled "W".

Kang Jihyun is a South Korean singer, model and musical actress. She was a former member of the girl group AL. Kang Jihyun never returned to singing, but continued on as a magazine model and musical actress.

Kang Jinju, formerly known as Tau, is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter, producer. She is a former member of the project girl group Flush. She debuted on February 8, 2018 with the digital single "And - One Way Traffic".
Kang Jiwon is a South Korean former trainee. She is mostly known for being a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND 2 N/a, where she was eliminated in episode 5.
Kang Jiyeon is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the co-ed group Space A.
Kang Kyoung Ah is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group PAPAYA.

Kang Min Hee is a Korean Hip-Hop/R&B singer under Brand New Music. She is a member of the girl duo Miss $. She joined the group in 2012. In 2013 she released her solo debut digital single "It's You". She was a contestant on The Unit.

Kang Mina is a South Korean actress, dancer, rapper, and singer under Story J Company. She is a former member of the girl group gugudan, its sub-units gugudan SEMINA and OGUOGU, and the project girl group I.O.I. In 2016, Kang Mina participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with three other trainees from her agency at the time, Jellyfish Entertainment. She ranked 9th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis'. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017. Kang Mina, along labelmate and fellow I.O.I member Kim Sejeong, debuted as a member of Jellyfish Entertainment's girl group gugudan on June 28, 2016, with the mini album "Act. 1 The Little Mermaid". Later, in July 2017, the agency formed gugudan's first sub-unit, called gugudan OGUOGU, which debuted on August 10, 2017 with the single "ICE CHU", and eventually disbanded after Hyeyeon left the group. Kang Mina was also a part of gugudan' second sub-unit, gugudan SeMiNa, which debuted on July 10, 2018, with the single "SEMINA". Both gugudan and gugudan SeMiNa eventually disbanded in December 2020, after two years of inactivity. Kang Mina made her acting debut in the MBC romantic comedy series "Children of the 20th Century" in 2017, acting as the younger counterpart of Han Ye-seul. She has, since gugudan disbandment, focused her career on acting, playing roles in well-known dramas such as "Hotel del Luna" (2019), "Moonshine" (2021-2022), "Café Minamdang" (2022), and "Welcome to Samdalri" (2024-2025).
Kang Minji is a South Korean trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Kang Min Ju, formerly Minjoo, is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group Year 7 Class 1.

Kang Minju is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN as a member of LOVELYPINK, however she did not pass the first performance evaluation and was therefore eliminated.

Kang Minseo is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Seowoo ENM. She debuted as a soloist singer on February 23, 2022 with the digital single "What-R-Ing". She is best known for being a contestant on the vocal survival show Girls on Fire.

Sejung is a South Korean singer and actress, formerly a member of the girl group PAPAYA. She has appeared in several dramas, including Heartless City, You’re My Pet, and Assorted Gems. Sejung has received recognition for her acting, winning an Excellence Award at the MBC Drama Awards and another at the 20th Korean Culture and Entertainment Awards. During her acting career, she was known as Go Naeun before reverting to her birth name, Kang Sejung, in 2017.

Kang Sira is a South Korean singer from Chungchun Music. She was first known for competing in the hit survival program "Produce 101" where she finished 22nd place. She made her official debut in January 2017 with the mini album "Sira."
Kang So Yeon is a South Korean singer, actress and model under Brand New Music. She was a member of the co-ed group WE as Rosie. She is the CEO of HitFit Boxing.
Kang Sumin, also known as UziA, is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire.
Kang Susie is a South Korean singer. She also hosted radio program Kang Su-ji's Memories from 2013 to 2014.

Kang Taeri, formerly known as Ruru, is a South Korean singer and model. She gained prominence as the leader and lead vocalist of the girl group TREN-D, debuting on October 2, 2013, with their digital single “Candy Boy.” Despite TREN-D’s eventual disbandment in 2016, Ruru’s journey continued beyond K-pop. She transitioned into modeling, captivating audiences both locally and internationally. Under the name ‘Kang Taeri,’ she made waves in Taiwan and Japan, leaving her mark on international runways and fashion campaigns.

Kang Siwon, also known as Xiwon, is a South Korean Singer under Soon Entertainment. She made her debut on April 4, 2019 with the single "Click Click". She was first known for appearing in the hit survival show Produce 101. In 2017, Kang Xiwon became a part of UNI, a four-member girl group that was formerly under We Can Do It! Entertainment and was later supposed to make their debut under TNK Entertainment, but ultimately disbanded before debuting.
Kang Ye Won is a South Korean actress and singer. She is a former member of the project girl group Unnies.
Kang Yebin is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.

Kang Yunjeong, also known as Gemma Kang, is a South Korean singer under Prain Global. She was a contestant on the mystery music game shows I Can See Your Voice 8 in 2021 and Art Singer in 2022. She was also a contestant on the JTBC survival show Girls On Fire where she ended up ranking #4 which made her a part of the final group on June 25, 2024. However, on December 23, 2024, it was announced that the debut of the final group had been canceled.
Kangbin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group A.H.H.A. Her birthday is October 8 of a unknown year.
Kangyoon is a South Korean singer who was a member of the girl group Blady. She left the group in 2015. In 2016, she participated in Produce 101 and ended in 78th place.
Kani is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the Korean pop girl group Bella.

Kanie is a South Korean singer under TOP Media. She was revealed as a member of the girl group ODD YOUTH on September 25, 2024. She debuted with them on November 1, 2024, with the release of their first single "Best Friendz".

Kanni, formerly known as Xeheun is a South Korean singer under Space Sound. She is a former member of the girl group GIRLKIND and its subunit GIRLKIND XJR.She made her solo debut on October 19, 2018 with the digital single "Vibe On". She was a contestant on Produce 101.

Kanno Miyu is a Japanese-South Korean trainee. She is a member of the Japanese girl group Nü FEEL. She is known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows Girls Planet 999 and Produce 101 JAPAN THE GIRLS.

femaleIdols.description: Kanny is a Thai rapper and singer under iNKODE. She is a member of the girl group SAY MY NAME. Kanny made her debut with SAY MY NAME on October 16, 2024 with the release of their first mini album "SAY MY NAME".

Kanou Miyu is a Japanese singer under n.CH Entertainment. She is one half of the duo Atlantis Kitsune and is a member of the upcoming Japanese girl group sis/T. She is also known for being a former contestant in the Japanese trot survival show Trot Girls Japan and its follow-up show, the South Korean-Japanese trot survival show Korea VS Japan Trot.
Karam is a South Korean singer. She was a former member of the upcoming girl group ALLS-GIRL and former member of D-CRUNCH's pre-debut sub-unit Geupsik-Dan.
Karin is a member of the virtual girl group Aesther under Charon Universe.
Karin is a Japanese trainee under High Up Entertainment. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

Karin is the lead vocalist, lead rapper, and youngest member of the girl group ALICE (formerly ELRIS) under IOK Company. Karin is also known for being a contestant in the 6th season of the show "Kpop Star." On May 3, 2024, Karin announced through Bubble that she would be leaving ALICE.

Karin is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer under 1EVEL ENM. Karin was introduced as one of the original members of the trainee group WishGirls under her birth name, Yerin, in the single "Wish For You". She released a solo song, "Ka Ka Ka", on November 1, 2019. Karin made her debut as a member of the girl group CRAXY on March 2, 2020, with the full-length album "My Universe".
Karina is a Japanese singer member of the girl group SKYGIRLS.

Karina (born Yoo Jimin) is a South Korean singer, rapper, and dancer under SM Entertainment. She is best known as the leader, main dancer, lead rapper, sub vocalist and visual of the girl group aespa. Before debuting, Karina was active on social media and was recruited by SM Entertainment in 2016. She made her first public appearance in Taemin’s Want MV on February 19, 2019, and also performed as a backup dancer during its promotions. She debuted as the leader of aespa on November 17, 2020, with the digital single Black Mamba. On January 3, 2022, she debuted as a member of GOT the beat, a unit from SM’s project girl group Girls On Top, alongside her aespa bandmate Winter. She also participated in SM Entertainment’s ninth winter album 2022 Winter SMTOWN: SMCU Palace, featuring on the track Hot & Cold with EXO’s Kai, Red Velvet’s Seulgi, and NCT’s Jeno. In 2023, Karina contributed to the OST for the Netflix drama Song of the Bandits with the track Sad Waltz, further showcasing her versatility as an artist.
Karine is an Armenian trainee. She is a member of the upcoming girl group DE:VA

Karlee is a Japanese-Korean-American singer. She made her solo debut on April 25, 2025 with digital single "Little Things". She gained fame for joining the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where she was eliminated at 18th place.
Karuna is a Japanese singer and model. She is a former member of the girl group GG. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar.
Kasia, formerly known as Gayeon, is a South Korean singer under Hi-Hat Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group ifeye.

Kasper is a South Korean rapper and YouTuber under MAJOR9. She is a former member of the co-ed hip-hop group Play the Siren. She made her solo debut on January 18, 2017, with her first single "Lean On Me". She was a contestant on Show Me the Money 4 and Unpretty Rapstar 2.
Kassy is a South Korean singer and rapper under Nextar Entertainment. She made her debut on August 25, 2015 with her first single "In My Bed".
Kate is a Russian singer and theater actress under Shinwha Entertainment, member of the pre-debut girl group GLX.
Katelyn is a Filipino singer under TITAN CONTENT. She is a member of the girl group AtHeart.
Katherine Lee is an American singer. She is currently not training and rather, focusing on her studies. She ranked #89 on Episode 5 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated.

Kim Seohyun is a South-Korean born American singer who is better known as Katie Kim. She was hailed the winner of K-pop star 4 back in 2015 and signed with YG Entertainment. Before releasing her debut track, Katie Kim left YG Entertainment and is currently under Axis creative collective.
Kato Yuuka is a Japanese singer under Showtitle, a former member of NMB48's Team M and Kyunmart. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 74th place.
Katrina is a Chinese singer under World K-Pop Center. She is a member of the girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE China.

Kawaguchi Yurina is an Actress, Model, and Singer. She was a member of X21. She was a contestant on the reality survival program "Girls Planet 999" but with her final rank being 14th, she was unable to get in the final lineup of Kep1er.
Yu is a Japanese trainee under INNIT Entertainment. She is a member of the pre-debut girl group DDDD 25.She is best known for participating in the survival shows Universe Ticket and The Entertainer.
Kaya is a South Korean rapper. She was member of the girl group SPIA.
KAYA is a South Korean singer-songwriter under IX Entertainment. She made her solo debut on April 12, 2023 with the digital single "Past Love".

Kaylee is a South Korean-American singer. She was a member of the girl group VCHA which was formed through the survival show "A2K" under JYP Entertainment. She debuted in VCHA on January 26, 2024, with their first single album Girls of the Year. Before the group's first comeback on March 15, 2024, JYP Entertainment announced that Kaylee would take an indefinite hiatus due to medical concerns. On July 11, 2025, Kaylee announced her departure from both VCHA and JYP Entertainment through her personal Instagram. And on August 16, 2025, she released her debut solo single Cotton Candy, officially starting her career as a solo artist.

Nakamura Kazuha is a Japanese dancer, singer-songwriter and composer under Source Music. She is best known as the main dancer of the girl group LE SSERAFIM. Kazuha was a professional ballet dancer before her debut and attended Hashimoto Sachiyo Ballet School & Jr in Japan, Bolshoi Ballet Academy in Moscow, Royal Ballet School in the UK, and since 2020 she has been studying at the Dutch National Ballet Academy in the Netherlands, where she was recruited by the CEO of Source Music in mid-December 2021. Kazuha debuted as a member of LE SSERAFIM on May 2, 2022, with their first mini album "FEARLESS".
Keen is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the band Kiwi Band.

Keena is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and composer under ATTRAKT. She is best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY. She officially debuted with the group on November 18, 2022, with the release of their mini album “The Fifty”. In a video from Genie Music Youtube channel, published on September 30, 2024, Keena revealed that she had legally changed her name from Song Jakyung to Song Yuni.

Kim Ji Yeon, popularly known as Kei, is a South Korean musician and actress under A2Z Entertainment. She is a member of the global project girl group EL7Z UP. She is also the former main vocalist, lead dancer, and face of the girl group Lovelyz under Woollim Entertainment. On November 17, 2014, she debuted as a member of the Lovelyz with their first studio album "Girls’ Invasion". Kei is also known as the aegyo queen of Woolim. Her “Oppa-yah” aegyo gained a lot of popularity after she performed it on the show Weekly Idol. She also made her debut as a soloist under her real name Kim Ji Yeon. She released her first solo mini album "Over and Over" on October 8, 2019. On November 1, 2021, Woollim Entertainment announced that 7 of the members, except Baby Soul, decided to leave the agency after their contracts ended on November 16. On January 10, 2022, it was announced that she signed an exclusive contract with PALMTREE ISLAND to promote as a musical actress. On April 24, 2023, she participated in the survival show Queendom Puzzle and finished in 4th place earning her spot in the project girl group EL7Z UP. They made their debut on September 14, 2023, with their first mini album “7+Up”.

Keiko is a Korean-Japanese singer under LAPONE Entertainment. In 2023, she participated in the survival show "Produce 101 Japan: The Girls" where she ended up ranking 8th place, securing her spot as a member of the Japanese project girl group ME:I.
Keina is a South Korean rapper and former member of the girl group H.U.B. She left the group on April 6, 2018.

Lín Wéixī, better known as Kelly, is a Taiwanese singer under TR Entertainment. She is the Lead Vocalist and Visual of the girl group TRI.BE. In March 2020, Kelly participated as a contestant on the Chinese survival show "Youth With You 2", where she faced elimination in episode 10 and secured the 64th position. On September 10, 2020, Kelly was officially introduced as the sixth member of TRI.BE.

Ha Seoyeon, known under her stage name Kelly, is a South Korean singer and dancer under BPM Entertainment. She is best known as the maknae of the girl group BADVILLAIN. On May 15, 2024, Kelly was revealed as the first member of BADVILLAIN. The group officially debuted on June 3, 2024, with their debut single album "OVERSTEP".
Kelly is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her solo debut on February 25, 2024 with the digital single "Unless".
Kelly is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Delight but left the group in October 2013.

Kelly Kim is a South Korean media personality and trainee under PI Corporation and member of the South Korean upcoming girl group I.MET.U. In November 2024, she participated in PI Corporation and Makestar' survival show TIME TURNER, where she ranked 1st place, thus becoming a member of the final group, I.MET.U.
Kemy is a South Korean singer formely under Doo Republic. She is a member of the disbanded girl group A.KOR as well as its sub-unit A.KOR Black with fellow member Minju.

Kendall is a Vietnamese-American singer and dancer under JYP Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group GIRLSET (formerly known as VCHA), which was formed through the survival show "A2K". She debuted with the group on January 26, 2024, with their first single album 'Girls of the Year".
Kenny is a Peruvian singer signed under World K-Pop Center. She is part of the multinational girl group BLINGONE and its sub-unit BLINGONE-PE.
Keris is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted independently in 2020.
Kerrigan May, born Park Ye-rim is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2019.

Kessia, formerly known as Raberry and Songhyohyeon, is a South Korean singer under Luminant Entertainment. She made her solo debut on October 12, 2020 with the single, "Same". She was one of the trainees who was supposed to debut in ZeroSix but left the company around mid to late 2020 for personal reasons.

Keumjo is a South Korean singer and musical actress under Handa Productions. She is a former member of the girl group 9MUSES and its sub-unit 9MUSES A. After the group's disbandment, she successfully debuted as a solo artist with her first Single Album "Fingertips" which was simultaneously released in Korean, Japanese, and Chinese on February, 12th 2020.

KG, also known as KG Crown or Kiera Grace, is an American singer. She is a former member of the girl group VCHA formed by the survival show "A2K" under JYP Entertainment. She debuted in VCHA on January 26, 2024, with their first single album "Girls of the Year". On December 7th, 2024, KG filed a lawsuit to terminate her contract with JYP Entertainment and depart from VCHA. Almost a year later, on August 7, 2025, it was announced that KG and JYP Entertainment had reached a mutual agreement on the terms of her contract termination, as part of a court-ordered settlement.
Khan Amina is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls On Fire.
Khaopoon is a Thai trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.

Khloe Kim, formerly known as Vita, is a South Korean influencer, and a former rapper, dancer, and singer. She was a member of the girl group MAJORS under ANS Entertainment. After some times of inactivity, her agency announced on May 25, 2022 that Vita hasn't officially left the group but was on an indefinite hiatus due to health/personal reasons. MAJORS ended up disbanding disbanding in 2023. Khloe Kim calls her fans "Klovers", as seen on her SNS bio in which it's written "Welcome Klovers🍀". She was a contestant on Time Turner.
Ji Won is a South Korean singer under LUK Factory. She was a member, maknae and main vocalist of the girl group TROPICAL. She debuted as a soloist under the stage name ki:ssy on March 3, 2023.
Kia is a Senegalese-French trainee and model. She is the leader of the upcoming girl group DE:VA and a former pre-debut member of the upcoming girl groups Tr!xie and GLX.
Kiara is a singer under EZ Entertainment. She made her debut on January 18, 2020, with the single "BOSS".
Kidnna, formerly known as Della, is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Rockit Girl.
Kieun is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo 2night.
Kiiri is a singer from the virtual group IRISÉ, which is under Parable Entertainment. She was the second member to be revealed, dated December 2, 2024.

femaleIdols.description: Kiirii, formerly known as Nami, is a Thai singer Big Mountain Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Queenz Eye and a former member of the girl group Busters and the Thai girl group SY51.

Xu Jia Qi is a Chinese idol singer under STAR48, its sub label STAR48 Culture Media and ZB Label. She is a graduated member of the Chinese idol group SNH48 (Team SII) and active member of its sub-unit 7SENSES. She is a former member of the Chinese project girl group THE9 before their disbandment in 2021.
Kiki is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls Frontier. She is a member of Hidden Glow and debuted on January 10, 2025 with the group's 1st single album 'Spotlight'.

Kim is an Indonesian singer and actress under EgoENT. She is a member of the girl group VVUP. She was a contestant on The Voice Kids Indonesia (2016) and The Indonesian Next Big Star (2022). She made her solo debut on February 22, 2019, with the single "Shine (ft. ELS & Willy Winarko)" under the stage name KIM!.

Kim Chaehyun is a South Korean trainee. She participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kim Chaeli is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of Girls2000. On June 25, 2021, Chaeli announced her graduation from Girls2000.
Kim Chaerin is a South Korean trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess. She is also a former member of the project kids group Hi Dream.

Kim Chaewon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer and dancer under Source Music. She is best known as the leader of the girl group LE SSERAFIM. On April 29, 2021, IZ*ONE disbanded after their contract of two years and six months ended. On March 14, 2022, it was announced that Chaewon and IZ*ONE's former groupmate Sakura had officially signed to Source Music and would be debuting in their upcoming girl group LE SSERAFIM. On May 2, The group officially debuted with their first mini album "FEARLESS".
Kim Chaeyoung is a trainee and YouTuber. She is best known for competing on the survival-reality show CAP-TEEN.

Kim Dahye is a South Korean singer. She was a competitor on Produce 48. She ranked #75 in episode 5 and was eliminated.

She is also one half of the duo Lucky PangPang. Dahyun is known for being a former contestant on various music survival shows, including Korea VS Japan Trot, Queen of Diva, Miss Trot 2, and Voice of Trot.

Kim Damso (김담소) is a South Korean singer, songwriter and pianist who made her solo debut in 2016 with "잔한 노래" featuring Jeon Sangkeun. She is a member of the duo Damsonegongbang (also known as simply Damgong), which debuted on December 8, 2016.

Kim Dasom is a Korean-American trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
