Kim Dohyun is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN. She is the daughter of actor/author Kim Bong-gon.
Kim Doyi is a South Korean trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

Kim E-Z is a South Korean singer and actress. She initially debuted in Baby V.O.X as a leader and main rapper in charge of the sexy concept. After the group’s disbandment she went on to work as an actress as well as MC for Mnet. In 2010 she married a non-celebrity, and they currently have 2 children together. E-Z has confirmed that she hasn’t retired, and would like to return to the entertainment industry once her children grow up.
Kim E-Z or simply EZ is a South Korean singer under FLUXUS MUSIC. She is one half of the duo Ggotjam Project.
Kim Eui Young is a South Korean singer under DR Music. She was a contestant on the reality survival show, Miss Trot 2, placing 5th.
Kim Eun Hye is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Barberettes. She left the group in 2015.
Kim Eun Ji is a South Korean contrabass player. She was a member of the girl group A.SOME.
Kim Eun Young, formerly known as Jubi or JuB, is a South Korean actress and singer-songwriter. She was the leader of the girl group Sunny Hill until her departure in 2018.
Kim Eunchae is a South Korean trainee. She is mostly known for being a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND 2 N/a, where she was eliminated in episode 4.
Kim Gangeon is a South Korean singer who debuted on February 15, 2021.

Kim Garam is a South Korean former idol under Source Music. She is a former member of the girl group LE SSERAFIM. She debuted with the group on May 2, 2022, with their first mini album "Fearless." Just 18 days after their debut, on May 20, 2022, Source Music announced that Garam would be on hiatus due to bullying accusations. Subsequently, on July 20, 2022, HYBE and Source Music announced the termination of Garam's contract, finalizing her departure from the group.
Kim Gawon is a South Korean trainee under WAKEONE. She is best known for being a former contestant on the survival shows, Stars Awakening in 2022, and Top 10 Student in 2020.
Kim Gayoon is a South Korean trainee. She gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Under 15.

Kim Gyeol Yu, formerly known as Kim Bowon, is a South Korean actress under Big Picture Entertainment. She is a former FAVE Entertainment trainee. She is also best known for being a contestant on the survival show MIXNINE.

Kim Gyuri is a South Korean trainee and actress under Pledis Entertainment. She debuted as an actress in 2018 in tvN's drama "My Mister". She then continued acting for two years, playing in four dramas until 2020. In 2024, Kim Gyuri was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she was sadly eliminated in the final episode. At that time, she was a trainee under WAKEONE.

Kim Haeri is a South Korean singer and cheerleader under Eyecontact Company. She is part of the cheerleading team TWINKLE and a former member of the girl group LipBubble, where she was known under the stage name Ella. She made her solo debut on October 6, 2020 with the digital single "OOTD".
Kim Hana is a South Korean singer. She is best known for participating in the survival shows Girls On Fire and Show Queen, where she finished in second place.

Kim Hana is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group CLEO. In 2012, Kim Hana debuted as a solo singer with the track "I Feel So Weird", featured in the OST of Big. She then married in 2014, had a son and settled down as a housewife.
Kim Hari is a South Korean trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Kim Harin is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.
Kim Hayun is a South Korean singer and MC under 101 Doors Entertainment. She was revealed to have left Produce 101 Season 1 on Episode 3.

Kim Hee Jin is a South Korean trot singer under JG Star Entertainment. She debuted as a soloist in 2020 and as a member of the duo The Two Sisters. She also participated in the reality show Miss Trot in 2019.
Kim Hee-jung is a South Korean actress and singer. She debuted as a member of the fictional group Temporary Idol in 2017. Besides the fictional group, she has not pursued music further.

Kim Hye-won is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of BaBa. Somi (Hyewon) joined BaBa shortly after the release of the group's second digital single "Catch Me", after the departure of Somi (Bimby). In later months she along with original BaBa members Hyoah and Dayul decided to leave the group. She rejoined the group after their promotions for "Funky Music" ended. She made her official debut in BaBa on July 3, 2018, with their fourth digital single "Oh! My God!", Somi left the group sometime after the single's release.
Kim Hyemi is a South Korean trainee announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, but was eliminated in the 4th episode. She is the younger sister of AOA member Im Do Hwa.
Kim Hyeseo is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted on January 13, 2020, with "I'm Letting You Go" (featuring Lee Jihyun).
Kim Hyojin is a South Korean trainee announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.
Kim Hyun Ji is a South Korean singer. She was a pre-debut member of the girl group To-Ya. She left the group in 1999.
Kim Hyun Jung is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed group Space A.
Kim Hyun Jung is a South Korean singer and one of the most popular female soloists from the 1st generation of K-pop.

Kim Hyun-jung is a South Korean pop singer. She is well known as the "Long-legged singer." With the experience of performing in a heavy metal band, Kim made her debut as a solo singer on March 21, 1997 with "Legend".
Kim Inhee is a South Korean keyboardist. She joined the band THETHE in 2017 as the keyboardist, but left later in the year.
Kim Jamin is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group A-plus.
Kim Ji Hye is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group To-Ya. She debuted as a soloist on July 31, 2007, with the single “Feel Me Now” under the stage name Pink Ruu.
Kim Ji Yeon, formerly known as U.E, is a South Korean trainee under ON1 Entertainment. She is a member of the trainee group ON1 Rookies and a former member of the kids girl group U.SSO Girl.

Kim Ji-hyun is a South Korean singer and actress. She debuted in 1994 as a member of the co-ed group, Roo'Ra, which she left in 1997 to release her first solo album, "Cat's Eye". She rejoined Roo'ra in 1999, and remained a member until the group disbanded in 2001. She released her second solo album, "Second Time", in 2003, and later participated in Roo'ra's reunion in 2009.
Kim Jieon is a South Korean singer who made her solo debut on May 22, 2019. She was a member of Percussive Slap (2016). She is a member of MINITREE.
Kim JiHee, is a South Korean dancer and singer under 4X4 Creative and Silk Music. She is a member of the girl group and dance crew 4X4.

Jini is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of BROS as well as the disbanded girl group DIVA. She also became a contestant of the third season of the TV show called “Project Runway Korea” in 2011. She currently works as a fashion designer.
Kim Jiyun, also stylized as Jiyoon, is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group A-plus and a former member of the trainee groups SG Girls and ALPHA RAY.
Kim Joo Yeon is a South Korean singer under iMe KOREA. She was a contestant on MIXNINE.
Kim Jooeun is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15 and Show Queen.
Kim Juna is a South Korean singer currently under Hidden Sound. She is most known for being a contestant on the reality competition show, Produce 101, placing 34th overall.
Kim Jungae is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Eco. She is a professor in the Department of Practical Music at Chugye University of the Arts.
Kim Jungyun is a South Korean trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Kim Leerang is a South Korean singer, Guitarist, and a member of the co-ed indie band LeeRang_E. She is the Vocalist and one of the Guitarists. Her birth year is 2007 on a unknown date. She was also the second member of LeeRang_E to be revealed.
Kim Lina is a South Korean trainee under Deep Studio Entertainment. She is best known for being a contestant on MBC's reality survival show, My Teenage Girl.

Kim Jungeun, known under her stage name Kim Lip, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and dancer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the project girl group ARTMS, and the leader of its second sub-unit, ODD EYE CIRCLE. She is also a member of the girl group LOONA, but the group is currently inactive. She debuted on May 15, 2017, as a member and subsequently released her solo single album "Kim Lip" on May 23, 2017. Kim Lip debuted as a member of LOONA on August 20, 2018, with their first mini album "[+ +]". On May 31, 2024, Kim Lip debuted as a member of ARTMS with their first album "Dall".

Kim Marie is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted in 2018 with the song "How to Hug a Memory", on July 3, 2022, it was removed by the artist. Since then "To Find You", released on July 11 of the same year, is considered her first song.

Kim Mijung (김미정), also known as yourbeagle, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and rapper under Wayside Town. yourbeagle made her official debut on July 26, 2018 with the EP 2018.07 under Wayside Town. She is building a successful career not only with her music activities as a singer, but also through various activities such as YouTube channel operation and modeling activities. As a rapper who is attracting attention for her cute appearance, pure voice, and high-level singing skills, she appeared as a rapper from East Gyeongin in High School Rapper in 2017 and Show Me the Money 9 in 2020.

Kim Min Ah (김정우; also known as Haru (하루)) is a South Korean actress, musician and singer under Woori Actors. She is a former member of the girl band CANDI.She made her solo debut on March 5, 2015 with the digital single "이렇게 좋은날엔".

Kim Min Seo (김민서) is a South Korean trainee under HOW Entertainment. In 2018, she appeared as a contestant on the survival show Produce 48, where she represented HOW Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 44th place.

Kim Minsol is a South Korean trainee. She mostly gained recognisation for her participation in MBC's survival show My Teenage Girl in 2021, and Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a in 2024. Sadly, she got eliminated from both survival shows and was unable to make her debut.
Kim Myojin (김묘진) is a South Korean singer. She participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

Kim Na Young is a South Korean singer-songwriter currently under FLEX M. She debuted with her first digital single, "Sometimes," on June 25, 2014. On April 11, 2022, it was announced that she had signed an exclusive contract with FLEX M, a subsidiary of Kakao Entertainment.
Kim Nahyun is a South Korean trainee under Brave Entertainment. She is best known for being a contestant on MBC's reality survival show, My Teenage Girl.

Kim Nayeon is a South Korean singer currently signed to Studio25. She is best known for her time as a member of the girl group Berry Good and as a contestant on the survival show Idol School. Nayeon made her solo debut with the single "Merry Solo Christmas" on December 13, 2021.
Kim Nayoung (김나영) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.
Kim Nayul is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.

Kim Pureum (김푸름) is a South Korean singer, songwriter and actress under n.CH Entertainment who debuted as an actress in 2016 in the movie "오빠생각" and as a singer on February 9, 2022 with the EP "16". She was a contestant of Stars Awakening under the Singer-Songwriter category.
Kim Rayul is a South Korean BJ, dancer and singer. She is a former of the project girl group Up To You. She was a contestant on the survival show "U2U: Up To You". Her final rank was fourth.

Kim Sa Eun (김사은) is a South Korean Singer, Model, Actress and Musical Actress under Golden Eight Media. She originally debuted under Big Hit Entertainment as a member of Banana Girl. Kim SeoWon is a South Korean dancer and singer under 4X4 Creative and Silk Music. She is a member of the girl group and dance crew 4X4.
Kim Seoyeon is a South Korean trainee announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.
Kim Seunghui (김승희) is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire.
Kim Seungyeon is a South Korean trainee and actress.She is a contestant on the upcoming survival show Stellar Sugar.

Krystal Jung, also known by her Korean name Jung Soo-Jung, is a prominent South Korean-American singer, actress, and model currently represented by Beasts & Natives. Rising to fame as a renowned K-pop girl group f(x) member, Krystal debuted under SM Entertainment in 2009, capturing attention for her talent and unique style. Krystal, born in San Francisco, was discovered alongside her sister Jessica Jung by SM Entertainment in South Korea during the early 2000s. Though her parents initially declined due to her young age, Jessica debuted with Girls' Generation in 2007. Krystal began appearing in commercials by 2002, notably in a Lotte ad with actress Han Ga-In, and officially joined SM in 2006, where she trained intensively in hip-hop and jazz dance. She appeared in popular music videos such as Shinhwa's "Wedding March" (2000), Rain's "Still Believe" (2006), and SHINee's "Juliette" (2009). In August 2009, SM Entertainment teased the debut of f(x), and the group released their first single, "LA chA TA," on September 1. f(x) officially debuted on September 2 with a showcase at Samseong-dong Fashion Center, followed by their first broadcast performance on Music Core on September 5. Krystal's acting debut came in 2010 with More Charming By Day, and she later co-hosted The M-Wave with MBLAQ’s Thunder. In 2011, she appeared on SBS’s Kim Yuna’s Kiss & Cry and won the competition with partner Lee Dong-Hun, securing a performance at Kim Yuna's All That Skate Summer 2011 ice show. That same year, she starred as Ahn Soo-Jung in High Kick! Season 3. Krystal's breakthrough role came in 2013 with SBS's hit teen drama The Heirs, where she portrayed a wealthy yet kind-hearted high school student. The role won her and co-star CNBLUE's Kang Min-hyuk the "Best Onscreen Couple" award at the 2013 DramaFever Awards. In 2014, Krystal joined SM’s ballad group SM the Ballad and co-starred with her sister Jessica in the reality show Jessica & Krystal, showcasing their lives and sisterly bond. Krystal took her first lead role in the 2014 SBS drama My Lovely Girl with Rain and released the solo single “All of a Sudden” for the show's soundtrack, earning her the "Most Popular Actress" award at the Baeksang Arts Awards. In 2017, she was named "Woman of the Year" by GQ Korea. After her contract with SM expired in 2020, Krystal joined H& Entertainment. In 2023, Krystal made her debut at the Cannes Film Festival with the cast of Cobweb. The film received an extended standing ovation of 10-12 minutes, solidifying Krystal's growing presence on the international stage.

KyoungSeo (경서) is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Engine of Dream and RND Company. She made her solo debut on November 14, 2020 with the digital single "Shiny Star (2020)".

Kyrin is a South Korean singer, model, and actress under Liz Entertainment. She is a former member of the pre-debut girl groups Milkyway as Geumju and Rainbow Girl. She is the twin sister of Windy, who was also a member of Milkyway as Jinju.

Jang Kyujin is a South Korean dancer, rapper and singer under JYP Entertainment. She is the main dancer of the girl group NMIXX. She debuted as a member of the girl group NMIXX on February 22, 2022, with their debut album "AD MARE".

Kyuri, also known as Kim Kyuri, is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her solo debut on November 28, 2022, with her first EP "Open The Door". She was a contestant on the JTBC survival show Girls On Fire and finished at rank 6 in the final round.
Kyuri (규리) is a South Korean artist under Live Entertainment. She is a member of the Korean Pop girl group 2wenty's.
L-like, born Lee Yoon-jung is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Irrelevant Music in 2018. L-like is currently a part-time DJ.
L.Cia (케이미) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group Fantastie and Double B as Jaehui (재희).
L.Rody (엘로디) is a South Korean singer under ROSE Entertainment. She was known as a member of the girl group Queen B'Z as Nora-Born (노라본), formerly Aram (아람). In 2015, she debuted as a soloist.

La Hee (라히) is a former South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Singing Girls (renamed to Melody Pink). She debuted with The Singing Girls on August 16, 2018 with a single Maybe Maybe. She left the group in 2018. She debuted as a singer in 2016 with "End" collaborating with Gong Min Seok.
Lacky (랙키) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Perfume.

Lady Jane(레이디 제인) is a South Korean soloist under Image 9 Comms that debuted in 2006 as the vocalist of the electronic band Aquibird and in 2009 she joined the indie band Tiramisu. Only one year later, on October 28th, 2010, she made her debut as a solo artist under CS Entertainment with the release of the digital single "Nunmulsatang".
Laeun (라은) is a South Korean singer, rapper and song-writer under Liz Entertainment. She is a member of Chic Angel and the project girl group Chic & Idle.
LaLa is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group BIKINY.
Lambda (람다) is a South Korean singer. She used to be a member of the girl group QODES.

Lana (Korea: 라나; Chinese: 拉娜; stylized as LANA) is a Russian singer-songwriter, rapper, model and TV Personality under Bates MeThinks Entertainment and WILD Entertainment. She made her Korean debut on June 27, 2019 with the single "Take The Wheel", marking her debut as the first Russian to debut as a solo k-pop artist under HiCC Entertainment. On December 10, 2019 she released her second digital single "Make It Real", which is a surprise gift for her fandom and everyone that had been supporting her. On March 11, 2020 she revealed that she would became a contestant on the Chinese reality survival show, Produce Camp 2020, under Bates MeThinks Entertainment.

Lara Rajagopalan is a American/Tamilian-Indian-Sri Lankan singer and dancer under Geffen Records and HYBE Labels. She is best known as a member of the global girl group KATSEYE. Lara is recognized for her participation in the survival show "The Debut: Dream Academy", where she ranked 2nd and qualified for debut, becoming a member of the girl group KATSEYE. On August 16, 2024, Lara officially debuted as a member of KATSEYE with their first EP "SIS (SOFT IS STRONG)".

Moon Sinae, also known as Lara, is the Main Vocalist and Dancer of the Girl Group DreamNote under IMe Entertainment. Before debuting, Lara has already garnered attention for the song covers that she posted on her Instagram account.
Lara (라라) is a South Korean singer and musical actress, member of the girl group Redmint. She joined the group in 2023.
Laura is an Korean-Australian trainee announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.
Laura (로라) is a South Korean rapper and producer who debuted independently in 2021.
Lay.bn (레이븐) is a South Korean singer who debuted under Rough in 2019.
Layeon is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group PURPLEBECK but left the gtoup in 2021.

Lea Navvab is a Korean-American singer, dancer, YouTuber, model and actress under PI Corporation. She is the older sister of TXT's Huening Kai and Kep1er's Huening Bahiyyih. She is a former member of the girl group VIVA under Shine E&M (now known as RBC Amusements) which officially debuted on October 13, 2017, with their first self-titled single "VIVA". Ever since their last release on March 2019, with every member leaving the agency, the group has apparently split. It was revealed on July 19, 2021, that Lea had signed a contract to work as a model in Seoul, South Korea, with Model Directors. It was revealed on September 13, 2022, that she has a deal with Model Directors and would be using her real name, Jung Lea, for acting promotions. On November 6, 2022, Model Directors announced that Lea would be using a new stage name which is J'Lea, and that she would be making her solo debut on November 11, 2022, with her first single "A Good Day To Love". On December 9, 2022, Lea was revealed as the newest employee of Pi House, a cooperative content production company. Model Directors removed Lea's profile board from their website on April 2, 2024. Via her Instagram stories, she revealed her 3 year contract with Model Directors had expired. On April 12, 2024, news reported that Lea had signed an exclusive contract with PI Corporation. In November 2024, she participated in PI Corporation and Makestar' survival show TIME TURNER, where she ended up ranking 5th place, thus becoming a member of the final group, I.MET.U.

Lee A Young (이아영) is a South Korean singer under PIG Entertainment. She is a former member of the ballad girl group A Train to Autumn. She made her debut as a soloist singer on November 27, 2021 with the digital single "We Already Broke Up". She is also known for being a former The Voice of Korea 2020 contestant. After being introduced as a member of A Train to Autumn, together with her band-mates, she recorded the group's pre-debut digital single "A Watercolor of a Rainy Day". Later on, Ayoung officially debuted in the group with their second digital single "That Season You Were In" on November 5, 2018. Unfortunately, the group presumably disbanded after their profile was removed from Cube's website.
Lee Ae (리애) is former member of ICIA. She joined ICIA in 2016 and left in 2018.
Lee Aerin (이애린) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN. She is the sister of Lee Chaerin.
Lee Aram is a South Korean soloist. She made her debut on August 12, 2016.
Lee Arumsoul (이아름솔) is a South Korean singer and musical actress. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire and Casting Call.
Lee Ayoung (이아영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Enue.
Lee Bo Ram is a South Korean R&B singer, actress, and YouTuber. She used to be the maknae and sub-vocalist of the girl group SeeYa.
Lee Bom (이봄) is a South Korean singer under RBW. She was a contestant on MIXNINE.
Lee Bom (이봄), formerly known as Byeol-so (별소) and Rian (리안), is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the acoustic trio BYUL, DAL and is a former member of the cancelled girl group LABELUP.
Lee Bon (이본) is a South Korean singer and actress.

Lee Chaeyeon is a South Korean singer and dancer, best known as a member of the project group IZ*ONE. She debuted with the group following her participation in the second season of Produce 48. Chaeyeon was recognized as the main dancer, lead vocalist, and lead rapper of the group. Prior to joining IZONE, she competed on JYP Entertainment's survival show "SIXTEEN," where she participated with her sister, ITZY's Chaeryeong. Chaeyeon officially debuted as a member of IZ*ONE on October 29, 2018, with the release of their first mini-album COLOR*IZ. The group gained significant success during their promotions, which lasted until their disbandment on April 29, 2021. After IZ*ONE's disbandment, Chaeyeon participated in the Mnet dance survival show Street Woman Fighter, where she finished in 7th place. She made her solo debut on October 12, 2022, with the release of her first mini-album HUSH RUSH. The album's single quickly ranked on various music platforms, including Bugs, Melon, Genie, and iTunes. The music video for the single also garnered significant attention, surpassing 10 million views within four days of its release. In 2023, Chaeyeon participated in the Mnet survival show Queendom Puzzle, but she left the competition due to personal reasons. On September 12, 2025, WM Entertainment announced that Lee Chae Yeon has officially parted ways with the company.
Lee Chaehyun is a South Korean trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Lee Chaemi (이채미), also known as 8mlee, is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire, Artistock Game, and I Can See Your Voice 9.
Lee Chaerin (이채린) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN. She is the sister of Lee Aerin.
Lee Chaeyeon is a South Korean trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Lee Chaeyun (이채윤) is a South Korean trainee, actress and YouTuber under FNC Entertainment. She is best known for being a contestants in Mnet’s reality survival show "Girls Planet 999".
Lee Dahye is a South Korean singer, cheerleader and BJ. She made her solo debut on March 30, 2024 with the digital single, "Hush".

Lee Dahyun (이다현), also known as Christine (크리스틴), is an South Korean-American singer-songwriter. She made her debut as a soloist singer on September 21, 2022 with the digital single "Take A Look At Me".She is also known for being a former contestant on CAP-TEEN and for being a former pre-debut member of CSR.
Lee Dakyung is a member of the South Korean co-ed band LeeRang_E. She is the Guitarist and she was the first member to be revealed. Her birth year is 2007 on a unknown date.

Lee Eun Joo is a retired South Korean singer. She used to be a member of the girl group Swi.T and co-ed group Moogadang. In 2010, she married Yang Hyun Suk, the former chief executive of YG Entertainment. They have a son and a daughter. Eunjoo is also the younger sister of SECHSKIES Jaijin.

Lee Eun Mi is a South Korean singer under Neobiz Company. She first made her debut in 1989 as a guest vocalist for the blues-rock band Shinchon Blues, performing with them. She was featured in their 1990 album ‘Shinchon Blues III’, gaining notoriety for her vocal prowess. In 1992 Lee Eun-mi released her self-titled debut solo album. Lee Eun-mi is very well known for performing barefoot and earned the nickname "the barefoot diva” by fans. Her discography spans across almost every genre of music, including jazz, rock, ballad, R&B and soul. She is a part of the project group Golden Girls alongside fellow top vocalists Insooni, Park Mikyung, and Shin Hyobum. The group was formed by the reality show of the same name by KBS2.
Lee Eun Young (이은영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Piggy Dolls. She joined the group in September 2013.
Lee Eunbyul is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.

Lee Eunchae is a South Korean singer, model and child actress signed to Clevr E&M. She was a member of the kid's girl group PIERCE. She is most famous for her appearance on the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 7th episode.
Lee Eunjeo (이은저) is a South Korean singer and model. She debuted as a soloist in April 1996 with her first and only studio album, "Monotone". She is the mother of Lena from GWSN.
Lee Eunyoung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group J'Heart.

Lee Ga-eun (sometimes romanised as Lee Ka-eun) is a South Korean actress and singer under High Entertainment. She is known as a former competitor of Produce 48 and a former member of AFTER SCHOOL. Lee is currently working solely as an actress and has featured in several dramas. It was reported in April 2012 that Gaeun made her first appearance with AFTER SCHOOL at Zepp Tokyo, during the performances of "Let's Do It" and the Japanese version of "BANG!" marking her admission. Lee officially made her debut as a member in the group's fifth single release, Flashback. In July 2019, Gaeun made her solo debut with the digital single "Remember You" to convey gratitude for her fans, marking her departure from Pledis Entertainment.

Lee Gai is a South Korean singer. She debuted in 1988 as a member of the trio Settorae under her real name Lee Hee-jung. After the group's disbandment in 1989, she re-debuted in a duo named Tam Tam in 1991, with one of the previous Settorae members. After the duo fell apart, underground producer Yoon Deungryong pitied her talent and so decided to debut her under his label, Deungryong Planning (later DR Music) with the name Lee Jisoo in 1993. After releasing 2 full albums, she could not manage to gain much attention with her solo work either. Yoon added her to the K-Pop girl group Baby V.O.X in 1998 under the name Lee Gai when he thought she would fit their new girl band concept as she had a good voice and composing experience. The concept was later changed to fit a Teen Pop audience. Unfortunately, she had been lying about her age since her solo debut, where she marked her age down by one year which was a common practice for female singers at the time. When promoting with Baby V.O.X, Lee Gai was supposedly 10 years younger, which was suspicious considering her aged look on top of her bad dance skills. When the fans of Baby V.O.X and the general public found out she was indeed a 30-year old, Lee Gai left the group and retired from the industry.
Lee Gawon is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former leader of the girl group 2EYES.
Lee Ha Young (or simply Hayoung), formerly known as Han Na Young, is a South Korean actress and rapper under Echo Global Group. She is a former member of the girl group Playback.

Lee Hae In is a South Korean singer-songwriter, actress, and creative director signed under DOD. She was first known for participating in the first seasons of MNET's hit survival show Produce 101, where she was eliminated in the final episode after ranking 17th place. At that time, she was a trainee under SS Entertainment. Due to her participation in the survival show, Lee Hae In was able to be a part of I.B.I, a five-member project girl group formed of some of the popular contestants. She made her debut with the group on August 16, 2016, with the release of their first and only single titled "Molae Molae". The group ended up disbanding sometimes between November and December 2016. Later that year, Lee Hae In made her acting debut with a supporting role in the drama 'Something About 1 Percent'. Since then, she also played support role in dramas such as 'My Secret Romance' in 2017 and 'Tutorial' in 2022. In 2017, she was a contestant in MNET' survival show Idol School, where she was again eliminated in the final after ranking 11th place this time. Sometimes in 2020, she joined The Groove Company (who later merged with Big Ocean ENM), under which she made her solo debut on November 17, 2020, with the release of her first song called “Santa Lullaby (We Used To Sing)”. On June 2, 2022, Lee Hae In revealed her involvement in some of S2 Entertainment and AURA's production and, on May 11, 2023, that she was working as a creative director for the girl group KISS OF LIFE. More recently, she became a judge, and more precisely the creative director, for JTBC' survival show PROJECT7, which aired from October 18 to December 27, 2024. On December 20, 2024, it was reported that she had signed a contract with DOD. In January 2025, it was announced that Lee Hae In had stepped down of her role as a creative director for KISS OF LIFE since November 2024. Still in January, she was said to be the creative director for PROJECT7's upcoming boy group, CLOSE YOUR EYES.
Lee Haeun (이하은) is a South Korean independent trainee. She was a contestant on Produce 48. She ranked #48 on episode 8 and was eliminated.
Lee Hamin is a South Korean dancer and former member of the girl group Up To You after ranking fourth on the survival show "U2U: Up To You Season 2".
Lee Ha-Rin (이하린) is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the South Korean K-pop girl group formed by SM Entertainment, "Sugar".
Lee Hayoung is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Hayun, also known as Dalha, is a South Korean singer and influencer under PI Corporation. She is a former member of the duo DATE and the girl group Brave Girls. Hayun debuted in the trainee girl group project duo DATE (formerly known as SUTY) in 2014, after the departure of one of the previous members. The duo disbanded in July 2015. She officially debuted as a member of Brave Girls on February 16, 2016, with the group's third digital single, "Deepened". On August 11, 2018, Brave Entertainment announced that Hayun would be sitting out from the group's activities due to health issues. In a March 2019 interview with Brave Brothers, it was revealed that Hayun was no longer part of Brave Girls after the group was reorganized into a four-member lineup. In 2019, Hayun gained a large following on TikTok with viral videos featuring makeup and dance. Later, she launched a YouTube channel focused on makeup. In 2020, she created the 'Running Hayun' channel on Twitch and began streaming content. She signed with digital entertainment company Sandbox Network in November 2020.
Lee Hee Jin is a South Korean singer, actress, and model. She was a member of the girl group Baby V.O.X.
Lee Heeju (이희주) is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group A-plus.
Lee Hena, also known as Hena, is a South Korean singer and a former member of the girl group Chocolate.

Lee Hi is a South Korean singer under duover. She was one half of the duo Hi Suhyun, a former member of the cancelled girl group SuPearls and a member of the disbanded girl duo BOM&HI. She is best known for being the second place runner-up of the reality survival show K-pop Star 1 in 2011 and was subsequently signed to YG Entertainment. On December 31, 2019, she announced her departure from YG Entertainment. On July 23, 2020, she was introduced as a new artist of AOMG. On March 28, 2024, AOMG announced her departure from the agency after her contract expired. On September 23, newly established agency duover announced she had signed an exclusive contract with them.

Lee Hwa Kyum (formerly known as Yooyoung) is a South Korean rapper, singer and actress under Prain TPC. She is a former member of the girl group HELLOVENUS. She made her HELLOVENUS debut on May 9, 2012, with the release of the group's first mini album 'Venus', going under the stage name Yooyoung. Fantagio Music said on April 26, 2019, that HELLOVENUS would be breaking up after seven years together. They also disclosed that Yooyoung was still debating extending her contract with the agency. On July 12, Fantagio revealed that Yooyoung had decided to renew her contract and would be continuing her activities as an actress under a new stage name, Lee Hwa Gyeom. On June 28, 2021, Prain TPC announced that Lee Hwa Kyum had signed onto the agency.
Lee Hye (이혜) is a South Korean singer under Ctrl Entertainment. She debuted on December 5, 2020, with the digital single "Erase You."
Lee Hyein is a South Korean drummer, member of the co-ed band FLY!YAAH. She is a former drummer of Band Down The Line.
Lee Hyein (이혜인) is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Untact Idol Unit.
Lee Hyeju is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the band THETHE during 2009 as the Vocalist.
Lee Hyewon is a South Korean trainee. She participated in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999.
Lee Hyobi is a South Korean-American trainee and actress, best known for competing on Under 15.
Lee Hyoju (이효주) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group MOA. She was added sometime in 2014.

Lee Hyori is a South Korean singer-songwriter, record producer, and actress affiliated with Antenna. She gained fame as part of the girl group Fin.K.L and the collaborative projects, coed-group SSAK3 (as Linda G) and Refund Sisters (as Chun Ok). Lee Hyori has had a diverse and successful career in the music industry. She first rose to prominence as the leader of the girl group Fin.K.L, debuting with their album “Blue Rain” on May 28, 1998. Despite being inactive since 2002, the group reunited for special comebacks in 2005 and 2019. Launching her solo career on August 18, 2003, with the album “Stylish...” Lee Hyori established herself as a versatile solo artist. In 2020, she was involved in two project groups. Under the name Linda G, she was part of the co-ed group SSAK3, releasing the single “Beach Again'' before disbanding on August 15, 2020. She also joined the all-female group Refund Sisters as Chun Ok, releasing the single “Don’t Touch Me” and disbanding on November 14, 2020. Beyond her professional life, Lee Hyori is married to guitarist Lee Sang Soon. They tied the knot on September 1, 2013, at their vacation home in Mt. Halla Jeju Island. On May 15, 2020, she signed an exclusive contract with ESteem Entertainment and was followed by her husband joining the agency a few days later.
Lee Hyunyoung (이현영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Enue.
Lee Hyunyoung is a South Korean singer and a member of the co-ed group THETHE. She joined the group in 2014 as a Vocalist.

Lee Jae Eun (이재은) is a South Korean singer, model, musical actress and child actress under Muse Odyssey. She is a member of the kids duo Little Muse. She debuted as a soloist on July 31, 2018 with her debut digital single, "Come Play With Me Kitty".
Jaehee is a rapper, vocalist, and dancer under IST Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Weeekly. The group made their debut on June 30 with the mini album titled "We Are".
Lee Jaye is an American-South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Lee Ji-hye is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the group Sharp. The group released six albums before their breakup in 2002, attributed to the feud between Lee and fellow female member Seo Ji-young. As a solo artist, she has released several singles. She was a cast member of the variety show Infinite Girls Season 2.

Lee Ji Hyun (이지현) is a South Korean singer, lyricist and actress under P&K Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups Circle and Jewelry. She made her solo debut on August 4, 2023 with the single album "롱롱 언니 1st Single 게리롱 푸리롱".
Lee Ji Min is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.
Lee Ji Young (이지영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the disbanded group Big Mama. She debuted as a soloist in April 2010.

Lee Ji-Hyeon, is a South Korean actress and member of the fictional girl group Element from the drama Who Is She. In the series, she plays Min Ah, a cheerful and energetic trainee at UNIS Entertainment. Min Ah’s vibrant personality and positive energy bring a sense of optimism to the group as they work towards their debut in the competitive K-pop industry. Lee Ji-Hyeon has gained recognition for her portrayal of Min Ah, adding depth to the character and contributing to the overall dynamic of the drama.

Lee Ji-yeon (이지연) is a former singing sensation in South Korea, best known for her youthful image and charming voice. She made her official debut in 1987 with her first album "Maybe You Were Young", and went on to become one of the most popular singers of her generation. After retiring from the industry, Lee Ji-yeon devoted herself to studying and pursued her passion in the culinary world. She is currently a chef in America, co-owning HEIRLOOM MARKET BBQ.
Lee Eun Young (이은영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Piggy Dolls. She joined the group in September 2013.
Lee Jihyun (이지현) is a South Korean influencer and trot singer under One Office Music. She made her debut on October 16, 2023, with the single "Funky Town".
Lee Jihyun (이지현) is a South Korean trainee under DR Music. She is a former member and the former leader of the kids girl group CoCo.
Lee Jimin is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on the survival show Undercover. She is the older sister of Sohee from RIIZE.
Lee Jin is a South Korean singer, actress, and lyricist under King Kong by Starship. She was a member of the girl group Fin.K.L.
Lee Jin Ah (이진아) is a South Korean singer under Antenna. She placed third in SBS's competition show K-Pop Star 4. She made her official debut on June 10, 2016 with the single "Appetizer".
Lee Jinkyoung (이진경) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Enue. She is also a musical actress.
Lee Jiwon is a South Korean trainee. She gained fame after competing on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Lee Joo Hye (이주혜) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group T.T.Ma as Juhae (주혜). She the sister of Queena (퀴나).
Lee Jooeun is a South Korean trainee under P NATION. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

Lee Jooyeon (이주연) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Jjarimongttang. She joined the group to replace Najin. She was a contestant of Kpop Star 2, where she landed in the Top 10, and also took part in MIXNINE, but didn’t pass the audition.

Lee Jung Hyun, also known by her occasional stage name AVA, is a South Korean singer and actress. She first started as an actress in 1996 before making her musical debut in 1999 with her first album "Let's Go To My Star".
Lee Kyung is a South Korean singer and a former member of the girl group TURAN.
Lee Kyungmin (이경민) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group G.U.Y.

Lee Michelle is a Korean-American singer under DIMA Entertainment. She made her solo debut with the single "Without You" on March 21, 2014. She was a former contestant on the first season of K-Pop Star and member of the disbanded girl group SuPearls at YG Entertainment.
Lee Min was a Korean-American singer. She was a member of the R&B duo As One. On August 6, 2025, it was announced that Lee Min had passed away.

Lee Min Kyoung is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the disbanded groups Diva, Unity and the supergroup BROS. In 2007, she appeared on the TV Show called “Styleholic”. She appeared on the musicals called “Singin’ in the Rain” and “On Air 2” in 2007 and 2009. She currently is the founder and owns a clothing brand called RHEEMIN.

Lee Minhwi (이민휘) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, composer and producer who made her debut in 2011 as a member of the indie duo Mukimukimanmansu under the stage name Mansu. The band disbanded in 2013. Lee Minhwi produced the soundtrack for A Midsummer's Fantasia in 2015. She released her first solo studio album, 'Borrowed Tongue', in 2016, which was awarded The Best Folk Album at the 2017 Korean Music Awards. In 2020, she formed the group Sam-seung with Seo Kyungsoo and Choi Kyeongjoo.
Lee MyeongGyeong is a South Korean singer and dancer. She is a member of the girl group and dance crew 4X4. She is a former member of the cancelled girl groups A-Girls and LIMETREE.
Lee Narin is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.

Lee Nayoung is a South Korean singer. She competed on the survival shows The Voice of Korea in 2020, The Legend, The New Singer in 2021, and The Debut: Dream Academy in 2023. She was also a contestant on the JTBC survival show Girls On Fire where she ended up ranking #1 which made her a part of the final group on June 25, 2024. However, on December 23, 2024, it was announced that the debut of the final group had been canceled.

Lee O Neul is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter and producer. She is a member of the CCM band GIFTED. She made her solo debut on December 19, 2016 under her birth name Kim Seul Ki. She is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.
Lee Pu Reum (이푸름) is a South Korean singer under Kemical Record. She is one half of the sister duo WABLE. Her sister is Lee Ki Rim.

Lee Pureun is a South Korean trainee and cheerleader. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl. She has been a cheerleader for the basketball team Anyang KGC and the handball team SK Hawks since 2020.
Lee Sara (이사라) is a South Korean keyoardist, member of the girl group Rainbow Note.
Lee Se Rim (이세림), also know as Lee Jessica (제시카리) is a South Korean oboe player. She was a member of the girl group A.SOME.

Lee Sem (also stylized as LeeSem) is a South Korean singer and model. She is a former member of the girl group 9MUSES but left on January 29, 2014, after the “Glue” promotions, when she graduated from the group.

Lee Seoan, formerly known as Lee Soomi or Soomi, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actress under Ghost Studio. She debuted as the main dancer and rapper of the Korean Pop female trio SeeYa. On July 23, 2010, Lee Soomi left SeeYa to be the leader of the new Core Contents Media mixed group Co-ed School and its sub-unit F-VE DOLLS. On February 17, 2012, Soomi left Co-ed School to focus on her solo career. In 2013 she joined D-Business Entertainment.
Lee Seoeun (이서은) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Lim Nayoung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, actress, and model currently under Ascendio. She is a former member of the girl group PRISTIN, its sub-unit PRISTIN V, and the project girl group I.O.I. In 2016, Lim Nayoung participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with five other trainees from her agency at the time, Pledis Entertainment. She ranked 10th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis', and was active with them throughout the entire length of their activities. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017. After the disbandment of I.O.I, Lim Nayoung, along fellow labelmate and I.O.I member Kyulkyung, debuted as a member of Pledis Entertainment's girl group PRISTIN, which debuted on March 21, 2017, with the mini album "Hi! PRISTIN" and its title track, "Wee Woo". The agency then formed PRISTIN V, a sub-unit of the group, with Nayoung being one of its members. They debuted on May 28, 2018, with the single album, "Like a V". Both group eventually disbanded in 2019 after almost two years without activity. It was also announced that 7 out of 10 members had not renewed their contracts with the agency, Nayoung being one of them. In late August 2019, it was reported that Lim Nayoung had signed an exclusive contract with Sublime Artist Agency where she would be focusing on many areas of entertainment including acting and choreography production. She later made her acting debut, playing the supporting role of the young Do Hae-soo in "Flower of Evil". In 2021, she played her first main role in the web drama "Summer Guys" alongside fellow I.O.I member Kang Mina.

femaleIdols.description: Lalisa Manobal, popularly known as Lisa, is a Thai rapper, singer, dancer, and actress under LLOUD and RCA Records. She gained international fame as a member of the South Korean girl group BLACKPINK, debuting under YG Entertainment in August 2016. Lisa is widely recognized as the main dancer, lead rapper, and the youngest (maknae) member of the group, making her one of the most influential figures in kpop. Lisa's journey to stardom began in Thailand, where she developed a passion for dance from an early age. She joined the dance crew "We Zaa Cool," where she became close friends with GOT7's Bambam. In 2010, she became the only person accepted in YG Entertainment's Thailand Audition, marking the beginning of her career in the Korean entertainment industry. After years of training in Korea, she debuted with BLACKPINK in 2016 and quickly rose to fame, contributing to the group's worldwide success. In September 2021, Lisa made her solo debut with the single album "LALISA," which set several records, including being the first female artist to sell over 736,000 copies in its first week in South Korea. The music video for the title track became the most-viewed solo artist video in its first 24 hours on YouTube. Both "Lalisa" and the viral track "Money" reached significant milestones, with "Money" becoming the longest-charting song by a female kpop soloist on the Billboard Hot 100. Lisa continued to break records with her solo career, becoming the first kpop solo artist to achieve one billion streams on Spotify with both her album "LALISA" and the song "Money." In 2024, Lisa launched her own management company, LLOUD, and signed with RCA Records. The following year, she released her debut studio album "Alter Ego" and achieved her first number-one single on the Billboard Global Excl. US with the song "Rockstar." Throughout her career, Lisa has received numerous accolades, including nine Guinness World Records, a Gaon Chart Music Award, and several MTV awards. She became the first kpop soloist to win at both the MTV Europe Music Awards and MTV Video Music Awards. Lisa is also recognized as the most-followed kpop artist on Instagram and the most-followed female kpop soloist on Spotify. Additionally, she has been honored as a cultural ambassador by the Thai government for her contributions to globalizing Thai culture.

In addition to her musical career, Luda made her acting debut in 2022 with the web drama My X Twenty, marking a new chapter in her entertainment career. On March 3, 2023, it was confirmed that Luda would not renew her contract with Starship Entertainment, though she remained a member of WJSN. Mei Qi is a Chinese singer, dancer, and actress under Yue Hua Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group WJSN and the Chinese project girl group Rocket Girls 101. Mei Qi debuted as a member of WJSN on February 25, 2016, with the mini album "WOULD YOU LIKE?". In the group's concept, she represented the Libra sign. On March 3, 2023, after five years of inactivity with the group, it was announced that Mei Qi didn't renew her contract with Starship Entertainment and would officially leave WJSN to pursue solo activities in China. Mei Qi, alongside fellow WJSN member Xuan Yi, joined Produce 101 China in 2018, where she ended up ranking 1st place overall, becoming a member of the final group, Rocket Girls 101. She debuted with the group on June 23, 2018, with the single "Collide". She was active with the group until its disbandment on June 23, 2020. Mei Qi made her Chinese solo debut on January 15, 2019, releasing the song "Helios" for the movie "The Wandering Earth". She later released the EP 'Jiang' on April 23, 2019, which became the fastest selling digital album on QQ Music in 2019, with over 1 million digital sales within the first twenty minutes of the album's release. Still in 2019, she also debuted as an actress in the movie 'Autumn Fairy Tale', as a supporting character. She starred for the first time as a main lead in the 2019 dance movie, 'Step Up: Year of the Dance' and in the Wuxia film 'Jade Dynasty'.

Melanie is a Korean-American singer who gained prominence as a member of the Korean pop girl group Chocolat. At a young age, Melanie moved to Hawaii, United States, where she lived with her parents for a brief year and a half. It was during this time that her passion for music began to take shape. At the age of 12, Melanie caught the attention of Paramount Entertainment, where she became a trainee. Interestingly, it was Tia, a colleague who would also join ChoColat, who recommended Melanie to the company’s CEO. Melanie’s hard work and dedication paid off when she made her debut with ChoColat, showcasing her talents as a vocalist, rapper, lead dancer, and the group’s youngest member (Maknae). Following Jaeyoon’s departure, Melanie stepped up as the main vocalist. Unfortunately, ChoColat faced challenges that led to its eventual disbandment. Factors such as financial struggles, communication gaps between the company and the group, and a lack of cohesive concepts contributed to this outcome. She leads a normal life in Hawaii alongside her family. In 2016, she married Matt Murphy, and together they have two daughters: Ayala (born in 2020) and Emilia (born in 2024). Melanie’s pursuit of education led her to study health services management in college.

Their debut song earned them their first win the same year, as well as many awards at the Mnet Asian Music Awards (MAMA), Golden Disk Awards (GDA), and Seoul Music Awards (SMA). In 2011, she made several cameo appearances in the hit drama 'Dream High' which starred her co-members, Bae Suzy and Wang FeiFei. She officially debuted as an actress with a support role in the Chinese drama 'One and a Half Summer'. In May 2016, she decided not to renew her contract with JYP and left Miss A to pursue solo activities in China. In June of that year, she signed with Banana Culture Music and in November debuted as a solo artist with the single 'Drip'. Her next song 'Who's That Girl', which was released in January of 2017, was charted at #6 on Billboards China. In April 2017, she won the "Breakthrough Female Artist of the Year" award at the 5th Annual V Chart Awards. In 2019, she left Banana Culture Music and continued her solo activities.

Mimi is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and television personality signed with WM Entertainment. She is the main rapper, main dancer, and vocalist of the girl group OH MY GIRL, and one-half of the project duo MNZ. She debuted as a member of OH MY GIRL on April 21, 2015, with the group’s self-titled debut mini album "Oh My Girl." Known for her sharp rap delivery and stage presence, Mimi quickly became a standout member within the kpop community. In 2022, Mimi expanded her presence through variety television. She joined the cast of Earth Arcade, a travel-based variety show on TvN, alongside An Yujin, Lee Youngji, and Lee Eun-ji. The show, produced by Na Young-seok, was well-received and returned for a second season in 2023. She also competed in the vocal survival show The Second World in August 2022, which featured rappers showcasing their vocal ability. Mimi placed 3rd in the final episode, earning praise for her versatility as both a rapper and singer. In July 2024, it was reported that Mimi and comedian Lee Eun-ji would debut as the project duo MNZ. They are reportedly in the final stages of preparing their first release, marking Mimi’s formal venture into collaborative music projects beyond OH MY GIRL.

At 13 years old she and Girls' Generation's member Hyoyeon, had formed a dance duo called "Little Winners". Min auditioned for JYP Entetainment when she was in the 6th grade. After a year of training in Korea, she was sent to the U.S. to train some more as she prepared for a U.S. solo debut. For her U.S. debut, J.Y. Park teamed up with Lil Jon in the production of her album. She went on to release three solo singles in 2007 and 2008; 'Dance Like This', 'Go Ahead' and 'Boyfriend'. Min made her official debut in South Korea as part of the four-member girl group Miss A on July 1, 2010 with the release of the single album "Bad Girl, Good Girl", from their debut mini album "Bad But Good". Despite leaving JYP Entertainment in November 2017, after her contract expired, she has stated many times that she is still a member of Miss A. In August of 2016, Min collaborated with Girls' Generation's member Hyoyeon and 2AM's member Jo Kwon, to form the co-ed project group Triple T. The trio released their debut single "Born to be Wild" featuring J.Y. Park, as part of SM Entertainment's 'SM Station' digital music project. On November 8, 2021, Min released her first official Korean solo digital single "Onion" under K-Tigers E&C.

Born and raised in Chuncheon, South Korea, Minji moved to Seoul and eventually began training under Source Music. Following this, due to internal changes within the company, Minji joined the label ADOR, leading to her debut as a member of NewJeans. On July 22, 2022, Minji officially debuted as a member of NewJeans with their self-titled mini debut album "NewJeans". Besides group activities, Minji also pursued solo endeavors, such as brand endorsements and pictorials. She is also credited as one of the lyricists of NewJeans' award-winning song "Ditto."
Minji (민지), also known as Seong Minji (성민지) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group MISS T. She was a contestant on Miss Trot 2.
Minji (민지) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group SIOSIJAK.
Minji (민지) is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the girl group Sunny Days. She left the group in June 2012 due to an ankle injury.

Minjoo (민주; also stylized as Minju) is a South Korean rapper. She is a former member of the girl group Two X. She debuted as a member of Two X on August 16, 2012 with the group's first single album "Double Up". On January 9, 2016, it was announced she would be leaving the group after four years of activities.

Minjoo, previously written as Minju, is a South Korean trainee. She is a former pre-debut member of the girl group WiTCHES. She is best known for participating in the South Korean survival show Stellar Sugar.

Kim Minju, also known as Minju, was the lead rapper, sub-vocalist, and visual of the South Korean girl group IZ*ONE. She ranked #11 in the survival show Produce48 with 227,061 votes, earning her a spot in the group. Prior to joining the show, Minju appeared in dramas such as The Great Seducer (2018) and in music videos such as iKON's "#WYD" and Kriesha Chu's "Like Paradise." She made her debut as a member of IZ*ONE on October 29, 2018, with their first mini album "COLOR*IZ". On April 29, 2021, IZ*ONE disbanded after their contract of two years and six months ended. Following IZ*ONE's disbandment, Minju has since focused on acting and being an MC for "Show! Music Core."

Minju is a South Korean singer and dancer, formely under Doo Republic. She was a member of now disbanded girl group A.KOR as well as its sub-unit A.KOR BLACK with fellow member Kemy. On July 25, 2014, she made her A.KOR debut with the release of the group's first digital song, "Payday". The digital single "How We Do" marked Minju's official group debut on June 3, 2015, as she joined A.KOR Black, the group's first subunit.
Kang Minju (강민주) is the Lead Vocalist, Lead Dancer, Rapper, and Visual of the Girl Group GWSN under The Wave Music. Aside from singing, Minju can also play the Piano.
Minju is a South Korean trainee under US Media Group. She is a member of the upcoming girl group KELT9b.
Minju (민주) is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the Korean pop girl group I.C.E.

Jeon Minju (전민주) is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on K-Pop Star 2 and K-Pop Star 6. She debuted as a soloist in 2014 with the digital single "Goodbye Rain." In 2015, she debuted as a member of the now-disbanded group The Ark and pre-debut group Dayday. In 2019, Minju and Euna Kim debuted as the duo Khan. However, they disbanded shortly after.

Park Minju is a South Korean singer under Belift Lab. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group ILLIT. In June 2023, she participated in HYBE and Belift Lab's survival show called R U Next?, where she was chosen by the label to be the third member to debut in the final group ILLIT.
Minjung is a South Korean singer. She is a former predebut member of the disbanded girl group Milkyway, and a former member of the girl group Busters and the kids' group CutieL.
Minjung is a South Korean singer under 8recordz, a member of the girl duo JAJUNG and the project vocal group Park Hajung.
Minkyeung is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Nazca.

Minkyeung, formerly known as Roa, is a South Korean former K-pop idol, songwriter, composer, currently an model and actress under KPLUS. She was the leader of the girl group HINAPIA and a former member of the girl group PRISTIN and its sub-unit PRISTIN V. In 2016, Minkyung participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with other five trainees from her agency, Pledis Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 42nd place. In 2017, Pledis Entertainment announced Minkyung, under the stage name Roa, as a member of PRISTIN, which debuted on March 21, 2017 with the mini album "Hi!" and its title track, "Wee Woo". On 24 October, 2022 Minkyeung signed an exclusive contract with KPLUS. She plans to be active in the fashion, beauty and acting industries.
Minkyung (민경) is a South Korean student, singer, and dancer. She is member of the girl group Azer Blossom.

Minkyung (민경) is a South Korean singer and actress signed with Artsro Entertainment. She used to be part of the girl group The SeeYa. She started her solo career in 2009 under the stage name JB (Jolly Baby) and with Kiroy Company.
Minkyung is a South Korean singer under CAM WITH US and a member of the female duo Davichi.
MinMin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Busters.
Minnie (미니) is a South Korean singer and rapper. She was a member of the girl group TINT.

femaleIdols.description: Nicha Yontararak, known under her stage name Minnie, is a Thai singer-songwriter, composer and actress under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE. On March 22, 2016, Minnie was first revealed to the public as a member of the trainee group Cube Tree. On April 18, 2018, Minnie was revealed as the sixth and final member of i-dle. The group officially debuted on May 2, 2018, with their first mini album "I am". In September 2020, Minnie made her acting debut in the Netflix sitcom "So Not Worth It" alongside Park Se-wan, Shin Hyun-Seung, GOT7's Youngjae, and Han Hyun-min. On January 6, 2025, Cube Entertainment released a teaser announcement for Minnie's solo debut song to be released the following day. On January 7, 2025, Minnie officially released "Blind Eyes Red". On the same day, it was also announced that Minnie will be releasing her 1st Mini Album soon. On January 21, 2025, Minnie released her 1st Mini Album with 7 tracks and the title track called "HER". The album composts of songs with featurings with fellow i-dle member Yuqi and Ten of WAYV.
Minnie is a singer, gamer and make-up artist. She is a member of the co-ed rotation project group PTMRS.

femaleIdols.description: Minnt, also known as Mint and Mintty, is a Thai singer, rapper, and model under Mflow Entertainment. She originally debuted as a member of Tiny-G in 2012, but in 2015 the group unofficially disbanded after being placed on an indefinite hiatus. In 2016, she left GNG Production and moved to JSL Company where she made her solo debut under the name Mintty on April 14, 2016, with the single "Already Go, Lady".
Minseo (민서) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group AZER.

Minseo is a South Korean singer under H Music Entertainment. She is the Main vocalist and Maknae of the girl group WOOAH (formerly known as woo!ah!). She made her debut as a member of WOOAH on May 15, 2020 with the group's first single album "Exclamation".
Park Minseo (박 민서) is the main dancer and maknae of the girl group Saturday under Yoonso Group. Minseo was added to the group in April 2019.
Minseo (Korean: 민서 ; Thai: มินซอ) is a South Korean singer and dancer under 411 Entertainment. She is a member of the Thai-Korean girl group AR3NA.
Minseo (민서) is a South Korean singer One Music Office and LST Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MayLiz.

Minseo is a South Korean singer and BJ. She was a former member of the girl group FLASHE. She originally debuted as a member of FLASHE with the group's third special single "FLASHE Season Album" in August 2017. Her departure from the group was announced on September 26, 2018 due to a back injury. She was a member of the dance crew SOONIGROUP.
Minseo (민서) is a South Korean singer and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. She is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO.

Kim Minseo is a South Korean singer and actress under A-Side Company. She is best known for competing in the show "Superstar K7" and appearing in the 2021 drama "Imitation" as Ria from the project girl group "Tea Party."
Minseung is a retired South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group AGirls.
Minsong is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group New-A.

Minsu (민수) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Magic Strawberry Sound. She is a member of the project duo Moi. Minsu eventually debuted as a soloist on May 31, 2018 with the digital single "The Birthday Song".

Minsun (민선) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Piggy Dolls. She’s now a soloist under the stage name Minsune. She is a former member of Mongshil Sisters. She was on Super Star K1.
Minsun is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the girl group JQT. She left the group in in early 2011.
Mint (민트) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups Love Cubic.
Mint (민트) is a singer and dancer. She is a former member of the performance girl group Bling. She left the group in early 2017.
Minyeong is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Alice White.
Minyoung (민영) is a South Korean singer and bassist. She was a member of the girl band Walking After U. She joined the group to replace Baemi.

Minyoung is a South Korean singer under BBGIRLS Company and GLG. She is the leader of the girl group BB GIRLS (formerly Brave Girls) and a former member of the girl group ZZBest and the project group HavyT. On February 2, 2016, it was announced that Brave Girls would be returning as a seven-member group after a two-year hiatus. She, alongside Yujeong, Eunji, Yuna, and Hayun, were added as new members. Minyoung officially debuted as a member on February 16, 2016, with the group's third digital single, "Deepened." Following Yujin's departure from the group on January 13, 2017, she was appointed as Brave Girls' leader.
Minyoung (민영) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group 84LY.

Gong Min-ji, popularly known as Minzy, is a South Korean singer. She rose to fame after debuting as the youngest member of the girl group 2NE1. Besides music activities, Minzy also actively participates in variety shows such as "Unnie's Slam Dunk" in 2016, which made her a member of the project girl group Unnies. On April 5, 2016, Minzy announced her departure from 2NE1 and its management company, YG Entertainment. As a result, she didn't participate in the group's final song, "Goodbye", which was released on January 21, 2017. After leaving 2NE1, Minzy focused on solo activities and eventually made a solo debut with her first mini album, Minzy Work 01 Uno. Despite this, she remained present in 2NE1's post-disbandment gatherings over the years, and even made a guest appearance at the 2022 Coachella for CL's stage performance together with Bom and Dara.
Minzy is a member of the girl group S.I.S.
Mio is a Japanese singer under XX Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group UNICODE.

MIO, formely known as Mihee, is a South Korean singer. She is part of the girl group BOTOPASS. She was also a participant in the survival show My Teenage Girl. She made her solo debut on June 6, 2025, with the digital single "Sink Into the Floor".
MIR is a V-Tuber and singer under Parable Entertainment. She debuted in May 2024 with the single "Dragon:MIR." Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be April 27.

Mira is a fictional singer and rapper created for the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. She is the main dancer, lead rapper, vocalist, and visual of fictional girl group HUNTR/X. She is voiced by May Hong while her vocals and rap are provided by singer and rapper Audrey Nuna.

Mirae is a South Korean singer under Zenith Media Contents. She was a member of the girl group LIPBUBBLE. After the disbandment of LIPBUBBLE, she focused on her YouTube and modelling career. She is currently a freelance model.

Mirae is a South Korean singer. She is the first revealed member of the girl group Soar-Over and a member of the live idol unit group EUNOiA. She was a member of the live idol group Kurohika from May 5 to August 31 2021 and a member of the independent live girl group Proxima Club from November 5 2021 to October 20th 2024.
Mirae (미래) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HEXE.
Mirai (미래) is a Japanese singer member of the girl group SKYGIRLS.

Mirani is a South Korean rapper under AT AREA. She was a contestant on Show Me The Money 9 in 2020 and got eliminated in Round 7 after going against Lil Boi. She made her solo debut independently with the digital single "The Detective" on April 24, 2020. She is also a member of the project girl group TDYA.
Aoyagi Sumire, better known as MiRe, is a Japanese singer under TR Entertainment. She is the Main Dancer, Sub Vocalist, Sub Rapper and Maknae of the girl group TRI.BE.
Miri was a contestant on Girls Planet 999
Miriam is an Italian singer under UnionWave Entertainment. She is a member of the pre-debut girl group PRISMA.
Mirika is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Mirim (미림) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group TINT. She was a contestant on KPOP STAR 2.
Mirin (미린) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Starz.

Miro (미로) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group NEKIRU. She joined the group in November 2022 and graduated on June 8, 2023. She re-joined the group on July 30, 2023. She is currently on hiatus, starting on October 13, 2023.

Miryo is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and producer under MYSTIC Story. She is a member of the girl group Brown Eyed Girls and a former member of Honey Family. She made her solo debut on February 1, 2012 with her first mini album Miryo aka Johoney.
Mischa is Filipina-Ukrainian-American trainee. She is best known for participating is the survival show A2K. She was eliminated in episode 15.

Miso, born Kim Mi-so, is a South Korean singer, producer, and DJ who debuted independently in 2016. She is a part of the artist collective Club Eskimo, alongside DEAN, Crush, millic, punchnello, OFONOFF (Colde & 0channel), Jusen, Chek Parren, 2xxx & Rad Museum. Miso is the older sister of singer-songwriter and composer Maddox.
Miso is a South Korean singer.She was a member of the girl group May Queen.
Jeon Jimin, popularly known as Miso, is the Main Vocalist of the Girl Group DreamNote under IMe Entertainment.
Miso (트리니티) is a former South Korean singer. She was the lead vocalist and maknae of the girl group GLAM.
Miso is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group A.De.

Miso (stylized as MiSO) is a South Korean rapper and singer under DOUBLE Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups GIRLS GIRLS and Ye-A. She made her solo debut on April 10, 2017, with the single album "MiSO ALL ACCESS". Miso was revealed as a member of GIRLS GIRLS on November 21, 2015. The group made their debut on December 9, 2015 with the single album "Strong Girls". On February 10, 2019 DOUBLE Entertainment made an official statement announcing that Miso had decided to leave the group to focus on her solo career. Miso came back with the digital single album "ON N ON" nine days later on February 19, 2019. In late October of 2022, she made her debut as a DJ under the stage name DJ RALLY, but she's still promoting under the name MiSO.
Miso (미소) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group P.O.P.
Miso is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the Korean pop girl group TAHITI.
Miso (미소) is a South Korean singer under StarCom Entertainment. She was a member of the upcoming girl group T.O.P Girls.
MISS H (미스에이치) is a South Korean singer signed to Vine Entertainment. She made her debut on July 3, 2024, with the single album “Bamboo.”
Miss Kim (미스김) is a South Korean singer under MIRI Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MIRI Girls.

Misty is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Gavy NJ. She joined the group in 2010 and left in 2012. She was a former member of BGH4 (2006-2009) and of the project duo H2 Gain (2007). She is a solo artist now.
Misun (미순) is a South Korean singer and bassist. She was a member of the girl band Swingz.

Lee Misung is a South Korean singer best known for being a former member of the group Sunny Hill. She joined the group in 2011. On December 18 2018, Misung left the group but would still contribute to the group as a lyricist.
Mitamura Yuka (미타무라 유우카) is a Japanese trainee. She is contestant on the survival show Find Rookie.
Mito is a Japanese trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.

MiU (Korean: 미유; Japanese: みゆ) is a South Korean singer-songwriter under 29production. She is a ex-member of the underground idol girl group Kizuna Simulation. MiU graduated from KZSM following her last live on September 22nd 2023.

MiU is a Japanese singer under 143 Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MADEIN, as well as it's pre debut sub unit LIMELIGHT. She is best known for participating in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999. She was formerly a tarento (TV Personality) under N.D.Promotion and also worked as a model and influencer. But, in early 2021, MiU deactivated her SNS accounts hinting that she had left the agency. On July 7, 2021, through the prologue teaser, MiU, and the other participating trainees were revealed as upcoming contestants on Mnet's newest reality program, Girls Planet 999. On July 19, her official profile was released. Regretfully, she was taken out in the show's fifth episode during the first round of eliminations. On December 24, 2021, 143 Entertainment then announced that MiU joined their company. On January 14, 2022, it was revealed that MiU was getting ready for her big break that month and would be making her debut with 143 Entertainment's new girl group by the end of the year. She made her debut as LIMELIGHT's (now MADEIN) second member on August 12, 2022. They released the EP 'Love & Happiness' on February 17, 2023, marking their debut. She will also soon debut in Japanese sub-unit MADEIN S with the album "MADE in BLUE" on 14th of August, 2025.

Miu is a Japanee singer under LAPONE Entertainment. In 2023, she participated in the survival show "Produce 101 Japan: The Girls" where she ended up ranking 4th place, securing her spot as a member of the Japanese project girl group ME:I. In 2020, she appeared as a contestant on the survival show Nizi Project. She was eliminated in the Part.1 and in 2021, she appeared as a contestant on the survival show Girls Planet 999. She was eliminated in episode 9 after ranking J11.
Miu (미우) is a Japanese trainee under KISS Entertainment. She is a former member of the trainee group MyDoll Girls and guest member for PinkFantasy.
Miu (미우) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group INY.
Miya is a Japanese rapper, singer, and dancer. She is a former member of the girl group GWSN. She made her solo debut on March 8, 2024, with the digital single "Miyao".
Miyabi is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

Miyazaki Miho (미야자키 미호) is a Japanese singer under Hori Pro. She is a former member of AKB48's Team A. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 15th place. She graduated from AKB48 on April 14, 2022.

Cho Miyeon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, and actress under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the visual and main vocalist of the girl group i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE. In 2010, Miyeon became a YG Entertainment trainee. She was supposed to debut as a member of BLACKPINK's final lineup, however, suddenly left the company in 2015. She said that she left the company because her debut was always postponed, and she gave up waiting. On April 8, 2018, Miyeon was revealed as the second member of i-dle. The group officially debuted on May 2 with their mini-album "I am" and the title song "Latata". On October 26, 2018, it was confirmed that Miyeon would perform at the League of Legends World Finals Opening Ceremony 2018, along with Soyeon, Madison Beer, and Jaira Burns. The four singers provided vocals for the virtual K-pop girl group K/DA, with Miyeon voicing Ahri, one of the most well-known champions in the League of Legends. In September 2020, it was revealed that Miyeon would make her acting debut as the female lead in web-drama "Replay: The Moment" as Yoo Hayoung, a popular YouTuber and band vocalist. The drama recorded more than 6 million cumulative views. On April 27, 2022, Miyeon made her solo debut with her mini-album "MY", with "Drive" serving as the album's title track.

Miyu (미유) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HAM. She left the group on September 27, 2010, citing that she was going to focus on her acting career. However, that never happened as she has since left the entertainment industry.
Miyu is a Japanese singer formely under No.1 Media. She is a member of the girl group GG and the sub-unit PoshGirls-J.

Takeuchi Miyu (also known as MIYUMIYU, is a Japanese singer, songwriter, and visual creator. She was a member of the trainee group MYSTIC Rookies and a former member of the Japanese groups FRUIT (2006-2009) and AKB48 (2009-2018). She was a contestant on Produce48 and ranked #17 in the final episode. On February 16th, 2024, she announced that she would be making her solo debut with the self-written and produced song "Memoirs" on February 23rd under the stage name MIYUMIYU.
Miyuna is a Japanese singer, member of the gril group GG. She joined the group in 2023.
Mizi is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups BIKINY and HeyGirls, but left both groups before their disbandments.
Mizi is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the co-ed band Re:Hearts.
Mizin is a South Korean singer, member of the pre-debut girl group YOURS. She was a member of Chloris as Mijin.

Mizuho is a Japanese singer and model under PLUSWIN Entertainment who debuted on November 24, 2021 with "Have A Good Day". She was a member of Himawari Princess until July, 2021 after graduating from the group.

Mizuki , formerly known as Léa and Hana, is a Japanese model, actress and singer under SNP Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl groups SECRET NUMBER and SKarf. In October 2017, she became a contestant on the survival show MIXNINE as a individual trainee. She was eliminated in episode 7 after ranking 109th place. On February 27, she was revealed as the fifth and final member of SECRET NUMBER. The group made their debut on May 19, 2020 with their first single "Who Dis?". On April 2, 2025, Vine Entertainment announced on their social media that Léa had chosen to leave the group as well as the company.
Mizuki (ミズキ) is a Japanese singer under Good Choice Entertainment. She is a member of the girl groups Secret School and PUZZLE.
mmddyy is a South Korean singer under Paktory Company. She made her solo debut on November 9, 2021 with the digital single "Non Fiction".
Moa, born Son Mo-ah, is a South Korean singer who debuted under Stoneship in 2020.

Moa, formerly known as Haroo and Hongrang, is a South Korean singer under BTC Entertainment. She was a member of the female duo SSOA and was the leader of the girl group Kitten Girls. She debuted as a soloist on July 20, 2017 with the release of her first digital single "너를 만나서".
