femaleIdols.description: Moa is a Thai model and influencer under an undisclosed agency. In June 2023, Moa participated in Belift Lab' survival show R U Next?, where she was eliminated in episode 6 after ranking 16th place.
Moah Lee is a South Korean singer under Warner Music Korea. She debuted on August 24th 2023 with her single album "Love Potion".

Yamauchi Moana is a Japanese personality under NiD Academy. She is best known for being a contestant on the South Korean reality survival shows, Girls Planet 999, The Entertainer and Stellar Sugar, and the Japanese competitive reality show, iCON Z.
Moe is a Japanese dancer and trainee under Eighty6. She is a member of the upcoming girl group ARVVY and a former member of the dance team CODE88.
Moeno is a Japanese singer. She was a contestant on Nizi Project.
Mogi Shinobu (모기 시노부) is a Japanese singer under Juss k.k. She was a member of AKB48's Team K. She graduated from AKB48 on January 19, 2024. She was a contestant on Produce 48.
Moha is a South Korean singer and songwriter under DH Play Entertainment. She debuted in 2014 with the single "The First Story".

Moka, also known by her birth name Jeon Youeun, is a South Korean singer under SooSo Entertainment and MANIA G. She is a former member of the live girl group Kawanari. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl and was also a contestant in the jihadol survival program Girls Frontier.

Moka is a Japanese singer and dancer under Belift Lab. She is the lead dancer, sub vocalist and visual of the South Korean girl group ILLIT. In June 2023, she participated in HYBE and Belift Lab's survival show called R U Next?, where she was chosen by the label to be the fifth member to debut in the final group ILLIT.

Moko Sakura (simply known as Moko) is a Japanese singer and AV actress. She is a member of the Japanese girl group Ebisu★Muscats and a former member of the groups Honey Popcorn and Bakusute Sotokanda Icchome.

Hirai Momo is a Japanese dancer, rapper, and singer-songwriter under JYP Entertainment. She is best known as one of the main dancers and rappers of the sensational girl group TWICE. She is also a member of TWICE's Japanese subunit MISAMO. Momo started dancing at a very young age. Her talent and passion led her to train at 'Step Out Studio' in Japan. There, she was scouted by a JYP Entertainment agent and was invited to audition for the 2011 JYP Japan Audition. Momo passed and ended up moving to South Korea as an official JYP Entertainment trainee. Years later, in 2015, Momo appeared as a contestant in the survival show SIXTEEN. Despite getting eliminated, Momo was brought back by JYP and ended up debuting as a member of TWICE.

Momoka is a Japanese singer and dancer under MyDoll Entertainment. She was a former member of the K-Pop girl group Pink Fantasy and a former pre-debut member of HitGirlz. She was in multiple J-pop groups. On May 10, 2024, Momoka was announced as a member of the upcoming co-ed group ToTh6y.
Momoka is a Japanese singer under Twin Planet Entertainment. She was a contestant on Nizi Project.

Okazaki Momoko is a Japanese tarento under BMD Fox Records. She is a member of the Japanese girl group BABYMETAL and a former member of the Japanese girl group Sakura Gakuin. She is also a dancer and once belonged to Babymetal Avengers (Momometal was the last remaining avenger), touring with Japanese kawaii-metal group BABYMETAL in 2019 and 2020. On July 2021, she was revealed to be a contestant on reality survival program "Girls Planet 999". Ranked 18th in cell ranking and 21st individually, she eventually got eliminated. On April 1, 2023, Momoko Okazaki was officially named as the new third member of Babymetal at the end of the “Black Night” concert at the Pia Arena, adopting the name “Momometal”.

Momona is a Japanese singer under LAPONE Entertainment. In 2023, she participated in the survival show "Produce 101 Japan: The Girls" where she ended up ranking 1st place, securing her spot as a member of the Japanese project girl group ME:I. She was a member of Hello Project Kenshuusei and Angerme.
Mona (모나) is a Canadian singer-songwriter under VIC Entertainment. She debuted as a soloist singer on February 9, 2018 with the mini album When.

Kim Jimin, popularly known as Monday, is a South Korean singer and dancer under IST Entertainment. She is the Main Vocalist, Main Dancer, and Rapper of the girl group Weeekly. She made her debut with the group on June 30, 2020.
Monika is a Japanese trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.
Mood & Feel (무드앤필), formerly known as Chok Chok (촉촉), is an independent South Korean solo singer-songwriter, composer and producer. She debuted on February 23, 2018 with the digital single, "Warmth".
Mooi is a South Korean singer and rapper. She was the lead vocalist and a rapper of the girl group GP Basic, and is a former member of the kids girl group 7Princess.
Moon (문) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Blue Fox. She joined the group Blue Fox in late 2019.

Moon is a South Korean retired singer and model. She is a former member of the girl group Tinus. She is best known for having an IQ of 158, appearing on television shows The Genius: Rules of the Game and The Genius: Grand Final, as well as being a part of Mensa International.
Moon is a hip-hop artist of Vietnamese, Chadian and Senegalese heritage under Wati-B. She debuted in South Korea on August 4, 2023, with the single "SEOUL CITY DRIFT".

Moon Hyunju (문현주) is a South Korean model and singer under YGK+ Entertainment. She ranked #97 in Episode 5 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated. During Produce 101, Hyunju represented NEXTAR Entertainment as a trainee. However, after the show, she left the agency and signed a contract with YGK+ Entertainment and is currently working as a model.
Moon Jiwon (문지원) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo Ashatree.
Moon Knife (문나이프) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Aftermoon Entertainment. She debuted on October 29, 2015 with her debut EP, Under the Moon.
Moon Mi Kyeong (문미경) is a South Korean violinist. She was a member of the girl group A.SOME.
Moon Seung You (문승유) is a South Korean singer under START Entertainment. She was a contestant on MIXNINE.

Moon Sua is a South Korean rapper, singer, and songwriter under MYSTIC Story. She is a member of the girl group Billlie and its sub unit Moon Sua X Siyoon. Before debuting, Moon Sua was already known by fans as a trainee under YG Entertainment. She had been training under the agency since 2009 and was speculated to be part of the trainee group that was meant to be a younger version of 2NE1. In 2015, she competed in the show 'Unpretty Rapstar 2' where she finished in 3rd place. Sometimes in 2019, Moon Sua left YG Entertainment after 10 years with the agency, and signed with MYSTIC Story. She eventually joined the trainee group Mystic Rookies, who later became Billlie, with whom she made her debut on November 10, 2021 with the release of the mini album "The Billage of Perception : Chapter One". In 2022, she was a contestant in JTBC' survival show The Second World, which allowed rappers to showcase their vocals through a singing competition. Moon Sua became an MC on MBC's "Show Champion" alongside fellow member Tsuki and WOOAH's Nana. Her first broadcast was held on February 8, 2023, while her last one was on November 15, 2023. On September 12, 2023, it was announced that Moon Sua would go on a hiatus due to health issues. On April 12, 2024, MYSTIC Story announced that her hiatus was over and that she would be coming back to the group.
Moon Sujin, formerly known as MOON, is a singer and songwriter under ANVI. She debuted on October 31, 2018, with the song “MILLION” featuring Dok2.

Moonbit is a South Korean indie singer-songwriter under the indie label INHEART MUSIC. She debuted with the single "Saturday" on the 19th of May, 2016. On the 5th of September 2018, she was revealed to be under INHEART MUSIC on their official instagram.

Moon Byul Yi, popularly known as Moonbyul, is a member of the girl group MAMAMOO under RBW Entertainment (formerly WA Entertainment). Moonbyul was, alongside other 6 female idols in the TV show “Idol Drama Operation Team”. They created a 7 membered girl group Girls Next Door which debuted on July 14, 2017. She also appeared on The King of Masked Singer as Swan. On July 21, 2020, Moonbyul became the new Radio DJ for Avengirls every Tuesday. On February 15, 2021, Moonbyul became the new Radio DJ for her program "Studio Moon Night" every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
MoonMomo is a singer and V-Tuber. She is a member of the group VLYZ.
moonsound is a South Korean singer who debuted independently on February 12, 2015, with Give Me A Chance featuring Kim Jiseok. She’s currently under h1BLE Records since October 2019.
Moonsun (문선) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo moi.
moony is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under AL Media Lab and Rabbiteyes Records. She made her solo debut on April 16, 2020 with the digital single "Prologue".
Moony is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Maywish. She joined the group in October 2019 after all the original members left in June,
Moonyeon (문연) is a korean singer under Kids Planet (ON1 Entertainment and 4D Label). She is a member of the girl group Youngest.
moOon is a singer-songwriter under 12ENT. She made her debut on March 11, 2022, with the digital single "Let's Hang Out On White Day".
Lim Kyung-hee, better known under the stage name Morning Coffee, is a South Korean singer under Victor Content. She made her debut on April 21, 2017.
Moro is a South Korean idol. She is the first member of the live idol group KOKOIYA.
Morrie is a South Korean Indie singer-songwriter. She debuted on June 4, 2010, with the full album "Don't listen to this music if you are happy".
Motomura Aoi (모토무라 아오이) is a Japanese singer under Mercury, member of HKT48's Team KIV. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 52nd place.
Motte (모트) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under Ruby Records. She made her debut on September 8, 2017 with the single "Tickin'".
Movin is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Stellar Music Collective. She made her solo debut on February 9, 2022, with the EP "Wander".
MOYA is a member of the live idol group -ny day. She is also a part of SEKAKOMO.
Mozzy is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Label Bada. She made her debut on November 11, 2022, with the self-titled digital single "Mozzy".
MRCH is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter. She made her debut on August 14, 2019 with the EP "Let's March!".

msftz (미스피츠) is a South Korean singer under Sony Music Entertainment Korea. Before her official debut, she uploaded her songs on SoundCloud. She officially made her solo debut on January 2, 2020 with the digital single "Eternity".
mu.b is a South Korean singer and YouTuber under RGB Sounds. She made her solo debut on April 13, 2021, with the digital single "Subscribe".

MUa is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper. She is the leader of the girl group SKYLE and a former member of the cancelled girl group ALLS-GIRL. She made her solo debut on May 24, 2024 with the digital single "Like Salad".
Mukgang is a South Korean YouTuber, content creator, and BJ. She is a member of the girl group OSDS.
Mul (뮬), is a South Korean rapper under talented, who debuted under Flip Base in 2020.

Murakawa Bibian (무라카와 비비안) is a Japanese singer under ASOBISYSTEM, member of CANDY TUNE. She was a member of HKT48's Team TII and graduated on November 1, 2022. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 45th place.
Murase Sae (무라세 사에) is a Japanese singer under Ten Carat. She was a member of NMB48's Team N and graduated on December 23, 2020. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 22nd place

Muto Tomu is a Japanese singer under Ikushimakikaku, member of AKB48's Team K. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 38th place. She is the daughter of Muto Daisuke, a former actor.

MUU is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups LUNARSOLAR and A-Daily under the stage name Taeryeong, as well as a pre-debut member of BLACKMAMBA. She made her solo debut on September 17, 2022, with the digital single "Happy Trip" under the stage name Taeryeong.
Mwah is a South Korean singer and rapper. She was a member of the girl group YJIG.

Myah is a South Korean-American singer under TOP MEDIA. In 2021, Myah was a contestant on MNET's survival show Girls Planet 999. She was eliminated in the final episode after ranking 11th overall and thus, being unable to debut with Kep1er. On September 18, 2024, Myah was announced as the first member of the upcoming girl group ODD YOUTH. She debuted with them on November 1, 2024, with the release of their first single "Best Friendz".
Myai is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier. She is a member of REKIREM and a former member of the live idol group KAWANARI.

Myeongseon (명선) is a South Korean singer and comedian, member of the girl group MISS T. She made her debut as a comedian in 2014 on the tvN show Comedy Big League. She was a contestant on Miss Trot 2.
Mygomiee is a Korean-Canadian member of the virtual girl group TSSJ.
Myolin (묘린) is a South Korean trainee and model. She was a member of the girl group HOLICS and was also a former member of the pre-debut girl group DAILY.

MyoU (Korean: 묘우; Japanese: ミョウ) is a Japanese singer and Twitch streamer under islet. She was a former member of T.K. Production and LAMIA MUSIC's girl group, Girls2000. She made her solo debut on November 11, 2020 with the release of her first digital single, "Cheer✰leader!".

Song Min-young is a Korean-American internet personality who was first known for being a JYP Entertainment trainee, even participating in the survival program SIXTEEN. On October 19, 2021, she debuted as a soloist under the name Myssong with the digital single “MIDNIGHT”.

Myu debuted with the group Re:Hearts in 2025 as a vocalist. Before debut, she gained attention as a YouTuber sharing content about makeup, fashion, and lifestyle. Re:Hearts aims to connect with listeners through emotional themes such as loneliness and self-discovery, with their debut single "Reborn" introducing a dreamy and modern sound.
Myung Inhee was a member of the co-ed group THETHE. She joined the group in 2007 as their third Vocalist but left in 2008. She made her solo debut on July 25, 2003.
Myung Sarang is a German-South Korean film director and former singer. She was a member of the girl group Baby V.O.X Re.V but left in 2007.
Myunghwa is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group MissMatch.
Na Aram (나아람) is a Korean pop singer and songwriter. She was a member of the girl group Six Bomb. She left the group in 2015. She is a former member of Holladang and Duo Flo.

Na Ha-Eun is a South Korean singer and dancer under High Up Entertainment. She made her official debut on January 26th, 2018 with the single "So Special" featuring Microdot. Na Haeun has done female and male dance covers at the 2017, 2018, and 2019 Melon Music Awards (MMA). During the 2017 Melon Music Awards, she gained popularity for performing a dance cover, 'Peek-A-Boo' by the K-pop girl group, Red Velvet. Na Haeun has a YouTube channel where she posts covers of female and male dance. She has collaborated with numerous K-pop groups on her channel such as MOMOLAND, GFRIEND, Cherry Bullet, Weeekly, and more.

Na Hyun is a South Korean singer under SidusHQ. She is best known for being a member of the girl group Sonamoo. On September 23, 2019 it was announced that Nah Yun has filed to terminate her contracts with TS Entertainment.
Na Mi Ri (나미리; or simply Miri), formerly known as K.Me (케이미), is a South Korean actress, rapper, singer and lyricist. She is a former member of the girl groups BADKIZ, ZZBest and Pandora.
Na Rin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Queenz Eye.
Na Yeongjoo is an South Korean trainee under INNIT Entertainment. She is a member of the pre-debut girl group DDDD 25. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show The Entertainer.
Gim Myeong-ok, better known by the stage name Na-mi, is a South Korean singer. She was considered a "superstar" and "icon" of Korean pop music in the 1980s and early 1990s.

Naakyeum is a South Korean R&B singer who debuted as a soloist on March 26, 2015, with the release of the single "No." Since December 2023, Naakyeum has been a part of the duo Add All Ears along with Shin Youme.

Nab2 is a South Korean idol. She is a member of the live idol group Proxima Club and the live idol unit group -ny day. She also made her solo debut with the track “Summer Time” released on September 5th, 2023.
Nada is a Egyptian singer and dancer. She was a member of the project girl group UHSN under Stone Music Entertainment.
Nada is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the project group RESONAR, and former member of the girl group WA$$UP.

Nadanbi (나단비) is a South Korean singer, YouTuber and BJ under Long Run Music. She was a former member of the girl groups Bob Girls and LoveUs. She made her debut as a solo singer on December 19, 2019 with her first digital single, "Winter Love".
Nael (나엘) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups HINT and TURAN.

Son Na Eun is a South Korean singer and Actress. She is best known for being the Visual and Center of the Korean pop girl group Apink. Aside from being one of the it girls of Kpop, Naeun has starred in numerous Music Videos, Movies, and even Dramas. She mader her debut as a member of Apink on April 21, 2011. In April 2021, Naeun left IST Entertainment although she remains as a member of Apink. Soon after, she joined YG Entertainment as an actress. In April 2022, Naeun announced that she will leave Apink after 11 years.

Lee Naeun is a former member of the girl group April. She debuted on August 24, 2015. On January 30, 2019, DSP Media announced the release of a new single album, which would be sung by a special sub-unit made up of Naeun and Jinsol. On February 7, the single, titled "My Story", was released. Besides her group activities, Naeun also has roles in A-Teen (2018), A-Teen 2 (2019) and Extraordinary You (2019). On January 28, 2022, DSP Media announced that April has decided to disband after 6 years and go their separate ways. Following this, in June 2022, it was announced that Naeun would be a full time actress under Namoo Actors.
Naeun was the third member revealed as part of Bunny.T's brand new lineup and is set to debut in the 4-member girl group in 2025.

naevis (stylized as nævis) is a virtual singer under SM Entertainment. She made her debut on September 10, 2024, with the digital single "Done". naevis is the first virtual artist under SM Entertainment. She is a supporting character in the aespa universe, helping and guiding the members and their avatars (aes) by opening the P.O.S (Port of Soul) to connect the Flat World, the Real World, and the Kwangya SM center. naevis will use a voice created with artificial intelligence and content generated by AI. Her IP universe will expand through music, webtoons, games, brand collaborations, and merchandise.

Nagai Manami is a Japanese trainee. She is a former member of the female trainee group KISS GIRL'S and of the Fukuoka-based drum band, Nowadaiko. Manami became a drummer of Nowadaiko at the young age of 6 and worked with them for over 12 years until 2021. The drum band was formed by her father, Nagai Hiromichi, who raised Manami with the skill of performing traditional Japanese wataiko (drums). She ultimately left the drum band in 2021 to pursue her dreams of becoming a singer. Manami is the third and youngest daughter of Nagai Yuuko and Nagai Hiromichi, who is the president and leader of Nowadaiko and the founder of ND-STUDIO. Her two older sisters, Nagai Ayaka and Nagai Ryouka are also members of Nowadaiko. She is best known for being contestant on the 2021 South Korean reality survival show, "Girls Planet 999".
Nagano Serika (나가노 세리카) is a Japanese singer, member of AKB48's Team 8 and Team 4. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 77th place.

Hiyajo Nagomi is a Japanese singer under EVA Entertainment. She debuted as a member of the girl group ViV on April 11, 2024, with their single album "Bomb". She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999 but got eliminated in episode 5. Her individual rank was J17.

Nagomi is a Japanese-British singer under 143 Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MADEIN and the sub unit MADEIN S. On September 2, 2023, Nagomi was revealed as a contestant on the survival show "PRODUCE 101 JAPAN THE GIRLS". She was eliminated in the tenth episode, during the third ranking announcement, after placing 23rd overall. On May 10, 2024, Nagomi was announced as a new member of the girl group MADEIN under 143 Entertainment, and will make her debut in Japanese sub-unit MADEIN S with the album "MADE in BLUE" on 14th of August, 2025.

Lee Nagyung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, actress, dancer, and composer under ASND. She was one of the lead vocalists and visuals of the girl group fromis_9. Nagyung was born in Korea but had to move and study in China when she was younger. In 2017, she appeared and competed in the show "Idol School" where she ranked 5th with 64,001 votes, earning her a spot in the group. Nagyung debuted as a member of fromis_9 on January 24, 2018, with the mini album To. Heart. On October 2021, Nagyung made her acting debut in the popular K-drama "Shadow Beauty".
Nahee is a South Korean singer. She was the leader of the girl group SPIA.

Nahee, stylized as Na_hee, was a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Mun Hwa In. She made her debut as a solo artist solo debut on October 28, 2019 with her first digital single, "Blue City". She sadly passed away on November 8th, 2023, the cause of the death has not been disclosed.
Nahna is a Thai trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.
Nahyun (나현) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Refiners.
Nahyun is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Blady. She left the group in 2013.
Nahyun (나현) is a South Korean singer and dancer. She was a member of the girl group Asome.D.

Nahyun is a South Korean singer signed with AO Entertainment. She is a part of the girl group PRIMROSE. Before this, she used to be the leader of another girl group HOT ISSUE. Nahyun debuted as a member of HOT ISSUE on April 28, 2021, with the mini-album “Issue Maker”. However, the group disbanded on April 22, 2022, just six days before their first anniversary. According to S2 Entertainment, their former agency, the decision was reached after a lengthy discussion about the group’s future and direction.

Nahyun (나현) is a South Korean professional dancer and choreographer. She is currently a member of the dance crew TURNS with whom she appeared on the dance survival program Street Dance Girls Fighter from November 2021 to January 2022. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group Elado.
Nahyun is a South Korean singer under TITAN CONTENT. She is the maknae of the girl group AtHeart.
Naiki Kokoro (나이키 코코로) is a Japanese singer under SOMEDAY. She was a member of NMB48's Team BII and graduated on August 11, 2019. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 87th place.
Nakanishi Chiyori (나카니시 치요리) is a Japanese singer, member of AKB48's Team B. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 37th place.

Nakano Ikumi (나카노 이쿠미) is a Japanese singer under Flave Entertainment. She was a member of AKB48's Team 8 and Team K and graduated on May 30, 2019. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 59th place.

Nako is a South Korean singer, and a former member of the live idol girl group KAWANARI. She debuted as a original member of KAWANARI on March 19, 2023. On January 3, 2024, It was announced that starting on March 17, Nako will be taking a hiatus of 8 months to focus on her studies while KAWANARI continues as a duo. On December 25, 2024, It was announced that Nako officially departed KAWANARI after a 9-month hiatus due to her studies.

Yabuki Nako, or simply Nako, is a Japanese singer, lyricist, actress, and radio host under Twin Planet Entertainment. She is a former member of the Japanese idol girl group HKT48 and the project girl group IZ*ONE. She ranked #6 in the hit survival program Produce48 with 261,788 votes, earning her a spot in the group. She debuted as a member of IZ*ONE on October 29, 2018, with their first mini album "Color*Iz". On April 29, 2021, her contract with IZ*ONE officially expired and she and the other two Japanese members returned to Japan. On May 15, 2021, she resumed formally HKT48 activities with a theatre appearance. In October of 2022, Nako had shared that she was busy preparing for her graduation concert, and on April 1st that concert was held, finishing her career in HKT48.
Nako (나코) is a Japanese trainee announced as a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 5th episode.
Naco Miyase (simply known as Nako) is a Japanese actress and former singer. She was a member of the girl groups Honey Popcorn and sherbet.
Nakyeong is a South Korean singer under HR Entertainment. She is a member of the kids girl group Rookie.

NaKyoung is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer under MODHAUS. NaKyoung was introduced as the seventh member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on August 22, 2022. She first debuted with the sub-unit Acid Angel from Asia on October 28, 2022, with the mini album "ACCESS". With their first ten revealed members, tripleS debuted on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE". As a member of tripleS, NaKyoung was placed in the sub-units Acid Angel from Asia, ACID EYES, EVOLution, Visionary Vision, and Neptune.
Dong Me (동미) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group DAILY.
Nam Dayun (남다윤) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of Fancy Factory's kids girl group CoCo. She is the twin sister of Nam Gayun.
Nam Gayun (남가윤) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of Fancy Factory's kids girl group CoCo. She is the twin sister of Nam Dayun.
Nam Geon Hye is a South Korean model. She used to be part of MOA, Leader’S, and its sub-unit Leader’S G.

Nam Gyu Ri (남규리) is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the girl group SeeYa. After leaving the group, she has since focused on acting. She is best known for appearing in dramas such as "49 Days" and "You Are My Spring."
Nam Minjeong (남민정; formerly known as Winy) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the female duo UNC and girl group LIPBUBBLE.
Nam Seri is a South Korean rapper. She is a member of the hip hop all female group Amourette, along with Hoody, KittyB and Nieah.

Nam Yujin, formelly known as Eyedi is a South Korean singer. She debuted on July 19, 2016 with the single "Sign". In 2017, she participated on JTBC's reality competition show MIXNINE, ranking fifth overall for female contestants. On July 10, 2022, the CEO of Bace Camp Studios stated that Eyedi was on indefinite hiatus. On February 19, 2024 she announced her departure from Bace Camp Studio after approximately four years of legal disputes and that she will continue her career under her birth name, Nam Yujin.

Nam Yuju is a South Korean-Japanese trainee with Evermore Entertainment and a member of their pre-debut girl group, EVERMORE MUSE. Yuju gained significant recognition by competing in multiple survival shows. She participated in CAP-TEEN in 2020 as part of the All U team, followed by Stars Awakening in 2022, and Mnet's I-LAND2: N/a in 2024. Despite her talent, she was eliminated from all three, which prevented her from debuting. During her time on I-LAND2: N/a, she was under WAKEONE. On September 8, 2025, she was confirmed as a contestant on Mnet's survival show, Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

femaleIdols.description: Namfon or Kora is a Thai model and YouTuber. She was a member of Korean girl group RaNia from 2018 till 2020. When Namfon had joined DR Music(or RaNia) she needed to have a visa to live in South Korea. However, DR Music was not responsible to do the requirements that Namfon had to do the 90 day visa plan. When K-Pop idols tend to do that, they go to South Korea for 90 days and fly back to their home country and stay there for five days before returning. The company is in charge of paying the flights. However, Namfon had to pay all flights herself causing her parents to be drowning in debt. Since she is the one who's paying for the flight, she decided to leave RaNia and DR Music by cancelling her flight. According to an interview with Ploopy678, she said that when she never returned, the company just went with it. She also never told the company.
Namgung Jinyoung (남궁진영) is a South Korean singer who debuted in 2016 with “Boat Song”.
Nami is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Black Pearl and The Unnies. After Black Pearl disbanded, she started her OST activity under the name of ‘Blackpearl Nami’.
Nami (나미) is a South Korean singer, lyricist and composer, member of the girl group PIU.
Namjjaem is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.

Kim Namjoo is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actress. She made her official debut on April 19, 2011 as the Lead Vocalist and Lead Dancer of the Girl Group APINK under With Us Entertainment. She's also part of sub-unit 'Apink BnN' alongside fellow Apink member BOMI. Namjoo has also ventured to acting in 2015 where she played the Main Role of the web-drama "Investigator Alice". She made her Solo debut with the single album "Bird" on September 7, 2020. Namjoo also made her debut as a musical actress in 2022 with the musical "Midnight Sun".

femaleIdols.description: Namkhing is a Thai vocalist under Big Ocean ENM. She debuted as a member of the girl group iii on August 29, 2025.

Nana is a Japanese trainee under WAKEONE. She is mostly known for her participation in the survival shows Produce 101 Japan The Girls in 2023, and Mnet's survival show I-LAND 2 N/a in 2024. Sadly, Nana was eliminated from both survivals shows, making her unable to debut.

Nana is a South Korean actress, model, and singer under SUBLIME. She is a member of After School and its unit Orange Caramel. She is collectively known for her work in modeling, acting, and idol entertainment industries, and has extended her charms by appearing in several television dramas, and becoming a prosperous commercial ambassador. Nana debuted as a member of After School on November 25, 2009, with the release of "Because of You". In June 2010, Nana and fellow members Raina and Lizzy assembled the sub-group, Orange Caramel, releasing the single "Magic Girl" showing a bubbly-charming image contrasted from After School's desirable concept.

Nana is a Japanese singer under F&F Entertainment. She is a former member of the Japanese girl group PRIKIL and is a member of the South Korean project girl group UNIS. She is best known for participating in the Japanese survival show Who Is Princess? and South Korean survival show Universe Ticket. On December 30, 2023, she represented Universe Ticket at the SBS Entertainment Awards alongside seven other contestants. They performed "Come With Me?" and "Smoke" (with Dynamic Duo).
Nana is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Nana is a Chinese trainee.She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar.

Nana is a South Korean singer and Actress signed with H Music Entertainment. Nana is the Leader, Main Dancer, Lead Vocalist, Lead Rapper & Visual of the girl group WOOAH (formerly known as woo!ah!). She is also a member of the project girl group EL7Z UP. She made her debut as a member of WOOAH on May 15, 2020, with the group's first single album "Exclamation". That same year, she also made her debut as an actress with the drama “No Going Back Romance.” She continued her acting career with roles in the dramas “Best Mistake Season 3” (2021), “Mimicus” (2022) and "Fall for You" (2022). On April 24, 2023, Nana participated in the survival show Queendom Puzzle and finished in 2nd place earning her spot in the project girl group EL7Z UP. They made their debut on September 14, 2023, with their first mini album “7+Up”.

Nana is a South Korean singer, DJ and model under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X.
Nana (난아) is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the girl group BBde Girl.
Nanaring is a singer and V-Tuber. She is the sub-vocalist of the group VLYZ.

Nanayuri (나나유리) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Cupid. She left the group in 2016 and rejoined after their move to Narda Entertainment. She then left the group in August 2017.
NanCho is a V-Tuber and singer under Parable Entertainment. She debuted with the digital single "RUN! RUN! RUN!" in November 2024.

Nancy Jewel McDonie is a Korean-American singer and entertainer signed under ATOC. She gained prominence as the youngest member of the girl group MOMOLAND, which debuted in 2016. Known for her dual heritage and global appeal, Nancy has been active in both the Korean and international entertainment industries. Nancy began her public career in 2011 through her appearance on Korea’s Got Talent as part of the hip-hop group "Cutie Pies," which advanced to the semi-finals. In her early teens, she featured in several variety programs, most notably Mak Irae Rae Show: Just Do It Expedition, where she traveled internationally alongside actress Kim Yoo-jung and future STAYC member Sieun. Before her official debut, Nancy trained under Nega Network before joining MLD Entertainment. She secured her place in MOMOLAND after winning first place in the survival show Finding Momoland. The group officially debuted on November 10, 2016, with the mini-album "Welcome to Momoland", and went on to achieve commercial success with viral hits like "Bboom Bboom". Following the group's announcement of disbandment on February 14, 2023, conflicting statements emerged regarding MOMOLAND’s status, with suggestions of an indefinite hiatus rather than a formal disbandment. Shortly after, Nancy launched new social media accounts, signaling the start of her solo career under ATOC. On April 10, 2025, MOMOLAND announced their return, now under Inyeon Entertainment (the same agency as 1THE9's former member Lee "ONLEE" Seung-hwan)

Nara (나라) is a South Korean singer. She was a member and vocalist of the girl group ASHA. She made her solo debut on January 11, 2018 with the digital single "Jealousy".

Nara (나라) is a Korean-Chinese dancer. She was a member of the girl group NEWRED. She left in July 2020, because she wants to focus on the future. She modeled for “Oh My Denim” & “AWCO”.
Nara (나라) is a South Korean singer under To Hermitage, member of the girl group NTORE. She joined the group in August 2023.

Nara Jjang (Korean: 장나라, Chinese: 张娜拉) is a South Korean singer and actress under Rawon Culture. She made her Korean debut on June 18, 2001, with her first album "First Story" before making her Chinese debut on January 20, 2005, with the studio album "一張".
Park Na Rae (박나래) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean Pop girl group SPICA and their sub-unit SPICA.S.

femaleIdols.description: Ahnatchaya Suputhipong, known under her stage name Natty, is a Thai dancer, singer-songwriter, composer, and choreographer under S2 Entertainment. She debuted as a soloist on August 21, 2008, with the single “ZUDY” under the stage name Zudy. She later changed her stage name to her birth name when she came back with “누나처럼” in 2022. Oh Yeon-seo (오연서) is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the girl group LUV as Haetnim (햇님). She is best known for her roles in television dramas My Husband Got a Family (2012), Jang Bo-ri is Here! (2014), Shine or Go Crazy (2015), Come Back Mister (2016), My Sassy Girl (2017), A Korean Odyssey (2017–18), Love with Flaws (2019–20), and Mad for Each Other (2021).

Oh Yoojin is a South Korean trot singer under TOTALSET. She debuted as a soloist singer on April 11, 2023 with the digital single "Flower of Love". She is best known for being a contestant on various singing survival shows such as Trot National Sports Festival, Trot Magic Wanderer, My Teenage Girl and Miss Trot 3.

Oh Yuna is a South Korean former trainee. From April to May 2024, she was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she was eliminated in episode 7. At the time, she was a trainee under WAKEONE.
OHAH is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter. She made her debut on October 14, 2022, with the single "Destiny".

Ohwayo is a singer under Project [i] who debuted as a member of the group HONEYZ on August 30, 2024, alongside the other members, with the single "Ready 2 Be Loved". Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be December 2.

Oil (오늘은 일요일; also known as Wooyoung (우영)) is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter and composer. She is a former member of the girl group Purfles.She made her solo debut on December 5, 2019 with the EP Vaccination.
Okoi, stylized as OKOI, is a South Korean dancer and trainee under PI Corporation. She gained recognition as a contestant on the reality show Time Turner.
Okuma Sumomo is a model under CAT'S EYE Okinawa. She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999.
Oli (올리) is a Chinese singer. She was a member of the girl group As One. she left the group in May 2013, rejoined iin February 2014 and left in July 2014.
Oline (올린) is a Norwegian dancer. She was a member of the project girl group UHSN under Stone Music Entertainment.
Olivia is a French singer. In 2013 she debuted as a member of The Gloss. However, they disbanded in 2014. Olivia was the first non-Asian member of any female Kpop group.

Olivia Marsh, also known as Gyuna, is a South Korean-Australian singer-songwriter and composer under MPLIFY. She debuted with the song "Lava" on March 31, 2024, which was part of the soundtrack for the JTBC TV show “Hide.” She made her solo debut with the single "42" on October 16, 2024. Olivia is the older sister of Danielle from NewJeans.
Olly (올리) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Nazca.
Ommi is a Thai trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.
On (온) is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the girl group Blastar. She was previously an actress in musicals.
OnB is a South Korean bassist and member of the rock band DIH.

Onda is a South Korean dancer and singer under Yue Hua Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group EVERGLOW. In 2017, Onda participated in the Mnet' survival show, Idol School, but was eliminated in episode 4 after ranking 40th place. On February 20, 2019, a teaser video was posted on Stone Music Entertainment's YouTube channel, revealing her, under the stage name Onda, as a member of the girl group EVERGLOW. She made her debut with them on March 18, 2019 with the release of their first digital single "Arrival of Everglow", and its title song "Bon Bon Chocolat".

One Ket is a South Korean rapper. She was a member of the South Korean pop girl group Global Icon, on February 26, 2015, One Ket was revealed to have filed a lawsuit against Simtong Entertainment, citing poor management. However, the company claimed that she and Aram had somehow breached their contracts.
Oohyo is a South Korean synthpop singer and songwriter under Mun Hwa In. She released her debut EP Girl Sense on May 15, 2014.
OoOo (Ornette) is an independent R&B singer-songwriter.
Orly is a South Korean singer. She debuted on October 5, 2019, with the digital single "Need You Now".

OVCOCO previously known as Doyeon is a South Korean singer. She made her debut in 2015 with 1st album “Shame On You”.
OWN, formerly known as Seulye and Han Bit Na is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Year 7 Class 1. She made her solo debut on March 20, 2025 with her first EP 0-6.
Oyeon is a South Korean singer-songwriter under CREATIVUS. She made her solo debut on August 21, 2019 with the digital single "Stay With Me".

femaleIdols.description: Paan is a Thai dancer and singer under EgoENT. She is a member of the girl group VVUP.
Yujin is a South Korean guitarist and member of the girl band DIH.
Panini Brunch (파니니 브런치) is a South Korean singer who debuted on December 22, 2015 with "찬바람 불면 (featuring 박살)".
Panpalin is a Thai trainee under DADDY U Entertainment, best known for her appearance as a contestant on the reality survival show Under 15.
Para (파라), also known as Jiyoung (지영) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl duo Maronie Girls. She participated in all of the group's line-ups.

Park Bom is a South Korean singer currently under D-Nation Entertainment. She was a former member of the girl group 2NE1 until the group reunited on July 21st 2024. She made her solo debut on October 28, 2009, with the single "You And I". In 2019, she made her official comeback in the industry with her mini album "Spring" under D-Nation.

Park Boram was a South Korean singer-songwriter under Xanadu Entertainment. She first appeared in the talent show "Superstar K" in 2010 where she finished eighth place. From then she started training until she made her official debut in 2014 with the digital single "Beautiful." On April 12, 2024, Xanadu Entertainment confirmed reports that Park Boram tragically passed away on the night of April 11th. Her cause of death was later revealed to be acute alcohol poisoning.

Park Chanju is an independent singer and brand owner. She was a competitor on Produce 48. However, she ranked #68 on episode 5 and was eliminated. Chanju along with Lee Chaejeong and Park Minji had an interview with yssdotcom in September of 2018. They teased that they are in an upcoming girl group, set to debut in the near future under M&D17. After M&D17's girl group failed to debut in 2019, Chanju terminated her contract with the company. In May 2019, she was selected as a model for the cosmetics brand Holika Holika. On July 8, 2020, she opened her marketing blog and got married in the second half of 2022, giving birth to her son on May 18, 2023
Park Damin is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.
Park Eun Bin is a South Korean actress and singer under Namoo Actors. She debuted as a soloist on January 4, 2024 with the digital single "Present".

Eunyoung is a South Korean singer and former member of the girl group Brave Girls. She debuted with the group on April 8, 2011, with their first single album, The Difference. Eunyoung, along with Seoah and Yejin, did not participate in Brave Girls' 2013 digital single For You. It was later confirmed on February 3, 2016, that the three members had officially departed the group. She is currently active as a pilates instructor and a YouTuber.
Park Ga Eun (박가은) is a South Korean singer under The Entertainment Pascal. She was a contestant on MIXNINE.
Park Ha Ran (박하란) is a South Korean drummer, member of the girl rock band SHOT GIRL.
Park Haewon is a South Korean singer and songwriter. She was a contestant on Star Awakening. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.
Park Haneum is a South Korean singer under Muse Odyssey. She is a member of the kids co-ed group Little Muse and a former member of the kids groups YOUNGEST.

Park Hee Von, formerly known as Park Jaeyoung or Jaeyoung, is a South Korean actress, singer, and lyricist under Noon Company. She is a former member of the girl M.I.L.K. She made her solo debut on November 29, 2010, with the single album "Twenty-Two". Heebon is better known for her roles in series such as Bubble Gum, Family, Secret Boutique, and more of a lot of famous series and movies. On June 16, 2016, Heebon and director Yoon Se Young got married in a private wedding at the Myeongdong Cathedral in Seoul.
Park Heejung (박희정) is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Top 10 Student and Stars Awakening.
Park Hayi (박하이; Park Hi) is a South Korean soloist and actress under Taein Entertainment. She ranked #51 in Episode 8 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated.
Park Hye Won (박혜원) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl rock band SHOT GIRL.
Park Hyekyung is a South Korean singer and actor. She first debuted in the co-ed band THETHE as the first Vocalist in 1997, but she left it in 1999. She also made her solo debut in 1999.
Park Hyolim is a South Korean trainee. She is a member of the upcoming girl band WAYE:Z. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Park Hyowon (박효원) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Park Hyun Ju (박현주) is a South Korean singer, violinist and model. She was a member of the girl group A.SOME.
Park Ji Yoon is a South Korean singer under Parkjiyoon Creative. She debuted as a singer in 1997 with her self-titled studio album.
Jieun (지은) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Various. She left the group in 2017. She’s now a solo artist under the name Park Ji Eun.

Park Jin-Joo (박진주) is a South Korean actress under Prain TPC. She made her acting debut in the hit 2011 film Sunny. She is a member of the project girl group WSG Wannabe, WSG Wannabe (OASISO) and JUJU SECRET.
Park Jinhyun (박진현) is a South Korean trainee under ESteem. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Park Jung Ah (박정아) is a South Korean singer and actress. She debuted in 2001 as the leader and main vocalist for Jewelry but left the group in 2009 to pursue a solo career. She released her solo debut album, Yeah, in 2006,
Park Ki Young is a South Korean singer-songwriter who debuted in the music industry with the title song from her first album One in 1998.
Park Kyunghyun (박경현) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Park Mi Kyung is a South Korean singer under SidusHQ. She made her debut in the music industry in 1985 by winning the encouragement award at the 6th Gangbyeon Music Festival with "Dandelion Hole". She is a member of the project girl group Golden Girls.
Park Min Hye is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the disbanded group Big Mama and its sub-unit Big Mama Soul. She debuted as a soloist with her first album “You & I” in 2014.
Park Min Jeong is a South Korean YouTuber, content creator, BJ and model. She is a member of the upcoming girl group OSDS.

Park Minyoung (박민영) is a South Korean Independent singer and songwriter. She made her solo debut on March 22, 2023 with the digital single ’말하지 않아도’. She was also known for being a pre-debut member of the YOURS project under Deep Studio Entertainment.

Park Moonchi (박문치) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under Magic Strawberry Sound. She is a member of the project girl group CSVC. She debuted as a soloist on August 23, 2017, under real name Park Bomin (박보민), with the digital single, "My Boo". She changed her stage name to Park Moonchi (박문치) later.

Park Najin is a South Korean singer under MS Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group Jjarimongttang. She left the group before debut for personal reasons. After leaving the group, she did busking activities in Hongdae, Seoul, promoting with Park Najin Band. She was a contestant on K-Pop Star 3. She made her solo debut on August 16, 2021 with the single album "Restart Again".
Park Nakyung (박나경) is a South Korean singer and songwriter. She was a contestant on Star Awakening. She appeared on season 8 of I Can See Your Voice
Park Rossi (박로시) is a South Korean singer under LSA entertainment. Rossi made her solo debut on February 20th, 2023 with the single "Gossip".

Park Rossi is a South Korean singer and dancer under LSA Entertainment. She was a temporary member and Dancer of the South Korean girl groups FlyWithMe and their dance sub-unit Flora under the stage name Ella under FA Entertainment and the Leader and Dancer of Another Level (formerly NEWRED) under the stage name Rossi under ROADLIGHT Entertainment. On June 27, 2018, she debuted as a temporary member of FlyWithMe with the release of their first digital single, "Your Face". She left the group on December 31, 2020, and joined the girl group Another Level under the new stage name Rossi. Another Level disbanded unofficially between March 2021 and March 2022. She later made her solo debut on February 20, 2023, with the single “Gossip“, under the new stage name Park Rossi.
Park Se Jin is a South Korean singer, melodica player, and xylophonist. She is a member of the female duo OKDAL.

Park Seeun (박세은) is a South Korean singer under ReS Entertainment. She debuted on February 17, 2016 with the digital single album Foxy under the stage name Seni. She originally debuted under the stage name Seni. After four years in hiatus, she returned to the music scene under her birth name.
Park Semi, formerly known as Yoon Jinsol, is a South Korean actress and singer under Zigu Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group Jewelry from 2010 until the group's disbandment in 2015.

Park Seoa, also known as Seoah or Seoa, is a South Korean singer, YouTuber, and streamer. She is a former member of the girl groups Flying Girls and Brave Girls. Seoa debuted as a member of Flying Girls under the stage name Jisoo on July 21, 2009, with their first mini album Girl's Hot. The group presumably disbanded the same year due to inactivity. She later debuted with Brave Girls on April 8, 2011, with their single album The Difference. In 2013, she, along with Eunyoung and Yejin, did not participate in Brave Girls' digital single For You. On February 3, 2016, it was confirmed that the three members had officially left the group. After leaving Brave Girls, Seoa worked as a model and launched her YouTube channel, "Park Seoa TV," in January 2019. As of April 2020, she has also been active as a streamer on AfreecaTV.
Park Seoha (박서하) is a South Korean singer. She was a former member of the kid girl group CoCo under Fancy Factory.
Park Seohee (박서희) is a South Korean trainee. She participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Park Seojeong (박서정) (born in 2004), also known as Seojeong (서정), is a South Korean singer. She is a contestant on Girls On Fire.

Park Seojin, formerly known as Caramel, is a South Korean model, actress, influencer and retired singer signed under Contrebande. She is a former member of the girl group Pink Heart. She is also known for being the winner of Mnet's modeling contest I Am A Model Season 4.
Park Seoyoon (박서윤) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.
Park SeoYoung is a South Korean singer, actor and influencer. She had her music debut with the single "Repeat".
Park Seung Yeon (박승연), formerly known as Dan-A (단아), is a South Korean actress, singer and rapper under Awesome ENT. She is a former member of the girl group MATILDA.
Park So Hee is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group The Barberettes. She left the group in 2018.
Park So Ri (박소리) is a South Korean singer and actress. She is a former member of the disbanded Korean Pop girl group Baby V.O.X Re.V. She joined the group in 2008.

Soeun is a South Korean singer and dancer under IST Entertainment. She is the Main Dancer and Lead Vocalist of the girl group Weeekly. In October 2017, she became a contestant on the survival show MIXNINE, where she would represent FAVE Entertainment. She was eliminated in episode 7 after ranking 55th place. She made her debut as a member of Weeekly on June 30, 2020. In 2023, Soeun was a constant of the Mnet's survival show "Queendom Puzzle", she was eliminated after ranking 23rd.
Park Sohyoun (박소현), also known as So Hyoun (구슬현), is a South Korean singer and pianist. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire.

Park Soo-ah, formerly recognized as Lizzy, is a South Korean actress and singer under BK Entertainment. She is a member of the sub-group Orange Caramel and a former member of AFTER SCHOOL from Pledis Entertainment. In 2009, Before Park Soo-ah's debut in AFTER SCHOOL, she served as a backup dancer for Son Dam-bi on MBC's Gayo Daejun. Park officially debuted as a member on March 25, 2010, in the third single release, "BANG!". In June 2010, Park Soo-ah and fellow members Nana and Raina assembled the sub-group Orange Caramel, releasing the single "Magic Girl" showing a bubbly-charming image. Park Soo-ah made her solo debut on January 23, 2015, with the trot album "Not an Easy Girl". On May 1, 2018, Park "graduated" from AFTER SCHOOL following the expiration of her contract with Pledis Entertainment to pursue various careers. In October 2022, Park signed with BK Entertainment.
Park Soo-Jin (박수진), is a South Korean singer, actress, and model. She was a member of the South Korean K-pop girl group, Sugar, signed under SM Entertainment.

Park Soyeon is a South Korean singer under Gachi Entertainment. She ranked #18 on the finale of Produce 101 Season 1 and was unable to make it into I.O.I. On November 30, 2020 Soyeon debuted with the single "Flower".
Park Soyoon (박소윤) is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.
Park Soyu (박소유) is a South Korean singer-songwriter, and producer. On November 7 2012, she debuted with the album "Lonely Planet”.

Park Su Bin (박수빈; formerly known as U.Bin) is a South Korean trainee currently under ON1 Entertainment. She is a member of the trainee group ON1 Rookies and a former member of the kid group U.SSO Girl.
Park Sua is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing on Under 15.
Park Subin is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.
Park Sui, formerly known as Hanbi, is a South Korean singer and actress. She was previously a member of the girl group TURAN.
Park Suji, formerly known as Candy, is a South Korean retired singer. She is a former member of the girl group Pink Heart.

Park Sun (박선) is a South Korean actress currently under King Kong by Starship. She was a member of the trainee team STARSHIPZ. She was first known for appearing on the survival program "Idol School". On October 2021, King Kong by Starship posted a new profile for Park Sun, revealing that she would be continuing an acting career.

Park Xiyeon (formely just known as Xiyeon) is a South Korean actress, singer-songwriter, composer and rapper currently under Saero Actors. She is a former member of the girl group PRISTIN. She was a contestant on the reality survival show, Produce 101, but was eliminated after ranking 25th place.

Park Yeeun is a South Korean trainee under High Up Entertainment. She is a member of the agency's upcoming girl group, UNCHILD, which will debut in November 2025. From April to May 2024, Park Yeeun was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she was eliminated in episode 7. At that time, she was a trainee under WAKEONE.
Park Yeeun (박예은) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group CLEO. She made her solo debut on January 22, 2013 with the digital single "그놈의 사랑".

Park Yehyeon (박예현) is a South Korean trainee, actress and model under Woollim Entertainment who is best knwon for taking part in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.
Park Yuri (박유리) is a South Korean trainee under OUI Entertainment. She is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Paxy (팍시) is a South Korean singer who debuted on November 8, 2014 with the single album Loneliness.

Son Jung Ae, now better recognized as Haedam, and known by her promotional name Peach, is a South Korean singer, model, and beauty pageant judge. She is a former member of CHI CHI, after leaving the group and presumably the entertainment industry entirely on December 12, 2011.
Penny is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group S.Blush.
Pesi (페시) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group EVAS.

femaleIdols.description: Pharita Chaikong is a Thai singer under YG Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group BABYMONSTER. On February 29, 2020, Pharita was introduced as a contestant (GI3218) of the Thai survival show "Idol Paradise" under the stage name Bear. She left the show somewhere that same year, before it officially started airing. On February 1 2023, Pharita was revealed as the sixth member of BABYMONSTER. The group officially debuted on March 31, 2024, with their mini album "BABYMONS7ER".
PiA (피아) is an South Korean singer. She made her solo debut on 2022 with the single, "Boy, I Want". She is also a former member of the project group D-art.
Pia is an Australian-Japanese-Thai singer under O21. She is a member of the Japanese girl group Ettone. She is known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket.
Pichu is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Pichu, formerly known as Eunbyeol, is a South Korean BJ and former singer. She is a former member of ACE and cancelled girl groups Milky Way, Twinkle and Just COLOR.

Pin-A is a South Korean singer, cheerleader and YouTuber. She was a former member of the pre-debut girl group Just COLOR. She is also known for being a former Best of the Best contestant and is currently a contestant in the jihadol survival program Girls Frontier.
Pinn is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Label Bada. She made her debut on January 30, 2021 with the digital single "Escape".
PPOYO is a South Korean idol and composer. She is an original member of the live idol group LuciDreaM and a member of the live idol unit O:N.
Prael (프라엘) is a South Korean singer under LPA Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group HOLICS.
prettylittleiris, formerly known as Iris (아이리스), is an Korean-Canadian independent singer-songwriter and composer. She made her solo debut on December 15, 2017 with the digital single "Me Too".

femaleIdols.description: Prim (พริม) is a Thai singer under 411 Entertainment. She is a member of the Thai-Korean girl group AR3NA.
Priyanka is an Indian singer under Zenith Media Contents. She is the main vocalist of the international girl group Z-Girls and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.
Puer Kim (퓨어킴) is an independent singer-songwriter and lyricist.
Puleundal (푸른달) is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted on March 13, 2020 with the digital single album "비가 왔음 좋겠어".
Punch is a South Korean singer under Naym Naym Entertainment. She is best known for her OSTs for various TV series like "Descendants of the Sun" and "Goblin."
Pup is a South Korean rapper signed with Secretly Canadian. She made her debut in 2017.

Pureum is a South Korean singer signed with PR Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group BaBa and was formerly the leader of another group called Leader’S, which had two subgroups Leader’S N and Leader’S T. She also made a solo debut on February 15, 2013, under Traum Entertainment with the digital single, "Gift".
Pureum (푸름) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Cupid. She joined the group in 2016, but left the shortly after when Cupid moved from IN Entertainment to Narda Entertainment.
Pxarx Kid (펄키드) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Dob music in 2016.
Pyeon Ji (편지) is a South Korean singer. She was the leader and main vocalist of the girl group BP POP before the group's disbandment. Her father is a famous trot singer, Pyun Seung Yup.
Qiu Yuting (치우유팅) is a Chinese singer. She is a contestant on the upcoming survival show Find Rookie.

Qri is a South Korean Singer and Actress and best known as a member of Girlgroup T-ARA and sub-unit T-ARA QBS. She debuted as a member of T-ARA on July 23, 2009 with the single "Lie". Her contract with MBK Entertainment ended in December 2017 and fellow member Hyo Min announced on her Instagram account that Qri, Eun Jung, Ji Yeon and herself would leave the company. She is now focused on her Career as an Actress.
Qrin is a Chinese trainee. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar. She is the twin sister of Arin.
Queen, also known as Quin, is a Vietnamese rapper under Zenith Media Contents. She is the main rapper of the international girl group Z-Girls and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.
Queen Wasabii, stylized as Queen Wa$abii, is a South Korean singer and rapper, whose real name is Kim So-hee. She is affiliated with PI Corporation and made her independent debut in 2019.
Queena (퀴나) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group T.T.Ma. She is the sister of Lee Joo Hye (이주혜).
Quinsha (퀸샤) is a South Korean singer. She made her debut on November 18, 2019, with “Summer Night”.
Qura (큐라) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Aurora and girl duo Maronie Girls as Joomi (주미).

Ra Mi Ran (라미란), is a South Korean actress and singer under C-JeS Entertainment. She was a member that is part of project girl group Unnies. She officially debuted as a girl group member on July 1, 2016 as a part of the show Sister's Slam Dunk.
Ra.L (라엘) is a South Korean singer and songwriter under RaomMusiq. She debuted in 2010 with the album God Is Able.

Rachel is a singer under RBW. She is a former member of the girl group April. She made her debut with APRIL in 2016 with Chaekyung after DSP Media announced on November 11, 2016 the departure of Hyunjoo. Rachel and Chaekyung officially joined APRIL on January 4, 2017 with the group's third mini album " Prelude ". Rachel also lived in Portland, Oregon, USA for 4 years. On January 28, 2022, DSP Media announced that April has decided to disband after 6 years and go their separate ways.
Rachel (라헬) is a South Korean rapper and singer. She is a former member of the girl group A.De.
RaHee (라회) is a South Korea singer, actress and pilates instructor. She was a member of the girl group BEBEHEAL.
Rahee is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Aila.
Lahee (라희) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group LPG and the sub-unit Chaness. She was a 3rd-generation member. She joined the group in 2013 and left in 2015.
Rahee is a South Korean singer under Hi-Hat Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group ifeye.
Rahel (라헬) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group YPDA. She left the group in 2018, shortly after debut.
Rahye is a South Korean singer and dancer under S Media Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group LAYSHA. She joined the group on March 30, 2023. She left the group on September 11, 2023.
Rai (라이) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group ANDS. She joined the group in 2015, after Bosun’s departure.
Rain, born Kim Kyunghee, is a South Korean singer and former member of the girl group Ureka under HY Company.

Raina is a South Korean singer under Chapter M. She is a former member of the girl group After School and its sub-units A.S. BLUE and Orange Caramel. She made her solo debut on October 8, 2014, with the digital single "Reset". On September 3, 2020, Raina was announced as a participant in the MBN variety show Miss Back, which will follow "a group of female singers who made their debut in idol groups but are slowly being forgotten in the minds of the public." The show is slated to premiere sometime in October.
Rainie is a Taiwanese singer signed with AO Entertainment. She is a part of the girl group PRIMROSE. Before this, she used to be in another girl group bugAboo.

Rakiyah (라카이야) is an American singer who debuted in Korea with the digital single “Like You” on October 23, 2020. She had previously announced her debut on October 19 through her social media accounts. She has a background in Industrial & Aerospace Engineering, which she studied in America. She moved to Seoul, South Korea in 2017 and spent two years as an exchange student at Hanyang University.

Jeon Wooram (전우람), also known as Rami, Rami Nu or RAMI NU (sometimes stylized as RAMI NU), is a South Korean singer and songwriter who was formerly a member of the girl group D-UNIT and the indie co-ed band as the lead vocalist Five Run Strike/SKIREN. Rei, born Naoi Rei on February 3, 2004, in Nagoya, Japan, is a Japanese singer and rapper best known as a member of the K-pop girl group IVE under Starship Entertainment. As the first Japanese idol to debut under Starship, Rei stands out not only for her talent but also for her fluency in Korean, which earned her the affectionate nickname "Kim Rei" from her fellow members. She moved to South Korea at the age of 14 to pursue her dream, attending the prestigious School of Performing Arts Seoul (SOPA) and later enrolling in Chung-Ang University to study Theater and Film. Rei is known for her duality—soft and adorable off-stage, yet bold and confident when performing. Her visuals often draw comparisons to anime characters, and her expressive style has made her a Gen Z fashion icon. Whether she’s delivering sharp rap verses or charming fans with her mochi-like cheeks, Rei continues to captivate audiences with her blend of elegance, edge, and authenticity.

Kim Geunah, better known as RoA, is a South Korean singer under Shinwha Entertainment. She is a member of the pre-debut girl group NEXTU.

Lee Da-in, known under her stage name Rora, is a South Korean singer and dancer under YG Entertainment. Rosanna is a South Korean singer under PJ Entertainment. She made her solo debut on May 31, 2021, with the digital single "Love Yourself".
Rose, formerly known as Sohui, is a South Korean singer under UNITIVE, member of the girl group Rabbit or Fox. She was a member of the girl group Coupsis, which is still active.

Rosé (born Roseanne Park) is a South Korean-New Zealand singer, songwriter, and global music icon, best known as the main vocalist and lead dancer of the internationally renowned girl group BLACKPINK. Raised in Melbourne after being born in Auckland, Rosé began her path in music after passing a YG Entertainment audition in Australia in 2012, leading to her eventual move to Seoul and four years of intensive training. She officially debuted with BLACKPINK on August 8, 2016, under YG Entertainment, contributing to the group’s massive global success. Early in her career, she was featured on G-Dragon’s track "Without You", marking her first major collaboration and public recognition within the kpop scene. Rosé launched her solo career with the single album "-R-", released on March 12, 2021. Its lead single, "On the Ground", broke several records, making her the first artist to top the Billboard Global 200 as both a soloist and a group member. She also became the first Korean female soloist to enter the UK Singles Chart, setting a new standard for kpop solo debuts. In 2024, Rosé signed with The Black Label and Atlantic Records, continuing her activities with BLACKPINK while expanding her solo portfolio. That same year, she collaborated with Bruno Mars on the surprise single "APT.", which shattered viewership records and topped charts globally. The track became the fastest kpop solo music video to hit 300 million views and earned over 200 perfect all-kills in South Korea’s charts. Her debut full-length album "Rosie" followed, making her the highest-charting Korean female soloist in both the US and UK. Outside of music, Rosé is recognized for her influence in fashion and pop culture. She serves as a global ambassador for Yves Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co., and was named one of Time magazine’s 100 Most Influential People in 2025. She is also featured in Rolling Stone’s list of living icons from Australia and New Zealand, solidifying her status as a defining figure in modern music and entertainment.

Rose is a South Korean singer and vocal trainer under Music Recipe. She is a former member of HF Music Company's pre-debut girl group Happyface Girls. She debuted on December 16, 2022 with the OST "Hold My Breath".

Rosy, formerly known as Rozi is a South Korean singer, and a former member of the girl group BADKIZ. She joined the group in 2020.
Rosy Barbie (로지 바비), is a South Korean rapper who debuted under C.P.U in 2022.

Rothy is a South Korean solo singer currently under Dorothy Company. She released two pre-debut tracks before making her official debut on August 30, 2018 with her mini album, "Shape of Rothy". Seunghee is a South Korean singer and actress under WM Entertainment. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group OH MY GIRL, which debuted on April 21, 2015, with the mini album "Oh My Girl." Prior to debut, Seunghee was active in several national singing competitions, gaining early recognition for her vocal talent. She appeared on Korea Sings in 2007 and Superstar K2 in 2010, where she advanced to Super Week. Her strong vocals earned her the nickname "Little BoA" after a standout appearance on Star King. She trained under Brave Entertainment before joining WM Entertainment in 2014, where she also contributed backing vocals to Sunmi’s track "Full Moon." Seunghee began her acting career in 2015 with a role in the web drama Loss:Time:Life. In July 2016, she competed in Girl Spirit, a vocal survival show that aimed to showcase underrated vocalists from lesser-known girl groups. In 2019, she joined King of Mask Singer under the alias “Zoo,” once again highlighting her vocal range and skill. From 2020 onward, Seunghee expanded into variety and hosting. She starred in the sports-themed variety program Not Soccer or Baseball alongside athletes Park Chan-ho and Lee Young-pyo. In 2021, she co-hosted the relationship and lifestyle reality show Friends, appearing with Kim Hee-chul, Shindong, and Lee Sang-min. Beyond entertainment, Seunghee has been active in philanthropy. In December 2022, she donated 20 million KRW to the Korea Childhood Cancer Foundation through the Million Angels Sharing initiative, contributing to the treatment and care of children with cancer.

On December 11, 2020, she won the "Best New Actor/Actress" award at the 2020 Grimae Awards for her role in the drama "Woman of 9.9 Billion". Park Shin-Hye is a renowned South Korean actress, singer and model, celebrated for her versatility and captivating performances in both the television dramas and films. She first gained recognition as a child actress in the popular drama Stairway to Heaven (2003), where she played as the younger version of Choi Ji-woo's character, Han Jung-Seo. Over the years, Park Shin-Hye has solidified her status as one of the leading actresses in the Korean entertainment industry, starring in hit dramas such as You're Beautiful (2009), The Heirs (2013), Pinocchio (2014) and Doctors (2016). She is currently signed with SALT Entertainment, a South Korean entertainment agency that manages her career, including her acting projects and other professional activities. Beyond her acting career, Park Shin-Hye is also known for her philanthropic work, particularly her involvement in various charitable organizations and causes. In her personal life, she married to Choi Tae Joon, a fellow South Korean actor. The couple began dating in late 2017 and went public with their relationship in March 2018. They got married on January 22, 2022, in a private ceremony attended by close friends and family. The couple welcomed their first child, a son, in May 2022.
