Shinyoung is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a former member of the girl group G-reyish.
Shinyujinssi (신유진씨), born Shin Yu-jin (신유진) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Gongyi Ilyuk in 2019.

ShiOn is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the girl group tripleS and its sub-units NXT, Hatchi!, Alphie, and Moon. ShiOn was introduced as the twentieth member of the girl group tripleS on December 24, 2023. She first released the single "Just Do It" as part of the sub-unit NXT, before officially debuting with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".
Shion is a Japanese trainee under Moai Entertainment. She is the maknae of the upcoming girl group E11iVyn.
Shirayuki (시라유키) also known as Baixue (바이슈에), is a Chinese-Japanese singer She was a member of the girl group Circle.

Shirayuki Hina is a South Korean V-Tuber and singer under Accelers. She is a member of the South Korean VTuber group StelLive and part of the subunit: 2nd Generation 'Universe'. She debuted as a soloist on September 11, 2024 with the digital single ''Catch the Summer''. Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be January 5.
Shirley is a Chinese singer. She was a member of the girl group Ilips.

Shiroko, also known as X:Ne and formerly known as Haruno Shine in the group Lumina, is a Japanese singer and V-Tuber under Orvit Entertainment. She made her singing debut with a collaboration song, Epilogue (Feat. Cha Jin Hyuk), on October 5, 2024. In November, she debuted in the virtual group Lumina until it disbanded on April 13, 2025.

Shiroma Miru (시로마 미루) is a Japanese singer under Universal Music Japan. She was a member of NMB48's Team M and the leader of Mix Juice. She graduated on August 31, 2021 She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 20th place. On July 6 2022, she made her debut solo with the single "Shine Bright". On May 26, 2023, Miru was confirmed as a constant of Mnet's newest survival show, "Queendom Puzzle". The show began airing on June 13, but Miru was eliminated in the semi-final, her final rank being 17th.
Shitao Miu is a Japanese singer, member of AKB48's Team A. She was a contestant on Produce 48 where she finished in 18th place.

Shizuku is a Japanese singer under LAPONE Entertainment, In 2023, she participated in the survival show "Produce 101 Japan: The Girls" where she ended up ranking 7th place, securing her spot as a member of the Japanese project girl group ME:I.

Shoo was a member of SES. She remained under SM Entertainment until 2006, and then signed with JIIN Entertainment. She started her solo career with the mini album "Devote One's Love". She is married to a basketball player Im Hyo Sung. The wedding took place on April 11 2010.
Shu, formely known as Datoni is a South Korean dancer, singer and model under LA Entertainment, member of the girl groups Honey Bees and VIVID. She is also a member of SISTERS.
Shu A is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl band Pritz.

ShuHua is a Taiwanese singer and model under Cube Entertainment. She is the visual and maknae of the girl group i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE. Before debuting as an idol under Cube, she worked as a model. Shuhua debuted as a member of (G)I-DLE on May 2, 2018, with their mini-album "I Am" and the title song "LATATA". On February 8, 2024, CUBE Entertainment announced that Shuhua would take a break from activities due to health issues, but she resumed activities on March 21, 2024.
Shuie is a Chinese Singer under iNKODE. On July 10, 2025, she was revealed as a new member of the girl group SAY MY NAME.
Shuma (슈마) is a South Korean cosplayer and singer. She is a contestant on Girls Frontier.
SHUROSE is a South Korean singer who debuted on September 27, 2019 with Secret.
SHUSHU9 is a South Korean singer who officially debuted on September 6, 2022 with the single Life Swimmer.
Shuya is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter and producer. She made her debut on April 19, 2018, with the digital single "Delusion".
Shuyun is a Taiwanese singer signed with TPOP Entertainment. She was a participant in the hit Korean survival show, Girls Planet 999 and the Taiwanese survival show NEXT GIRLZ.
Sia is a South Korean singer, dancer and DJ. She is a former member of the girl group LAYSHA and a former member of the dance group STRAW (formerly GIRL CRUSH) under the stage name Seihee.
Sia (시아) is a South Korean singer under Liz Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Chic Angel. She made her solo debut on March 9, 2020 with the single "Breath".
Sia (시아) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group TWEETY. She left the group in 2017.
Sia (시아), formerly known as Sowon (소원), is a South Korean trainee. She is a former pre-debut member of the girl groups Ndear and PoshGirls and a former member of AZM.
Sia (시아) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group New-A. She left the group in 2016.
Sia (시아) is a South Korean singer and dancer. She is a former member of performance girl group Bling.
Sia (시아) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group NTORE. She joined the group in August 2023 and graduated on October 17, 2023.

Sia Jiwoo, formerly known as simply Sia and also by her full name Park Jiwoo, is a South Korean singer, influencer and content creator under Just COLOR Studio and Starting House Entertainment. She was a former member of the cancelled trainee group Just COLOR. She made her solo debut debut on October 7, 2022 with the digital single "Do It My Own Way (D.I.M.O.W)". She is also known for being a former contestant on the competitive reality show, MIXNINE.

Sian is a South Korean singer, dancer and rapper under WM Entertainment. She was revealed as the first member of USPEER on April 3, 2025. She made her debut with the group on June 4, 2025, with the release of their first single album called "SPEED ZONE".
Sieun is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Alice White.
Sieun is a South Korean rapper. She is a former member of BarbieD.

Sieun is a South Korean singer from the predebut co-ed group CHECKMATE, under GRACE Company. She firstly debuted on UI Entertainment's girl group RAMISU (2017) that disbanded at the same year. She is also a former pre-debut contender for the supposed girl group Rendezvous from Parksal Company.

Sieun is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and actress currently under High Up Entertainment. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group STAYC Sieun is a former member of the trainee team i-Teen. Her father, Park Nam Jung, is a famous singer from the 80's. Sieun originally made her debut as a child actress in 2014 through the children's television series Pluto Secret Society. On September 8, 2020 she was first member of STAYC to be revealed. She debuted on November 12, 2020 with the group's first single album "Star To A Young Culture".

Sieun is a South Korean singer and dancer under AB Creative, member of the girl group ARTBEAT and the co-ed dance crew ARTBEAT. She joined the agency AB Creative in 2021 or earlier where she was active as a dancer in their dance group 'AB' (also called AB Project) and also as a soloist dance performer.
Sieun is a South Korean trainee under Sol Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group DAILY.

Sihyeon (Hangul: 시현) is a member of Rising Star Entertainment's 6-member Girl Group ARIAZ. She first appeared in the public through "Produce 101 Season 1" and "Mix Nine" before making her Official Debut on October 24th, 2019 with ARIAZ!

Kim Sihyeon is a South Korean singer, dancer, and actress under Yuehua Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group EVERGLOW. Sihyeon first gained recognition for her participation in the first season of MNET's hit survival show Produce 101, from which she was eliminated after ranking 40th place, and its third season, Produce 48, where she was eliminated after ranking 27th place this time. On February 18, it was announced that Sihyeon, along with her fellow trainee from Produce 48, Yiren, were selected as members of Yuehua Entertainment's new girl group called EVERGLOW. Concurrently, Stone Music Entertainment released a teaser video on their YouTube channel, introducing Sihyeon as the inaugural member of the group. She made her debut with EVERGLOW on March 18, 2019 with the release of their first digital single "Arrival of Everglow", and its title song "Bon Bon Chocolat". On February 7, 2020, Sihyeon was announced as one of the new MC of SBS' The Show. She held that position until her last broadcast on February 2, 2021, when it was announced that she would be stepping down from her role. On April 12, 2024, it was reported that she would be debuting as an actress in the upcoming series called 'Salon de Holmes'.

Sihyeon (시현) is a South Korean singer and model. She was a member of the girl group Carcaro Girl. She has an older brother, Park Eunseok. She’s now a DJ under the stage name DJ Siena. She’s currently under Leanon Entertainment.
Sihyeon is a South Korean rapper and singer under A2Z Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group CSR.

Sihyun is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the Korean Pop girl group SPICA and their sub-unit SPICA.S. Born as Park Joo-hyun, she legally changed her name to Park Si-hyun, in October of 2014, a name she's been called since she's a child.
Sihyun is a South Korean singer under The Music Works Entertainment. She is a member of the project group AQUA.

Sihyun is a South Korean actress and singer. She is a former member of the girl group BADKIZ (formely known as HOT PLACE). On October 18, 2018, Sihyun was introduced as a new member of the girl group BADKIZ. On March 29, 2019, she debuted as a member of HOT PLACE with their first digital single album, "Hot Place". She left the group in February 2020.
Sijin (시진) is a South Korean singer and dancer under CP Sound. She is one half of the female duo Coda Bridge.
Sika (시카) is a South Korean singer and member of the girl group WAZE:Z.

Sika, currently better known as Lian Sijia, is a Japanese-Chinese singer. She is a former member of the Korean girl group FANATICS and is currently active in China as a member of the C-Pop girl group Summer Flower Girls which was formed through the idol reality show, Sounds Like Summer Flowers (声声如夏花).
Silly Silky, formerly known as YESEO until 2022, is a South Korean electronic producer and singer-songwriter. She debuted with her single 'Let It All Go' on July 26, 2016.
Eunhwa / Silver (은화) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Vanilla Lucy. She joined the band in January 2011 to replace Dahae.
Silver-G is a South Korean singer and songwriter who debuted on February 7, 2018 with the digital single album 젖은 눈사람.
Silverbell is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Coconut Music. She made her solo debut on January 30, 2018 with the EP Smile.
Sim Jamon is a South Korean streamer and singer. She was a contestant on Girls Frontier.
Simeez is a South Korean dancer, member of the dance groups La Chica and JUMMAMIA. She was a dance mentor for the Mnet survival show CAP-TEEN. She’s owns a shoes brand named SSIMEEZ.

Lee Simyeong (이시명) was the Lead Dancer, Sub Vocalist, and Visual of the Girl Group BVNDIT (Be Ambitious N Do It) under MNH Entertainment. Living by her motto "Live Flexibly", Simyeong does whatever it takes to express gratitude towards the people around her. She aims to be stronger and better for her group so that they could even reach #1 in a music show someday.
Sin Sumin (신수민) is a South Korean singer. She was formerly a member and the leader of the kid girl group CoCo under Fancy Factory.
Sin Ye Young (신예영) is a South Korean singer signed with CELEBIT. She released her first solo digital single called “Why Break Up?” on November 20, 2019.
Sin Yejin (신예진) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of Fancy Factory's kids girl group CoCo.
Sina (formerly known as Yeeun) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups Tahiti and Verry.
Sinae is a South Korean singer under Logi Entertainment.

SinB is a South Korean singer under Big Planet Made. She is a member of the girl group VIVIZ and a member of the girl group GFRIEND. She was born in Cheongju, South Korea, and has one older brother. She trained at Big Hit Entertainment along with Eunha for 5 years. She attended the School of Performing Arts Seoul and graduated in February 2017 along with Umji. She debuted as a member of GFriend with the EP Season of Glass on January 15, 2015. GFriend disbanded on May 22, 2021, after all members left Source Music upon the completion of their six-year contract. On October 6, 2021, it was announced that SinB, along with former GFRIEND members, Eunha and Umji, have signed a contract with BPM Entertainment to debut as a three-member group. She debuted as a member of VIVIZ on February 9, 2022, with the mini album Beam of Prism.
Since is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2020. She participated in Show Me The Money 9.

Sio is a South Korean singer under Massive E&C. She used to be a part of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY. The group officially made their debut with “The Fifty” released on November 18, 2022. She left the group with members Aran and Saena after the group's first comeback In a legal turn of events, FIFTY FIFTY initiated a lawsuit against Attrakt Creative Group on June 28, 2023, citing contract violations and damage to their reputation. Further developments on October 23 revealed that Attrakt had ended its exclusive contracts with group members Saena, Sio, and Aran as of October 19, 2023.
Sion (시온) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups AL and A.sia. Sion has not been active in media since the disbandment of A.sia.

Sion is a South Korean singer, model and pilates instructor. She is a former member of the girl groups SATURDAY and LIPBUBBLE. Originally debuting in 2017 with the group LIPBUBBLE, she left the group shortly after debuting. In 2018 she redebuted as the main vocalist of the girl group SATURDAY. However, she left in 2019.

Ryu Sion is a South Korean singer under HOMe. She is a member of the girl group Geenius and a former member of the trainee team Bebez. She is best known for participating in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999. She is the older sister of ADYA's Yeonsu.

Siren is a South Korean singer and songwriter. She is a part of Warner Music Korea. She made her debut with the single "LAKE" on December 10, 2020. On August 12, 2023, she came back with her Single "Betty".
Sirin (시린) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group ikling. She debuted as a soloist on November 10, 2017, with the single “환시(幻視)”.

siso is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Beautiful Noise. She made her solo debut on January 29, 2020 with the digital single "Dawn" under her birth name Ha Jin. She is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.

femaleIdols.description: Sitala is a Thai singer. She was a member of the girl group H1-KEY. She is the daughter of Thai actor Sarunyu Wongkrachang and has a twin sister. She debuted as a member of H1-KEY on January 5, 2022 with their first single "Athletic Girl". On May 25, 2022 GLG announced that Sitala decided to leave the group for personal reasons.
Siu: is a South Korean virtual idol under Metaverse Entertainment. She is a member of the virtual girl group MAVE:.
Siwoo was a South Korean former trainee. She is known for being a contestant in the competitive reality television show, Idol School.
Siwoo (시우) is a South Korean student, singer, and dancer. She is a member of the girl group Azer Blossom.
Siwoo (시우) is a trainee and cheerleader under Space Music Entertainment. She was a pre-debut member of trot group Yeowooya and kpop group Like Me.

Yeon Si Woo is a South Korean singer and actress. She is most known for starring in kdramas such as "Our Blues", "Hospital Playlist 2" and "Imitation". She has her own YouTube channel where she posts videos of herself singing covers of famous songs. Siwoo began her career as a pre-debut member of idle (formerly G-IDLE), but was promply kicked out without much of an explanation. She made her debut as an actress in 2021 and as a singer in 2023, with the single "Obsession". Her debut gained attention when Yuqi posted about it. Many netizens were moved by their friendship, and picked up on Jiwoo's lokalike visuals to Jisoo of BLACKPINK. In 2025 Jiwoo came back with her two single albums, "Rainy Day Reverie" and "Is this really how we end?"
Siya (시야) is a South Korean trainee. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group, IOLITE, which was set to debut in August 2022. For undisclosed reasons, the group was dissolved before debut.
Siyeon, formerly known as Heeil, is a South Korean BJ and singer. She is a member of the dance crew SOONIGROUP. She is a former member of the disbanded groups Aila, 4X, and HeyGirls.
Siyeon (시연) is a South Korean singer and member of the pre-debut girl group UNI.
Siyeon is a South Korean singer and child model under HR Entertainment. She is a member of the kids' girl group CooKie since May 2021.
Siyeon (시연) is a South Korean singer and BJ. She was member of the girl group Flying Girls.

Siyeon is a South Korean singer and dancer under Dreamcatcher Company. She first debuted on September 18, 2014 as a member of the girl group MINX with the digital single "Why Did You Come To My Home?". On November 29, 2016, it was announced that MINX would be rebranding as Dreamcatcher while keeping the five member from the original lineup. Siyeon redebuted with Dreamcatcher on January 13, 2017 with the release of the single "Nightmare". In October 2017, Siyeon participed on the YG survival show MIXNINE under her birth name, Lee Siyeon. However, she left the show on December 10 due to scheduling conflicts. Siyeon debuted as a soloist on January 29, 2020 with the digital single "Paradise". In April 2022 she started recording a song that will be featured in Dreamcatcher's second studio album, "Apocalypse: Save Us" which was released on April 12, 2022 called "Entrancing". Her latest work is actually her second digital single following "Paradise" which is called "Start Over" that was released on December 31, 2023.

Siyoon is a South Korean rapper, dancer, and singer under MYSTIC Story. She is a member of the girl group Billlie and its sub unit Moon Sua X Siyoon. In October 2019, alongside fellow member Tsuki, Siyoon participated in the third season of the Japanese magazine Popteen' survival show called 'Popteen Cover Girl War'. This made her a regular model for Popteen starting November 2019. She was a member of the trainee group Mystic Rookies, who later became Billlie, with whom she made her debut on November 10, 2021 with the release of the mini album "The Billage of Perception : Chapter One".

Cho Shi-Yoon (조시윤), best known by the stage name Siyoon (시윤), is a South Korean singer and actress. She was a member of the South Korean girl group, Puretty, under DSP Media. Siyoon and the group debuted on September 5th, 2012 with their single, "'(チェキ☆ラブ) Cheki Love" in Japan.
Siyoung (시영) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group WANNA.B.

Sleeq, born Kim Ryeong-hwa, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter under Daze Alive Music. She began her activities in 2011. She joined Daze Alive in 2013, when she released the pre-debut single album "Lightless" before debuting in 2014 with "Rap Tight".

Snowbaby (스노우베이비) is a Taiwanese YouTuber, influencer and actress. She is best known in South Korea as a former contestant on Mnet's reality survival show, Idol School. Snowbaby is half Taiwanese through her father, and mixed Uzbek and Tibetan through her mother.
Kim Kyoung-hee (김경희), better known by her stage name So Chan-whee (소찬휘), is a South Korean singer, best known for her 2000 song, "Tears".
So Yeop is a South Korean singer, member of the pre-debut girl group I.G. She is a former member of the girl group SHA SHA. She left the group on July 30, 2018.
So Yumi is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl groups VNT and Kiss&Cry. She made her solo debut on April 21, 2015 with the single "Shake Me Up".
So!Yoon! (stylized as So!YoON!) is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and musician under Magic Strawberry Sound. She is a member of the band Se So Neon.
Soa (소아) is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is a member and leader of the Korean pop girl group SIX BOMB and its sub-unit Soda Bomb.
Soa (소아) is a South Korean singer under Etromedia. She is a member of the female duo Thalia.
SOBAE is a Korean-American singer. She debuted on October 24, 2017 with the single "Switch Up". Before debuting she was a journalist.

Soee is a South Korean rapper and singer under WM Entertainment. She was revealed as the sixth member of USPEER on April 3, 2025. She made her debut with the group on June 4, 2025, with the release of their first single album called "SPEED ZONE".
Soeun (소은) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Various. She left the group in 2017.
Soeun, formerly known as Sowon, is a South Korean singer under Gleamedia. She is member of the girl group tracer.
Bang So-eun, better know as SoEun, is a South Korean singer and rapper under and PI Corporation. She is the Lead Rapper and Sub Vocalist of the girl group TRI.BE.
SoEun is a South Korean singer under Richworld Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group HighSchool.

Soeun is a South Korean singer under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X. On May 21, 2025, it was revealed through the group’s official account that Wish changed her stage name to Soeun.
Soeun is a South Korean singer best known for being a member of girlgroup ABRY.
Soeun (소은) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HEXE. She joined the group after debut.
Soffee is a South Korean singer-songwriter who made her debut on January 29, 2021.
Sofy (소피) is a Russian trainee under Shinwha Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group GLX. She made her solo debut with “Заветное желание” on July 30, 2019.

sogak sogak is a South Korean singer-songwriter under INHEART MUSIC who debuted on July 17, 2015, with the digital single album "Popcorn Nam (팝콘남)". Her stage name “sogak sogak” derives from an expression of the sound made when writing in a diary with a pencil. It means that everyday stories are put into music, like a diary written with a pencil. On the 2nd of October 2018 she was revealed to be under INHEART MUSIC on their official Instagram.
Sogeum is a South Korean singer under Starpro Entertainment. She's a former member of the girl group HINT.

Kwon So-hee (권소희) also known as Sogumm (소금), is a South Korean singer who debuted independently in 2015. She was signed to Jay Park’s label AOMG, after winning AOMG’s hip-hop audition show “Signhere” in August of 2019, showcasing her producing skills and wide range of musical backgrounds. Sogumm has captured listeners’ hearts with her unique singing style and straight-forward, bold lyrics. She posted her songs on Soundcloud and gradually garnered a lot of attention, going on to collaborate with artists like DJ Wegun, dress and Hippie Was Gypsy. She dropped a collaborative album with dress, titled “Not My Fault” on September 27, 2019 under Highline Entertainment, with a handful of features by Punchnello, PENOMECO, Jay Park, CHE, Woo, Mokyo, JANE, Kim Ximya, Omega Sapien & HYUN SU. She went on to release “Sobrightttttttt” on October 21, 2019 under Balming Tiger. “Sobrightttttttt” showcased Sogumm’s essence of talents and personalities, making her one of the most recognized rookies in the South Korean R&B scene.

Soha is a South Korean singer, member of the girl groups Nekiru and To Hermitage. In June 2019, she took a break from the group to focus on solo activities. She returned to NEKIRU one year later, in June 2020.

Soha is a South Korean singer under iNKODE. She is a member of the girl group SAY MY NAME. Soha made her debut with SAY MY NAME on October 16, 2024 with the release of their first mini album "SAY MY NAME".

Soha is a South Korean singer and songwriter under BTC Entertainment who made her solo debut on December 15, 2022 with the EP "Sweet & Sour". She was a member of the girl group White Witch. She is a vocalist for the virtual girl group Eternity and the virtual soloist Aimy Moon. She was a contestant on Burn Up 30.
Sohee (소희) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Peernine. Before joining Peernine, she was active as a vocalist singer featured in CMs.

Sohee was a South Korean singer, actress, and model managed by IOK Company. She first gained attention by placing second on KPOP Star 6. She debuted as the main vocalist, lead dancer, and face of the girl group ALICE (formerly known as Elris). During her early career, Sohee was highly anticipated to be her generation's "IT girl." On October 18, 2018, she released her first solo digital single, "Hurry Up". On April 26, 2024, Sohee announced her engagement to a non-celebrity businessman, who is 15 years her senior, after dating for a year. With her marriage announcement, she also declared her retirement from the entertainment industry. Her contract with IOK Company was set to expire around the same time, marking the end of her career with ALICE and in K-pop.
An So Hee (or simply as Sohee) is a South Korean actress and singer currently under BH Entertainment. She was a former member of the girl group Wonder Girls.

Sohee (Korean: 소희; Japanese: ソヒ) is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Rocket Punch. In 2018, she participated in Mnet's survival show Produce 48. She was eliminated in the episode 8 after ranking 43rd place. On July 23, 2019, Woollim Entertainment released a concept film showing the six members of their new girl group, Rocket Punch, for the first time, with Sohee being one of them. On July 26, her solo concept film was released. She debuted as a member of Rocket Punch on August 7, 2019 with the mini album Pink Punch.

Sohee is a South Korean singer formelybunder KM Entertainment. She made her official debut on September 8, 2021, as a member of the girl group ICHILLIN'. On July 15th, 2022, KM Entertainment announced that Sohee would be leaving ICHILLIN' after discussing her future career.
Sohee is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group SIOSIJAK.

Kim Sohee is a South Korean singer and actress under n.CH Entertainment, member of the girl duo Atlantis Kisune. She gained prominence through her participation in the popular television competition, Produce 101, in 2016. Following her appearance on the show, she became a member of several project groups, including C.I.V.A, I.B.I, and Girls Next Door. After these groups disbanded, Sohee embarked on a solo career, releasing her debut mini-album titled “The Filette” in 2017. On the 8th of October, 2019, she entered into an exclusive agreement with n.CH Entertainment. Subsequently, it was revealed that she would become a member of the girl group NATURE.
Sohee (소희) os a South Korean singer and cheerleader, member of the girl duo Chumchurum. She joined the group in November 2019. She is a member of KOVO, a professional Volleyball cheerleading team.
Sohlhee (솔희 ), born Kim Sohl-hee (김솔희) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under All I Know Music in 2019.
Sohn Yerim is a South Korean singer under New Order Entertainment who debuted on January 5, 2020 with Problem.
Sohn Yujin (손유진) is a South Korean singer. She was a contestant on Girls On Fire.

Sohyang is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musical theatre actress under KQ Entertainment. Widely recognized for her powerful vocal range and emotive performances, she debuted in 1996 with the CCM single "Mr." and has since become acclaimed both domestically and internationally. Known as the “Korean Mariah Carey” for her technical skill and expansive vocal range, Sohyang has appeared on popular television programs such as Immortal Songs 2 and King of Mask Singer. Beyond her solo work, she has performed in musicals, collaborated with various artists, and contributed to drama soundtracks. She is celebrated as one of Korea’s most iconic vocalists.
Sohyeon is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo YDS.

SoHyun is a South Korean singer, dancer, rapper, songwriter and producer under MODHAUS. From 2020 to 2022, SoHyun uploaded songs on Soundcloud. She debuted as a soloist on December 14, 2021, with the digital single "20". She was known by multiple aliases, like Han Gaeul, hene, and Autumn Han. SoHyun was introduced as the fourteenth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on April 14, 2023. She first debuted with the sub-unit LOVElution on August 17, 2023 with the mini album "ↀ (MUHAN)". SoHyun then made her debut with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24". As a member of tripleS, SoHyun was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Visionary Vision, and Moon.
Sohyun is a South Korean pop singer and actress. She was a sub-vocalist for 4minute. Before debuting with 4minute she had minor roles in various dramas and was a member of the child group Orange.
Sohyun is a South Korean bassist, member of the girl band Pride Band. As one of the original members, Sohyun was named the new leader after Hyein, Bomi and Yeonhee’s departure.
Soi is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2022.
Soii (이소이) is an independent South Korean singer-songwriter and composer. She made her solo debut on April 13, 2021 with the digital single "This Night Doesn't Miss Us".

Park Sojin popularly known as Sojin is a South Korean singer and actress under Noon Company. She is best known for being the Leader and Lead Vocalist of the South Korean pop girl group Girl's Day under DreamT Entertainment. Before debuting, Sojin used to be a vocal trainer for the K-pop boy band Ulala Session. Sojin debuted in the South Korean pop girl group Girl's Day under DreamT Entertainment as an original member and Leader and Lead Vocalist with their debut single "갸우뚱 (Tilt My Head)" on the 7th of July 2010. On the 17th of June 2017, an industry source reported that Sojin and Eddy Kim had been dating for two months. The next day, DreamT Entertainment confirmed the reports, clarifying that initially denied the rumors because they wanted to protect one another. On the 27th of December 2017, DreamT Entertainment revealed that the couple had broken up, but did not reveal the reason for it. On the 11th of January 2019, DreamT Entertainment announced that Sojin would be leaving the agency after deciding not to renew her contract which expires in February. On the 19th of March 2019, Sojin signed up with Noon Company to launch her career as an actress but emphasized that she is taking a break from group activities but she is still part of Girl's Day. On the 6th of October 2023, an industry source reported that Sojin and actor Lee Dong-ha would be getting married in November. The next day, both of their agencies confirmed the reports. It was then later announced that the wedding would be held privately on November 18, 2023.

femaleIdols.description: Sorn is a Thai singer and YouTuber under Wild Entertainment Group. She is a former member of CLC, a South Korean girl group formed by Cube Entertainment on March 19th, 2015. She has her own show called Produsorn that aired on United Cube's Official YouTube channel. Her representative fruit in the group is Watermelon. She announced her departure from Cube Entertainment in November 2021. Sorn was 14 years old when she first started singing and 15 when she won the very first season of K-Pop Star Hunt in 2011. After her win, Cube Entertainment contacted her and wanted a contract with her. After discussing it with her parents, she decided to take time off to focus on her studies, and then in 2013, she moved to Korea from her home country of Thailand to become a Cube trainee. She debuted as a member of CLC on March 19, 2015, with the group's first mini album First Love. In 2017, Sorn began campaigning for fair royalty payments for foreign musicians based in South Korea. In a Facebook live interview, she revealed that she was being paid six times less than her Korean members, but also acknowledged that her agency tried to help the situation. In an Instagram story posted in 2019, Sorn stated that the issue had been resolved with the Federation of Korean Music Performers (FKMP). She made her official solo debut with the digital single "Run" on March 23, 2021. On November 16, 2021, it was announced that Sorn had officially left CLC and Cube Entertainment as her contract with the agency was terminated in a mutual agreement between both parties. On December 3, Sorn announced that she had signed with Wild Entertainment Group as a solo artist. She released the single "Sharp Objects" on February 25, 2022.

Soseo, formerly known as SHUUU, is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She was a member of the girl group Unicorn under the stage name Sally until their disbandment in September 2017. In 2018, she announced that she would be changing her stage name into Lily Pink. In May 2021, she changed her stage name into SHUUU and made her official solo debut with the digital single "Candy." On May 31, 2022, she changed her stage name again to Soseo.
Soseom is an independent singer-songwriter. She made her solo debut on April 20, 2021, with the digital single "Cool Off". She was a contestant on Star Awakening.
Soseon is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group SongCryGirlz. She left the group in 2012.
Soso is a Taiwanese singer under True Fun Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group GWSN.

Soul:A formelly known as Leni and Kim Ahyun is a South Korean singer under Ecube Media. She ranked #82 in Episode 5 of Produce 101 Season 1 and was eliminated. Before Produce 101, Seol:A was a contestant on Super Star K 6.
Lee Sowun (이소운) is a Drummer and former member of South Korean band Clinah (disbanded in 2012)under Dino Entertainment. Since the band broke up, it is not known what is happening to her.

Sowon, born Kim So-jung, is a South Korean singer and rapper. She is the leader, vocalist, and rapper of GFRIEND, which is under Source Music. She debuted as the leader of GFRIEND on January 15, 2015, with the EP Season of Glass. GFRIEND disbanded on May 22, 2021, after all members left Source Music following the completion of their six-year contract. On August 2, 2021, it was announced that Sowon had signed with IOK Company as an actress, using her birth name. She left IOK Company on September 1, 2022. On November 15, 2022, it was announced that Sowon had signed with OUI Entertainment as an actress, and would be using the stage name Kim Sowon.
Soya is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the duo Soya n' Sun. She made her solo debut on November 16, 2010, with the single "Loving every day".
Ssoya (쏘야) is a South Korean singer under HANDMADE and KMG, member of the girl group POA.
Soye (소예) is a South Korean singer under an unrevealed agency. She is a member of the girl group January and a former member of the girl group Yellow Bee.
Soyeah is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group HEXE. She debuted solo on April 4, 2017 with the single "To.My Star".

Soyee (소이) is a South Korean singer and actress under Noah Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group gugudan. Before debuting, Soyee used to be a trainee under Cube and Plan A Entertainment. Soyee debuted as a member of gugudan on June 28, 2016, with their EP Act. 1 The Little Mermaid.

Soyeon is a South Korean singer and actress under Think Entertainment. She is a former member of T-ARA and its sub-unit QBS. Soyeon made her debut as a member of T-ara in July 2009 with the single "Lie". On September 25, 2013, it was announced that Soyeon had been dating Click-B member Oh Jonghyuk. On July 5, 2016, it was reported the couple had broken up after six years of dating due to their drifting apart because of their busy schedules. On March 6, 2017, MBK Entertainment announced that T-ARA will be releasing their final album in May, with Soyeon and Boram terminating their contracts after its release. On May 7, MBK Entertainment revealed the group's plans had changed, and that the final album had been rescheduled to release in June 2017, with members Boram and Soyeon not being able to partake due to the expiry of their contracts. She made her solo debut on February 5, 2021, with the digital single "They Are All The Same". She then proceeded to release her second digital single called "Interview", on March 24, 2021. On January 18, 2022, Think Entertainment announced that Soyeon would be marrying soccer player Cho Yumin in November after three years of dating. However, on November 3, 2022, it was announced that they postponed their wedding ceremony to next year after Cho Yumin was listed on the national team for the 2022 FIFA World Cup warm-up match, although they already completed their marriage registration.
Soyeon is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the pre-debut girl group BLINDZ.

Jeon Soyeon is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, producer, and dancer under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the leader and main rapper of the girl group i-dle (formerly (G)I-DLE). She first gained attention as a contestant on Produce 101 in 2016, placing 20th, and later as the second runner-up on Unpretty Rapstar 3. After signing with Cube Entertainment, she debuted as a soloist in 2017 with the single "Jelly" and later made her group debut in 2018, as the leader of i-dle, with the mini album "I Am". Soyeon has participated in notable collaborations, including the girl group project for "SM Station X 0" (the third season of SM Entertainment's digital music project) and as a voice for the virtual K-pop group K/DA, portraying the character Akali for League of Legends. She also joined the virtual hip-hop group True Damage in 2019 and collaborated with IVE's Liz and æspa's Winter on the 2023 single "Nobody". In 2025 Soyeon was revealed as the creative director and producer of the girl group Baby DONT Cry.
Soyi (소이) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group Pastel Girl. She was a contestant on Miss Trot 2.
Soyoon is a retired South Korean singer and model. She was a member of the girl group Pocket Girls but left the group in 2016.

Soyou is a South Korean singer under Magic Strawberry Sound. She was a member of the girl group SISTAR. She made her official group debut on June 7th of 2010 and later made her solo debut on December 13, 2017 with the album Re:Born.
Soyoung (소영) is a South Korean singer and guitarist. She was a member of the girl band Sweer Revenge.

So-young officially debuted as a member of the group in January 2009; with the single "AH!". On October 29, 2009, So-young graduated from AFTER SCHOOL to pursue her career in acting.

In 2017, Suhyeon became a contestant on the survival show MIXNINE, where she was eliminated in the final episode. In the same year, she made her acting debut in the drama "Girls' Generation 1979". Lee Su-hyun is a South Korean singer signed with YG Entertainment. She is the lead singer of the brother-sister duo AKMU (Akdong Musician) and a part of the duo Hi Suhyun. She also launched her solo career on October 16, 2020, with the digital single “Alien”. She and her brother debuted on the SBS audition program K-pop Star Season 2. She has also joined reality music shows like Begin Again and served as a judge on the audition show Superband. In addition to singing, Lee has also explored YouTube with her channel, Leesuhyun, and radio broadcasting with a KBS Cool FM show, AKMU Suhyun’s Volume Up. She received her first award for “Radio DJ Award” at the 16th KBS Entertainment Awards. She has also contributed to original soundtracks for Korean TV dramas such as It’s Okay to Not Be Okay, and the Disney live-action film Mulan.

Sulhee is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She is a former member of the duo 1CHU, the project girl group PUZZLE, the girl group HeyGirls and a pre-debut member of the girl group IWU.

Choi Jin Ri, better known by her stage name Sulli, was a South Korean actress, singer, and model. She first gained recognition as a child actress, appearing in various television dramas and films. Sulli rose to fame as a former member of the South Korean girl group f(x), which debuted under SM Entertainment in 2009. During f(x)'s “Red Light” promotions, Sulli paused her activities due to exhaustion from ongoing negative comments. SM Entertainment pursued legal action against rumor spreaders, which concluded with an apology and charge withdrawal. SM Entertainment stated on August 7, 2015, that Sulli left the group f(x) to focus more on acting. Sulli acted in main roles in TV shows and movies. She also debuted as a soloist with her first single “Goblin” on June 29, 2019. Tragically, on October 14, 2019, Sulli was found deceased at her residence in Seongnam, Gyeonggi-do. The cause of death was investigated by authorities, with preliminary assumptions pointing towards self-inflicted circumstances. Sulli’s untimely passing has been deeply mourned by fans worldwide, and her contributions to the entertainment industry remain celebrated.
Sullin is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the band Kiwi Band.

femaleIdols.description: Sullin is a Thai singer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the girl group tripleS and its sub-units Glow and Moon. Initially, she was introduced as a co-MC for the last month of March to the first week of April, following the departure of Kim Min Ju. On April 6, she was declared as the new official MC for Show! Music Core, starting from April 15.

Kim Taeyeon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and voice actress under SM Entertainment. Taeyeon had been a trainee at SM Entertainment's Starlight Academy during her middle school years before debuting as a member of the agency's girl group Girls' Generation in 2007. Since then, she has risen to prominence as SNSD has become one of the most acclaimed acts in South Korea. She has also participated in other SM's projects, including Girls' Generation-TTS alongside with members Taeyeon and Seohyun, SM the Ballad, Girls' Generation-Oh! GG, and Got the Beat. Throughout her tenure with Girl's Generation, Taeyeon played a pivotal role in their immense success, establishing the group as one of the most celebrated acts in K-pop's 2nd-generation and amassing a devoted global fanbase. She is renowned for her exceptional vocal abilities, commanding stage presence, and versatility as an artist. In addition to her work with Girls' Generation, Taeyeon has participated in various projects within the SM Entertainment ecosystem. Notably, she contributed to the sub-unit Girls' Generation-TTS, captivating audiences with her powerful vocals and dynamic performances. She has also lent her talent to collaborations such as SM the Ballad and Girls' Generation-Oh! GG, showcasing her diverse musical range and artistic versatility. In late 2014, Taeyeon embarked on her solo endeavors after eight-years with Girls' Generation. Her solo debut arrived in October 2015 with the highly anticipated mini-album, "I." In 2022, Taeyeon achieved a significant milestone with her hit song "INVU," securing her first-ever perfect all-kill. on multiple music charts underscoring her growth and continued dominance even as a solo artist.

Chou Tzuyu is a Taiwanese singer-songwriter, and dancer under JYP Entertainment. She is best known as the maknae, visual, and one of the lead dancers of the sensational girl group TWICE. Tzuyu's journey in the world of K-pop began in 2012 when she was discovered by talent scouts at the MUSE Performing Arts Workshop in Tainan, Taiwan. Impressed by her talent and potential, she made the life-changing decision to travel to South Korea in November of that year to pursue her dreams as a K-pop trainee. Her unwavering dedication and hard work paid off when she was given the opportunity to participate in the South Korean reality show Sixteen in 2015. Through the intense competition, Tzuyu emerged as one of the chosen to become one of the main members of TWICE. Debuting as the youngest member of TWICE on October 20, 2015, with their first extended play (EP) titled "The Story Begins," Tzuyu captured the hearts of fans worldwide with her captivating visuals, impressive vocals, and graceful presence. Her contributions to the group have played a significant role in their rise to stardom and continuous success. In November 2015, Tzuyu appeared alongside TWICE on the popular Korean variety show, My Little Television. During her introduction, she proudly identified herself as Taiwanese and held the flags of both the Republic of China (Taiwan) and South Korea. Unfortunately, her innocent action unintentionally ignited controversy and sparked a negative reaction from mainland Chinese internet users due to the political tensions between the two countries at the time. Consequently, TWICE faced restrictions on Chinese television, and Tzuyu's endorsement deal with Chinese communications company Huawei was terminated. Controversially to address the situation, JYP Entertainment released a video of Tzuyu issuing a heartfelt apology. The incident involving Tzuyu's apology caused a significant uproar among the Taiwanese public, particularly on the day of the 2016 general election. It gained international attention and was believed to have influenced the decision of approximately more than a million young voters, highlighting the impact that her actions had beyond the realm of entertainment. On September 6, 2024, Tzuyu made her solo debut with the mini album "abouTZU".

U_Chae, formerly known as Dajeong, is a South Korean singer and lyricist under JUNITY Entertainment. She first debuted as a member of the kid group SUPA on November 8, 2016, with the release of the single of the same name, "SUPA". The group eventually disbanded sometimes in 2018. U_Chae then debuted as a member of the girl group PIXY, under ALLART Entertainment, on February 24, 2021 with the release of their first single, "Wings". It was announced that she had left both the group and the agency on June 20, 2024. Since then, she gained recognition through notable projects, including her single "One sweet day", released on July 17, 2024, and her contribution to the album "RUSH: The Music Of EVO 2024", for which she lended her vocal on the track "Let's Roll", alongside Rolling Quartz's Jayoung. U_Chae made her solo debut on July 31, 2024, with the release of her first mini album "AWAKE". On October 31, 2024, she released a collaborative single, titled "U&I", which featured fan participation.

U-Chung, born Hwang Yoon Ha, is a South Korean retired singer. She used to be a member of the girl group Six Bomb, which she joined in May 2015 with their reformation under Pacemaker Entertainment. She made her debut with the group on May 12, 2015 with the release of the single "Step To Me". She left the group in May 2016 due to health reasons.
U-Hyun (유현) is a South Korean trainee. She was a part of the pre-debut lineup of the girlgroup WITCHERS. She is also an actress and model.
U-Jin (유진) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group I.C.E. She left the group in 2018.

U-Min (유민) is a South Korean singer and YouTuber under HUX Entertainment. She will make her official debut on April 8, 2021 with her first mini album Nineteen. She is also known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN. U-Min is the daughter of retired actress Yum Jungyeon. Her aunt is actress Yum Jungah.

U.Ji is a South Korean singer, best known as a former member of the girl groups BESTie and EXID. She made her stage debut on February 12, 2012, as a member of EXID with the release of the group's debut single "Holla." However, on April 30, U.Ji announced her departure from EXID to focus on her education, as confirmed by AB Entertainment. On July 2, 2013, U.Ji, along with former EXID members Hyeyeon and Haeryung, joined YNB Entertainment to form a new girl group, BESTie. The group officially debuted on July 11, 2013, with the single "Pitapat." However, on September 5, 2017, YNB Entertainment revealed that U.Ji and Dahye had left BESTie following the termination of their contracts. U.Ji made her solo debut on February 17, 2015, with the digital single "Love Letter."
U.Na (유나) is a South Korean singer. She was a member, leader and the lead vocalist of the girl group Cooki.
U.u (우우) is a South Korean singer and model. She is member of the girl group U.SSO Girl.
Ua is a Japanese trainee. She gained fame for joining the survival show The Debut: Dream Academy by HYBE Labels and Geffen Records, where she was eliminated at 13th place.

Ubyeol (유별), formerly known as MiU (미유), is a South Korean singer and model. She is a former member of the girl groups TURAN, S2U and My Darling. She made her debut as a soloist under the stage name Shin Yubi (신유비) with the digital single "I'm Okay" on January 14, 2016.
Uchae (유채) is a South Korean singer and cheerleader. She is a former member of the girl group NATURE and the pre-debut girl group Elado.

UEE is a South Korean singer, actress, and model under Lucky Company. She is best known as a former member of After School. In 2007, UEE was a member of the short-lived group Five Girls formed by Good Entertainment. However, the group later disbanded due to the company's financial troubles. UEE later joined Pledis Entertainment and debuted as a member of AFTER SCHOOL in April 2009, with their single DIVA. In July 2009, UEE debuted as an actress in MBC's historical drama Queen Seondok, and has appeared in various television dramas since—receiving numerous awards and consolidating her career. UEE debuted as a soloist on June 21, 2011 with the single "Sok Sok Sok." On May 31, 2017, UEE graduated from AFTER SCHOOL after terminating her contract with Pledis Entertainment.
Uemura Azusa (우에무라 아즈사) is a Japanese singer. She was a member of NMB48's Team BII. She withdrew from NMB48 on December 3, 2018. She was a contestant on Produce 48.
Uhm Ji-won is a South Korean actress. She made her debut in 1999 with the movue Vectorman. She is a member of the project girl group WSG Wannabe.

Uhm Ji Yoon (엄지윤) is a South Korean comedienne and member of the project girl group WSG Wannabe. She made her debut in 2018 at the 32nd KBS open recruitment gag concert, and is currently the youngest comedian at KBS.

Uhm Jung Hwa (엄정화) is a South Korean singer and actress under APOP Entertainment. She is a member of the project girl group Refund Expedition. She debuted as a solo singer on April 1993, with her first studio album Sorrowful Secret.
Uihyun is a South Korean retired singer. She was a member of the girl group Six Bomb, which she left in 2015.
Ujeong (우정) is a South Korean singer under Good Luck Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group SKYLE.

Oki Fuka is a Japanese trainee. She is a former member of the pre-debut girl group BENNY. She was a contestant on the South Korean reality survival show, Girls Planet 999 and the Japanese reality survival show BLACK&WHITE.
Uki Satake is a Japanese singer, actress and radio host. She is a member of the South Korean rotational Co-ed group PTMRS. She is a former member of Japanese girl group 9nine.

Um Jiwon is a South Korean trainee under H1GHR MUSIC. She is a member of the agency's upcoming girl group along three others I-LAND2: N/a contestants. In 2024, Um Jiwon was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she was sadly eliminated in episode 7. At that time, she was a trainee under WAKEONE.

Umeyama Cocona is a Japanese singer and actress under Eggman. She is formerly a member of NMB48's Team N, Mix Juice, and a former member of LAPIS ARCH. She was a contestant on Produce 48 but left the show after the 3rd episode. She graduated from NMB48 in 2022.
Umji (엄지) is a South Korean musical actress and singer. She started her career as a member of the girl group KISS in 2001.

Umji is a South Korean singer under Big Planet Made. She is a member of the girl group VIVIZ and a former member of the girl group GFriend. The CEO of Source Music saw her walking on the street and invited her to audition for the agency. She eventually debuted as a member of GFriend on January 15, 2015, with the EP Season of Glass. After six years of successful promotions, GFriend disbanded on May 22, 2021. Following this, all members left the agency, including Umji. On October 6, 2021, it was announced that Umji, along with former GFriend members, Eunha and SinB, have signed a contract with BPM Entertainment to debut as a three-member group. VIVIZ debuted on February 9, 2022, with the mini album Beam of Prism.
umu is a Soth Korean indie artist. She made her debut on March 16, 2022 with the single "lost and found".
Une (으네) is a South Korean singer under Dejavu Group who debuted under Broadway in 2017.

Himemiya Uni is a South Korean singer, and former member and the Cat of the South Korean J-POP live idol girl group YUBiKiRi. She debuted in the group on January 20, 2024, but graduated soon after on April 27, 2024.

Unia (유니아), also known as Haeun (하은) and formerly known as Ye Ah (예아), is a South Korean singer, dancer and model. She is a former member of the girl groups GOOD DAY, cignature, ALDL and the pre-debut kid group Littles.

Unia is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for participating in the reality survival show Stellar Sugar. On May 19, Unia issued an apology on her TikTok account because the fandom name she originally chose is the same name to the girl group UNIS. According to her, she will change her official fandom name and act more responsibly in the future.

UniN is a South Korean singer-songwriter under MissDica Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming girl group MissDica Girls. She made her solo debut on March 21, 2025 with the digital single "Lucid".

Universe Mongae (우주멍게) is a South Korean electronic pop musician. She debuted with the digital single 'MORPH+NE' on June 14th, 2016. MORPH+NE was exclusively released on Bandcamp, Soundcloud, and on South Korean streaming services. Before she made her debut, she released five songs on Soundcloud, one of which was a cover of Wasted by Dreezy.
Uranus is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted independently in 2019.
Urara is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Usin is a South Korean singer under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X.
Usoul (유설) is a South Korean singer. She is a former pre-debut member of PURPLEBECK. She was born in Japan.

Uta (우타) is a Japanese singer under FNC Entertainment Japan. She is a former member of PRIKIL. On 2021, Uta participated in the FNC survival show "Who Is Princess?" where she finished 1st place, securing her spot as a member of the Japanese girl group PRIKIL.
UZ (유지) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BIKINY. She joined the group in 2013.
V1va is a South Korean rapper under H&B Company who debuted on November 18, 2019, with the single album "Bakin’ Bad!"
Vake is a South Korean solo singer. She debuted on May 28, 2020, with the single “Where’s My Doll”.
Vanessa is a South Korean dancer, singer and guitarist, member of the girl group VIVID. She is in a band called ChordBlue.
Vanesya is an Indonesian trainee under Na Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming global girl group NWH:I She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket.
Vanya is an Indonesian singer under Zenith Media Contents. She is the main dancer of the international girl group Z-Girls and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.

veanii (베아니), formerly known as JEOMi (저미) and also by her birth name An Jeongmin (안정민), is a South Korean singer-songwriter under EXSCAPE. She made her solo debut on June 24, 2023 with the digital single "Rainy Day". She also participated in the popular Korean survival show, Girls Planet 999 and Kpop Star 6: The Last Chance.
Lingyi (링이) is a Singaporean singer. She was the maknae of the pre-debut disbanded girl group Rendezvous.
Go Woo-ri, best known by the stage name Vekoel, is a South Korean rapper. She debuted on July 1st, 2020 with the single album, "umm uh".

Venny is a South Korean singer under SXTYDGRS. She is a member of the girl group Kandis which she was added to on October 10, 2023. Venny was a former pre-debut member of the girl group FANATICS under FENT using her birth name Hyewon.

Via, formerly known as Sookyoung and Jian, is a South Korean singer under Rabbit's Foot. She is a former member of the cancelled girl groups A.B.O. and White Witch. She was also a contestant on the survival show Burn Up 30. She made her solo debut on June 25, 2022, with the single album "Between Us".
Via is a South Korean singer and member of the girl group FANATICS. She joined the group in 2020.

Via is an Indonesian singer-songwriter and rapper under Na Entertainment. She is a member of the upcoming global girl group NWH:I. She is also a former member of the girl group Beauty Box and a former pre-debut member of the girl group MEP-C formed through the training platform Universe.
Vicki is a Hong Kongese-Indonesian singer under Echo Entertainment and Number K Entertainment. She is a member of the project girl group SMORZ.

Vicky is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the disbanded Korean pop girl group Diva and the supergroup BROS. She married her boyfriend on July 25, 2009. She is still active as a soloist.

Victoria Song (or simply Victoria) is a Chinese singer, actress, and model under Song Qian Studio. She studied ethnic Chinese dance at Bejing Dance Academy after her graduation, and in 2007, she was scouted by SM during a dance competition. Victoria debuted as an idol in 2009 with SM's 5-member South Korean girl group f(x) as their Leader, Main Dancer, Lead Rapper, Sub Vocalist, and Visual. Through this group, she steadily rose to fame in Korea. She starred in the 2012 Chinese and Tawainese co-production drama 'When Love Walked In' which scored the number 1 spot in viewership ratings and led her to win the Best New Actress awards at the China TV Drama Awards. In 2018, she debuted as a solo artist with the single 'Roof of Fire' and continued her solo singing career with the 2020 self-titled album 'Victoria' which sold 250 000 copies within 22 hours of its release, leading her to become the fastest Chinese female artist to reach diamond certification on QQ Music in 2020. The album reached #1 place on QQ Music after selling over 300,000 copies in the first weeks. In April 2021, Victoria left SM Entertainment after her contract expired.

Vienna Finger is a South Korean singer, formally under Naturally Music. She is the Leader, Main Vocalist, Guitarist, Composer of the girl group fishingirls. On August 29, 2017, she made her solo debut with a single titled "Honey in My Ear".
Viichan is a virtual South Korean singer and streamer under WAK Entertainment. She debuted as the maknae and a vocalist of the virtual girl group ISEGYE IDOL on December 17, 2021.

Viki, also known as Yubeen, Yoobin, Yubin, and Jeongyu, is a South Korean singer under SW Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group 3piece and a former member of the girl groups P.O.A, CAMILA, and LAYSHA. She is also a pre-debut member of BLINDZ, Queens, CAMILA X, and 1NB.

Choi Seobin, known under her stage name Vin, a South Korean singer and dancer under BPM Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the girl group BADVILLAIN. On May 16, 2024, Vin was revealed as the sixth member of BADVILLAIN. The group officially debuted on June 3, 2024, with their debut single album "OVERSTEP".
Choi Rin is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group MINIMANI and its sub-unit MINIMANI M. On April 11, 2024, CMG Stars announced that she had withdrawn from the group.

Wong Kahei, known under her stage name ViVi, is a Hong Kongese singer-songwriter and model under CTDENM. She is the oldest member of the girl group Loossemble. She is a member of the inactive girl group LOONA, and its sub-unit LOONA 1/3. According to the LOONAverse she lives on Earth along with HeeJin, HyunJin, HaSeul, and YeoJin. Before debuting as an idol, she worked as a freelance model under the name Vivian Wong from 2011 to 2016. She took part in various modeling projects, such as a Blush Cosmetics video tutorial and a PlayStation model at the Asia Game Show 2012. She also appeared in some short YouTube skits, which presumably were with her friends. On February 14, 2017, she was introduced as a member and released her solo single album “ViVi” on April 17. She debuted in LOONA on August 20, 2018, with their debut mini album "[+ +]". However, she parted ways with BlockBerryCreative after a legal dispute. On June 11, 2023, it was announced that she signed an exclusive contract with CTDENM. On July 29, It was also confirmed that she would debut as a member of Loossemble alongside some of the other members of her former group. On September 15th, 2023, she debuted as a member of Loossemble with a mini album of the same name. The group later left CTDENM on November 29, 2024.

Vivi is a Filipino singer under TryCrew Entertainment. She is member of the japanese girl group BENNY. She was a participant in the survival show Universe Ticket, but was eliminated in the 6th episode.

Vivi was a Thai-Austrian trainee. She was the Main Dancer of upcoming K-pop girl group iii. Sometime in early to mid-2024 she seems to have left Big Ocean ENM & iii & went back to resume her studies in Thailand.
Vivian (비비안) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group GeeGu.
Vlada is a Ukrainian model and a blogger. She was a member of the project girl group UHSN under Stone Music Entertainment.
Vosun (보선) is a South Korean singer. She is a former leader of the girl group 84LY.
VOYOON is a South Korean singer. On October 27, 2017, she made her debut with "OAH".

Vu Linh Dan is a Vietnamese singer. She made her Vietnamese solo debut on October 30, 2019 with the release of her digital single "This Is My Destiny". She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket and The Voice Kids of Vietnam.
VV is a Chinese singer, actress and model under H Music Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group HITGS.

Wang Ke is a Chinese singer. She is a member of the girl group Gen1es, the Chinese girl group AIM, and a former member of the pre-debut Korean girl group HOWZ. She is known for being a contestant on the South Korean reality survival show, Produce 48, where she was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 56th. In 2024, she competed in the reality survival show, Chuang Asia Thailand, where she ranked 6th overall, thus becoming a member of the girl group Gen1es.

Wang QiuRu (Chinese: 王秋茹, Korean: 왕추루) is a Chinese singer, member of SNH48's Team SII and former member of SHY48. She participated on Korean survival show 'Girls Planet 999' and ranked 32nd (C-Group). Team History: [2017.04.29] - Joined SHY48 as a Research Student. [2019.01.19] - Transferred to SNH48 Overseas Trainee. [2020.03.07] - Transferred to SNH48 Team SII.
Wang Se-yoon (왕세윤) is a South Korean songwriter, producer, and guitarist of Sweden Laundry.
Wang Yale (Chinese: 王雅乐, Korean: 왕 예일) is a Chinese singer under Jaywalk Newjoy. She was a contestant on Find Your Voice Season 2, Sing It!, Girls Planet 999 and Youth With You 2.

Wan Lin (완린) is a Chinese singer. She is a former member of the girl group SHA SHA. In 2018, Wan Lin was introduced as a member of SHA SHA, after the departures of I An, So Yeop, and Ga Ram. She officially debuted in the group with the single album "What The Heck." On August 24, 2018, Major Entertainment notified fans that she would be taking a hiatus from the group's activity after she fainted on stage.

Heo Min-seon (허민선), best known by the stage name Way (웨이), is a South Korean singer, streamer, and YouTuber. She is best known as a member of the of the South Korean girl group Crayon Pop, along with their sub-unit, Choa & Way (Strawberry Milk) under Chrome Entertainment. Before Way's debut as a member of Crayon Pop, she debuted in November 2011 as a member of the South Korean rock band, N.Dolphin. However, she left the band to join Crayon Pop after being given a second chance by Chrome Entertainment as she declined the first time. Her group Crayon Pop then disbanded in 2017. Her group Crayon Pop is now on hiatus. After Crayon Pop's hiatus, she created a YouTube channel called Wayland.

Way was a South Korean singer and dancer. She was a guest member and Dancer of the South Korean girl group Fly With Me and their dance sub-unit Flora under FA Entertainment. On June 27, 2018, she originally debuted as a guest member in the South Korean girl group FlyWithMe with the release of their first digital single, "Your Face". She left the group, Fly With Me, sometime in 2019.
Wei Yang is a Filipino-Chinese singer under Houxiu TV. She is the former leader of the girl group O21.
Wei Yi is a Chinese actress. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Wellie (웰리) is a South Korean independent rapper who made her debut in 2023.
Wen Zhe (Chinese: 文哲) is a Chinese singer under Star Master Entertainment. She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999 and on Youth With You 2. She is also a member of the Chinese girl group HICKEY.

Son Seung-wan, known professionally as Wendy, is a South Korean singer under ASND. She is best known as a member of the Kpop girl group Red Velvet and has established herself as a solo artist, radio host, and musical actress. Wendy debuted with Red Velvet on August 1, 2014. She later launched her solo career with the mini album "Like Water" on April 5, 2021, becoming the first Red Velvet member to release a solo album. In January 2022, she joined GOT the Beat, a unit under the Girls On Top project, alongside other SM Entertainment artists. Beyond music, Wendy has been active in television and radio. She has appeared on variety shows like We Got Married (2015–2016) and Trick & True (2016–2017) and was a cast member on Saturday Night Live Korea (2021). She also hosted Mysterious Record Shop (2021) and the radio program Wendy’s Youngstreet (2021–2023). In 2023, she made her theatrical debut in the musical Rebecca. On April 4th, 2025, SM Entertainment announced that Wendy, along with Yeri, won't be renewing their contracts but they will continue as members of Red Velvet.
Whai is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Perfume.

Jung Whee In, better known by her stage name Wheein, is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group MAMAMOO formed by RBW Entertainment. She gained recognition for her appearance on "King of Masked Singer," where she performed as "Half Moon." Before her debut with MAMAMOO, she was a trainee under MBK Entertainment. Wheein made her solo debut on April 17, 2018, with the digital single "Magnolia." She later parted ways with RBW Entertainment on June 11, 2021.
Whoru (후아유) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl duo 1set.
Whynn is a South Korean singer under Inter B.D Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group INTER GIRLS.
Wildberry is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under Dynasty Musik. She is a part of the duo VIEW. She made her solo debut on November 28, 2017, with the digital single "Marilyn".
Willow is a Korean-American singer under Inyeon Entertainment who debuted on January 2, 2021, with "Let’s Just Sing".
Windy, formerly known as Jinju is a Korean singer, member of the girl group Girl's World. She was a member of Milkyway. She is the twin sister of Kyrin, also a member of Milkyway as Geumju.
WINee (위니) is a South Korean singer who made her debut on March 5, 2018 with the single "Make me".
Winnie (위니‬) is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Unicorn. She left the group in 2016.

Kim Min Jeong, known under her stage name Winter, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under SM Entertainment. She is best known as the lead vocalist and lead dancer of the girl group aespa. Winter debuted as a member of aespa on November 17, 2020, with the digital single "Black Mamba". She was one of the performers at BoA's 20-year career tribute on December 6 at the 2020 Mnet Asian Music Awards. She sang "ID; Peace B" BoA's first single. She debuted as a member in the unit GOT the beat from the project girl group Girls On Top on January 3, 2022, alongside her groupmate Karina.
Wish is a South Korean singer under MUMW Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group ViV. She made her solo debut on December 15, 2024 with the digital single "What's Your Wish?"
Won is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Blity.
Won Hwayeon is a South Korean singer under Hi-Hat Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group ifeye.
Won Seoyeon is currently an independent trainee. She was a competitor on Produce 48 under MMO Entertainment. However, she ranked #92 in episode 5 and was eliminated.
Wonchae is a South Korean singer and actress under Big Mountain Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group Queenz Eye. She was a former member of the pre-debut trainee team WM Ggumnamu.

Wonhee is a South Korean singer under Belift Lab. She is the center and lead vocalist of the South Korean girl group ILLIT. In June 2023, she participated in HYBE and Belift Lab's survival show called R U Next?, where she was chosen by fans' votes as the first member to debut in the final group ILLIT.
Chu Wonhui is a South Korean trainee who participated in the survival program Idol School and was a contestant on Stars Awakening.

Wonhyo is a South Korean singer and dancer, former member of the girl group Diawings. She became a member on June 27, 2023. Previously, Wonhyo was part of the group RANIAN and also served as a backup dancer for Diawings. As of May 12, 2024, Diawings has made an announcement regarding Wonhyo’s status. Due to personal reasons, Wonhyo will be taking an indefinite hiatus from the group. During this period, Diawings will continue their activities as a four-member ensemble until Wonhyo is able to return. On May 1, 2025, Diawings members Dohee and Dahae announced that Wonhyo has officially departed from the group.

Woni is a South Korean singer and rapper under THE MUZE Entertainment. She is best known as the leader, lead rapper and sub vocalist of the girl group RESCENE. She debuted as a member of RESCENE on March 26, 2024, with their single album "Re:Scene".
Wonji (원지) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group BELLA4.
Wonjjang (원쨩) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Happymil 05o in 2019.

Wony, formerly known as Seungwon, is a South Korean singer under RBC Amusement. She is the maknae of the girl group We;Na, its sub-unit Yeonseo & Wony and a member of the project girl group PUZZLE. She made her solo debut on March 25, 2024 with the digital single "Time After Time".

Jang Wonyoung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, model, and MC under Starship Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group IVE. Wonyoung was only thirteen years old when she joined the popular survival show Produce 48 as the youngest trainee. Her visuals and unique charms captivated the viewers from the start. She earned the most votes and became the center of the project group IZ*ONE, debuting with them on October 29, 2018. After three years of promotions, the group officially disbanded on April 29, 2021. Following this, Wonyoung continued to train while pursuing solo activities. In early November 2021, Starship Entertainment revealed that Wonyoung and her former IZ*ONE groupmate Yujin would join their new girl group. Wonyoung made her debut as an IVE member on December 1, 2021.
Woo Yerin (Korean: 우예린; Japanese: ウ イェリン) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under Ruby Records. She made her solo debut on April 20, 2018 with the digital single "안아주세요".
Woo Yewon is a South Korean trainee, best known for competing in Under 15.

Woo-Ah is a South Korean rapper and singer under SAI Entertainment. In January 2019, Woo-Ah was introduced as a member of the trainee group WishGirls under her birth name, Chaewon. She released a solo song, "ISSUE", on May 18, 2019. Woo-Ah made her debut as a member of the girl group CRAXY on March 2, 2020, with the full-length album "My Universe".

Bae Woo-hee is a South Korean singer and actress under Fly Up Entertainment. She made her official debut on May 24, 2012, upon joining the girl group Dal Shabet. Following the group's hiatus in 2017, Woohee participated in the survival show "The Unit" where she successfully qualified to be a member of the project girl group UNI.T. In 2019, Wohee left Happy Face Entertainment and signed with Fly Up Entertainment. Since then, she has focused on acting, appearing in dramas such as "Business Proposal" and "Birthcare Center."
WooIn (우인) is a South Korean self producing singer under Pondsound.
Wooji (우지) is a South Korean singer, member of the duo HAIL.
Wooju is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Wassup.
Wook Jin is a South Korean singer. She was the main dancer and maknae of the girl group ALiKE.
Wool is a South Korean singer and model under I-Star Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group New-L. She also works as a model for L4K3.
Woomi (우미) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group Purplay.
Woomi (우미) is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group HWAITING.
Woomool, formerly known as Eumyul, is a South Korean former singer. She was a member of the girl group Kassia. She made her solo debut on May 16, 2012, with the digital single "Goodbye Symptom."
Woori is a South Korean model and former singer under MissDica. She is a former member of the girl group LAY.T.

Wooyeon is a South Korean singer and Actress signed with H Music Entertainment. Wooyeon is the Lead Vocalist & Visual of the girl group WOOAH (formerly known as woo!ah!). She made her debut as a member of WOOAH on May 15, 2020, with the group's first single album "Exclamation". That same year, she also made her debut as an actress with the drama “My YouTube Diary Season 2.” She continued her acting career with roles in the dramas "Ongoing Loved One"(2022), “Revenge of Others”(2022) and "Snap and Spark"(2023). In 2023, she participated in the Mnet survival show "Queendom Puzzle", where she was eliminated after ranking 9th.
Wu Tammy (우태미) is a Chinese-American trainee. She was a participant in the hit Korean survival show, Girls Planet 999 as an independent trainee.

wYte, also known as Park Haeyoung, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under NUPLAY. She is a former member of the girl group A.De.

Despite showing early promise, she was eliminated in the fourth episode, ranking 80th overall. In 2021, Xiaoting returned to the idol scene through Girls Planet 999, representing the C-Group. Throughout the program, she maintained a consistently high ranking, becoming the only contestant to hold first place within her group for the entire season. She remained a part of the Planet Top 9 throughout the competition and ultimately placed ninth in the finale, earning her place in the final lineup of Kep1er. Kep1er officially debuted on January 3, 2022, with the mini album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group's debut was a commercial success, and Xiaoting has since continued her activities with the group under WAKEONE, contributing to their growing influence in the global kpop market.

Yujin is a South Korean singer, dancer, and actress currently signed to WAKEONE. She is best known as a former member of CLC and a current member of the Kep1er, a project girl group formed through Mnet’s survival program Girls Planet 999. She began her entertainment career in 2014, appearing as a backup dancer for G.NA during her promotions for "G.NA’s Secret". On March 19, 2015, Yujin debuted as a member of CLC with their first mini album "First Love". The group gained recognition for their diverse music style and remained active until Cube Entertainment announced the conclusion of CLC's official activities on May 20, 2022. Although no longer under active management by Cube, the members stated the group had not officially disbanded. In June 2021, Yujin was introduced as a contestant on Girls Planet 999. She finished in third place during the final episode, earning her a place in Kep1er. The group debuted on January 3, 2022, with the mini album "First Impact" and the lead track "WA DA DA", which received commercial success both domestically and internationally. By mid-2022, Yujin had officially parted ways with Cube Entertainment after more than a decade, as confirmed by her removal from their artist listings. Her departure marked a full transition to her new activities under WAKEONE. On May 30, 2024, it was announced that Yujin had renewed her contract with WAKEONE and would continue promoting as a core member of Kep1er's restructured seven-member lineup.
