She is also a member of its sub-unit Girls' Generation-Oh!GG. She debuted as a member of Girls' Generation on August 5, 2007, with the group's first single, "Into the New World." On September 5, 2018, Yuri debuted as a member of Girls' Generation's second sub-unit, Girls' Generation-Oh!GG with their first single, "Lil' Touch." On October 4, 2018, Yuri made her solo debut with her first mini-album, "The First Scene."
Yuri is a Chinese singer under Houxiu TV. She was a member of the girl group O21.

Yuri is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the co-ed group Cool and the girl duo Girl Friends. Yuri joined Cool in 1995 following the departure of members Choi Jun-myeong and Yoo Chae-young. After Cool's disbandment in 2005, she and her friend Chae Ri Na formed the group Girl Friends. Cool re-formed in 2008, and she participated in all comebacks until 2014, owing to childcare matters. She currently lives in Los Angeles with her husband.
Yuri formerly known as Yull is a Korean pop singer and DJ and singer. In August 10, 2012 she made her debut as the Main Vocalist of the girl group EvoL.
Yuri is a Japanese singer under Across Entertanment and a member of the Japanese girl group ALETTA. She is best known for participating in the survival show Universe Ticket.
Yuri (유리) is a South Korean rapper and singer-songwriter signed with GF Music Entertainment. She debuted as a solo artist with her first studio album “Just Like R&B” on September 1, 2001.
Yuri is a South Korean singer under Danah Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group DIVA-X.
Yurian is a retired South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group AGirls.
Yurim (유림) is a South Korean singer and child model under Clevr E&M. She is a member of the kids girl group PIERCE. She used to be a member of the kids girl group CooKie.
Yurim (유림) is a South Korean artist under LPA Entertainment. She is a member of the Korean pop girl group Holics.
Yurim (유림) is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group May Queen. She joined the group in 2013.

Yurim is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group 3YE and the co-ed project group Triple7. Yurim originally debuted as a member of Apple.B on August 1, 2017, with the group's first digital single "Woochuchu." However, the group disbanded in 2018. She made her second debut on May 21, 2019, as a member of 3YE with their first digital single "DMT." On August 10, 2021, Urim debuted as part of the project group Triple7, with the digital single "Presente." Triple7 is a collaboration between members of 3YE and B.I.G.

Yurisa is a South Korean singer, actress and model under GRIMPRODUCTION. She made her official debut on April 3, 2019, with the cover digital single "Lemon", and on May 19, 2024 with the single "NYA?".

Choi Jeong-Yun (최정윤), best known by the stage name YuSeol (유설), is a South Korean solo-singer assumingly under Newplan Entertainment. She debuted on November 17th, 2020 with the single "Ocean View". Because YuSeol was the only artist under Newplan Entertainment, it is believed that she left the company. As of 2020, she is more active as an actress and vlogger.
Yusu is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under Pida Music. She made her debut on June 22, 2019, with the digital single "Hold Me Tight".
Yusu (유수) is a solo artist from South Korea who started her music career with the release of her single “Stay” on March 29, 2023. She is the sibling of Soohyun, a member of the group MINIMANI.
yusuii is an independent K-RnB soloist who debuted on 25th September 2023 with her song, 'Try on me'.
Yuting, also known as Seoeun, is a Taiwanese singer. She is a a member of the South Korean co-ed rotation project group PTMRS and former member of the cancelled girl group SOE.

Yuu is a South Korean singer and former member of the live idol group PSEUDO SIGMA. She departed from the group on October 1, 2023. Yuu made her solo debut on September 26, 2024, with the single "I Love YUU."
Yuuki (유키) is a Japanese singer under LAPONE GIRLS, member of the girl group IS:SUE. She was a contestant on PRODUCE 101 JAPAN THE GIRLS. She was eliminated in the finals, placing 15th.
Yuuri is a Japanese formely singer under GGA. She is a former member of the girl group LUNARSOLAR and the Japanese girl group I'S9.
Yuuz,formerly known as Grita, is a South Korean trainee under Entertainment Han. She is a member of the girl group lilli lilli.

Yuyeon, formerly known as Cherry and Yujeong is a South Korean singer and model. She is a member of the upcoming girl group Clear:I and a former pre-debut member of the girl group MIDNIGHT. In 2022, she was featured in STEFANO X RUTA‘s “NYX”.

Yuyu is a South Korean singer formally under Naturally Music. She is the Vocalist and Drummer of the girl group fishingirls. She joined the group in November 2019. She was a member of Ggeumgonggang prior to joining fishingirls.
Yuzion is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2019 with the EP Young Trapper. She’s currently under Yng & Rich Records.

Yuzuha Riko is a South Korean V-Tuber and singer under Accelers. She is a member of the South Korean VTuber group StelLive and part of the subunit: 3rd Generation 'Cliché. Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be April 13.

Yves is a South Korean singer and producer under PAIX PER MIL. She is a member of the girl group LOONA and the leader of its third sub-unit, yyxy. She made her solo debut on May 29, 2024, with EP "LOOP". According to the LOONAverse, She lives in Eden along with Chuu, Go Won, and HyeJu (formerly known as Olivia Hye).
YZZI is a member of Asia girlS. She debuted as a soloist on the 18th of January 2023 with her digital single "NEVER DIE".

Z.Hera (지헤라) is a South Korean solo singer and actress under Artisans Music. She made her singing debut on May 23, 2013, with her mini-album Z.HERA Born. Her acting debut was in 2016 with the drama Moorim School.
Zellda is a Taiwanese singer under Echo Entertainment and Number K Entertainment. She made her debut as a member of the project girl group SMORZ on May 19, 2025.
Zelli (젤리), also stylized as Jelli, is a Taiwanese former rapper. She is a former member of the girl group MOA. She left right before “I’ll Call Ya” promotions started.

Zena is a South Korean singer under GOLDDUST Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group BEWAVE and a former member of the trainee groups SG Girls and ALPHA RAY. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.

Kim Gayoung, known under her stage name Zena, is a South Korean singer and rapper under THE MUZE Entertainment. She is best known as the main rapper, lead vocalist, visual and maknae of the girl group RESCENE. She debuted as a member of the girl group RESCENE on March 26, 2024, with their single album "Re:Scene". She was a contestant on "Stars Awakening".
Zena: is a South Korean virtual idol under Metaverse Entertainment. She is a member of the virtual girl group MAVE:.
Zero is a South Korean singer, member of the girl group NEKIRU. She joined the group in July 2023.
Zerø is a singer from the virtual group IRISÉ, which is under Parable Entertainment. She was the first member to be revealed, dated December 1, 2024.

Zhang Liyin is a Chinese singer and songwriter under Xunfei Music. She made her solo debut under SM Entertainment on September 8, 2006 with the digital single "Timeless", a duet song with former TVXQ! member Xia Junsu. She is a former member of the project group S.M. THE BALLAD. On February 28, 2017, she revealed that she will be leaving SM Entertainment as her contract expired.
Zhang Luofei (Chinese: 张洛菲, Korean: 장 뤄페이) is a Chinese singer under Gramarie Entertainment. She was a contestant on Girls Planet 999 and on Youth With You 2.

Zhao Caier, also known as Alyssa, is a Chinese singer under Letong Times Entertainment. She is a former member of the South Korean girl group TURAN. Alyssa made her solo debut on May 19, 2016, with the digital single "开口说爱你."
Zheng Qiu Hong, also known as Jade Zheng, is a Chinese singer and actress. She is a member of the two-member pop group Smile Girls.
Zhou Jiaqi is a Chinese trainee under TOP CLASS Entertaiment announced as a contestant in the survival show Universe Ticket, where she was eliminated in the 4th episode.

Zhou Jie Qiong (formerly known as Kyulkyung) is a Chinese dancer, singer-songwriter, composer, and actress under Zhou Jieqiong Studio. She is a former member of the girl group PRISTIN, its sub-unit PRISTIN V, and the project girl group I.O.I. In 2016, Zhou Jie Qieong participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with five other trainees from her agency at the time, Pledis Entertainment. She ranked 6th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis', and was active with them throughout the entire length of their activities. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017. On May 4, 2016, she debuted in I.O.I with the mini album, Chrysalis, and its title track, "Dream Girls". After the disbandment of I.O.I, Zhou Jie Qieong, along fellow labelmate and I.O.I member Lim Nayoung, debuted as a member of Pledis Entertainment's girl group PRISTIN, which debuted on March 21, 2017, with the mini album "Hi! PRISTIN" and its title track, "Wee Woo". The agency then formed PRISTIN V, a sub-unit of the group, with Zhou Jie Qieong being one of its members. They debuted on May 28, 2018, with the single album, "Like a V". Both group eventually disbanded in 2019 after almost two years without activity. Zhou Jie Qieong made her solo China-based debut with the digital single "Why" on September 6, 2018. On September 2019, Zhou Jie Qiong sent a contract termination notice to Pledis and XCSS Entertainment, her Chinese agency, which led them to demand her for breaching the contract on March 25, 2020, declaring the notice as "baseless". The same day Zhou Jie Qiong released a statement on her Weibo. Since then, she has been promoting as an actress in China and is well-known for the dramas Miss Truth (2020), Legend of Fei (2020), To Be With You (2021) and Be My Princess (2021).
Zhuang Yihan is a Chinese actress. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
Zi.L is a South Korean singer and dancer. She was a member of the girl group Asome.D.
Zi.U, formerly known as Seulji, is a South Korean singer, actress, model, BJ and MC. She was a member of the Korean pop girl group RaNia but left in 2019.
Zia is a South Korean soloist under FlexM Entertainment. She debuted as a solo act on July 16th, 2007 with “Voice of Heaven”.

Zia is a South Korean singer. She is member of the girl group Burvey and cover group Meringue Cookies. Zia joined Burvey sometime around June 2022 or earlier. She remained an active member of the girl group and eventually got to make a music debut on June 30, 2023 with the release of Burvey's second digital single, "Don't Look Away".
Zia is a South Korean singer under DAM Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group STRAW.
Zin (지인) is a South Korean singer under A team Entertainment. She debuted as the maknae of bugAboo on October 25, 2021.
zin (진) is a South-Korean singer-songwriter under 8BallTown. She debuted on July 17, 2022, with the single “horn”.
Zion is a South Korean singer. She was the leader and a sub-vocalist of the girl group GP Basic.
Zisu is a South Korean singer-songwriter who debuted on August 28, 2015, with the digital single album 짝사랑. Her birthday is on March 1994 the day is unknown or the month is unknown.
Ziya is a popular independent artist in Hongdae under Megameta. She is part of the virtual group IXIA as a composer and all-rounder.
Ziyoon (also known as Kwon Ziyoon) is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter, composer, and producer. She made her solo debut on August 26, 2020 with the digital single "From Your Eyes".

Cho Hyewon, also known by the stage name Zoa, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under KeyEast. She debuted as the maknae of the girl group Weeekly on June 30, 2020. Zoa was confirmed as a constant of Mnet's survival show, "Queendom Puzzle" in May of 2023. However, she was eliminated in the semi-final, her final rank being 19th.

Zoe is an Italian singer and lyricist under HOMe. She is a member of the girl group Geenius and a former member of the trainee team Polaris Junior. She is known for participating in JTBC and YG's reality survival show MIXNINE. Her parents are both Korean but she was born and raised in Lombardy, Italy.

Zoey is a fictional rapper and singer-songwriter introduced in the 2025 Netflix animated film Kpop Demon Hunters. She serves as the main rapper, vocalist, lyricist, and the youngest member of the fictional girl group HUNTR/X. Ji-young Yoo provides her speaking voice, while Rei Ami, a Korean American artist known for her sharp lyrics and genre-blending style, delivers her rap and vocal performances. Within the group, Zoey shows the fiery, outspoken energy of a maknae. She is quick with her words and fearless on stage, but beneath her confident exterior, she is still figuring out her identity and place among her peers. Growing up in the U.S. gives her a fresh perspective that adds depth to HUNTR/X's dynamic. Her voice actor, Ji-young Yoo, is a Korean American actress known for her versatility on screen. She debuted in the 2021 Netflix film Moxie and has since appeared in productions like Expats, Smoking Tigers, and Until Dawn. Yoo also voiced Eun-yu in the English-language dub of Sweet Home (Season 1).
Zoo.Y is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl group A.sia. She was born in 1986 the month she was born is currently unknown.
ZSun (제트썬) is a South Korean dancer and singer under MLD Entertainment. She is a member of the dance group CocaNButter, and a former member of the dance group PURPLOW (2011 - May 2017).

Zuu is a singer under Vine Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group SECRET NUMBER. On October 16, 2021, Zuu was revealed as a new member of SECRET NUMBER. She made her official debut as a member on October 27 with the single album "Fire Saturday".

zzone, formerly known as Jeewon, is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups cignature, GOOD DAY, and GOOD DAY's sub-unit Morning unit. Jeewon made her solo debut on August 25, 2025 with the single "Devil's Jam".

maleIdols.description: #AnNyeong is a South Korean singer under the 2nd Floor Record. He officially made his face public on November 7, 2023, at 18:00 (KST), as he released the single "Don’t Love Me, Don’t Hug Me". He was on King of Masked Singer on November 12 and 26, 2023.
#Gun, born Song Gun-hee is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Starship Entertainment on July 29, 2016 with the single "Beep".
0820 is a South Korean singer, songwriter and producer who debuted in 2018 with the single album ROMEO.
104 is a South Korean rapper who officially debuted with the mini-album, “Wicked” on August 10, 2020.
1060 is a South Korean Soloist who debuted in July 4th, 2016.

109, formerly known as Chanyoung, is a South Korean singer and songwriter under INHEART MUSIC. He debuted on November 9, 2015, with the single "I Want to Tell You" under his birth name Chanyoung. On 18th of January 2019, he was revealed to be under INHEART MUSIC on their offical instagram.
1chika is a Japanese singer under his own label JJ Music. He is best known for being a contestant on the Chinese survival show Produce Camp 2021 and the Korean survival show Boys Planet.

Song Kyung Il, better known as 1iL, is a South Korean model and singer from Siganture Sound. He was first known for being a member of the boy group HISTORY under FAVE Entertainment. Following HISTORY's disbandment, Kyung Il began to promote as a soloist under the stage name 1iL. He made his official debut in HISTORY on April 26, 2013 with the digital single "Dreamer." After four years of promotion, the group eventually disbanded in May 12, 2017.

20 Years of Age is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Shofar Entertainment (formerly known as Shofar Music). 20 Years of Age originally debuted as a duo in 2013 but after Boon Joon Kyung left in 2014, Hwang Dae Hyun continued releasing music under the same name.
250 is a South Korean producer and DJ under 'Beasts And Natives Alike.'

26 is a Korean rapper, dancer and director. He was a member of the South Korean pop/hip-hop boy group SEVENUS (formerly known as MASC). He debuted in the South Korean pop/hip-hop boy group SEVENUS (formerly known as MASC) on August 19, 2016, with the mini album "Strange". He left the group during its controversys on July 30th, 2018 because he decided to pursue a new career as a director.
365Lit is a South Korean rapper that is a part of UNDER SEONGSU BRIDGE crew.

Kim Han-Jun, best known by his stage name 40, under 40 Company, and 8recordz, is a South Korean singer. Originally under YNB Entertainment, He left the company on July 12th, 2017. He is now signed under his own company he created, 40 company. He debuted in May 2011 with the single album, "Give You".
4sure is a South Korean singer. He made his official debut on February 4, 2020, with the digital single "Space Ship."
9z, also known as Goosy, is a South Korean singer under big wav Music who made his solo debut on Jan 3, 2019. He is a member of Korean indie band, We Are The Night.
A-Min is a South Korean singer under C9 Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2021 as a member of the boy group EPEX.
A'byss was a Korean rapper who debuted on Jan 19th 2018 with the track "they say".

Aaron, is a South Korean musician and songwriter under Favor Entertainment. He is the keyboardist of the boy band W24. He is also a member of the CCM band AGAPAO Worship. He debuted with the boy band W24 on March 8, 2018, with the mini album "Singing Dancing".

Kwak Young Min, popularly known as Aron, is a Korean-American singer, rapper, and DJ. In 2012, he debuted as the sub-vocalist and sub-rapper of the boy group NU'EST under Pledis Entertainment. He is the group's eldest member and representative when it comes to speaking in English. On February 28, 2022, Pledis Entertainment announced that the NU'EST members' contracts will expire on March 14 and Aron decided not to renew with the company.

Abs Saja, more commonly referred to as Abby, is a fictional singer and rapper from the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He serves as the main dancer, vocalist, and rapper of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Abby is voiced by YouTuber and professional voice actor Sungwon Cho (ProZD), while his singing voice is provided by NECKWAV, a Korean indie R&B artist, composer, and lyricist known for tracks like "Without You." Abby's eccentric flair and unpredictable energy shine through NECKWAV's vocal delivery, adding a chaotic but captivating edge to his character.
ACE was a member of The SEED, R*Chemist and Five Run Strike. He played bass in Five Run Strike.
Jang Wooyoung, known for his stage name ACE, is a member of the boy group VAV. ACE is also known for his songs covers posted on the group's Youtube Channel.

Kim Dae Sung, also known as ACE, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter. He used to be a member of the boy group MASC. In July 2018, ACE announced that he would be leaving the group, taking responsibility for assaulting fellow member Chibin. Following his departure from the group, ACE has since

Achillo is a South Korean rapper and lyricist under TNC. He is a former member of the project boy group OG SCHOOL PROJECT. He made his solo debut on April 12, 2022 with the studio album Achillo. He is also known as a contestant on the reality show Show Me The Money 9.

AEEO is a South Korean singer under JACSO Entertainment. He made his solo debut with the single album "Stars" on July 4, 2025. He is a former contestant of Under Nineteen and a former member of the pre-debut group MBK BOYS. On August 12, 2021, he was introduced as the 30th contestant of the survival show Wild Idol.
Ahn Jung Hun is a South Korean actor. He made his debut in 2018 on the web-drama "A-Teen". In 2021, he was a part of the fictional boy group SHAX, created for KBS2's drama "Imitation".
Ahn Jeongjun is a South Korean singer. He made his musical debut with the release of “Haru” in 2017. He is also known for being a part of the indie duo off the menu.
Ahn Junwon is a South Korean trainee under MEGAMETA and THE L1VE. He is a member of the upcoming boy group ASTEON. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Project 7.
Ahn Si YuL, formerly known as Jaewon, is a South Korean singer, actor, and model. He was a member of the boy group Apeace and its sub-unit Apeace Jade. He left the group on June 30, 2014.
Ai is a Japanese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Aiboy is a South Korean rapper and singer under PYRAT and is a member of 0WAVE. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2023 with his EP "Hype Boy".
Aiden is a South Korean singer and rapper under Illusion Entertainment and OneWorld Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group AWEEK.
Ain is a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of EPIC TRAVELS. He was the leader and the main dancer of the boy group TST and a former member of the boy group NOM.
Aito is a Japanese trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Aito is a Japanese singer and member of the group 1VERSE under Singing Beetle Entertainment.
Aivan is a solo artist under Evermore Music. He started off doing covers on YouTube and promoting his music in Japan. He debuted on July 5th, 2018 with his single ‘Tell The World’.

AJ, also known as Siyoon, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and producer under Rooftop Company. He is a member of the boy group U-KISS and a former member of Paran. In 2011, AJ was added to U-KISS along with Hoon. He also became a member of the group's sub-unit 'uBEAT with Kevin and Eli. In July 2012, AJ announced he would be going on hiatus from group activities to study after being accepted at Columbia University. However, he officially left the group in 2016 but has rejoined as of 2023 to participate in the group's 15th-anniversary comeback. In July 2017, he changed his real name from Kim Jae-seop to Kim Si-yoon and made a comeback as a solo singer.
AJOO is a South Korean singer and model under Stam Entertainment. He debuted in 2008 with the single “1st Kiss”.

Leeon is a rapper from the virtual group RE:REVOLUTION. He began his career debuting in July 2021 in the group Revolution Heart until he and the other members terminated their contracts and formed their own group, re-debuting on April 26, 2024.
Ahn Jun-sang, better know by the stage name Aki, is a retired South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group O.P.P.A.

maleIdols.description: Aki is a Thai trainee and former pre-debut member of Thai boy group A Ten. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 6 after ranking 34th.
Akira is a Japanese singer under Sony Music Entertainment Korea. He is a member of the boy group KJRGL.
Akito is Japanese Singer. He is a member of the boy group Celest1a.
Aknow was a member of the 4-member group AFOS.
Alex is a Japanese singer. He was added to the boy group DUSTIN under Na Entertainment on February 15, 2023. He sadly left the group in late 2023 after already being on hiatus for health issues.

Alex is a Korean-German singer best known as a former member of the boy group DRIPPIN under Woollim Entertainment. He debuted as a member of DRIPPIN on October 28, 2020, with the mini album "Boyager." He promoted with the group for years until January 2023, when Woollim Entertainment announced his hiatus due to health issues. Six months later, in July 2023, it was revealed that Alex left the group and the agency.
Alex Chu, known simply as Alex, is a Korean-Canadian singer and actor. He was the male vocalist of the South Korean electropop band Clazziquai Project.
Alexander is a member of the boy group U-KISS. He left the group in 2011 but returned in 2023 to take part in the group's comeback in celebration of their 15th debut anniversary.
Allan is a South Korean rapper under Wannabe Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut boy group VVS and was a member of DIP.MX and Hi5.

Allen is a Taiwanese-American rapper under Starship Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group CRAVITY. He joined JYP in 2016 and left in 2018. He was supposed to participate in “Stray Kids Survival Show” but was replaced before the first episode. He debuted as a member of CRAVITY on April 14, 2020 with the mini album "HIDEOUT : REMEMBER WHO WE ARE".

Allen Kibum, also known simply as Kibum, is a South Korean singer and the younger brother of SS501’s Kim Hyung Jun. He debuted with U-Kiss in 2008, initially performing under the name Kibum, but left the group in February 2011. Afterwards, he adopted the stage name Allen Kibum and pursued a career as a solo singer and musical actor in Japan and Korea. Currently, he works as a businessman in international trade and performance planning.
Allzwell is a member of co-ed trio PRSNT under BIXIZ XOUND. They made their debut on June 22, 2019, with the digital single "I Feel, You Feel, We Feel".

Mitsuyuki Amaru is a Japanese singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip. Amaru began his idol journey by training with YG Japan but eventually left the agency. In 2021, he participated in the survival show Loud, where he placed third and earned a spot as an official member of JYP Entertainment's upcoming boy group.
Ambid Jack, whose real name is Kim Seung-soo, is a South Korean rapper. He began his music career independently in 2020 and is currently signed with Nazca Records.

Amón, also known as Lee Youngjun, is a South Korean rapper. He is a former member of the boy group BIGSTAR under the stage name Baram. He made his solo debut on April 22nd, 2024, with the digital single Club Wolf.

An Chanwon is a South Korean singer under With US Entertainment, a subsidiary of Around US Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group The Wind on May 15, 2023. As of January 23rd, 2024, An Chanwon was absent from The Wind's upcoming 2nd Mini Album, "Our: YouthTeen", due to his health. He returned back to activities as of Children's Day 2024 and participated in their next comeback "Sirius Pt.2".
An Tae Gyu is a South Korean singer under Antenna. He is the leader, vocalist, and guitarist of the boy band DRAGONPONY.

An Xin is a Chinese trainee and actor under Chromosome Entertainment and Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the project boy group ALPHA DRIVE ONE. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 where he made it to the finale. On June 7, 2025, he was revealed to be a contestant on Boys II Planet. During the show's finale, he ranked 2nd, securing his spot in the debut group.
An Yuchan is a South Korean singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

An Yul is a singer under No.1 ENM. He has participated in shows such as Voice King, Kookmin Singer, the Burning Trotman, and is SBS' reality show Universe League. He debuted as a solo artist on April 2, 2025 with the digital single "Heart On Fire".
Anderson is a former Canadian trainee. He was a contestant on NCT Universe : LASTART.
Andrew is a Korean-American trainee under Bill Entertainment. He is best known as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Andy is a member of the South Korean boy group ARrC under MYSTIC Story. He is known for participating in the survival show, PROJECT 7. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated in the final after ranking 19th place. On January 30th, 2025, MYSTIC STORY announced that Andy joined ARrC as a new member and ARrC would continue as a 7-member group.
Andy is a Hong Kong singer under Forest Network. He is a former member of the boy group Seven O'clock.

Lee Sun Ho, best known by the stage name Andy, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and a member of the South Korean boy band, Shinhwa, currently signed under Shinhwa company. Andy's company, TOP Media produced the South Korean boy bands, Teen Top, 100%, and UP10TION. He has also ventured into musicals, solo singing, and television acting. In 2003, when the members of Shinhwa began solo activities, Andy surprised the community by being an actor in various dramas, most notably "Lovers In Prague". He was also an MC on SBS Inkigayo and MBC Goldfish, however, he stepped down from his position in January 2007. In March 2012, Andy reunited with his Shinhwa members for their comeback after four years under the management company, Shinhwa Company. While Shinhwa members Eric and Lee Min-Woo are co-CEOs, Andy the other members are shareholders.

Anlee is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer affiliated with MYSTIC Story. He is part of the male duo ANODE. Anlee first stepped into the music scene as a solo artist, releasing his digital single “Sunrise!” on March 15, 2023. In collaboration with Blanc, his partner in ANODE, Anlee has also contributed to the production of music for the artist Billlie.
Anngyeungjaebee, born Moon Ju-yeong is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Stoneship in 2020.

Anthonny is a Filipino-Japanese trainee signed with YY Entertainment. He gained fame as a participant in the Korean reality show “Boys Planet” and the Japanese competition show “Produce 101 Japan Season 2”. Anthonny is a member of the J-POP group TOZ, under YY Entertainment. They made their debut on September 27, 2023 with the mini album FLARE.

Anthony is a Chinese-American rapper and singer. He used to be a member of the boy group Varsity. In 2019, following Varsity's disbandment, Anthony participated in the Chinese survival show "Youth with You."

Anton Lee, also known as Anton, is a South Korean-American singer under SM Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group RIIZE, which debuted on September 4, 2023, with their first single album "Get a Guitar." Reports emerged on July 18, 2023, suggesting that Anton would make his debut in SM Entertainment's new boy group. However, SM Entertainment neither confirmed nor denied the reports, stating that further details about the new boy group would be released on August 1, 2023. On August 1, 2023, his participation in the new boy group, RIIZE, was officially confirmed by SM Entertainment. He was introduced as a member with a new talent in composition and a unique musical sense.
Anzardi Timothee is a French trainee, idol and even model under ESteem Entertainment. He was first known for appearing and competing on the survival program "Produce X 101".
Aoi is a Japanese singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY. On September 13, 2024, Aoi was announced as a member of 3WAY.

maleIdols.description: Aom is a Thai singer, actor and trainee under Escrow Entertainment. On November 8, 2021, he was introduced as a contestant on World Star's survival show Boyband The Series. He ranked 10th place overall, making him a member of the winning group XI. Aom debuted with the group on August 29, 2022, with the release of the digital single "Flame". He made his acting debut with a supporting role in GMM 25's Thai series "Boyband", which aired from February 16 to March 23, 2023. Aom announced on his SNS that he had left World Star Academy on October 29, 2023, even tho the agency claimed otherwise the next day. However, as he has not been active with them since then, he is believed to have left the group and the company. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
AON is a South Korean rapper and producer who officially debuted on October 12, 2020 with Time Travel.

Aoora is a South Korean soloist that debut September 4, 2009. He later debuted as a member of now disbanded boy group AA that debuted in 2011. He was the vocalist, rapper, and producer of the group. In 2015 he debuted in the groups sub-unit AOORA&HOIK with fellow AA member Hoik. He shortly after left the group but is still active as a soloist.
Aoshi is a Japanese trainee under BPM Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Apro is a South Korean soloist, singer-songwriter, DJ and designer under WAVY. He made his official debut as a member of Basterd in 2014. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2016 with the single "I.D.L.Y".
Aquinas is a South Korean independent rapper and songwriter. He made his official debut on May 1, 2020 with single “Oh!”.

maleIdols.description: Arctic is a Thai trainee under IST Entertainment. He is best known as a contestant of the survival show Boys II Planet.

Jeong Dongsu, also known as Arkay is a South Korean singer and rapper under Enterarts Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the duo "AA" and participated in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Jang Yun-ho, also known as Arthur, is a South Korean singer under GF Entertainment. He first debuted in 2017 as a member of the boy group VARSITY. After VARSITY's disbandment in 2020, he continued to train under a different agency. In 2021, he debuted once again, this time as a member of the boy group KINGDOM. He officially made his debut as a member of VARSITY on January 9, 2017 with the single "Round One". Arthur debuted as a member of KINGDOM on February 18, 2021 with their mini album History of Kingdom : PartⅠ. Arthur. Within the group Kingdom, he represents the Kingdom of Rain.

Hamada Asahi, also known by his stage name Asahi is a Japanese singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. He competed in YG's survival show YG Treasure Box where he qualified as a member of Magnum, the second debuting group from the show, but the plans were changed and instead of debuting two groups, YG Entertainment decided to debut all of the members in the group TREASURE. Asahi debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One.

Yoon Jin-young, better known by his stage name ASH ISLAND and formerly known as Clloud, is a South Korean rapper and singer. He first gained attention as a contestant on season 2 of Mnet’s High School Rapper, where he finished in 4th place. In November 2018, he signed under The Quiett’s sub-label Ambition Musik, marking the start of his professional career. ASH ISLAND officially debuted on March 22, 2019 with the release of his first full-length album Ash, which established his signature sound characterized by husky vocals, melodic rap, and emotional lyricism. Since then, he has built a strong presence in the Korean hip-hop scene and gained recognition for both his solo releases and collaborations with other prominent artists. On July 7, 2024, Yoon announced his marriage to Korean-Japanese rapper Chanmina, as well as her pregnancy with their first child. The couple welcomed their daughter on November 1, 2024.
Asher, born Kim Hyun-soo is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and composer who debuted under Dynasty Muzik in 2020.
Ato is the vocalist and maknae of triger. His official member color is Mint and his birthday is April 18th. He was announced as a member on June 16, 2021.

Ato, also known by his birth name Song Duhyun, is a South Korean trainee under C9 Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group NAZE and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Daily Note. He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Ato is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group Be.A, formerly known K-MUCH.

Kang Jung Woo, better known as Attack was a South Korean bassist and former member of the rock band TRAXX under SM Entertainment. He made his first television appearance in 2002 on the survival show "2002 Survival Audition, HeeJun VS. KangTa; Battle of The Century" and later featured alongside TRAXX on BoA's song "Rock With You" in December 2003. Shortly after the band released their fifth Japanese single "Cold Rain", Attack had decided to part ways with TRAXX.

Ayalon Adam is a Japanese-Australian trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. On November 29, he was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 67th place.

Ayden is a South Korean rapper under C9 Entertainment. In 2021, he made his official debut as the lead rapper of the boy group EPEX. He was revealed as the 8th and final member to join the group. He officially debuted in 2021with the mini-album ‘BIPOLAR Pt. 1: Prelude of Anxiety’.

Ayno is a South Korean rapper-songwriter. He is best known for being a member of the boy group VAV. He, along with Lou and Ziu, joined the group in 2017. Prior to debuting, he participated on the survival show "NO.MERCY" but was ultimately eliminated. He made his solo debut on March 12, 2024 with the digital single "Good Mistakes".
Ayumu is a Japanese trainee under Bill Entertainment. He is currently participating in SBS survival show titled "Universe League."

Fukuda Ayuta, also known as Ayuta made his first apperance on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2), where his fnal ranking was 35th place. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".
B-0 is a singer and streamer under Familya Entertainmente and is a member of the virtual group ARRIVAL.

B-Bomb is a South Korean singer and dancer under Seven Seasons. He is the sub-vocalist and main dancer of the boy group Block B and member of their sub-unit Block B BASTARZ. In July 2, 2019 He made his solo debut with the mini album "Dawn".

B-Joo is a South Korean singer under Hunus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XENO-T. His stage name comes from his real name ByungJoo, but also holds the meaning of 'Be With You' so that he'll always be with his fans. In 2017, he participated on the idol rebooting project show The Unit. He was eliminated in episode 14 and finished in 25th place. B-Joo enlisted on April 9, 2019.

Hong Ho Sung, popularly known as B-Side, is a member of the boy group N.O.M under JZ Factory Entertainment. He was added to the group in 2019 and made his official debut with N.O.M's 3rd single I'm Not But in August of 2020.
B:eta is a South Korean singer under APB Entertainment. He is the leader and main vocalist of the boy group AlphaBAT and a former member of HITT under his real name Hayong.

Kim Han Bin, also known by his stage name B.I., is a South Korean Rapper, Record Producer, and Founder of the label 131 Online. He is best known as the former leader of the boy group iKON. Prior to debuting, B.I appeared on Show Me The Money 3, where YG described him as the next G-Dragon. B.I left iKON and ended his exclusive contract with YG Entertainment in June 2019 after it was reported that he attempted to buy marijuana and LSD illegally in 2019. On February 27, 2020, Police confirmed that B.I tested negative for drug usage. B.I made his solo debut on 19 March 2021 with "Midnight Blue", under 131 Label. He wrote and composed all of iKON's songs, composed Winner’s “Empty”, and contributed in Epik High’s “Born Hater”, Blackpink’s “Whistle” and three of PSY’s songs: “Bomb”, “Last Scene” and “Auto Reverse”.
B.S. is a member of 14U. He is the leader of the Xplosive unit. B.S. stands for Be Special.

Baby Saja is a fictional rapper created for the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He is the main rapper and youngest member of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Danny Chung, a Korean-American rapper and songwriter under THEBLACKLABEL, provides his singing and rapping voice. Chung is known for his work with BLACKPINK, Jeon Somi, and CL. While Baby doesn't have spoken dialogue in the film, his rap lines, delivered by Chung, have received particular attention for their intensity. Baby's feature is inspired by Stray Kids' Hyunjin and BTS's Jungkook during his "Golden" era. This gives him the look of a cute but chaotic youngest member. Do not let his name fool you. Baby is not innocent. He delivers quick lines, unsettling smiles, and an unpredictable energy that make him the real wildcard of Saja Boys. He's the member most likely to charm unsuspecting fans and then leave them completely shattered.

Babylon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, dancer, and producer under Babylon Records. He originally debuted as a member of the boy group N-Train in 2011 under the stage name Soul J before the group disbanded in 2013.He debuted as a solo artist on June 30, 2015 with the digital single "Pray".
Bae Jae Ho is a South Korean trainee under Woollim Entertainment. He participated in the survival show Fantasy Boys. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.
Bae Jun Ho is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Bae Seung Yoon is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys. He was a contestant on Be Mbitious and Street Man Fighter.
Bae Woo Sul is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Baek Chung Kang is a Chinese singer best known for winning MBC's hit audition program Star Audition: The Great Birth in 2011. His powerful vocals and emotional depth quickly earned him public acclaim, establishing him as one of the standout talents of his season. He officially debuted on April 18, 2012, with the release of his digital single "I Miss You", under Thor Entertainment. He later released his first mini-album "All Night" on June 25, 2012. The project showcased his versatility across genres including ballad, dance, and rock, helping him carve out a unique presence as a solo artist. Baek later signed with FACE Entertainment, continuing to build his career through additional singles, drama OSTs, and live appearances. In late 2018, Baek was diagnosed with rectal cancer, which led to a significant hiatus from his musical activities. After undergoing treatment and making a full recovery, he returned to the spotlight with the single 'At the End'. In 2025, under new management with JNR Entertainment, he made a long-awaited comeback with the release of 'Closer and Closer', marking his return after more than six years. Baek Chung Kang is widely admired not only for his vocal strength and artistic range, but also for his resilience and determination, both personally and professionally.
Baek Jae Hyeon is a South Korean trainee under H.O.M.E Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Baek Jiho is a South Korean-Spanish trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Baek Joong Hoon is a South Korean singer and musical actor. He was a contesant on Wild Idol. His brother is Mix Nine/ Produce X 101 contestant/ former JxR member Baek Jin.
Baek Jun Hyuk is a South Korean trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Debut's Plan, where he ranked third, earning his place in IDID.
Baek Seung Heon, formerly known as BK, is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group AFOS.

Baekchan is a South Korean singer, rapper, and songwriter under his own agency, Thisisit Records. He made his official debut in 2008 as a member of the co-ed group 8eight. Baekchan eventually debuted as a soloist on March 23, 2011, with the mini album "What Really Love."
Jung Se Min is a South Korean singer under DNA Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist and maknae of the boy group Greatguys.
Baek Gyeul is a South Korean singer under E Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group E'LAST.
Baekhan, formerly known as Donghwan and Lee Han, is a South Korean rapper under Campus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group RoaD-B.

Baekho is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer who was formerly a member of NU'EST under Pledis Entertainment. He debuted with NU'EST on March 15, 2012, with the single Face and later gained recognition through Produce 101 Season 2 in 2017, where he finished in 13th place. While fellow member Minhyun joined Wanna One, Baekho and the remaining members formed NU'EST W, releasing three mini albums. In 2021, he made his musical debut as Haram in Midnight Sun. Following NU'EST’s disbandment in 2022, Baekho renewed his contract with Pledis and launched his solo career with the mini album Absolute Zero. Since then, he has released multiple digital singles, including Elevator, What Are We, and the collaboration Love Or Die with BIGONE. In March 2025, Baekho announced his departure from Pledis Entertainment after 13 years, with his final digital single under the agency, Off-Road, set for release on March 14, his last day with the company. His career has been marked by versatility, from idol group promotions to solo music production and theater. As he embarks on a new chapter, fans eagerly anticipate his next steps in the industry. On April 7, 2025, it was announced that Baekho (Kang Dong-ho) had launched "TEAM Baekho" to begin his solo career. He signed with Prismfilter Music Group for music activities and partnered with RND Company for management and RIZZCOMM for media promotion. The team aims to support his growth across music, broadcasting, and entertainment, while enhancing communication with fans, known as dOnO.

Byun Baekhyun is a South Korean singer and actor under INB100. He is a member of the boy group EXO, and its sub-units EXO-K and EXO-CBX. He is also the leader of the supergroup SuperM and a member of the virtual group HEARTSTEEL. He made his solo debut on July 10, 2019, with the mini album City Lights. Born on May 6, 1992, Baekhyun grew up with the passion to sing and perform which led him to practice his skills and become an official SM trainee in 2011. Eventually, Baekhyun made his official debut in 2012. Baekhyun also became an actor, famous for appearing in the drama "Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo." Baekhyun is the first solo artist in 19 years to become a million-seller since Kim Gunmo in 2001. He is also the second artist to earn the title "million-seller" both as a group and as a soloist following Seo Taiji of Seo Taiji and Boys. Since May 6, 2021, Baekhyun has been enlisted in South Korea's mandatory military service. Having been diagnosed with hypothyroidism, he is serving as a public service worker instead of an active-duty soldier. Baekhyun's expected discharge date from the military service is in 2023. On June 1, 2023, Baekhyun—together with Chen and Xiumin—revealed the termination of their exclusive contracts with SM Entertainment. On January 3, 10 Asia reported that Baekhyun established a company called INB100 for his solo activities on June 23, 2023, and will act as its CEO Director.

Baekjin, born as Jung Baek Jin is a South Korean singer and rapper under Vine Entertainment. He is one half of the duo JxR. He took part on the survival show MIXNINE, but was eliminated in the second elimination round. Baekjin was also a contestant on Produce X 101, but was eliminated episode 8.

Kim Hyunwoo, better known as Baekseung, is a South Korean rapper of the boy group EPEX under C9 Entertainment. Before making his official debut in 2021, Baekseung first appeared in the survival program "CAP-TEEN" as a trainee. In 2021 Baekseung acted in the drama "Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha" where he appeared in a couple of episodes playing the role of a famous 'first love' idol member.

Jang Baek-sik, better known simply as Baesik, is a South Korean independent rapper and singer-songwriter. Previously signed to Dynasty Muzik, he officially debuted on February 9, 2020 with the single "T.T.W.I.I".

Song Byeonghee, also known as Bain, is a member of the boy group JUST B under Bluedot Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Under Nineteen and Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor.
Bak Doha is a South Korean actor under Cube Entertainment. He was a contestant on the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet".

maleIdols.description: BamBam is a Thai singer, rapper, and entertainer under HALO Corporation. Originally from Bangkok, Thailand, he was cast by JYP Entertainment at a young age and moved to South Korea for training. He debuted as a member of GOT7 on January 16, 2014, with the single "Girls Girls Girls." Following the expiration of his contract with JYP Entertainment, BamBam signed with ABYSS Company on March 5, 2021. He made his solo debut in South Korea on June 15, 2021, with the EP "riBBon" and its title track of the same name. In 2023, he launched his YouTube web series "Bam House," where he interviews celebrity guests. On February 6, 2025, ABYSS Company announced BamBam's departure from the agency.
Bamby is a South Korean singer under VLAST. He is a member of the virtual boy group PLAVE.
Ban Daniel is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Bang Chan, born Bahng Christopher Chan, is a South Korean-Australian artist and the leader of the boy group Stray Kids under JYP Entertainment. He joined JYP in 2011 after passing an audition in Australia and trained for seven years. In 2016, he formed the hip-hop unit 3RACHA with fellow trainees Changbin and Han, releasing original music under the name “CB97.” He debuted as Stray Kids’ leader and main producer on March 25, 2018, with the album "I Am NOT". Bang Chan is also prolific songwriter and was promoted to a full member of the Korea Music Copyright Association (KOMCA) in 2023, with 208 songs registered under his name as of early 2025. In fashion, Fendi appointed him as a Brand Ambassador on January 16, 2025.
Bang Junwon is a singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Bang Su Hwan is a South Korean trainee under WITHUS Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Bang Ye Dam is a South Korean singer-songwriter under GF Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group TREASURE. Prior to this, he gained fame as the runner-up of the show “Kpop Star.” He was among the most sought-after idol trainees due to his vocals, particularly his performances in YG survival shows. His performances often went viral both domestically and internationally. On June 5, 2020, he made his solo debut with the digital single, "Wayo". He also debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020, with the single album, “The First Step: Chapter One”. He parted ways with YG Entertainment and the group on November 8, 2022. He then joined GF Entertainment and continued his career as a solo artist. On December 8th, 2023, Bang Yedam announced his new fandom name, "BY:D". The name represents the idea of being together with Bang Yedam in the future, expressing the idea of being by his side as his most precious existence.

Bang Yongguk is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and producer under YY Entertainment and CONSENT. He is a member of the boy group B.A.P and its subunit Bang & Zelo. In 2008, he debuted as a member of the underground hip-hop group Soul Connection under the stage name 'Jepp Blackman'. He then signed with TS Entertainment and was featured in Song Ji Eun's single "Crazy" in 2011, which attracted a lot of attention. He released his first single "I Remember" on August 12, 2011, and was part of the sub-unit duo Bang & Zelo with fellow labelmate Zelo later that year. He debuted in B.A.P on January 26, 2012, with their first single "Warrior". He left B.A.P on August 19, 2018, following the expiration of his contract with TS Entertainment. On September 15, he announced that he set up a one-man agency called CONSENT and that he would be making a solo comeback. On November 17, he announced his comeback with the digital single "Race", set to be released on November 23. On February 12, 2022, he posted a teaser on Instagram for his upcoming EP 2, set to be released on March 2. In an article on W Korea, it was revealed that his next album would be released this fall but was ultimately pushed back. On March 30, 2023, YY Entertainment announced that Bang Yongguk signed an exclusive contract with them as their first artist. On April 12, 2023, he announced his comeback with his first (labeled as second) mini album The Colors of Love, set to be released on May 2. A pre-release single, "Green", was released on April 17. Yongguk enlisted on August 1, 2019, as a public service worker. He was discharged on May 18, 2021.

Bao is a South Korean rapper and Twitch streamer under Nature Space entertainment. He is a former member of the boy groups LUCENTE and XD (formerly XEED). Bao debuted as a member of LUCENTE on September 18, 2018 with the release of their debut mini album "The Big Dipper". In April of 2021 Bao announced that he had left LUCENTE as his contract with NOGA had come to an end. He later stated his plans to release music on his own. In March of 2022, Bao was introduced as a member of the pre-debut group XEED. They debuted on December 1, 2022 with the mini album Dreamland. He later went on to make his solo debut with the single "Why So Serious?" on September 12, 2024.
June is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the boy groups DNT and SM☆SH. He was added to the group on July 18, 2014 alongside member June.
Baro, is a South Korean singer, rapper and actor. He is also a former member of South Korean boy group B1A4.
Baron is a South Korean singer and dancer under A Team Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group VAV (Very Awesome Voice) but left in 2023.
Basick, born Lee Cheol-joo is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Jiggy Fellaz in 2008.
Kim Ba Wool is a South Korean singer and musician. He is currently the drummer of the pre-debut group A.FACT.
Bbaekga is a South Korean rapper and photographer. He was added to the KOYOTE lineup in 2004 and has been a member since then.
BC, also known as Sungho, is an Korean-American rapper. He was a member of the boy group 1TEAM. He first appeared on Mnet's survival show BOYS24 and later on JTBC's survival show MIXNINE.

Be'O, born Yoo Chan-wook, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter known for his emotive lyricism and distinct vocal tone. Raised in Jongno District, Seoul, he developed an interest in hip hop after watching Show Me the Money 3, which inspired him to pursue a music career from his middle school years. He later graduated from the School of Performing Arts Seoul and gained early performance experience through his appearance on High School Rapper 3. His stage name “Be'O” is derived from his Christian name, Pio. He officially began his career in 2020 after signing with the hip hop label FameUs Entertainment, founded by rapper San E. That year, he participated in the label’s compilation albums God FameUs and Famous FameUs before making his solo debut with the single “Monster.” He continued to build momentum with the release of “Bipolar” in 2021, showcasing his evolving artistry and emotional depth. Be'O rose to mainstream prominence through his appearance on Show Me the Money 10 in 2021, where he became one of the breakout stars of the season. His performances on the show, including tracks like “Breathe,” “Limousine,” “MBTI,” and “Without You,” gained significant attention, with several of the songs topping the Gaon Digital Chart. He ultimately finished the show in third place, further solidifying his presence in the Korean hip hop scene. In December of that same year, he released the chart-topping single “Counting Stars” featuring Beenzino, which further elevated his popularity. Following his rise to fame, Be’O expanded his activities and signed a co-management deal with BPM Entertainment while remaining under FameUs. Around this time, he was also appointed as the brand ambassador for Kappa. In September 2022, he released his first extended play Five Senses, further showcasing his versatility and musical identity. In 2024, he returned with his second extended play Affection, continuing to explore personal and introspective themes through his music.
Been is a South Korean artist under PH Entertainment. He is a sub-vocalist of the Korean pop boy group MVP.

Lim Sung-bin, better known by the stage name Beenzino, is a South Korean rapper. His stage name is a play on that of Boston rapper Benzino, combined with "빈" (pronounced "been") from his birth name. Beenzino made his first official public appearance at Dok2's Hustle Real Hard Concert on June 5, 2011, and has since released three solo albums, as well as other works in collaboration with hip hop producers Primary and Shimmy Twice, and as the duo Hot Clip with South Korean rapper Beatbox DG. He is noted for his melodic style of rapping. After establishing his reputation within the Korean rap scene, he became well known through singles such as "Dali, Van, Picasso", which was a mainstream hit. Beenzino toured as a solo artist in the U.S. in 2015. In 2020, Beenzino left Illionaire Records and joined fellow rapper and friend E Sens after signing with Beasts and Natives Alike in 2021.

Bel is a South Korean rapper and singer. He was also a member of DUSTIN and its sub unit DUSTIN-ON under Na Entertainment. He left the group when they disbanded on May 24, 2021 and he wasn't apart of the lineup when the group reformed. In 2023, he participated in MBN' survival show "Show King Night" as part of the group URSA MAJOR.
Bella, is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of Kiwi Band and its subunit Kiwi. She made her solo debut on July 2, 2017 with the digital single "Blue Ocean".

Benjamin Jaewook Bae, known under the stage name Benji, is a Korean-American singer-songwriter, MC, DJ and musician. He is a former member of the boy group B.I.G and made his solo debut on August 29, 2019 with his first digital single "Telephone". On October 1, 2020 Benji has confirmed on his Instagram that he left the group.

Choi Beomgyu is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under BIGHIT MUSIC and HYBE Labels. He is best known as one of the visuals of the boy group TXT. Beomgyu is known for his unique charms and high energy. He is a mood-maker, as told by everyone around him. After training for three years, Beomgyu made his official debut on March 4, 2019, as a member of Big Hit's five-member boy group TXT (Tomorrow X Together). On January 21, 2019, Beomgyu was revealed as the fifth and last member of TXT. The group officially debuted on March 4, 2019, with their debut mini album "The Dream Chapter: STAR". He later made his solo debut on March 27, 2025 with Beomgyu's Mixtape:Panic.

Beomhan is a Chinese-American singer, rapper, and dancer. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group M.O.N.T Arena and is currently active as a solo artist. Beomhan first gained public attention as a trainee under FM Entertainment and was introduced as a member of M.O.N.T Arena. Before officially debuting, he began releasing music independently, sharing digital singles and participating in a variety of promotional events in the United States. During this period, he frequently collaborated with fellow trainee Jay Chang, appearing at K-pop festivals, pop-up events, and themed fan experiences where they also worked as baristas and hosts. In addition to his growing online presence, Beomhan took part in interactive U.S. tours alongside other M.O.N.T members, combining music showcases with meet-and-greets, fan activities, and gallery-style exhibitions. His grassroots promotional efforts helped build a dedicated international fanbase prior to his official debut. Following his departure from FM Entertainment, Beomhan transitioned into independent promotions. He made his solo debut with the digital single “Me Myself & I,” marking a new phase in his career. He later announced his second single, “D.U.M (Dancing Until Moonlight),” further establishing his identity as a self-directed artist.
Beomsoo is a South Korean singer under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XODIAC and a former member of the pre-debut boy group CLIMIX Boy Group.

Beomsoo is a member of the upcoming boy group IB147, they have 2 pre-debut releases out and are currently promoting in Japan, their official debut date is unknown. He is very good at dancing and serves as the team's dance teacher. On August 4th, 2024, a Twitter account for the upcoming group L5ST was opened, revealing 4 of 5 members being former IB147 members and one being a former Daychild member. Beomsoo was one of the members listed.

Bernard Park, formerly known as NakJoon from 2017 to 2020, is a Korean-American singer under JYP Entertainment label, Studio J. He was the winner of the competition show K-Pop Star 3. He debuted on October 13, 2014 with his first mini-album I'm.
Berry is a South Korean singer, songwriter and composer signed with White Moon Entertainment. He is one half of the K-indie duo Rocoberry under BrotherHood Entertainment.

BewhY is a South Korean rapper. Initially he chose 'BY' as a stage name, but changed it to 'BewhY' to give a meaning to the name. He won first place on Show Me the Money 5 in 2016. Rapper C JAMM is his old friend from high school. BewhY is also well known for being a devout Christian. He found his own hip-hop label DEJAVU GROUP in 2017. In October 2020, Bewhy married his non-celebrity girlfriend, with whom he had been dating for 8 years. He is considered as one of the fastest rappers in the industry and history.
Bian Shi Yu is a Chinese trainee under Top Class Entertainment, best known for participating in the survival shows Starlight Boys and Boys II Planet.
Nam Sung-min, popularly known as BIC, is a South Korean rapper and dancer under TOP Media Entertainment. He debuted in 2020 as a member of the boy group MCND.
Big Naughty is a South Korean rapper who debuted under H1GHR Music in 2019.

Bigman is a South Korean beatboxer, singer-songwriter, composer and producer under Sidus HQ. He made his debut with released single album "DAY BY DAY" on May 31, 2019. He is a contestant on the survival show Undercover and was a contestant on I Can See Your Voice 6 and Mr. Trot 2.

Bigone is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Choeun Entertainment as a member of 24K in 2012. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2017. He made his solo debut on October 20, 2017 with the digital single "W I N D M I L L".

Shin Dong-yeol, better known by his stage name Bill Stax, previously known as Vasco, is a South Korean rapper under Skrr Gang Business. He was a contestant on Show Me the Money 3. He debuted under Master Plan Production in 2004.

Bin is H.B.Y's leader and sub-vocalist. He used to be a soccer player before switching to be a musician. When he was young he dreamt of being a professional gamer so he signed up for a competition. It was here that he found out that it was not meant to be (he lost very badly).
Bing Hua is a Chinese trainee under RND Company. He is best known for competing on the survival shows PROJECT7, where he ranked 15th, and Boys II Planet.

Bit is a South Korean singer under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy groups BAE173 and Double 0ne. In 2024, he participated in the survival show Starlight Boys, but was eliminated in the last episode at rank 16.
Lee Chang Hyun, also known as Bit-to, is the main rapper and main dancer of the boy group UP10TION under TOP Media Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the group on September 10, 2015.

Bitsaeon is a South Korean singer under FM Entertainment. He is the main vocalist of the boy group M.O.N.T and a member of the upcoming boy group B.D.U. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MIXNINE and Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor. Bitsaeon was part of the winning team on Build Up. He will be part of B.D.U a project group that will promote for 2 years. The debut date is June 26, 2024.
Bizzy is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Feel Ghood Music in 2008.
BJ Wnjn is a South Korean Male Artist. He started in group Balming Tiger.
Black Nine is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Blacknine Records in 2016.
Blaise is an English-Belgian singer. He is a member of the boy group dearALICE.

Blanc is a South Korean singer, composer, and producer affiliated with MYSTIC Story. He is part of the male duo ANODE. Blanc, along with fellow ANODE member Anlee, has produced music for the artist Billlie.
BLASÉ is a South Korean rapper under AT AREA. He was in Hive Crew and was a member of Roof Top in 2018. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2018. He was also known as Bla$e Kid.
