maleIdols.description: Blink was a Thai singer under Zenith Media Contents. He is a former member of the international boy group Z-Boys and a part of the co-ed group Z-Stars.
Bloo is a South Korean rapper who debuted under MKIT Rain in 2016 with the single album "Drive Thru". He is a member of the crew “42”, and a member of duo “Neonblue” with Niahn.
BLUSH! is a South Korean guitarist and producer, member of the co-ed duo DALUNA.

Matthew Kim, popularly known as BM which stands for Big Matthew, is the main dancer and lead rapper of the group KARD under DSP Media. BM first participated in the show Kpop Star and became a trainee for 4 years and a half. He debuted as a member of KARD on July 19, 2017, with the mini album Hola Hola. He represents the letter K and the King card. BM eventually debuted as a soloist with his first digital single, "Broken Me" on June 9, 2021. In 2021, BM began selling "Big Tiddie Gang" merchandise through his apparel brand Staydium, with a share of the proceeds going to breast cancer research and awareness.

Kim Ji Won, popularly known as Bobby. He is the main rapper and producer of the boy group iKON. Bobby was born in Seoul, South Korea but later moved to Fairfax, Virginia, United States with his parents until he was in high school. Bobby first appeared in the 2013 survival program "W.I.N Who is Next" as a member of the boy group Team B. He also competed in the third season "Show Me the Money" where he finished as the champion. He eventually made his official debut in October 2015 as the main rapper of iKON (formerly called Team B). On August 20, 2021, Bobby suprised everyone when he announced that he would get married later in the year and that he will become a father by September of the same year. In 2023 he announced his official club in Japan and also the name of his solo fanbase "S.I.R".
Bohoon is the lead guitarist and main vocalist of the South Korean rock band Purple Rain. Currently he releases music under his one-man band named THE VANE.
Bohyeon is a South Korean trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows Project 7 and B:MY BOYZ.
BornB is a member of the boy group Be.A.

Choi Bomin is a South Korean dancer, singer, and actor. He debuted as a member of the boy group Golden Child under Woollim Entertainment on August 28, 2017. Choi Bomin made his acting debut in the second season of the web drama 'A-TEEN' in 2019. He then played in other series such as '18 Again' in 2020, and 'Shadow Beauty' in 2021. From September 29, 2022, to February 13, 2023, he was on hiatus due to an incident where he was hit in the face with a golf club by another person while practicing for his individual schedule. On August 27, 2024, Woollim Entertainment announced that Choi Bomin did not renew his contract and would be leaving the group and the agency.

Bon, formerly known as B.Nish, is a South Korean singer. He is best known as a member of the group D.I.P and a former member of the group XENEX. Originally planning to debut in a group called Lose Control alongside Taeha, Seungho, Soomin and Hyeongseong, the group's debut plans fell through. The five later signed with Inter B.D Entertainment and debuted in the group D.I.P. The group disbanded after only 2 years of activity in November of 2018. Later in 2019 he, Taeha, and Uhyeong debuted in the group XENEX.
Bon is the leader and main vocalist of the boy group, Blue Zone boys under Chrome Entertainment. He used to be a well known Ulzzang before debuting.

Bonggeun is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group T:EV and a former member of the boy group AQA and the busking group D.O.B. He made his solo debut with the digital single "Umbrella" on October 12, 2018. In April 2025, Bonggeun and the other members of T:EV departed from Startree, the agency under which they debuted. As of now, he is not signed to any entertainment company.
Bongjun is a South Korean singer. He debuted in 2011 as a member of the now-disbanded boy group N.SONIC.
Bongwoo is a South Korean guitarist, member of the co-ed group Lubless.
Boseong is a South Korean rapper, singer, and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO.

Boun was a singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group TARGET until September, 2021, although no official statement was released. He made his solo debut on April 22nd, 2022 as an independently produced artist.
Han Minho, also known as Bourbon, is a South Korean singer who debuted under the boy group "Purebooy" and participated on the survival show "Produce 101 Season 2".
Boycold, born Jung Sung-won, is a South Korean producer who debuted under Sony Music in 2018.

BOYHOOD is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter, composer, producer, and musician. He is a former member of the boy band South Club. He made his solo debut on July 26, 2020 with the digital single "Retro Love". On February 18, South Club performed at the Rolling Hall 23rd Anniversary Concert, and Donghyun was introduced as their new bassist. His first release with the band was their second mini album, 20. Sometime after, he left the band. In 2019, he became a contestant of Mnet's reality survival show, Produce X 101. He was eliminated in the episode 8 after ranking 60th place. On July 21, it was announced that he would make his solo debut, with a self-produced song, on July 26. In that day, a set of concept photos was released. On July 22, the official teaser for the music video was released. In 2022, he participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Boyul is a South Korean singer signed with WEUS Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WEUS.

Hwang Dongjun, known professionally as Brad, is a South Korean singer, rapper, songwriter, and music producer. He first gained recognition as a member of the boy group GHOST9, where he served as a main vocalist and rapper. After departing from the group in 2021, he took a break from the spotlight before reintroducing himself under the stage name Brad in 2025. Before his group debut, he was active as a solo artist under the name $ept Rabbit, where he showcased his songwriting and producing skills. His music blends genres such as hip hop, R&B, and pop, often characterized by introspective lyrics and experimental production. As Brad, he made a comeback with a fresh sound and image, marking a new chapter in his artistic journey. Brad is known for his reserved yet confident demeanor, a sharp creative vision, and a dedication to artistic independence. In addition to his solo work, he has also contributed behind the scenes as a producer for various other artists.
Brad Moore is an American musician and songwriter, best known as the drummer of the indie rock band Busker Busker.

BRADYSTREET is a Korean-American rapper who debuted under Heart Tears in 2018 with the EP 'Cocaine Lullaby'. On January 29, 2021, he was unveiled as a new member of Daytona Entertainment. The rap name, Bradystreet, is said to be derived from the town where he lived. He released his debut album 'Jack Frost' on January 29, 2021.
Brian, born Brian He, is a Chinese-Canadian idol under FNC Entertainment. He is a vocalist of the boy group AMPERS&ONE. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show, "Boys Planet."

Brian is a Korean-American singer and one-half of the R&B duo Fly to the Sky. His first solo album, The Brian, was released in December 2006. His second solo album, Manifold was released in December 2009.
Brody is a South Korean singer-producer under MPLIFY. He made his solo debut on October 13, 2022 with the digital single "Yuwol". He re-debuted on February 6, 2025 with the digital single "Why".

BROOKLYN, also known as BROOKLYN Juliana, is a South Korean K-pop singer under Masefield Entertainment. He made his debut on August 9, 2019, with the single “Young Love”. As of June 2025, He is no longer active in the K-Pop genre and has undergone a full rebrand, including a name change, completely new musical direction, and removal of previous works from streaming services and other platforms.
Brother Su is a South Korean singer-songwriter and record producer. Su debuted in 2010 and has been signed under Starship Entertainment's subsidiary label Starship X since 2015.

Buffy is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the boy group MADTOWN and the unit duo Pro C. On November 10, 2017, Buffy posted a letter to the fan cafe announcing his departure from MADTOWN. He also announced his enlistment date to be on November 20. He is currently uploading songs to SoundCloud under the name HENNEXXI. On November 10th 2017, Buffy announced that he left the group and he enlisted in the military. He was discharged on August 9, 2019.
Yoon Byung-ho, better known as Bully Da Ba$tard, is a South Korean Rapper under Fame Records and member of the co-ed hip-hop group DiCKIDS. He made his solo debut in 2016 with the song "Slaughter".
Bumjin is a South Korean singer under XX Entertainment. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening. He debuted as a soloist on June 3, 2018, with the song “Love Is” for the OST of The Rich Son.
Bum Jun is a South Korean musician and model under UZUROCKS Entertainment and GOGO2020. He is the leader and drummer of the boy band 2Z.

Bumkey is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Brand New Music. He was a member of the boy group TROY and the duo 2winS. He made his solo debut on June 3, 2013 with the digital single "Bad Girl".
Bumzu is a South Korean composer and soloist under Pledis Entertainment. He debuted as a soloist on June 14, 2011 with the song Oh My Girl.

BX is a South Korean rapper under C9 Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group CIX. In October 2017, he became a contestant on the survival show MIXNINE. He ranked 9th in the finale, thus becoming a member of the final group. However, the group's debut was ultimately cancelled. In November 2018, BX became a contestant on the survival show YG Treasure Box. He was eliminated in the show's final episode. He debuted as a member of C9 Entertainment's boy group CIX on July 23, 2019 with the mini album 'Hello' Chapter 1. Hello, Stranger.
Byeon Seong Tae, or simply Seong Tae, is a South Korean actor under DSP Media. He is best known for participating in the reality show MIXNINE and Produce X 101.
Byeongcheol is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the project boy group Nonstop.He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys

Byeong Min is a South Korean singer signed with HF Music Company. He is best known as a member of the boy group Classmate In October 2021, Seong Jeong appeared as a contestant on SBS TV's competitive survival show, Kookmin Singer, as part of Classmate's group participation. Seong Jeong along with his teammates were eventually eliminated but finished within the 'Top 111' ranks (ranks after 40 for individuals were not assigned).
Byul is a South Korean singer and member of the now-disbanded boy group N.SONIC.

Byulha is a South Korean singer and V-Tuber under 99Major. He debuted as a singer with the collaborative song "Song For You" with Lokid. A month later, on May 16, 2022, he debuted as a solo artist with his song "Love Alone." In August 2023, it was announced that Byulha would be joining the virtual group For The More as a vocalist. He re-debuted with the group on September 30, 2023, with the single "Love Set."
Byun Jeongho is a South Korean bassist, member of the rock band CNEMA. He was a contestant on SuperBand 2. In the past, he was the bass player in the bands LOY, YOON and Diversity.
Byung Hun is a South Korean rapper, singer and actor under SidusHQ. He is a former member of the boy group TEEN TOP.

Choi Byung-chan is a South Korean singer and actor under New Way Company. Byunchan debuted as a member of VICTON on November 9, 2016, with the mini album 'Voice To New World.' In May 2019, he, alongside fellow member Han Seung Woo, became a contestant on the survival show Produce X 101. However, on July 11, it was announced he would be leaving the show due to health issues.
Byungho is a South Korean real estate agent and former singer. He was a member of the boy group 24K.

Choi Byunghoon is a South Korean singer under COMMAND THE-M Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 27, 2023 as a member of the boy group CMDM. Before debuting, Choi Byunghoon joined the hit survival program "Produce X 101" as a trainee under Majesty Entertainment, but was sadly eliminated in episode 5 after ranking 98th place. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 5 after ranking 90th place.
C Jamm is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Sexy Steet and Yello Music in 2013.
C:ode is a former member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.

C.A.P is a South Korean rapper and songwriter. He is a former member of the boy group TEEN TOP. C.A.P's stage name came from his love for hats. He loves designing and has many tattoos all over his body.

C.I. is a Chinese singer under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He was a pre-debut member of the boy group OCJ NEWBIES and a former member of the boy group LIMITLESS. He is best known for participating in the Chinese reality show Asia Super Young.
Cai Cheng Yuan is a Chinese trainee under Ningbo Huajieyu Film and Television Culture Media Co., Ltd. He is best known for participating in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Cai Jin Xin is a Chinese trainee under EE - Media. He best known for competing on the survival shows "Boys Planet" and "Boys II Planet".

Car, the garden is a South Korean singer under DRDRamc. He originally debuted under the name Mayson the Soul in September 2013 with the single "Bus Stop" but changed to his current name in 2016 after moving agencies.
Casper was a rapper in the group Cross Gene. He was also known as the Wild Chic Gene.
Castle J, born Son Sung Jun, is a South Korean rapper and composer under TOP Media. In 2020, he made his official debut as the main rapper of the boy group MCND.

Cha Dohyun, formerly known as Kim Sunghyun, is a South Korean rapper and singer. He is best known as a former member of the boy group IN2IT, which was formed through the pre-debut survival project BOYS24. In May 2019, he participated in the Mnet survival program Produce X 101 as a contestant representing Stone Music Entertainment. He was eliminated in episode 8, ranking 44th overall. On September 5, 2019, his agency MMO Entertainment announced his departure from IN2IT, citing personal reasons. Shortly after, Dohyun shared a statement via his personal Instagram, explaining that his decision was due to unresolved family matters and financial difficulties, including not receiving payment since his debut. MMO responded publicly, describing his claims as one-sided and stating their intent to take legal action in response to defamation. Since then, Cha Dohyun has continued his career as a content creator and performer, most notably as a founding member of the creative collective Season House.

Cha Eun Woo is a South Korean singer and actor under Fantagio Music. He is a member of the boy group ASTRO and a former member of the project group S.O.U.L. Eunwoo debuted as a member of ASTRO on February 23, 2016 with the album "Spring Up". He made his acting debut in 2014 in the drama "Modern Farmer". He also starred as the main lead in dramas such as "My ID is Gangnam Beauty", "Rookie Historian Goo Hae Ryung", "True Beauty", "Island","Wonderful World" and " A Good Day to be a Dog ". Cha Eun woo enlisted in the Republic of Korea Army on July 28, 2025. He is expected to be discharged by January 27, 2027.
Cha Joo Hyuk previously known as Kangho was a South Korean Singer and an original male member of the K-POP co-ed group, Co-ed School under MBK Entertainment.
Cha Sun Hyung is a South Korean actor and singer. He was a contestant on Wild Idol. He was elimininated in Ep. 3.
Chaboom is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Chiko Bros. Ent in 2014 and the CEO of the hiphop label, LBNC (Lay Back N Chill).
Im Junyeop, also known as Chael, is a singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023.

Chaemin is a South Korean singer under J-Star Entertainment. He is the main dancer of the boy group N.TOP, having been introduced as part of the group’s original lineup through official channels. Known for his strong performance skills, Chaemin officially made his debut with N.TOP through their first single album "We:Disconnect," marking the beginning of his career in the K-Pop industry.

Chaepyoung is a South Korean trainee under SM Entertainment. He gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Mr. Trot 2. He is set to debut as a member of the upcoming trot boy group MYTRO.

Chan, also known as Chanwoo or Jung Chan-woo, is a South Korean singer, actor, model, and maknae of the group iKON. He is known for playing the younger counterpart of Lee Minho in both Boys Over Flowers and The Heirs. In 2006, he was part of the entertainment agency Fantagio and portrayed the younger Max Changmin in TVXQ's music video "Balloons". In 2008, he appeared in Lost and Found and several subsequent dramas, starting with The Great King Sejong. In 2014, he joined the survival show Mix & Match and competed for a spot in the group iKON against the original B-team members. In July 2018, Chan started his YouTube channel, "Chanwoosari". The official name of his fandom is "Changus" granted through his youtube channel which mostly dedicated to video games, vlogs, and his daily life. In 2022 he returned to acting as the lead in the movie drama "My Chilling Roommate".

Cho Chanhyuk is a South Korean rapper and record producer. He first appeared in the survival show "WORLD KLASS" where he finished second place, allowing him to debut as the main dancer, lead rapper, and producer of the boy group TO1. Chan debuted as a member of TO1 on April 1, 2020, with their first mini album Reason for Being : Benevolence. On September 18, 2021, he released his first mixtape [Moth] under the name IRI.

CHÁN (formerly known as Kyle; real name Kim Chan) is a South Korean singer currently active as a soloist under The Vault. He is a former contestant on *Produce 101 Season 2* and *Project 7*, and was previously a member of the groups ATEEN, UTH, and the pre-debut group AMBITION. Although some fan sources report that he departed AMBITION in January 2025, no official confirmation of his withdrawal from the group or Wells Entertainment has been made public. He made his solo debut on February 20, 2025, with the digital single "Saucy."

Heo Chan is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Play M Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group VICTON. Chan specializes in Hip Hop and Urban Choreography. He was also considered the mood maker of the group thanks to his 4D Personality. Chan debuted with Victon on November 9, 2016, with their first mini album "Voice To New World". However, on October 11, 2022, IST Entertainment (formerly Play M) announced his departure from the group due to a DUI incident.
Chan Young is a male kpop idol. His group is currently unknown.

Chancellor is a South Korean-American singer-songwriter and producer under KONNECT Entertainment. He is a former member of the hip-hop group Oneway. He is also the co-founder and former member of the producing team Duble Sidekick.
Chang Yu Hong is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Seo Changbin is a South Korean rapper, lyricist, singer, and music producer under JYP Entertainment. He is the main rapper of the boy group Stray Kids and its sub-unit 3RACHA. In late 2016, Changbin formed the hip-hop crew 3RACHA with trainees Bang Chan (“CB97”) and HAN (“J.One”), using the stage name “SPEARB”. They released self-composed extended plays on SoundCloud and on HipHople, an online hip-hop forum and community throughout 2017. On October 12, 2017, his picture and name were revealed for his participation in the survival show "Stray Kids," where he was introduced as a producer and rapper. On December 19, 2017, it was confirmed that Changbin would debut with the boy group Stray Kids. Changbin debuted as a member of Stray Kids on March 25, 2018, with the mini album titled, "I Am Not." On February 3, 2023, he alongside the rest of 3RACHA, was promoted as a regular member of KOMCA, a Korean Music Copyright Association, which makes him eligible to be able to vote and become part of the board. As of October 15, 2024, Changbin has 166 songs copyrighted under KOMCA. On October 15, 2024, Changbin produced and was featured in ITZY's 9th mini album, "GOLD", with the b-side titled "VAY".
Changgyu is a former member of the group UNVS. He was the fourth member to be revealed on August 30, 2019.
Song Changha is a South Korean idol trainee under Kiwi Media Group. In 2019, he appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
Changhun is a South Korean singer under Victory Company. He is a member of the boy group NTX.
Changhyeon is a South Korean trainee under CTDENM. He is a member of the upcoming boy group CTDROOKIES. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7.
Changhyun is a South Korean rapper under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group W.A.O.

Choi Jong Hyun, popularly known as Changjo, is the main dancer, vocalist, and maknae of the boy group Teen Top". Changjo also appeared as an actor in the 2014 drama "Sweden Laundry" and the 2015 film "Makgeolli Girls".
Lee Chang Min, also known simply as Changmin, is a South Korean singer, musical actor, and MC under MAJOR9. He is a member of the boy group 2AM, and a former member of the duo Homme.

Ku Chang‑mo, known mononymously as CHANGMO is a South Korean rapper, vocalist, producer & multi‑instrumentalist. He debuted in the underground scene with mixtapes in 2014 (“Time to Get Money”, “Ready to Be a Star #DBJB”) and officially marked his debut with his self-produced studio album "M O T O W N" (2016). That same year, he joined Ambition Musik, the sub-label founded by Dok2 and The Quiett, which significantly boosted his exposure. He plays instruments like piano and bass, and produces nearly all his own tracks. He turned down two opportunities to attend prestigious Berklee College of Music due to financial constraints. He made his breakout with his debut studio album "Boyhood" (2019). The albums spawned the single “METEOR", which topped charts and earned him the Best R&B/Hip-Hop Award and Hip-Hop Track of the Year at the 2020 Golden Disc Awards. Changmo served as a producer on Show Me The Money 777 in 2018 and continued to release chart-topping projects such as "Underground Rockstar" (2021), which included singles like “Hyperstar” and “Taiji.” These tracks earned him accolades at the Korean Hip-Hop Awards and the Korean Music Awards in 2022. After his contract with Ambition Musik ended on April 7 2025, Changmo went onto establish his indepenent label MORIENT.

Lee Chang-sub is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He is the lead vocalist of the South Korean boy group, BTOB. Lee Changsub was born in Suwon, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea. He studied Practical Music at Howon University with group-mate Lim Hyunsik. Changsub debuted as a member of BTOB on March 21, 2012, with the digital single "Insane". He made his solo debut on December 11, 2018 with the mini album Mark. He enlisted on January 14, 2019. On August 21, 2020 Changsub completed his military service.

Lee Changsun is a South Korean former singer under Think Entertainment. He first debuted in August 2016 as a member of the boy group 24K (now known as 24K +). In 2021, Changsun joined the survival program "Wild Idol" where he finished first place, qualifiying him to debut as a member of the project boy group TAN. On June 30, 2023 Changsung's contract with Choeun Entertainment ended marking his conclusion of activities with 24K. He will continue his activities as a member of TAN. On June 29, 2024 Changsun announced on the TAN's official fan cafe that TAN had disbanded and he is stepping down as leader as he leaves the idol industry.

Joo Chang Uk, better known as Changuk, is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 28, 2020, as a member of the boy group DRIPPIN. When he was a trainee, Changuk participated in the hit reality show Produce X 101 where he finished 29th place.
Changwoo is a former-member of 5TION under IV Entertainment.
Changwoo is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He was a member of the boy group TROY.
Chanhyo is a South Korean singer. He is the maknae of the boy group WeNU and a former member of the boy group SIGMA.

Lee Chanhyuk, also known as Chanhyuk (찬혁), is a South Korean singer-songwriter under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the sibling duo AKMU, who rose to fame after winning the second season of K-pop Star in 2012.
Chanhyun is apart of Co-Ed group Messgram

Kang Chanhee, popularly known as Chani, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under FNC Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 5, 2016 as the maknae and rapper of the boy group SF9. Before debuting, Chani was a child actor who starred in the MBC drama "Queen Seondeok". He continued acting after debuting as an idol and starred in dramas such as "Sky Castle", "Signal", and "Miracle".
Chanseung is a South Korean singer under Campus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group RoaD-B.

Lee Chan Sol is a South Korean singer and musician under IST Entertainment. He is best known as the leader and vocalist of the rock band BANDAGE. On January 6, 2023, IST Entertainment released a statement announcing the termination of the contract between the members and the company.

Chansung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper and actor under L' July Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 2PM. He made his debut as an actor in the 2006 comedy series High Kick!.He officially left JYP Entertainment after his contract expired on January 25, 2022. He signed with L' July Entertainment on March 3, 2022 as an actor, but he will still continue his activities as a member of 2PM.

Roy, also known as Chanwook, is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DAYCHILD, a former member of the boy group WEUS, and a former pre-debut member of the boy group Black Level. On August 4th, 2024, a Twitter account for the upcoming group L5ST was opened, revealing 4 of 5 members being former IB147 members and one being a former Daychild member. Chanwook was one of the members listed.

Park Chanyeol is a South Korean rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor under SM Entertainment. He debuted in 2012 as a member of the South Korean boy group EXO and its sub-units EXO-K. He later debuted in the sub-unit EXO-SC, alongside member Sehun, in 2019. In November 2019, Chanyeol launched a YouTube channel named "Studio NNG" for a project, in collaboration with an SM Entertainment Director MQ who also is a part of the performance group BeatBurger. Chanyeol enlisted as an active-duty soldier on March 29, 2021, and ended his military service on September 27, 2022. Chanyeol had his official solo debut on August 28, 2024, with his first mini-album, Blackout.
Lee Chanyeon is a South Korean Singer under Parastar Entertainment. He is member of the group South Korean hard of hearing boy group, Big Ocean.
Kim Chan-yong is a South Korean rapper and singer. He used to be the main rapper of the now-disbanded boy group 100%.
Chan Young is a South Korean singer under Ai Grand Korea. He is a member of the boy group D-CRUNCH and its pre-debut sub-unit Geupsik-Dan.

Cho Yong-pil is a legendary South Korean singer-songwriter under YPC Company and Universal Music Group. He is known for his groundbreaking contributions to Kpop and the broader Korean music industry. Often referred to as a pioneer and one of the pillars of Korean music, Cho has maintained an influential career for over five decades, releasing 20 albums and remaining consistently relevant across generations. He began his music journey in 1968 as a guitarist for the rock band Atkins, which performed for U.S. military bases in Korea. After stints with bands like Five Fingers and Kim Trio, Cho launched his solo career in 1976 with the release of "Come Back to Busan Port", a song that gained widespread popularity in South Korea and Japan. His early success positioned him as a major solo act, allowing him to break international ground. In 1980, Cho became the first Korean artist to hold a solo concert at Carnegie Hall in New York City. Other firsts followed this milestone: he was the first South Korean singer to perform in China in 1988 and in Pyongyang, North Korea, in 2005. By 1994, he had also become the first South Korean artist to surpass one million record sales, reinforcing his commercial dominance. Although his mainstream popularity slowed in the 1990s due to the rise of younger artists like Seo Taiji and Boys, Cho remained active through live performances and large-scale concerts. In 2013, he returned to the spotlight with his 19th album, Hello, which topped the charts and featured hit singles like "Bounce." That same year, Gallup Korea named him Singer of the Year, with "Bounce" selected as Song of the Year. To commemorate his 50th year in the industry, Cho held nationwide anniversary concerts in 2018. He followed this with the release of the single album Road to 20 – Prelude 1 in 2022, and in 2024, he unveiled his 20th full-length album, 20, marking an impressive return 11 years after his last studio release. Cho Yong-pil’s enduring legacy is marked not only by his musical innovation but also by his role in elevating Kpop onto the global stage.

In late 2023, he announced a shift to performing under his birth name, launching his own label CTYL (Coming To You Live) to pursue a more authentic creative process. As Dabin, he released his debut album Giggles in 2024. Continuing this new chapter, he dropped his fourth EP, senseS, in 2025, further showcasing his evolving artistry while maintaining his ties to DPR. Though he has temporarily stepped back from the DPR LIVE persona, Dabin has expressed intentions to revisit it in the future, reflecting an ongoing creative evolution. As of 2025, Hong Da-bin/Dabin represents a matured artist balancing personal authenticity with the innovative spirit of the DPR collective, continually pushing boundaries in Korean hip-hop and R&B.

Dane is a South Korean singer-songwriter who debuted on October 10, 2024, with his single "Selfie." This partnership culminated in the production of "Selfie." Dane's musical style is influenced by artists such as Daniel Caesar, whose song "Get You" profoundly impacted him and steered his interest towards the R&B genre. He aspires to deliver genuine and heartfelt music, focusing on simplicity to highlight the emotional depth of his songs.

DAYN, who is in charge of vocals and guitar and member of NND. He began learning guitar in elementary school, and began studying abroad around the time his identity was formed. Through this, he was exposed to music in a more expansive environment, and thanks to interacting with various people from various countries, he was able to develop a clear artistic perspective. The title of the first album [Wonder, I], which risked his life to the extent that he quit college to join a band and began a full-fledged music career, represents the hope that everyone will have a moment when they become the main character. NND's first album, created with much attention to the emotional aspect of providing comfort and strength through empathy and understanding through music, conveys realistic lyrics and emotions based on what they felt and learned in everyday life.

Ryu Sang-gu, better known by his stage name Deepflow, is a South Korean rapper, music producer, and founder of the hip-hop label Vismajor Company (VMC). He is widely recognized for his significant contributions to the Korean hip-hop scene. His stage name, Deepflow, was inspired by the legendary American hip-hop duo Mobb Deep. He began his music career in 2003, and officially made his solo debut in 2007 with the album Vismajor. Originally established as a hip-hop crew, Vismajor Company evolved into a full-fledged label under Deepflow’s leadership. He founded the label in the early 2010s to support then-underground artists such as Don Mills & Nucksal. After the company dissolution in 2023, they have returned to their original state as a crew. In recognition of his influence and artistry, Deepflow was named Musician of the Year at the 2016 Korean Music Awards. His 2015 album 'Yanghwa' is frequently cited as a defining moment in the Korean underground hip-hop movement. He has served as a mentor/producer on Show Me the Money 777 and the first two seasons of High School Rapper. Deepflow is credited writing EXO’s ‘Monster’ and RIIZE’s ‘Fly Up’.

Dokyun, formerly known by the stage name DK, is a South Korean singer currently under DS Entertainment. He was previously a member of the pre-debut boy group DV.OL and the boy group BLANK2Y before embarking on a solo career. He officially debuted as a soloist on April 25, 2025 with the digital single Light On Me. He first came into the spotlight in early 2022 when Keystone Entertainment revealed him as a member of their upcoming boy group BLANK2Y. On January 7, the company’s CEO hinted at his role as the oldest member of the team, describing him as a “new face.” He was formally introduced on February 26 as the group’s eighth member, and later that year, on May 24, BLANK2Y made their debut with the mini album K2Y I : Confidence [Thumbs Up]. After a little over a year of activities, Dokyun and several members chose to part ways with Keystone Entertainment. On June 27, 2023, he, along with Louis, U, Sungjun, and Sodam, terminated their exclusive contracts. By August 16, the same group of former members had signed with DS Entertainment. Two months later, on October 24, he was announced as part of DS Entertainment’s upcoming boy group DV.OL. However, his path shifted once again in September 2024, when it was revealed that he had departed DV.OL and would prepare instead for a solo debut in the following year. In April 2025, Dokyun confirmed plans for his first solo release. On April 14, he shared news of his debut single Light On Me, which was officially released on April 25. His solo work continued quickly after: on June 20, he teased his second digital single Better With You, releasing a snippet of the track before its official launch on August 6. Just days later, on August 8, he announced his third single Unbound, which was released on August 13. Outside of music, Dokyun’s health briefly interrupted his career in 2022. Shortly after his debut with BLANK2Y, he underwent emergency surgery for acute appendicitis on May 27 and was placed on temporary rest for two to three weeks. During this time, the group continued promotions with eight members while he focused on recovery.

Domo is a member of the South Korean boy group Like a Movie. as of January 17, 2024 LAM’s DOMO has announced that he has officially left LAM after news that he has been charged with avoiding military service.
Don Malik is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Daze Alive Music in 2014.

Don Mills is a South Korean rapper signed with Mine Field. He debuted under Beyond Records in 2013. In addition to being a rap mentor in the popular reality show Produce 101 Season 2, he also participated in the 10th Season of Show Me The Money.
Dong Dong is a trainee under Stardust Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."
Im Dong Geon is a South Korean musician, best known for being the bassist of the indie band "Hyukoh".

Song Donggeon is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group TO1 under WAKEONE. He first appeared in the survival program WORD KLASS where he finished fifth place, allowing him a spot in the group. Donggeon debuted as a member of TO1 on April 1, 2020 with their first mini album Reason for Being : Benevolence.
Dong Jing Kun is a trainee under Dragon Team Film and Television Culture. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Dong Q is a South Korean singer and musician under Wavy Seoul. He is the Drummer of the boy band wave to earth.
Dong Zi Qi is a Chinese trainee under Top Class Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Kim Dongbin is a South Korean trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He participated in several survival programs such as "Produce 101 Season 2" and "Produce X 101".
Donggyu is a South Korean trainee under Macaroni Media. He is a member of the boy group L5ST. On August 31, 2024, Donggyu was revealed as a member.
Lee Dong Hae is a South Korean singer and actor under ODE Entertainment. He is famous for being a member of the group Super Junior and its sub-units Super Junior-M and Super Junior-D&E.

Kim Donghan is a South Korean singer under OUI Entertainment. In 2017, he appeared in the second season of the boy group survival program "Produce 101 Season 2." Although he was eliminated, Donghan still managed to debut as a member of the temporary project boy group JBJ. After JBJ disbanded, he made his official solo debut in 2018 with the mini-album "D-Day." In 2020, it was announced that Donghan would debut again, this time as the lead vocalist and main dancer of the boy group WEi. He debuted with WEi in October 2020 with the mini-album "Identity: First Sight."

Dongheon is a South Korean rapper currently under Jellyfish Entertainment. He debuted as the leader and rapper of boy group VERIVERY on January 9, 2019, with their debut mini album Veri-Us. In 2025, he was revealed as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Shin Dong Ho is a South Korean singer, actor, and DJ. He is a former member of the South Korean boy group, U-KISS under NH Media. Dongho appeared in many reality shows and other productions--His first acting role was as a middle-school student for "Villain and Window". Dongho also performed in the MBC drama, "Royal Family". He also voiced the lead character in a 3-D animation movie, "Hong Gil Dong 2084" (2011). In 2012, He was cast for a TV-movie series, "Holy Land". On October 16, 2013, NH Media announced that Dongho would be leaving U-KISS. He then chose to leave the entertainment industry the same year. Dongho is now a DJ with the name "DJ Rushin' Justin".

Lee Donghwa is a South Korean singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip. In January 5, 2025, Donghwa was revealed as the 3rd member of KickFlip. He officially debuted with the group's first single album "Umm Great".
Donghwa is a South Korean rapper under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group W.A.O.
Donghwi is a South Korean singer. He is the main vocalist of the boy group Greatguys.
Donghyeok is a vocalist in The King

Donghyeon is a South Korean singer and dancer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip. He was revealed as a contestant on the SBS audition show Loud on May 20, 2021. In the final round, Donghyeon, along with four other members, won the online vote, securing their automatic inclusion in JYP Entertainment's upcoming boy group.
Donghyuk, formerly known as Avin, is a South Korean singer under Keystone Entertainment. He was a member of the boy groups BLANK2Y and ENOi.

Kim Dong Hyun, better known as Donghyun, is a South Korean singer, music producer, and actor under Brand New Music. He is the visual of the boy group AB6IX and a member of its project unit, MXM. Donghyun is also a member of the one-time project group YDPP and the fictional band LUNA from the 2021 drama 'Let Me Be Your Knight.' In 2017, as a trainee, Donghyun participated in the second season of the hit survival show 'Produce 101' along with the other four trainees from his agency. He ranked 28th overall, rendering him unable to debut as a member of Wanna One. Despite this, his appearance on the show opened different opportunities for him. In the same year, Donghyun and Lim Young Min debuted as the duo MXM with the mini album 'Unmix.' He also became a member of his agency's pre-debut group, BRANDNEWBOYS, which will later be called AB6IX. Moreover, on April 5, 2018, Donghyun debuted in a project boy group between Starship Entertainment and Brand New Music called YDPP with the digital single "Love It Live It." Besides singing, Donghyun also debuted as an actor through the web drama "Monchouchou Globalhouse."
Kim Dong-hyun is a South Korean singer and actor under SidusHQ. He is best known as the leader and lead vocalist of the boy group BF (formerly called Boyfriend).

Kim Donghyun is a South Korean dancer and singer under Woollim Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group Golden Child on August 28, 2017. On December 27, Woolim took to Weverse to announce that the exclusive contracts of Golden Child members Lee Daeyeol, Y, Bae Seungmin, Bong Jaehyun and Kim Donghyun will come to an end on December 31.
Donghyun is a member of the South Korean boy group LU:KUS (also known as L.A.U). He’s a former member of X-5.
Donghyun is a South Korean singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY.
Dongjae is a South Korean rapper under TM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EASTSHINE.

Kim Dong Jun is a South Korean singer and actor under MAJOR9. He is a member and maknae of the boy group ZE:A and its subunits ZE:A FIVE and ZE:A J. He made his official solo debut on November 6, 2019 with the mini-album "Alone". While ZE:A is on hiatus, Dongjun has since then focused on acting. He starred in dramas such as "Black", "Chief of Staff", and "More than Friends". In July 2021, Dongjun enlisted in the military.
He is a former member of LST
Dongkyu is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group SPECTRUM and a former member of the group Underdog, as well as a pre-debut member of D.I.P. under his previous name Seunghyuk.
Kim Dongkyu is a South Korean rapper, dancer, and choreographer. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival show "Produce X 101".
Donglim is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group DMTN as well as a soloist.

Dongmyeong is a member of the band ONEWE under RBW Entertainment. He is the vocalist and keyboardist of the group. He represented RBW on Produce 101 Season 2 but was eliminated in the 5th episode, securing the 68th position. On October 2017, Dongmyeong and M.A.S participated for 'The Unit'. Although he reached the finale, he was eliminated in 16th place.

Son Dong Pyo, also known as Dongpyo, is a South Korean singer and lyricist under DSP Media. In 2019, Dongpyo participated in the Mnet survival show "Produce X 101". During the finale, he ranked 6th place, thus becoming a member of the boy group X1. He debuted with X1 on August 27, 2019, with the mini album "Quantum Leap". The agencies representing the members of announced the group's disbandment on January 6, 2020, due to not being able to reach a unanimous agreement following the "Produce 101" vote manipulation controversy. Dongpyo was revealed as the fourth member of DSP Media's new boy group MIRAE on February 5, 2021. MIRAE debuted on March 17th with the mini album "Killa". On July 9, 2024, DSP announced that the group had concluded their activities and disbanded with the contract terminations of all the members except Dongpyo, who would continue his individual activities with the agency. He officially made his solo debut on August 7, 2024 with the digital single "Wave (2024)".

Dongsung is the bassist and vocalist of N.Flying. He was previously the bassist and vocalist of HONEYST. Before debuting, he competed in the survival show d.o.b. (Dance or Band) by FNC Entertainment and Mnet as part of the NEOZ Band team. Although his team lost to the NEOZ Dance team, he eventually debuted in May 2017 with the band HONEYST, alongside the other NEOZ Band members. HONEYST disbanded in April 2019, and in December 2019 it was announced that Dongsung would be joining N.Flying as their new bassist. He was officially added as a member in January 2020 and made his debut with the band in June 2020 through N.Flying's 7th mini album So, COMMUNICATION.
Donguk is a singer and maknae of the boy band THE T-BIRD.

Kim Dong-wan, best known by the stage name Dongwan, is a South Korean singer and actor under Shinhwa Company and Office DH. He is best known as a member of the Kpop boy group Shinhwa, where he serves as a vocalist. Dongwan made his official group debut with Shinhwa on March 24, 1998, under SM Entertainment. However, he and the group left the company in July 2003. In addition to his vocal position, he also wrote, composed, and arranged a song on the album titled Set Free. On July 5, 2007, Dongwan released his debut solo album Kimdongwan, which featured collaborations with his fellow Shinhwa members including Andy, who rapped in the song "Loving Summer", Shin Hye-sung, who sang a duet with Dongwan in "The One Left Alone", and Eric, who rapped in "My Love". In November 2008, Dongwan enlisted for mandatory military service at an army training camp in Gongju, Chungcheongnam-do. He was discharged on December 17, 2010, after serving 24 months as an administrative worker at the Seodaemun-gu District Office. After Shinhwa's hiatus due to mandatory military enlistment, Dongwan reunited with the members in March 2012 under the management company Shinhwa Company. He released his tenth album with the group on March 23, The Return. In 2006, he was one of several Korean celebrities praised by the Japanese media for giving generous donations to flood victims. Dongwan is also known for his charitable actions. In April 2015, after an earthquake in Nepal, it was reported that he donated $33,660 towards the relief fund.
Dongwon is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed gospel group Diaconia.
Lee Dong Won is a South Korean rapper. He is best known for being a member of the boy group KNK.

Dongwoo is a South Korean rapper, singer, and actor under INFINITE Company. He is a member of the boy group INFINITE and its now defunct sub-unit, INFINITE H. As a soloist, he promotes under his full name, Jang Dongwoo, and made his solo debut on March 4, 2019, with his first mini album, Bye. He debuted as a member of INFINITE on June 9, 2010, with the release of their mini album First Invasion. On March 31, 2021, Woollim Entertainment announced that Dongwoo, along with fellow member Sungyeol, had departed from the agency following the expiration of their contracts. Later that year, on October 1, he signed a short lived contract with Big Boss Entertainment. In September, he signed with Hi-Hat Entertainment but eventually transitioned to INFINITE Company, an agency founded by his fellow member Kim Sungkyu.
Son Dongwoon is a South Korean singer and TV Personality under Around US Entertainment. He is best known for being a member of the popular boy group B2ST and later HIGHLIGHT.

Justin Youn also known as Dongyeon is a Filipino-South Korean singer and dancer under GRID Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group POW. He was a contestant in the SBS survival program "Loud" under JYP Entertainment but was eliminated in the 7th round.

Dongyoon was a South Korean singer and songwriter under WYNN Entertainment. He made his official debut in May 2018 as a member of the boy group SPECTRUM. Before his debut, he participated in the survival show 'MIXNINE' where he finished 21st place. On July 27th of 2018, months after his debut, Dongyoon passed away.

Kim Dong Yun is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 28, 2020, as a member of the boy group DRIPPIN. When he was a trainee, Dongyun participated in the hit reality show Produce X 101 where he finished 23rd place. He also participated in the 2025 survival shows Boys II Planet.
Bae Doohoon is a South Korean singer and musical actor. He is a member of the crossover vocal quartet Forestella.

Doojoon is a South Korean singer and actor under Around US Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Highlight (formerly BEAST). He made his solo debut on July 27, 2020, with the mini album Daybreak.
Doryun is a South Korean singer under Hyper Rhythm. He is a member of the boy group AIMERS.
Do Sun is a South Korean musician, recognized as the drummer and maknae of the boy band D.COY.

Son Chang-il (손창일)better known by his stage name Illson (stylized as ILLSON) and formerly as Double K (더블 케이), is a South Korean rapper. He was the winning judge/producer on the first season of Show Me the Money before making a second appearance as a contestant in the sixth season. He released his first album, Positive Mind, on October 28, 2004.

Chung Donghwan, going by the stage name Double.D, is a former member of the boy group BZ-Boys under Chrome Entertainment. In February 2024, all of BZ-Boys' social media stopped following Hamin and Double.D it is assumed they have left the group.
Dovin is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which operates under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 24, 2025.

Dowon is a Chinese trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a former pre-debut member of the boy group OCJ NEWBIES.He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows "We Are Young" and "Stars Awakening".
Dowoo is the leader of Korean Boygroup A-JAX. He is also a creator on Youtube with his channel "Dowoo TV".

Yoon Dowoon is a South Korean musician under JYP Entertainment, best known as the drummer and youngest member of the rock band DAY6. He was the last member to join the group in 2015, leading to the band’s rebranding from 5LIVE to DAY6. Dowoon debuted with DAY6 on September 7, 2015, with the EP "The Day" and the lead single "Congratulations." While primarily a drummer, he has also contributed vocals to some of the band's songs. On September 27, 2021, he made his solo debut as a singer with the digital single "Out of the Blue." He enlisted for his mandatory military service on January 17, 2022, serving in the military band before being discharged on July 16, 2023.
DOY is a producer and composer under NOMAD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NOMAD.

Kim Dong-young, popularly known as Doyoung, is a South Korean singer, actor, and musical theatre actor under SM Entertainment. Best known as a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT U, NCT 127, and NCT DOJAEJUNG, he debuted on April 9, 2016 with the digital single "The 7th Sense". He later made his official solo debut with the album "Youth" in April of 2024. Prior to debuting, Doyoung was introduced through the SM trainee team SM Rookies and even appeared on Disney Channel Korea's "The Mickey Mouse Club".
Doyoung is a South Korean dancer and singer. He is a former member of the trainee group ODD ONE OUT and the boy group N.CUS.

Doyoung is a South Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2018, Doyoung participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. At first, he was not selected for the main group, TREASURE, however, on January 29, 2019, YGE announced that he would form a second group from the show, called MAGNUM, and he was one of the members. The groups would promote together as TREASURE 13, and also eventually separated as two units. The plans of making two groups were canceled and it was decided that the 12 trainees would debut as one boy group, TREASURE. Doyoung debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020, with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One. On June 16, 2023, Doyoung was confirmed as the fifth and last member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.
Doyul formerly known as Minsung is a South Korean trainee and actor. He is the maknae of the upcoming boy group AWIN.
DPR ARTIC is a South Korean artist under Dream Perfect Regime. He debuted under DPR on February 2nd 2024 with his EP “KINEMA“. In 2023, he performed at the Regime Tour Finale in SEOUL with DPR CREAM.

Kim Kyung-mo, better known as DPR CREAM, is a South Korean singer, rapper, composer & producer under Dream Perfect Regime. He initially debuted in 2012 as a member of the group LAYBACKSOUND, alongside Hangyeol & U-Turn. During his time in the group, he notably contributed to BTS’ song “Where You From”. Cream is well-known for his diverse musical style in addition to contributing to over 500 songs in the KOMCA database, which is the reason fans affectionately refer to him as 'DPR Mozart'. He has composed & contributed to many projects of his fellow DPR label mates, in addition to artists like Big Naughty, Beenzino, Code Kunst, Nucksal, HAON & Loco. Prior to joining DPR in 2015, he adopted the moniker ‘CREAM’ inspired by American hip-hop group Wu Tang Clan's 1994 song “C.R.E.A.M” which is an acronym of the phrase "Cash Rules Everything Around Me”. He made his solo debut as DPR CREAM on July 5, 2019, with the digital single "The Voyager 737". On May 3, 2024, he returned as a solo artist with his debut full-length album “psyche: red”.

DPR IAN also known as Christian Yu, born Yu Barom, was a rapper and leader of the group C-CLOWN, where he went under the stage name Rome. After the disbandment of C-CLOWN in 2015, he went ahead and founded DPR (Dream Perfect Regime), a multi-genre music and video group. He is the CEO and Visual Director of DPR, known for shooting stunning visuals for DPR's music videos. Some of his most notable work as a Visual Director are the music videos "BORDERS" by Amber Liu, "COULD YOU BE MINE" by PHANTOM, "HOLUP!" by BOBBY, "BODY" by MINO, "Movie Shoot" by Loco, or even "WAKE ME UP" by Taeyang.

Kim Dohyun, better known as dress, is a South Korean producer known for his work in K-hip hop and R&B genres. He first debuted in 2015 and was a producer under THEBLACKLABEL. In 2018 he joined HIGHLINE Entertainment and has worked with various artists including Kid Milli, PENOMECO, sogumm, VINXEN, Okasian, SAAY, ZICO and SURAN. He's known for his distinctive experimental/soul sound and has released several collaborative albums and singles. He was part of Team YG in Show Me the Money 5. On January 14, 2024, he released his debut studio album 'How Deep is Your Love'.
Drok Q is a South Korean musician that used to be the drummer of the band Drug Restaurant.

Dsel is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Stoneship and Layback Records in 2017. He participated in the rap survival show "Show Me The Money 9" in 2020 and was in the Team Dynamic Duo with Bewhy.

Duan Xing Xing is a Chinese singer under M-Nation and a former member of the project boy group IXFORM. He launched his solo career on April 21, 2021, with the release of the digital single "I Will." He gained notable recognition as a contestant on the survival shows Youth With You 3 and Starlight Boys.

Duhwan is a retired South Korean rapper. He was originally part of the fifth generation of the boy group Xing; however, the lineup never officially debuted. He later debuted as a member of Apeace (originally Double B 21) in August 2010. Within Apeace, he was part of the sub-units Onyx and later Jade5, following the group's reorganization into a 15-member lineup. He left the group on June 29, 2018.

Dumbfoundead is an Argentine-American rapper and actor. He began his career in the 2000s as a battle rapper in Los Angeles and has since become one of the most prominent Asian-American rappers in the United States, known for his witty and socially conscious lyrics. He was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina to South Korean immigrants. His family immigrated to the United States when he was 3 years old and he became a U.S. citizen when he was 19 years old. He made his debut on May 12, 2008 with the EP "Fun with Dumb".
Dut2 is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted independently in 2021.

Dvwn is a South Korean singer who debuted under Studio MOS in 2018. He was formerly signed with KOZ Entertainment. In 2018, he released his debut EP "Panorama". On April 14, 2021 Dvwn released his first album "it's not your fault".

Dy, also known as Jeon Do Yum, is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer. He is currently a member of the boy group "Just B" under Bluedot Entertainment. He used to be a member of the now-disbanded project group 1THE9, as well as a former trainee group PlayM BOYS. On October 25, 2018, Jeon Do Yum was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the performance team. He finished in first place, thus becoming a member and the center of the project group 1THE9.
Dylan is a Korean-New Zealander singer under Ai Grand Korea. He is the maknae of the boy group D-CRUNCH and its pre-debut sub-unit Geupsik-Dan.
Dyno is a South Korean rapper and producer. He was a member of the duo Team X and the project group D.A.N.He made his solo debut on July 15, 2018 with the digital single "My Battle Ground".
E Sens is a South Korean rapper under Munn Company who debuted under Amoeba Culture as a member of Supreme Team in 2003. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2014.

Lee Chang-min, popularly known as E-Chan, is a South Korean singer under Brave Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2019 as the main rapper and one of the leaders of the boy group DKB. E-Chan was a contestant on the survival show BOYS24. He was in Unit Blue, however, he was eliminated. He was introduced as a member of DKB on October 28, 2019. He officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020, with the mini album Youth.

Lee Chang-yoon, also known under his stage name E-Tion, was born in Jeonju, South Korea on December 24, 1994. After training for three years, E-Tion debuted as the Lead Vocalist of the Boy Group ONF under WM Entertainment. He is a member of the ON sub-unit. E-tion is also known for appearing and competing in the survival show Mixnine.
E:dan is a South Korean singer under Gost Entertainment. Before debuting as a soloist, E:dan participated in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
E:psilon debuted as a member of the boy group AlphaBAT.
E.an is the main vocalist of the boy group NCHIVE. He made his debut of April 9th, with the single album "Drive".
E.Den is a former member of now disbanded boy group LC9. He left the group in 2014 to continue pursuing his studies.
E.SOL is a South Korean singer. He made his official debut in 2015 as a member of the boy group M.CROWN. After leaving the group, he redebuted in 2017 as the leader of 14U.

Park Jae-hyung, known professionally as Jae and eaJ, is a South Korean-American musician, singer, and songwriter. He was the lead vocalist and lead guitarist of the rock band DAY6 under JYP Entertainment before his departure in 2022. Before debuting with DAY6, Jae gained recognition as a top-six finalist on the first season of the SBS survival program K-pop Star. He officially debuted with DAY6 on September 7, 2015, with the album "The Day." In 2020, he began releasing solo music under the name eaJ, showcasing a different musical style. On January 1, 2022, JYP Entertainment announced the termination of his contract, confirming his departure from both the group and the company. Since then, Jae has continued his solo career independently.
EAND is a South Korean artist under ACE Entertainment. He debuted on January 31, 2024, with the K-R&B and Soul song Drownin'. He is the first and only artist currently at ACE.

Eddie is an openly gay, Mexican singer, Youtuber, rapper, and dancer, he participated in Under19 under the Performance Team placing 17th. He is a member of American (USA) based Korean co-ed groups First Bite and Lalary On August 6, 2018, he debuted in First Bite with their debut song “Move Over”. He later re-debuted with two of his fellow members from First Bite, Canaco, and Hope in Lalary on August 29, 2019 with their debut digital single "Lalary". He debuted in Lalary's first sub-unit BABYLALARY with Canaco and Hope on June 29. The other two members from First Bite, Youa, and Lex (also known as Alexa) joined Lalary on February 12, 2022.

Eddie is a South Korean-American rapper under n.CH Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group n.SSign. On June 24, 2024, n.CH Entertainment announced that Eddie will be going on hiatus to focus on treatment and recovery following a deterioration of his health condition.
Edward Park, known under that stage name Eddie and formerly known as Youngjin, is a Korean-American singer and actor under ALLELE ENTERTAINMENT. He is a member of the boy group RE:WIND.
Eddy is a South Korean-American singer. He made his official debut as a member of JJCC. He participated in various shows such as Mixnine, Masterchef, and I Can See Your Voice.
Eddy is a South Korean singer under Campus Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group RoaD-B.

Eddy Kim is a South Korean singer-songwriter under MYSTIC89. He is best known for finishing in the top 6 on Mnet's talent show Superstar K4. He made his solo debut on April 11, 2014 with his first mini album The Manual.
Eden is a member of the boy group Daychild.

Eden is a South Korean singer. He is a member of EPIC TRAVELS, former member of the boy groups WeNU, BIGFLO, and a pre-debut member of the boy group WE:A. He made his solo debut on February 26, 2019, with the digital single "Wake Me Up" under the name Yuseong. Eden is currently on hiatus due to health issues. In January 2025, it was reported that he was experiencing difficulty breathing and worsening health problems, leading to his hiatus. On March 5, 2025 it was noticed by fans that all posts about Jung Eden, who had been on hiatus, had been deleted from the group's SNS and that the group's Instagram account had unfollowed him. Though no official announcement had been given.
Eden is a South Korean singer under FirstOne Entertainment. He is a vocalist in the boy group NINE.I.

EDEN is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under KQ Entertainment's sub-label KQ Produce. He debuted as a singer on February 17, 2017 with the single "Urban Hymns" but has been producing since 2010. He currently produces alongside Buddy, LEEZ and Ollounder (known collectively as as "Edenary") for ATEEZ.
Eian is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter, composer and DJ.
Eito is a Japanese trainee under STARON Entertainment. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Byun Eui Joo, known under his stage name EJ, is a South Korean singer and dancer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as the leader, one of the rappers and vocalists of the Japanese boy group &Team. EJ participated on the survival program I-LAND–the same show were ENHYPEN was created. However, EJ got eliminated in episode 7. In 2022, he participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to become a member of the Japanese boy group &TEAM.
EK is a South Korean rapper who debuted under M.B.A Crew as a member of MBA in 2015. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2017.

Jang Yi Jeong is a singer-songwriter and producer under HYBE. He is a former member of the boy group HISTORY. As a producer, he goes by the pseudonym EL CAPITXN and is also the founder of the producing group VENDORS. He's known for working with BTS, TXT, PSY, NCT, ZeroBaseOne, IU, Sunmi, Heize, and more! His most recent works include: Plave and StayC, Kingdom, Paul Kim, CNBlue's Yonghwa, LOVElution, Yerin, Acid Eyes, and Agust D!
Elaya is an Japanese-Mexican-American singer under ALLELE ENTERTAINMENT. He is a member of the boy group RE:WIND.

Eli is a Korean-American singer and actor. He is a member of the South Korean boy group, U-KISS. Eli started his acting career in January 2010 in a Thai-Korean drama, "Autumn Destiny''. In 2011, he was cast in an MBC sitcom, "Real School". In October 2014, Eli was cast as the male lead in a Chinese adaptation of the Korean drama, "Full House". On May 16, 2019, NH Media announced that Eli's contract with the agency expired and he had decided to not renew. In 2023 he rejoined the group to participate in the group's 15th anniversary comeback
Ellery Hyun Bae is a Korean-American idol trainee and participant in the SBS survival show "Loud".
Elo is a South Korean singer-songwriter, member of the R&B and hip hop crew VV:D. He is managed under Jay Park & Cha Cha Malone's label AOMG, debuting in 2013 with the single "Blur".

Elvin was a South Korean idol in the group A-DEAN with the stage name Jongwon, which went from being a girl group to a co-ed group with him joining in 2014. He later left the group in 2015 reverting the group back into a girl group.

EOH is a South Korean producer who debuted independently as a member of offonoff with Colde in 2016. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2020. He is a part of the artist collective Club Eskimo, which consists of DEAN, Crush, Millic, Punchnello, Jusen, Chek Parren, 2xxx, Camper MISO and Colde.
Eos is the former leader and vocalist of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment. He has already completed his mandatory military service prior to debuting.

Son Young-jae, known by his stage name Eric, is the lead dancer, rapper, and maknae of The Boyz under ONE HUNDRED. He debuted as a member of THE BOYZ on December 6, 2017, with the lead single "Boy" from their debut EP The First. On March 4, 2022, IST Entertainment announced that Eric won't be participating in any activities for the time being due to health issues. On September 16th, 2022, IST Entertainment announced that Eric would return to promoting with THE BOYZ for the next album promotion.

Eric Mun is a South Korean singer and actor. He is a member and leader of the South Korean boy band Shinhwa. He is also well known for several dramas such as Phoenix, Super Rookie and Another Oh Hae-young.
Eric is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL. He was a member of the group MuXima.

Eric Nam is a Korean-American singer and television host currently based in South Korea. He first appeared on Birth of a Great Star 2 in 2012 after being discovered from one of his cover songs on YouTube. He made his official debut with the mini album Cloud 9 on January 23, 2013.
Errday Jinju is a South Korean rapper. He was a contestant on Show Me The Money 777.

Eson is an American-Korean Singer and Songwriter under Choon Entertainment. He is the Leader and Main Rapper of the upcoming group WITZ also known as We in the Zone. He was first known for featuring in two songs of labelmate Longguo.
Esun is a South Korean singer, rapper, and V-Tuber under 99Major. He debuted as the main rapper of the group For The More on September 30, 2023, with the single "Love Set."
Eugene is one of SUPERKIND’s rappers and vocalists and the third member announced for the group. He was a trainee under Bighit for 4 years before being drafted into the group.

Euijin is a South Korean singer and rapper under Wan Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BIGFLO and a former member of A.cian and the project group UNB. He made his debut as a soloist on June 26, 2019 with his first mini album E:motion. He is also known for being a former contestant on the competitive survival shows The Unit and Kookmin Singer.

Eun is a member of the upcoming boy group IB147, they have 2 pre-debut releases out and are currently promoting in Japan, their official debut date is unknown. He specializes in girlish, which is rare among men, and his other major is hip hop. He is a senior/junior from the same school as the team leader Yoon Sang. On August 4th, 2024, a Twitter account for the upcoming group L5ST was opened, revealing 4 of 5 members being former IB147 members and one being a former Daychild member. Eun was one of the members listed.

Eun Seop is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023. On January 20, 2025 Fantagio announced that members Dohyun and Eunho would be going on hiatus due to health issues while also announcing the departure of Eunseop due to health reasons.

Eunchan is a South Korean singer and actor under Yue Hua Entertainment. On January 3, 2022, Eunchan was revealed as the sixth member of Yue Hua Entertainment's upcoming boy group TEMPEST. He debuted as a member of the group on March 2, 2022, with the release of their first mini album titled "It's ME, It's WE". Eunchan made his debut as an actor in 2025 as a supporting role in KBS2's drama "Villains Everywhere", which aired from March 19 to April 24, 2025.
Eunho, formerly Crown is a former member of the group UNVS. He was the second member to be revealed on August 16, 2019.
Eunho is a South Korean rapper and singer under VLAST. He is a member of the virtual boy group PLAVE.
Eunho is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He is a member of the boy group YOUNITE and a former member of trainee group BRANDNEWZ.
Eunho is a South Korean singer under Victory Company. He is a member of the boy group NTX.

Lee Hyuk Jae, also known as Eunhyuk, is a South Korean singer, rapper, songwriter, actor, radio host, MC, and concert director under ODE Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SUPER JUNIOR and its sub-units SUPER JUNIOR-T, SUPER JUNIOR-M, SUPER JUNIOR-H, and SUPER JUNIOR-D&E. On October 20, 2021, he released his first solo digital single, "Be".
Eunil is a singer under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ. Eunil debuted as a member of TRENDZ on January 5, 2022 with their first mini album "Blue Set Chapter 1. Tracks.".
Eunjae is a member of 14U and the leader of its Lucky unit.
Eunjun is a South Korean singer under HYPER RHYTHM. He is a member of the boy group AIMERS and a former member of the boy group SPECTRUM.

Eunkwang is a South Korean singer, songwriter, TV personality, and musical actor under BTOB Company. He is best known for being the leader and main vocalist of the boy group BTOB and its sub-unit BTOB-Blue. He eventually made his solo debut on June 8, 2020 with the mini album FoRest: Entrance. Eunkwang debuted as the leader of BTOB on March 21, 2012 with the digital single "Insane". In August 2018, Eunkwang enlisted in the military. He was released in April 7, 2020.
Eunkyul is a South Korean trainee. She is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Idol School and also as a former YG Entertainment trainee.

Lee Eun Sang is a South Korean singer and rapper under Brand New Music. He is a former member of the boy group X1 and current member of the boy group YOUNITE. In 2019, while he was still a trainee, Eunsang participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101, representing Brand New Music. He finished in the X place, thus becoming a member of X1. The group officially debuted on August 27, 2019 with the mini album "Quantum Leap".

Eunseok is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a member of the boy group RIIZE. He made his debut on September 4th, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar". Originally introduced as a member of the trainee team SMROOKIES in July of 2022, it was later revealed that he would be a member of SM's new boy group RIIZE in August of 2023.
Choi Eunsu is a retired South Korean rapper. He was a member of Musicworks Entertainment's boy group MYTEEN. In 2024, Eunsu began working as an airman for JEJUair.
EunSung is a member of the boy group TheEastLight.
Euntaek is the Main Dancer and Vocalist of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment. Aside from singing and dancing, Euntaek is also good at sports especially Soccer.

EXXI is a Malaysian singer and dancer under TEN Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SEVENTOEIGHT, whom he debuted with on July 28, 2025. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
F:ie is a former member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.
Fan is a Chinese singer under CHROMOSOME and Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NouerA. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MAKE MATE 1.
Fan Zhe Yi is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Fana, born Kim Kyung-hwan, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Brownie Entertainment in 2005. He signed to Yumdda and The Quiett's label Daytona Entertainment in 2021.

Feeldog is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor. He is a former member and leader of the boy groups BIGSTAR and UNB. He made his solo debut on November 28, 2019, with the single album "Dye The World To Positive".

Felix Yongbok Lee is a South Korean-Australian rapper, singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under JYP Entertainment. He is the lead rapper and lead dancer of Stray Kids and part of its unofficial subunit Danceracha. Felix was scouted through an online message after school, leading to an audition where he showcased freestyle dance. He officially joined JYP Entertainment on February 24, 2017, and was introduced as a participant in the survival show Stray Kids on October 12, 2017. Although eliminated in episode 8 due to language challenges, he was reinstated in the final episode on December 19, 2017, confirming his place in the then 9-member group. Felix debuted with Stray Kids on March 25, 2018, with the album I Am Not and its title track "District 9." On August 22, 2023, he was announced as a house ambassador for Louis Vuitton, later featuring in multiple magazine spreads and attending global fashion week events. On March 5, 2024, he made his runway debut at Paris Fashion Week for Louis Vuitton Women's Fall-Winter 2024 Collection at Cour Carrée. Since 2020, Felix has been a consistent donor to Save the Children, earning membership in the charity’s Honors Club. His philanthropic efforts continued with donations for disaster relief, including the Turkey–Syria earthquakes in 2023. In January 2024, he contributed ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) to the Korean Committee for UNICEF for Laotian children's sanitation and nutrition, becoming the youngest UNICEF Honors Club member. To celebrate his 24th birthday, he donated an additional ₩50 million to UNICEF for child nutrition and water sanitation in Laos and ₩50 million to World Vision for breakfast support for underprivileged children in Korea. On September 23, 2024, Felix was officially appointed as a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador for Korea.

Felix, born Chen Liang, is a member of the upcoming group LOONG9, which was formed through the Hong Kong based competition, Asia Super Young. He was one of the contestants of the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet," using his birth name.
Feng Jun Lan is a trainee under Stardust Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."
Xu Fengfan is a Chinese singer under LAPONE Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and visual of the boy group INI, with whom he debuted in on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A".
Fillip is a South Korean singer under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group W.A.O and a former member of the boy group ASTIN.
Find.A is a South Korean singer-songwriter under MUSIC&NEW.
Finn is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which operates under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 26, 2025.
Flavordash is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2016.
Fleeky Bang is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Yellin Records in 2022. He signed with DIRTY PLAY RECORDS in 2023 and released his debut studio album 'The Predator' on August 6, 2023.
