maleIdols.description: Float is a Thai rapper signed under Stardust Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut Chinese boy group Stardust Boys and a previous member of the boy group Hashtax. He gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Starlight Boys.

Flower is a musical group formed in 1999. The initial members were Goseongjin (guitar), Kimmie (bass) and Eugene (vocals). In 2004, Jae In Hyuk, Yada's vocalist, joined the flower as a guitarist. In 2005, Goseongjin and Kim Woo-dy left, and together with Kim Jung-min, they formed a group called Replay but did not gain much popularity. From 2010 to 2010, Goseongjin and Kimudy did not perform, and the representative songs are "Tears" and "Endless". In 2006, Flower was automatically dismantled when Jeon In-hyeok joined the army. In 2010, he was reorganized as a first-year member (Yoojin, Go Seong Jin, Kim WooDee).

Flowsik is a Korean-American rapper. He debuted in 2011 as a member of the hip-hop group Aziatix. Flowsik started rap at the age of 15 in Queens, New York, where he was based, and his skills are well recognized by American rapper and actor ICE-T . Since then, he has been working mainly in New York. When he appeared in Yoo Hee-yeol's sketchbook , he said in an interview that the husky voice is presumed to be genetic, and his brother, father, and himself all have a pretty husky voice. He participated in the 1st and 2nd rounds of SHOW ME THE MONEY 5 held in LA , USA . The first round was judged by Simon Dominic and passed with perfect skills. Even in the second round, ALL PASS was highly praised by all producers. He won the title of the championship candidate. After that, he came to Korea and impressed other participants in the Cypher search match with his high-level skills.

Fong Atilla is a Hongkongese-Australian trainee. Atilla participated in the survival show “Asia Super Young” in 2023, where he was eliminated in episode 14, ranking 19th. In 2024, he joined JTBC’s survival show “PROJECT 7” but was eliminated in episode 11 after ranking 24th place.

Frederic is a singer and dancer under Oort Entertainment. He is a member of the virtual group Sphaze. He was the fifth member to be revealed and the third to do a live broadcast, dated December 20, 2023.
Kim Si-hwan, better known as Fredi Casso, is a South Korean producer who made his debut under NMWM Entertainment in 2015.
From20 is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor under WAY BETTER. He is a former member of the boy group BIGSTAR. He made his solo debut on March 28, 2021, with the digital single "20".
Fukuyama Sota is a Japanese trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Fuma is a Japanese singer and dancer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as the sub-leader and vocalist of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. In 2022, Fuma participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to join the Japanese boy group &TEAM.
Miura Fumiya is a Japanese dancer and singer based in South Korea. He was a member of the Korean-Japanese boy group NIK.

Lee Min-woo, better known as Futuristic Swaver, is a South Korean rapper and producer who debuted under AVLX in 2014. He joined Yumdda & The Quiett's label Daytona Entertainment on December 3, 2020. His producer tag is Laptopboyboy.

Kwon Ji-yong, better known under the stage name G-Dragon, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, producer and fashion designer under Galaxy Corporation. He is a member of the boy group BIGBANG and its sub-units GD&TOP and GD X TAEYANG. At the age of 7, he debuted in a kids group called 'Little Roora'. After the group's disbandment, he joined SM Entertainment as a trainee when he was 8 but left for YG Entertainment 4 years later. He made his solo debut with the album "Heartbreaker" in 2009. G-Dragon began his two-year mandatory military service on February 27, 2018, by entering the 3rd Infantry Division’s boot camp in Gangwon province as an active duty soldier, where he was set to be discharged on October 26, 2019, after completing the requirements. On October 26, 2019, G-Dragon was officially discharged from the military.
G:amma is a South Korean singer under APB Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group AlphaBAT.
G.I is a rapper under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EPIC TRAVELS, a former member of the boy group TARGET and the hip hop trio Triplow.
Jung Byunghee , also known as G.O, is the main vocalist of MBLAQ under J.Tune Camp. He is currently a broadcasting jockey on Afreeca TV.
He a member of LST
Gaeko is South Korean rapper and singer who debuted in 2004 under Amoeba Culture. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2014.
Gaeun is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl band Rose Queen.

Gaho is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer, and member of the band KAVE. Known for his versatile musical talents, he is also a former member of the project boy group PLT. Gaho made his solo debut on May 3, 2018, with the digital single Stay Here, which showcased his ability to craft emotive and engaging music. As a member of KAVE, Gaho contributes his powerful vocals and creative input to the group’s dynamic sound. His songwriting and production skills are key to the band’s evolving music.
Gai is a Japanese rapper under Zenith Media Contents. He is the main rapper of the international boy group Z-Boys and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.

Gaku is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He placed sixth on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the upcoming boy group aoen. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group 24kumi. He is best known for participating in the reality survival shows &AUDITION - The Howling - and Oen-High.

GamJay is the Main Vocalist and President of the 5-member Virtual boy group Psychord. He debuted with them on February 23, 2023, with their debut single "Crazier".On April 11, 2024, he made his solo debut with the EP (Extended Play) "Missed Call". His birthday is on July 17 of a unknown year.
He a member of LST

Kwak Jiseok, better known as Gaon, is a South Korean rapper and musician under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut as the electric guitarist and rapper of the band Xdinary Heroes on December 6, 2021. He was revealed as the third member of the band.

Kang Hee-gun, better known by his stage name Gary, is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, record producer, entrepreneur, and television personality. Besides a solo artist, he is also the rapper and lyricist of the former hip-hop duo Leessang. He is best known for his participation in the iconic Running Man series.
GATO is a South Korean TikToker and singer under SOONENT who made his debut on May 16, 2022, with the single album "CELEBRATE".

Kim Jae-Min also known as GEMINI is a South Korean singer who debuted under AT AREA on November 1, 2020, with the single album Going. He is an R&B and alternative artist who explores various musical genres. He first gained attention for his appearance on the H1GHR MUSIC compilation album H1GHR: BLUE TAPE.

Gemini is a singer and rapper from the virtual group RE:REVOLUTION. He began his career debuting in July 2021 in the group Revolution Heart until he and the other members terminated their contracts and formed their own group, re-debuting on April 26, 2024.
Gen is a South Korean guitarist, member of the co-ed band Red Sonnet.
Geojung is a South Korean drummer and guitarist under Fluxus Music. He is a member of the rock band Ibadi.
Geon is a South Korean singer under DNA Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SWEET:CH. He auditioned for Project 7 but did not make it past the audition round.
Geon was announced as a Deep Studio Entertainment trainee on July 4th, 2020. He is the Vocalist of the group SUPERKIND.
Geonhee is a former South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group Apeace and its sub-units Apeace Onyx and later Apeace Jade5.
Geonil is a member of the South Korean boy group Supernova.
Geonroung is a South Korean singer. He is a part of the co-ed kids band Play With Me Club.
Lee Geon-woo, also known as Geonu, is the lead vocalist of the boy group JUST B under Bluedot Entertainment. He was first known for competing in the survival program "I-LAND".
george is a South Korean singer who debuted under Nrml Credit in 2016.
Hwang Geumryul is a South Korean trainee under Yue Hua Entertainment. He first appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Han Gichan is a South Korean trainee and actor under Fantagio Music. Besides starring in webdramas such as "When Your Eyes Linger" and "Oceans Like Me," Gichan has also appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101" where he ranked 57th,
Kim Gi Hwan is a member of the boy group Signal under J Star Entertainment.

Gihyeon is a South Korean singer under Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NouerA and was previously part of the pre-debut boy group Daily Note, which is now called ALL(H)OURS. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MAKE MATE 1.

Gihyun is an Independent South Korean singer and rapper. He was a member of the boy group NTX under Victory Company. On November 6, 2022, Victory Company released a statement saying that Gihyun had left the group due to personal reasons.

Kim Kijoong, also known as Gijung, is a South Korean singer, dancer, and former member of UNB and IM. He debuted in 2017 as the vocalist and maknae of IM. In the same year, he took part in the singing survival show "The Unit", securing the 8th position. As a result, he was chosen to be part of the project group UNB, which made its debut in April 2018 and wrapped its activities about a year later, around the same time. In 2021, he returned as a participant on "Extreme Debut: Wild Idol", hoping to join the TAN group. Sadly, he didn't make it into Top-7. After that, he decided to start his military service on December 12, 2022, and he's expected to be discharged on June 11, 2024. He is currently participating in the SBS reality survival show, Universe League.

Lee Gi-kwang known, professionally as Gikwang or Kikwang, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor. He originally debuted as solo singer with the stage name AJ (Ace Junior), releasing his first mini album First Episode: A New Hero on April 4, 2009. In October 2009, he debuted as the main dancer, visual and a lead vocalist of boy group BEAST which had been renamed to Highlight in February 2017.

Gil Seong-joon, better known by his stage name Gill, is a South Korean singer and television personality. He has been active since 1997. He debuted in the group X-Teen (1997-1999) and then joined the rap group Honey Family (1999-2007). He briefly joined the group "Lissam Trio" with fellow Honey Family member Gary in 2000. Also along with Gary, they were apart and produced the rap duo, Leessang (2002-2017). He has also made cameo appearances in Psy's "GENTLEMAN" (2013) music video and Lee Hyori's "Bad Girls" (2013). He has so far has made appearances on many Korean TV entertainment programs, including being a judge for The Voice Korea.
Ginjo is a South Korean DJ, composer and producer currently under ScreaM Records. He is a former member of the boy band TraxX.
Giriboy is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and record producer signed to Just Music Entertainment. Giriboy debuted on November 18, 2011 with the song “You Look So Good to Me” featuring Swings.
Giseok was a member of IM, and was one of the first 4 to debut before joining "The Unit".
Giseok is a South Korean singer from DONGYO Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 12, 2022 as one of the newest members of the boy group DKZ.
Gist (formerly stylized as GI$T), is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently on April 21, 2019, with the mini album "Child".

Gitae is a South Korean guitarist. He was a member of the co-ed rock band 5but. Served as their Gutarist, one if the original members. He left the band around late 2020 for unknown reasons and was ultimately replaced by Lee Yangeop.
Oh Gi Taek is a South Korean singer. He used to be a member of the boy group MVP.

Giuk, formerly known as CyA, is a member of the band ONEWE under RBW Entertainment. He is the bassist, rapper, and the maknae of the group. On March 9, 2023, he declared that he would no longer go by the stage name CyA. Instead, he decided to use, Giuk, for all official activities, whether as part of ONEWE or in solo projects. On April 20, 2023, he debuted as a soloist with the mini album "Psycho Cybernetics: Turn Over".

GK is a South Korean rapper under Brave Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DKB. GK was introduced as a member of DKB on November 12, 2019. He officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020, with the mini album Youth.
Go Chang Young is a South Korean guitarist, member of the co-ed rock band An Old Moon.

Go_U is a South Korean singer under Wuzo Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group BLITZERS. He debuted as a member of BLITZERS on May 12, 2021, with their debut EP Check-In. On March 28, 2023, Wuzo Entertainment announced that Go_U was recently diagnosed with restless legs syndrome and would therefore be going on hiatus to focus on treatment. On January 29, 2024, Wuzo Entertainment announced Go_U’s departure from the group.

Ha Ji-Yong, best known by the stage name Godak is a South Korean vocalist, and producer for the South Korean male ballad duo, MIND U signed under Starship Entertainment on April 27th, 2017. Godak has written and composed numerous songs for MIND U and multiple other artists. Godak has a YouTube channel where he posts videos about Korean vlogs, Mukbang, his life, and more.

South Korean singer-songwriter and guitarist Gohi formed the project group Vanillare in 2019. The group officially debuted with the EP album, ‘Hollywood Fever‘ on May 1, 2021, as a duo with Ji Yong-hee. In August 2023, Yi Yong-hee left the group and now Gohi works with varying guest members known as "Good Hands" when performing as Vanillare. On February 7, 2025, Gohi announced their transition to a solo career, with all future releases and performances under their name. Their bandmates will continue supporting them as the session band Vanillare, performing together as Gohi with Vanillare. Past music will also be rebranded under Gohi after the release of their next single album.
Jung Jaewoo, bettern known as GOLDBUUDA and formerly Jito Mo is a Korean-American rapper who debuted alongside his younger sister Lil Cherry with the song 'Motorola' in June 27th, 2018.
Gon is a South Korean singer-songwriter under KLAP Entertainment. He is the main rapper and main dancer of the boy group VANNER.

Gong Myung is a South Korean singer and actor under Saram Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group 5URPRISE in November 2014 under Fantagio Entertainment. He is best known for appearing in the dramas "Revolutionary Love", "Bride of the Water God", and "Lovers of the Red Sky".

Gongchan is a South Korean singer and actor, best known as the youngest member of the boy group B1A4. He was introduced as the third member of B1A4 by WM Entertainment on April 11, 2011. The group made their official debut on April 23, 2011, with the release of their first mini album Let's Fly. In August 2024, WM Entertainment announced that Gongchan had decided not to renew his contract with the agency. Despite his departure, Gongchan will continue to participate in B1A4's future group activities.

Goo Hyun is a South Korean singer under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS and a former pre-debut member of the boy group PLATINUM78 and EASTSHINE. He is also known for being a contestant on the survival shows Fantasy Boys, Fan Pick and Project 7.
Jeon Hyuk-jun also known as Goopy is a South Korean singer under ALFHA.

GooseBumps is a South Korean producer, who debuted with the single "C.I.G.F" in 2012. He is best known for producing every track in Simon Dominic’s EP "No Open Flames" and Sik-K‘s EP "Officially OG" which are just a few of the noteworthy projects that he has produced. On September 4, 2020, it was revealed that he had joined AOMG, headed by Jay Park, after being a frequent collaborator with their artists. He has since expanded his production with projects such as EP "PRISON BREAK" with Leellamarz and project single ‘CODE CLEAR’.
Gorey is a guitarist under NAME X Entertainment. He is part of the virtual band OFF EQUALS.

GOU, formerly known as Rasa, is a South Korean singer and rapper under AG Entertainment. He is former member of disbanded boy group LC9. He made his official debut on May 12, 2025 with the single album 'Anew'.

Lee Seong-hwa, better known as GRAY, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and record producer. He began composing music in his first year of high school and participated in the 2011 MBC College Song Festival, which he won. He cites Kanye West and Pharrell Williams as key inspirations for his interest in production. He released his debut single "Blink," in 2012, featuring Zion.T and CRUCiAL STAR. Gray started to make music professionally around 2010. After rapper Swings heard the work of a then-unknown Gray, they began working together, boosting Gray's career. Because of this, he credits Swings as the person who discovered him. GRAY’s famous producer tag is a whisper of his stager name, "GRAY," spoken by Zion.T. His original stage name was 'Illest Mike', which was changed to GRAY after a conversation with Zion.T. In 2013, he signed as AOMG’s first artist, and through this, Gray was able to contribute significantly to the label. He worked with Jay Park in the recruitment of the artists ELO, Loco, Simon Dominic, Ugly Duck, DJ Wegun, and Woo Wonjae. Despite being a singer himself, Gray is highly regarded for his production skills. His musical style is not restricted to a particular genre, often experimenting with R&B, trap, pop, and hip-hop. He released his debut EP, 'Call Me Gray', in 2013. His debut full-length album, 'grayground.' came in 2021. In 2023, he produced his debut film soundtrack for the Netflix film Ballerina. Through this, Gray was officially invited to the 28th Busan International Film Festival and was also nominated for the Music Award at the 44th Blue Dragon Film Awards. He was a central figure at the AOMG label from 2013 to 2024, producing many hit songs for the label's artists and significantly contributing to its growth. In 2024, he co-founded the label Duover with Code Kunst and Woo.
Griffy is a South Korean R&B singer under Undefind Entertainment. He made his official debut on February 2, 2022, with the digital single "Young"
Grizzly is a South Korean singer-songwriter and record producer under the label EGO. He debuted on September 5, 2014 with his first single 'DS'.

Kim Ji Hyun also known as GSoul is an American singer with Korean descent. Before moving to Korea G.soul studied in America alongside R.Kelly which gave him the recognition as "R.Kelly's Protege". G.Soul was scouted into Studio J, which is JYP Entertainments subsidiary label. He is known to be the longest trainee in JYP Entertainment for training about 15 years before making a debut with his first single "You" back in January 2015. After years being with the label he decided to leave and sign under global hip-hop label H1GHR MUSIC on June 6, 2017. In December 2019, he changed his stage name from G.Soul to Golden. In January 2021, he announced through Instagram that he would be changing his stage name back into GSoul.
Gukcheol is a retired South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group O.P.P.A.
Kwak Gun is a South Korean singer. He made his official debut in 2015 as a member of the now-disbanded boy group 14U.

Shin Gwangchul, also kwown by the stage name Gun, is a South Korean model and former singer. He was a member of the boy group XING. Prior to debuting as an idol, he was known as an ulzzang model and appeared on shows such as Generation Ulzzang.

Gun Boi Kaz is a South Korean-born, Connecticut-raised music artist whose journey into the world of music began at the tender age of 16. Born as Kaz in Korea, he moved to the quaint town of New Haven, Connecticut, where he spent his formative years. During his teenage years, Kaz turned to music as an emotional outlet, recording his first tracks as a means to navigate and express his complex feelings. At 21, Gun Boi Kaz’s musical career reached a significant milestone with the release of his debut album, “Love Me Not.” This album is a curated selection of eight tracks, representing the cream of the crop from an impressive repertoire of 400 songs written during a challenging two-year treatment period. This creative explosion not only served as a therapeutic process for Kaz but also as a foundation for his artistic identity.
Gunho is a South Korean singer under EVERGLOW. He made his official debut on November 24, 2020 with the single "Actually.. I Miss You", the solo version of the eponymous single by GyeongseoYeji.
Goo Gun-il, better known as Gunil, is a South Korean singer and drummer under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2021 as the leader and drummer of the band Xdinary Heroes.

Gunmin is a South Korean singer, dancer, and choreographer, best known as a former member of the boy group B.I.G under GH Entertainment. He also participated in the sub-unit Gunmin X Heedo, the co-ed project group Triple7, and the Japan-Korea collaborative group NIK. He made his official debut in 2014 as the main dancer and vocalist of B.I.G with the single “Hello”, which received attention for its lyrics promoting Korean culture. In 2016, the group signed with HY Entertainment and made their Japanese debut with the mini album “Aphrodite”, featuring a Japanese version of their song “Taola.” In 2020, Gunmin competed in the Japan-based idol survival show G-EGG, and was selected as a final member of the group NIK, which debuted in South Korea with the single “Santa Monica” in September 2021, followed by a Japanese debut with “Universe.” That same year, following J-Hoon’s military discharge, Gunmin was named the new leader of B.I.G and joined the seasonal co-ed project group Triple7. On January 14, 2023, GH Entertainment announced Gunmin’s upcoming military enlistment, which began on January 26, 2023. He was officially discharged on October 25, 2024. After his military service, he briefly re-debuted in the group New And.B, which disbanded on March 23, 2025 following a final performance in Japan. As of 2025, Gunmin has not announced affiliation with a new agency. He is currently active as a dancer, choreographer, and instructor at Just Jerk Dance Academy and mu:tudio. Although there has been no official statement confirming his departure from GH Entertainment, he is presumed to have left the company following the dissolution of B.I.G and prolonged inactivity.

Guno is a Taiwanese singer under Dream Passport Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 2022 as a member of the Japanese boy group BUGVEL. Before making his debut in Japan, Guno was first known in South Korea for participating in the survival shows "YG Treasure Box" and "Produce X 101."
Gunwoo is a South Korean rapper and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a former member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. He left the group on October 9, 2020.
NiiiiiA, also known as Gunwoo, is a South Korean singer and actor under World Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group MYNAME.

Gunwoo, also known by his former stage name T28, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and dancer under Roots Entertainment. He first entered the spotlight as a member of the boy group TFN, previously known as T1419, where he debuted in 2021. After the group’s disbandment in early 2024, he continued to pursue his career in entertainment, later appearing as a contestant on the Chinese–South Korean survival show Starlight Boys. In 2025, Gunwoo transitioned into solo activities, officially signing with Roots Entertainment. He made his solo debut on March 10 with the release of the digital single Shot, marking a new chapter in his career as an independent artist.

Guo Zhen is a Chinese singer under Giant Music Entertainment. He first debuted as a soloist in January 2017 with the digital single "Anti-State". Other than his singing career, Zhen has competed on the survival shows The Coming One 2 (2018), We Are Young (2020), and Boys II Planet (2025).
Guohao is a Chinese trainee. He was a pre-debut member of the boy group XODIAC. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows Fantasy Boys and Boys II Planet.
Guwon is a South Korean singer under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group W.A.O.
GV is a South Korean rapper who debuted under M.B.A Crew as a member of MBA.
Gwanghyeon, born Jeong Gweong Hyeon, was the drummer and maknae of the South Korean band Purple Rain. In 2025 joined a newly formed rock band FIRR.
Shin Gwang Il is a South Korean singer-songwriter, musician, and producer under MYSTIC89. He is the vocalist and drummer of the boy band LUCY.

Jo Gyehyeon is a South Korean singer under Jellyfish Entertainment. He debuted as the lead vocalist of the boy group VERIVERY on January 9, 2019. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

W.D, also known as Seungyong, is a South Korean dancer and rapper under Kyuri Entertainment. He is the main rapper of the boy group N.CUS. He announced the change of his stage name from W.D to Seungyong on November 6th, 2019 His brother is Junyong of Noir. On November 6, 2023 on Like a Movie's instagram they revealed two new members and updated line-up showing Seungyong as a new member going by the stage name Gyeom
Kwon Gyeongtae is a South Korean singer. He debuted in 2017 as a member of the boy group 14U.
Gyowon is a member of Biuret

Gyuchan is a South Korean singer under J-Star Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ABLUE and is a former member of the busking groups 4TEN, KingdomS, and Unknown. On August 30, 2023, Gyuchan was announced as a new member of the boy group ABLUE. He then made his debut with them with the release of their third single "Blue of Winter" on December 21st. Gyuchan has already served his time in the military.

Jeon Kyu-ho is the talented guitarist of the acclaimed South Korean rock band Guckkasten. Known for his masterful command of the guitar and his ability to create intricate, emotionally evocative soundscapes, Jeon plays a vital role in shaping the band’s unique psychedelic and progressive rock style. As one of the founding members of Guckkasten, Jeon has been a key creative force behind the band’s evolution since its early days in the indie scene. His guitar work is often praised for its technical precision, layered textures, and experimental flair, providing the perfect complement to Ha Hyun-woo’s powerful vocals. Though he maintains a low public profile, Jeon Kyu-ho is admired by fans and fellow musicians alike for his dedication to his craft and understated charisma on stage. He is married and has two children, but keeps his personal life largely private. A quiet yet influential presence in the Korean rock scene, Jeon continues to push musical boundaries with Guckkasten, contributing to some of the most visually and sonically captivating performances in Korean live music.
Lee Gyuhyung is a South Korean trainee under WM Entertainment. He made his first appearance in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Han Gyujin is a South Korean singer. He made his official debut on September 10, 2015 as the lead dancer and vocalist of the boy group UP10TION. On June 17, 2023 Gyujin took to social media to announce that he changed his real name from Han Gyujin to Woo Handam.
Gyumin is a South Korean trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group XODIAC.
Seol Jun, known under the stage name H:eta, is a member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.
H.O. is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group MADTOWN.
H3hyeon, born Hwang Se-hyeon, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Daytona Entertainment in 2021.
Ha Bin is a member of the South Korean group BNF.

Ha Hyun Sang is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musician under Stone Music Entertainment. He is the vocalist and guitarist of the boy band Hoppípolla. Ha Hyun Sang made his solo debut as an independant singer with his first digital single "Dawn" on February 21, 2018. He joined JTBC's audition show SuperBand and won with his band Hoppípolla. The band debuted on November 16, 2019 with the group's first digital single "About Time".

Ha Hyun-woo is a South Korean rock vocalist, guitarist, and composer, best known as the lead singer and frontman of the critically acclaimed band Guckkasten. Renowned for his soaring vocal range, emotionally charged performances, and poetic songwriting, Ha has become one of the most distinctive voices in Korean rock. Before forming Guckkasten, he was active in various underground bands, eventually founding Guckkasten in 2003 and officially debuting with the group in 2008. His artistry blends elements of rock, psychedelia, and progressive music, with a strong emphasis on conceptual depth and theatrical flair. Ha Hyun-woo became a household name through his record-breaking run on “King of Masked Singer”, where he appeared as the now-iconic “Our Neighborhood Music General” and held the champion title for an unprecedented 9 consecutive wins. His appearances not only highlighted his vocal prowess but also brought new attention to Korea's indie and rock scene. Though deeply respected for his musical genius, Ha is known to be humble and introspective, often discussing the emotional and philosophical layers of his work. His influence spans beyond rock into the broader Korean music industry, where he is admired as a true artist in every sense.

Ha Sung Woon (or simply Sungwoon) is a South Korean singer under BPM Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2014 as a member of the boy group Hotshot. However, he became known for participating in Produce 101 Season 2, where he finished 11th place, allowing him to debut as a member of the project boy group Wanna One. Following the conclusion of his Wanna One activities, Sungwoon made his solo debut on February 28, 2019, with the mini album "My Moment." On November 2, 2021, both Sungwoon and Star Crew Entertainment announced that his exclusive 7-year contract with them expired on October 31, and he decided not to renew. On December 24, 2021, it was announced that Sungwoon had signed an exclusive contract with BPM Entertainment.

Ha Yoojon is a South Korean actor, singer, and lyricist under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy band AxMxP. He is also a member of the fictional co-ed band TWO SAGYE and the fictional boy band THE CROWN under the name Sa Gye.
Ha.El is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group "Megamax".
HA.L is a South Korean singer under Aube Moon Studio. He is the leader of the boy group NCHIVE. He made his debut on April 9th with the single album "Drive".

Lee Dong-hyuck, best known by his stage name Haechan, is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT 127, NCT Dream, and NCT U. He made his official debut on July 7, 2016 with NCT 127's mini album "NCT #127". Haechan is set to have his solo debut on September 8, 2025, with the release of his first full-length album, titled TASTE. The lead single will be "CRZY".
Haechang is a South Korean singer. He was member of the co-ed group CHECKMATE. He joined the group on November 19, 2020 and left on December 10, 2020.
Jung Haemin is a South Korean singer under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023.
Haemin is a South Korean singer under S.I.E.T.E Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming group Pattern.
Haeun is a South Korean vocalist member of the ballad group 4MEN on April 14, 2021. He also made his solo debut on September 14, 2018, with the digital single “Love…ing (Reply).”
Haewon is a member of the South Korean boy group L.A.U (formerly LU4US and LU:KUS)

Haha is a South Korean singer, variety show host and member of RGP. He is best known for being in the sitcom "Nonstop" and for co-hosting two popular variety programs, MBC's "Infinite Challenge" and SBS's "Running Man." He also hosted his "Ya Man TV" show on Mnet in 2015. He released an independent studio album called "Ha Dong Hoon" on April 30, 1997.
Hajin is the bass guitarist of the South Korean band Purple Rain.

Hajoon is a South Korean trainee under YM Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group UNNAME. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated in the final after ranking 14th place.
Hajoon, also know as Dylan, is a South Korean musician. He is the drummer, Sub Vocalist and Rapper for the rock boy band The Rose.

Kim Hak Seong is a North Korean singer under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 where he made it all the way to the live finale.

Lee Hakmin is a South Korean singer and dancer, formerly a member of the now-disbanded boy group TRCNG under TS Entertainment. Hakmin playfully nicknamed himself "Chicken", saying he's "crispy on the outside but soft on the inside."

Hale is a singer and dancer in the group WE GO-6. He is the second member revealed through a short video on the group's social media platforms. He is the first to have a live broadcast, dated March 9, 2025.

Hale In Ocean is a singer and rapper under Parable Entertainment and J Major. He made his singing debut with a collaborative song called "Among Us," but in 2022 he made his solo debut with "Movie Star."
Ham Hyun Seo is a South Korean trainee under n.CH Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Ham Seokyoung is a founding member of Mandong, formed in 2019, with their debut on August 18, 2020. He has been pivotal in crafting the band's unique sound, showcasing his talent and creativity as a guitarist. Mandong is renowned for its experimental music style, and Ham Seokyoung's development of melodies and riffs perfectly complements the drums and bass, creating a distinctive musical experience. Despite the limited public information about his personal life, Ham Seokyoung is acknowledged for his musical prowess and dedication, playing a significant role in Mandong's growth and identity in Korea's independent music scene.
Hamin is a South Korean rapper under VLAST and a member of the virtual boy group PLAVE. His birthday is on November 1st, though the year he was born is unknown.

Jo Hamin is the main vocalist of ENOi under Kithewhale Entertainment. In addition to singing, he is skilled at playing the piano. On March 29, 2023, Hamin and former ENOi leader Laon debuted together in the band Monkey Shoulder.

Hamin is a South Korean singer under Chrome Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group Bz-Boys and the pre-debut group Eight. He made his solo debut on June 15, 2024 with the single album "Look Like U".
Hamin, formerly known as Kim Kangmin, is a South Korean singer under Wolfburn. He used to be a member of the boy group TRCNG. In 2022, he debuted as a member of the boy group BXB.
Han is a South Korean singer under F&F Entertainment. He was a contestant on SBS' survival show Universe League, where he ranked 3rd overall, securing his spot as a member of the final group AHOF.
Han is a South Korean singer signed with Mainbase Entertainment. On October 9, 2022, he was revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group D-ONE.

Han Jisung is a South Korean rapper, dancer, singer-songwriter, and composer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as one of the main rappers and music producers of the group Stray Kids. He is also part of the hip-hop rap unit 3RACHA. In late 2016, HAN, under the stage name "J.One," formed the hip-hop group 3RACHA with fellow trainees Bang Chan and Changbin. They released self-produced music on SoundCloud throughout 2017. On October 13, 2017, JYP Entertainment officially introduced HAN by revealing his picture and name, announcing his participation in the survival show Stray Kids, where he took on roles as a rapper, vocalist, and producer. By the final episode on December 19, 2017, it was confirmed that HAN would debut as a member of the boy group Stray Kids. Han debuted as a member of Stray Kids on March 25, 2018, with I Am Not and its title track "District 9".

Han Dong Geun is a South Korean ballad singer currently under Brand New Music. He was the winner of MBC's Star Audition 3 and debuted on September 30, 2014 with the single "Making A New Ending For This Story". On December 20, 2019, it was announced that his exclusive contract has expired with Pledis has expired. They released a statement declaring that they came to a mutual agreement to go their separate ways. On December 26, 2019, it was announced that he had signed with Brand New Music after previously leaving Pledis.

Han Heejun is a South Korean singer, actor and MC under Polaris Entertainment. He made his solo debut on May 15, 2015 with the digital single "QnA." Before debuting, he was first known for appearing in the eleventh season of American Idol.
Han Jeong Woo is a South Korean trainee. He was previously a member of the trainee group ODD ONE OUT. He gained recognition for his participation in the reality survival show Starlight Boys.

Han Jun is a South Korean idol trainee and actor under n.CH Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the reality show World Klass. He made it to the final lineup after placing third, but did not join the group due to partaking in an unauthorized leave and disreputable scandal when he was a trainee. He was then replaced by Jae Yun, who had the next highest number of votes on the show. In 2021, he made his acting debut through the JTBC drama "Idol: The Coup."
Han Rui Ze is a Chinese singer and former member of the disbanded Chinese project group Guanghe Shaonian. He is best known for competing on the survival shows Youth With You 3 and Boys II Planet.

Lee Sejin, also known as Han Sejin, is a South Korean actor and idol trainee under iMe Entertainment. Sejin has appeared in numerous television dramas and music videos over the years. In 2019, Sejin took part in the hit survival program "Produce X 101" where he finished 19th place.
Han Seobin is a South Korean trainee under H1GHR Music. He was one of the contestants of the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet."

Han Seung Woo is a South Korean singer currently under Aura Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VICTON and a former member of the project boy group X1. Han Seung Woo debuted as a member of VICTON on November 9, 2016, with the mini album Voice To New World. In 2019, he, along with fellow VICTON member Choi Byung Chan, participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101 representing Play M Entertainment. Seung Woo finished in third place, earning a position in the project group X1. The group officially debuted on August 27, 2019, with the mini album 비상 : Quantum Leap. On January 6, 2020, the agencies representing X1 members announced the group’s disbandment following the Produce 101 vote manipulation controversy, as they were unable to reach a unanimous agreement. On January 29, it was announced that Seung Woo would resume activities with VICTON. Seung Woo released his first solo mini album, Fame, on August 10, 2020. He enlisted in the military on July 26, 2021, and was discharged in January 2023. During his service, his contract period was adjusted, allowing him to remain with IST Entertainment after VICTON’s contract expiration. On November 28, 2024, Han Seung Woo announced his departure from IST Entertainment. He subsequently signed an exclusive contract with Aura Entertainment on December 13, 2024.

Han Seung Yun, also known simply as Yun, is a South Korean singer. He is a member the band D82 and was a member of the duo LUNAFLY, and the boy group NZN. He released his first solo single, ‘Wonder Land,’ in 2017. His official solo debut came with the mini album ‘Lovender’ on February 15th, 2022.
Han Sin is a Taiwanese trainee and model under TEN Entertainment and EeLin Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Han Tae I is a South Korean trainee. He gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys.
Han Young Jun is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed group Space A.

Han Yu Jin, also known as Yujin, is a South Korean singer originally under Yuehua Entertainment. In 2023, he competed in the hit survival show "Boys Planet," where he ended up ranking 9th place, earning his spot in the group ZEROBASEONE. He made his official debut with ZEROBASEONE on July 10, 2023, under the management of WAKEONE.
Hanbang, formerly One Shot, is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group SM☆SH.
Hanbin is a South Korean singer, member of the ballad group 4MEN as part of the group’s fourth generation.

Hanbin is a Vietnamese dancer and singer under Yue Hua Entertainment. Prior to his debut, Hanbin was apart of a dance team called CAC, that he found and led himself for three years, from 2016 to 2019. He was first known for appearing and competing in HYBE and Belift Lab's survival show I-LAND in 2020. After his elimination from the show in episode 11, Hanbin continued to train under Belift Lab until June 2021, when the agency announced that he had left. The same day, it was reported that Hanbin had signed with Yue Hua Entertainment. On January 3, 2022, Hanbin was revealed as the fifth member of Yue Hua Entertainment's upcoming boy group TEMPEST. He debuted as a member of the group on March 2, 2022, with the release of their first mini album titled "It's ME, It's WE".

Park Haneol is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Big Soul Records. He made his solo debut on June 8, 2018 with the digital single "You Don't Know". He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kim Jin Hyeon, formerly known as Haneul, is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group GreatGuys.
Haneul is a member of the South Korean by group ARGON.

Haneum is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under ES Nation. He made his solo debut on April 29th, 2023, with the digital single 'First Love'. He is known for participating in the survival shows Vocal Showdown and Boys II Planet.

Hangeng is a Chinese Mandopop singer and actor under Yuehua Entertainment. He is a former vocalist and lead dancer of the Korean boy group SUPER JUNIOR and it's Mandarin Chinese sub-unit SUPER JUNIOR-M under SM Entertainment. He pursued a solo career in China after leaving SM Entertainment and SUPER JUNIOR in 2010. He got married to actress and model Celina Jade on December 31, 2019 in New Zealand. On May 8, 2022, Hangeng and his wife, Celina Jade announced that Celina is pregnant and they will be expecting their first child together. On September 9, 2022, Hangeng and his wife, Celina Jade announced through Hangeng's personal Weibo account that Celina had given birth to their first child.
Hangyeom (formerly A-Day) is a singer and lyricist in the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly the leader of the boy group Seven O’clock.

Hangyul is a South Korean singer affiliated with MBK Entertainment and a member of the group IM. Initially, he was among the first four members to debut before joining "The Unit." In 2019, Hangyul competed in the popular survival show Produce 101, where he secured 7th place in the final episode, earning a spot in the boy group X1. Following the disbandment of X1 in 2020, Hangyul began promoting as part of the duo "H&D" alongside Nam Dohyon. Later, in November 2020, he debuted as a member of the boy group BAE173. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys.

Jung Han-hae, better known by the mononym Hanhae, is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted in 2011. Hanhae was originally set to debut as a member of Block B, but instead made his debut in the project hip-hop trio Phantom in 2011. As part of Phantom, he released two mini albums before the group disbanded in 2017. He made his solo debut in 2014 and released his first full-length solo album, 365, the following year. Hanhae began to gain wider attention following an incident during his appearance on Show Me the Money 4, where he was unfairly eliminated. He later returned as a contestant on Show Me the Money 6, where he advanced to the semi-finals. As a solo artist, Hanhae has released several EPs and albums, as well as numerous original soundtracks for Korean dramas. He has collaborated with artists such as Dynamic Duo, KEY, Chung Ha, HyunA, Moonbyul, Verbal Jint, and Kim Hyun-joong, among others. He is an active guest on various popular Korean variety shows, including Amazing Saturday and Radio Star, and continues to establish himself in the entertainment industry.
Hanjin is a Chinese singer and a member of the boy group TWS under Pledis Entertainment. He debuted with the group on January 22, 2024, with the release of their first mini album, "Sparkling Blue."

Lee Hanjun is a South Korean singer under n.CH Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group n.SSign on August 9, 2023. Prior to his debut, he competed on the survival shows CAP-TEEN (2020) and Stars Awakening (2022), where he secured a spot in the debut group n.SSign.

Hankook is a singer under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ. In late 2017, Hankook participated in the JTBC reality show MIXNINE as a trainee from NH Media. Unfortunately, he was eliminated in the seventh episode, which was aired on December 10. Hankook debuted as a member of TRENDZ on January 5, 2022 with their first mini album "Blue Set Chapter 1. Tracks."

Park Min Jun, also known as Hanseul, is the lead vocalist, rapper, and maknae of the boy group Myteen under Musicworks Entertainment. Despite of being the youngest, Hanseul is the tallest member of the group.

Jia Hanyu, popularly known as Hanyu, is the leader, main rapper, vocalist, and lead dancer of the Chinese boy group BOY STORY under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Haolin is a Chinese member of the South Korean boy group Gidongdae under 2Y Entertainment.

HAON is a South Korean rapper under KC. He made his solo debut on June 28, 2018, with the digital single "Love! Dance!" Following his win on High School Rapper 2, he signed with H1GHR Music on May 11, 2018, and left on May 8, 2023.
Harang is a member of the South Korean group BNF.
Harin is a South Korean musician under RBW. He is the drummer of the boy band ONEWE.

Han Harry-June is a South Korean singer and dancer under Brave Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group DKB. Introduced as a member of DKB on November 26, 2019, he officially made his debut on February 3, 2020, with the mini-album "Youth". In 2025, Harry-June was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Hart is a member of the boy group TOZ under YY Entertainment. They made their debut on September 27, 2023 with the mini album FLARE. He gained fame as a participant in the Korean reality shows “Boys Planet”, and "LOUD".
Haru is a Japanese singer and a member of the boy group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 2nd in "Nizi Project Season 2."
Haru is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He was a contestant the reality survival show Oen-High.

Haru is a Japanese singer, rapper, and member of the boy group XLOV. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet." On December 23, 2024 he was revealed as a member of the group XLOV.

Harua is a Japanese singer, dancer and actor under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as one of the vocalists and visuals of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. In 2022, He participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -"where he qualified to become a member of the boy group &TEAM.

Haruta is a Japanese trainee under SM Entertainment. Best known for his participation in the survival show NCT Universe : LASTART, he was introduced as a member of the SMROOKIES trainee team SMTR25 in April of 2025.

Haruto is a Japanese singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2018, Haruto took part in YG Entertainment's survival show, YG Treasure Box. Following his participation, he was revealed as the first member of the boy group on the show's final episode. The group was subsequently named TREASURE. Haruto officially debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020, with their single album, "The First Step: Chapter One".
