Haruto is a Japanese trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Lee Taewoo is a South Korean trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening. He is a member of the boy group WHIB, debuting on November 8, 2023.

Han Deok-kwang, also known as Hash Swan, is a South Korean rapper signed with Ambition Musik, a label founded by DOK2 & The Quiett. He participated in the 5th and 6th seasons of the rap competition Show Me The Money. He made his debut with his first EP, Hash X Kash, on September 28, 2016.

Havit is a singer under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ. In late 2017, Havit participated in the JTBC reality show MIXNINE as a trainee from NH Media. Unfortunately, he was eliminated in the 10th episode, which was aired on December 31, with his final rank being 39th. Havit debuted as a member of TRENDZ on January 5, 2022 with their first mini album "Blue Set Chapter 1. Tracks."
Hawool is a South Korean singer. He was the leader of the boy group B.I.T. and the CEO of SU Entertainment.
Hawoon is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.

Hayate is a Japanese singer under YK Music Entertainment. He is the sub-leader of the Japanese boy group WILD BLUE. He is best known for participating in the reality survival show &AUDITION - The Howling -.
Hayato is a Japanese trainee. He is a member of the boy group Celest1a. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Kang Ha Yoon is a South Korean dancer and trainee. He gained fame after competing in LOUD, as well as Kookmin Singer. He also joined Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor, where he was eliminated in the 10th episode.

Choi Hayoung is a South Korean singer and the main vocalist of the now-disbanded boy group TRCNG under TS Entertainment. Having lived in California, he served as the group's English speaker. In addition to singing, Hayoung is also skilled in composing music.
He Jun Jin is a Chinese trainee under I.E.One Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival shows "Universe League" and "Boys II Planet".

He Xi Long is a Chinese trainee under Stardust Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut Chinese boy group, Stardust Boys. He gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys.
Hee, born Shin Youngseo, is a member of the boy group DXMON under SSQ ENTERTAINMENT on January 17, 2024.

Heechan is a South Korean dancer under Brave Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DKB. Introduced as a member of DKB on November 7, 2019, he officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020, with the mini album "Youth". Prior to debuting, he competed on the survival show BOYS24. He also appeared on other survival shows such as Peak Time and Boys II Planet after making his debut.
Heechan is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group WeNU.

Kim Heecheon, better known as Heecho or simply Heecheon, is a former member of the Japanese-Korean boy group ORBIT and the k-pop boy groups Halo and Twi-light. He and his groupmate June (Jun Uehara) left ORBIT on June 20, 2025.
Jeong Hee Chul is the lead rapper of Korean boy group ZE:A.

Heechul is a South Korean singer, rapper, actor, radio DJ, songwriter and MC under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SUPER JUNIOR and its sub-unit SUPER JUNIOR-T. He is also part of the project group, M&D along with TRAXX's Jungmo and the duo Universe Cowards with BUZZ's Kyunghoon. He was originally placed in a four-member group called 'Four Seasons' along with TVXQ's Yunho and Jaejoong and future bandmate Kangin. The group was dropped pre-debut due to Yunho and Jaejoong joining TVXQ. He was later preparing to debut as the main vocalist of rock band TRAXX, but due to frequent clashes and misunderstandings with the people in charge of SM Entertainment at the time, he left Seoul and returned to his hometown in Gangwon Province. He first made his acting debut in 2004 in the TV drama "Sharp 2" with labelmates Go Ara and future bandmate Kibum. He is mostly known for hosting variety shows such as Knowing Brothers, Weekly Idol, Lipstick Prince, and A Style for You.

Yoo Heedo is a South Korean rapper, singer, and actor under Futore Company. He is a member of the boy group B.I.G under GH Entertainment, with whom he made his official debut on July 9, 2014 with the release of their first single titled "Hello". On April 10, 2018, he debuted with fellow member Gunmin in their group sub unit, Gunmin X Heedo, with the release of the single "Don't Worry". In 2021, he took part in the co-ed project group Triple7 along his fellow members and girl group 3YE. They released the song "Presente" on August 10, 2021. In 2017, he was a contestant on KBS2's survival show The Unit but was sadly eliminated in episode 14 after ranking 28th place. On October 31, 2023, Yoo Heedo announced he has left GH Entertainment, however, he did not state if he was leaving B.I.G, therefore, until any official announcement, it is assumed he's still part of the group. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 46th place. On March 31, 2025, FUTORE announced that Heedo will begin his military service on May 12.

Heejae is a South Korean singer. He is a member of Xst and a former member of Herycle. When the group was known as M.FECT, his stage name was Low. Heejae enlisted into the army at the end of April 2019.

Yoo Hee Jae is a South Korean singer and actor. He is the maknae of the boy group SEVENUS (formerly MASC). Although the group initially disbanded, It was announced that he, along with Ireah would be joining PCS Entertainment as SEVENUS in May of 2023.

Heeju is a South Korean singer under COMMAND THE-M Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 27, 2023 as a member of the boy group CMDM. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Heejun is a South Korean singer. He made his solo debut in October of 2001 with the studio album "Alone".

Heejun is a South Korean Singer, he was the maknae of the boy group KNK. Heejun debuted as a member of KNK on March 3, 2016 with the single album "Knock". He made his solo debut with the digital single "Night" on October 16, 2021. On January 13, 2022, 220 Entertainment announced the departure of Oh Hee Jun from KNK as he decided not to renew his contract with the company
Yoon Hee Seok is the Lead Vocalist and Visual of the boy group LIMITLESS under ONO Entertainment. Heeseok is first known for appearing in Produce 101 Season 2.

Park Hee-seok, or simply Heeseok and formerly K-BEAN, is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group XENEX. He debuted as part of the duo "X10" and boy group "Baikal". He was also a participant in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Lee Heeseung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, composer, and producer under HYBE Labels and Belift Lab. He is best known as the main vocalist and the oldest member of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Heeseung was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked 5th place by global votes and became a member of the boy group ENHYPEN. He made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".

Heewoo is a South Korean singer and trainee under J-Star Entertainment. He is the sub-vocalist of the boy group N.TOP, having been introduced as part of the group’s debut lineup. Though he began his career without prior public appearances, Heewoo officially stepped into the spotlight with the release of N.TOP’s debut single album "We:Disconnect," marking his first activities as an idol.
Heitetsu is a Japanese actor under CULEN. He was a contestant of the survival show NCT Universe : LASTART.

Na Ung Jae, better known as Ungjae and Hello Gloom, is a South Korean singer under WAYBETTER. He is best known for being the maknae of the boy group Imfact. In 2021, he set up his label The Faker Club together with former BIGSTAR member Raehwan and designer Sulju. He then released new music under his stage name Hello Gloom. He made his solo debut on May 28, 2022, with his first EP Because I Was Young Boy.

Hendery is a Chinese-Macanese rapper and singer-songwriter under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and NCT U its Chinese sub-unit WayV. He is also one-half of WayV's pre-debut subunit duo WayV-LUCAS&HENDERY.

Henry, also known as Henry Lau, is a Chinese-Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, composer, and actor. He first gained recognition as a member of SUPER JUNIOR’s sub-unit SUPER JUNIOR-M in 2008 before making his solo debut on June 7, 2013 with the mini album Trap. His career spans music, film, television, and the arts, establishing him as one of the most versatile entertainers in the Korean and Chinese entertainment industries. In April 2018, Henry parted ways with SM Entertainment and Label SJ following the expiration of his contract. He soon established his own one-man agency in China and later signed with Monster Entertainment Group and AXIS to manage his global activities. Since then, Henry has continued to expand his career internationally. His 2017 OST It’s You became the most streamed Korean soundtrack on Spotify for two consecutive years, further cementing his reputation as a successful solo artist. Beyond music, Henry made his Hollywood debut in 2019 with A Dog’s Journey and starred in the 2020 action-fantasy film Double World, which marked a milestone as the first Chinese-produced movie to receive a simultaneous global release through Netflix and iQIYI. On television, his variety show appearances on Real Man and I Live Alone earned him major recognition, including the Best Newcomer Award in 2014 and the Excellence Male Award in 2017 at the MBC Entertainment Awards. Henry is also an entrepreneur and artist. In 2018, he opened the Taiwanese restaurant Xiao Zhan in Seoul, later expanding with a second branch. His artwork was showcased in 2021 at the START Art Fair at London’s Saatchi Gallery in a special exhibit highlighting K-pop’s cultural influence. Alongside his creative pursuits, Henry has been actively engaged in philanthropy, serving as a goodwill ambassador for organizations such as Save the Children and the International Vaccine Institute. He has also supported music education programs and campaigns promoting youth welfare and social causes.
Heo Ji O is a South Korean trainee under STARON Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Heo Jinhyeok is a Korean singer. He is a member of the K-rock group Wetter.
Heo Seungmin is a South Korean singer. He is a contesant on Wild Idol. He used to be a Pledis trainee.
Young Saeng is a member of the South Korean boy group SS501. He is currently active as a part of the subgroup SS301 (Double S 301).
Heojun is a South Korean singer and actor. He is a former member of the boy group MADTOWN.
Heon Seo is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He made his debut on March 29th, 2023 with the single "I Believed In Love".
Kim Min Su, known under the stage name Hero, is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group SM☆SH.
Lee Young-woong, also known as Hero, is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group LUCENTE.
Jo Youngwoong, better known as Hero, is a South Korean rapper. He made his official debut in 2017 as a member of the boy group 14U.
Heungsun is a South Korean drummer and percussionist. He was a member of the co-ed indie rock band Beautiful Days.
Hijiri is a Japanese trainee. He is a member of the boy group BERAVE. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.

Hikari is a Japanese singer affiliated with KISS Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group FANTASY BOYS. Hikari gained recognition as a contestant on the survival shows Fantasy Boys and Starlight Boys.

Hikaru is a Japanese singer and model under YX LABELS. He placed fifth on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the boy group aoen. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group 24kumi. He is also known for participating in the reality survival show &AUDITION - The Howling -.

Hikaru was born as Urabe Hikaru on July 14th, 2003 in Saitama, Japan. He a member of the boy group FANTASY BOYS under PocketDol Studios. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys. His finishing rank was #11.
Him Chan is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group B.A.P. He made his solo debut on October 25, 2020 with the digital single "Reason Of My Life".
Yonemaru Hinata is a Japanese singer and member of the Korean-Japanese boy group "NIK".
Hinata is a Japanese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Hiro, formerly known as Hwan, is a South Korean singer currently signed to Startree Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group MY ONE and was previously active in the groups AQA and Road Boyz. Hiro made his solo debut on June 20, 2019, with the digital single “Weekends,” showcasing his individual artistry ahead of his later group activities.
Won is a South Korean singer. He is set to debut as a member of the boy group I1IT on August 25, 2022.
Takatsuka Hiromu was born on April 4th, 1999, in Tokyo, Japan. He is the main vocalist of INI. He made his debut in INI on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A".
Hiroto is a Japanese trainee, model and actor under NEW EVIDENCE. He is a former member of Johnny’s Jr.. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Nishi Hiroto was born on June 1st, 1997, in Kagoshima, Japan. He is the main dancer and lead rapper of INI. Nishi Hiroto debuted as a member of INI on November 3rd, 2021 with the single "A".
Hiroto is a Japanese trainee under CAT's Eye Okinawa. He is currently participating in the SBS survival show "Universe League."

Hiroto is a Japanese rapper and dancer under JT Entertainment. He is a former pre-debut member of the boy group NXD. He made his solo debut on June 30, 2025 with the digital single "Tasty". He is best known for his participation on the survival shows "Produce 101 Japan", "Produce Camp 2021" and "Boys Planet".

Hitchhiker is a South Korean singer, musician, DJ, producer, and composer under SM Entertainment. He began his career in 1995, under the name Jinu, as a composer for the song "Boogie-Woogie" for Lee Seung Hwan's fourth album Human. In 1996, he released his first solo album Jinu#Joke. He then formed the rock band Rollercoaster in 1999, with Lee Sang Soon and Jo Won Sun. He serving as the bassist and programmer. Following the group's disbandment, he began working as a DJ under the name DJ Jinu before changing to his current stage name, Hitchhiker.
Hoang Phan is a Vietnamese-American trainee. He gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Asia Super Young and Starlight Boys.
Hogeon is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the co-ed duo Electricity Flowing. He was a member of Frenzy (2010 - 2012) along with 9 and the Numbers‘ Jeongmok.

Lee Hohyeon is a South Korean rapper and former member of the boy group TRCNG under TS Entertainment. As the group's main rapper, he also took part in writing lyrics, including contributing to the rap lines in their debut album.
Jung Ho Ik, better known as Hoik, was the vocalist, rapper, and maknae of now disbanded boy group AA and it's subunit AOORA&HOIK. After the group's disbandment, he began working primarily as a model.
Hojae Lim is a member of the co-ed rock band Adios Audio, he was also a member of Vermitrap and OopsNice.
Jeon Hojin is the Main Dancer of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment.
Ho Jin is a South Korean singer and model under Morph Management and GOGO2020. He is a member and the main vocalist of the boy band 2Z.

Hojoon is a South Korean singer under Hunus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XENO-T. In 2017, he participated on the idol rebooting project show The Unit. He was eliminated in episode 11 and finished in 38th place. Hojoon announced his enlistment on April 28th, 2019.

Hojun is a South Korean singer and model. He is a former member of the boy group F.able. Following the group’s last activities in the summer of 2023, he began using his Instagram account for personal updates and modeling-related content. Since late 2024, he has frequently posted product advertisements, dance reels with friends, and snapshots of his daily life, often engaging with fans through comments and stories. He also occasionally hosts live streams on TikTok.
Hojun is a South Korean singer under Victory Company. He is a member of the boy group NTX.
Ko Hojung, or simply Hojung and formerly K.HO, is a South Korean singer and actor. He is best known for being a member of the boy groups HOTSHOT and UNB.

Holland is an independant South Korean solo artist who officially debuted on January 22, 2018 with the single "Neverland". He is considered the first openly gay idol to debut in the Korean music industry.

homezone is a South Korean singer-songwriter under Garden on Mars. He made his solo debut on August 23, 2019 with the digital single "Hymn to the Equinox". He is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.
Honey was apart of AxisB
Hong is a South Korean singer and dancer signed with GRID Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group POW.

Hong Eunki, also known simply as Eunki, is a South Korean singer currently under Daol Entertainment. He was first known for appearing and competing in the hit boy group survival show "Produce 101 Season 2". Despite getting eliminated, Eunki was able to debut through the project boy group RAINZ. Following the group's disbandment, Eunki started preparing for his solo promotions. Eunki eventually made his solo debut on July 19, 2019 with his first digital single "Blow".

Hong Jin Ho is a South Korean musician under CREDIA Music & Artists. He is the cellist of the boy band Hoppípolla. Hong Jin Ho graduated from Seoul National University (Bachelor in instrumental music) and Hochschule für Musik Würzburg (Master and PhD in instrumental music). He won various music competitions in Korea, Italy, France and Germany. In 2019, Hong Jin Ho joined JTBC's audition show SuperBand and won with his band Hoppípolla. The band debuted on November 16, 2019 with the group's first digital single "About Time".
Hong Keon Hee is a South Korean rapper under Redstart ENM. He is a member of the boy group TIOT. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Boys Planet.
Hong Sung Min is a member of the boy group FANTASY BOYS under PocketDol Studios. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys. His finishing rank was #3.
Hong Zhi Han is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Hong Zih Hao is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Lee Hong Bin is a South Korean Singer and Actor under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is best known as the Lead Rapper, Vocalist, Visual, and Face of the Boy Group VIXX. He acted in the dramas: Glorious Day (2014), Moorim School (2014), Witch's Love (2018), and the smile has left your eyes (2018). On 7 August 2020, his departure from VIXX & Jellyfish Entertainment was announced following the controversy of his drunken livestream on Twitch.
Hongil is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group ASTIN.

Hongjoong is a South Korean rapper, dancer, singer, songwriter, producer, and composer under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ, in which he debuted on October 24, 2018 with the release of their first mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero". Before debuting, Hongjoong appeared and competed on the survival show "MIXNINE" where he ranked 42nd.
Hong Gyu is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group Be.A, formerly known K-MUCH.
Hongseob is a South Korean singer and rapper. He was former member of the boy group 24K.

Yang Hongseok is a South Korean singer and actor best known as the lead vocalist of PENTAGON. He is currently under ANDMARQ after parting ways with Cube Entertainment. Before debuting, Hongseok gained recognition for his participation in YG Entertainment's survival show MIX & MATCH in 2014, where he competed as a member of TEAM B but was eliminated in the final episode. He left YG Entertainment in 2015 and later joined Cube Entertainment, where he participated in Pentagon Maker in 2016 and secured a spot in PENTAGON’s final lineup. He officially debuted with the group on October 10, 2016, with the mini-album PENTAGON. In addition to his music career, Hongseok ventured into acting, making his debut in the 2017 film The Love That’s Left. On November 6, 2023, Cube Entertainment announced that he had decided not to renew his contract. While he is no longer under Cube, he remains an active member of PENTAGON.
Lee Hoolim is a South Korean model, actor, and trainee under Big Punch Entertainment. Besides starring in dramas and musicals, Hoolim also participated in the survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Yeo Hoon Min, best known as Hoon is a South Korean singer and actor. He is best known as a member of the South Korean boy group, U-KISS under NH Media. Hoon joined the group in February 2011 after the departure of two members. He made his debut as a member of U-KISS through the group's fifth mini album, "Bran New Kiss" on March 30th the same year. Before his debut in U-KISS, he was a solo ballad singer under his real name and released an extended play, "Pure & Love" on September 9, 2009. Hoon has acted in several dramas including: “Athena: Goddess of War” (2010), “Beautiful Man” (2013), “Sweet Home, Sweet Honey” (2015), and “Unknown Woman” (2017). On August 1, 2021 Hoon ended his contract with NH Media as he continued his solo activities.
Hoon is a part of Boy Group 1/N
Hooni is a vocalist in the boy group B.I.T. He was previously in groups NewUs and All-Star.

Lee Seung-hoon, better known by the mononym Seunghoon or Hoony, is a South Korean singer, rapper, songwriter and choreographer. He is a member of the South Korean boy group WINNER. Prior to his debut, he appeared in the first season of the television singing contest K-pop Star, finishing in fourth place. Hoony was born in South Korea's Busan. Following his high school graduation, he relocated to Seoul and participated in the "Honest Boys" dance group's audition for Korea's Got Talent. He then debuted as a member of WINNER on August 17, 2014 with lead singles "Empty" and "Color Ring". Seunghoon became the second member of the group to enlist on April 16, 2020. He was discharged on January 15, 2022.
Jeong Yeong Ki is a South Korean singer and model. He is a member of the boy group Greatguys.
Ji Ho Seong is a South Korean singer and musician. He is currently the bassist and vocalist of the pre-debut band A:FACT.

Kwon Soonyoung, popularly known by his stage name Hoshi, is a South Korean dancer, singer, choreographer, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the main dancer, lead vocalist and sub rapper of the boy group SEVENTEEN. Hoshi is also the leader of SVT PERFORMANCE Team and choreographs most of the group's performances. He also debuted in SVT's sub-unit BSS (BooSeokSoon). Hoshi debuted as a member of SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015, with the EP 17 Carat. Hoshi released his first solo mixtape, "Spider", worldwide on April 2, 2021.
Hosoo is a singer and pianist under NAME X Entertainment. He debuted as a soloist on May 29, 2025, with the single "Dr. B-PANG" and is part of the virtual band OFF EQUALS.
Hou Jia En is a Chinese trainee under JS Entertainment. He gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys.
Howon is a South Korean singer and guitarist, member of the co-ed group THE HRTZ. He is one of the original members of the group.
Chung Ho Won, or simply Howon, is a Korean-Chilean singer-songwriter under Favor Entertainment. He is the vocalist of the boy band W24. He is also a member of the CCM band AGAPAO Worship.

Hoya (also known as Lee Ho Won) is a South Korean singer and rapper under Yellow Flavor. He is a former member of the boy group INFINITE and its subunit INFINITE H, leaving the group in 2017 after deciding not to renew his contract. Hoya is also a member of the dance crew Mbitious. He made his debut as a soloist on March 28, 2018, with the mini album "Shower." He debuted as a member of INFINITE on June 9, 2010, with the mini album "First Invasion." In 2013, he, along with fellow groupmate Dong Woo, debuted as the subunit INFINITE H with the mini album "Fly High." On August 30, 2017, it was announced that Hoya would leave both INFINITE and Woollim Entertainment after his exclusive 7-year contract with the agency expired on June 9, 2017. He then posted a handwritten letter on Instagram following his departure from the group. On September 26, 2017, Glorious Entertainment announced that Hoya had signed with them. Hoya made his solo debut on March 28, 2018, with the mini album "Shower." On April 1, 2022, Illusion Entertainment announced that he had signed an exclusive contract with them. In 2022, he applied to be a part of the Mbitious crew, a group of dancers that allows those not involved in a crew to participate in "Street Man Fighter." He participated in the Mnet reality show "Be Mbitious" and became a final member of the crew. On September 11, 2023, Yellow Flavor announced that Hoya had signed with them. On May 2, 2024, RISE Entertainment announced that Hoya had signed an exclusive contract with them. Hoya enlisted in the military as a public service worker on February 7, 2019, and was officially discharged on December 6, 2020.

Ryu Hoyeon, also known as Hoyeon, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and producer. He is a former member of the disbanded boy group NOIR. Hoyeon is also part of the producing team CIELOGROOVE, where he works under the name BIGSHARKK.
Son Ho-Young (also known as SHY) is a Korean-American singer and musical actor under Beat Interactive. He is best known for being the lead vocalist of South Korean idol group g.o.d.

Hoyoung is a South Korean singer and rapper currently under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is a member, dancer and rapper of boy group VERIVERY. Hoyoung was introduced as a member of VERIVERY on September 4 with a short video, followed by two reveal photos and a behind-the-scenes video. Hoyoung debuted as a member of VERIVERY on January 9, 2019, with their debut mini-album Veri-Us. On October 30, 2023, Jellyfish Entertainment announced that Hoyoung would be going on hiatus due to a deterioration in his psychological well-being.
HoYul is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the duo Rayin Tree.
Hsu Ching Yu is a Taiwanese trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Hu is a member of the 4-member group AFOS.
Hu Han Wen is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Huang Jia Liang is a Chinese trainee under Qin's Entertainment. He is a member of the trainee group BC221. He gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys.
Huang Peng Feng is a Chinese trainee under JS Entertainment. He gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys.
Huckleberry P, born Park Sang-hyuk is a South Korean rapper who debuted as a member of Pinodyne in 2007. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2011.

Kai Kamal Huening is a Brazilian/American-South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under BIGHIT MUSIC and HYBE Labels. He is the first foreign artist in the company. He is best known as the maknae of the boy group TXT. Beyond his vocal talents, Hueningkai has also contributed significantly to TXT’s music production, having worked on eight of their songs under the producer name Producer Hue. On January 15, 2019, Kai was revealed as the third member of TXT. The group officially debuted on March 4, 2019, with their debut mini album "The Dream Chapter: STAR".

Hugh is a South Korean singer under H&H Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BECZ. He is also a former member of the boy groups B.I.T, ALL-STAR and NewUs, and a former pre-debut member of B.O.B. Hugh was introduced as the first member of boy group BECZ on November 25, 2019. They made their debut on March, 13, 2020, with their first digital single "Into U".
Huh Gak is a South Korean singer under Play M Entertainment. He was the winner of Mnet's competition show Superstar K2 and made his debut on November 4, 2010 with his first single "As Always".
Hui is a former 24K member. He was born in Jiangsu province in China and is the Chinese member who at first was only going to be with 24K during the promotions in China.

Hui is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and the leader of PENTAGON under Cube Entertainment. He debuted with PENTAGON on October 10, 2016, with their self-titled mini-album PENTAGON. He was also a member of the co-ed group Triple H, alongside Hyuna and Dawn, debuting on May 1, 2017, with the EP 199X and the title track 365 Fresh. Hui is known for his contributions as a songwriter and composer, having written songs such as Never for Produce 101 Season 2, Energetic for Wanna One, and PENTAGON’s hit tracks Shine and Naughty Boy. He enlisted in the military on February 18, 2021, and was discharged on November 17, 2022. Shortly after, he participated in the 2023 survival show Boys Planet. On December 21, 2023, it was announced that Hui would make his solo debut on January 16, 2024, with his first mini-album Whu Is Me: Complex. On July 16, 2025, Cube Entertainment, as well as Hui himself, announced on social media that his contract had ended and he had parted ways with the company.

Noh Huijun is a South Korean singer under TOP Media. He made his official debut in 2020 as the main vocalist of the boy group MCND. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Gwon Huijun is a South Korean trainee and actor under PI Corporation. In 2019, he participated in the hit survival show Produce X 101, finishing 56th place, representing Cre.Ker Entertainment. He is currently participating in the SBS survival show Universe League.

Jang Hee Won, better known as Huiwon, is a South Korean singer under n.CH Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group n.SSign on August 9, 2023. Prior to debuting, he competed on the 2021 survival show LOUD, but was eliminated in the first round. He later participated in the 2022 survival show Stars Awakening, where he secured a spot in the debut group n.SSign.

Cha Hun is the Lead Guitarist and Vocalist of the band N.Flying under FNC Entertainment. Despite his serious looks, Hun is well-known for his comedic talent, which he showcases on his YouTube channel "2 Idiots," co-hosted with fellow band member Jaehyun. Their fans are affectionately referred to as "Professors."
HunnyHunna, born Kim Kyu-hyun is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2018.

maleIdols.description: Hunter is a Thai singer under KQ Entertainment. He debuted on March 30, 2023, as the main dancer of the boy group Xikers with their first mini album "House of Tricky: Doorbell Ringing" He was introduced as a member of KQ Fellaz 2 on August 19, 2022 alongside Seeun. His BT23 team participated in the show Got Talent and took 1st. He also learned to play golf at the age of 6 and won gold and bronze medals when he was just 10 years old, he won these medals from the 1st CGA & U.S Kids Golf Par 3 Challenge in 2015.
Hwan is the guitarist in FNC Entertainment's band, HONEYST. Before debut, he competed in d.o.b. alongside the other members of HONEYST as NEOZ Band.
Lee Hwan is a South Korean trainee. He is a former member of the pre-debut group DSP N.He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Produce X 101.
Hwang Chi Yeul is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and TV personality under TEN2 Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2007 with the digital single "Chi Yeul".

Hwang Inkyu is a South Korean guitarist and singer, member of the co-ed rock band KARDI and of indie rock band MOVNING. Inkyu has debuted as a solo artist under the name 667 on January 5, 2021, with the album “Do We Need“.
Hwang Leen is a South Korean guitarist and singer. He is also a member of the co-ed rock band KARDI and the bands ABTB and HASH.

Hwang Minhyun is a South Korean singer and actor under Pledis Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist of the boy group NU'EST and a former member of the temporary boy group Wanna One. Minhyun is best known for competing in the second season of MNET's Produce 101 where he earned a spot to be a member of Wanna One. After the group's success and disbandment, Minhyun returned to the group NU'EST. Minhyun debuted as a member of the boy group NU'EST in 2012. Wanna One debuted on August 7, 2017, with their first mini album 1X1=1 (To Be One), and officially concluded their activities on January 27, 2019. Following Wanna One's disbandment, he released his first digital single "Universe" on April 3, 2019. On June 26, 2020, Hwang was cast in the lead role of Go Eun-taek in the JTBC drama Live On, which aired from November 2020 to January 2021. On February 28, Pledis Entertainment announced that the NU'EST members' contracts would expire on March 14 and Minhyun decided to renew with the company. Hwang Sun Woo is a South Korean trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

HwangBo MinGyeol is a South Korean trainee under MODHAUS. He is the third revealed member of the upcoming boy group idntt. Hwang Yoon-Seok, better known as Hwanhee, is a South Korean singer, actor and a member of South Korean R&B duo Fly to the Sky.

Hwani is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group DUSTIN under Na Entertainment which he left on May 24, 2021, when the group disbanded. Jeong Hwan Rok, better known by his stage name Hwanrok, is a South Korean singer. He is the vocalist and maknae of the KPop boy group, Withus, under withHC. However, he withdrew from the program shortly before its broadcast.

Hwansung was a member of the South Korean boy group NRG (New Radiancy Group). Hwansung was in a project group with Shoo (S.E.S), Son Hoyoung, and Danny Ahn from g.o.d called Kkaebi Kkaebi before he debuted in NRG On June 6, 2000, Hwansung was taken to the hospital due to cold symptoms but was transferred to the intensive care unit (ICU) due to a sudden high fever and difficulty breathing. Hwanwoong is a South Korean singer under RBW. He is a member of the boy group ONEUS, with whom he debuted with on January 9, 2019 with the release of their first mini album "Light Us". Park Jong-chan also known as Hwarang is a South Korean actor, rapper, songwriter, and producer. On October 4, 2023, it was reported by different news sites that Hwarang had filmed a woman without her consent at his house while she was asleep intoxicated. Following the reports, his social media accounts went private and his scenes on a web drama were edited out.

Song Jaewon, also known by the stage name Hwarang, is a South Korean rapper and dancer. He is a former member of the boy group TEMPEST. Hwarang (then known as Song Jae Won) was introduced as a contestant of the survival show Under Nineteen on October 25, 2018, as part of the performance team. He was eliminated in episode 12 after placing 11th in the performance team and 32nd overall. On March 2, 2022, under the stage name Hwarang, he debuted as the main rapper and main dancer of the boy group TEMPEST. On October 19, 2023, Yue Hua Entertainment announced that Hwarang would undergo surgery for his injured shoulder and would be going on hiatus to recover. On March 6, 2024, Yue Hua Entertainment announced that Hwarang would halt activities with the group for a second time due to a lack of trust between both parties. Subsequently, on August 11, 2024, Yue Hua Entertainment announced that both Hwarang and the company had mutually agreed to end his exclusive contract with Yue Hua, resulting in him leaving both the company, as well as TEMPEST.

Yoo Hweseung is a South Korean singer and songwriter under FNC Entertainment. He is currently the vocalist of the band "N.Flying". Before making his debut, Hweseung participated in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2", where he finished in 39th place. It was only on June, 2017, that FNC Entertainment announced that Hweseung would be joining the group. He officially debuted with N.Flying during August of 2017 with the band's 2nd mini album "THE REAL : N.Flying"
Lee Choong-Hyun, better known as Hwi, is a South Korean singer under Rain Company. In 2021, he made his official debut as the main dancer and vocalist of the boy group CIIPHER.
Hwi is a member of ANTARES. He was formerly a member of ZPZG, who debuted on September 25, 2014.
Hwi is a member of the South Korean boy group New Kidd which started on July 11, 2018 with the group's second pre-debut album "Boy Boy Boy".

Eun Hwi is a South Korean singer and dancer under P Nation and a member of the boy group TNX. As a trainee, he competed in the SBS survival show "Loud." Through the show, he was recruited by PSY to be a member of the boy group TNX. He made his official debut on May 17, 2022.
Hwi is a South Korean singer under DND ENS. He is a member of the boy group SWEET:CH and a former member of PLAN B.

Hwichan (formerly Raychan) is a singer and lyricist in the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly in the boy group LIMITLESS. The label further revealed Hwichan will serve as a public service worker.

Kim Taekwan, better known as Hwichan, is a South Korean singer and actor. He gained popularity by participating in the show "Battle Shinhwa!" Originally eliminated, he was added to the boy group Battle before their debut as Shinhwa's Dongwan's pick of contestant chose to drop out of the group. After Battle disbanded, he began an acting career in China. He now owns his own cafe.

Kim Youngkyun, also known by his stage name Hwiyoung, is a South Korean singer, rapper, songwriter, and actor under FNC Entertainment. He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016, with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation". He made his solo debut with the digital single "Drive5" on August 13, 2023. In 2018, he participated as a contestant in Mnet's "High School Rapper 2".

On August 31, 2022, Hwon was introduced as the newest member of The KingDom. He made his debut with the group with the album: "History of Kingdom: Part Ⅴ. Louis", released on October 5, 2022. On January 17, 2025 GF Entertainment announced that Hwon has left the group due to personal reasons.
Hyecheon is a South Korean singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY.

Chu Hyuk-jin, also known as Hyeok Jin, is a South Korean singer and actor under Wings Entertainment. He first debuted in 2014 as a member of the boy group A.Cian. In 2020, he was selected to be a member of the project trot boy group Super Five.
Hyeon is a South Korean singer under Illusion Entertainment and OneWorld Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group AWEEK.

Kim Hyeonbin is a South Korean idol under Cube Entertainment. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival program Produce X 101, and was eliminated at 30th place. He later debuted as a member of the boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024, with the single album "NOWADAYS".

Lim Hyeongbin is a South Korean singer and musician under IST Entertainment. He is the maknae of the rock band BANDAGE. On January 6, 2023, IST Entertainment released a statement announcing the termination of the contract between the members and the company.
Park Hyeonggeun is a South Korean rapper under RBW. He is a member of the boy group NXD. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show "Fantasy Boys".
Hyeongjin is a South Korean rapper under PCS Entertainment. He is the maknae of the upcoming boy group DIGNITY and a former member of the pre-debut JN boy group.
Hyeongjin is a South Korean singer under Victory Company. He is the leader of the boy group NTX.

Song Hyeong Jun is a South Korean Singer under Starship Entertainment. However, on January 6, 2020, the agencies representing the members announced the group has disbanded due to not being able to reach an unanimous agreement following the Produce 101 vote manipulation controversy. Hyeongjun debuted as a member of CRAVITY on April 14, 2020 with the release of the mini album Hideout: Remember Who We Are - Season1.
Kim Hyeongmin is a trainee under Kiwi Media Group. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival show "Produce X 101".
Hyeongseok is a South Korean singer and rapper under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group W.A.O and is a former member of the boy group ASTIN.

Hyeongseong is a South Korean former singer. He is best known for being a member of the group D.I.P. The five later signed with Inter B.D Entertainment and debuted in the group D.I.P. The group disbanded after only 2 years of activity in November of 2018.

Hyeongseop is a South Korean singer and actor under Yue Hua Entertainment. Soon after, he debuted as an actor in Naver TV Cast's web drama "Mischievous Detectives", which aired from September 12 to September 28, 2017. He also played in the second season of the show. They debuted on November 2, 2017, with the release of the digital single "The Moment of Memory". On January 3, 2022, Hyeongseop was revealed as the fourth member of Yue Hua Entertainment's upcoming boy group TEMPEST. He debuted as a member of the group on March 2, 2022, with the release of their first mini album titled "It's ME, It's WE". Hyeongseop was an MC for SBS M's The Show along ATEEZ's Yeosang and NCT's Xiaojun from March 28, 2023 to March 5, 2024.

Hyeonmin is nicknamed as the Cutie Maknae of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment. His main specialty is dancing and taking care of his fellow members despite being the youngest. With his youthful charms and skills, Hyeonmin is one of the rookie idols to watch out for.

Hyeonseung is a South Korean singer and dancer under TNK Entertainment. On August 14, 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on MBC's survival show Fan Pick. He ranked 7th place overall, making him the seventh and last member of the winning group PICKUS. He debuted with the group on April 23, 2024 with the release of the single album "Little Prince". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024, but was eliminated

Kang Hyeonsu, formerly known as AO (LC9) and later D.A. (BLK), is a South Korean singer, rapper, and member of the project group Playback 7. He was a member of the boy groups LC9, BLK, NIK. Kim Hyeonwoo is a South Korean actor, model, and trainee under YG KPlus. He is a current member of project group AT06. Hyeonwoo was first known for appearing in the reality survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Lee Hyeop is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He debuted on October 28, 2020, as the main vocalist of the boy group DRIPPIN. Hyesung is a South Korean singer under KLAP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VANNER. Hyo is a Japanese trainee under Watanabe Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows Boys Planet and B:MY BOYZ.
Hyobin is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy groups PUREBOY and NTB.

Hyojin, also known as JN, is a South Korean singer and songwriter. He is a member of the boy group XONIK and a former member of the pre-debut group Eight and SUPERX. He is best known for participating in the survival shows Stars Awakening and Project 7.

Kim Hyojin is the Main Vocalist of the boy group ONF under WM Entertainment. He is also the leader of the boy group's ON sub-unit. In October 2017, he joined the survival reality show MIXNINE as a contestant and representative of his agency and boy group ONF. Hyojin ranked 2nd place and made it into the final group, however after much discussion it was decided the MIXNINE group would not debut.
Jeong Hyojun is an actor and trainee under YGKPlus. Besides acting in several web and tv dramas, he has also appeared in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2".
Hyosung is a South Korean singer signed with Wannabe Entertainment. He is part of the pre-debut group VVS. He also used to be in the boy group ZPZG under the name Hyo.
Hyowon, formerly known as JuKang, is a South Korean singer under NEWWAYS COMPANY. He is the maknae of the boy group ASC2NT and a former member of JWiiver.
Komori, Yuhi known as Hyu,i is a Japanese singer and Member of the Pre-debut Boy Group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 6th in the Nizi Project Season 2.
Hyuk (formerly Gun) is a singer, rapper, lyricist, and actor signed with IPQ and EarlyBird Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Omega X was formerly part of the boy group ENOi.

Hyuk is a South Korean singer under Yue Hua Entertainment. On January 3, 2022, Hyuk was revealed as the seventh and last member of Yue Hua Entertainment's upcoming boy group TEMPEST. He debuted as a member of the group on March 2, 2022, with the release of their first mini album titled "It's ME, It's WE".
Hyuk is a North Korean rapper under Singing Beetle Entertainment. He debuted as a member of 1VERSE on July 18, 2025.

Han Sang Hyuk, popularly known as Hyuk, is a South Korean singer and actor under Companion Company. He made his official debut in May 2012 as the maknae of the boy group VIXX under Jellyfish Entertainment. On June 1, 2022 Hyuk released a heartfelt letter announcing to fans that he would be leaving Jellyfish Entertainment to pursue solo activities elsewhere. Despite of this, he will not be leaving VIXX.
Hyukgi (also known as James) is a South Korean singer under YT Entertainment. He debuted with the group TRY1 on October 23, 2024 with the single album RE: TRY1.
HyukJin is a South Korean musician, known as the guitarist of the boy band D.COY, its subunit Lure, and the co-ed band WESS.

Hyukjin is a South Korean singer and musical theatre actor. He is a member of the boy group FAVE1 and a former member of the boy group 100% and its subunit 100% V. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show The Unit and Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor.
Hyukjin is a South Korean singer signed with WEUS Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WEUS.
Hyun is a South Korean singer and actor under n.CH Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group n.SSign. He is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Hyun is a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TARGET.

Hyun is the talented keyboardist of the Korean band KAVE and a current member of the co-ed band Binary Number. With his exceptional keyboard skills, he adds rich textures and layers to KAVE’s sound, enhancing their musical arrangements. Hyun's ability to blend melody and harmony brings depth to the band’s performances, both on stage and in the studio. His creativity and passion for music make him an integral part of KAVE’s distinctive style, while his work with Binary Number further showcases his versatility as a musician.
Hyun is a member of the upcoming boy group "DIOS". He was a back-up dancer for Teen Top (Miss Right), Yugyeom (Hit the Stage), Top Secret (Mind Control MV), and Mina and Phillip (Immortal Songs).
Hyun is a South Korean singer under 257 Entertainment. He is member of the group XLOV.
Hyun is a South Korean singer under Forest Network. He is a former member of the boy group Seven O'clock.
Hyun is a South Korean singer under TM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EASTSHINE.

Hyun Bin is a South Korean singer under Rain Company. He first appeared and competed in the boy group survival program "Produce X 101" where he finished 32nd place. In 2021, he made his official debut as the leader of the boy group CIIPHER. in 2023, he was introduced as one of the participants of the MBC survival show "Fantasy Boys."
Im Hyun Jae is a South Korean musician, best known for being the Lead Guitarist of the indie band "Hyukoh".

Kim Hyun-joong is a South Korean singer, actor, and songwriter. He rose to fame as the leader of the boy band SS501, which debuted in 2005. He gained widespread recognition for his roles in popular television dramas such as Boys Over Flowers (2009) and Playful Kiss (2010). On June 7, 2011, Kim launched his solo career with the release of his debut mini-album, Break Down, which achieved significant commercial success, topping South Korea's Gaon Weekly Album Chart and earning platinum certification in Taiwan. The album's title track, "Break Down," secured first place on music shows including Mnet's M Countdown and KBS's Music Bank. In 2012, he expanded his solo activities to Japan with the release of his first full-length Japanese studio album, Unlimited.

Lee Hyun Ho, known professionally as Hyun.O, is a South Korean rapper and actor. He began his entertainment career as a member of the hip-hop boy group D-CRUNCH, which debuted on August 6, 2018, with the single album "0806." Within the group, Hyun.O was recognized for his rapping skills and contributions to choreography. In 2021, he made his acting debut in the web drama "Time To Be Together 1:11,". Following D-CRUNCH's disbandment on November 9, 2022, Hyun.O signed an exclusive contract with High Season Company to focus on his acting career. Shortly thereafter, he enlisted in the military on February 27, 2023, and was discharged on August 26, 2024. In November 2023, Hyun.O released the single "Always In My Heart" in collaboration with SoYeon, under the label High Season.

Shin Hyunbin is a South Korean musician under IST Entertainment. He is a guitarist in the rock band BANDAGE. On January 6, 2023, IST Entertainment released a statement announcing the termination of the contract between the members and the company.
Hyunbin is a South Korean singer and dancer signed with GRID Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group POW.
Hyunbin is a South Korean trainee singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.

Lee Chang-hee, also known by the stage name Hyunchang, is a South Korean singer and musical theatre actor. He is best known for being a member of the boy group O.P.P.A. He began his musical theatre career by acting in the Rocky Horror Show musical in 2005.

Kang Hyungho is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the crossover vocal quartet Forestella. As a soloist, he goes by the stage name PITTA. He made his solo debut on October 29, 2020 with the single "Universe".
Hyungkyun is a South Korean singer and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a former member and a main vocalist of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. He left the group on October 9, 2020.
Song Hyungseok is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He is a member of the boy group YOUNITE.

Park Hyung-sik, known mononymously as Hyungsik, is a South Korean singer and actor. He made his official debut on January 7, 2010 as a member of the boy group ZE:A and its sub-group ZE:A Five. As an actor, he is known for his roles in The Heirs (2013), Hwarang: The Poet Warrior Youth (2016), Strong Girl Bong-soon (2017), Happiness (2021), Soundtrack #1 (2022) and Doctor Slump (2024).

Chae Hyungwon is a South Korean singer,actor,model, and DJ under Starship Entertainment. He is best known as the lead dancer, vocalist, and visual of the boy group MONSTA X. Besides his musical skills and visuals, Hyungwon is also widely recognized for being a "Meme King". His reaction gifs and photos are always used in social media sites, earning love and interest from even non-kpop fans. Before joining Monsta X, Hyung Won was a popular model. He participated in lots of fashion shows. He attended the Joy Dance - Plug In Music Academy in Seoul. In 2014, he also made many appearances as a model in fashion events, including the W Hotel and CéCi Fashion Show. In an attempt to join Starship Entertainment's newest boy band, Hyungwon competed in the Mnet reality survival series NO.MERCY. It was verified in the most recent show that he was in the final lineup. The group, whose name is set to be MONSTA X, made their debut on May 15, 2015, with the release of the mini-album 'Trespass'. In 2017 and 2018, Hyungwon made two consecutive appearances at the Ultra Korea electronic music event as a DJ, going under the moniker DJ H.ONE. Several further live performances and KCON Japan were attended by him in 2017. Two of the collaboration tracks he has released include Joohoney, a fellow member of MONSTA X. He was also the lead actor in the drama “Fly Again” (2021). On June 9, 2022, it was announced that he had renewed his contract with Starship Entertainment. In an effort to shorten the group's separation, Hyungwon stated on October 20, 2023, via the MONSTA X fancafe that he would be joining the military on November 14. The letter was handwritten. It is anticipated that he will be released on May 13, 2025.
Kim Hyunhah is a South Korean singer under COMMAND THE-M Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 27, 2023 as a member of the boy group CMDM.

Hyun Ho is a South Korean rapper under Ai Grand Korea and a member of the boy group D-CRUNCH. He enlisted in the military on February 27, 2023, and was discharged on August 26, 2024. On February 3, 2023, he signed an exclusive contract with U Entertainment to pursue his dream as an actor.
Hyunho is a South Korean drummer. He was a member of the co-ed group Broccoli, you too. He left the group in 2006. He was also a member of Kiha and the Faces and Nunco Band.

Lee Jae Hyun, better known as Hyunjae, is a South Korean singer and songwriter under ONE HUNDRED. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and visual of the eleven-member boy group The Boyz.

Kim Hyunjae, formerly known as The King, is a South Korean rapper. He first debuted as a member of BLACK6IX on April 7, 2017 with the release of the digital single "Please". The group ended up disbanding on April 16, 2021. In 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show Peak Time as part of TEAM 24:00. He eventually had to step down from the show due school violence allegations as he had to wait until he was proven innocent. On July 10, 2024, he announced through his SNS that one of his former school classmates was found guilty by the court for making false school bullying accusations, thus confirming his innocence. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 44th place.
Hyunjin Yu is a South Korean bassist, member of the rock band GonyBand.

Hwang Hyunjin is a South Korean rapper, dancer, singer-songwriter, and composer under JYP Entertainment. He is a member of Stray Kids and part of its unofficial subunit Danceracha. Hyunjin was scouted by JYP Entertainment while shopping with his mother in middle school. With no prior experience, he trained for two years before joining the survival show Stray Kids in 2017. He officially debuted with the group on March 25, 2018, with the album I Am Not and the title track "District 9." In 2021, he took a four-month hiatus following school bullying allegations. Hyunjin was named one of Forbes Korea’s "Top 30 Under 30," ranking among the top five entertainers and the youngest honoree in 2023. The same year, he became Versace’s first South Korean and Asian male ambassador, later starring in the brand’s Holiday Campaign and attending global fashion events. He was also appointed a brand ambassador for Cartier on September 24, 2024, and confirmed as Givenchy Beauty’s ambassador on March 5, 2025.

Kim Hyun Jong is a South Korean singer under 220 Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group KNK, and a former member of ROMEO pre-debut team i-Teen. In October 2017, Hyun Jong, became contestant on the survival show MIXNINE. Hyun Jong was eliminated in episode 14 after ranking 17th place. On December 4, 2023, ROMEO's Kim Hyun Jong was revealed as a new member of KNK.

Hyunjun, formerly known as Hwall and Hyunjun Hur, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and actor under Blossom Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group THE BOYZ. He made his solo debut on August 14, 2020, with the digital single "Baragi". On October 23, 2019, Hwall left THE BOYZ to focus on his recovery from a leg injury. He made his debut as an actor with the BL series "Color Rush" on December 30th, 2020.
Hyunjun is a South Korean singer under Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NouerA. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MAKE MATE 1.
Lee Hyunjun is the leader, guitarist, and visual of the boy band IZ under Music K Entertainment. Aside from playing the guitar, Hyunjun can also act and rap.

Bae Hyunjun is a member of the South Korean boy group ATBO under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” and debuted with ATBO by placing fifth place with a total of 1270 points.
Hyunki is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Neverland Entertainment. He made his solo debut on August 20, 2019, with the digital single "Wee Need To Talk."
Park Hyun-kyu, is a South Korean singer and musician. He is best known for his appearance in the survival program MIXNINE, and being a member of the vocal group VROMANCE.
Hyunmin is a South Korean singer and martial artist under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO and a former member of the project group RAINZ.

Hyunmin is a South Korean rapper under MYSTIC Story. He is the leader and main rapper of the boy group ARrC. Hyunmin was first known as one of the contestants on the 2023 survival show Boys Planet under Jellyfish Entertainment. He was officially introduced on December 29, 2022 as Park Hyun Been. He competed in the show until his eventual elimination in the 8th episode, ranking 48th place. On July 8, 2024, MYSTIC Story announced their first boy group to the public named ARrC. Hyunmin was revealed to be one of the 7 members of this group.

Woo Hyunmin, or simply Hyunmin, is a retired South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy groups XING and DGNA. He departed from DGNA in 2018. After retiring he began working as a painter under the name Woo Jaka.

Lee Hyun Seok is a South Korean singer under RBW. He was a member of the male vocal group VROMANCE. Hyunseok has recorded the guide for Soyou & Junggigo "Some." He has recorded the guide for 2AM's "I Wonder If You Hurt Like Me."

Shim Hyunseong is a South Korean singer under Dorothy Communications. He is best known as the main vocalist of the boy group BF, also known as BOYFRIEND. Hyunseong made his solo debut on October 2, 2020 with the digital single "Wind Road."

Hyunseung is a Korean singer and also a former member of the group 415. He made his debut on February 12, 2019 with the song “When We Were in Love Back Then”.
