Unfortunately, on November 11, 2022, it was announced that the duo disbanded due to the expiration of their contracts. Following this, Hyunseung enlisted in the military, and their activities were halted for the time being.
Kim Hyunseung is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group YOUNITE.

Hyunsik is a South Korean singer under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XODIAC and a former pre-debut member of HNB. Before debuting he participated in the survival show Produce X 101.

Lim Hyunsik is a South Korean singer under BTOB Company. He is a member of the boy group BTOB and its sub-unit BTOB-BLUE. He made his debut as a member of BTOB on March 21, 2012 with their first single "Insane". He made his solo debut on October 14, 2019 with his first mini album Rendez-Vous.
Kim Hyun Soo is a member of the boy group D1CE. He was first known for appearing on the survival show MIXNINE where he ranked 14th place.

Jang Hyun Soo is a South Korean singer and dancer under P Nation and a member of the boy group TNX. He was first known for competing in the SBS survival show "Loud" where he was also recruited by Psy to be a member of TNX. He made his official debut with the group on May 17, 2022.

Choi Hyun Suk is a South Korean rapper under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2017, he participarted in the reality survival show MIXNINE. He ranked 5th place on the final episode, hence becoming a member of the boy group. However, the debut got cancelled. In 2018, he participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. On January 25, 2019. he was announced as the seventh and final member of the boy group TREASURE. On January 29, 2019, YGE announced that he would form a second group from the show, called MAGNUM and together with TREASURE, they would promote together as TREASURE 13. Unfortunately, due to scandals surrounding the agency, the debut was postponed. On January 6, YGE posted a notice on their official website stating the group's future plans. This included re-organizing as a 12-member group and the integration of the two units, TREASURE and MAGNUM, into only one group named simply as TREASURE. Hyunsuk debuted as the leader of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with their first single album "The First Step : Chapter One".
Hyun Suk is a South Korean singer and rapper under C9 Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group CIX.

Hyunsung is a South Korean singer and model. He is a member of the disbanded boy group Apeace and its sub-units Apeace Lapis and later Apeace Onyx5. When the group went by Double B 21, he was the center of the sub-unit Sky.

HighTop is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and actor under Dahong Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group BIGFLO and its sub-unit Z-UK X HighTop. As an actor, he uses his full name, Lim Hyun Tae.
Hyunuk is a South Korean singer best know as member of the boy group SKYE (formerly IN2IT).

Hyunwoo is a South Korean rapper under Wolfburn. He officially debuted in 2017 as a member of the now-disbanded boy group TRCNG. After the group's disbandment in 2022, Hyunwoo re-debuted on January 30, 2023, as a member of the boy group BXB.
Hyunwoo is a soloist and former member of M.Pire and B.Crown He used to go by the stage name T.O.
Jeon Hyunwoo is a South Korean trainee under Astory Entertainment. He participated in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Hyunwoo is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the main vocalist of the boy group xikers. Hyunwoo was introduced as a member of KQ Fellaz 2 on August 17, 2022 alongside Junghoon.
Hyun Woo is a South Korean singer under Ai Grand Korea. He is a former member of the boy group D-CRUNCH. On December 28, 2020, it was announced that Hyunwoo had left the group due to health issues.
Hyun Wook is a South Korean singer under Ai Grand Korea. He is a member of the boy group D-CRUNCH.

Hyunwoong is a South Korean singer under J-Star Entertainment and the main vocalist of the boy group N.TOP. Prior to joining the group, he began his career as a solo artist with the digital single "White Night," later releasing additional tracks such as "Spring" and "Sailing." Known for his expressive vocals, Hyunwoong transitioned from solo activities to group promotions with his official debut in N.TOP through their first single album "We:Disconnect."

2017–2019: 14U On July 22, 2017, Hyun Woong made his debut in the boy group 14U with the single album VVV. He was a member of the group until their disbandment on May 13, 2019. 2019–2020: 2Z On November 21, 2019, Hyun Woong was introduced as the fourth member of 2Z. It was revealed in the video that he would be the main rapper of the boy band, which was a collaboration between Morph and GOGO2020. He officially made his debut with the band on January 14, 2020, with the EP We Tuzi:. On June 17, 2020, it was announced that he had decided to leave the band. 2022–present: D-ONE On October 6, 2022, he was revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group D-ONE.

Hyunyeop (Kim Hyun Yeop) is an emerging talent in the K-pop industry, now stepping into the spotlight as a member of IN A MINUTE under JWIN Entertainment. Before joining the trio, he gained recognition as a finalist on the survival show Wild Idol, where he ranked 6th, earning his debut in the project group TAN. With extensive training under BigHit Music, Brand New Music, FirstOne Entertainment, and RND Company, Hyunyeop has honed his skills as a well-rounded performer, showcasing strong vocals and stage presence. Now, alongside Jaejun and Juntae, he is set to debut with IN A MINUTE on March 15, 2025, with their first single album, UNBOXING: WHAT YOU WANTED. With their combined experience and passion, the group aims to make a lasting impact on the industry.
Kim Hyunyul is the guitarist of FNC Entertainment's boyband, Hi-Fi Un!corn.
I:ota is a former member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.

Im Chang-kyun, better known as I.M, is the lead rapper, vocalist and maknae of the boy group MONSTA X. He debuted through the Mnet's survival show No. Mercy, under Starship Entertainment. He was supposed to debut in another group in 2014 (Nu’Bility), but plans fell through in the last minute, since he decided to leave the group. I.M debuted as a member of MONSTA X on May 14, 2015 with their first mini-album "Trespass". He made his solo debut on February 19, 2021, with his first digital mini album Duality. In August 2022, he chose not to extend his contract with Starship Entertainment but will still continue to participate in the group's future plans. Later, in November, he signed an exclusive contract with Sony Music Korea for his solo activities. On September 15, 2025 MONSTA X’s I.M has officially become a free agent following the end of his exclusive contract with Sony Music Korea. Since joining the label in 2022, he expanded his solo career with releases such as Slowly, OVERDRIVE, and Off The Beat, and completed his first solo world tour across 18 cities. Despite focusing on individual activities, I.M has remained active with MONSTA X, most recently joining the group’s 10th anniversary concerts and contributing to their latest mini album THE X. Born in 1996, he is the youngest member of the group and the only one yet to complete military service.

Yang Jeongin, known as I.N, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and the youngest member of the boy group Stray Kids under JYP Entertainment. He joined the company after a second audition in Busan and was introduced through the survival show Stray Kids in 2017, officially debuting with the group on March 25, 2018. Beyond music, I.N has been recognized for his philanthropy, becoming the youngest member of the Green Noble Club in 2024 after donating 100 million KRW to ChildFund Korea. In 2025, he expanded his influence into fashion, being named Brand Ambassador for Bottega Veneta in January and Global Brand Ambassador for Damiani in May.

I'll is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musician. He was the leader, vocalist, and keyboardist of the boy band Hoppipolla. I'll debuted as a soloist on November 22, 2017 with his first single album "Maybe We Are". He later debuted with Hoppipolla on November 16, 2019 with the group's first digital single "About Time".

Noh Sungchul, also known as Ian, is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023. Ian was first known for participating in the 2020 survival show I-LAND.
Icey Blouie (아이시 블루이) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Icey Blouie Worldwide Entertainment in 2016.

Jeong Ichan, also known as Jeong Echan, is a South Korean singer and music producer under HYPLE Entertainment. As a trainee, he is known for appearing and competing in the suvival show "I-LAND" under the name Jaebeom and Boys Planet under the name Ichan. He made his official debut on June 23, 2022 with the digital single "Eternal Summer."
Iden is a South Korean rapper. He is currently the main rapper of the boy group "Megamax".
IEL is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under TM Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group EASTSHINE.
Ignito (이그니토), born Min Jae-ki (민재기) is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Tile Music in 2006. He was a contestant on Show Me The Money 6.
Ihwa (이화) is a South Korean singer signed with Mainbase Entertainment. On October 10, 2022, he was revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group D-ONE.

Ijun is a South Korean singer signed with HOWLING Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WAKER and was previously associated with the pre-debut group Shooter-X. He first gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show MIXNINE.
Ikuto is a Japanese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the Korean survival show B:MY BOYZ and the Japanese survival show timelesz Project.
Il Kwon is a former-member of 5TION.
Ilang Kwon is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which is under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 27, 2025.

Jung Ilhoon is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and composer, under Carpenters Art Republic. Formerly the main rapper of the boy group BTOB under Cube Entertainment. Known as the creator of the "Gwiyomi Player" trend, he debuted with BTOB on March 21, 2012, with their single "Insane." Ilhoon later made his solo debut on March 8, 2018, with the mini album "Big Wave". He enlisted for mandatory service on May 28, 2020, as a public service worker. However, in December 2020, Ilhoon officially left BTOB after becoming involved in a marijuana controversy. He admitted to all charges in April 2021 and submitted two statements of reflection. Originally sentenced to two years in prison with a fine of 133 million KRW on June 10, 2021, Ilhoon appealed, demonstrating remorse with over 80 statements of reflection. His sentence was reduced to three years of probation, a fine of 126.63 million KRW, and 40 hours of drug treatment. Ilhoon stopped using marijuana in 2019, seeking therapy and support from family and friends, which contributed to the court's leniency. After a three-year hiatus, Ilhoon announced his return to the music industry on Instagram on November 13, 2024, with his single “Lullaby,” set for release on November 21, 2024.
IlKyung was a member of now disbanded boy group BLK.
Im Chang Jung is a veteran Actor, Singer, and Composer. He made his singing debut in 1995 and has become one of the most loved musical acts in South Korea.
Im Hanguk is a member of the South Korean co-ed group THETHE and he is a Drummer. He joined the group in 2016.

Im Jung Hoon, formerly known by his stage name J-Hoon, is a South Korean singer, dancer, and actor. He is best known as the former leader of the boy group B.I.G, which debuted in 2014 under GH Entertainment. He was also a member of the seasonal co-ed project group Triple7, which featured members of B.I.G and 3YE before becoming inactive in 2022. After departing GH Entertainment in December 2023, Im Jung Hoon re-debuted with the boy group New And.B under Klick Studio in August 2024. Following the group’s disbandment in March 2025, he began promoting under his birth name. In mid-2025, he signed an exclusive contract with Numa Company, officially launching his solo career as both a singer and actor. Known for his strong popping dance skills, charming personality, and stage presence, Im Jung Hoon is now actively pursuing opportunities in music, acting, and variety entertainment.

Im Siu is a South Korean trainee. In 2019, he was a contestant on MNET's survival show Produce X 101 but left the show before the reevaluation grade in episode 2. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Imchan is a singer under Choeun Entertainment. He is a member of 24K+. He was revealed as #4 on August 2, 2019.

IMLAY, born Im Jae-bim, is a South Korean producer and DJ under SM Entertainment and ScreaM Records. He released his first solo single, "Gaze," on February 24, 2015. As a composer, he has contributed to projects by SHINee, Super Junior, LOONA, BoA, EXO, aespa, and many more. Since 2025, he has been appointed as a professor at Seoul National University of Arts.
Lee In Woo (이인우) is a South Korean musician. He is best known for being the drummer of the indie band "Hyukoh".
Inati (이나티) is a South Korean rapper. He is a member of boy group DMTN.
Lee Ingon, or simply Ingon, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He is best known for being a member of the boy group XENEX.
Lee In Haeng (이인행) is a South Korean rapper. He used to be the main rapper of the now-disbanded boy group Halo.
Inho is a South Korea singer best known as a member of the boy group SKYE.

Lee Inhong is a South Korean idol trainee under C-JeS Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WHIB, debuting on November 8, 2023. Inhong is best known for participating in the 2018 survival program YG Treasure Box.

Injun is a South Korean singer New Ways Company. He is a member of the upcoming boy group ASC2NT and a former member of the boy groups XING and DGNA. He made his acting debut in 2017 as the main role in Power Rangers Dino Force Brave. In late 2024, New Ways Company announced that Injun would go on hiatus due to health problems.

Go Bon-kuk, known under the stage name Ino, is a South Korean rapper and singer under INAKIST Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Y&W and a former member of INX under the stage name Bonkuk. He now does professional sports modeling and is a certified life sports instructor.

Inpyo is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group SKYE (formerly IN2IT). In 2016 he participated in the survival show BOYS24. After placing 8th, he debuted as a member of IN2IT on October 26, 2017 with their mini album "Carpe Diem".

Jeong Inseong (정인성) is a South Korean singer under 220 Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 3, 2016 as the main vocalist of the boy group KNK. He is currently in hiatus due to his military enlistment. Inseong was a former Big Hit Entertainment trainee where they both trained with the members of the boy group BTS. He also trained under FNC Entertainment which allowed him to appear as one of the trainees in a reality show called Cheongdam-dong 111 with Heejun back in 2013.

Kim Inseong is the vocalist and dancer of the boy group SF9 under FNC Entertainment. Aside from being the eldest, Inseong is also considered the smartest in the group. Inseong learned to speak English after studying in London for a year. He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016, with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation".
Lee Insoo (이인수) is a South Korean trainee and internet personality known as "Jaguar". He was first known for participating in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2".

Insoo is a South Korean singer and actor currently under iMe KOREA. He is a member of the boy group MYNAME. Insoo made his Japanese solo debut on September 6, 2017 with his first mini album Naked, shortly before enlisting for mandatory military service on October 26, 2017. He later made his Korean solo debut on August 7, 2021 with the digital single “Love Yourself.”

Cheon Intae (천인태) is a South Korean rapper under VT Entertainment. He is the main rapper of the boy group BLACK LEVEL. Before debuting, Intae became a trainee under different companies such as Blockberry Creative, DSP Media, and JYP Entertainment. He also participated in MIXNINE, representing 2Y Entertainment. On March 12, 2024 Daychild took to instagram to announce the addition of Intae!

Intae (인태) is a South Korean singer and former member of the duo groups 415 (사이로). On January 21, 2024, he was introduced as one of 40 contestants on the survival show “Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor” by Mnet. Prior to that, he was a trainee under Brand New Music.

Hwang Intak is a South Korean rapper, dancer, songwriter, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as one of the visuals of the boy group P1Harmony. On September 16, Intak was revealed as the third member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
Inu is a South Korean rapper under New Planet Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BXK.
Ioah is a South Korean producer who debuted under WAVY in 2019.

IÖN (born Park Gyu-jeong,) is a South Korean music producer and DJ. He is best known as one half of the acclaimed production duo GroovyRoom, which debuted independently in 2016 and quickly rose to prominence in the South Korean hip-hop and R&B scene. In addition to his work with GroovyRoom, IÖN is also a member of the South Korean hip-hop crew Yelows Mob, a collective known for its influential role in the underground and mainstream hip-hop community. He was previously signed to H1GHR MUSIC, a label founded by Jay Park and Cha Cha Malone, where he and fellow GroovyRoom member Lil Moshpit produced for a wide range of notable artists. In 2024, the duo departed H1GHR MUSIC to establish their own label and creative collective, AT AREA, aimed at promoting artistic independence and innovation. That same year, IÖN officially debuted as a solo artist, expanding his musical identity beyond collaborative production. Known for his genre-blending sound, polished production style, and forward-thinking approach to music, IÖN continues to shape the evolution of Korean hip-hop and R&B as both a producer and solo musician.

IONE (formerly known as Taeha) is a South Korean singer under Million Market. He was a member of the boy group SPEED, a sub-unit of Co-ed School that became independent in 2013. Following SPEED's disbandment, he debuted as a solo artist on June 24, 2016 with his first digital single "Back".

Lee Jong-hee, better known as Ireah, is a South Korean singer under J Planet Entertainment. In 2017, he debuted as a member of the boy group MASC. On May 2, 2023 it was announced that he, along with Heejae, would be joining PCS Entertainment as MASC.
Iro Cloud is a singer affiliated with Hubble Office. He is part of the virtual band SKOSHISM as a synthesizer. His birthday is September 25th.

Iron was a South Korean rapper. Best known for participating on the show Show Me The Money 3, he made his official debut in September of 2016. On January 25, 2021, Iron was found on the ground outside of an apartment building. After being rushed to a hospital, he was pronounced dead.

Isaac is a Malaysian singer. He is a member of the boy group SKYE, formed through the pre-debut survival group and show BOYS24. He made his solo debut on August 5, 2022 with the digital single "Time Bomb".
Isaac is an American singer under Sony Music Entertainment Korea. He is the maknae of the boy group KJRGL.
Itsuki (이츠키) is a Japanese trainee under MLD Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."
Ivan is a Malaysian trainee under Yuxiao Media. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Ivan is a Taiwanese trainee under True Fun Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Park Yoo-sung (박유성), better known as Ivan, is a South Korean singer under GF Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group KINGDOM. Within the group, he represents the Kingdom of Snow. Ivan debuted as a member of KINGDOM on February 18, 2021, with History of Kingdom Pt.1 Arthur and the title track of "Excalibur".

J_ust is a South Korean singer-songwriter signed under ATCM. He made his debut in July 2015 through a collaboration with Dr. Simpson on the track “Yeppeobwoyo” and has continued his musical activities as a solo artist. Known for his folk, blues, indie, and ballad influences, J_ust’s music focuses on creating emotionally resonant and easy-to-listen-to melodies. His debut solo track, “Goding (Mom’s Thoughts),” was released in September 2015, marking the start of his ongoing presence in the South Korean indie music scene.

Jung Hoseok, known under his stage name j-hope, is a South Korean dancer, rapper, singer-songwriter, producer, and composer under Big Hit Entertainment and HYBE Labels. He is best known as one of the main dancers and rappers of the worldwide sensational boy group BTS. j-hope took dancing classes at Gwangju Music Academy and became a part of an underground dance team called "Neuron" in which he went by the name Smile Hoya. Finding inspiration in G-Dragon and Beenzino, j-hope initially auditioned for JYP Entertainment but ultimately became part of Big Hit Entertainment. Eventually, j-hope debuted as a member of the group BTS; a boy group that went on to grow as a worldwide phenomenon. With passion and ceaseless efforts, j-hope became one of the most sought after artists of his generation. j-hope released his first solo mixtape, "Hope World" in 2018, and became the highest-charting Korean soloist at the time on Billboard 200. j-hope’s single “Chicken Noodle Soup (feat. Becky G)”, released in 2019 became his first solo entry on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart. With the song he became the third South Korean soloist overall to enter the chart. j-hope released his first official solo album, ”Jack In The Box” in 2022. The album debuted on the Billboard 200 Chart and the album’s two main tracks ”More” and ”Arson” both debuted on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart. Shortly after the album was released, he also became the first South Korean artist to headline a main stage at a major U.S. music festival ”Lollapalooza”. His second official solo album "HOPE ON THE STREET VOL.1" debuted at no. 5 on the Billboard 200 chart. With this, j-hope became the first South Korean artist to have multiple albums chart in the top 10 of the Billboard 200 chart.
J-Jin is a member of the boy group Limitless under ONO Entertainment.
J:eta is a former member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.
J.G. was the original maknae of the boy group CROSS GENE. He was known as the Destiny Gene. He left the group in 2013 in order to further pursue a solo career.
J.Heart is a South Korean singer. He is best known as the leader of the boy group N.SONIC. Following the group's disbandment, he made his official debut as a solo artist in 2015.
J.Jun is a South Korean singer under All-S Company. He is a member of MAP6 and was a member of the boy group A-PRINCE under the stage name Seung Jun.

Jung Jun Gyu, popularly known as J.K, is a member of the boy group N.O.M under JZ Factory Entertainment, company of which he is the CEO. He's also the leader of his group and the older brother of KOM (member of the same group).

Kim TaeHyung, popularly known as J.Seph, is the main rapper and lead dancer of the group KARD under DSP Media. He represents the letter A and the Ace card. J.Seph, the Ace, explained: “The Ace can either be the lowest card that supports the team or the highest card that is sharp.” J.Seph debuted as a member of KARD on July 19, 2017, with the mini album Hola Hola. He enlisted for his mandatory military service as an active duty soldier on October 5, 2020, and was eventually discharged on April 4th, 2022.
J.T is the main vocalist of the boy group VX.
J.UNA is a South Korean singer and acoustic guitarist, member of the rock band poco a poco. He was a contestant on SuperBand 2.
J.Vin is a South Korean rapper and singer under All-S Company. He is a member of the boy group MAP6 and a former member of the disbanded group A-PRINCE under the stage name Woo Bin.

Park Jin Young is a famous South Korean singer, songwriter, producer, and record label executive of JYP Entertainment. He started his music career with the song “Don’t Leave Me” from his first album, Blue City. From May 1997 to February 2011, he led JYP Entertainment and helped successful artists like Wonder Girls, TWICE, Stray Kids, and more. He is also known as one of Asia's top producers, creating back-to-back hits for different artists, such as TWICE's "Signal" and Sunmi's "24 Hours". As a globally recognized South Korean Entertainment industry figure, J.Y. Park continues to leave a mark with his music releases, business ventures, and iconic performances.

J.You, born as Kim Je-you, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter. He was a contestant in the survival program "WORD KLASS". In the final episode, he ranked first place, allowing him a spot in the boy group TO1 (then known as TOO) under WAKEONE. TO1 debuted on April 1, 2020 with their first mini album "Reason for Being : Benevolence". On December 17, 2023, WAKEONE announced that all members of TO1, including J.You, chose not to renew their contracts with the agency. Their contracts ended on December 31.
Ja Mezz, born Kim Sung-hee is a South Korean rapper who debuted under GRDL in 2014.

Jack is a singer and rapper from the virtual group RE:REVOLUTION. He is a former trainee of WM Entertainment and Starship Entertainment He began his career debuting in July 2021 in the group Revolution Heart until he and the other members terminated their contracts and formed their own group, re-debuting on April 26, 2024.

Jackson Wang (born Wang Ka-Yee) is a Hong Kong singer, rapper, and former national fencer. Before his music career, he represented Hong Kong’s national fencing team, winning two gold medals at the 2011 Asian Junior Olympics in Thailand. He later moved to South Korea to train under JYP Entertainment and debuted as a member of GOT7 in January 2014. Beyond group activities, Jackson gained international recognition as a singer and TV personality, leveraging his fluency in Korean, Cantonese, English, and Mandarin. In 2017, he founded Team Wang, his own music label, and made his solo debut in August of that year. Following GOT7’s departure from JYP Entertainment in 2021, Jackson continued his solo career under Team Wang, which manages his global promotions. On January 22, 2021, he confirmed a partnership with Sublime Artist Agency for additional representation.

Jacob Bae (Korean name: Bae Joon-young) is a Korean-Canadian singer and songwriter under ONE HUNDRED. Although born and raised in Toronto, Canada, Jacob remained anchored in his Korean roots. He wanted to be a singer, so he flew back to South Korea and auditioned for LOEN Entertainment. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the lead vocalist of the 11-member boy group The Boyz. Jacob took part in writing some of his group’s songs, including “I’m Your Boy (2017),” “Just U (2018),” and “Spring Snow (2020).”

Jang Peng, better known by the stage name Jacob, is a Chinese singer under A Team Entertainment. In 2015, he debuted with the Boy Group VAV (Very Awesome Voice) and in 2018, he debuted his Chinese solo track "Love Night".
Im Hahyeong, also known as Jae i, is a South Korean singer. He is the leader, lead vocalist, and main dancer of the boy group Greatguys.
Jae Jiho is a guitarist from the band, Wetter.
Jae Kyung is a South Korean musician and songwriter. He is best known for being the guitarist of the band "Nell".
Ha Jae Min is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Jung Jae Won is a South Korean musician under Space Bohemian Entertainment. He is best known as the drummer of the band "Nell".
Jae Yeon, also known as JayYeon, is a South Korean singer under A2Z Entertainment. He is a member of the co-ed group SWAY.
Jae-hyun is a member of the South Korean R&B duo "Vibe."
Lee Jaebin is a a South Korean singer and trainee under C9 Entertainment. He first appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Dèngbīn promoting under the stage name JaeBin, is a Chinese singer. He debuted as a member of the now-disbanded South Korean-Chinese boy group Varsity. His proficiency in the Chinese and Korean language made him the group's translator.

Jae Chan is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and actor under Dongyo Entertainment. He is a member of boy group DKZ and its first sub-unit DONGKIZ I:KAN. He has also starred in web dramas such as "Youtuber Class" and "Semantic Error." Jaechan debuted as a member of DONGKIZ on April 24, 2019 with their first single album "DONGKIZ On The Block."

Jae Chan is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and actor under GOLDEN MOON. He was one half of the duo XRO and a member of the fictional boy group ACT under the name Chuwoo. He made his solo debut on June 22, 2024, with the digital single "Too Late." Jae Chan was also a contestant on Produce 101 Season 2 and Wild Idol.

Kim Jae-duck is a South Korean singer, rapper, dancer and choreographer, he is the lead rapper and lead dancer of the first generation idol boy groups SECHSKIES and J-Walk under YG Entertainment. After SECHSKIES' sudden disbandment in 2000, Jaeduck said he wanted to become a dance instructor at their company, Daesung Entertainment (now known as DSP Media), but ended up forming a duo with fellow member Jang Suwon, going on to re-debut together in 2002 in the group J-Walk. After a few years of promotion with J-Walk and his mandatory military service, Jaeduck had reunited with SECHSKIES, having a reunion concert through the variety show Infinite Challenge. The group had later signed a contract with YG Entertainment to start promotions again.
Jaeha, born Kim Jae-ha is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2020. He joined Yumdda and The Quiett's label Daytona Entertainment in 2021.
Jaeha is a member of the South Korean boy group NTB (Never Take A Break).

Kim Jae-hyun, also known as Jaehyeon, is a South Korean idol trainee under C-JeS Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WHIB, debuting on November 8, 2023. Before training to become an idol, Jaehyeon was a competitive figure skater from 2011-2019.

Jaehan is a South Korean singer-songwriter under IPQ. He is a member of the boy group OMEGA X. He was also a member of the boy group SPECTRUM and the duo OneVoices under the name J.Han. He released his first solo single "Jaehan Watch" on December 18, 2018. He made his debut as a member of OMEGA X on June 30, 2021, with their first mini album Vamos. Jaehan starred in the BL drama “A Shoulder to Cry On,” portraying Lee Da Yeol.
Jaehee is a South Korean singer under oddsoap. He is a member of the duo MIND U and was a member of the duo Acourve. He debuted as a soloist on May 30, 2025 with the digital single "Laundry".

Jaehee is a South Korean trainee under ASTORY Entertainment. He is a former member of the project boy group HNB. He is also a former Brand New Music trainee. He participated in the survival show MIXNINE.

Jaehee is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of NCT and its Japan-based sub-unit NCT Wish. He was first introduced as a participant in the survival show NCT Universe: LASTART. He was introduced in Episode 4. He ranked 3rd in the show, earning his spot in the Japanese unit.
Jaeho is a South Korean trainee under Belift Lab. He appeared on the reality survival programs "World Klass" and "I-LAND".
Jaehoon is a South Korean singer signed with Mainbase Entertainment. On October 8, 2022, he was revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group D-ONE.
Park Jaehoon is a South Korean trainee under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” which got eliminated on Episode 5.
Jaehun is a South Korean singer and the youngest member (maknae) of the boy group Megamax.

Jeong Jaehun is a South Korean trainee under Around Us Entertainment. He first appeared and competed in the hit survival show "Produce X 101". In 2021, he then participated in "Extreme Debut: Wild Idol."
Jaehyeong, also known as Jeff, is a South Korean musician. He is the Maknae, Bassist, Sub Vocalist, Visual for the rock boy band The Rose.
Ahn Jae Hyo is a South Korean singer, dancer, model, and actor. Besides his good looks, Jaehyo is also known for being a member of the boy group Block B.

Jaehyuk is a Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. Jaehyuk debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One. On June 15, 2023, Jaehyuk was confirmed as the fourth member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.

Jaehyuk is a South Korean CEO, singer, rapper, and producer under Gallery Music. He is a member of the boy group He'rose and a former member of The LEGEND. Currently, he is part of the new group AVION. Jaehyuk has produced music for various K-Pop groups including ATBO, ICHILLIN', A.C.E, and more. He is close friends with Park Junhee of A.C.E and Ken of VIXX.

Jung Jaehyun, best known by his stage name Jaehyun, is a member of the South Korean boy group NCT. He is the lead dancer, main vocalist, and lead rapper of its sub-units NCT U and NCT 127. Born as Jung Jae Hyun on February 14th, 1997. Aside from singing and dancing, Jaehyun can also play the piano. Moreover, he used to be the DJ for the NCT Night Night radio show along with Johnny. Jaehyun, along with his fellow members Doyoung and Jungwoo, debuted in the sub-unit NCT DOJAEJUNG with their first EP, Perfume, on April 17, 2023. Jaehyun is the Main Vocalist, Lead Dancer, and Visual of the group. Jaehyun had his official solo debut on August 26, 2024, with the release of his first full-length studio album, J. Jaehyun enlisted in the South Korean military on November 4, 2024, to serve as an active-duty soldier in the Army Band. He is expected to be dicharged by May 3, 2026.

Bong Jaehyun is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his debut as a member of Golden Child in the reality series Woollim Pick in 2017. With the release of their first mini album, 'Gol-Cha!', on August 28, 2017, he made his formal group debut with "DamDaDi" serving as the lead single. The first episode of the web drama "Convenience Store Fling" featuring Jaehyun debuted on January 23, 2021, marking his acting debut. Then, on May 2, it was reported that he was in the cast of the film Urban Myths. It premiered on April 27, 2022. On April 6, 2023, the three major cast members for the upcoming drama "I Am a Gangster Who Became a High School Student" (literal title) that will premiere in 2024 have been revealed to include Jaehyun. On August 22, 2023, the casting of Jaehyun as Eunho in the drama Twinkling Watermelon was revealed. Then, on September 25, the first episode aired. On December 27, Woolim took to Weverse to announce that the exclusive contracts of Golden Child members Lee Daeyeol, Y, Bae Seungmin, Bong Jaehyun and Kim Donghyun will come to an end on December 31.
Jaehyun was a South Korean singer and a member of the boy group F.able. He sadly passed away on June 29, 2025, after battling leukemia.
Jaehyun is the drummer in N.Flying under FNC Entertainment. He also runs a YouTube channel with his fellow member Hun called "2 Idiots". Their fans are named ''Professors''.
Jaehyun is a South Korean singer under KOZ Entertainment. He made his official debut as the leader of the boy group BOYNEXTDOOR on May 30th, 2023.

Jaehyung was a vocalist and visual in the boy group A-Jax. After returning from his mandatory miltary service, he decided to terminate his contract in order to pursue a career as a solo artist and an actor.
Jaeil is a South Korean trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Lee Jae Jin is a South Korean musician, singer, and actor under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the boy band FTISLAND and its sub unit FT.Triple. He made his Japanese solo debut on October 9, 2019 with his first mini album scene.27.

Kim Jae Joong also known as Jaejoong and as J-Jun in Japan, is a South Korean Singer-songwriter, Actor, Director, and Designer under iNKODE. He is a member of the boy group JYJ, the duo JX, and a former member of TVXQ!. He made his solo debut on January 17, 2013, with the mini album I. Kim Jae Joong created his own company in May of 2023 called, iNKODE. In July of the same year, he started a weekly YouTube show called Jaefriends, where he interviews various celebrities.

Lee Jae Jun, or simply Jaejun, is a seasoned artist in the K-pop industry, bringing years of experience to his latest venture as a member of IN A MINUTE, a trio under JWIN Entertainment. Having previously been part of groups like C-CLOWN, TREI, and TAN, as well as the duo JT&MARCUS, Jaejun has showcased his versatility as a vocalist, performer, and songwriter. His participation in survival shows such as MIXNINE and Wild Idol further solidified his reputation as a dedicated and skilled artist. Now, alongside Juntae and Hyunyeop, he is set to debut with IN A MINUTE on March 15, 2025, with their first single album, UNBOXING: WHAT YOU WANTED. On November 10, 2024, Jaejun announced his departure from MLD Entertainment. Shortly after, on February 19, 2025, he signed an exclusive contract with JWIN Entertainment, joining the trio IN A MINUTE alongside Juntae and Hyunyeop. With his move to JWIN, JT&MARCUS has likely disbanded, as both Jaejun and Juntae have embarked on this new chapter.

Jaemin is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT Dream and NCT U. He made his official debut on August 24, 2016, with NCT Dream's digital single "Chewing Gum". Besides being a singer, Jaemin also engages in various entertainment activities. In 2018, he joined the cast of tvN's My English Teen 100 Hours Season 2, an educational variety show where cast members study English intensively before being sent abroad to test their real-life English skills. Moreover, Jaemin made his acting debut in JTBC's short web drama Method to Hate You, which was based on a popular webtoon of the same name.
Jeon Jaemin is a South Korean singer and idol. He is the leader and vocalist of the group KOKOON.
Hwang Jaemin is a South Korean trainee under RBW. He is the leader of the boy group NXD. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show "Fantasy Boys".

Shin Jaemin, or simply Jaemin, is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group XD (formerly XEED). Prior to debuting, Jaemin appeared on Mnet’s 2016 survival show BOYS24 where he made it to the semi-finals. He later worked as a backup dancer for different groups and idols before finally debuting in XD in 2022.
Jaeseok was a member of the group Golden Child, formerly known as the Woolim Boys. He left the group on January 6, 2018 due to health issues.

Jae Seong is a singer from South Korea signed with HF Music Company. He is a member of the boy group Classmate and was previously part of the pre-debut group i-Teen. He began his solo career with the release of his debut digital single, “Wonderful,” on April 1, 2019.
Han Jaeun is the rapper, vocalist, and maknae of the boy group "Argon" under MHS Entertainment. He used to be a member of the group INX under the stage name WIN.
Lee Jae Won is a South Korean DJ and singer. He was the youngest members of the boy groups H.O.T and jtL. He is also known by his DJ name J-WANT.
Jaewook is a South Korean former singer. He was a member of the boy group TOUCH. He was added to the group in 2011.
Jaewoong is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He was a member of the boy group TROY.

Kim Jae Yong is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actor. He used to be a member of the now-disbanded boy group Halo. In 2018, he debuted as an actor through the drama "The Miracle that We Met" and has been acting ever since. He also appeared in the drama "Love with Flaws" in 2019, and "Ghost Doctor" 2022.

Lee Jaeyoon is the lead vocalist and dancer of the boy group SF9 under FNC Entertainment. Growing up in the countryside of Busan, South Korea, Jaeyoon is known for having a Satoori accent and even having deep knowledge about plants and animals. Jaeyoon has sang OSTs such as for the drama “Girls Generation 1979” and "My Only Love Song". He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016 with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation".

Jaeyun is a Korean-New Zealander singer under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023. Prior to debut, he was best known for participating in the reality survival shows "BOYS24" and "MIXNINE."

Jagger is a Taiwanese singer and rapper under TEN Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SEVENTOEIGHT, whom he debuted with on July 28, 2025. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Im Ji-hun, better known as Jahan, is a South Korean singer under GF Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Kingdom. Within the group, he represents the Kingdom of Sun.
Jahnny shin is a part of Co-ed group Messgram

Lee JaiJin is a South Korean singer, rapper, dancer and artist, he is the main dancer of first generation idol boy group SECHSKIES under YG Entertainment. He first made his debut with SECHSKIES on May 14, 1997 with the album School Byeolgok and went on to make his solo debut on November 19, 2001 with the studio album "S.Wing". JaiJin began his mandatory military service in 2006, after releasing his final solo album "It's New". After being discharged, he had withdrawn from the entertainment industry and went to Japan to study. In 2015 and 2016, he participated in group exhibitions, "Imagination Alliance 2" and "Imagination Alliance 3", in GALERIE GAIA under his pseudonym HANZO. In 2016, JaiJin had reunited with SECHSKIES, having a reunion concert through the variety show Infinite Challenge. The group had later signed a contract with YG Entertainment to start promotions again, after their sudden disbandment in 2000. JaiJin and fellow member Kang SungHoon had also signed exclusive solo contracts with YG Entertainment.

Sim Jaeyun, known under his stage name Jake, is a South Korean-Australian singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as a member of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Jake was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked as the 3rd place by global votes and became a member of ENHYPEN. Jake made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".

Yeom Yechan, also known as Jake, is a Korean-American dancer, singer, and rapper under ChoCo Entertainment. He made his debut as a member of the co-ed group ChoCo1&2 on June 1, 2023 with the release of the album "ChoCo Takes Hollywood (MAX)". He is known for competing in the survival shows PROJECT7, where he ranked 45th, and Boys II Planet.
Simon Park (Also known as Simon Jakops) is a South Korean singer and member of boy group DMTN. He is also the CEO of XGALX, the agency behind XG.

James is a Thai-Hong Kongese singer and songwriter under BIGHIT MUSIC. He made his debut as a member of the boy group CORTIS on August 18, 2025. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A.
James is an English singer. He is the leader of the upcoming boy group dearALICE.
