maleIdols.description: James was a member of the six-member Thai boy group, "PrimeTime" which debuted on June 21, 2023 but disbanded on October 20, 2024. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League
Jang Beom-june is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and TV personality. He is best known for being the vocalist of the indie rock band "Busker Busker".

Jang Hanbyul is a South Korean/Australian singer who made his official solo debut under The Groove Entertainment on October 12, 2015 . He is the former lead vocalist of LEDApple and made his official debut with mini-album CODA in November 2011. He’s currently under BIGOCEAN ENM.
Jang Ho-Il is a part of the band and producing group 015B.
Jang Huigwang is a Vietnamese-South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Jang Hyeonseok is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Jang Hyounjoon is a South Korean singer under With US Entertainment, a subsidiary of Around US Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group The Wind on May 15, 2023.

Jang Hyunseung, formerly known by the stage name Able, is a South Korean singer currently signed to MPLIFY Records. He is best known as a former member of the boy group B2ST and the co-ed subunit Trouble Maker. Jang made his solo debut on May 8, 2015, with the extended play My. After parting ways with Cube Entertainment in 2021, he briefly promoted under Mine Field before signing with MPLIFY Records in 2025, as announced through the label’s official social media channels.
Jang Injae is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Jang Geun Suk is a South Korean actor, singer, and model under CRAFT_42. He began his career as a child model at the age of five and made his acting debut in 1997. He is best known for his leading roles in popular dramas such as You're Beautiful and Mary Stayed Out All Night, as well as for being a member of the fictional idol group A.N.JELL. He made his Korean singing debut in 2008 with the digital single “Black Engine” and his Japanese debut in 2011 with “Let Me Cry.” Jang is also active in Japan as part of the project duo Team H. Fluent in Korean, Japanese, and English, he studied abroad in New Zealand and graduated from Hanyang University’s Department of Theater and Film.
Jang Kyu Hyun is a South Korean trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is currently a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.
Jang Kyung Jun is a South Korean musician under Peponi Music. He is a member of the rock band Jannabi.
Jang Min Seo is a South Korean trainee under Woollim Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet" but dropped out shortly before the show aired.
Jang Seok Hyun is a South Korean singer and actor, best known as the rapper of the co-ed group S#arp (1998–2002).
Jang Tae Yoon is a South Korean trainee under iNKODE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Jang Won is a South Korean trainee under KPLUS. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Jang Woohyuk, also known as his DJ name XXXV is a South Korean rapper, singer, choreographer, and DJ under WH Creative. He is best known for being a member of the boy group H.O.T.. Following their disbandment in May 2001, he, along with former members Tony An and Lee Jae Won, formed the group jtL. Following jtL's disbandment in 2003, he debuted as a solo artist on September 12, 2005, with the album No More Drama.

Jang Yeojun is a South Korean singer under UNCORE and member of the project boy group CLOSE YOUR EYES. He made his official debut on April 2, 2025, with the group's mini album "Eternalt". prior to debuting, he participated in several survival shows, including Wild Idol (2021), where he was eliminated in episode 3, and Boys Planet (2023), where he ranked 62nd and was eliminated in episode 5 while under Jellyfish Entertainment. In 2024, he joined JTBC's PROJECT7, successfully finishing in 6th place and debuting as a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.
Jang Yong Hoon is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He is best known for participating on the survival show Debut's Plan, where he ranked second, earning his place in IDID.

Jang Yousung is a South Korean singer, model, and actor under Peak Factory. He debuted as a member of the boy group RION FIVE, under Narda Entertainment, on March 25, 2014, with the digital single "Rion Five", and was active with the group until its disbandment in late 2021. He also took part in the agency's project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018. Jang Yousung was also a member of A.CONIC Entertainment's boy group WOW, with whom he debuted on March 8, 2021, with the single "Miss U".

Bang Jang Hyeon, better known by his stage name Janghyeon, is a South Korean singer. He serves as the rapper and vocalist of the Kpop boy group withus, under withHC. He was the first member to be revealed on October 26, 2020.
Kim Jang Hyun is a South Korean musician and producer. He is best known as the only male member of the vocal group Sunny Hill. He left the group in 2014 to become a full-time producer.

Park Jang Hyun is a South Korean singer under RBW and n.CH Entertainment. He is a former member of the male vocal group VROMANCE and a member of the project boy group KKD. He is also known for being a former Kookmin Singer finalist and a Superstar K3 contestant.
Lee Jangjun is a South Koran rapper and singer under Woolim Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group Golden Child on August 28, 2017.
Jaon is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which operates under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 27, 2025.
Jason is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed group Space A.

Jay, formerly known as Jinhwan, is a singer, lyricist, composer, and musical actor under 143 Entertainment. He is best known for being the leader, main vocalist and lead dancer of the boy group iKON. He joined YG Entertainment in 2011 and later participated in the survival show "W.I.N: Who is Next" where he was a member of the Team B. In 2014, he was confirmed as a member of iKON. He then participated as one of three leaders on the survival show "Mix&Match" where he helped choose the rest iKON's members. He debuted as a member of iKON on September 15, 2015, and as a solo artist with the LP "BLUE MOON" in 2023.

Jay is a Korean/American singer and actor under Rainmaker Company. He debuted as the Main Vocalist of rock group TRAXX under SM Entertainment with the stage name "Typhoon Jay". He debuted as an actor in February 2009 in the MBC drama "Romance Zero". He left SM Entertainment in 2019 after his contract expired.
Jay is the maknae of the upcoming boy group "DIOS".

Park Jongseong, known under his stage name Jay, is a South Korean-American singer-songwriter, rapper, dancer, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as a member of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Jay was introduced as a contestant in the CJ E&M and BIGHIT MUSIC's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked as the 2nd place by global votes and became a member of ENHYPEN. Jay made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".
Jay is the maknae of the group J2KC. He was previously in the group Blast as Haejeong.

Jay is a South Korean singer New Ways Company. He is the leader of the upcoming boy group ASC2NT, and a former member of the boy groups XING and DGNA, as well as its sub-unit Popsicle. He made his acting debut beginning in 2009 with a supporting role in the movie Short! Short! Short!. He received his first main role in 2011 with the movie Themselves and also starred in the movie Confession as a supporting role in 2014.

Jay B (born Im Jae Bum) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actor. He debuted in 2012 as part of the duo JJ Project alongside Jinyoung under JYP Entertainment. In 2014, he became the leader of the seven-member boy group GOT7, later forming the sub-unit Jus2 with Yugyeom in 2019 and releasing the EP "Focus." Following GOT7’s departure from JYP Entertainment in 2021, JAY B signed with H1GHR Music and made his solo debut. He left the label in July 2022 and later joined CDNZA Records, before parting ways in April 2023. Despite his solo pursuits, he remains the leader of GOT7 and oversees the group’s legal and official matters.

Jay Chang is an American singer and lyricist currently signed under FM Entertainment. Known for his versatility and engaging stage presence, he has made a mark in the K-pop industry as a member of the boy group ONE PACT and the project group B.D.U. Additionally, he is a pre-debut member of M.O.N.T Arena. Jay gained widespread recognition through his participation in several reality survival shows, including Under Nineteen, Boys Planet, and Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor. He made his official solo debut on October 17, 2023, with his mini album Late Night, showcasing his vocal and lyrical talents. Jay’s journey began in 2018 when he appeared on Under Nineteen as part of the vocal team. Although he was eliminated in the early rounds, this experience paved the way for his future in the industry. In 2022, he was introduced as a pre-debut member of M.O.N.T Arena, demonstrating his potential as a rising star. In 2023, Jay competed on Boys Planet, where he ranked 10th overall, narrowly missing a spot in ZEROBASEONE. Later that year, he officially debuted as a solo artist with Late Night and joined ONE PACT, debuting with the group’s mini album Moment on November 30. In 2024, Jay participated in Mnet’s Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor and secured his debut in the project group B.D.U, releasing their mini album Wishpool on June 26. His musical journey continued with the release of his second solo mini album, Neighborhood, on November 22. With a career marked by persistence and diverse talents, Jay Chang continues to captivate audiences worldwide.

Jay Park is a Korean-American singer, rapper, and actor under AOMG, MORE VISION, and Roc Nation. He is a former member of the boy group 2PM. In 2010, he left JYP Entertainment after controversial comments about life in South Korea surfaced online. He later re-debuted as a solo artist under SidusHQ. In September 2013, he became the founder and CEO of AOMG, a Korean independent record label specializing in hip-hop. In May 2017, he announced the co-creation with producer Cha Cha Malone of a new global hip-hop label, H1GHR Music. On December 31, 2021, he stepped down as the CEO of AOMG and H1GHR Music. On March 3, 2022, he established a new label, MORE VISION.
Jayci Yucca is a South Korean rapper signed with Pyrat and Wayside Town. He made his debut in 2019 under WYSD Neokidz.

Jayden is a South Korean singer and composer. He is a former member of Universe (now known as UNVS) and is currently a member of AVION. Jayden has composed and worked for several artists, most notably A.C.E. He officially debuted as a soloist on September 7, 2024. When promoting with the group, he goes by Jayden, but when promoting as a soloist, he uses his real name, Sihoon. He previously worked under the labels Media Asia Music and UNI Entertainment.
Kim Junmin is a South Korean idol under C-JeS Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WHIB. In 2025, he was revealed as a contest on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Jayn Lee, also known as Jaeyun, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under HYPEER Records and was the leader of the boy group TO1. After participating in the 2019 survival show World Klass, he debuted with TO1 in April 2020. Following TO1's disbandment in December 2023, Jaeyun signed with HYPEER Records in June 2024 and announced the he would make his solo debut, under the stage name Jayn Lee, with the EP "zzZ", releasing on July 4, 2024, with the pre-release of the single "Say Yes" on June 21.

JD1 is a South Korean singer signed under ShowPLAY Entertainment. He made his solo debut with the digital single “Who Am I” released on January 11, 2024. Notably, JD1 is the idol clone character of Jeong Dong Won.
JDV is a South Korean singer under Deep Studio Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group SUPERKIND.
Je1 is a South Korean singer who made her official debut on June 13, 2017 as a member of the boy group Vermuda.
Jean Paul is a South Korean singer under Jackpot Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group FREE PASS and is a former member of BLANC7 and BTL.
Jee Seokjin is a South Korean comedian, singer, television presenter, actor, and broadcaster. He debut in 1992 with the album "I Know". He is also a member of MSG Wannabe.
Jeff is a South Korean rapper under C9 Entertainment. He made his official debut as the main rapper and maknae of the boy group EPEX in 2021.
Jehyun is a singer and lyricist of the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly part of the boy group 1TEAM.
Jeil is a South Korean singer. He is the main vocalist of Xst and a former member of the group Herycle.
Jeki is a rapper of the boy group VX.
Jen, formerly Yehyeon is a former member of the group UNVS. He was the last member to be revealed on September 5, 2019.
Jenissi is a former member of Topp Dogg and unit Lion Kingdom. His stage name is an abbreviation of the biblical name Jehovah Nissi. He left the group on November 1, 2016.

Jeno is a South Korean singer and rapper under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT Dream and NCT U. He made his official debuted in NCT Dream on August 24, 2016.
Jeon Ho Young is a South Korean trainee under OUI Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."
Jeon Hyun-jae is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Imagination World League in 2019. He was a contestant on Show Me The Money 9.
Jeon Jun Seo is a South Korean trainee under ABM Company. He was contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.
Jeon Jungin is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.
Jeon Min Gyu is a South Korean trainee. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.

Jeon Minwook, also known as J-Min, is a South Korean rapper under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy group BAE173 and the co-ed group A-SIX. On September 26, 2024, he was announced as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which began airing in October 2024. He successfully secured a spot in the final lineup, placing 3rd, and became a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.
Jeon Se Jin is a South Korean rapper and singer. He is the leader of the pre-debut band A:FACT.
Jeon Seongbae is a South Korean drummer. He was a member of the co-ed rock band KARDI.
Jeon Woo Sung is a South Korean singer and songwriter. He is best known for being a member of the band "Noel".
Jeongw is a South Korean singer under Startree Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group ENPHAZE and a former member of F.able.

Jeong Deunhaesol is a South Korean trainee. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group ALLART BOYZ under ALLART Entertainment, which he is believed to have left in October 2023. On February 20, 2023, he was announced as a contestant on MBC's survival show Fantasy Boys. He was eliminated in episode 7 after ranking 33rd place. He was revealed as a member of NineTwo Entertainment's upcoming boy group 3WAY on December 3, 2023. The agency announced his departure on March 4, 2024. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 68th place.
Jeong Dong Hwan is a South Korean musician and singer under ABYSS Entertainment. He is best known for being the pianist and vocalist of the duo Melomance.

Jeong Haeil is a South Korean singer-songwriter under INHEART MUSIC who debuted in 2015 with the single album "You and I, Back When We Were in Love". On the 21st of September he was revealed to be under INHEART MUSIC on their official Instagram.
Jeong Hyeon Uk is a South Korean trainee and contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1.
Jeong Hyeon Woo is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Wild Idol. He was elimininated in Ep. 3.
Jeong Hyunwoo is a South Korean singer model under YG KPLUS. He is a contesant on Wild Idol.
Jeong Ji Won is the guitarist of bands Tequila Old Fashioned and FIRR. He is also a former member of the band Batu.
Jeong Min Seong is a South Korean singer under Studio JAMM. He is a member of the boy group LA POEM.
Jeong Minhyuk is a South Korean electric guitarist, member of the rock band poco a poco. In 2021, along with his group Lacuna, he participated in Superband 2.
Jeong Myeongseong is the Bassist of the South Korean co-ed band THETHE. He joined the group in 2017.
Jeong Se Min is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He is best known for participating on the survival show Debut's Plan, where he ranked sixth, earning his place in IDID.

Jeong Seunghoon is a South Korean singer who released the single 'Swimmer' on December 9, 2021 before officially debuting on September 1, 2023. While his birth year is unknown, he was born on March 11th.

Jeong Sewoon is a South Korean singer and songwriter under Starship Entertainment. As a trainee, he appeared and competed in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2." He made his official debut on August 31, 2017 with the mini album "Ever."
Jeonggeol is a South Korean rapper. He is a member of the boy group XST and a former member of Herycle. When the group was known as M.FECT, his stage name was Boho.
Jeonggeun is a South Korean singer under Wonijin Entertainment Corp. He is a member of the boy group HAWW.

Lee Jeong-gil is the skilled drummer of the South Korean rock band Guckkasten. Known for his precise, dynamic playing style and his ability to navigate the band’s complex and experimental sound, Jeong-gil forms the rhythmic foundation that drives Guckkasten’s powerful live performances. A founding member of the group, Lee Jeong-gil has been with Guckkasten since its formation, contributing to the band’s rise as one of Korea’s most respected rock acts. His drumming is both technically refined and emotionally responsive, often shifting effortlessly between delicate textures and thunderous intensity to match the band’s psychedelic and progressive rock influences. Although he keeps a low profile outside of performances, Lee is praised for his consistency, musical intuition, and the steady presence he brings to both the studio and stage. He is admired by fans and musicians alike for his artistry and commitment to the band’s creative vision. With years of experience and a passion for musical exploration, Lee Jeong-gil continues to be a vital force in Guckkasten’s distinct sound, helping shape their identity as one of Korea’s most innovative and visually stunning rock bands.
Jeonggyu is a South Korean singer and rapper under Forest Network. He is a former member of the boy group Seven O'clock.

Yoon Jeong Han is a South Korean Singer and dancer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist of the boy group SEVENTEEN and a member of its vocal unit. He made his official debut with SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015, with their first mini album "17 Carat." He also made his debut in the sub-unit "Jeonghan X Wonwoo" on June 17th, 2024 with their single "This Man".

Jeongkyun is a South Korean singer, producer, and the CEO of Madewell Music. He is a member of the boy group WE:A and a former member of BIGFLO and N-Train. He made his Japanese solo debut on March 16, 2016 with the mini album Jungkyun 1st Mini Unfinished. In March 2022, he was introduced as one of the five original members of the then-upcoming group WE:A when the group’s official social media accounts were launched. Beyond his Korean activities, Jeongkyun is also listed as an artist under KZ Entertainment (Japan), which manages WE:A’s overseas promotions and partnerships. He enlisted in the military on June 9, 2016, and was discharged on March 8, 2018. In May 2024, he announced his engagement via Instagram, and later that year, he married in October 2024.

Lee Jeongmin is a South Korean singer and songwriter, best known as the lead vocalist of the boy group BF, formerly known as BOYFRIEND. He made his official solo debut on July 19, 2019, with the single album Small But Certain Happiness (Nearby).
Jeongmin is a South Korean singer signed with WEUS Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WEUS and a former pre-debut member of the boy group BLITZERS.

Park Jeong Woo is a South Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2018, Park Jeong Woo participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. On January 21, 2019, he was announced as the fifth member of the boy group TREASURE. Jeongwoo debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One.

Jeongwoo is a South Korean singer under F&F Entertainment. He was a contestant in SBS' survival show Universe League, where his team, the "Team Rhythm", won the prism cup, securing him a spot as a member of the final group AHOF.
Jeongyoon is a South Korean singer. He used to be part of the boy group WEUS.
Shin Jeong You is a South Korean singer and actor under Stardium. He is a member of the boy group THE MAN BLK.

Jero is a South Korean independent singer-songwriter specializing in hip-hop and R&B. He debuted in 2010 as a member of the boy group TOUCH under the name Junyong and later joined the co-ed group Lucky J in 2014 as J-Yo, before going solo in 2016.
Jerome is a South Korean singer. He debuted as the member of the boy group J2KC.
Jeromy is a Filipino idol member of the global pop group, HORI7ON. He secured his spot in the group after ranking first in the survival show, Dream Maker.
Shim Min Gyu, known under the stage name Jerry, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He is best known for being a member of the boy group SM☆SH.
Jerry is a member of the South Korean group M.Pire.

Park Je Up, also known as Jeup and formerly as Seowool, is a South Korean singer under KH Company. He is a member of the boy group IMFACT and the duo D&J. Jeup made his solo debut on October 3, 2022, with the digital single Daystar. He is also recognized for competing on the reality survival shows The Unit, Sing Again 3, and Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor.

Woo Jewon is a South Korean singer under FirstOne Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2022 as the leader and vocalist of the boy group NINE.I. Before debuting, Jewon first appeared and competed in the hit survival program "Produce X 101" as a trainee under Around US Entertainment. He finished 54th place and continued training after the show.

Jung Jinhyeong, known better as JEY, is a Korean-Australian singer under ALFHA and a part of FA Crew. He debuted as a soloist in 2017 under S.F.R Entertainment. He was a member of ambitious ambition but left the crew. He was a former trainee of YG Entertainment & KQ Produce, best known for competing in the survival show "MIX&MATCH" that formed the group iKON.

Jhnovr is a South Korean hip-hop singer-songwriter and independent artist. He initially performed under the stage name New Day, debuting with the digital single Birthday Suit. He officially debuted as Jhnovr in 2017 under the underground label Badtrip, releasing his first mini-album Escape From The Late Night. Known for his moody, introspective sound and lyrical depth, he has remained active in the Korean underground hip-hop scene. Following his time with Badtrip, Jhnovr became affiliated with Wedaplugg Records, while continuing to operate independently. He has since released several notable works, including the EPs Mechanism and Dirty Messiah (2019), and his first full-length album A Nocturnal Visit (2020). His later projects include Human Nature (2022) and a series of digital singles such as Fxxk U, Something (2024), and Hate&Love (2025). Balancing label collaborations with independent activity, Jhnovr has built a distinct identity in Korea’s hip-hop landscape.
Jhunnit is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under IKW. He is also a member of the trio ITY Buyers and duo HASHIGEYO.

Lee Sangmin, also known as Ji Eun-ho, is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023. On January 20, 2025 Fantagio announced that members Dohyun and Eunho would be going on hiatus due to health issues while also announcing the departure of Eunseop due to health reasons.

Ji Hansol is the main dancer and sub vocalist of the boy group NewKidd underJ-Flo entertainment. Hansol was first known as SM Rookie and a participant in the survival show 'The Unit' where he ranked 6th in the final episode, earning him a spot in the temporary group UNB. Upon UNB's disbandment, Hansol debuted with the group NewKidd.

Ji Jinseok, also simply as Jinseok, is a South Korean singer under Black Y Music. He is former participant of the survival show Under Nineteen. He left the show on January 26, 2019 due to health reasons. He made his solo debut on June 3, 2019 with the single "Good Night".

Kim Jisung is a South Korean rapper and former member of the boy group TRCNG under TS Entertainment. He debuted on October 10, 2017, with the group's mini album New Generation. Before becoming an idol, Jisung was active as a child actor. On March 27, 2022, he revealed that his contract with TS Entertainment had ended on February 28, officially confirming his departure from the group.

Ji Yeon Woo is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Wild Idol. He was eliminated in Ep. 3. On January 21, 2024, he was introduced as one of 40 contestants on the survival show Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor by Mnet.
Ji Yun Seo is a South Korean trainee signed with Yue Hua. He is a member of the boy group EVNNE under Jellyfish Entertainment. The group debuted on September 19, 2023.

Jia Hao is a Chinese trainee under Chromosome Entertainment. He is a member of the project group ALPHA DRIVE ONE. He is best known for competing in the 2024 survival show Make Mate 1, where he made it to the finale, as well as the 2025 survival show Boys II Planet, where he ranked 5th.

Yu Jiahn is a South Korean singer and rapper. In 2016, he was a contestant of the survival show BOYS24. He ranked 5th place and became a member of the final group SKYE (originally called IN2IT), whom he debuted with on October 26, 2017 with the mini album "Carpe Diem". In September of 2023 he debuted in the group's first subunit CoA, alongside fellow member Yeontae, with the release of the Japanese single "A New Beginning". He also participated as a contestant on JTBC's 2024 survival show PROJECT7. However, he was eliminated in episode 11 after ranking 33rd place

Jian is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper, best known as the leader of the boy group IMFACT. On January 4, 2022, it was announced that Jian and the other members of IMFACT had parted ways with Star Empire Entertainment, marking a new chapter in their careers.
Jiang Fan is a trainee under TOP Class Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival shows Universe League, where he ranked 39th, and Boys II Planet.
Choi Jaewoo, who goes by the stage name Jiann, is the sub-vocalist of NewKidd under J-Flo Entertainment.

Jibeen is a South Korean-Brazillian rapper under MYSTIC Story. He is the maknae and main dancer of the boy group ARrC. On July 8, 2024, MYSTIC STORY introduced their first boy group, ARrC. Jibeen was unveiled as one of the seven members of this group.

Kim Jibeom is a South Korean singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group Golden Child under Woollim Entertainment, on August 28, 2017. On August 27, 2024, Woollim Entertainment announced that Kim Jibeom did not renew his contract and would be leaving the group and the agency.
He was a member of LST

Lee Jihan was a South Korean actor and idol trainee. Besides acting in dramas, he also participated in the reality survival program "Produce 101 Season 2." Lee Jihan unfortunately passed away on October 29, 2022, in the Itaewon Seoul Halloween Crowd Crush.

Jang Jiho is a South Korean singer. He debuted on March 20, 2022 as the maknae of the boy group NINE.i. Jiho was revealed to be one of the participants of the survival show "Boys Planet" on December 29, 2023. Unfortunately, he was eliminated in episode 5 after ranking 63rd place.

Choi Ji Ho is a South Korean singer under FNC Entertainment. He made his official debut on November 15, 2023 as a membef of the boy group AMPERS&ONE. Prior to debuting, he was a contestant on the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet."
Lim Soojung, also known as Jihoo, is the Main Vocalist and guitarist of the band IZ under Music K Entertainment. In 2017, Jihoo and GFriend's Yuju released a duet called "Heart Signal".

Jihoon is a South Korean singer and rapper under Pledis Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TWS and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A. Jihoon debuted with TWS on January 22, 2024, with the release of their first mini album, "Sparkling Blue."
Jihoon is a member of the South Korean boy group Fallanc.

Jihoon is a South Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2018, Jihoon participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. At first he was not selected for the main group, TREASURE, however, on January 29, 2019, YGE announced that he would form a second group from the show, called MAGNUM, and he was one of the members. The groups would promote together as TREASURE 13, and also eventually separated as two units. Unfortunately, due to scandals surrounding the agency, the debut was postponed. On January 6, YGE posted a notice on their official website stating the group's future plans. This included re-organizing as a 12-member group and the integration of the two units, TREASURE and MAGNUM, into only one group named simply as TREASURE. Jihoon debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with their first single album "THE FIRST STEP: CHAPTER ONE". On June 14, 2023, Jihoon was confirmed as the third member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.

Jihun is a South Korean singer, best known as the leader of the boy group KNK. He debuted with KNK on March 3, 2016 with the single album "Knock". As a solo artist, he goes under the name HALF. He released his first digital single, "Behind U", on August 21, 2021.

Ji Hun is a South Korean singer and actor under Wolfburn. He first debuted as an actor in 2011 through the drama Glory Jane. In 2017, he officially debuted as the lead vocalist of the boy group TRCNG, which later disbanded in 2022. On January 30, 2023, Ji Hun re-debuted as a member of the boy group BXB.
Jihwan is a South Korean singer under YT Entertainment. He debuted with the group TRY1 on October 23, 2024 with the single album RE: TRY1.
Jihyuk is a member of the South Korean boy group Supernova.

Jimin is a South Korean singer under Biscuit Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group HAWW, with whom he debuted on February 23, 2023 with the release of the mini album "How Are You". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 56th place.

Park Jimin is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, composer, and producer under Big Hit Entertainment HYBE Labels. He is best known as the lead vocalist and one of the main dancers of the worldwide sensation boy group BTS. Jimin was a top student in the modern dance department at Busan High School when one of his teachers suggested he audition for an entertainment company. Following this, Jimin tried to audition for several companies and eventually earned a spot in Big Hit Entertainment. In 2013, Jimin debuted with BTS and went on to become one of the most well-known and loved artists of his generation. In 2023, Jimin released his first solo album 'FACE' and upon the release of his title track 'Like Crazy,' he became the first Kpop Soloist to hit #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Jimin’s second solo album ”MUSE”, released in 2024 earned him his second no. 2 entry on the Billboard 200 Chart, after ”FACE” in 2023. The album’s two main tracks ”Smeraldo Garden Marching Band (feat. Loco” and ”Who” became his fifth and sixth solo entry on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart. In August, 2024 ”Who” also became the longest-running no. 1 by a K-pop soloist in Billboard Global 200 chart history.

Lim Jimin is a South Korean singer under Bluedot Entertainment. He was first known for being a former member of the trainee group PlayM BOYS. In 2019, he debuted as a soloist with the digital single "Mini." In 2021, he debuted once again, this time as the leader, lead vocalist, and center of the boy group Just B.
Jimmy Brown is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer who debuted in 2017. He currently is signed with THE VAULT.
Jin is a South Korean drummer, member of the co-ed band Red Sonnet.
Park Young Jin, also known as Jin, is a South Korean singer. He used to be a member of the boy group MVP, alongside his twin brother Been.

Kim Seokjin, known under his stage name Jin, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Big Hit Entertainment and HYBE Labels. He is best known as one of the vocalists and visuals of the worldwide sensational boy group BTS. Jin was just walking down a street when he was spotted by a casting agent and was invited to audition for Big Hit Entertainment. With a head-turner presence, sweet vocals, and acting education, Jin became a trainee alongside his fellow members. Eventually, Jin debuted with the group and went on to become one of the most famous artists of his generation. Jin’s first official single ”The Astronaut”, released in 2022 became his first solo entry on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart. It was also named one of the best songs of 2022 by Rolling Stone.

Jin, also known as Do Jin, is a Japanese singer under DNA Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SWEET:CH. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Jin is a South Korean singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group J2KC.
Matsuda Jin was born on October 30, 2002, in Okinawa, Japan. He is the sub-vocalist and youngest member of INI. Jin debuted as a member of INI on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A".
Jin Bo Min is a South Korean trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is currently a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.

Jin Hyeon Jun, also known by his stage name JINN, is a South Korean YouTuber and singer renowned for his exceptional ability to mimic over 100 different voices, including prominent artists like K.Will, Jang Beom June, Jannabi, Lee Soo Young, and Kim Jin Ho. YouTube Career: JINN has built a substantial following on YouTube, where he showcases his vocal versatility through various song covers and live performances. He engages with his audience through live broadcasts titled "Jin Hyun Jun's Daily Sseun," held every Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday from 10 PM to 12 AM KST, featuring singing sessions and interactive discussions. On March 9, 2024, JINN made his official singing debut with the single album 'Farewell Diary', marking his transition from a YouTuber to a professional singer.

Jin Myung Jae, is a South Korean singer under Eighty6 and VENUE401 Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming Japanese project boy group MY BOYZ, a former member of the pre-debut boy group THE BIGDIPPER, and a former member of the boy group Nonstop. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Jin Su is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as the leader of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023.

Jin Tae Hwa is a South Korean singer and musical actor. He first gained popularity through the show "Battle Shinhwa!" where he was chosen by Shinhwa's Minwoo to debut in the group Battle. He made his group debut in December of 2006 and later made his solo debut in October of 2009 with the song 'Fallen Angel'.
Jin Ziming is a contestant of the SBS survival show "Universe League." He is currently a trainee under TOP CLASS Entertainment.
Jin.O is a member and singer of the boy group A.Cian.
Jinbeom is a South Korean idol trainee under C-JeS Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WHIB.
Kim Jingon is a South Korean model and idol trainee under ESteem Entertainment. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Jingyu is a South Korean singer under Illusion Entertainment and OneWorld Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group AWEEK. Before this, he was a member of the group ASTIN and took part in busking activities with KingdomS.
Heo Jinho is a trainee under Astory Entertainment. He first appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Jo Jin Ho is a South Korean singer and the main vocalist of PENTAGON under Cube Entertainment. Before joining PENTAGON, he debuted in 2010 as a member of SM Entertainment’s project group SM the Ballad, where he gained recognition for his vocal ability. Jinho officially debuted with PENTAGON on October 10, 2016, with their self-titled mini-album PENTAGON. In addition to his group activities, he has been active in musical theater. On April 15, 2025. CUBE Entertainment announced that Jinho's exclusive contract with CUBE Entertainment ended and Jinho officially left the Company. On May 19, it was revealed that Jinho has signed with S27M Entertainment.

Jinhong is a former member of the Korean boy group 24K and was the former maknae of AA. He joined AA in 2013 at the age of 15 after Juwon left the group. However, in 2015, Jinhong left AA and joined 24K under Choeun Entertainment. His membership in 24K was confirmed at the end of May 2015, following a performance of "Hey You," where Jinhong and Hui disguised their identities with masks. In 2017, Jinhong and other 24K members participated in YG Entertainment's survival series MIXNINE. However, after leaving 24K in 2019, Jinhong withdrew from the entertainment industry. In 2022, he made a brief return, appearing in the music video for "Cheese Burger" by his former groupmate Kisu.

Min Jinhong is a South Korean singer, model, and actor. He debuted as a member of Apeace (known as Double B 21 at the time) in August 2010 and was a member of its sub-unit Lapis, which was later reorganized into Lapis5. During the time the group was known as Double B 21, he was part of its unit Sky. After going on an indefinite hiatus due to poor health in March 2015, he officially left the group on July 29, 2018.
Jinhoo is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He is a member of EPIC TRAVELS and a former member of the boy group UP10TION.

Jinhwa is a South Korean rapper under WUZO Entertainment. He is a leader of the boy group BLITZERS. He entered the Mnet reality survival series Produce X 101 in 2019 as a representative of his firm. After placing 74th, he was eliminated on the fifth episode. On March 17, 2020, was revealed as a member of Wuzo's new boy group, WUZOCIRCLE (now known as BLITZERS) and was reintroduced as BLITZERS' third member on February 5, 2021. On May 12, 2021, he made his group debut with their first EP 'Check-In'.
Jinhwa is the leader and a vocalist of the boy group VX.
Jinhyuk is a rapper under Cube Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024 with the single album "NOWADAYS".

Lee Jin Hyuk (formerly known as Wei) is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under TOP Media. He made his official debut in 2015 as a member of the boy group UP10TION. In 2019, Jinhyuk, along with fellow member Wooshin, participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101. He was eliminated in the finale after finishing in 12th place. Following this, TOP Media announced that both of them will be focusing on solo activities and will not be participating in group promotions indefinitely. Jinhyuk made his solo debut on November 4, 2019, with the mini album S.O.L. The next year, he made his acting debut through the drama "Find Me in Your Memory." On November 27, 2014, it was reported that he is exempt from mandatory military enlistment due to a congenital heart condition. Because of this condition, Lee Jin-hyuk is unable to fulfill his military service duties. It is reported that he continues to visit the hospital regularly to manage his health condition.
Jinhyung is a South Korean drummer, member of the co-ed rock band 5but.

Jini, formerly known as Yongjin, is a South Korean singer under Illusion Entertainment and OneWorld Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group AWEEK. Prior to this, he had appeared in the Make Your Star Audition and used to be part of the group Underdog but left the group. Yongjin also participated in the Chinese survival show “Super Idol Season 2”, but he was eliminated after the first round and in the popular South Korean survival show Produce 101 Season 2, where he ranked 56th. He also took part in the online idol search Burn Up 30.

Park Jin-woo, popularly known by his stage name JinJin, is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and actor under Fantagio Music. He is best known as the leader and main rapper of the boy group Astro. He is also part of the group's second sub-unit JinJin & Rocky. JinJin debuted as a member of ASTRO on February 23, 2016 with the album "Spring Up". JinJin debuted in the sub unit JinJin & Rocky with fellow member Rocky on January 17, 2022 with the album "Restore".

Kim Jinkwon is the Leader and Sub-Vocalist of the Boy Group NewKidd and it's sub-units ‘Lemme Spoil U’ and ‘New Kidd 02’ under J-Flo Entertainment. The announcement of the launch of a new boy group named Newkidd was made by J-FLO Entertainment on November 28, 2017. Additionally, it was revealed that Jinkwon would be part of the sub-unit that would be releasing a pre-debut single. Under the moniker Newkidd - Lemme Spoil U, they formally released their first pre-debut track, "Will You Be Ma". Jinkwon made his public debut as a member of Newkidd's second sub-unit, Newkidd02. On July 25, 2018, the pre-debut single album "Boy Boy Boy" was published. On April 18, 2019, Newkidd released news of their official debut along with individual teasers and on April 25 Jinkwon officially made his debut with the group with their single album 'NEWKIDD' He was also unveiled as the tenth competitor on the survival series Wild Idol on August 10, 2021. Sadly, he was taken out of the show in the third episode and never returned.
Park Jinkyu is the bassist of the the South Korean band ourR.
Jinon is a South Korean singer best known for being a member of boy group F.Cuz. He is one of the original members of the group and was a pre-debut member of the boy group Supernova.
Jinseo is a South Korean rapper and member of the boy group N.tic.

Jinseok is a singer under GH Entertainment. He is the maknae and lead vocalist of the boy group B.I.G and is a member of the co-ed group Triple7. He joined B.I.G in January 2019. On December 15, 2023 Jinseok took to social media to announce that he has left GH Entertainment following his contract ending. It is unclear whether or not B.I.G will continue to promote.
Jinsik is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the lead vocalist of the boy group xikers.

Jinsub is a South Korean singer and rapper. He is a former member of the boy group IN2IT, formed through the survival show BOYS24. On March 26, 2018, it was announced that Jinsub would be departing from IN2IT due to Meniere's disease

Jung Jin Sung is a South Korean singer and dancer under Play M Entertainment. He was a member of project group 1THE9, as well as a pre-debut member of the trainee group PlayM BOYS, which would debut in 2021 as JUST B. On October 25, 2018, Jung Jin Sung was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the vocal team. He finished in second place, thus becoming a member of the project group 1THE9.
Jinu is a South Korean singer under S.I.E.T.E Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming group Pattern. He is also a former member of the groups B:Skit, PUREBOY and its sub-unit PURE-L.

Kim Jin-woo, better known as Jinwoo or Jinu, is a South Korean singer and actor. He is the lead vocalist of the South Korean boy group Winner, formed in 2013 by YG Entertainment through the survival show WIN: Who Is Next. In July 2016, Jinu made his acting debut through the web drama Magic Cellphone. He made his solo debut on August 14 with single album Jinu's Heyday and lead single "Call Anytime" featuring bandmate Mino In April 2020, Jinu enlisted in the military as a public service worker; and served at the Nonsan Army Training Center. He was discharged on December 31, 2021.

Jinu is a fictional singer created for the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He is the leader, center, and main vocalist of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Jinu is voiced by Ahn Hyo Seop, the Korean-Canadian actor known for dramas such as A Business Proposal, Dr. Romantic, and the upcoming Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint. His singing voice is provided by Andrew Choi, a singer-songwriter and composer under SM Entertainment. Designed as the group's charismatic frontman, Jinu draws inspiration from visuals like Cha Eun Woo, Nam Joo Hyuk, and BTS's Jungkook. He embodies the archetype of the distant but magnetic leader, strikingly handsome, quietly intense, and difficult to read. Director Maggie Kang shared that Jinu was meant to channel the aura of actors with pristine visuals yet ambiguous allure, creating a character who feels both trustworthy and dangerous. Though Jinu speaks sparingly in the film, every word carries weight, part serenade, part warning.
Jinwan is a former member of the South Korean group LU:KUS.

Joo Jinwoo is a South Korean singer and actor under FineCut Entertainment. Following his participation in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2", Jinwoo pursued an acting career and ultimately made his debut as a singer with the digital single "EVER".
Kim Jinwoo is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group Apeace and its sub-units Apeace Lapis and later Apeace Onyx5.

Lee Jin Woo is South Korean rapper and singer under Maroo Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group GHOST9 and unit group TEEN TEEN. Jinwoo is best known for appearing on the hit survival show Produce X 101.
Jung Jinwoon is a Korean Pop singer. He is a member of the group 2AM, and of the one-time unit Dynamic BLACK.
Jinyong is a member of Biuret

Bae Jin Young, also known simply as Jinyoung, is a South Korean singer and actor under AURA Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group CIX and the project group Wanna One. He is set to make his solo debut on October 14, 2025 with the mini album Still Young. In 2017, Bae Jin Young participated in the second season of Mnet’s survival program Produce 101 as a trainee representing C9 Entertainment. He finished in 10th place and subsequently debuted as a member of Wanna One. The group officially debuted on August 7, 2017 with the mini album 1X1=1 (To Be One). Following the conclusion of their contract, Wanna One disbanded on January 27, 2019 after holding their final concert, Therefore. On April 26, 2019, Bae Jin Young released his first solo single album Hard To Say Goodbye. Later that year, he debuted as a member of CIX on July 23 with the group’s first mini album Hello Chapter 1. Hello, Stranger. Expanding into acting, it was confirmed on July 30, 2021 that he would star as the male lead in the web drama User Not Found, which premiered in November. On August 4, 2024, reports revealed that Bae Jin Young had chosen not to renew his exclusive contract with C9 Entertainment. The following day, C9 confirmed that his contract had ended on August 1 and that he would depart from both the company and CIX. On December 6, 2024, he signed an exclusive contract with AURA Entertainment. In 2025, it was first reported on August 1 that he would make his solo debut in September. On September 25, he officially announced that his first solo mini album, Still Young, would be released on October 14, marking the beginning of his solo career.

Woo Jin Young is a South Korean rapper and songwriter. He is the former maknae of the boy group D1CE. He made his solo debut on June 9, 2021 with his first mini album [3-2=A]. On February 24, 2024 he took to social media to announce that he will be enlisting on March 4, 2024.
Jinyoung is a singer, actor and well-known composer. He is also a former member of Korean boy group B1A4.

Jinyoung (born Park Jinyoung) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actor under BH Entertainment. He debuted in 2012 as part of the duo JJ Project alongside Jay B before re-debuting in January 2014 as the lead vocalist and visual of GOT7 under JYP Entertainment. Beyond music, Jinyoung has built a successful acting career. He made his acting debut in "Dream High 2" (2012) and later took supporting roles in "When a Man Falls in Love" (2013) and "Beloved Eun-dong" (2015). In 2016, he made his big-screen debut in the independent film "A Stray Goat." Following his departure from JYP Entertainment in 2021, Jinyoung signed with BH Entertainment and continued to pursue both music and acting. On May 8, 2023, he enlisted as an active-duty soldier.
Jion is a South Korean singer under Yechan Media. He is a member of the boy group N.tic and a former member of the groups NewUs and Le Quattro, the latter under the stage name RaF.

Jisan is the maknae of H.B.Y. He is also a rapper in the group. He used to be a child actor, and has even acted in a commercial with Kim Yoojung. He is really good at claw machines, and used to collect plushies from them. He has taught himself guitar, and has been playing for 5 years.

Jisang is the talented guitarist of the Korean band KAVE. Known for his exceptional skills and musicality, he plays a crucial role in shaping the band’s dynamic sound. With a passion for guitar and a keen ear for arrangements, Jisang’s contributions help create the unique vibe that defines KAVE’s music. His creative approach to both live performances and studio recordings makes him an essential part of the band’s musical identity.

Jung Ji Seob is a South Korean singer and musician under UZUROCKS Entertainment and GOGO2020. He is the guitarist and vocalist of the boy group 2Z. On November 12, 2024, GOGO20 released a statement that Jiseob had left 2Z due to health reasons.
Kim Jiseok is a South Korean singer under Parastar Entertainment. He is the main dancer and maknae of the boy group Big Ocean who debuted on April 20, 2024.

Jiseong is a South Korean rapper-songwriter and producer under DIPBLU. He is a former member of the boy group NTX and the project boy group TAN and its sub-unit Shmallow. He will make his solo debut on June 25, 2025, with the EP Noxius. On December 11, 2024, Victory Company announced that Jiseong left the group and the agency due to differences in the direction in which either party wanted to go.

Choi Jisu is a South Korean singer under WAKEONE. He first appeared in the survival program "WORLD KLASS" where he finished tenth place, allowing him to debut as the lead dancer and sub vocalist of the boy group TO1. Jisu debuted as a member of TO1 on April 1, 2020 with their first mini album Reason for Being : Benevolence.
Jisu (formerly known as Jeesu) is a South Korean singer and member of the group DMTN. He is also a soloist.

Yoon Jisung is a South Korean singer under LM Entertainment. He is best known for finishing 8th in Produce 101 Season 2 and becoming a member of Wanna One until their disbandment. In January 2019, Jisung was cast as the male lead in the musical The Days. He made his solo debut on February 20, 2019 with his first mini album Aside. Jisung enlisted for his military service as an active duty soldier on May 14, 2019. He was discharged early on November 20, 2020. On April 6, 2022 Jisung signed a contract with the company DG Entertainment after terminating his contract with LM Entertainment.

Jisung is a South Korean singer and rapper under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT Dream and NCT U. He made his official debut on August 24, 2016, with NCT Dream's digital single "Chewing Gum".

Choi Jiung, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group P1Harmony. On September 16, Jiung was revealed as the fourth member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
Jiwan is the guitarist of the South Korean band Purple Rain.

Eun Ji-won is a South Korean rapper, dancer, composer, host and leader of the first generation idol group SECHSKIES under YG Entertainment. He first made his debut with SECHSKIES on May 14, 1997 with the album School Byeolgok and went on to make his solo debut on October 27, 2000 with the self-composed mini album "G". During his solo promotions he faced heavy criticism from SECHSKIES fans, as he changed his music genre from Pop to Hip-Hop, although many argued saying SECHSKIES had many hip-hop influences in their music. In 2004, Jiwon made his acting debut, in the romance comedy film "Marrying a High-School Girl", which he had later announced that he was forced into the role by his company at the time, even noting the reason he shaved his head was to get out of the role. During his time solo, he had joined Tiger JK's crew "Movement", and had created music and performed with them for a few years. Jiwon is also considered an entertainment icon, appearing on many variety shows and earning himself the nickname "Eun Choding" (Elementary-kid Eun) for his childish personality on television. In February of 2010, Jiwon announced his marriage with Lee Sooyeon, yet three years later it was announced that they had gotten a divorce in the August of 2012. In 2011, Jiwon had formed and led a new group, Clover, with members Glime and Mr. Typhoon, which was met with outstanding positivity despite being a hip-hop group. After a few years of promotion with Clover and focusing on television promotions, Jiwon had reunited with SECHSKIES, having a reunion concert through the variety show Infinite Challenge. The group had later signed a contract with YG Entertainment to start promotions again, after their sudden disbandment in 2000. In March of 2018, Eun Jiwon had announced the re-openening his fanclub 1kyne (1 of a kind), and in August of the same year had signed an individual contract with YG Entertainment. On June 6, 2019, it was revealed that Eun Jiwon was to make his solo comeback with his 6th studio album "G1" on June 27, he went on to hold solo concerts of the same name.
Park Ji Won, or simply Jiwon, is a South Korean musician formerly under Favor Entertainment. He was the bassist of the boy band W24. He left the band in 2020 due to personal reasons.
Jiwoo is a South Korean keyboardist, member of the co-ed group THE HRTZ. He is one of the original members of the group.

Jeon Ji-woo, popularly known as Jiwoo, is a South Korean-Canadian soloist, singer, rapper and producer singed with WAVY. He made his official debut with the name Jiwoo on July 6, 2019 with his digital EP "Maison". Previously he had debuted with the name "HAYAKE " on the 24th of July, 2015 with the track ‘ONLY‘ on soundcloud.
Ko Ji Yong is a South Korean singer and former member of the boy group SechsKies under YG Entertainment.

JJ is a South Korean rapper and singer. He was a member of the boy group DUSTIN and its sub-unit DUSTIN-ON under Na Entertainment but left the group on May 24, 2021. He made his solo debut on September 7, 2025 with the digital single "GWANG-GI (Madness)". JJ is a rapper under S.I.E.T.E Entertainment. He is a member of the group Pattern. He is also a former member of the groups B:Skit, PUREBOY and its sub-unit PURE-L.
JK was a member and the guitarist of Five Run Strike.

JL is a Filipino singer under ShowBT Entertainment, a Filipino-based company. He first debuted in the Filipino boy group PLUUS on February 8, 2023, with the release of their first mini-album "+.Y.M." (also known as "PLUUS +.Y.M.", read as Time). He was a contestant on SBS' survival show Universe League, where he ranked 1st overall, securing his spot as a member of the final group AHOF. JMIN, born Jonathan Min, is a Korean-American rapper who debuted independently in 2018. He joined Jay Park & Cha Cha Malone's H1GHR MUSIC in 2021. He made his official debut under H1GHR Music with his first ep “HOMECOMING” which dropped on August 13, 2021.
He was a member under LST
JNXSK, also known as Junseok, is a South Korean singer under Spheres Entertainment. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group HALF&HALF and of the boy group 24K.

Jo is a Japanese singer and dancer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as the lead vocalist, visual and center of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. In 2022, Jo participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to become a member of the Japanese boy group &TEAM.

Jo Ihan was the leader of D1CE, pronounced as D-Once, under HF Music Company. He was first known for appearing on survival shows, Produce 101 and MIXNINE. He changed his stage name from Yonggeun to Jo Ihan following the group's disbandment.
Jo Jae Hyeon is a South Korean trainee. He is a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1.
Jo Kihun is a South Korean musician. He is the drummer of the rock band The Whales. He was also a contestant on JTBC's SuperBand 2.

Jo Kwon is a South Korean singer, actor, TV host, and musical actor under Archive Achim. He is best known as the leader of the group 2AM, as well as a member of the project groups Dramatic BLUE and Triple T. He made his official group debut on July 11, 2008 with 2AM's single "This Song". Jo Min Jae is a South Korean trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is currently a participant in the survival show Debut's Plan, He was also a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1, where he made it to the finale,
Jo Minhyuk is a former member of the co-ed band THETHE. He joined the group in 2006 as a Drummer but left in 2008.
Jo Seung Hyeon is a South Korean trainee. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 6.
Jo Youngbae is a South Korean singer-songwriter, vocal coach and producer under JUNITY Entertainment. He is a member of the co-ed rotational project group PTMRS.

Jo Jinhyung, also known as Joel, is a South Korean singer under FN Entertainment. He participated in the survival show "MIXNINE" and "Produce 101 Season 2". He made his official debut with the digital single "She's Gone".
Joha is a South Korean rapper under Top Cloud Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group Like A Movie
John B. Kim is a South Korean songwriter, and bass guitarist of the rock band, Touched.

John Cha, also known as Potatoi, is a South Korean singer and musician under Wavy Seoul. He is the Bass of the boy band wave to earth. On November 25, 2023, he made his debut as a solo artist under the name Potatoi. The name came from his nickname 'Potato Boy' because he really likes potatoes.
John Kim was a former member of the co-ed group Sharp. He left shortly after their debut.

John Park is a Korean-American singer, composer, and songwriter under Music Farm. He debuted on December 17, 2010 with the release of his first single titled "I'm Your Man". Prior to his solo career, John Park was known for competing in American Idol ninth season and MNET's Superstar K2.

Johnny is the lead dancer, sub rapper, and sub vocalist of the group NCT and its sub-units NCT 127 and NCT U. Johnny was born in Chicago, Illinois, USA. Jom is a Filipino idol under MLD Entertainment. He's known for participating in Dream Maker, but was eliminated. He and 4 other contestents who were eliminated in the finale signed with MLD Entertainment and formed New:ID.
Kim Jong Wan is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and TV personality. He is best known as the vocalist and guitarist of the band "Nell".
Kim Jong Gil, or simply Jonggil, is a South Korean musician and singer-songwriter under Favor Entertainment. He is the drummer of the boy band W24. He is also a member of the CCM band AGAPAO Worship.
Jonghan is a South Korean singer under KONSORTIUM. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening. He debuted as a soloist on September 16, 2021, with the single “Sandbag”.

Jongho is a South Korean singer, dancer, songwriter, and actor under KQ Entertainment. Jo Jong-hwan is a South Korean singer. He is a member the boy group FAVE1 and originally a member of disbanded boy group 100%.

Jong Hyeong is a South Korean singer under Dongyo Entertainment. He's a member of boy group DKZ. Jonghyeong debuted as a member of DONGKIZ on April 24, 2019 with their first single album "DONGKIZ On The Block."

Jonghyo originally debuted as “J-Hyo” with the boy group LC9. The group disbanded in 2015 following the expiration of the members' contracts. On June 6, 2020, Jonghyo became an official member of the boy group LU:KUS (also known as LU4US and formerly L.A.U), this time promoting under his real name. In 2016 he redebuted in the group "Circus Crazy" with the stage name "Kizo". The group disbanded in 2017.

Jonghyun was a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under SM Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group SHINee and the project ballad group S.M. THE BALLAD. In 2005, Jonghyun was scouted by SM Entertainment after he performed in a song festival with his high school band, called ZION. He later dropped out of high school in the tenth grade, transferring to Seoul Music Institute. Jonghyun debuted as part of the five-member boy group SHINee on May 25, 2008, on SBS' Inkigayo. In November 2010, Jonghyun, along with TRAXX's Jay, Super Junior's Kyuhyun, and Jino (now a member of Pentagon and goes by the name Jinho) participated in SM the Ballad, a project group formed by SM Entertainment with a focus on ballads and R&B. The group released their debut EP album, Miss You, on November 29, 2010. He made his solo debut on January 12, 2015 with his first mini-album Base. On December 18, 2017, Jonghyun passed away due to suicide. His final album, Poet | Artist, was released posthumously on January 23, 2018.

Lee Jonghyun is a South Korean musician, singer-songwriter and sctor. He is the former lead guitarist and vocalist of CNBLUE. In 2019, it was revealed that Jonghyun took part in the infamous group chat of Jung Joon-young where they shared illegally filmed videos. Due to this, he officially left the band.
Jongkook was a member of Kpop Boy Group SPEED under MBK Entertainment.

Kim Jongkook is a South Korean singer, entertainer, and actor under Turbo JK Company. He debuted as a member of the duo Turbo in 1995. The duo was considered to be one of the most popular idols in that time and sold out millions of albums in South Korea and Asia. Following the duo's disbandment in 2000, Jongkook released his debut solo album in 2001 called "Renaissance". Besides being a singer, Jongkook is popularly known worldwide as a fixed-cast member of the iconic variety show "Running Man".

Kim Jongseob, is a South Korean rapper, dancer, songwriter, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as the maknae of the boy group P1Harmony. From December 2016 to April 2017, Jongseob participated in the competition show K-pop Star 6 and won as part of the duo, Boyfriend, with Park Hyun Jin. Following the show's conclusion, the duo signed a trainee contract with YG Entertainment. The following year, he join YG Treasure Box in Group C. However, he was eliminated in Episode 9. On September 16, 2020, Jongseob was revealed as the first member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".

Moon Jongup, also known simply as Jong Up, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under MA Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group B.A.P. He made his solo debut on May 7, 2020, with the single album "Headache". 2012–2019: B.A.P He made his debut as a member of B.A.P on January 26, 2012, with the single album "Warrior". On February 17, 2019, TS Entertainment stated that the four remaining members of B.A.P, after the departure of Bang Yong Guk in August 2018, and Zelo in December 2018, have all elected to not renew their contracts with the agency. 2019–2020: New agency, and solo debut On November 21, 2019, it was announced that he had recently signed an exclusive contract with The Groove Company as a soloist. On April 21, 2020, a teaser image was released revealing his first release under his new company. The single album, "Headache", was released on May 7. 2021: "Find", Us On June 24, 2021, Big Ocean ENM dropped a teaser image for Jongup's first mini album, Us, set to release on July 8. "Find" was pre-released on July 1. 2023: Peak Time, new agency, Some On February 15, 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's Peak Time and took part in TEAM 24:00. The group won third place. On May 22, it was revealed that he had signed an exclusive contract with MA Entertainment. On October 5, a teaser was dropped for Jongup's second mini album, Some. The next day, M.A Entertainment revealed that the album will be released on October 30.

Yoon Jongwoo is a South Korean Rapper under ARMADA Ent. He is the Leader of the boy group ONE PACT and a former member of Black Level. He used to be a member of the boy group 'Black Level' under the stage name Ze:U. In December 2022, he participated in the popular Mnet survival show "Boys Planet," where he finished in 18th place. Despite not making it to the debut lineup of the 9-member boy group, Jongwoo's talent won the hearts of fans worldwide. He was determined to debut in a boy group and worked hard towards his dream. On September 27, 2023, Armada Entertainment announced Jongwoo as the First Member and Leader of their upcoming boy group ONE PACT.
Lee Jong-woon is a South Korean singer and member of the now-disbanded boy group BLACK6IX.

Jonny is a South Korean guitarist under Blue Vinyl. He is a member of the rock bands Bye Bye Badman and The Volunteers. In April 2024, the members of "The Volunteers" left their previous label BLUEVINYL, and they founded their own independent label, peoplelikepeople.
Joo Sangwook is a South Korean musician. He is the drummer of the rock band Redoor.
Joo Wondae is a South Korean singer and musician under A.CONIC and Stallion Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WOW and a former member of the pre-debut project band A.FACT.

Joo Woo-Jae is a South Korean model, actor, and comedian. He began his career as a model in 2013 and has since expanded into acting and variety shows. In 2023, he joined the cast of the variety show "Hangout with Yoo" and became a member of the project group "One Top," formed during the "JS Entertainment" segment of the show. His participation in "One Top" contributed to the group winning the Popularity Award at the 2023 MBC Entertainment Awards.
Im Ji-Myoung also known as Jooan is the main dancer and lead vocalist of "We in the Zone", also known as WITZ, under Choon Entertainment.

Hong Joochan is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He debuted as a member of Golden Child on August 28, 2017. In February 2019, Hong Joochan debuted as a solo artist with the digital single "A song for me".
Jooen is a South Korean singer and former member of groups IN4MAL and AFOS. In 2017, he participated in the second season of Produce 101.

Joohoney is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter and producer Starship Entertainment. He is the main rapper of the boy group MONSTA X and a member of the project group Y TEEN, and a pre-debut member of NUBOYZ. He made his solo debut with the mini album Lights on May 22, 2023
Kim Joohyoung is a South Korean singer under FirstOne Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NINE.i. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Joon Park is a Korean-American singer, rapper, dancer, and actor, best known as the leader and main rapper of the boy group g.o.d. He debuted in 1999 with the group but they faced a near-disbandment in 2001 after his relationship was revealed. The company removed him from the group without the knowledge of the members, but with strong fan support, as well as support from his members, the company backed down and kept him in the group. They went on hiatus in 2006. During g.o.d's hiatus, he pursued acting in the U.S., appearing in Speed Racer and Dragonball Evolution. g.o.d made a successful comeback in 2014 for their 15th anniversary, releasing Chapter 8. In 2018, he launched a popular YouTube channel, Wassup Man, which was adapted into a Netflix series in 2020.
Joonghee is a member of Korean Boygroup A-JAX (에이젝스). He was added in 2016 after members Jaehyung, Sungmin and Jihu left the group.
Joonghyun is a South Korean guitarist. He was a member of the co-ed indie rock band Beautiful Days.
JoonHyuk is a South Korean singer, songwriter and actor under A2Z Entertainment. He is a member of the co-ed group SWAY.

Hwang Joowon is a model and former idol who debuted in the now disbanded boy group AA. He was the vocalist, rapper, visual, and the face of the group. He left this group in June of 2013 to pursue acting. He now works as a model.
Lee Jooyeon is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2021 as the maknae, bassist, main vocalist, and rapper of the band Xdinary Heroes.
Jooyoung is a South Korean singer and songwriter under Starship Entertainment. He is best known for his hit collaborations with Hyolyn and Heize.

Jooyoung is a South Korean singer under Mainbase Entertainment. He is the youngest member of the boy group D-ONE and a former member of the pre-debut boy group IB147.
