Kim Bok Eun is the rapper of the boy group Signal under J Star Entertainment. He first debuted in the boy group E7 on 2012.

Hong Jisoo, also known for his stage name Joshua, is a South Korean-American singer, dancer, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He is best known for being the lead vocalist and visual of the boy group SEVENTEEN. He is part of the group's vocal unit SVT VOCAL Team. Joshua was born and raised in Los Angeles, California. He frequented Koreatown where he was scouted by an agent from Pledis Entertainment. After passing an audtion, Joshua moved back to South Korea and became an official trainee, until he eventually made his official debut on May 26, 2015 as a member of SEVENTEEN.

Joss Cheng is a Chinese actor and singer. He was a member of the project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018, with the single "Haeyo Haeyo". He first started as an actor in 2022, playing a suppprting role in the drama "Just Fiancée". He now works mainly as an actor, earning his first main role in the 2023 drama "Disappearing Mom".

Lee Jong Hwa, also known as Jota, is a South Korean rapper and actor under King Kong by Starship. He debuted as a member of the boy group MADTOWN on October 6, 2014. A few years later he made his acting debut in 2016. On October 9, 2018, it was announced that he signed with King Kong by Starship as an actor under his full name.
Jowonu, born Jo Won-woo is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Hi-Lite Records in 2018.

Ju Hak-Nyeon is a South Korean singer, actor, and former member of THE BOYZ. He participated in the survival show Produce 101 season 2, where he finished 19th place. Haknyeon made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the vocalist, rapper, and lead dancer of the boy group The Boyz. He made his acting debut in 2022 through the horror anthology film "Seoul Goedam." One Hundred Label announced that Ju Haknyeon had officially withdrawn from THE BOYZ and terminated his exclusive contract with the company on June 18, 2025. The decision came after reports surfaced linking Haknyeon to a former JAV actress turned influencer, along with media accusations of prostitution. These allegations led to the immediate suspension of his activities. Both Haknyeon and the influencer denied the prostitution claims, and the police later cleared Haknyeon after an anonymous individual filed a complaint based solely on articles they had read online. On June 20, Haknyeon took to social media to announce that he would be taking legal action against malicious articles as well as his company and clarified that he had neither withdrawn from the group, nor agreed to terminate his exclusive contract with One Hundred. He also stated that the company had not only ignored the proper procedures outlined in his contract, but had also demanded over 2 billion won (approximately 1.46 million USD) and lied to the public about his contract being finalized.

Ju-ne, formerly known as Junhoe, is the main vocalist from the boy group iKON, he is also an actor and composer. Before debuting, he appeared in the first season of "Kpop Star" and was a member of Team B in the survival show "W.I.N", later he also participated in "Mix & Match" and became the 4th confirmed member of iKON. He is a big fan of poems and wishes to release a book one day. In 2020 he released through youtube a collaboration with Bobby "Deep Night" in the rock genre. He has been a fan of Michael Jackson since he was a child and has a large collection of the artist. He can play the guitar. In 2023 he made his debut as an actor through the drama "Bora Deborah" receiving praise from the public for his skills, he also sang his first ost for the same drama. That same year he made his first English release through a collaboration with Soulbysel, with which he released his first song completely in English "Night Flight", he also got his first official solo song "Want you back" in iKON's 3rd full album.
Juchan is a South Korean singer under Nature Space. He is a member of the boy group XONIK.He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows Dancing High and Project 7.

Jude, later known as Jvde, is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He made his official debut in 2012 as the maknae of the boy group Bigstar. Following the group's disbandment, he made his solo debut with the digital single "Time" in 2020.
Juhan is a singer under Wuzo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BLITZERS. He debuted as a member of BLITZERS on May 12, 2021, with their debut EP Check-In.

Juho is a South Korean singer under Biscuit Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group HAWW, with whom he debuted on February 23, 2023 with the release of the mini album "How Are You". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 5 after ranking 73rd place.
Juho is a former-member of 5TION
Juhoon is a South Korean singer and songwriter under BIGHIT MUSIC. He made his debut as a member of the boy group CORTIS on August 18, 2025.
Juhwan is a South Korean trainee and actor under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy band AxMxP.

Jukjae is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and producer known for his smooth and melodic style, mainly in the R&B and pop genres. He has gained popularity for his emotional ballads and collaborations with various K-pop artists. Besides his solo work, he is recognized for his skill in producing and writing songs.

Jumin is a South Korean rapper, singer, and composer under ON1 Entertainment. He is a member of the co-ed group Bijou and a former member of The Feel. Jumin started his career under his real name Park Jun-gyu, releasing the studio album "Funknova" in 1995. In 1997, he debuted in the co-ed group The Feel with fellow future Bijou member Dabi. Bijou was formed in 1998, where Jumin took charge of the rap and composed with Dabi.
Jun was a member of now disbanded group boy group LC9.

Jun is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group VERMUDA under Triple J (JJJ) Entertainment. He debuted with the group along with other members on June 13, 2017 with the song "Dream Girl".

Wen Junhui , also known by his stage name Jun, is a Chinese singer, dancer, actor, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He the main dancer and sub vocalist of the South Korean boy group SEVENTEEN and its sub-unit SVT PERFORMANCE Team. He is also best known for starring in the 2023 Chinese drama "Exclusive Fairy Tale". Before joining SEVENTEEN, he was a child actor who starred in multiple films including The Pye Dog (2006), for which he won the Hong Kong Film Directors' Guild's Best New Actor Silver Award. In 2010, he played the young Ip Man in The Legend Is Born: Ip Man. Eventually, Jun debuted as a member of SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015, with the EP 17 Carat. On August 12, 2024, it was announced Jun would be going on hiatus to focus on his acting career in China. He will not be active in SEVENTEEN's world tour or promotions for the rest of 2024 due to this.

Jun Han is a South Korean singer and musician under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut as the electric guitarist of the band Xdinary Heroes on December 6, 2021 On April 25, 2023, JYP Entertainment announced that Jun Han will be going on hiatus due to enteritis. He has since returned to activities.
Jun Woo is a South Korean singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023.

Jun Young is a Korean pop singer. He is a former-member of 5TION under IV Entertainment and Shine E&M. He was former member of JJCC and J.Rich He debuted as Solo on November 24, 2011 with his song 'Let's Stop'.

Lee Jun Young, also known mononymously as Jun, is a South Korean singer, rapper, dancer, and actor under BILLIONS and Jflex, the latter being a company he co-founded. He first rose to fame as a member of the boy group U-KISS and later gained recognition as part of the project group UNB, which was formed through the survival show The Unit. Beyond his idol activities, he has also taken on acting roles, portraying Kwon Ryuk in the fictional idol group SHAX and Taein in the project group LUNA. Jun launched his solo career on December 5, 2019 with the single album Gallery. His participation in The Unit in 2017 brought him wide attention, as he emerged as the top-ranked male contestant and went on to debut in UNB. The group was active until its disbandment in 2019. After several years focused on acting and other projects, Jun prepared for his musical return in 2025. On July 21, reports surfaced that he would be releasing a new solo album in September, marking his first comeback in nearly five years. The news was quickly confirmed by his agency, and on September 4, a promotion schedule was released for his first mini album, Last Dance, which is set to be unveiled on September 22. In his personal life, Jun experienced the loss of his paternal grandmother on January 25, 2023. His company, Jflex, announced the news and confirmed that he would be canceling all scheduled activities to mourn with his family.

Jun. K is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper and actor under JYP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 2PM. They made their formal debut with the single album "Hottest Time of the Day" on September 4, 2008, after initially consisting of seven members. He made his solo debut on October 7, 2011 with the single 'Alive' and in Japan in 2014 with the mini-album 'LOVE & HATE'. On May 7, 2018, Jun.K joined the military as an active duty soldier. On January 2, 2020, he was formally released. He had his first solo international concert on the year 2017 which was named "Mr. NO♡".
Jun H. (born Im Joon Hyeon), formerly known as Junhyeon, is a South Korean rapper and singer under CHITWN Music. He is a fomer member of the boy groups UNVS, B.O.i and ALL-STAR.

JUN0 is a South Korean solo artist. He officially debuted on April 5, 2023, with the single "Honestly, I Don’t Need Love Anymore" under the label DIPBLU. His music blends elements of R&B, soul, and indie, featuring a light vocal tone and memorable, catchy lyrics.
Jang Ju Na is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Wild Idol. He is a former a JYP trainee.

Lee Jun-sang, popularly known as June, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and producer under Planetarium Records. Besides being a soloist, he is also a member of the project boy group PLT. June is a South Korean singer under Wolfburn. He made his official debut on January 30, 2023, as a member of the boy group BXB.
June is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the boy group SM☆SH He was added to the group on July 18, 2014 alongside member Baram.

June is a Japanese singer who is best known for being a former member of the Japanese-Korean boy group "ORBIT" under Dream Passport Entertainment. Jung Bo Moon is a South Korean trainee. He is one of the participants in the 2023 survival show "Fantasy Boys."
Jung Hae Sung is a South Korean trainee. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Jung Hoe Min is a South Korean musician under P&B Entertainment. He is the bassist for the boy band South Club.
Lee Jung Hoon is a South Korean musician under Space Bohemian Entertainment. He is best known as the bassist and keyboardist of the band "Nell".
Jung Hyun Jun is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for competing in the 2024 survival show Make Mate 1, where he made it to the finale, as well as the 2025 survival show Boys II Planet.
Jung Jae Young is a South Korean trainee. He was a participant in the reality survival program Make Mate 1 but was eliminated in episode 9.
Jung Jihoon is a member of Wetters
Jung Jin Woo, popularly known as P.ODD (Perfectly Odd), is a South Korean singer, composer, and producer. He was also a member of the project boy group PLT.

Jung Jo Han is a Chinese trainee under Stardust Entertainment. He is a member of the predebut Chinese boy group Stardust Boys. He was a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024, but left the show soon after the beginning.

Jung Joon Young is a South Korean singer, composer, and TV personality who rose to fame after participating in the hit show Superstar K. In 2020, he was sentenced to six years in jail for his sexual crimes.

Jung Min Gyu is a South Korean actor and idol trainee under Fantagio. He is best known for participating in the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet" under the agency CABIN74. On May 2023, he signed an exclusive contract with Fantagio as an actor.
Jung Pyungeun is a singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

Jung Sang is a South Korean rapper. He is best known for participating in the reality show World Klass. Following his elimination, he opened up an Instagram account on December 8 and posted a song to his SoundCloud account titled "Trouble" on December 16 under the name L-dy.
Jung Seokhoon is a South Korean singer and musician. He is a member of the rock band The Whales. He was also a contestant on Superband 2.
Jung Seung Hwan is a South Korean singer and songwriter under Antenna Music. Before debuting in 2016, Jung Seung Hwan joined K-pop Star 4 where he finished as a runner-up.
Jung Seunghwan is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening.
Jung Seungwon is a South Korean trainee under JG Entertainment. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Jung Seyun is a South Korean trainee under Hi-Hat Entertainment. In 2022, he was a contestant on MNET's survival show Boys Planet. He was sadly eliminated in episode 5 after ranking 74th place. At that time he was signed under Woollim Entertainment. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated in the final after ranking 18th place.

Jung Soo-min is a South Korean-American singer and dancer based in the United States under Neuron Music. He gained recognition through his participation in the reality shows LOUD, Stars Awakening, and Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor. Jung Soo Min released his solo debut EP titled "Phasis" on October 10, 2023.
Jung Yoonjae is a South Korean trainee and actor under SM Entertainment. He is part of the trot boy group MYTRO.
Jungbin is a South Korean singer and dancer signed with GRID Entertainment. He debuted as a member and leader of the boy group POW on October 11, 2023.
Junggigo is a South Korean R&B singer. He made his official debut in 2008 with the digital single "Byebyebye"

Jungha is a South Korean rapper, singer, and actor under N Company Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group BEATWIN under Elen Entertainment, which he left on December 22, 2017. In 2017, Jungha participated in the survival show The Unit. He ranked 30th and was eliminated in episode 13. On December 22, 2017, the same day he left BEATWIN, it was announced that he had resigned with his previous agency, N Company Entertainment.
Lee Jung Hoon, formerly known as Daun, is a South Korean singer. He is the former main vocalist of the boy group GreatGuys.
Junghoon (formerly J-Kid) is a singer and lyricist of the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly part of the boy group ENOi.
Junghoon was a part of the group Axis.
Lee Jung Hoon is a South Korean fitness trainer. He was a rapper as well as the youngest member of the boy group 1TEAM.
Junghoon is a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TST.

Junghoon is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the lead vocalist of the boy group xikers. On May 5, 2023, it was announced that Junghoon would be going on hiatus to recover from surgery after tearing his cruciate ligament.
Junghun is a South Korean singer under KINGTOP Entertainment. He is a member and of the boy group ASTIN.

Junghwan is a Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is the maknae and a vocalist in the boy group TREASURE. In 2018, So Jung Hwan participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. On the final episode, he was announced as the third member of the boy group, later called TREASURE. Junghwan debuted as the maknae of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One. On June 12, 2023, Junghwan was confirmed as the first member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.

Yun JungHwan is a South Korean singer and composer under Brand New Music. He first appeared on the hit survival program Produce X 101. He made his official debut in 2019 as the maknae and vocalist of the trio BDC.
Lee Jung Hyun is a South Korean singer and musician under UZUROCKS Entertainment and GOGO2020. He is the bassist, vocalist, and maknae of the boy group 2Z.
Hongi Jungi debuted as a member of the co-ed rock band 11Degrees on the 7th of December 2018.
Jungkey is a South Korean composer under Those Records. He released his first album "Emotions" on May 29, 2014.

Jeon Jungkook, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, rapper, producer and composer under Big Hit Entertainment. He is best known as the main vocalist, lead dancer, center, and maknae of the worldwide sensational boy group BTS. Jungkook used to dream of becoming a professional badminton player, but the moment he saw G-Dragon perform on television, he was inspired to become an idol. Jungkook auditioned for the show 'Super Star K' and although he did not pass, he still received casting offers from different entertainment companies. After watching RM perform, Jungkook chose to be a part of Big Hit Entertainment. In 2013, Jungkook debuted with the group and went on to become a worlwide phenomenon. Jungkook made his solo debut with single "Seven" on July 14, 2023 featuring American rapper Latto, and released his second solo single, "3D", featuring Jack Harlow, on September 29. His first studio album "Golden" was published on November of the same year featuring title track "Standing Next to You".
Jung Min is a South Korean singer and musician, known for being the keyboardist and sub-vocalist of the boy band D.COY.

Jungmin is a South Korean trainee. He is a former pre-debut member of the boy group NCT and its sub-unit NCT Wish. On July 12, 2023, Jungmin, was revealed as a contestant of SM Entertainment's NCT Universe : LASTART. He ranked 4th, thus making him a member of NCT Wish. On October 2, 2023, SM Entertainment announced that Jungmin would depart from the group and return to be a trainee due to health concerns. NCT Wish would continue their activities with six members.

Jungmo is a South Korean solo artist and guitarist under PA Entertainment. He is a former member of the rock band TraxX and pop-rock duo M&D. He debuted as a solo artist on July 23, 2019 after leaving SM Entertainment.
Jungmo is the drummer for Catch The Youth. He made his debut on November 1st, 2023, with the mini album, ‘Catch The Young : Fragments of Youth‘.

Koo Jungmo, also known by the mononym Jungmo is a vocalist under Starship Entertainment. He is a member of the boy band CRAVITY. He was a contestant in Produce X 101 where he finished at 12th place. He debuted as a member of CRAVITY on April 14, 2020 with the mini album "HIDEOUT : REMEMBER WHO WE ARE".

Kim Jungnam is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and actor. He is best known as a member of the legendary hip-hop group Turbo. Despite leaving the group in 1997, Jungnam later re-joined them for their 2015 comeback.
Jungsang is a member and singer of the group A.Cian under Wings Entertainment.
Jeongseung is a member of the South Korean boy group D-CRUNCH. On January 17, 2023, Jung Seung enlisted into the military. He was discharged on July 16, 2024.

Lee Jung-shin is a South Korean musician, singer, rapper, and actor under FNC Entertainment. He is best known for being the bassist and maknae of the band CNBLUE. He made his acting debut in 2012 and has since appeared in dramas such as "Cinderella and the Four Knights", "My First Love", "Voice 2", and "Shooting Star". He enlisted in the military on July 2018 and was discharged in March 2020.
Kim Jungsu is a South Korean musician, singer, and songwriter under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut as the keyboardist and main vocalist of the band Xdinary Heroes on December 6, 2021.

Yang Jungwon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as the leader of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Jungwon was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked as the 1st place by global votes and became a member of ENHYPEN. Jungwon made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".
Jungwoo, preveiously known as Yoosung, is a South Korean singer and actor under Mario Entertainment. He was a member of MBK Entertainment's co-ed group Co-ed School and its male counterpart SPEED.

Kim Jungwoo is a member of NCT and it's sub-units NCT 127, NCT U, and NCT DOJAEJUNG. He was first introduced through SMRookies on April 18, 2017. In the same month, he appeared in SUPER JUNIOR Yesung's 'Paper Umbrella' music video, alongside former SMRookies member Koeun. In January 2018, he alongside Kun and Lucas were announced to become members of NCT, through the 'NCT 2018 Yearbook'. On February 19, 2018, he officially debuted as a member of NCT, in the unit NCT U, with the song 'BOSS'. On October 12, 2018, he debuted as a member of NCT 127, with their full studio album 'NCT #127 Regular-Irregular'.
Jungwook is a South Korean trainee under ICE Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut group HALF&HALF.
Junhee is a South Korean rapper and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member and the leader and rapper of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO.
Junho is a former-member of K-pop band 5Tion under IV Entertainment.

Junho is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor under JYP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 2PM. He debuted with the group on September 4, 2008 with the single album 'Hottest Time of the Day'. He made his Japanese solo debut in June 24, 2013 with his first mini album Kimi no Koe and his Korean solo debut on September 14, 2015 with the best album One. Junho began his military duty as a public service worker on May 30, 2019. The date of his release was March 20, 2021. On March 20, 2025, JYP Entertainment announced that Lee Junho's exclusive contract with the company will end on April 15, 2025, and both parties have mutually decided not to renew it after 17 years of partnership. JYP expressed gratitude for his contributions as a 2PM member and actor, while Junho thanked the company for its support over the years. Despite his departure, JYP will continue managing his activities in Japan and supporting future collaborations.

Cha Jun Ho is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He first appeared and competed in the hit survival show "Produce X 101" where he finished ninth place, allowing him a spot in the project group X1. He promoted as a member of X1 from August 2019, until the group's unfortunate disbandment in January 2020. In October 2020, Junho debuted once again, this time as the lead vocalist, visual, and center of the boy group DRIPPIN.
Junho is a South Korean singer under NOMAD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NOMAD. He is best known for participating in the survival show The Origin - A, B, or What?.
Junhyeok is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group Celest1a. He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Junhyeok is a South Korean singer under WithHC & n.CH Entertainment. He is a member of the boy groups withus and n.SSign.

Cheon Jun Hyeok is a South Korean idol under P Nation and a member of the boy group TNX. As a trainee, he appeared and competed in the SBS survival show "Loud" where he was recruited by Psy to join his first boy group, TNX. He made his official debut on May 17, 2022.
Junhyeok is a member of the rock boy band (formerly co-ed) 5but, he was added as a member after Lee Hyesu left to fill her spot. He is a former member of 828, Monday Off With Bluesy, and HANUM.
Junhyeong is a South Korean rapper and lyricist under Startree Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ENPHAZE and a former member of F.able.
Oh Junhyoung is a South Korean singer under COMMAND THE-M Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 27, 2023 as a member of the boy group CMDM.
Jung Jun Hyuk is a South Korean-Canadian trainee who participated on survival show "YG Treasure Box"

Junhyuk, born Lee Junhyuk, is a South Korean singer under Idol Youth Entertainment. He is member of the now disbanded boy group MIRAE and the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys. Before debuting he competed on the 2019 survival show Produce X 101. He later debuted as a member of MIRAE on March 17, 2021 with the mini album "Killa".
Son Jun Hyung is a singer under Maroo Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group GHOST9.
Park Junil, or simply Junil, is a South Korean trainee under iNKODE. He is best known for being a former member of the pre-debut group Trainee A and for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Kim Junjae is a South Korean idol trainee and DJ under Think About Entertainment. He is first known for appearing in the hit survival program "Produce X 101.
Kim Junhyung, known under his stage name as JunJi, is a South Korean singer under 8D Entertainment. He debuted as a member of OnlyOneOf on May 28, 2019 with the mini album "Dot point jump'.

Park Choong-Jae, best known by the stage name Jun Jin, is a South Korean singer and actor under Shinhwa Company and CI Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the K-pop boy group, Shinhwa as a lead rapper, vocalist, and lead dancer. Jun Jin made his official group debut with Shinhwa on March 24th, 1998 under SM Entertainment. However, he and the group left the company in July 2003. Jun Jin used to sing small parts; when he and Shinhwa signed with Good Entertainment, he advanced and sang a solo song entitled, "Painfully Loving You". In November 2006, Jun Jin released his first single, "Love Doesn't Come". In early January 2007, he filmed a music video with Taiwanese singer, Linda Liao. In mid-2007, Jun Jin left his group's company and set up his own company, JF Story Entertainment to concentrate on his solo career more. However, it has been since managed by Open World Entertainment. On April 26th, 2008, Jun Jin held his first solo concert at Shibuya Public Hall, Tokyo. Jun Jin released his first full-length solo album on April 28th titled, 'The New Decade'. His first single from the album "Wa" unfortunately sparked controversy when the music video was given a 19+ rating due to sexual content.
Shin Junki is the Bassist and Sub-Vocalist for the rock-ballad band BUZZ under Long Play Music. Junki got married to his non-celebrity wife in 2014.

Kono Junki, more commonly known as Junki, is a Japanese singer. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Junkyu is a South Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE. In 2017, he participated in the reality survival show MIXNINE. He was eliminated in the episode 10 after ranking 35th place. In 2018, Junkyu participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. On the final episode, he was announced as the fourth member of the boy group, later called TREASURE. On January 29, 2019, YGE announced that he would form a second group from the show, called MAGNUM and together with TREASURE, they would promote together as TREASURE 13. Unfortunately, due to scandals surrounding the agency, the debut was postponed. On January 6, YGE posted a notice on their official website stating the group's future plans. This included re-organizing as a 12-member group and the integration of the two units, TREASURE and MAGNUM, into only one group named simply as TREASURE. Junkyu debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with their first single album "The First Step : Chapter One". On June 14, 2023, Junkyu was confirmed as the second member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.

Ryu Junmin is a member of the South Korean boy group ATBO under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” and debuted with ATBO by placing fourth place with a total of 1380 points.

Junmin is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the main dancer of the boy group xikers. He was introduced as a member of KQ Fellaz 2 on August 15, 2022.

JUNNY is a Korean-Canadian singer-songwriter and producer based in South Korea, currently signed to MAUVE Company. He officially debuted on April 6, 2017, with the extended play “Monochrome,” and has since gained recognition for his smooth R&B sound, introspective lyrics, and active involvement in composing and producing both his own music and songs for other artists.
He was apart of AxisB
Junoflo is a Korean-American rapper under GLX. He was a contestant on the TV series Show Me the Money 5 (2016) Show Me the Money 6 (2017).
JUNON is a member of VERMUDA. On October 5th 2018, it was announced he’ll join Vermuda.
Junpyo is a South Korean singer under Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NouerA. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MAKE MATE 1.
Kang Jun Kyu, also known as JunQ, is a South Korean actor and rapper under YY Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group MYNAME.

Kim Jun Seo, also known simply as Junseo, is a South Korean singer and rapper under OUI Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WEi, the project group ALPHA DRIVE ONE, and was previously a member of the project group 1THE9. Junseo first gained recognition on the boy group survival show "Under Nineteen," where he finished in 9th place, securing his spot in 1THE9. After the group's contract expired, Junseo continued his training. On October 25, 2018, Junseo was introduced as a contestant on "Under Nineteen," as part of the performance team. He finished in ninth place, thus joining the project group 1THE9. The group officially debuted on April 13, 2019, with the mini album "XIX." 1THE9 disbanded on August 8, 2020, after releasing their final mini album "Good Bye 1THE9." In 2020, Junseo was announced as a member of OUI Entertainment's new boy group, WEi. He debuted with WEi on October 5, 2020, with their first mini album "Identity: First Sight." Junseo later went on to participate in the 2025 survival show Boys II Planet where he ranked 8th, securing his spot in the debut group.

Junseo is a South Korean dancer under Brave Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DKB. Junseo was introduced as a member of DKB on November 14, 2019. He officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020, with the mini album Youth.

Park Junseo is a South Korean dancer and singer under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy group BAE173. In 2016, he was a member and contestant of the pre-debut survival group and show BOYS24, but was sadly eliminated and couldn't make it into the final group. On September 21, 2020, Park Junseo was introduced as the eighth member of BAE173. He officially debuted with the group on November 19, 2020, with the release of their mini album Intersection: Spark. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated in the final after ranking 21st place.
Lim Junseo, also known as Junseo is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the 2022 survival show, "Boys Planet."

Oh Junseok is the Leader of the South Korean boy group ATBO under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” and debuted with ATBO by placing second place with a total of 1710 points.

Choi Jun Seong, also known as Jun S, is South Korean singer under Maroo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group GHOST9. He made his solo Japanese debut on June 9, 2025 with the digital single "Melty Love". He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show Produce X 101.
Junseong is a South Korean trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Shin Jun Seop is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under 51K Entertainment. He started his career in 2017 when he debuted as the rapper and visual of the boy group MYTEEN. He also participated in the show "Show Me the Money 6" and the survival program "MIXNINE". Junseop made his acting debut in 2018 through the drama "My ID is Gangnam Beauty" where he played the younger version of Cha Eunwoo's character. Following MYTEEN's disbandment in 2019, he has since focused in acting.

Junsik is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the disbanded boy group Apeace and its sub-units Apeace Lapis and late Apeace Onyx5. He was first introduced through Apeace's trainee team, Apeace Gem, in October 2011. However, he did not officially join the group until the departure of former member Seunghyung.
Kim Juntae is a South Korean singer under MYstar Entertainment and MY Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group MY.st.

Juntae (Kim Jun Tae) is a skilled vocalist, songwriter, and composer, now leading IN A MINUTE under JWIN Entertainment. Previously a member of TREI and the duo JT&MARCUS, he has established himself as a multifaceted artist. His songwriting and composition credits include work for OMEGA X and TAN, showcasing his creative depth. Now, alongside Jaejun and Hyunyeop, he is set to debut with IN A MINUTE on March 15, 2025, with their first single album, UNBOXING: WHAT YOU WANTED. With his leadership and musical expertise, Juntae aims to bring a distinct sound and vision to the group’s debut.
Lee Junwoo is a South Korean trainee who competed on the survival program "Produce 101 Season 2"
Junwoo (formerly known as Bullet) is a South Korean singer. He is the leader of the Korean pop boy group VARSITY.
JunWook is a member of the boy group TheEastLight.

Lee Jun Yeop, better known by his stage name Junyeop, is a South Korean singer. He is the rapper and vocalist of the KPop boy group Withus, under withHC. He was the third member to be revealed on October 28, 2020.

Lee Junyong is a South Korean singer currently signed under MOREDAY. He is a former member of the disbanded groups NOIR and INX. Junyong gained further recognition as a contestant on the survival programs Wild Idol and Project 7.
Junyong is the keyboardist and vocalist of Catch The Young. He made his debut on November 1st, 2023, with the mini album, ‘Catch The Young : Fragments of Youth‘.
Lee Junyoung is the bassist and maknae of the boy band IZ under Music K Entertainment.
Jura is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the hip hop group Honey Family.
Justhis, born Heo Seung is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2015, then under Indigo Music. He is now under GROOVL1N.
Justin is a Korean-New Zealander trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Huang Minghao, also known as Justin Huang, is a Chinese solo singer and member of the boy group NEX7 under Yuehua Entertainment. In 2017, Minghao, along with fellow trainee, now groupmate Zhengting participated on Mnet's Produce 101 Season 2, apart of the Yuehua Entertainment trainees. He was eliminated in episode 8 with a total of 458,650 votes. In early 2018, he participated on iQiYi's Idol Producer, where he ranked fourth place, earning himself a place in the group Nine Percent. On June 21, 2018, he debuted as a member of Yuehua Entertainment's new boy group NEX7. On August 3, 2020, Minghao released his first solo album "18".

Justin, formerly known as JJ, is a Japanese-American trainee under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the SMROOKIES trainee team SMTR25. He is also a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A and the Japanese boy group AMEZARI -RED STAR-.
Justin Kim is a Souh Korean bassist under Fluxus Music as a member of the rock band, Ibadi.

Jang Juwang is a South Korean singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip. In January 5, 2025, Juwang was revealed as the 4th member of KickFlip. He officially debuted with the group's first single album "Umm Great".
Juwun is a singer and dancer who debuted on August 22, 2024, with the group AFOTS. On December 27 of the same year, it was announced that he would be leaving the group.

Lee Ju-Yeon is a South Korean singer under ONE HUNDRED. He was discovered by a casting director while watching a concert with his family and ultimately became a trainee. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the main dancer, vocalist, and visual of the eleven-member boy group The Boyz.
Juyoung is a South Korean singer under AUBEMOOON STUDIO. He is a vocalist of the boy group NCHIVE. He made his debut on April 9th, with the single album "Drive".
Jyan is a South Korean singer and streamer under Familya Entertainment and a member of the virtual group ARRIVAL.
K is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the upcoming boy group AWIN and a former member of the boy group MVP.

Koga Yudai, known under his stage name K, is a Japanese singer and dancer under HYBE Labels Japan. K is best known for participating in the survival program I-LAND–the same show where ENHYPEN was created. However, K was eliminated on the final episode. In 2022, K participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to join the Japanese boy group &TEAM.
K is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DAYCHILD, former member of the boy group WEUS and the pre-debut boy group Sea Park.
K is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group NEEZ.
Kim Geon Woong, also known for his stage name K-Kid, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He used to be a member of the boy group Blanc7.
K:appa is a member of the South Korean boy group AlphaBAT.

Kim Hyungsoo, popularly known as K.Will, is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2007 with the album "Left Heart." Having been in the industry for more than a decade, K.Will has released songs that became massive hits domestically and internationally such as "You Don't Know Love," "Please Don't..." and "Love Blossom"

maleIdols.description: Kad is a Thai singer and actor under RS Music. He was previously a member of the boy group ELEMENT, as well as the project groups F2K and SUPERBOY. He gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Starlight Boys.

Kaedan is a member and the maknae of the boy group FANTASY BOYS under PocketDol Studios. On February 20, 2023, he was introduced as a contestant on MBC's boy group survival show Fantasy Boys. During the show's finale, he secured the 12th position overall, earning him a spot as a member of Fantsay Boys. The group debuted with the mini album "New Tomorrow" on September 21, 2023.
Kai is a Japanese trainee. He was a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 6 after ranking 35th.
Kai is a Japanese-Mexican trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Kim Jong In, better known by his stage name Kai, is a South Korean singer and actor. Kai is the Main Dancer, Lead Rapper, and Center of the world-famous boy group EXO and its sub-unit EXO-K. Famous for being EXO's Dancing Machine, Kai also starred in the Kdrama series "Andante", "Seven First Kisses", "Miracle We Met", "EXO Next Door" and Japanese drama "Spring Has Come". On October 4th, 2019, he debuted once more under SM Entertainment's supergroup, SuperM. On November 30, 2020, Kai released his first solo mini album "Kai". On May 3, 2023, SM Entertainment released a statement that because of a recent change in regulations of the Military Manpower Administration, Kai would be enlisting on May 11 as a public service worker. He was then discharged on February 10, 2025.
Kaiji is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group 24kumi. He was a contestant the reality survival show Oen-High.

Bang Junho, better known by his stage name Kain, is the leader, main dancer, and rapper of the South Korean boy group under MSH Entertainment. Before debuting, Kain worked as a backup dancer for BTS during their Wings Tour.
Kairi was a Japanese rapper and singer under MLD Entertainment and he was a member of the boy group TFN. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.
Kaisei is a Japanese trainee under C9 Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group NAZE.

Na Kamden, also known Na Du Bin, is a Korean-American singer and rapper under FNC Entertainment. He is known for participating in survival shows "Wild Idol" and "Boys Planet" 2023. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group AMPERS&ONE on November 15, 2023.
Kan is a Mongolian-Korean singer and member of the boy group "Megamax." He is the first male Mongolian Kpop idol and the second Mongolian idol overall.
Kang Chang Mo is a South Korean singer and model under ESteem Model Management. He is a contesant on Wild Idol.
Kang Chanhwi is a South Korean singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

Kang Daniel is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actor under ARA. He first gained prominence after winning first place on Produce 101 Season 2 in 2017, earning the center position in the project group Wanna One. The group debuted on August 7, 2017, with 1X1=1 (To Be One) and quickly became one of the most successful acts in K-pop during their active years. Following their final album 1¹¹=1 (Power of Destiny) in November 2018, Wanna One officially disbanded on December 31, 2018. After parting ways with LM Entertainment in 2019, Kang Daniel founded KONNECT Entertainment and launched his solo career. His first special album, Color On Me, was released on July 25, 2019, marking a strong start to his independent musical journey. He continued to build his discography with the Color Trilogy series, which included Cyan (2020), Magenta (2020), and Yellow (2021), showcasing his versatility as an artist. His first full-length album, The Story, was released in May 2022, followed by his Japanese debut EP Joy Ride in October 2022. He further solidified his presence in the Japanese market with Re8el in November 2023. Beyond music, Kang Daniel ventured into acting, making his official debut in 2022 as the lead in Disney+ original series Rookie Cops. He also became a well-known television personality, serving as the MC for Mnet’s hit dance competition Street Woman Fighter 2 in 2023. His continued success in both entertainment and music led to the release of his fourth mini album Realiez in June 2023, featuring the pre-release single Wasteland. In May 2024, Kang Daniel filed a criminal lawsuit against the major shareholder of KONNECT Entertainment for various charges, including embezzlement and fraud. As a result, KONNECT officially shut down in June 2024, and he departed from the company. Shortly after, on July 25, 2024, he signed an exclusive contract with ARA, an agency founded by a former KONNECT executive with experience at YG Entertainment and BigHit Music. Under his new agency, he released his fifth mini album Act on September 23, 2024. Kang Daniel pursued his education at Kyunghee Cyber University after obtaining his GED during Produce 101. In his personal life, he was in a public relationship with TWICE’s Jihyo from August 2019 to November 2020. In December 2019, he was diagnosed with depression and panic disorder, leading to a temporary hiatus from activities. He resumed his career in February 2020 after focusing on treatment and recovery. With a career spanning music, acting, and television, Kang Daniel continues to evolve as an artist, maintaining a strong presence in both the Korean and international entertainment industries. On August 29, Kang Daniel revealed his official fandom name as FLOWD. It's a combination of "FLOW" and the "D" from Daniel, symbolizing those who are immersed in Kang Daniel enough to forget the flow of time and those who love the flow created by Kang Daniel.
Kang Han is South Korean artist. He was a member of the pop/Hip-Hop co-ed group WE, boy gorup Black Beat (2002–2006) and Eagle Five.

Kang Heemin is a South Korean trainee. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group HALF&HALF and former member of boy group We1ne. He is best known for being a contestant on JTBC's 2024 survival show PROJECT7.
Kang Himchan is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Kang Hyunwoo is a South Korean singer under Eighty6. He made his solo debut on May 22, 2025, with the digital single "Serena-Day." Prior to debuting, he participated in the SBS's survival show LOUD, MBC’s Fantasy Boys, and JTBC's PROJECT7. Hyunwoo was introduced as a member of the upcoming Japanese boy group MY BOYZ in October 2023, but no further updates were given about the group in 2024.
Kang Irang is a South Korean trainee under Maroo Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Kang Jeonseo is a trainee under n.CH Entertainment. He is currently participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kang Jimin is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Kang Jun Hyuk is a contestant in the SBS survival show "Universe League."
Kang Kyun Sung is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and TV personality. He was first known for being a member of the band "Noel".
Kang Min Jae is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Wild Idol. He was eliminated in Ep. 3.
Kang Min Jun is a South Korean musician under P&B Entertainment. He is the guitarist for the boy band South Club.

Kang Min Seo is a South Korean singer signed with PocketDol Studio. In 2023, he got recognition as a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys, where he finished in 7th place, being able to debut in the final group FANTASY BOYS. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Kang Min Hyuk is a musician and actor under FNC Entertainment. He first rose to fame as the drummer of the pop rock band CNBLUE. He also made his acting debut in 2010. Since then, Minhyuk has starred in many dramas such as "The Heirs", "Entertainer", "Hospital Ship", and "How to be Thirty". In July 2018, Minhyuk enlisted in the military. He was discharged in March 2020.
Kang San is a member of the South Korean vocal group Voisper. He and his high school friends auditioned on the 6th season of Superstar K under the name "North Incheon Nineteen."

Kang Seok Hwa is a South Korean singer and lyricist affiliated with OUI Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WEi. Seokhwa initially gained attention through his participation in the survival shows "YG Treasure Box" and "Produce X 101." He debuted as the main vocalist of WEi on October 5, 2020, with the release of their first mini-album "Identity: First Sight." In 2018, Seokhwa competed in YG Treasure Box, where he was eliminated in episode 9. Afterward, he left YG Entertainment and joined "Produce X 101" as an independent trainee. He was eliminated in episode 8, finishing in 35th place.
Kang Seokju is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening. He was a member of ambitious ambition.
Kang Seon Jun is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Kang Seung Sik (also known as Seungsik) is a South Korean singer-songwriter currently under MUMW Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VICTON. He debuted as a member of VICTON on November 9, 2016 with the group’s first mini album Voice To New World. On January 31, 2023, Kang announced through a Weverse live broadcast that he would be enlisting in the military band on March 22. He was officially discharged on September 19, 2024. On December 17, 2024, IST Entertainment confirmed that Kang would be leaving the company ahead of the expiration of his exclusive contract. On July 30, 2025, MUMW Entertainment announced that Kang had signed with the agency.
Kang Seungchan is a rapper and vocalist of the Boy Group NewKidd under J-flo Entertainment. He was introduced as the newest member of Newkidd in April of 2019.

Kang Tae Oh is a South Korean actor and singer. He used to be a member of the boy group 5URPRISE with fellow actors under Fantagio Entertainment. Kang Tae Oh is best known for appearing on dramas such as "Tale of Nokdu", "Doom At Your Service", and "Run On".
Kang Woo Jin is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Kang Yuchan, also known as Chan, is a South Korean singer and actor under WAY BETTER. He is the youngest member of the boy group A.C.E and a former member of the project boy group UNB. He made his official debut with A.C.E on May 23, 2017. In 2017, Chan and fellow A.C.E member Jun competed on KBS 2TV's idol rebooting show The Unit. Chan reached the final lineup by placing 9th, earning a spot in the temporary boy group UNB. The group debuted on April 7, 2018, with the mini-album Boyhood and disbanded in December 2018. On April 6, 2025 it was announced on Way Better's Official Twitter that he has officially signed with the agency to pursue activities as a solo artist.
Jo Young Bin, also known as Kanghan, is a South Korean singer. He is the former leader and lead vocalist of the boy group MVP.

Kanghyun is a South Korean rapper and trainee under J-Star Entertainment. He is the youngest member of the boy group N.TOP, where he serves as the group's rapper. Before debuting, he appeared as a contestant on the survival show Debut’s Plan, where he gained early exposure despite not advancing past the survival round. He officially began his idol career with the debut of N.TOP and the release of their first single album "We:Disconnect."
Kanghyun is a member of the band ONEWE under RBW Entertainment. He is the guitarist.
Kanghyun is a South Korean formed singer. He joined the boy group TOUCH in 2012 but left the group in May of 2013.

Kim Young Woon, also known as Kangin, is a South Korean singer, actor, MC and radio DJ. He is popularly known for being a former member of the boy group SUPER JUNIOR under SM Entertainment. He is also a former member of its sub-units SUPER JUNIOR-T and SUPER JUNIOR-H. In addition to singing, he is also known for hosting programs including A Song For You and Show Champion. In 2002, Kangin won first place on the fourth annual SM Youth Best Contest and won the best outward appearance award and signed a contract with SM Entertainment. He enlisted in the military on July 5, 2010 and was discharged on April 16, 2012. Kangin officially left the group on July 11, 2019.

Kang Jun is a South Korean singer and artist. He made his official debut in July 2012 as a member of the boy group C-CLOWN. The group eventually disbanded in 2015. Kang Jun currently works as a graphic designer and visual director.

Yoo Kangmin is a South Korean rapper and dancer under Jellyfish Entertainment. He made his official debut in as the lead dancer, rapper, and visual of the boy group, Verivery, with the release of their first mini album, 'Veri-Us', on January 9, 2019. In 2025, he was revealed as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Kangmin is a South Korean singer and taekwondo practitioner. He is a former member and the lead vocalist of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. On September 19, 2019, Kangmin debuted as a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO with the release of their mini album HuiRoAeRak. Unfortunately, he left the group sometime in January 2021, with his final participation in the group being their first digital single "Love".
Kangmin is a South Korean singer under CT Entertainment. He is the maknae and the sub rapper of ROMEO.

Yasuo Namekawa, also known as Kangnam, is a Korean-Japanese Singer, Model, and TV personality under Sandbox Network. He joined the Japanese band Kick Chop Busters (KCB) in March 2008 with the stage name Ya-Cha as a new member. He later quit the band in 2010 for Unknown Reasons. He debuted as a Soloist releasing his 1st single “Say My Name" in 2011, shortly before joining M.I.B, and was the Lead Vocalist and the Oldest Member of M.I.B, a South Korean Hip-Hop Group. (M.I.B later disbanded in 2017). Following M.I.B's Disbandment, He later released several singles and EPs. He married Lee Sang-Hwa (A Two-Time Olympic Gold Medalist) in 2019. Since 2021, He has been the Main Host of his own YouTube show "Neighborhood Friend Kangnam". On October 6, 2023, Kangnam was announced as the CEO of ARMADA Ent, where he produced the boy group ONE PACT. On May 21, 2024, it was announced that Kangnam had stepped down from his position as ARMADA Ent's CEO since January 2024.

Kangsan is a South Korean singer under Aubemoon Studio. He is former member of the pre-debut group C On H under the name Hanwol. He is also the main rapper of the boy group NCHIVE He is known for participating in the "Stars Awakening" survival show. He made his debut with NCHIVE on April 9th, with the single album "Drive".
Kim Kangsan debuted as a member of the co-ed rock band 11Degrees on the 7th of December 2018.
Lee Kang Sung is a rapper under Maroo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group GHOST9.

Kangta is a South Korean singer-songwriter, actor, composer, and host under SM Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group H.O.T. Following the group's disbandment in March 2001, he made his solo debut in August 2001 with the album Polaris. On February 3, 2020, it was revealed by SM Entertainment and Ace Factory that Kangta is in a relationship with actress Jung Yu-mi.
Kangto is a South Korean drummer. He was a member of the co-ed group Se So Neon. He left the group in December 2018 to enlist for military service.
Kanto is a South Korean rapper under Brand New Music. He is a former member of the boy group TROY. He debuted as a solo artist on October 25, 2013 with the single "What You Want".

Karam is a South Korean singer and actor under New Ways Company. He is a member of the boy group ASC2NT, and a former member of the boy groups XING and DGNA, as well as its sub-unit Popsicle. He made his solo debut on June 8, 2018, with the Japanese single album "Rise Up". In 2022, he took on his first major role in a drama series with Happy Ending Romance, marking a significant step in his acting career. Prior to this, he made his acting debut in the Japanese film Be Crazy About Me, an adaptation of the popular manga Ai Ore!.
Karis is a South Korean singer under TM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EASTSHINE and a former member of the pre-debut JN boy group.
Kash Bang is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Webside in 2017.
Kass, formerly known as Bakchigi, is a South Korean rapper and producer. He was a member of the boy group Wonder Boyz.
Kassho is a Japanese trainee under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the SMROOKIES trainee team SMTR25. He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show NCT Universe : LASTART.
Kay-G is a South Korean singer associated with BADBOSS COMPANY. He is a member of the boy group FREE PASS. He made his solo debut on November 9, 2017, with the digital single "G."
Kazuta is a Japanese singer under n.CH Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group n.SSign. He is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Shin Kyubin, better known as KB, is a South Korean singer and rapper under 8D Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the group OnlyOneOf on May 28, 2019 with the mini album "Dot point jump'.
KCM is a South Korean singer. He debuted in 2003 with the song "I Know" from the soundtrack to the Korean drama (Punch) he is also a member of MSG Wannabe.

IF is a Rapper, Vocalist, Dancer, and Visual of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment. On November 6, 2023 the group Like A Movie introduced a new line up and two new members revealing IF as a new member and changing his stage name to KDay

Keeho is a South Korean-Canadian singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as the leader and one of the visuals of the boy group P1Harmony, Keeho is very popular on social networks thanks to his VLives in which he speaks a lot in English which makes it easier for international fans to understand. He is also popular for his cover of John Legend's "All of Me" on 10 January 2021 during the @P1uspace H: Get Together. On September 16, Keeho was revealed as the fifth member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
Keem Hyo-eun is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Ambition Musik in 2016.
Kei is a member of the Japanese boy group EBIDAN and its unit EDAMAME BEANS. He was a contestant on the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet" but was eliminated in the 5th episode after ranking 87th.

Sato Keigo, more commonly known as Keigo, is a Japanese singer, dancer, and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Keiju is a Japanese singer and dancer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip. He participated in the SBS survival program Loud, which led to him becoming a pre-debut member of the boy group JYPE LOUD. On January 6, 2025, he was officially revealed as a member of the boy group KickFlip.

Terazono Keita, popularly known as Keita, is a Japanese rapper and composer signed with Rain Company. He plays the roles of the main rapper, dancer, and singer in the boy group Ciipher and also leads the project boy group EVNNE. He first appeared in the survival show YG TREASURE BOX by YG Entertainment. In 2021, he debuted as a member of Ciipher. In 2023, he participated in Boys Planet. Although he did not make it in the final lineup, Keita became a member of the spinoff group EVNNE managed by Jellyfish Entertainment.

Kekinu is the energetic drummer of the Korean band KAVE and a current member of the co-ed band Binary Number. His powerful drumming style and rhythmic precision bring a strong backbone to KAVE’s music, adding depth and energy to every track. Kekinu’s skillful performance is central to KAVE’s sound, and his dynamic presence in both live shows and studio recordings showcases his versatility as a musician. His involvement with Binary Number further highlights his adaptability, contributing to his growth as a well-rounded artist.

Lee Jae Hwan, popularly known as Ken, is the main vocalist of the boy group VIXX under Jellyfish Entertainment. He has performed in many musicals and also acted in the drama Boarding House no. 24 (2014) and the web-drama Tofu Personified. On May 20, 2020, Ken made a solo debut with his first solo mini album "Greeting" prior to his enlistment. On July 17, 2024, Ken took to social media to announce that he joined a new agency, S27M ENTERTAINMENT.
Hiramoto Ken made his first appearance on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2), where his final rank was 34th. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".
Eric Hao, known by his stage name Kenny and his native name Hao Ruiran, is a Chinese-American singer and a member of the group 1VERSE under Singing Beetle Entertainment.

Kenshin is a Japanese singer under PocketDoll Studio and UNCORE. On September 26, 2024, he was announced as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which began airing in October 2024. He successfully secured a spot in the final lineup, placing 2nd, and became a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.
Kenshiro is a Japanese trainee under FNC Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Kenta is a Japanese trainee and a former member of the Japanese idol group Zero PLANET. He is currently participating in the SBS survival show Universe League.

Kenta, formerly known as RIKYM, is a Japanese singer under Star Road Entertainment. He is one half of the duo JBJ95 and a former member of the project group JBJ and Japanese cover dance group "Garagara Hebi". As a soloist, he goes by his full name Takada Kenta.

Keonhee is a South Korean singer under RBW. He is a member of the boy group ONEUS, with whom he debuted with on January 9, 2019 with the release of their first mini album "Light Us". Prior to debuting, in 2017, Keonhee was a contestant on MNET's survival show Produce 101 Season 2, where he was eliminated after ranking 33rd.
Keonho is a South Korean singer and songwriter under BIGHIT MUSIC. He made his debut as the maknae of the boy group CORTIS on August 18, 2025.
Kim Keonwoo, simply Keonwoo, is a South Korean singer under MYstar Entertainment and MY Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group MY.st.

Keum is a South Korean singer and actor under C9 Entertainment. As a trainee, he appeared and competed in the hit survival program "Produce X 101". He made his official debut in 2021 as the rapper and center of the boy group EPEX.
Keum Jin Ho is a South Korean trainee under PI Corporation and Eighty6. He participated in the survival show Fantasy Boys. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Kevin Moon (Korean name: Moon Hyung-Seo, is a South Korean singer under ONE HUNDRED. Born in Gwangju, Kevin moved to Vancouver when he was four and then back to Korea when he was thirteen, where he joined and competed in Kpop Star 6. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the main vocalist of the eleven-member boy group, The Boyz.
Kevin is a South Korean singer and pianist, member of the co-ed duo Monogram.
Kevin (formerly Jinwoo) is a singer and lyricist of the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly part of the boy group ENOi.
Kevin (T48) is a South Korean rapper and singer under MLD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TFN.
Kim Ji-yeop, better known as Kevin, is a South Korean rapper, singer, and MC. He debuted in January 2010 as the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and rapper of the boy group ZE:A.

Kevin Woo, professionally known as Kevin, is a Korean-American singer, actor, and MC affiliated with FC ENM. He began his music career as a member of the boy group XING, debuting on December 14, 2006, with the single album In Your Hands. Kevin departed from the group in April 2008 and subsequently filed a successful lawsuit against XING Entertainment over contractual issues, which he won in March 2010. Later that year, he joined U-KISS and officially debuted with the group on August 28, 2008, through their mini album New Generation. He remained an active member until March 2017, when he announced his departure upon the expiration of his contract. He was also part of U-KISS's subunit, uBEAT. Following his departure from U-KISS, Kevin pursued a solo career. He made his Japanese solo debut with the single "Ride Along" on October 25, 2018, and later launched his U.S. solo career with the release of "Got It" on June 29, 2021. Expanding into musical theatre, Kevin made his Broadway debut on April 4, 2022, in the musical KPOP, portraying Jun Hyuk, a member of the fictional idol group F8. In 2025, he lent his singing voice to the character Mystery Saja of the fictional Saja Boys in the Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters, marking another milestone in his multifaceted entertainment career.

Kim Kibum, known better as his stage name Key, is a member of the South Korean boy group SHINee under SM Entertainment. He was also a member of the short lived duo Toheart with Infinite's Woohyun. Key made his official debut as a member of SHINee on May 22, 2008 with the group's first mini album "Replay". He later made his solo debut with the digital single "Forever Yours" on November 6, 2018. Well known for his love of fashion, he helped design many of SHINee's costumes worn in concerts.

Lee Sangmin, also knowns as Khael, is a South Korean singer under DSP Media. He is a member of the boy group MIRAE. He was a former contestant on Under Nineteen. He was part of the top 19, but was eliminated in the final episode. He debuted as a member of MIRAE on March 17, 2021 with the mini album, "Killa".

KHAN, born Choi Jun-young, is a South Korean rapper who debuted in 2020 under 446 Block with the single “No Lie”. He first gained attention on the rap survival show "Drop The Bit" placing at 3rd and later became a semi-finalist on "Show Me the Money 11", finishing at 5th. He won RAP:PUBLIC with with his block, Block 2. In 2023, he signed with YNG & RICH Records, founded by SUPERBEE & Uneducated Kid. He is a member of the hip-hop crew NFL (Naughty4Life).
Koo Kihoon is a South Korean singer under MYmusic Entertainment, member of the duo We Are Young. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening.
Ki Hyeong Jun is a South Korean trainee. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 6 after ranking 29th.
KI-O was a member of Boy Group SPEED under MBK Entertainment.
Ki:XÉ is a self-composed and self-written independent South Korean singer. He debuted on May 13, 2025, with the single "??? (ODD)".
He was a member of LST

Kibum is a South Korean singer, rapper, actor, and model formerly under SM Entertainment and currently under Y Team Company. A former member of the boy group SUPER JUNIOR, after their 2009 album he left to pursue his acting career.

Kichun, formerly known as TN, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He is a member of the boy groups WE:A and AVION, and a former member of BIGFLO and Twilight. He was also the CEO and founder of JN Entertainment, which he operated until closing the company in 2021. Kichun first gained attention in January 2012 when Yeil Entertainment introduced him as one of the new members of Twilight, debuting under the stage name TN on February 8, 2012, with the group’s first mini album Twilight. The group became inactive later that year, following the deletion of their official Facebook page. He later joined BIGFLO, debuting with their third mini album Incant on October 8, 2015, before confirming his departure in December 2016 through an apology letter posted on social media. In March 2022, he was introduced as one of the original members of the then-upcoming group WE:A when their official social media accounts were launched. Outside of his group activities, he is part of the YouTube crew HEMFREEDOM CREW and is the founder of WEDANCESTUDIO, a dance studio located near Hongik University in Seoul.
Kid Milli is a South Korean rapper under Indigo Music. He debuted on February 3, 2016 with the single, "Tn" under BLGM.
Kid Wine is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, producer and hiphop artist who debuted under WaterWineGang in 2019.

Kidoh is a former member of Topp Dogg and unit Knight Kingdom.He is currently signed under the hip-hop label ROCKBOTTOM. His stage name comes from a combination of the word 'kid' (as in a child) and the exclamation 'oh.'

Kien is a Vietnamese singer and dancer under MYSTIC Story. He is the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and the oldest member of the boy group ARrC. On July 8, 2024, MYSTIC STORY introduced their first boy group, ARrC. Kien was unveiled as one of the seven members of this group.
Kiggen is an artist and producer under Starship X, a subsidiary of Starship Entertainment. He is a former member of the hip hop group Phantom.

Ahn Kihoon is the guitarist of Catch The Youth. He was introduced on June 29, 2021. He made his debut in Catch The Youth on November 1st, 2023 with the mini album, ‘Catch The Young : Fragments of Youth‘.

Shin Kihyun, or simply Kihyun, is a South Korean singer, actor, and model. He gained popularity through the show "Battle Shinhwa!" where he was chose by Shinhwa's Eric to debut in the boy group Battle. In 2008, Kihyun left the group to pursue acting. However, 10 years later, he reunited with the group and appeared on the sixth season of the show I Can See Your Voice.

Yoo Kihyun is a South Korean singer, actor, and composer under Starship Entertainment. He is best known as the main vocalist of the boy group Monsta X. He also takes part in writing and composing their songs. Kihyun debuted as a member of MONSTA X on May 14, 2015 with their first mini-album "Trespass". Kihyun made his solo debut on March 15, 2022, with his solo single album “VOYAGER”. On June 9, 2022, it was announced that he had renewed his contract with Starship Entertainment.
Killagramz is a Korean-American rapper under K-Tune Collective (a sub-label of Kiwi Media Group) who debuted on October 28, 2016 with the digital single Black Out
Kim is a Filipino idol member of the global pop group, HORI7ON. He secured the sixth rank in the survival show, Dream Maker. Before this, he also participated in a PPop survival show, Top Class.
Kim Beom Jun is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Kim Ki-bum is the talented bassist of the South Korean rock band Guckkasten. With a cool and understated presence, Kim lays down the groove that anchors the band’s intricate, psychedelic soundscapes. His basslines are known for being both steady and expressive, often weaving complexity into the band’s richly layered music. As a founding member of Guckkasten, Kim Ki-bum has played an essential role in the group’s musical evolution since their early indie days. His style blends technical skill with emotional subtlety, helping to create the band’s signature blend of progressive rock, alternative, and experimental elements. Though he keeps a low public profile and rarely appears in the media spotlight, Kim is deeply respected for his dedication to the craft and his synergy with the other band members. His calm demeanor on stage contrasts beautifully with the intensity of the band’s sound, making him a quiet force behind Guckkasten’s unforgettable live performances. With his solid musicianship and artistic integrity, Kim Ki-bum continues to be an integral part of Guckkasten’s identity and legacy in the Korean rock scene.

Ko Eun Sung is a South Korean singer and musical actor. He was a member of the project group KKD.
Ko Ganghun is a South Korean musician under Antenna. He is the drummer and maknae of the boy band DRAGONPONY.
Ko Ming Chieh is a Taiwanese trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Ko Minsung is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Ko Young-wook is a former member of the 1st generation co-ed group Roo'ra. In January 2013, he was sentenced to two years and six months for molesting and sexually assaulting three underage girls. He was released in 2015 with a monitoring device and was forced to register as a sex offender.

Ko Youngbae is a South Korean singer. He is a member and the founder of the band SORAN, with whom he debuted on August 19, 2010, with the release of their first EP "Why Didn't I Know It Then?". Aside from that, he is also an host for MBC FM4U's radio show 'Spoiler King Ko Youngbae'.
Kodai is a Japanese trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kogun is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group Lucente and project group NIK. He also used to be a member of ZEST before their official disbandment in 2016.

Kogyeol is a South Korean singer and actor under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group UP10TION. He debuted on September 10, 2015, as part of UP10TION with the release of the group’s first mini album Top Secret. In February 2023, it was announced that Kogyeol, together with Kuhn, Bit-to, Sunyoul, and Gyujin, had left TOP Media while continuing as members of the group under a seven-member lineup. On September 29, 2025, OAK Company announced that Kogyeol had signed with the company to promote as an actor.

Kohyeon is a South Korean singer under HOWLING Entertainment. He was part of the duo LuhaxHyeon and is also the leader of the boy group WAKER. Prior to these, he was part of the pre-debut lineup of Ten-X and the boy group 14U. Kohyeon embarked on his solo career with the release of the digital single “Don’t Laugh” on August 23, 2021. He and Luha formed a duo on January 13, 2022 with the debut digital single "You, me = Us". On November 13, 2023, it was revealed that is a member of the upcoming boy group WAKER; they made their debut on January 8, 2024 with the mini album "Mission of School"
Jung Min Gyu, popularly known as KOM, is a member of the boy group N.O.M under JZ Factory Entertainment. He's the younger brother of J.K (member of the same group).
Koo Doheon is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Top 10 Student and Stars Awakening.

Koo Han Seo is a South Korean trainee who is currently participating in the SBS survival show "Universe League." He was also a contestant of the MBC survival show "Under Nineteen" but was eliminated in Episode 9.

Koo Min-jae is a South Korean rapper. He is a member of the trio SIKKOO alongside 200 and Yosi. The group was independent under Sikkoo Entertainment until they signed with AOMG in 2025, and released their debut EP 'GAN' the same year.

Koo Tae-hoon is a drummer belonging to the Korean music group Jaurim . His current agency is Soundholic and is the CEO of Soundholic. In 1993, while serving in the military, he met Yoona Kim and worked full-count together, then got a job at an event company and quit his band life. However, after listening to demo tapes made by Yoona Kim, Jinman Kim, and Sunkyu Lee in 1996. On June 28, 2017, Jaurim announced a temporary suspension of activities due to personal circumstances.

Kim Kook Heon, also simply as Kook Heon, is a singer under The Music Works Entertainment. He is one half of the duo B.O.Y and a former member of the boy group MYTEEN. He made his solo debut on August 9, 2020 with his first digital single "Dry Flower".
Koon is a singer under S.I.E.T.E Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming group Pattern. He is also a former member of B:Skit.
Koonta, born Ahn Tae-hyun is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Blackbook Muzik in 2017.
Terao Koshin first made his appearance on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2), where his final rank was 17th. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".
Koseuke was a Japanese trainee. He is a former member of the pre-debut group UTH and was a pre-debut member of the group HNB. He was a contestant on Under Nineteen.
Kotaro is a Japanese trainee who appeared on survival show "YG Treasure Box"

Kotaro is a Japanese singer and dancer under TNK Entertainment. On August 14, 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on MBC's survival show Fan Pick. He ranked 5th place overall, making him a member of the winning group PICKUS. He debuted with the group on April 23, 2024 with the release of the single album "Little Prince". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Kouki is a Japanese singer under Sony Music Entertainment Korea. He is a member of the boy group KJRGL. He is best known for being a contestant on the Japanese survival show Produce 101 Japan Season 2.
Koyo Tempest is a singer and guitarist affiliated with Hubble Office. He is part of the virtual band SKOSHISM as lead singer and electric guitarist. His birthday is November 15th.
