maleIdols.description: Kris is a Thai trainee. He is best known as a contestant on the reality survival shows To Be Number One Idol 11, 9low on top, and Starlight Boys.

Wu Yi Fan, also known as Kris Wu, is a Canadian-Chinese former rapper and convicted rapist. He is currently serving his 13-year prison sentence in China. Kris Wu rose to fame in 2012 when he debuted as a member of the boy group EXO under SM Entertainment. In May 2014, he left the group after filing a lawsuit to terminate his exclusive contract with the agency. Although he lost in his legal battle with SM Entertainment, he was able to settle his contracts. Shortly after leaving EXO, Kris Wu started to promote in China as an actor and rapper, where his career reached new heights. He went on to star in multiple top-grossing local films, collaborate with international artists like Travis Scott, and even appear on international films such as "XXX: Return of Xander Cage" and "Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets". Kris Wu's flourishing career came crashing down after multiple women came forward with sexual assault accusations against him. In August 2021, he was formally arrested on multiple charges. By November 2022, the Chaoyang District People's Court in Beijing sentenced him to 13 years in prison. He is set to be deported in Canada by the time he finishes his sentence.

Krystian is a Chinese singer-songwriter, model, and former member of the global pop group, Now United. He is also known for participating in the survival shows "Youth With You 3" (2021), "Boys Planet" (2022), and "Boys II Planet" (2025).

Ksoul was born as Liu Zekai on October 19, 2000 in Chengdu, China. He participated in My Teenage Boy/Fantasy Boys with a final rank of 9th; making him a member of the boy group FANTASY BOYS, under PocketDol Studios. Ksoul made his official debut in China on 2018 as a member of the boy group Mu Ji Shao Nian, using the stage name Su Er. He later changed his legal name to Su Er. He has been on an on-and-off hiatus since September of 2023 due to the deteriorating health of his father and grandmother. It was announced in early March that his father has passed away on February 25th. On January 24, 2025, KSoul discovered online that PocketDol Studio had announced his exit from FANTASY BOYS on their fan cafe. He will end all ties with both the group and the agency.
Ku One Chan is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Peaches Label. He debuted on September 20, 2017 with a debut EP, titled Repetition.

Lai Kuan Lin is a Taiwanese rapper, singer, and actor. He is best known for being a member of the project group Wanna One after competing on Produce 101 season 2. He debuted with Wanna One on August 7, 2017, with the mini album 1X1=1 (To Be One). After the group disbanded, he formed a duo with PENTAGON's Wooseok. Known as Wooseok X Kuanlin, they debuted on March 11, 2019, with the mini album 9801. In July 2020, Kuanlin requested to terminate his contract with his former agency, Cube Entertainment, citing violations of contract and the sale of his management rights to a third party. On June 17, 2021, the Seoul Central District Court ruled in his favor, allowing him to terminate his contract with Cube.

No Soo Il, also known as Kuhn, is the co-leader, lead rapper, and vocalist of the boy group UP10TION under TOP MEDIA. Aside from rapping, Kuhn also has a knack for beatboxing. On February 1, 2024 Kuhn took to social media to announce that he was discharged from military early due to a herniated disk in his back and has been receiving treatment. He announced his upcoming marriage to his non-celebrity girlfriend on March 20, 2025, and the couple officially tied the knot on March 29.

Kum Jun Hyeon is a South Korean singer and actor under Redstart ENM. He is a member of the boy group TIOT and a former pre-debut member of the boy group Ciipher. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Boys Planet.

Qian Kun is a Chinese singer under SM Entertainment. He is best known for being a member of NCT and its sub-units NCT U and the China-based unit WayV, of which he is the leader. He is also part of the duo WayV-KUN&XIAOJUN, a subgroup specific to WayV. First introduced as a member of the trainee team SMROOKIES, Kun made his official debut in 2016 as a member of NCT's first unit, NCT U, with the Chinese version of the single 'Without You'.
Kunho is a South Korean singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.

Kursor (formerly known as Jung Ho) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and producer. He first entered the music industry as one half of the R&B duo 2MUCH, later renamed 8LOOP, alongside TE.O. The duo debuted on April 24, 2017 under Real Slow Company, a label he is still affiliated with. Although the group became inactive as of November 17, 2017, Kursor remained active in music. He made his solo debut on January 15, 2019 with the single "KNOT", under the independent label BIXIZ XOUND. In addition to performing, Kursor is involved in the full production of his music, including songwriting and composition. His style blends elements of R&B and other genres, and he has received recognition both in South Korea and internationally for his work.

Kush is a South Korean rapper, producer, and composer under Heart Entertainment. He originally debuted as part of the reggae duo Stony Skunk in 2003. Following their disbandment in 2008, he continued under YG Entertainment as a producer and composer. In 2015, Kush and Teddy founded The Black Label. In February 2019, he left YGE and The Black Label to form his own independent label.
Kwang Ho is a member of the South Korean vocal group Voisper. He and his high school friends auditioned on the 6th season of Superstar K under the name "North Incheon Nineteen."
Lee Kwang Hyun is a South Korean trainee who appeared in survival shows such as "Boys24" and "Produce 101 Season 2." In 2018 he debuted as a member of the one-time project boy group YDPP.
Kwanghaeng was an orignial male member of Co-ed School. In March 2018, he debuted in the band Le Ciel.

Kwanghee is a South Korean singer, actor, and MC under Bonboo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ZE:A and their subunit ZE:A 4U. In 2012 he participated in the show “We Got Married,” where he was paired with SECRET’s Sunhwa. On February 7, 2017, Kwanghee joined Bonboo Entertainment. In January 2022, he renewed his contract with the company. Kwanghee has been the fixed MC of “Weekly Idol” since January 9, 2019.
Kwangji is a South Korean rapper. He participated on the survival show "NO.MERCY" but was ultimately eliminated in round 2.

Kwon Kwangjin is the former member and bassist of N.Flying, and former bassist of CNBLUE. Kwangjin was a member of CNBLUE who played bass for the band during their Japanese debut days, being featured in the group's Japanese debut mini album "Now or Never". However, he left the band in September 2009, prior to their Korean debut, and was replaced by Lee Jungshin as the new bassist. Afterwards, he trained under FNC Entertainment and eventually debuted as the bassist and vocalist of N.Flying during the group's Japanese debut with the single "Basket" in October 2013 and during their Korean debut with the mini-album Awesome in May 2015. On December 19, 2018, Kwangjin went on a hiatus due to allegations of inappropriate behavior towards fans. However, on December 26, 2018, the group's company released a statement announcing that he would be leaving the group.
Kwangmin is a South Korean rapper. He is popularly known as a member of the boy group BF (formerly Boyfriend) and one of the Jo Twins.
Kim Kwangsoo is a South Korean singer and actor. He made his official debut in 2007 as a member of the boy group Supernova.
Kwon E Rob is a South Korean trainee. He is a former member of the boy group MEGAMAX. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Kwon Gyu Hyung is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Kwon Hyeong Seok is a South Korean actor and singer. He is a contestant on Wild Idol.

Kwon Hyeop is a South Korean singer under HOWLING Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WAKER, which made its official debut on January 8, 2024, with the mini album “Mission of School”. He rose to fame as a contestant on Produce 101 Season 2 in 2017, representing Maroo Entertainment. Despite being eliminated in the fifth episode finishing in 65th place. He also gained attention for his resemblance to BTS V.

Kwon Jung-yeol is a South Korean singer and songwriter signed to Magic Strawberry Sound. He is best known as a member of the duo 10cm, which debuted in 2010. Initially a two-member group, Kwon Jung-yeol continued as a one-man band after the departure of Yoon Cheol-jong in 2017, maintaining the stage name 10cm. In June 2014, Kwon Jung-yeol married Kim Yoon Ju, a member of OKDAL, with the news confirmed by their agency. Kwon’s career gained significant momentum with the release of popular songs such as "Tell Me It's Not a Dream" and "Spring Snow." Both tracks became widely recognized after being featured as OSTs for the highly rated 2024 dramas "Queen of Tears" and "Lovely Runner," respectively, further establishing his impact in the music industry.
Kwon Ohkyung is South Korean bassist. He is a member of the duo Echae en Route. He’s a member of The Solutions since 2014.
Kwon Sehyuk is a South Korean musician signed with Antenna. He is the guitarist for the boy band DRAGONPONY.
Kwon Soon Il is a South Korean singer and member of co-ed group Urban Zakapa

Kwon Taeeun is a South Korean singer and model under A.CONIC. He is a member of the boy group WOW and pre-debut project band A.FACT. In 2019, Taeeun participated in Mnet's reality show Produce X 101. Unfortunately, in the eighth episode, he was eliminated and ranked 34th place. On October 23, he was introduced as a member of the pre-debut project band A.FACT. On September 22, 2020, he was revealed to be a part of A.CONIC's seven-member boy group WOW.
Kwon Yangwoo is a South Korean trainee under KPLUS. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Lee Gyehun, known under his stage name Kyehoon, is a South Korean singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as the oldest member and leader of the boy group KickFlip. In 2016, he participated in JYP Entertainment's 12th Open Audition where he finished 1st place, thus automatically becoming a trainee in the company. He later participated in the 2021 survival show Loud, where he finished first place in the final episode, making him an official member of JYP Entertainment's upcoming boy group.

Kyungha is a South Korean former singer and former member of boy group TST. In May 2018, Kyungha was sentenced to 18 months in prison and three years of probation after confessing to sexual harassment charges from 2014. On May 11, it was announced that he had left the group.
Yoon Kyeong Heon is the main vocalist of the South Korean boy group We in the Zone under Choon Entertainment. Aside from singing, he is also talented in drawing and painting.
Kyle is an Indonesian singer under NEWWAYS COMPANY. Best known for being the maknae of the boy group ASC2NT, he made his debut on May 7, 2024 with the group's 1st single album "Expecting Tomorrow"

Kyle is a South Korean singer under CT Entertainment. He is the main vocalist of ROMEO. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show MIXNINE and Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor.
Kyler is a Filipino idol member of the global pop group, HORI7ON. He secured his spot in the group after ranking third in the survival show, Dream Maker.
Kyo is a singer under S.I.E.T.E Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming group Pattern.

Kyojun is a Taiwanese singer under TEN Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SEVENTOEIGHT, whom he debuted with on July 28, 2025. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Kyosuke is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He placed first on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the upcoming boy group aoen. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group 24kumi.
Fujimaka Kyosuke was born on August 10th, 1999, in Nagono, Japan. He is the main vocalist in INI. Fujimaka Kyosuke debuted as a member of INI on November 3rd, 2021 with the single "A".
Kyoungkeun is a member of the South Korean boy group Fallanc.

Kang Kyoung-yoon is a South Korean musician under IST Entertainment. He is best known as the drummer of the rock band BANDAGE. On January 6, 2023, IST Entertainment released a statement announcing the termination of the contract between the members and the company.

Kyoungyoon, also known as Yoon, is a South Korean singer and lyricist under DONGYO Entertainment. He debuted as the main vocalist of DKZ (formerly DONGKIZ) with their single DONGKIZ on the Block on April 24, 2019. On April 20, 2023, it was announced that Kyoungyoon would take a hiatus due to anxiety and sociophobia. On August 7th, 2023, after four months of hiatus, he officially left the group.
Kyrell is an American K-pop idol under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group AMPERS&ONE and made his official debut on November 15th of 2023.

Kyu (formerly Daniel) is a South Korean-American singer under NAISU Agency. He debuted as a soloist on March 26, 2025, with the single "Tempo." Before his debut, he trained under PLEDIS Entertainment and gained recognition as a contestant on the survival show I-LAND. He initially debuted under the name Daniel with the digital single "ISOLATED" on June 22, 2024, before rebranding as Kyu in 2025.
Kyuhyuk is one of the main vocals in H.B.Y. He was previously in disbanded groups Blast and Underdog. He is the gag person of the group and used to be a backup dancer for BTS during concert tours.

Cho Kyu Hyun is the main vocalist and maknae of the boy group Super Junior and its sub-units Super Junior K.R.Y and Super Junior-M under Label SJ, a subsidiary of SM Entertainment. He debuted as a solo artist in 2014 with his album "At Gwanghwamun".
Kyuhyung is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musical actor under Palmtree Island. He is the leader of the boy group CREZL.

Kyul is a member of the upcoming boy group IB147, they have 2 pre-debut releases out and are currently promoting in Japan, their official debut date is unknown. He has top-notch vocal skills and has a nice high-pitched vocal. Although he is good at rapping, he is said to not rap during IB147's songs for positioning reasons. On August 4th, 2024, a Twitter account for the upcoming group L5ST was opened, revealing 4 of 5 members being former IB147 members and one being a former Daychild member. Kyul was one of the members listed.

Cho Kyumin is a South Korean singer and internet personality. He is currently a member of the pre-debut group "Off The Cuff" under Purple Entertainment. He was first known for debuting in the duo and boy group "AlphaBAT". Besides his music releases, Kyumin has also participated in the survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Park Kyung is a South Korean rapper, best known for being a member of the group Block B. Kyung started his rapping career by performing underground along with Zico. He used the name Holke, which means Horse-K. Park Kyung debuted in 2009 with the digital single "The Letter" as duo with Zico Park Kyung became a set member of the cast of tvN’s Problematic Men, after temporarily replacing regular cast member BTS RM's spot. During the October 23 episode of the show, he was accepted by Mensa International, a non-profit organization open only to those who score within the top two percent of a standardized intelligence test. He had a IQ of 156.
Kyung Joon is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the reality show World Klass.
Kyung Min is a member of the South Korean duo WeAreYoung. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening.

Jang Kyungho is the main dancer and sub-vocalist of the boy group TO1 under WAKEONE. He appeared in the show "World Klass" where he ranked 4th place, earning him a spot in the group. Kyungho debuted as a member of TO1 on April 1, 2020, with their first mini album Reason for Being : Benevolence. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Min Kyung Hoon is a South Korean singer and entertainer under Long Play Music, he is best known for being the Main Vocalist, Face and Maknae of the rock-ballad band BUZZ, along with being a member of the rock-ballad duo Universe Cowards with SUPER JUNIOR's Kim Heechul. BUZZ gained extreme popularity since debut, while promoting their 3rd album "Perfect", Kyunghoon had made a lyrical mistake in a performance of the hit song "You Don't Know Men", which earned him the name "Ssamja" (The lyrical mistake he made). In May of 2007, BUZZ began a temporary disbandment, as all members excluding Kyunghoon had started to begin their mandatory military service. During this time Kyunghoon went on to make his solo debut on December 5, 2007, with the album "Im.pres.sive". Due to the negative reception of Kyunghoon's solo debut album and single, he had found himself in a slump, battling extreme depression and alcoholism. In April of 2014, BUZZ had announced their return and were no longer disbanded. The following year, Kyunghoon had joined the JTBC variety show "Knowing Brothers", this along with him making music with BUZZ again had gained him immense popularity and became a fan favourite on the show. In autumn of 2016, Kyunghoon and SUPER JUNIOR's Kim Heechul released a duet as Universe Cowards, named "Sweet Dream". The song was extremely successful, topping the South Korean Gaon Digital Charts, earning themselves an all-kill.
Kyungjin is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group LU:KUS.

Woo Kyung Joon, better known as Kyungjun, is a South Korean singer and dancer under P Nation. He is a member of the boy group TNX. Through the SBS survival program "Loud," he qualified and was recruited to become a member of the boy group TNX. He made his official debut with the group on May 17, 2022. On October 23, it was announced that Kyung Jun had decided to enlist in the military and leave the group upon completing his military service, thereby terminating his contract with the company.

Jo Kyungmin is a South Korean singer under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023. Kyungmin was first known for being a participant in the survival show "I-LAND" and a former pre-debut member of &TEAM.

Kyungmin is a South Korean singer and a member of the boy group TWS under Pledis Entertainment. He debuted with the group on January 22, 2024, with the release of their first mini album, "Sparkling Blue."

Lim Kyoung Mun, better known as Kyungmun, is a South Korean singer and dancer under Brand New Music. He was first known for appearing in the boy group survival program "Loud" where he represented JYP Entertainment. In February 2022, it was announced that he transfered to Brand New Music and is now a member of the boy group YOUNITE.
Kyusung is a South Korean singer under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. he joined the group in December 2020.

Kyuu is a hip-hop artist from South Korea who made his debut in February 2018 with the single "Come Over." He continued to build his career with tracks like "Come Over" and "I Need Selfish Time." Later that year, Kyuu released his first EP, ROMANCEISCOMMON, an introspective project capturing fleeting, memorable moments. Following this, he introduced his second EP, CHILLINGISRARE, and, in 2020, his first full-length album, ALLFORNOTHING. Around this time, he transitioned his stage name from Nunsseop to kyuu, marking a new phase in his artistic journey.

Kim Myung Soo, better known by the stage name L, is a South Korean singer and actor under Look Media and Infinite Company. He is best known as the lead vocalist and visual of the boy group INFINITE. He debuted with INFINITE in 2010 and later expanded his career into acting, appearing in several dramas. In 2019, he left Woollim Entertainment and joined Management 2sang shortly after in 2020. He made his solo debut in 2021 with the single album 'Memory'. After leaving Management 2sang in 2023, he signed with Look Media. L's Japanese debut came in November 2023 with the single 'Moments'. In 2024, he announced the release of his first EP, '24/7'. Myungsoo also completed his mandatory military service in 2022, where he was involved in a military musical.

Vincent Josh Labing-isa, better known by the stage name L, is a Filipino idol under MLD Entertainment. He's known for participating in Dream Maker, but was eliminated. He and 4 other contestents who were eliminated in the finale signed with MLD Entertainment and formed New:ID.
L:ambda is a South Korean singer under APB Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group AlphaBAT.He officially made his debut with them on October 8, 2018 with digital single album "New World".

L.IP, born Shin Wonho, is a South Korean singer and actor under Amuse Korea. He first gained recognition as the leader, main vocalist, and visual of the boy group CROSS GENE, making his official debut in 2012. In addition to his music career, L.IP has appeared in several television dramas, including Big (2012) and The Legend of the Blue Sea (2016), establishing himself as both an idol and an actor. In August 2025, Shin re-introduced himself under the stage name L.IP, making his re-debut as the vocalist and frontman of the band LIPSTICKERZ with their first full album VESSEL and lead single “Back To You.”
La-e is a vocalist and the maknae in the boy group VX.
Lai Lai is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows Produce Camp 2021 and SCOOL.
Lake is a South Korean singer under Na Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DUSTIN, having joined on February 17, 2022.

Shin Kyuhyun, also known as Laon, is the Leader and Lead Vocalist of the boy group ENOi under Kithewhale Entertainment. Laon is first known as a member of the boy group Boys24. It was said that Laon was also responsible for creating the group as he was the one who recruited all of the members and planned their events. As of March 29, 2023, Laon and former ENOi member Hamin debuted together in the band Monkey Shoulder.

Laun, born Kim Minseok, is a former member of boy group ONF under WM Entertainment. He trained under BigHit Entertainment until the age of 14 along with the members of BTS. After joining WM, he trained 4 years before debuting. He served as the main dancer, sub vocalist, and maknae. Aside from those, he was also the only member of the "N" Team, meaning he could be a part of both "On" and "Off" Teams. WM Entertainment announced, on August 23, 2019, the departure of Laun from ONF due to personal reasons.

Laurence is a Taiwanese-South Korean singer under n.CH Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group n.SSign on August 9, 2023. Prior to debuting, Laurence participated in the 2022 survival show Stars Awakening, but was eliminated in episode 11. However, in July 2023, n.CH Entertainment announced that n.SSign would reorganize as a permanent boy group with the addition of 3 new members. Laurence was then announced as the second new member shortly after.

Zhang Yixing, known professionally as Lay Zhang or simply Lay, is a Chinese singer, songwriter, record producer, dancer, and actor. He is best known as a member of the boy group EXO and its Chinese sub-unit, EXO-M. Lay officially made his Chinese solo debut on October 7, 2016, with the single "What You Need?", followed by the release of his first EP, Lose Control, on October 28, 2016. On April 8, 2022, Lay announced through his social media accounts that he had left SM Entertainment but would continue to remain a member of EXO.

Wang Zi Hao, known by the stage name LE'V, is a Chinese singer under Chromosome Entertainment. He made his solo debut on August 18, 2023, with the EP "A.I.BAE". He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show “Boys Planet” where he finished in 19th place.
Lee Chan Hee is a South Korean trainee. He gained fame as a participant in the survival show Fan Pick.
Lee Chan Won is a South Korean trot singer who rose to fame after appearing in the show "Mr. Trot"". He made his debut on August 25, 2021 with the digital single, "Convinience Store".
Lee Changhyun is a former member of the band THETHE. He was a Bassist in the group but he left in 2008.

Lee Da Eul is a South Korean singer under ES Nation. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show, "Boys Planet."
Lee Daeyoung, formerly known as Hwalchan, is a South Korean singer under 4824 Company. He is a former member of the boy group GreatGuys.
Lee Deul is a South Korean trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Lee Deungdae, also known as Sang-min, is a South Korean musician. He is the Leader, Vocalist, Guitarist, and Maknae of the rock band Redoor.
Lee Do Ha is a South Korean trainee. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 8.

Lee Dokyeong is a South Korean trainee and actor. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. In the 5th episode of the show, he was eliminated after ranking 96th place.
Lee Dong Hwi is a South Korean actor and singer. He is a member of MSG Wannabe.

Lee Min-ho is a prominent South Korean actor, singer, and model, under MYM Entertainment. He gained widespread recognition for his role as Gu Jun-pyo in the 2009 drama Boys Over Flowers, which earned him the Best New Actor – Television award at the 45th Baeksang Arts Awards. He has starred in several acclaimed television series, including City Hunter (2011), The Heirs (2013), The Legend of the Blue Sea (2016), and The King: Eternal Monarch (2020). His film credits include Gangnam Blues (2015) and Bounty Hunters (2016). In 2022, he took on a leading role in the Apple TV+ series Pachinko, based on the novel by Min Jin Lee. Lee's success in television has solidified his status as a leading Hallyu star, making him one of the most followed South Korean actors on social media. He was the first Korean celebrity to have wax figures displayed at Madame Tussauds, with unveilings in Shanghai in 2013 and Hong Kong in 2014. He began acting in his second year of high school and signed with Starhaus Entertainment in his senior year. Initially, he used the stage name "Lee Min," but later reverted to his real name due to difficulties in online searches. In August 2006, Lee's career was interrupted by a serious car accident that resulted in the loss of two friends. He suffered severe injuries, including broken ribs and a fractured thigh. After several days in a coma and extensive treatment, he made a full recovery and returned to acting in 2007 with the lead role in Mackerel Run. Lee made his singing debut on May 22, 2013, with the release of his album "My Everything". Through his talent and resilience, Lee Min-ho has become a beloved figure in the global entertainment industry, showcasing his versatility across various media.

Loudi debuted as a member of the boy group 14U on July 22, 2017, with the single album "VVV." He remained part of the group until their disbandment on May 13, 2019. On August 26, 2020, Bleu (formerly Loudi) was revealed as the first member of an unnamed boy group under JN Entertainment, set to debut in 2021. Around this time, he announced on Instagram his decision to change his stage name from Loudi to Bleu. However, on August 6, 2021, Bleu confirmed his departure from JN Entertainment and signed with Aimers Entertainment. He reverted to his original stage name, Loudi, and began focusing on his solo career. On July 2, 2024, Loudi teased a new project with a video hinting at a July release. Shortly after, on July 15, he was officially announced as an artist under AllBlue Records. As anticipation grew, Loudi released a second teaser on July 12, hinting at a July 22 launch. On July 20, he unveiled the music video teaser for his single "Obsession."
Louie, born Chae Kang-min is a South Korean rapper who debuted under G.M.S.P as a member of Homies in 2019.
Hwang Moonseop, better known as Louie, is a South Korean rapper and TV personality. He made his official debut in 2011 as a member of Geeks. In 2013, he eventually debuted as a soloist.
Seonghoon is a South Korean trainee under Biscuit Entertainment. He is set to debut as a member of the boy group HAWW on February 23, 2023.
Louis is a South Korean singer and rapper under DS Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DV.OL and a former member of the boy group BLANK2Y and of project boy group 1THE9.

Yang Dong-sik, also known as Louis, is a South Korean singer under GF Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group The KingDom. Within the group, he represents the Kingdom of Aesthetic. Louis debuted as a member of KINGDOM on February 18, 2021, with History of Kingdom Pt.1 Arthur and the title track of "Excalibur".
Louiszzan is the leader of the Virtual boy group Psychord. His birthday is on December 9, of a unknown year.

Park Jisung, popularly known as "Love", was the former leader and vocalist of the boy group OnlyOneOf under 8D Entertainment. He officially debuted as a member of OnlyOneOf with the release of their first mini album 'Dot Point Jump' on May 28, 2019. On August 2, 2021, the company then announced that Love will be leaving the group due to personal reasons. He is also known for his appearance on ViVi's ( Loossemble ) "Everyday I Love You" MV on 2017.

Loren, also known as DJ Boid, is a singer and producer under THEBLACKLABEL and releases music through his own indie label, Fire Exit Records. He made his official debut with the digital single "Empty Trash" on November 13, 2020. He is the founder of FIRE EXIT RECØRDS. Loren was first known for being a producer for YG Entertainment artists and for appearing in BLACKPINK's "Lovesick Girls" music video. In March 2023, he joined the recording label 88rising. Together with THEBLACKLABEL, he plans to release his music through this partnership.
Lua is a South Korean singer under HnA Entertainment, member of the boy group IB147. He was revealed as a new member on November 1, 2023.

Lucas is a Chinese-Thai singer and rapper under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the supergroup SuperM and a former member of NCT and It's sub-units NCT U and WayV. He was also one-half of WayV's pre-debut subunit duo WayV-LUCAS&HENDERY. He made his solo debut with the single album "Renegade" on April 1st, 2024. In 2015, he was cast into SM Entertainment through SM’s Global Audition in Hong Kong. On April 5, 2017, he was introduced as a member of SM's pre-debut training team, SMROOKIES, and in the same month, he appeared in NCT member Ten’s "Dream In A Dream" music video. In January 2018, Him alongside Kun, and Jungwoo were announced to become NCT member, through the NCT 2018 Yearbook. On February 18, 2018, he officially debuted as a member of NCT, in the unit NCT U, with the song "Boss". On March 14, 2018, he took in the NCT's first studio album 'NCT 2018 Empathy'. On December 31, 2018, it was revealed that he was a member of NCT's Chinese sub-unit, WayV which debuted on January 17, 2019, with the digital EP, 'The Vision'. On August 8, 2019, it was announced that Lucas would be a member of the supergroup SuperM. They released their self-titled debut mini-album on October 4, 2019. On November 18, 2019, they released the promotional single "Let's Go Everywhere". On May 10, 2023, SM Entertainment announced that Lucas would leave NCT and WayV and would begin his solo activities.

Lue Younghoon, also known simply as Younghoon, is a South Korean singer and former member of the boy groups Seven O’Clock, Black Level, and the pre-debut group VI'ENX. He first debuted under the stage name 2Soul in 2017 as a member of Seven O’Clock with their mini album Butterfly Effect. During his time with the group, he participated in the survival show MIXNINE, though he was not selected as an official contestant. After Seven O’Clock disbanded in 2021, he re-debuted with Black Level in 2022 with the mini album New-Start, but left the group later that year. In 2023, he joined VI'ENX, though he appeared to have left the group by April 2024. In September 2024, Younghoon competed in the survival show Project 7, where he was officially introduced as a contestant. However, he was eliminated in episode 8 after ranking 53rd. Following his time on the show, he announced his solo debut under the name Lue Younghoon, releasing his first single album "Untold Story" on February 12, 2025.
Luha is a member of 14U. He is the leader of their sub-unit "Lucky".

Luhan is a Chinese singer and actor. He is a former member of the boy group EXO and their subgroup EXO-M. He was a main vocalist and dancer. He left the group and agency after filing a lawsuit to terminate his contract in October 2014 which led him to leaving the group with fellow member Kris who left a few months earlier. Since leaving, he has been active in Mandopop/C-pop under Rock Forward Entertainment, releasing his first solo song "That Good Good". He was also a cast member of Running Man China until 2019.
Luhwa is a singer and dancer under Megameta. She is part of the virtual group IXIA as a composer and main dancer.
Luke is a South Korean trainee under PCS Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DIGNITY.

Lee Seung Hyun, better known as Lumin, is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group F.CUZ and former member of boy group M.pire. While he originally left F.CUZ in 2011, he officially rejoined the group in 2023.
Lumin is a South Korean singer under TM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EASTSHINE.

Lune is a South Korean singer under Brave Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DKB. Lune was introduced as a member of DKB on November 5, 2019. He officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020 with the mini album Youth. On July 30, 2024 it was announced that Lune would be going on hiatus due to poor health and anxiety, and would not participate in further album promotions or the group's upcoming world tour.
Luo, formerly known as Moonbong, is a South Korean singer under PCS Entertainment. He is the leader of the upcoming boy group DIGNITY and a former member of the boy groups MASC and JN boy group.
Luo Jun Wei is a Chinese trainee under The Line Star Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival shows The Coming One 2 and Starlight Boys.

Luo Zhuo Bin, formerly known as Lizi, is a Chinese trainee under CHUYING. He is best known for being a contestant on the Thai reality survival show Chuang Asia 2 and the Korean survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Choi Gyeong Seok, better known by his stage name Lutan, is a singer under Wuzo Entertainment. In May 2021, he made his official debut as a member of the boy group Blitzers.

Lucin is a singer and dancer under SCON Ent. His birth year is unknown, but it is known that it was December 15th. He debuted on August 22, 2024, with the group AFOTS. Although he no longer performs group activities, he is still active in live broadcasts.

LXX, born Alexander Kim, is a South Korean-American rapper and former member of the boy group HIGH4 and its sub-unit HIGH4 20. He debuted as a solo artist on November 22, 2020, with the single "Black" under 28 LABORATORY.
Lyle, formerly known as Changhyun in the group TREI, is a singer, rapper, and songwriter from the co-ed band Re:Hearts.
Lynn is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows SCOOL and Boys II Planet.
Lynn Lynn, also known as Zhao Guang Xu, is a Chinese trainee under IX Entertainment. He is best known for competing in the survival shows PROJECT7, where he ranked 20th, and Boys II Planet.

Lyson is a South Korean singer and songwriter under Crepe Sound. He first made his official debut as a member of the boy group SIGNAL on August 28, 2019. Following the group's disbandment on June 2021, he changed his stage name to Lyson in preperation for his solo activities.

M is a Taiwanese singer and dancer under TEN Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SEVENTOEIGHT, whom he debuted with on July 28, 2025. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Mingun is a South Korean singer. He is the leader of Xst and the former leader of Herycle.
M.Joon, formerly known as Hanjun, is a South Korean singer. He originally debuted as a member of the boy group TOUCH but left in 2011. He made his solo debut in 2015 under the stage name M.Joon.
M1nu, born Kim Min-woo, is a South Korean rapper under The Eye Entertainment.
Ma Daehyeop is a singer and dancer under Oort Entertainment. He is a member of the virtual group Sphaze. He was the first to be revealed and the last to do a live broadcast, dated July 26, 2024.

Ma Jing Xiang is a Chinese singer and member of the project boy group CLOSE YOUR EYES under UNCORE. He made his official debut on April 2, 2025 with the group's mini album "Eternalt". Prior to debuting, he participated in Boys Planet (2022–2023), where he was selected as one of the 'Shiny Boys' by other trainees and ranked 30th before being eliminated in episode 8. In 2024, he competed in JTBC's PROJECT7, placing 1st and debuting as a member of CLOSE YOUR EYES. Besides his survival show activities, he was a former member of the pre-debut Chinese group Midsummer Cubs.
Ma Tao is a Chinese trainee under Liangcheng Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Mamehara Issei, more commonly known as Mame, is a Japanese singer, dancer, and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Mar Vista is a South Korean DJ, composer and producer signed with ScreaM Records. He used to be part of the duo Kolour FM. He released his first solo digital single "Cor 98" on April 3, 2020.

Lee Hyung-Geun, also known as Marco, is a South Korean rapper, singer, model, and actor under Humap Contents. He is best known for being a member of the now-disbanded project boy group UNB. He also used to be a member of the group H.B.Y.

Marcus is a Filipino idol member of the global pop group, HORI7ON. He secured his spot in the group after ranking second in the survival show, Dream Maker. Marcus made his film debut in the Philippines with “My 2 Mommies” in 2018. Following that, he joined “Team Yey!” and was part of an Asian touring company for the musical “The Lion King.” He was affiliated with ABS-CBN. He is cousins with Elisia of UNIS.
Marine s a member of boy group 5TION and FL1X.

Mark Lee is a Korean-Canadian artist under SM Entertainment. He is best known for being the main rapper and vocalist of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT U, NCT 127, and NCT Dream. Born in Canada, Mark was able to audition for SM Entertainment through the 'SM Global Audition' in Vancouver and became a trainee of the agency for four years before finally debuting as a member of NCT. On August 24, 2016, Mark debuted as a member of the sub-unit NCT Dream. However, in December 2018, Mark graduated from the group due to its rotational system based on age. In March of 2021, SM Entertainment surprised fans when they confirmed that Mark would officially return to NCT Dream, making it a fixed sub-unit with the seven original members. In 2022, Mark eventually began to release his solo songs through SM Station's NCT Lab, such as "Child" and "Golden Hour." After releasing several digital singles, Mark had his official solo debut on April 7, 2025. He debuted with his first full-length album, The Firstfruit.

Mark Tuan (born Tuan Yi-Eun) is an American singer and rapper of Taiwanese descent. He is best known as a member of the boy group GOT7, which debuted under JYP Entertainment on January 16, 2014, with the single "Girls Girls Girls." Before his debut, he trained under JYP after moving to South Korea in 2010. Following the expiration of his contract in 2021, Mark and his bandmates left JYP Entertainment to pursue solo and group activities. He has since continued his music career under the stage name Mark Tuan, releasing new music independently. In the same year, he established a studio in Beijing, China, to focus on solo promotions. Mark officially debuted as a soloist in January 2020 with the digital single "Outta My Head" and later collaborated with Sanjoy Deb on "One in a Million" (February 12, 2021). On April 29, 2021, he signed with Creative Artists Agency to expand his career globally.
Martin is a Korean-Canadian singer and songwriter under BIGHIT MUSIC. He made his debut as a member of the boy group CORTIS on August 18, 2025.

Maru, formely known as Z.One, is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed group DIP.MX. He was the newest member of the group, and the only one from the original line up who didn’t leave the group in November 2018.
Marvel J is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2014.
Masami is a Japanese singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.
Masato is a Japanese trainee under iNKODE Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Kimura Masaya was born on October 10th, 1997, in Aichi, Japan. He is the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and leader of INI. He made his debut in INI on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A". His final rank on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2) was 1st.

Mashiho is a Japanese singer and former member of the boy group TREASURE. He made his solo debut on June 26, 2024, with the digital single "Just the 2 of Us". In 2018, he participated in YG Entertainment's survival show YG Treasure Box, initially not being selected for the main group, he was later included in a second group called MAGNUM, which was meant to debut alongside TREASURE 13 before being delayed due to scandals surrounding the agency. On January 6, 2020, YG Entertainment re-organized the groups into a 12-member TREASURE. Mashiho officially debuted with TREASURE on August 7, 2020. He left the group and terminated his contract on November 8, 2022.
Mavin is an Indonesian dancer under Zenith Media Contents. He is the Leader of the international boy group Z-Boys and part of the co-ed group Z-Stars.

Max Changmin also known as Choikang Changmin is a South Korean singer, actor, and lyricist under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the male duo TVXQ! and the project ballad group S.M. THE BALLAD. He released his first Japanese solo debut mini album, "Close To You", on November 18, 2015 and made his Korean solo debut on April 6, 2020 with the mini album "Chocolate".
Shin Dong-hyun, popularly known as MC MONG, is a South Korean Singer, Rapper, Record Producer, and TV Personality. He is considered one of the most popular hip-hop artists of Korea.

Kim Jin-ho, better known as Meloh, is a South Korean singer-rapper. He began his career on Sound Cloud in 2017 and debuted as an independent artist in 2019. He also participated in AOMG’s hip-hop audition show SignHere which was broadcasted in 2019.
Lee Whoiwon is the keyboardist, guitarist of the the South Korean band ourR.

Lee Mi-dam is a South Korean trainee under AAP.Y Entertainment. He was first known for competing on YG Treasure Box and Produce X 101.
Midori is a Japanese trainee. He was a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 9.

Mika, also known as MikaL, is a South Korean singer and musical theatre actor. He is a former member of the groups Singing In The Rain (2008), Xing (2008-2009), and the former leader and main vocalist of the group DGNA and its subunit Popsicle. He departed from DGNA in 2018. As of 2023 he has been active in Japan.
Jo Myungik popularly known as Mikey, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter. He is the maknae of the legendary hip-hop group Turbo.
Mikey Romeo is a German rapper and producer who was added briefly to the Roo'ra lineup for their 5th album in 1997. Not much is known about his personal life.
Lee Yongsoo, better know as Mill, is a South Korean rapper under 8D Entertainment. He debuted as a member of OnlyOneOf on May 28, 2019 with the mini album "Dot point jump'.
Millham is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2020.
Millic is a South Korean producer under HIGHGRND. He debuted in July 2017 with the album “Vida” and the title track “Paradise”.
Milly is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the boy group Be.A, formerly known K-MUCH.
Milo is a South Korean singer who debuted as a member of the boy group Romeo in 2015.

Min is a vocalist in J2KC. He was added during the second round of promotions during their Showboxing events in Japan.

Minchan debuted as a member of VERIVERY on January 9, 2019, with their debut mini-album Veri-Us. Mingi is a South Korean rapper, dancer, singer, songwriter, producer, and composer under KQ Entertainment. Mingkai is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment and a member of the upcoming boy group AM8IC. He is also known for competing on the survival show Starlight Boys. Mingyu is a South Korean singer under Top Cloud Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Like A Movie and was a member of the boy group N2.

Mingyu is a South Korean singer under Dongyo Entertainment. He is a member of the group DKZ and its sub-unit NINE to SIX. Kim Mingyu is a South Korean rapper, dancer, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the lead rapper, sub vocalist, visual, and face of the boy group SEVENTEEN. Lee Minho is a South Korean rapper under MYstar Entertainment and MY Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group MY.st.

Choi Minho is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SHINee. He officially debuted with SHINee on May 22, 2008 with the group's first mini album "Replay". Minho later made his solo debut with the single, "I'm Home", on March 28, 2019.

Choi Min Hwan is a South Korean musician and actor under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the boy band FTISLAND and its sub unit FT.triple. He was married to Laboum's Yulhee from 2018-2023 and they have Three kids, two whom are twin girls.

Minhwi is a South Korean bassist, member of the co-ed group DongyangGozupa. He was added to the band on June 30, 2020. He’s also a member of Theatre8. They debuted in 2008 with the single album "Welcome To The Show".

Wang Min-hyuk is a South Korean singer. He was a member of pre-debut group NPI and boy group BAIKAL. He made his group debut in 2015 and eventually made his solo debut on October 2019 with the digital single "The Moment We First Met". Lee Minhyuk, also known as Huta, is a South Korean rapper, singer, and actor under BTOB Company. Minhyuk is best known as the lead rapper, lead dancer, vocalist, and visual of the boy group BTOB. Minhyuk debuted as a member of BTOB on March 21, 2012 with the digital single "Insane". In 2018, he debuted as a soloist in Japan through his first EP Summer Diary. He was eventually discharged on December 9, 2020.

Minhyuk is a South Korean rapper under All-S Company. He is a member of MAP6 and was a member of the boy group A-PRINCE.
Kim Minhyuk is a South Korean idol trainee under C-JeS Entertainment. He is a member of the agency's trainee group, introduced in November 2021. He was a contestant on the survival show Boys Planet.
Minhyuk is a South Korean singer signed with WEUS Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WEUS.

Lee Minhyuk is a South Korean singer and actor under Starship Entertainment. He is best known as the visual and vocalist of the boy group Monsta X. Minhyuk is considered as the moodmaker of the group since his jokes tend to brighten the mood. Minhyuk debuted as a member of MONSTA X on May 14, 2015 with their first mini-album "Trespass". Minhyuk was an MC for “Inkygayo”. (October 20, 2019 – February 28, 2021)
Min Hyuk is a South Korean rapper under Ai Grand Korea. He was a member of the boy group D-CRUNCH.
Minhyung is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the reality survival show &AUDITION - The Howling -.

Minjae is a South Korean singer signed with Wannabe Entertainment. He is part of the pre-debut boy group VVS. On August 19, 2023, his individual concept photos were released through the group’s official SNS.
Minjae, born Baek Minjae, is a member of the boy group DXMON under SSQ ENTERTAINMENT on January 17, 2024.

Song Minjae is a South Korean singer under TOP Media. He made his official debut in 2020 as the main vocalist of the boy group MCND. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Minjae is a South Korean rapper under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the leader and main rapper of the boy group xikers.

Choi Minje is a South Korean singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of boy group KickFlip. In January 5, 2025, Minje was revealed as the 5th member of KickFlip. He officially debuted with the group's first single album "Umm Great".
Minje is a South Korean singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.
Lee Minjong, or simply Minjong, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He is best known for being a member of the boy group XENEX.

Kim Min Jun is a South Korean singer under FirstOne Entertainment. He first appeared in the survival show Wild Idol. After the show, he continued to train until he eventually made his debut in 2022 as a member of the boy group NINE.I.
Minkee is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group N.SONIC.
Jeon Minki, formery known as Uiyeon, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He was the lead rapper and visual of the boy group GreatGuys.

Kim Minkyu is a South Korean singer, actor, MC, and idol trainee under Jellyfish Entertainment. He rose to fame after competing in the hit survival program "Produce X 101" where he finished in the 12th rank. Despite not being able to debut, the program paved the way for him to land opportunities such as being an MC for SBS MTV's "The Show" and even acting on dramas such as "Idol: The Coup" and "Pop Out Boy."

MK was born in Anyang, South Korea. He is a member of the boy group ONF under WM Entertainment. He used to be a Starship trainee and appeared on the survival show No.Mercy. He trained for a total of 7 years before debuting. He is part of the ON Team. On June 20, MK finished his Military Service. On January 1, 2024 WM Entertainment announced thay MK would be changing to his real name as his stage name.

Song Min-ho, better known by the stage name Mino, is a South Korean rapper and TV personality from YG Entertainment. He rose to fame as a member of the highly-successful group "Winner". In November 2018, Mino made his official solo debut with the studio album "XX". In September 2016, Mino and labelmate Bobby of iKON was formed as the project sub-unit, MOBB. Together, they released a four-track single album titled The Mobb, with the double A-side singles, "Full House" and "Hit Me" on September 9. Besides rapping and performing on stage, Mino is also known for appearing in countless TV shows. He is currently a fixed cast member in the hit variety show "New Journey to the West" and "Kang's Kitchen".

Minpyo is a South Korean rapper. He was the main rapper of the boy group B.I.G. On March 31, 2021, it was announced that Minpyo had decided not to renew his contract with the company and had left B.I.G.

Kim Min Seo is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 28, 2020 as a member of the boy group DRIPPIN. When he was a trainee, Minseo participated in the hit reality show Produce X 101 where he finished 52nd place.

Minseo, also known by his full name Kim Min Seo, is a South Korean singer and trainee under J-Star Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist of the boy group N.TOP, and first gained public attention through his participation in the survival shows Produce X 101 and LOUD, where he represented Urban Works Entertainment. Despite early eliminations, he continued to pursue his idol career and was later introduced as a member of N.TOP. He officially debuted with the group through their single album "We:Disconnect," showcasing his growth as both a performer and vocalist.
Minseok is a South Korean trainee under PCS Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DIGNITY.
Park Minseok is an actor, singer, and a member of the boy group, NEWBEAT under BEAT INTERACTIVE. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show, "Boys Planet."

Kim Minsu is a South Korean singer and dancer. He made his official debut in 2013 as a member of the boy group Boys Republic. Following the group's indefinite hiatus, Minsu redebuted as a member of the Korean-Japanese boy group Y&W.

Kim Min Su, formerly known as Minjae, is a South Korean trainee under YM Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group UNNAME. On July 13, 2023, Minjae, alongside Ryu, were revealed as contestant of SM Entertainment's NCT Universe : LASTART.

Kim Min Su is a South Korean singer under WAKEONE. He first appeared in the survival show "WORLD KLASS" where he finished ninth place, allowing him to debut as the lead dancer and sub vocalist of the boy group TO1. Minsu debuted as a member of TO1 on April 1, 2020 with their first mini album Reason for Being : Benevolence. On June 17, 2022, WAKEONE announced that Minsu had left the group but are preparing for a new start.
Minsung is a South Korean singer under Beat Interactive. He is a member of the boy group NEWBEAT.
Minsung is a South Korean singer under CT Entertainment. He is the sub vocal and the visual of ROMEO.

Minsung is a South Korean singer-songwriter under ADVANTAGE. He first debuted as a member of the boy group VARSITY, under the name Kid, on January 5, 2017, with the single "Round One". He was active with the group until their disbandment in April 2020. During his time in the group, Minsung participated in the survival show MIXNINE, where he was eliminated after ranking 48th place. In September 2019, he performed as a member of RION FIVE, though his time in the group was short lived as he already seemed to have left sometime in 2020. Minsung then took part in the pre-debut group Ten-X in 2020, but left before their debut due to personal reasons. He made his solo debut on January 31, 2022, with the release of the single "Tonight".

Minue (also known as; Rose, Icon, No Min-woo) is a South Korean musician and actor under MJ Dreamsys. He originally debuted as the drummer of rock band TRAXX (with the stage name Rose) under SM Entertainment in 2004, but left in 2006 to become a guitarist for band, The Romantist before they disbanded. In 2008, Minwoo began his acting career in the tvN drama 'Detective Mr. Lee' and in 2010, he gained recognition for his supporting roles in the drama series' 'Pasta' and 'My Girlfriend is a Nine-Tailed Fox'. In 2009, he returned to the music scene as the leader of the project group 24/7, along with Lee Jang Woo and Hyun Woo. In 2012, his contract with Core Contents Media (MBK Entertainment) expired, and he made his own company, MJ Dreamsys. In April 2015, No Min Woo filed a lawsuit against his former agency, SM Entertainment, as well as reported the agency to the South Korea Fair Trade Commission. Documents from the lawsuit reveal that No originally signed a 17-year exclusive contract with SM. No sought 100 million KRW for damages resulting from the agency's interference in his career. On July 21, 2016 No lost his damage lawsuit against SM as a result of insufficient evidence and the court ruled out the contract between SM Entertainment and No Min woo as invalid. In June 2018, it was reported that No had lost the appeal in his lawsuit against SM Entertainment due to insufficient evidence to the above stated claims. On May 17, 2020, his newly formed band The Midnight Romance, released their self-titled debut single of the same name which consisted of three songs.

Minwoo was a South Korean singer and actor under TOP Media. He was the leader of the boy group 100%. On March 25, 2018, he passed away from cardiac arrest in his home in Gangnam, Seoul. In 2020, Instagram made updates to its application and brought the function of memorializing accounts of those who passed away, so the account become a place full of good memories from the time when they were alive, and so that the account do not get deleted due to inactivity. Minwoo's account was one of those memorialized.
No Minwoo is a South Korean rapper. He is best known as the lead rapper and maknae of the boy group BF, formerly known as BOYFRIEND.

Ha Min Woo is a South Korean singer under KMG. He is a member of the boy group ZE:A and their subunits ZE:A FIVE and ZE:A J. He was also part of the Japanese project group 3Peace☆Lovers. He made his solo debut on January 8, 2018 with his first mini album The Rosso.
Minwook is a South Korean Singer. He is a member of the boy group Celest1a.
Minyong is a South Korean singer under Biscuit Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group HAWW.
Bang Cheolyong, popularly known as Mir, is a South Korean singer and variety star. He is best known for being the maknae, vocalist, and main rapper of the boy group MBLAQ.

Miraku is a Japanese singer under Nouer Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group NouerA. He is known for being a contestant on the Japanese survival show Nizi Project 2 and the South Korean survival show MAKE MATE 1.

Misonyeon is a South Korean R&B and hip-hop soloist who debuted on February 20, 2020, with the single "I Go," featuring seizetheday. Known for his emotional vocals and heartfelt music, he is signed with ANDME and continues to release captivating tracks. Currently, no personal details about him, such as his real name or background, are publicly available.
Mithra Jin is a South Korean rapper and lyricist. He is a member of the group Epik High under William Morris Endeavor.
Miyata Haru is a Japanese trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is currently a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.

Mizuki is a Japanese idol and rapper of the boy group One or Eight. Being the seventh member announced, he made his official group debut on August 16, 2024. Prior to debuting, he was a backup dancer for EXILE and Sandaime J Soul Brothers.

Kim Myeong-jun, better known by his stage name MJ, is a South Korean singer under Fantagio Music. He debuted in 2016 as the main vocalist of the boy group ASTRO. In August 2020, MJ debuted as one of the five members of the idol trot group 'Super Five,' formed through MBC's trot reality/survival show Favourite Entertainment. In April 2020, it was confirmed that MJ was cast in the Korean version of the musical 'Everybody's Talking About Jamie,' a British musical based on the true story of a teenager named Jamie who aspires to become a drag queen. On May 9, 2022, MJ enlisted in the military band as part of his mandatory military service.
Kim Sehoon also known as MODS, is a South Korean rapper and singer under PYRAT, he is a member of 0WAVE.
Mokyo is a South Korean singer and producer under MPLIFY. He signed with H1GHR Music as a producer in 2017 under the name of Thurxday. He resigned and debuted as a soloist in 2019 as Mokyo.
Molly Yam is a rising Korean R&B artist. He officially debuted on December 19, 2024 with his album MY SWEET VOICE, containing 18 tracks.
Mommy Son is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Beautiful Noise in 2018. He is thought to be the alter ego of Mad Clown.
mOnSteR nO.9 is a producer and member of co-ed trio PRSNT under BIXIZ XOUND. They made their debut on June 22, 2019 with the digital single "I Feel, You Feel, We Feel".
Moon Fancy is a South Korean bassist. He was a member of the co-ed group Se So Neon. He left the group in December 2018 to enlist for military service.
Moon Hyeok Jun is a South Korean singer and dancer.He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows LOUD and Fantasy Boys.
Moon Jae Young is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Moon Jeho is a South Korean singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Moon Junho is a South Korean singer under Luminant Entertainment. Before debuting, Junho appeared in boy group survival shows such as "Mixnine" and "Produce X 101".

Moon Suhn Bin is a South Korean-American trainee under Model Directors. He is a former predebut member of the cancelled boy group Nth BOYS. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Moonbin (1998–2023) was a South Korean singer, dancer, and actor, best known as a member of the boy group ASTRO and its first sub-unit, Moonbin & Sanha. He debuted with ASTRO on February 23, 2016, through their extended play Spring Up, where he contributed as the main dancer and lead vocalist. His career spanned both music and acting, with his most notable acting role being in the drama Moments of Eighteen (2019), where he played the character Jung Oh-je. In 2020, Moonbin expanded his career by forming the sub-unit Moonbin & Sanha with his bandmate Sanha. Their debut EP, In-Out, was released on September 14, 2020, with the lead single "Bad Idea." The duo quickly gained popularity, earning their first music show win within days of their debut. In addition to his music career, Moonbin showcased his versatility by participating in various variety shows, including hosting Show Champion and starring in the web drama The Mermaid Prince. Tragically, Moonbin passed away on April 19, 2023, at the age of 25. He was found at his home in Seoul, and authorities later confirmed the possibility of his death by suicide. His passing was met with an outpouring of grief from fans and the entertainment community, and he was laid to rest in a private funeral as per his family's wishes.
Moonkyu is a South Korean trainee under ICE Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut boy group HALF&HALF.
Moos is a South Korean rapper and DJ. He was a member of the boy group MADTOWN and the unit duo Pro C.
Jo Junseong popularly known as Moti, is a South Korean rapper, songwriter and composer under Planetarium Records. Besides being a soloist, he is also a member of the project boy group PLT.
Mr. Boombox is a South Korean artist under KW Entertainment. He is a member of the Korean pop trio WALWARI.
Mr. Tyfoon was a member of the hip-hop trio Clover.
Suh Kyung-min, better known as Mu, is a South Korean singer under C9 Entertainment. In 2021, he debuted as the lead vocalist of the boy group EPEX.
Mudd the Student is a singer-songwriter of Balming Tiger. He also is one of the rappers of Balming Tiger.

Ko Sung-ho, also known as Mujin, is a South Korean rapper and singer under GF Entertainment. He debuted in 2021 as the lead rapper of the boy group The Kingdom. Within the group, he represents the kingdom of Cherry Blossom. Mujin debuted as a member of KINGDOM on February 18, 2021, with History of Kingdom Pt.1 Arthur and the title track of "Excalibur".

Moon Ji-hu (formerly known as Moon Hyo-jun and by the stage name Hyojun) is a South Korean singer, dancer, actor, and comedian currently under Haky Entertainment. He debuted in June 2012 as a vocalist of the boy group A-Jax with their first single, One 4 U. In February 2016, DSP Media officially announced his departure from A-Jax, though he remained with the agency until 2021. Afterward, he expanded into comedy and entertainment, making appearances on Gag Concert. While he was not officially recruited by KBS, he was invited to return for the show’s second season but declined due to scheduling conflicts. Since then, Moon Ji-hu has focused primarily on his acting career. On May 30, 2025, Haky Entertainment announced that he had joined the company, where he continues to pursue roles as both an actor and entertainer.
Mun Jung Hyun is a South Korean trainee signed with WAKEONE. He is a member of the boy group EVNNE under Jellyfish Entertainment. The group debuted on September 19, 2023.
Munchman is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Stoneship in 2019.

Mun Ik is a South Korean singer who was previously a member of the boy group DKZ and its first sub-unit DONGKIZ I:KAN, under Dongyo Entertainment. He debuted as a member with the single album "DONGKIZ On the Block". He later took part in the group's sub-unit DONGKIZ I:KAN alongside fellow member Jaechan. The sub-unit debuted on July 7, 2020, with the single album "Y.O.U". On February 28, 2023, Dongyo Entertainment announced Mun Ik's departure from DKZ after a long hiatus and discussions with the agency regarding his activities. Despite leaving the group, he remained with the company. In a handwritten letter posted on his Instagram on July 31, he announced that he had returned to his hometown Busan and hinted at the end of his career as an idol, stating that it would be challenging for him to return to stage. However, he assured fans that he would continue to provide updates for those who supported him.
MUSHVENOM is a South Korean rapper. He debuted on September 05, 2019, with the digital single “Why Are You So Noisy?"

Kim Hyunwoo, also known as Muzin, is a South Korean rapper and songwriter under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy groups BAE173 and Double 0ne. He made his official group debut on November 19, 2020 with the release of BAE173's mini album "Intersection: Spark". In 2024, he competed on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, where he was eliminated in the final round, finishing in 11th place.
Myeong is a Vocalist and Dancer of the boy group N.CUS under Kyuri Entertainment. Myeong left China and trained for 7 years in order to follow his dreams of becoming an idol.
Myoungshin is a member of the band Messgram. He was a former member and guitarist of Five Run Strike which he left just before they disbanded. On his personal instagram it seems he has two daughters.
Myoungsoo is a part of boy grouo 1/N

Mystery Saja is a fictional singer from the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He serves as the sub-vocal and visual enigma of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Mystery is voiced by Alan Lee, a Korean American voice actor known for works such as The Ghost and The Ghost and Molly McGee, while his singing voice is provided by Kevin Woo, a member of U-KISS and solo artist. Inspired by anime archetypes and the idea of faceless idols, Mystery is designed as the unreadable cipher of the group. With his long, violet hair concealing most of his expression, he embodies elegance and eeriness in equal measure. Director Kang explained that Mystery's concept came partly from animation limitations, but fans quickly turned him into their projection point. As the group's most enigmatic figure, Mystery represents the unknowable presence, unsettling yet gentle, elusive yet magnetic.
Myung-ho is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the hip hop group Honey Family.

Myungeun is a South Korean model and former singer. He was a member of the boy group Apeace and it's sub-unit Onyx. He was added to the group after the departure of Lee Sungwoo on November 28, 2011. However, he was kick out of the group due to a breach of contract on March 1, 2014. It was later revealed, on March 15th, that he had gotten married and even had a daughter.
Baek Myung Han is a South Korean singer. He used to be the main vocalist of the boy group High4.
Myungho is a South Korean singer under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023.
Myunghoon was a member of the South Korean boy group NRG (New Radiancy Group).
Jung Myunghoon is a South Korean trainee under AAP.Y Entertainment. He participated in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
N is a South Korean singer under under AUBEMOOON STUDIO. He is the maknae of the boy group NCHIVE. He made his debut on April 9th, with the single album "Drive".

Cha Hak Yeon, better known by his stage name N, is a South Korean Singer, Actor, Presenter, and, Radio Host signed under 51k. N is best known for being the Leader, Main Dancer, and Vocalist of the boy group VIXX which debuted in 2012. N enlisted in the military on March 4, 2019, and was discharged on October 7, 2020. On October 31, 2020, N left Jellyfish Entertainment after he decided not to renew his contract, he joined 51k on November 3.
N-Sun is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the co-ed group Soya n' Sun.

Kim Sangbin, also known for his stage names BIL and n99d, is an independent singer. He first appeared in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2" in 2017. Later that year, he made his official debut with the digital single "Juicy" with the stage name BIL under 12% Music Entertainment. In 2020, after leaving 12% music, he redebuted under the stage name n99d (pronounced as need) as an independent singer.

Na Jee Hyuk is a soloist singer under 2nd Floor Records. He made his offical debut on October 2nd, 2023 with the single "Still Alive". He was announced on March 19th, 2024 to be under 2nd Floor Records on their official Instagram account.
Na Sung Ho is a South Korean singer and songwriter, best known as a member of the band Noel.
Na Yoonjae is a South Korean singer and model under YG KPLUS. He is a contesant on Wild Idol.
Na Yun Seo is a South Korean trainee under Cube Entertainment. He is best known as a participant on the survival shows LOUD and Boys II Planet.

Nabin, a trainee under Macaroni Media, was officially introduced as the newest member of L5ST on March 10, 2025. Since his reveal, he has appeared in group content, social media posts, and public events, although his official musical debut has yet to be confirmed. At present, publicly available information about him remains limited.
Nafla, born Choi Seok Bae, also known as Nicholas Choi, is a Korean-American rapper who debuted independently in 2013. Then he signed with MKIT Rain. He's currently under the label GROOVL1N.
Na Kang is a South Korean dancer and singer under Pacemaker Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group VERMUDA, along with ZPZG under the name N.K.He is Highlight’s Kikwang’s cousin.
Okubo Nalu made his first appearance on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2), where he ranked 12th place. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".
Nam Doyoon is a trainee under Blossom Entertainment and is participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Nam Jin-hyun, formerly known by the stage name Zen, is a South Korean former singer, art director, dancer, actor, and model under W.A Company. He is best known for being a former member of the boy group XING, which he left in June of 2009. Besides his activites in XING, he also competed on Mnet's 2013 dance survival show 'Dancing 9'.
Nam Jin Myung is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Nam JiWoon is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS. He is the seventh revealed member of the boy group idntt and its subunit unevermet. Prior to that, Nam JiWoon was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 on September 26, 2024. The show started airing in October 2024, and he was eliminated in the final episode after ranking 9th place.
Nam Son is a Vietnamese trainee. He is a member of the upcoming boy group PICKUS. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fan Pick.
Kim Namhyun is the main vocalist of Catch The Youth. He made his debut as a member of Catch The Youth on November 1st, 2023, with a mini album ‘Catch The Young: Fragments of Youth‘.

NANO is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and music producer. He was formerly a member of the boy group HISTORY. Following the group's disbandment in 2017, he adopted the stage name NANO and pursued a career as a singer-songwriter. Currently, he leads the producer team VENDORS, which he co-founded with fellow HISTORY member Jang Yi Jeong. In 2023, NANO established his own music production company, BILLION MUSIC.
Nara is a singer and part of the boy band THE T-BIRD.

Narachan, formerly known as Chan.0, is a South Korean singer under FM Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group M.O.N.T and a former member of Trophy. He made his solo debut on February 19, 2021, with the single album "Beautiful Sunday".
Naru is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group SM☆SH.
Narumi is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He was a contestant the reality survival show Oen-High.
Nason is a South Korean vocalist and rapper. He is a former member of the co-ed group CHECKMATE.
Nathan is a Lao-Thai-American singer and member of the group, 1VERSE under Singing Beetle Entertainment.
Nau Lee is a South Korean musician and composer under JTBC Studios. He is a former member of the band Purple Rain.
Naul is a South Korean Singer and member of the group "Brown Eyed Soul". He made his first debut in 1999 as a member of 4 member R&B group "Anthem".

Hansol is a former member of South Korean boy band XENO-T, formerly known as ToppDogg, and it's unit Wizard Kingdom. On September 29, 2017, it was announced that Minsung left the group. Hansol/Minsung is now in a dance studio called 1997 Dance Studio, where he makes choregraphy and dances under the name Navinci.

Needmorecash is a singer from South Korea, known for being one half of the musical duo ASMRZ.
Neo is a Taiwanese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows SCOOL and Boys II Planet.

Neo is a Japanese singer and member of the boy group ONE OR EIGHT. He was the only member who did not participate in the survival show WARPs DIG. Instead, he competed in Produce 101 Japan Season 2, where he ranked 85th. He later joined Avex in 2021, making him the last member to join the debut team. Eventually, he debuted as part of ONE OR EIGHT.
Neo is a Japanese singer under YT Entertainment. He debuted with the group TRY1 on October 23, 2024 with the single album "RE: TRY1".
Neon is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He was introduced as one of the 40 contestants on the survival show “Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor” by Mnet on January 21, 2024.
Lee Chang Mo, better known as NeoN, is a member of the South Korean band AboutU.
Choi Chan-hee, popularly known as New, is a South Korean singer under ONE HUNDRED. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the main vocalist of the boy group The Boyz.
Ngan Chau Yuet is a Hong Kongese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival shows Starlight Boys and Boys II Planet.

Nishimura Riki, known under his stage name Ni-ki, is a Japanese dancer, rapper, singer-songwriter, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as the maknae and main dancer of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Ni-ki was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked 4th place by global votes and became a member of ENHYPEN. Ni-ki made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".
Niahn is a South Korean singer and rapper who debuted under MKIT Rain as a member of Neonblue in 2017. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2019.
Nian Bo Heng is a Chinese-American trainee.. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Wang Yixiang, known under his stage name Nicholas, is a Taiwanese singer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as one of the rappers and vocalists of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. Nicholas is known for participating in the survival program I-LAND–the same show were ENHYPEN was created. However, Nicholas got eliminated in episode 3. In 2022, He participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to become a member of the Japanese boy group &TEAM.

Nidi is a South Korean singer and V-Tuber under 99Major. Initially, he uploaded covers to YouTube, and in October 2023, it was announced that he would join For The More as a member. He debuted with the group on their first comeback single, "End of the Film".

Ahn Daniel, popularly known as Niel, is a South Korean singer under New Entry. He is best known for being the main vocalist and face of the boy group Teen Top under Top Media Entertainment. Aside from performing, Niel also writes and composes tracks. He made his solo debut on February 16, 2015.

Yoo Gwan Woo is a Taiwanese singer associated with Image Music. He previously belonged to the project boy group IXFORM. Jung Wook Jin, known under his stage name as Nine, is a South Korean Kpop idol under 8D Entertainment. He is the maknae and vocalist of OnlyOneOf, and made his debut on May 28, 2019, with the mini album OnlyOneOf yOu.
Nino Sunday is a singer and bassist affiliated with Hubble Office. He is part of the virtual band SKOSHISM as leader and bassist. His birthday is May 13th.
Nithan is a singer and dancer under Oort Entertainment. He is a member of the virtual group Sphaze. He was the fourth to be revealed and to do a live broadcast, dated February 1, 2024.

NIve is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and producer under Chapter M. While he released his first single, "Getaway", on November 9, 2018, he didn't make his official Korean debut until April 2, 2020, with the release of the song "Like a Fool". He has worked with many artist, such as EXO, EXO’s Chen, Paul Kim, Sam Kim, Jeong Sewoon, BTS, and more.

No:el, born Jang Yong-jun, is a South Korean rapper who is under Indigo Music. He debuted under Prima Music Group in 2017. He released his first album, Elleonoel, on September 2, 2017.
