Noori is a South Korean singer and an original member of the co-ed group Co-ed School and the boy group SPEED, both under MBK Entertainment.
No Rann is a drummer under NAME X Entertainment. He is part of the virtual band OFF EQUALS.
Northfacegawd is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Whip in 2019.

Noyul is a South Korean singer under COMMAND THE-M Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 27, 2023 as a member of the boy group CMDM. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

NUA is the newest guitarist of 2Z. He was officially introduced on September 20, 2025 through the group’s social media posts, following the departure of Nuvorn. Nuvorn’s exit had been announced on August 8, 2025, when GOGO2020 stated he would leave due to musical differences after the group’s June 2025 U.S. tour. Other personal details about NUA have not yet been revealed.

Lee Jun-yeong, better known by his stage name, Nucksal, is a South Korean rapper. He debuted in 2009 as a member of the hip hop duo Future Heaven, and became one of the most popular rappers in South Korea's underground hip hop scene. He gained mainstream recognition in 2017 after finishing in second place on the TV rap competition show, Show Me The Money 6.

NUVorn is the newest member of 2Z. He was revealed on January 6, 2025, with their Glorious Youth teasers. On August 8, 2025, GOGO2020 posted through 2Z’s official Instagram story that Nuvorn would be leaving the band due to differences in musical direction following their June 2025 U.S. tour.
O:M is a South Korean singer who debuted on November 2, 2020 with Touch under YG Plus.

Oh Seung-min, better known as O.de, is a South Korean rapper and musician under JYP Entertainment. He made his official debut as the keyboardist and rapper of the band Xdinary Heroes on December 6, 2021.
O.V is the 3rd member revealed on June 6, 2018 of the South Korean boy group D-CRUNCH and its pre-debut sub-unit Geupsik-Dan. On March 25, 2024, he announced that he will be enlisting the next day.

O3ohn, a South Korean singer-songwriter signed with DooRooDooRoo Artist Company. He gained recognition through his participation in the Mnet-tvN folk musician survival program “Folk Us,” where he secured the third position. He made his debut on October 6, 2026 with EP (O).
Obayashi Yusei is a Japanese trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
OBON is a South Korean singer and actor under HICON ENTERTAINMENT. He made his debut on February 26, 2019, with the digital single "Good Time". He was a contestant on the 2016 survival show BOYS24.
oceanfromtheblue, formerly known as OCEAN, is a South Korean Singer signed under Nostalgia Music. He made his official debut on the 12th of March, 2018 with ‘Luv-fi 2018’.
ODEE, born Oh Dong-ho is a South Korean rapper who debuted under VMC in 2014.

Yoo Jinwon, also known as OFJW, is a South Korean singer and member of the duo "UNLOCK". In 2017, he participated in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2". He made his official solo debut in July 25, 2019 with the digital single "Rain".
OGon is a South Korean singer, singer and songwriter, member of the co-ed group Luna Pirates. He debuted on June 7, 2013 with "Love Is".

Oh Eunchul is a South Korean singer and musician. He first debuted as a soloist in 2018. Three years later, he joined SuperBand 2 and ended up debuting as the pianist and keyboardist of the rock band Craxilver.

Oh Hyeon Tae is a member of the boy group FANTASY BOYS under PocketDol Studios. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys. His finishing rank was #4. He is under ABYSS Company and PocketDol Studios.

Oh Hyuk is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and guitarist best known as the frontman of the indie rock band HYOKOH. Born on October 5, 1993, he is celebrated for his soulful indie vocals. His raw, emotional delivery and minimalist style have made him a standout figure not just in Korea’s indie scene but also on the international stage. Beyond his work with HYUKOH, Oh Hyuk has collaborated with major artists like IU and DEAN, further cementing his reputation as a creative force who blurs the lines between mainstream and underground music.
Oh Hyuk is a South Korean singer-songwriter, best known as the frontman of the best-selling indie band Hyuko.
Oh Hyujin is a member of the South Korean boy group M.Pire.
Oh Jae Woong is a South Korean singer and actor under Urban Works Entertainment. He is a contesant on Wild Idol.
Oh Ji Hoon is a South Korean musician who was a member of the first-generation group TWO TWO.

Oh Jinhwan is a South Korean rapper and dancer. He was a member of the South Korean hip hop boy group 1TYM under YG Entertainment in which he made his debut in 1998. The group went on hiatus when Oh Jinhwan started his mandatory military service in 2006 (the exact date is currently unknown). Oh Jinhwan has now his own family and it was revealed that he and fellow 1TYM member Baekyoung were business partners and owned a restaurant together.

Oh Jong Hyuk is a South Korean singer, actor, and television personality best known for his role as a former member of the popular first-generation K-pop group Click-B under DSP Media. Born on February 16, 1983, he debuted in 1999 as a vocalist for the group, which gained significant attention for their blend of pop and rock elements. Following Click-B's initial disbandment in 2002, Oh Jong Hyuk embarked on a successful solo career, releasing multiple albums and showcasing his vocal versatility. Beyond music, he expanded his talents into acting, appearing in dramas, musicals, and variety shows, further solidifying his presence in the entertainment industry. Known for his dedication to his craft, he has remained a beloved figure among fans and continues to influence the evolving landscape of Korean pop culture.
Oh Jun Ho is a South Korean trainee under WITH US Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Oh Junhee is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Oh Sae Bom is a South Korean singer-songwriter and dancer currently affiliated with Studio Four Seasons and the creative collective Season House. In 2019, he participated in the Mnet survival show Produce X 101 as a contestant representing NEST, where he was eliminated in Episode 5 and placed 69th overall. He was previously the leader of the performance and busking crew MAXXAM, which officially disbanded in 2021. Oh Sae Bom made his solo debut on December 17, 2019, with the release of his digital single “Tie.” On May 9, 2022, he publicly disclosed via Instagram that he had been diagnosed with malignant lymphoma, a form of blood cancer, in January 2022. He shared that he had completed his second round of chemotherapy at the time and, although not in critical condition, anticipated a decline in his health due to ongoing treatment. He co-founded Season House, a casual creative collective centered on dance, lifestyle content, and artistic collaboration, alongside close friends Kunho, Changha, Song Hyungseok, and Cha Dohyun. The group brings together individuals with diverse backgrounds in entertainment—Hyungseok is a former member of the pre-debut team PROJECT 7, while Dohyun is better known as Kim Sunghyun, a former member of IN2IT and a contestant on Produce X 101, now promoting under the name Cha Dohyun. Season House has gained attention for its original content and participation in high-profile projects, including the release of official promotional photos for "Squid Game Season 2", showcasing their creative direction and visual branding.

Oh Seungchan, born Oh Byeong Yong, is a South Korean trainee. On February 20, 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on MBC's survival show "Fantasy Boys". He ended up being eliminated in episode 2. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 41st place.
Oh Sounghoon is a member of the co-ed Indie band LeeRang_E. He is the drummer and he was also the last member to be revealed. His birth year is 2007 on a unknown date.
Oh Taehwan is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on MBC's 2023 survival show Fan Pick and JTBC's 2024 survival show PROJECT7.

Oh Won Bin is a South Korean singer, rapper, musician, and actor under JIHO Entertainment. He is best known as a former member of the kpop boy band FTISLAND. He made his official debut on June 7, 2007, as the guitarist of FTISLAND with the group's first full-length album, "Cheerful Sensibility". The album was a commercial success and played a key role in the band’s early popularity in the kpop industry. During his time with FTISLAND, Oh Won Bin contributed to the group’s musical and stage performances, gaining recognition as part of their original lineup. In January 2009, FNC Entertainment confirmed his departure from FTISLAND, stating creative differences as the reason. He was subsequently replaced by trainee Song Seung Hyun. After leaving the group, Oh Won Bin shifted focus toward acting and solo pursuits. On December 1, 2014, he signed with JIHO Entertainment to formally continue his career as an actor. Outside his professional career, Oh Won Bin publicly announced his marriage to a non-celebrity partner on January 22, 2022, via Instagram. Later that year, he welcomed the birth of his first child.
Oh Youngwoong is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Kim Ji-yong or Alexander Kim, widely known as Okasian, is a Korean-American rapper who debuted independently in 2010. His stage name 'Okasian' is a compound of the words Ok and Asian, with the pronunciation similar to the word 'Occasion'. He was born in Los Angeles then moved to Korea as a child before returning to the United States during his teenage years to attend college. He studied biology at Pennsylvania State University, but soon shifted his focus toward music. Okasian made his musical debut with his mixtape Preseason #1 in 2010 and released his first official single, “You’re the One,” in 2011. His debut studio album, Boarding Procedures was released the following year. He quickly became known for his fluid transitions between English and Korean in his lyrics. He was a founding member of The Cohort, a South Korea-based hip-hop collective that included prominent names such as Keith Ape, Bryan Chase, and B-Free. Okasian rose to international prominence with his feature on Keith Ape’s viral hit “It G Ma,” which became a global sensation and a touchstone for Korean trap music. He began his career with Hi-Lite Records (2011–2016), then went independent for a short period before signing with YG Entertainment’s sub-label, The Black Label, in 2017. After his contract expired he joined Universal Music Korea in 2025.

Ollie is a Chinese trainee under Yuehua Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet." He competed on "Asia Super Young" with his final rank being 1st, meaning he will debut as a member of a China/Hong Kong based group called LOONG9.
Olly is an English singer. He is a member of the boy group dearALICE.

OLNL, born Lee Je-won is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Stoneship in 2017. He’s a member of WYBH, areyouchildish, and kgvovc. He was a participant in Show Me The Money 4 (eliminated in the second round) and he reached the semi-finals of Show Me The Money 777 where he was defeated by Kid Milli. He featured on Show Me The Money 9 with Han Yohan and Sky Minhyuk. OLNL was featured on GIRIBOY‘s ‘Way‘ in Feb. of 2022. In March, he was featured on yourbeagle‘s ‘do re mi pa sol‘. He was also featured on PATEKO‘s ‘Refresh‘.
Omega Sapien is the Center Rapper of Balming Tiger.
Uhm Taehoon, better known as Omtae, is a South Korean singer and member of the disbanded group UglyPumpkin.
On is a South Korean rapper under PCS Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DIGNITY.
On is a South Korean singer under J-Star Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ABLUE.
On (T07) is a South Korean singer and rapper under MLD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TFN.
ON:N is a South Korean singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.

Jung Jae-won, also known as One, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor. He first debuted with Kim Samuel as the duo 1Punch in 2015 under Brave Entertainment before debuting as a solo artist in YG Entertainment. Aside from singing, One has also acted in the dramas A Korean Odyssey (2017), Room No. 9 (2018), and Her Private Life (2019). One also acted as the main lead in his debut film "Goodbye Summer" in 2019. Following the end of his contract with YG Entertainment on July 17, 2019, he's now under his own management company, Private Only.
Kim Ji-won, also known as ONE is a rapper under NOMAD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NOMAD.

ONE.KI, also known as Lee Ki Won is a South-Korean singer and producer. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival show Produce 101 Season 2. Despite getting eliminated in the show, Kiwon was able to debut as a member of the temporary group RAINZ that debuted in 2017 and disbanded in 2018. He was also a member of the pre-debut group GIDONGDAE before their disbandment in 2021. He debuted as a soloist on October 28, 2022 with the single album "Hug".

Jo Won-jun. better known as Onejunn, is a South Korean singer under Universal Music Korea. He made his official debut in 2013 as a member of the boy group Boys Republic. He also participated in the survival show "The Unit."

Lim Hanbyeol, also known as ONESTAR, is a South Korean singed under OS Project. He first debuted in 2008 as a member of DSP's short lived group A-Style. Aside from A-style, he was part of the group Monday Kiz (2010-2014) and currently is a member of the trio HYB Project.

Onew is a South Korean singer and actor, currently under Griffin Entertainment. He debuted as a member and leader of the SM Entertainment boy group SHINee on May 25, 2008, with the group's first mini album, "Replay". He made his solo debut on December 5, 2018, with his first mini album, "Voice", shortly before his military enlistment, and has continued to be a prolific soloist ever since. He has also released music in Japan, starting with his first studio album, "Life Goes On", in 2022. He has contributed to songwriting for both himself and SHINee. Onew is regarded as an excellent vocalist and has appeared in several musicals, including "Brothers Were Brave", "Rock of Ages" and "Midnight Sun". He has also acted in various television shows, such as "Welcome to Royal Villa" and "Descendant of the Sun".

Lee Seunghwan, or ONLEE, is a South Korean singer. Hi is a former member of the project boy group, 1THE9. ONLEE was first known as a member of the boy group, JUST B (formerly known as the trainee group, PlayM Boys). On October 25, 2018, he was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the performance team. He finished in eighth place, thus becoming a member of the project group 1THE9. In December 2022, he was revealed as one of the participants of the 2023 survival show, 'Boys Planet'. He participated as an individual trainee, meaning he was not under any agency. On April 13, he was eliminated in episode 11 after ranking 24th. On August 29, 2023, Inyeon Entertainment announced that Seunghwan had signed with them and would adopt the stage name, ONLEE. He made his official debut on November 27, 2023, with the mini album Switch ON.

Onyu is a singer from the virtual group RE:REVOLUTION. He began his career debuting in July 2021 in the group Revolution Heart until he and the other members terminated their contracts and formed their own group, re-debuting on April 26, 2024.

maleIdols.description: Opp is a Thai actor and singer. He was chosen by the fans to be part of the group THE7 through the Thai survival show Seven Stars. THE7 debuted on January 29, 2023.
Osuke is a Japanese trainee. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."

OSUN, born Kwon Oh-sun, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Five Lines in 2021. He first gained mainstream attention after his appearence on High School Rapper. He also competed on RAP:PUBLIC in 2024.
Oto Rainy is a singer and pianist affiliated with Hubble Office. He is part of the virtual band SKOSHISM as a pianist. His birthday is January 2nd.
Ouju is a Japanese trainee under Hyper Rhythm. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."

Oversleep is a South Korean rapper under Parable Entertainment. He is a member of the virtual boy group Psychode as the Main Rapper and Planning Director. His birthday is on March 1, of a unknown year.
Owell Mood is a South Korean singer who debuted independently in 2016.
Owen, born Kim Hyun-woo is a South Korean rapper who debuted under MKIT Rain in 2016.
Owler is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Cash Me Outside in 2018.

Ownr is a multi-talented member of the Korean band KAVE, serving as the keyboardist and DJ. Known for his creativity and innovative sound, Ownr contributes not only as a performer but also as a producer and arranger for the band. His musical versatility shines through in KAVE’s tracks, helping shape the group's unique blend of styles. With a passion for exploring new sounds, Ownr plays a key role in the band's evolving musical journey.
Owol, formerly known as K, is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He was a member of the boy group Wonder Boyz.

Sehyuk (P-Goon) is the ex-leader of ToppDogg. Currently he is working on an acting career instead. On September 29, 2017 it was announced that P-Goon left Topp Dogg. It was also announced that he plans to enlist for his mandatory military service and after discharge he plans to focus on acting.

Pyo Ji Hoon, also known as P.O, is a South Korean Rapper and TV Personality best known for being the deep-voiced Maknae of the boy group Block B under Seven Seasons Entertainment. After many years of being a rapper, P.O started appearing in variety shows and even starring in the drama "Hotel del Luna" (2019)

maleIdols.description: Pa is a Thai singer. Through the show Seven Stars, he was chosen by the Korean members to be part of the group THE7, which debuted on January 29, 2023. The contracts of all THE7 members ended on March 20, 2024.

Jeon Sang-hyun, better known as Paloalto is a prominent South Korean rapper, producer and singer. He has been active in the industry since 2002, making him one of the most idolized rappers in the Korean hip-hop scene. Paloalto is known for his musical style of blending jazz and hip-hop, as well as his role as a record label CEO. His stage name is a direct reference to the city of Palo Alto in California, USA, where he lived for a year when he was young. Paloalto first encountered hip-hop in middle school after hearing the music of Wu-Tang Clan and Jay-Z. He released his debut single “Memoriez” in 2002, and followed up with his official debut EP ‘Footprints’ in 2004. His first studio album ‘Resoundin’’ came the following year. In 2006, he formed the duo P&Q with The Quiett and released the collaborative album ‘Supremacy’. Shortly after meeting Tiger JK, he joined Jungle Entertainment. However, after his contract came to an end he founded Hi-Lite Records in 2010. Former artists of Hi-Lite include Keith Ape, B-Free, Okasian, Swervy & Reddy. Paloalto has appeared as a producer on three seasons of Show Me the Money, garnering attention for his ability to create hooks and guiding rookie rappers. He is also a member of Damoim, a project group of rappers born in 1984 alongside The Quiett, Simon Dominic, Deepflow & Yumdda. The group was formed on Dingo Freestyle’s web variety show of the same name. Paloalto married his non-celebrity partner in 2015, after being introduced to each other by fellow rapper Koonta. After the dissolution of Hi-Lite Records in 2022, he joined Daytona Entertainment. In May 2025, his contract with Daytona came to an end.

Parc Jae Jung is a South Korean singer under Romantic Factory. He rose to fame after winning in the singing competition program "Superstar K5" in 2013. He is a member of the project boy group MSG Wannabe.

Park Bo Gum is a South Korean actor, singer, and musician currently signed under THE BLACK LABEL. He first gained widespread recognition for his work in television and film, and has since become one of Korea’s most prominent and well-respected entertainers. Bo Gum began his career under Blossom Entertainment, where he remained for ten years before parting ways with the agency in December 2022. The following month, in January 2023, he officially joined THE BLACK LABEL. As a singer, Park Bo Gum made his Korean solo debut on October 12, 2018 with the release of his first digital single, “Let’s Go See the Stars.” He later expanded into the Japanese market, debuting with the single “Bloomin’” on March 20, 2019. His soft vocal style and warm image have earned him acclaim not only as an actor but also as a recording artist. Throughout his career, Bo Gum has received numerous accolades, including the Top Excellence Award at the 30th KBS Drama Awards and the Acting Award at the 16th Korea Assembly Grand Award. In 2016, he was named Gallup Korea’s Actor of the Year, becoming the youngest recipient in the award’s history. On August 31, 2020, Park Bo Gum began his mandatory military service, enlisting in the Navy as a cultural promotion specialist, which allowed him to serve as part of the military band. He was officially discharged from duty on April 30, 2022.

Park Chanyong is a South Korean trainee. On August 11, 2021, he was introduced as a contestant on MBC's survival show Wild Idol, but was sadly eliminated in episode 3. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 69th place.
Park Dawool is a South Korean musician. He is a member of the co-ed rock band KARDI and plays the geomungo.
Park Dong Gyu is a trainee under IST Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Park Gun Wook is a South Korean singer originally under Jellyfish Entertainment. He made his official debut with ZEROBASEONE on July 10, 2023, under the management of WAKEONE. In 2021, Park Gun Wook participated in the survival show "Wild Idol" Following this, in 2023, he participated in the hit survival show "Boys Planet," representing Jellyfish Entertainment. In the finale of Boys Planet, Gun Wook ranked 5th place, earning his spot in the group ZEROBASEONE.
Park Gwanyoung is a South Korean trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening. He was a contestant on the show Boys Planet.
Park Gyuseok is a South Korean drummer and a former member of the co-ed band THETHE. From 2011-2017 he was the drummer of THETHE.
Park Han Bin is a South Korean singer signed with WAKEONE. He is a member of the boy group EVNNE under Jellyfish Entertainment. The group debuted on September 19, 2023.
Park Hayuchan is a South Korean singer under With US Entertainment, a subsidiary of Around US Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group The Wind on May 15, 2023.
Park Hyeon-jin is a South Korean rapper who debuted under H1GHR Music in 2022.

Park Hyo Shin is a South Korean Singer and Musical Actor under Herbigharo. He made his music debut in 1999 with the album "Things I Can't Do For You". Nicknamed "God of Vocals", he is a renowned artist celebrated for his powerful, emotive voice and versatility across genres like ballad, rock, and R&B. Hyo-shin is also a skilled lyricist, composer, and producer, known for hits like "Wild Flower", "Breath", and "Home". In 2019, he became the first Korean solo artist to sell out a concert with over 100,000 attendees. Beyond music, Park Hyo Shin has earned acclaim in musical theatre, starring in major productions such as Mozart, The Man Who Laughs, and Beethoven.

I’M (formerly Seogoong) is a former member of Topp Dogg, and its subunits, UNDERDOGG, Lion Kingdom and Topp Dogg G. It was announced via ToppDogg’s official fancafe on 2015.01.16 that I’M would be leaving the group to join sub-unit UnderDogg with the intent of pursuing a “broader musical spectrum”. He debuted solo and is now using the stage name I’M, under Dream Tea Entertainment.
Park Hyunjin is a South Korean bassist, member of the co-ed group Se So Neon. He joined the band around 2019 along with U-Su to replace Fancy Moon and Gangto
Park Jaegu is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed group Space A.
Park Jihoo is a South Korean trainee signed with WAKEONE. He is a member of the boy group EVNNE under Jellyfish Entertainment. The group debuted on September 19, 2023.
Park Ji Hun is a South Korean trainee who participated in the SBS survival show "Universe League" and ranked 40th.
Park Ji Min is a South Korean trainee under ZERO-HI. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Park Jihoon, formerly known as Jihoon, is a South Korean singer and actor under Maroo Entertainment. He is mainly known for participating in Produce 101 Season 2 and becoming a member of Wanna One. Park Jihoon initally debuted as a child actor, participating in musicals such as Peter Pan (2007–2009), The Harmonium in My Memory (2010), and Radio Star (2010–2011), as well as television dramas like Jumong (2006–2007), The King and I (2007–2008), Kimchi Cheese Smile (2007–2008), Iljimae (2008), and more. From April 7th to June 16th of 2017, Park Jihoon participated in Mnet's survival program Produce 101 Season 2. Under the stage name of Jihoon, he finished in 2nd place and earned himself a place in the group Wanna One. He eventually debuted as the lead dancer and visual of the group on August 7, 2017 with the mini album 1X1=1 (To Be One). He continued to be in the group until they disbanded on January 27, 2019. However, they reunited to release the single Beautiful (Part.3) on January 27, 2022. 2 months after Wanna One's disbandment, Park Jihoon made his solo debut on March 26, 2019 with the mini album O'Clock. Besides from being a soloist, he still continues to act in successful television dramas, including Love Revolution (2020), At a Distance, Spring is Green (2021), and Weak Hero Class 1 (2022). He majored in Broadcasting Arts Department at School of Performing Arts Seoul and graduated in February 2018. He attended Chung-Ang University, majored in Performing Arts and Media.
Park Jin Woo is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Park Jueon is a South Korean singer under CLIMIX, member of CLIMIX's unnamed pre-debut boy group. He is a contestant on Wild Idol.

Park Jun Hwan is a South Korean trainee under Starship Entertainment. Best known for being a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan, he was set to debut in the group IDID after ranking 7th in the finale. However, on June 2, 2025, Starship announced that Park Jun Hwan would not be debuting in the group.

Park Jun Seong is a South Korean trainee under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet. He previously participated in the survival show Debut's Plan, but did not pass the survival round.

Park Jung Min ,also known as Romeo, is a South Korean singer under ALLART Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SS501. He made his solo debut on January 20, 2011 with the single "Not Alone". He made his debut in Japan on September 5, 2012 with the single "Give Me Your Heart" under the stage name Romeo.
Park Jungho is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group Kairos. He is known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Park Junghyun is a singer. He was a member of the band 7SIA. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Park Jungmin is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on CAP-TEEN.

Park Junhee, formerly known as Jun, is a South Korean singer under Beat Interactive. He is the leader of the boy group A.C.E. Park Junhee appeared on episode seven of I Can See Your Voice 5. He was known as Suncheon's Kangta and was eliminated in the second round. In 2017, Park Junhee, along with fellow group member Chan, became a contestant on KBS 2TV's idol rebooting show The Unit. He was eliminated in the episode 4 after achieving 27th place. On June 1, 2025, Park Junhee established his own agency, H&P Entertainment (also known as HNP Entertainment), marking the beginning of his independent activities. The company was introduced via his personal Instagram, where he tagged the official H&P account. A teaser film featuring Junhee was released shortly after through the agency's official channels.
Park Junhyeok is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Park Junseok is a South Korean singer and actor. He is best known as a member of the 4-member boy group TaeSaJa, where he was responsible for high-energy rapping and vocals. After the group's disbandment in 2001, he shifted his focus to acting, fully pursuing his career in the entertainment industry around 2003.
Park Junwoo is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Juwon is a South Korean singer under Bill Entertainment. He was a contestant on SBS' survival show Universe League, where his team "Team Rhythm" won the Prism Cup, securing him a spot as a member of the final group AHOF.
Park Ki Hun is a South Korean singer under Studio JAMM. He is a member of the crossover vocal quartet LA POEM.

Park Nam Jung (박남정) is a South Korean singer and former actor under NJP Enertainment. He debuted in February 1988 with his first album "아! 바람이여".He is most well-known for inventing the L-Dance craze in the late 80s. He is the father of STAYC's Sieun.

Park Nu Ri is a trainee under MODHAUS. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet representing Great M Entertainment. On July 30, 2025, he announced through Instragram that he has signed with MODHAUS and will likely be joining their upcoming boy group idntt due to the fact that he tagged them in the post.
Park Sejin is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening.

Park Seo An, previously known as Sejun and later KIDZ, is a South Korean singer. He was part of MBK entertainment's boy group SPEED. He officially debuted as a member of SPEED on January 7, 2013 with the single album "Speed Of Light". After the group's disbandment in 2015, he debuted as a solo artist under the stage name KIDZ, releasing his first digital single album "BETRAY" on December 29, 2016. After years of not releasing music, he dropped his second digital single, "JJAM BBONG", on July 11, 2022 under his current stage name, Park Seo An.
Park Seong Hyeon is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He is best known for participating on the survival show Debut's Plan, where he ranked eighth, earning his place in IDID.
Park Seong Min is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Park Sewoong is a South Korean musician. He is the Bass Guitarist of the rock band Redoor.

Park Jun-won, better known by his stage name pH-1, is a Korean-American rapper based in South Korea. The stage name pH-1 is a combination of his name, "p" from his surname Park, "H" from the English name Harry, and "Won" from the Korean name Park Joon-won. He is currently under Jay Park & Cha Cha Malone's record label H1GHR MUSIC. pH-1 was born in South Korea and moved with his family to Long Island, New York, when he was about 12 years old. He studied biology at Boston College and worked as a dental assistant post-graduation. Park was later employed at a web development company prior to moving to South Korea in 2016. He then moved to Korea in pursuit of his music career after Jay Park reached out to him via Instagram to join his newly formed record label, H1GHR MUSIC. As the three keywords he pursues in his music are truth, positivity, and experience, he tries to contain only positive messages as much as possible, excluding alcohol, money bragging, and sexual content.

The video became a global sensation and was the first to reach one billion views on YouTube, making PSY an international icon. Lee Young-sin, better known by his stage name Punchnello, is a South Korean rapper under Jay Park’s label AOMG. He initially debuted under Epik High’s Tablo’s label HIGHGRND in 2016, but left the YG headed subsidiary for AOMG in 2019, debuting once more with the EP “Oridinary” on January 28. Later that year, he won the rap competition show “Show Me the Money 8”. Punchnello kickstarted his musical career in 2015, releasing a mixtape that garnered a lot of attention within the South Korean hip-hop scene. It gave him the opportunities to collaborate and feature alongside some of the most recognized hip-hop artists in South Korea. Punchnello has built his own musical style, starting with his debut single “Lime”, appearing on “Show Me the Money 6” and through single albums including “Worth It” and “Detox”. 2019 was the year Punchnello approaced the public and was the talk of the town. He showed a mature side of him and distinctive style followed by the single “23”, where he collaborated with singer-songwriter Sam Kim. He then participated in “Show Me the Money 8”, two years after his first appearance on the sixth season of the show, and managed to become the champion. A few months later, it was announced that he had joined Jay Park’s label AOMG. The first single under the label, “Doodle”, gained mass recognition from the public for his unique style of rapping, harmonized with Baek Yerin’s beautiful vocals.

Pyeon Yuil is a South Korean drummer. He was a member of the band SORAN, with whom he debuted on August 19, 2010, with the release of their first EP "Why Didn't I Know It Then?", before leaving the team in July of 2024.

He has released two studio albums, Boylife In 12'' (2014) & Some Hearts Are For Two (2022).

R.Tee is a South Korean producer, songwriter, and DJ currently signed under RTST Label. He is widely recognized for producing songs for prominent artists, particularly those under YG Entertainment, including BIGBANG, BLACKPINK, iKON, and WINNER. In addition to his collaborative work, he has pursued his own music projects, debuting as a solo artist with the single "We Got The World" in June 2014. In 2025, R.Tee established his own label, RTST Label, marking a new chapter in his career. Shortly after the launch, he announced his second digital single, "Damdadi", featuring Soyeon, scheduled for release on August 10, 2025.
R1AN is a South Korean singer & dancer. He is currently being managed by Lo-Fi Kids. He debuted on June 23rd, 2020 with the song ‘Eh bebe', the MV was released later in August.

R1ke (also known as Rikuto) is a Japanese singer under YT Entertainment. He debuted with the boy group TRY1 on October 23, 2024 with the single album RE: TRY1. He was a member of the pre-debut group MY0NE until their disbandment on February 7, 2024, and the trainee duo MYENT BOYS.
Ra Jiwoong is a South Korean guitarist. He was a member of the co-ed band THETHE from 2015 to 2017.
ra.L is a trainee under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ.
Rad Museum is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and music producer signed with You.will.konvv Entertainment. He officially debuted in 2017 and released his first EP, “Scene”, on October 26, 2017.
Raehyun is a South Korean singer best known for being a member of boy group F.Cuz. He was added to the group in late 2011 after the departure of one of the original members.

Raiden is a South Korean DJ and producer signed under Protocol Recordings and SM Entertainment. He released his first solo single, "Heart Of Steel", on January 13, 2017. Prior to becoming a DJ, he was a guitarist and had studied music in Japan for six years before starting his own band in 2011.

Jung Jihoon, popularly known as Rain, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer, businessman, and actor under his self-established agency Rain Company. He made his debut as a soloist on May 13, 2002 with his first album N001. Over the years following his debut, he became one of the most popular and influential singer and actor in South Korea. He also garnered love from international fans after starring in the 2004 hit drama "Full House". Rain is also a former member of the boy group Fanclub and current member of the project co-ed group SSAK3. In SSAK3, he uses the stage name B-RYONG.
Lee Rak, better known by his stage name Rak, is a South Korean singer. He is the main vocalist of the Kpop boy group withus, under withHC. He was the second member to be revealed on October 27, 2020.

Seok Rakwon is a former member of the South Korean boy group ATBO under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” and debuted with ATBO by placing third place with a total of 1520 points. On May 6, 2024, IST Entertainment announced that Rakwon would be leaving ATBO due to health reasons.

Rano is a South Korean rapper under E Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group E'LAST. On August 19, 2019, he was announced as a member of the upcoming boy group, then known as EBOYZ. Now called E'LAST, the group made their official debut on June 9, 2020 with the mini album Day Dream.

Raots is a Chinese singer under Star Weave Entertainment. As a trainee, he participated in the Chinese survival show "Next Generation Star." On February 17, 2022, Raots made his official debut as a member of the boy group JWiiver.

Raphael is a Brazilian-Japanese rapper and dancer under Na Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DUSTIN which he joined on February 15, 2023. Raphael is also a former member of the J-Pop group Super Fantasy under the stage name EL.
Ravi is a South Korean rapper under GROOVL1N. He is a former member of the boy group VIXX and their sub-unit VIXX LR. He made his solo debut on January 9, 2017, with his first mini-album, "R.eal1ze".

Ravn, born Kim Young-jo on September 2, 1995, in Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, Seoul, South Korea, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and producer currently signed under DSP Media. He first gained attention as a contestant on JTBC’s survival program MIXNINE in 2017, representing his former agency RBW. Although eliminated in episode 13 with a final ranking of 23rd, his appearance led to his debut on January 9, 2019, as a member of the boy group ONEUS with their mini album Light Us. Ravn actively promoted with the group as the main rapper and one of their leading songwriters, earning recognition for his strong stage presence and musical contributions. In October 2022, Ravn voluntarily withdrew from ONEUS following allegations made by an anonymous individual online. After a brief period of inactivity, he re-emerged in early 2023 by launching his independent music project Demian, through which he released a series of self-produced tracks on YouTube and SoundCloud. His return marked a gradual re-entry into the music scene, showing a more personal and introspective side to his artistry. In March 2025, Ravn signed with DSP Media and launched new official social media channels to connect with fans. He announced the release of his pre-debut digital single “Comedy” on April 2 and is set to make his official solo debut in Japan later that same month. His fandom is called ROSES, and he remains active through both personal and official social platforms as he begins the next chapter of his career.

Huang Ren Jun is a Chinese singer based in South Korea. Renjun is best known as a member of the boy group NCT and the Main Vocalist and Lead Dancer of its sub-group NCT Dream. Born in Jilin, China on March 23rd, 2000, Renjun has always been interested in performing. Before debuting, Renjun used to study ballet and contemporary dance. On April 13, 2024, SM Entertainment announced that Renjun recently experienced a "worsening of his physical health" and symptoms of anxiety. As a result, his activities with NCT DREAM would be suspended for the time being to receive sufficient rest and stability. On April 20, SM Entertainment announced that Renjun would go on a temporary hiatus from all activities to focus on treatment and recovery. 6 months later, on October 8, 2024, SM Entertainment announced that Renjun will be resuming activites with NCT DREAM.

Nishijima Renta, also known as Renta, is a Japanese rapper and lyricist under Yoshimoto Kogyo. He is a member of the Japanese boy group OCTPATH and a former member of the boy group TO1. Shen Quanrui, known better under the stage name Ricky, is a Chinese singer originally under Yuehua Entertainment. Ricky made his official debut as a member of ZEROBASEONE on July 10, 2023, under the management of WAKEONE.

Choi Yeonsik, better known as Rihan, is a South Korean singer under Star Weave Entertainment. In February 17, 2022, he debuted as the leader of the boy group JWiiver.

Ikezaki Rihito was born on August 30th, 2001, in Fukuoka, Japan. He is the lead rapper in INI. He made his debut on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A". His final rank on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2) was 9th.

Riku is a Japanese singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the group NCT and it's Japan sub-unit NCT Wish. On October 22, 2024, SM Entertainment released a statement announcing that Riku would be going on a hiatus period from activities after a recent "worsening of his health" to receive sufficient rest and stability. He returned to the group February of 2025.

Rikuto is a Japanese singer under DNA Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SWEET:CH.

Rio is a South Korean singer and musical actor under Handa Productions. He was a member of the disbanded boy group 14U.

Rioto is a Japanese dancer and singer under MYSTIC Story. He is the main dancer of the boy group ARrC. On July 8, 2024, MYSTIC Story introduced their first boy group, ARrC. Rioto was unveiled as one of the seven members of this group.
Shin Kangsu, also known as RIVR, is a singer under NOMAD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NOMAD.
Riwoo is a South Korean singer under Beat Interactive. He is a member of the boy group NEWBEAT.
Riwoo is a South Korean singer under KOZ Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of BOYNEXTDOOR on May 30th, 2023.

Kim Namjoon, known under his stage name RM and formerly Rap Monster, is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, producer, and composer under Big Hit Entertainment and HYBE Labels. He is best known as the leader and main rapper of the worldwide sensation boy group BTS. RM was born on September 12, 1994 with the name Kim Nam-Joon. At a young age, RM has always been interested in poetry and hip hop music which paved the way for his passion in writing his own lyrics and music. RM continued to pursue his music, becoming an underground rapper and auditioning for different entertainment companies. After a referral from Sleepy, a South Korean Hip Hop artist, RM auditioned and was offered a spot in Big Hit Entertainment. Eventually, RM debuted as the leader of BTS. With hard work and unwavering passion, RM and the rest of his members went on to become one of the most sought after artists of their generation, known not just in South Korea but all over the world. RM released his first solo mixtape, "RM," in 2015. In 2017, he announced the change of his stage name from Rap Monster to RM, and expressed that his new stage name "could mean anything you want to," like for example, Real Me. RM became the highest-charting South Korean soloist on the Billboard 200 chart with his second solo mixtape ‘mono’, in 2018. RM’s first official solo album, ”Indigo”, released in 2022 was a big success, the album reached the no. 3 spot on the Billboard 200 chart and was named the best K-Pop album of 2022 by Billboard. The album’s title track ”Wild Flower” also became his first solo entry on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart.
Roa is the newest member of Triger and his official member color is green. His birthday is April 2nd.
Roan also known as Minjae is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the upcoming boy group AWIN and a former member of SPECTRUM.

Robin is Korea-Australian singer under n.CH Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group n.SSign on August 9, 2023. Prior to his debut, he participated in multiple survival shows such as World Klass (2019), CAP-TEEN (2020), and Stars Awakening (2022), where he secured a spot in the debut group n.SSign.
Robo Frostor is a singer and drummer affiliated with Hubble Office. He is part of the virtual band SKOSHISM as a drummer. His birthday is December 13th.

Rockhyun is a South Korean singer. He is a former member and the main vocalist of the boy group 100% under TOP Media, which disbanded on October 9, 2021. He is now a singer in the Japanese boy group FAVE1.

Park Min Hyuk, also known by his stage name Rocky, is a South Korean singer, rapper, songwriter, and actor signed under Wonijin Entertainment Entertainment Corp. (formerly ONE FINE DAY Entertainment). He is a former member of the boy group ASTRO and the group's second duo sub-unit, JinJin & Rocky. On February 28, 2023, it was announced that Rocky had left ASTRO and Fantagio, as he had decided not to renew his contract. On October 26, 2023, Rocky established his own agency under the name ONE FINE DAY Entertainment. However, on March 18, 2024, the company was officially rebranded as Wonijin Entertainment Corp., reflecting a fresh start and a new vision. He made his solo debut on November 22, 2023, with his first mini-album, "Rockyst."

Kim Sunho, better known by his stage name Roel, is the lead vocalist of the South Korean boy group ARGON under MHS Entertainment.

He later went on to join the record label Mine Field in 2022. Over the years, he has appeared on major survival shows like Show Me the Money 11 and Drop The Bit. His debut full-length album, TOO YOUNG came in 2024.

Rohyoon is a South Korean former singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group RION FIVE, under Narda Entertainment, on March 25, 2014, with the digital single "Rion Five", and was active with the group until his departure in August 2018. He also took part in the agency's project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018. To this day, Rohyoon's whereabouts are unknown.
Roi is a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TARGET.

Romance Saja is a fictional singer created for the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He is a dancer and vocalist of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. He is voiced by Jeol Kim Booster while his vocals were provided by SamUIL Lee, who has worked with many Kpop artists in his career, including Seventeen, RIIZE, Peniel of BTOB, and NCT Dream. His character design was inspired by SHINee's Taemin and TXT's Yeonjun.
Romin is a South Korean rapper under E Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group E'LAST and it's sub-unit E'LAST U.

Ron is a South Korean singer, currently a member of the boy group WE:A and formerly a member of BIGFLO. He debuted with BIGFLO on June 23, 2014, through the release of their first mini album First Flow, and remained active with the group until announcing his departure from both HO Company and BIGFLO on February 23, 2019. In March 2022, he was introduced as one of the original members of the then-upcoming group WE:A when their official social media accounts were launched.
Ron, stylized as ron, is a South Korean rapper under Indigo Music.

Roni is a South Korean singer and lyricist. He was a member of the group XEED and a pre-debut member of the group OFF THE CUFF under the stage name Rowoon. On March 26, 2021, he made his debut with the digital single, "You Are." He debuted with XEED on December 1, 2022 with the EP "Dream Land". However, he left on January 17, 2023 due to personal circumstances, also leaving the agency Nature Space.

Rookie is a South Korean singer and member of the pre-debut boy group AMBITION under Wells Entertainment. He was first introduced as part of the group’s original five-member lineup on March 14, 2022, through promotional material for their Japanese concert dates. Before joining AMBITION, Rookie was a member of the pre-debut groups ATEEN (2018–2019) and B.I.T (2019–2020). He debuted with ATEEN in Japan on September 1, 2018, but the group later disbanded following serious abuse allegations against their agency’s CEO, which led to contract terminations and public controversy. Rookie later joined B.I.T in 2019, though the group became inactive by 2020. Beyond his idol activities, Rookie has a diverse background in entertainment and fashion. He modeled at the Milano Kids Fashion Show and appeared on MBC’s Surprise Mystery TV and tvN’s Blue Tower. He also contributed to the lyrics of AMBITION’s pre-debut single “Inception.”
Roscoe, also known as goodviberoscoe and previously Young Boy, is a South Korean rapper. He is best known for being a member of the boy group Wonder Boyz.

Bae Si Jun, better known as Roshin, is a South Korean singer under Star Weave Entertainment. He participated in the 2019 survival program World Klass, and was a member of the trainee group JTG Boys. In February 2022, he made his official debut as a member of the boy group JWiiver.

Roux is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment and a member of the upcoming boy group AM8IC. He is also known for participating as a contestant on the survival show Starlight Boys. On July 16, 2024, he was introduced as a member of the male trainee group YOUTOVE under TOV Entertainment. On September 29, 2024, he was announced as a contestant on the Chinese–South Korean survival show Starlight Boys. He was eliminated in episode 9 on December 21 after placing 20th
Rovv is a South Korean singer who debuted under THE VAULT in 2018.

Rowoon, born as Kim Seokwoo, in Ilsan South Korea, is the main vocalist and visual of the boy group SF9 under FNC Entertainment. He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016 with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation". A year after his debut, he started appearing in television drama series such as as "School 2017" , "About Time", and "Where Stars Land". Over the years, he became one of the most popular actors of his generation and starred as main lead in dramas: "Extraordinary You", "She Would Never Know", "The King's Affection" and Tomorrow".
Roy is a Vietnamese singer under Zenith Media Contents. He is a member of the international boy group Z-Boys and part of the co-ed group Z-Stars.

Kim Sang-woo, popularly known as Roy Kim, is a South Korean singer under WAKEONE. He rose to fame after becoming the winner of Superstar K4 back in 2012. He made his solo debut on April 22, 2013 with the digital single "Bom Bom Bom". In 2019, Roy Kim was investigated after he was accused of being involved in a hidden camera scandal. He was on hiatus until he was eventually cleared of any suspicions in February 2020. Following this, Roy Kim released the song "Linger On" before enlisting in the military. He completed his service on December 2021.
Royal 44 is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Whip in 2020.
Royce is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment, and a member of their pre-debut trainee group called "YOUTOVE." He participated in the SBS reality show Universe League and ranked 38th.

RubberMan is a South Korean singer, guitarist and bassist, member of the co-ed duo My Yellow Poney. He’s also a solo singer and songwriter. He debuted on February 10, 2020 with the album "Nine is Lucky Number" and the title track "Roe Deer".

Lee Haejoon, also known as Rubin, is a member of the now disbanded boy group 1TEAM under Liveworks Company. He is known for appearing in survival shows "Boys24" and "Mixnine". Although Rubin was eliminated in Boys 24, he was able to make it to the final debuting group in Mixnine however the plans fell through.
Rudals is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Brand New Music in 2017.
Ruha is a member of the South Korean boy group Fallanc.

Rui is a South Korean rapper under Forest Network. He is a former member of the boy group Seven O'clock. He was introduced as a contestant of the survival show Under Nineteen on October 25, 2018 as part of the rap team. He was eliminated in episode 9 after placing 13th in the rap team. In 2021, he participated in the survival program Wild Idol. On August 14, 2024, he was introduced as a contestant of the SBS M's reality survival show SCOOL, but he was eliminated in the tenth and final episode. On April 16, 2025, he was introduced as a contestant of the SBS M's reality survival show AFTER SCOOL.

Rui also known as Hou Guan Yi is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment. He is a member of the trainee group YOUTOVE. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Chen Kuan Jui, or simply Rui, is a Taiwanese singer and member of the boy group XLOV. He is best known for being a contestant on the 2022 survival show, "Boys Planet." On December 19, 2024, he was revealed as the second member of the upcoming boy group XLOV.

Ruka is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He placed fourth on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the upcoming boy group aoen. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group 24kumi. He was also a contestant on the reality survival show iCON Z ~Dreams For Children~.

Shiroiwa Ruki, more commonly known as Ruki, is a Japanese singer and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".
Ryan is an American singer under WAYF. He made his solo debut on July 31, 2025 with the single "Arojin". He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Ryan is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Kim Ryeo Wook is a South Korean singer, songwriter, DJ, TV personality and musical actor under Label SJ, a subsidary of SM Entertainment. He is best known for being the main vocalist of the boy group Super Junior and its sub-units Super Junior K.R.Y and Super Junior M.
Ryo is a Japanese singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY.
Mitsui Ryo is a Japanese rapper and dancer. He was a member of the Korean-Japanese boy group "NIK".

Ryo is a Japanese singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of NCT and it's Japan based sub-unit NCT Wish. On July 10, 2023, Ryo was announced as one of the contestants in SM Entertainment's NCT UNIVERSE : LASTART, along with Riku.

Ryota is a singer and streamer who was previously in the virtual group ARRIVAL. On June 10, 2024, it was announced that he would be leaving the group due to personal matters. The following day, he made his final broadcast.

Ryota is a Japanese singer and member of the boy group ONE OR EIGHT. He is known for his impressive acrobatic skills, which were notably showcased in pre-debut performances such as 'KAWASAKI'. Ryota was the second member announced to debut under ONE OR EIGHT through their survival show WARPs DIG.
Ryou Kaito is a Japanese-Chinese trainee. He is recognized for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Ryu is a Filipino-Japanese trainee under SM Entertainment announced as a participant in the survival show NCT Universe : LASTART.
Ryu Han Il is South Korean trainee. He gained fame after appearing on the survival show Fan Pick.
Hayashi Ryuta is a Japanese singer based in South Korea. In September 2021, he debuted as the vocalist of Korean-Japanese group "Nik".

Choi Seung Cheol, better known by his stage name S.Coups, is a South Korean rapper, singer, dancer, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the leader, lead rapper and sub vocalist of the boy group SEVENTEEN. S.coups is also the leader of the group's Hip Hop unit SVT HIPHOP Team. S.Coups debuted as the leader of SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015 with their first mini album "17 Carat".
SADVAY is a South Korean rapper-songwriter under 220 Entertainment. He made his debut as YunGGI on February 18, 2019 with his first digital single, "OxO".
Saebyeok is a South Korean singer and dancer. He was a member of the virtual group AEONIT before it disbanded.
Saebyeol is a South Korean singer signed with HOWLING Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WAKER and is best known for participating in the reality show Produce X 101.

Saejin is a South Korean singer and member of SUPERKIND under Deep Studio Entertainment. He is the first virtual human to be active as a member of a KPOP boy group. From 2019, he joined Deep Studio and received attention as a virtual idol trainee. He was active on SNS such as Instagram and TikTok and had many followers, and was introduced as a virtual influencer at the time. He was revealed as a YOURS member at the beginning but he left from the group on June 17, 2021.
Saeron is a South Korean singer under Sony Music Entertainment Korea. He is a member of the boy group KJRGL.
SaGang is a member of the boy group TheEastLight.
Saho is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment and a member of the upcoming boy group AM8IC. On September 1, 2025, he was revealed as one of the group’s members.

Sakuya is a Japanese singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of NCT and its Japan based sub-unit NCT Wish. He was first introduced as a participant in the survival show NCT Universe : LASTART in which he finished in 2nd place.

Sam Kim is an American singer-songwriter, producer, and guitarist based in South Korea. He gained recognition as the runner-up of the talent show K-pop Star 3. He is signed to Antenna Music and made his official debut on April 10, 2016, with the EP I Am Sam, followed by his studio album Sun and Moon on November 22, 2018. Sam Kim is widely known for contributing to popular K-drama soundtracks, including "Love Me Like That" for the Netflix drama Nevertheless in 2021, and "Say You Love Me" for the 2022 drama My Demon.

Samuel (also known as Kim Samuel & previously as Punch) is a Korean-American singer. He was known for becoming a potential member of SEVENTEEN, one-half of the former duo 1PUNCH, and for participating in Produce 101 Season 2 where he placed 18th in the finale. He made his solo debut on August 2, 2017, with the mini album 'Sixteen'.
Samuel Seo is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and record producer, who debuted under Digital Record in 2010. He is the brother of Janet Suhh.

San is a South Korean singer, dancer, songwriter, and actor under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ which debuted on October 24, 2018 with the mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero". In 2021, San made his acting debut in the KBS drama Imitation, portraying Minsoo, a member of the fictional boy group SPARKLING.

Jung San, best known by the stage name San E, is a South Korean rapper, and songwriter. He debuted on September 13th, 2010 with his first mini-album, "Everybody Ready?" signed under JYP Entertainment, also being the company's first solo-rapper. San E was more recognized by the Korean hip-hop community after he jokingly dissed South Korean rapper, Verbal Jint in one of his songs. Verbal Jint then asked San E to join his hip hop crew, Overclass. San E collaborated with South Korean singer, Raina from After School with the single, "A Midsummer Night's Sweetness". The song was an instant hint and achieved #1 on the 10 music charts shortly after release. The song also won awards during that year at the Gaon Chart K-pop Awards, Melon Music Awards, and the Seoul Music Awards. In 2013, San E left JYP Entertainment where he later signed with Brand New Music. In late 2018, San E made a series of controversial remarks about feminism. Due to the controversy, Brand New Music terminated his contract on December 6th, 2018.

Sanchung, also known as D.on and Ha Don, is a South korean singer, rapper, and DJ. He is best known as a member of the boy group JJCC. He made his group debuted on March 24, 2014 with the single album "At First". During his time as an idol, he participated in the second season of Mnet's survival show Produce 101.

Sandeul is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the South Korean boy group B1A4, which debuted on April 23, 2011. He eventually debuted as a solo artist on October 4, 2016, with the mini album "Stay As You Are".

Leesang, also known as Sang, is a South Korean singer and actor. He is a member of the boy group IMFACT and a former member of the fictional boy group X-PIERS. Leesang debuted with IMFACT on January 27, 2016, with the single album Lollipop. On January 3, 2022, he announced his departure from Star Empire Entertainment following the expiration of his contract. The next day, it was confirmed that all members of IMFACT had parted ways with the agency.
Sang Lin is a Chinese trainee under Liangcheng Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Sangdo is a South Korean singer under Hunus Entertainment. He is a leader of the boy group XENO-T. He participated on the idol rebooting project show The Unit but didn't pass the auditions.
Sanggyu is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group BEATWIN under Elen Entertainment which he was announced to have left on July 16, 2015.
Sanggyun, formerly known as A-Tom, is a South Korean rapper currently under Star Road Entertainment. He is one half of the duo JBJ95 and a former member of the boy groups JBJ and ToppDogg.

Sangha is a South Korean singer under NOMAD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NOMAD. He is best known for participating in the reality survival show Wild Idol. On August 10, 2021, Sangha was introduced as the 18th contestant of Wild Idol but was eliminated in the third episode. Despite this setback, on December 15, 2023, he was announced as a member of NOMAD, with the EP "Nomad".
Sanghee is a South Korean singer and dance teacher. He is a member of the boy group FREE PASS and was previously a member of B.HEART and Road Boyz.
Lee Sang Ho is a South Korean singer and former member of the boy group INX under NA Entertainment.
Lee Sangho is a South Korean trainee under Gost Entertainment. He first appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
Sang Ho is a South Korean singer and dancer. He is a member of EPIC TRAVELS and a former member of the boy group SNUPER.
Sanghoon is a former member of 100%.
Sanghyeon is a singer and member of the group A.Cian.

Sangil is a South Korean singer under Monster Brain and a member of the upcoming boy group EPIC TRAVELS. He debuted with SNUPER in 2015 and later competed on The Unit in 2017, finishing in 35th place. On February 20, 2025, he was announced as a member of EPIC TRAVELS. He enlisted in the military on July 20, 2020, but was discharged early on April 2, 2021, due to health reasons.

Sangmin is a South Korean rapper. He is a member of the boy group CROSS GENE and responsible for low-tone rap within the group. On December 31, 2019, it was announced he decided not to renew his contract with Amuse Korea due to his enlistment.

Sangmin, formerly known as L.Min, is a South Korean singer and member of theboy group NTB. Before debuting in NTB, originally called Naughty Boys, he debuted in the group PUREBOY on November 19, 2014.

Sangtae is a retired South Korean singer-songwriter. He is best known for being a member of the boy group O.P.P.A and it's sub-unit OPPA 007. He is one of two original members to stay in the group up until it's disbandment.

Sangwon is a South Korean trainee under GRID Entertainment. He is a member of the project boy group ALPHA DRIVE ONE and the upcoming duo Leo & Sangwon and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A. In June 2025, he was revealed as a contestant of the survival show Boys II Planet.
Sangwon is a South Korean singer, rapper, and producer under Hunus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XENO-T. Sangwon is part of HEENT, a producer duo.
Sangwoo is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.
Kim Sang Woo is a South Korean singer under Bluedot Entertainment. He debuted as the lead dancer and Maknae of the boy group JUST B.
Sangwook is a South Korean rapper and member of the boy group N.tic.
Sangwook is a South Korean former rapper. He joined the boy group TOUCH in 2013.
Lee Sang-Yeon is a South Korean singer and songwriter under ONE HUNDRED. He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the leader and lead vocalist of the 11-member boy group The Boyz.

Yoon San Ha is a South Korean singer and actor under Fantagio. He is widely recognized as the maknae and lead vocalist of the boy group ASTRO and its first-ever sub-unit Moonbin & Sanha. Sanha participated in the second Fantagio iTeen audition, showcasing his singing and guitar skills. He joined Fantagio as a trainee on December 16, 2012, and was later officially introduced through the Fantagio iTeen Photo Test Cut on February 4, 2014. He debuted as the youngest member of ASTRO on February 23, 2016, with the album "Spring Up". Additionally, Sanha debuted in the sub-unit Moonbin & Sanha alongside fellow member Moonbin on September 14, 2020, with their first extended play "In-Out".

Sanho is a singer and dancer in the boy group WE GO-6. He is the third member revealed through a short video on the group's social media platform. He had a brief appearance on Hale's second broadcast, but has not had an introductory broadcast yet.
Kang Sani is the bassist and sub-vocalist for Catch The Youth. He was revealed on June 22, 2021. He made his debut on November 1st, 2023, with the mini album, ‘Catch The Young : Fragments of Youth‘.

maleIdols.description: Pongsapak Oudompoch, known as Santa, is a Thai actor, singer, and member of the project boy group PROJECT JASP.ER under RISER MUSIC. The group debuted on December 19, 2024, with the single "แรงอีกนิด (SADISTIC)." Santa first gained recognition as a contestant in GMMTV's "Thailand School Star 2019" and began his acting career in 2021 with Studio Wabi Sabi, debuting in the series "7 Project." He is notable for his roles in "My Only 12%" (as Cake), "Between Us" (as Wiew), and "War of Y" (guest role). In 2024, after participating in the South Korean survival show "Fantasy Boys," Santa joined GMMTV. He is currently pursuing a degree in Digital Marketing Communication and Branding at Rangsit University.

names.native: วัชรวิศว์ สรสุริยวงษ์

maleIdols.description: Santa is a Thai trainee under KONGTHUP. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Santa Paine is a South Korean producer who debuted under GB Studio in 2020.
Satoshi is a Japanese singer under DND ENS. He is a member of the boy group SWEET:CH. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Scene is a Japanese singer currently under Startree Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group MY ONE and previously promoted under the name Ryushin as a member of the Japanese boy groups SKYXROS and SAFIRE. With experience in both J-pop and K-pop industries, Scene brings a versatile background to the group’s evolving identity.
Se7en is a South Korean singer under Starit Entertainment. He released his first album Just Listen on March 8, 2003 and held his debut stage on MBC's Music Camp on March 22.
Sea is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
Sean is a member of the pre-debut co-ed group ChoCo. He is set to debut sometime in 2023.He is the younger brother of Bohme Sara.
Sewoong Park iis a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and indie musician under Media Dream Net. He is known for blending rap, indie, and rock/metal styles.

Sebin is a singer and lyricist in the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly in the boy group SNUPER. On June 5, OMEGA X' label IPQ Entertainment revealed Sebin would be enlisting for his mandatory military service on July 16. The label further revealed Sebin is enlisting as an active-duty soldier.

Sebum is a South Korean singer signed with HOWLING Entertainment. He holds the position of the youngest member, or maknae, in the boy group WAKER. Previously, he was part of the pre-debut group DREAMER. Sebum has also participated in the reality shows CAP-TEEN and Stars Awakening.

Sechan is a South Korean trainee under Cube Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ and the pre-debut team Cube Tree. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.
Seeun is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as one of the vocalists of the boy group xikers.
Sehan is a singer and dancer who debuted on August 22, 2024, with the group AFOTS. On December 27 of the same year, it was announced that he would be leaving the group.
Sehee was a member of the boy group A.Cian.

Oh Se Hun is the lead dancer, lead rapper, and youngest member of the famous boy group EXO under SM Entertainment. Sehun was only 12 when an SM Casting Manager approached him while he was having lunch with his friends. Thinking it was a scam, he ran away but was followed for about 30 minutes until he was finally convinced to audition. He became an official trainee in 2008 and made his official debut with EXO in 2012. On July 22, 2019, Sehun debuted as a member of the group's sub-unit EXO-SC with the mini album "What a Life," alongside fellow member Chanyeol. Sehun enlisted for his mandatory military service, as a public service worker, on December 21, 2023. He is expected to be discharged on September 20, 2025.
Se Hyeon is a South Korean singer under DONGYO Entertainment. He made his official debut on April 12, 2022 as one of the newest members of the group DKZ.

Oh Sehyun is a South Korean singer, pianist, and actor. He is best known for being a former member of the boy group Apeace. Originally a member of the group's sub-unit Apeace Jade, he was placed in Apeace Lapis5 after lineup changes to the main group. He officially left the group on July 29, 2018.
Seita is a Japanese singer and a member of the boy group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 7th in "Nizi Project Season 2."
Seita was born as Takizawa Seita on February 21, 2003 in Yokohama, Japan. He made his debut as a member of the boy group DXMON under SSQ ENTERTAINMENT on January 17, 2024.
Seita is a Japanese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL. He is a member of the dance crew HRC BEAST CREW and was a member of HRC KiDS Dance Crew.
Sejin is a South Korean Singer. He is the maknae of the boy group Celest1a.

Sejin is a South Korean singer under Mainbase Entertainment. He is the youngest member of the boy group D-ONE and a former member of the boy group 14U. He made his official debut with 14U on July 22, 2017 and remained with the group until their disbandment in 2019. Following the group's disbandment, he was involved in several pre-debut projects, including UTH, YOURS, C On H, and FLORET, all of which disbanded before officially debuting. In 2023, he was added to the boy group D-ONE after the departure of Kim Doyul.

Lim Se-jun is a South Korean singer under Way Better. He is best known as the lead vocalist, visual, and face of the boy group VICTON under IST Entertainment (formerly Play M Entertainment). He officially debuted with the group on November 9, 2016 with the mini album, "Voice To New World". On December 17, 2024, IST Entertainment announced that Lim Se Jun would be leaving the company ahead of the expiration of his exclusive contracts with IST Entertainment. Artist's From20 and Hello Gloom announced Sejun as a new artist of their company, Way Better label, on February 19, 2025. It was later announced that he would be making his solo debut on May 16, 2025, with the single "You're My Summer".
Semi is a South Korean rapper who debuted under M.B.A Crew as a member of MBA.
Sen is a Japanese trainee under iNKODE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Seo In Guk is a South Korean singer and actor currently signed under Story J Company and AER MUSIC. He first gained widespread recognition after winning the inaugural season of M.net's Superstar K, debuting as a singer on October 27, 2009, with his first mini album, Bureunda. On February 24, 2017, Jellyfish Entertainment announced Seo In Guk's scheduled military enlistment for March 28. However, due to an osteochondral lesion in his left ankle, he was discharged on March 31. Following this, he underwent a medical reevaluation at the Seoul Regional Military Manpower Administration on April 27 and an additional examination at the Central Physical Examination Center on June 5. On June 14, Jellyfish Entertainment issued a statement confirming that Seo In Guk had been diagnosed with osteochondritis dissecans in his left anklebone, resulting in a grade five health classification, exempting him from mandatory military service. Seo In Guk has built an impressive portfolio in both film and television. His film credits include No Breathing (2013), Wild Dog (2014), Pipeline (2020), and Project Wolf Hunting (2022). On television, he gained popularity through dramas such as Love Rain (2012), Reply 1997 (2012), The Master's Sun (2013), High School King of Savvy (2014), Squad 38 (2016), Doom at Your Service (2021), and Café Minamdang (2022). Additionally, he has made notable music video appearances, including K.Will's "Please Don't..." (2012) and "No Sad Song For My Broken Heart" (2024).
Seo Ji Ho is a South Korean trainee. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 9.
Seo Jinwon is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Seo Kang Joon is a South Korean actor under Man of Creation (M.O.C). He made his acting debut in 2012 in the drama To The Beautiful You. He is a member of the actor-singing group 5urprise under Fantagio.

Seo Kyoungbae is a South Korean singer under UNCORE. On September 26, 2024, he was announced as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which began airing in October 2024. He successfully secured a spot in the final lineup, placing 4th, and became a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.

Seo Kyoungsoo is a founding member of Mandong, formed in 2019, debuting on August 18, 2020. As the drummer, he has significantly shaped the band's style and sound with his complex and dynamic rhythms. While there is limited public information about his personal life, Seo Kyoungsoo is celebrated for his musical talent and dedication, playing a crucial role in establishing Mandong's unique identity in the Korean music scene.
Seo Myeonho is a South Korean bassist. He is a member of the band SORAN, with whom he debuted on August 19, 2010, with the release of their first EP "Why Didn't I Know It Then?".
Sangwoo is a South Korean trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group XODIAC.He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Jeong Hyeon Cheol, popularly known as Seo Taiji, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, musician, and producer. He rose to become an influential music icon and one of the most successful artists of the country, even earning the nickname "Culture president". Seo Taiji's passion for music began at a very young age. He joined different amateur rock bands until he was recruited to join the heavy metal band Sinawe. Seo Taiji eventually decided to drop out of high school to pursue music full time, and from this, he slowly worked on his musicality and career growth. In 1992, Seo Taiji formed the group Seo Taiji and the boys, along with Yang Hyun Suk and Lee Juno—together, they found immediate success. They released different music and presented styles that resonated with the younger generation, eventually becoming the catalyst of Korean pop's development. In 1996, after Seo Taiji and The Boys' disbandment, Seo Taiji retired and flew to America. In 2000, Seo Taiji returned to South Korea and pursued a solo career in music.

Seo Tale is a singer, dancer and rapper under Oort Entertainment. He is a member of the virtual group Sphaze. He was the third to be revealed and the second to do a live broadcast, dated December 1, 2023.
Seo Woohyeok is a South Korean trainee and actor under SM Entertainment. He is part of the trot boy group MYTRO.
Seo Wooyeon, formerly known as Siwoo, is a South Korean actor and former singer. He was a member of the boy group C-CLOWN.
Seo Yuan is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy groups NOM and TST, where he went by the stage name K.
Seo Yun Deok is a South Korean trainee. He was a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1 where he made it to the live finale.
Seobin is a South Korean trainee under Biscuit Entertainment. He is set to debut as a member of the boy group HAWW on February 23, 2023.

Seochan is a member of the upcoming 4-member boy group WEUS. He was revealed as a new member on June 3, 2024. He is a former member of the pre-debut group ACHV/ CODE:VVID (2023) under the name Seungyou.
Seogyeom was introduced as a new member of L5ST on August 23, 2024. So far no other details are known at this time.

Park Gyeong-bok, also known as Park Seoham, is a South Korean singer, actor, and model under NPIO Entertainment.
