Lee Seung-hyun was a South Korean singer, songwriter, record producer, actor, and entrepreneur. In the mid-2000s, Seungri rose to prominence as one of three vocalists and youngest member of the South Korean boy band BIGBANG under YG Entertainment, which eventually became one of the best-selling digital group of all-time in Asia and one of the best-selling boy bands in the world. With the release of the group's second studio album Remember (2008), in which the second single released, "Strong Baby". On March 11, 2019, Seungri departed from BIGBANG and retired from the entertainment industry after being involved in different legal cases. He was indicted in 2020 after the police investigation of the Burning Sun scandal but the investigation showed that he had no connection to that case. The same happened with the Chat Molka case, both cases being completely different from the original case for which he was brought to trial. His original case was mainly centered on the illegal exchange of money, gambling and allegedly contracting sexual services for other people. Seungri's military trial commenced on September 16, 2020, where he denied 8 out of his 9 charges, only admitting to the violation of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. A military court sentenced Seungri to three years of imprisonment and a fine of 1.15 billion won (970,000 USD) on 12 August 2021. During the investigation, the defence showed evidence of the intervention of politicians in the case and police abuse, as well as altered texts presented by different media outlets that led to the confusion of the case and pressure from the general public until today. He appealed the sentence but the military court denied any appeal despite having all the testimonies in his favor and no evidence of the crimes for which he was being prosecuted according to the legal documents reported. In February 2023, Seungri completed his sentence and was released from prison. Since then he has kept a low profile with his family and close friends.

Although Shohei was initially slated to join NCT New Team, he was unable to do so due to a severe back injury in May 2023. However, SM Entertainment clarified that he remained with the company and has plans for future solo activities.

Ohira Shosei, more commonly known as Shosei, is a Japanese singer, dancer, and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Shotaro is a Japanese rapper signed under SM Entertainment. He is part of the boy group RIIZE and a former member of the boy group NCT and its sub-unit NCT U. He was introduced through a V Live broadcast as a new member of NCT on September 23, 2020, along with Sungchan. They joined the group for the album NCT Resonance Pt. 1 and participated in the song “Make A Wish (Birthday Song).”
Tanaka Shotaro is a member of the Japanese boy group 'DXTEEN'. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".

Shownu, born Sohn Hyun-woo, is the leader, main dancer, and lead vocalist of the boy group MONSTA X under Starship Entertainment. As a trainee, he was part of the project group Nu Boyz, alongside MONSTA X member Jooheon and former member Wonho. In 2014, he debuted in MONSTA X after competing on Mnet’s No.Mercy.
Shoya is a Japanese trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Shuaibo is a Chinese singer under Well Entertainment. He was first known for being a contestant in the survival show Youth With You 3, where he ranked 100th place and was eliminated. In 2023, he was a contestant on MNET's survival show Boys Planet, where he was also eliminated after ranking 28th. He also became a contestant on SBS' survival show Universe League, where his team "Team Rhythm" won the Prism Cup, securing him a spot as a member of the final group AHOF.

Shuhyang is a South Korean singer and V-Tuber under 99Major. In August 2023, it was announced that he would be joining the virtual group For The More as the main vocalist, and he debuted with the group on September 30, 2023, with the single "Love Set".

Shun, formerly known as Seul Chan, is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy groups XD and TARGET. He made his official Korean debut on January 24, 2018, with the group TARGET. However, he later left the group in 2020. Three years later, on July 27, 2023, he was introduced as a new member of XEED (now XD) under the stage name Shun. He made his debut with the group on August 1 with the release of their second mini album Blue. On July 30, 2025, it was announced through XD's official twitter that Shun would be leaving the group.
Shupie is a South Korean rapper under DLMG Entertainment. He is also part of the SNK Crew.
Shuto is the vocalist of FNC Entertainment's boyband, Hi-Fi Un!corn.
Ren Shuyang, popularly known as Shuyang, is the lead vocalist, rapper, and youngest member of the Chinese boy group Boy Story under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China.
Sian (T21) is a South Korean rapper and singer under MLD Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TFN.
Siddhant Arora, also known as Sid, was an Indian singer formerly under Zenith Media Contents. He was the main vocalist of the international boy group Z-Boys and a member of the co-ed group Z-Stars.
Sign is a South Korean singer under All-S Company. He is a member of MAP6.

Yang Siha, also known as Siha, is a retired South Korean singer and the former main vocalist of the disbanded boy group NOIR. In 2024, Siha and five other members successfully terminated his contract with LUK Factory following a legal dispute over the agency's failure to meet its obligations. Shortly after, Siha announced his retirement from the entertainment industry to focus on his personal life. He also shared plans to enlist in the military later that year.

Kim Siheon, also known as Siheon, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and a former member of the disbanded boy group NOIR. In 2024, Siheon and several fellow members successfully terminated his exclusive contract with LUK Factory after winning a lawsuit highlighting significant agency violations. He is the brother of BADKIZ Seoeun. He is also a music producer for VILLAINX MUSIC.
Sihoo is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.
Sihoo is a vocalist in N.Sonic.
Sihoon is a South Korean singer under Startree Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ENPHAZE and a former member of F.able.
Kim Sihyoung is a South Korean model and former rapper. He was a member of the boy group HISTORY.
Choi Sihyuk is a South Korean trainee under Around Us Entertainment. He appeared on the show "Produce X 101".

Choi Sihyuk is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the boy group Apeace, its sub-units Apeace Onyx and Apeace Lapis5, and a pre-debut member of the project group NIK. Sihyuk was added to Apeace in 2014, following the departure of former member Myungeun. He made his debut through the group's sub-unit Onyx on April 9, 2014. After multiple members left the group, the sub-units were reorganized, and he was moved to Lapis5 (originally Lapis). In 2020, he participated in the survival show G-EGG. During the finale, he secured a spot in the debut team. Although he was set to debut in NIK, he ultimately decided to withdraw before the group's official debut.
Jeong Sihyun is a South Korean singer, actor, and model. He is also known to have participated in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2".

Sik-K, born Kwon Min-sik, is a prominent rapper, singer, and songwriter best known for his melodic & versatile sound that blends hip-hop, trap, and R&B. He first came into the spotlight as a contestant on Show Me the Money 4 in 2015, where he joined Team AOMG (Jay Park and Loco) and reached the Top 16. This appearance boosted his visibility in the Korean hip-hop scene. In 2016, he made his official debut with the EP FLIP, released under the independent crew OTC (Outside the Circle). In 2017, he signed with H1GHR MUSIC, a label founded by Jay Park and Cha Cha Malone to bridge Korean and American hip-hop artists. Beyond his solo ventures, Sik-K is a member of the influential hip-hop collective Yelows Mob, which includes producers and artists such as GroovyRoom, Mac Kidd, Boycold, and Vangdale, who are frequent collaborators. He released his first full-length album FL1P (2019), followed by HEADLINER (2020) before enlisting for mandatory military service. Fans of Sik-K often praise his production choices and emotional openness. Fan favorite tracks include “Fire,” “HALF,” and "Ring Ring”. After completing his military service and fulfilling his contract with H1GHR MUSIC, Sik-K left the label in 2022 and established his own company, KC (Kwon Min-sik Company) the following year, where he currently serves as CEO. In April 2025, Sik-K was sentenced to a two-year suspension, probation, and 40 hours of drug prevention education after voluntarily surrendering for multiple drug offenses. His swift return to performing—resuming festival appearances just 48 hours after sentencing—sparked controversy. Public opinion was divided, with some criticizing his actions while others acknowledged his remorse and voluntary surrender. Despite the controversy, Sik-K received major recognition at the 2025 Korean Hip-Hop Awards. He won Artist of the Year, KC won Label of the Year, HAON and Sik-K took Music Video of the Year for “KC (BUST IT DOWN),” and Vangdale earned Producer of the Year. The same year, Sik-K released K-Flip+, a deluxe version of his collaborative EP with Lil Moshpit. The album samples traditional Korean sounds from artists of various genres like Silica Gel (indie rock), Kim Sawol (folk indie), Epik High, Dok2, The Koxx, Verbal Jint, and Jay Park (hip-hop), bridging old and new influences.
Simba is a member of JJCC. He was a participant on MIXNINE. He enlisted for his mandatory military service on January 22, 2018.

Simon Dominic, previously known as Ssam D, K-OUTA & Simon D, is a South Korean rapper currently under Jay Park’s label, AOMG. He first appeared into the Korean hip-hop scene as K-OUTA, rapping underground in the early 2000’s, even being called the best rookie in the underground scene.
Simon Park is a South Korean former singer. He was a member of the project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018, with the single "Haeyo Haeyo".

Sims (also stylized as $IM$) is a South Korean rapper and producer. He is a former member of the Korean hip-hop group M.I.B. Before debuting in the group, he released a solo as a part of a spin-off promotion to prove that each member is capable of standing alone.

Sing is a Hong Kongese trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group XODIAC. He was revealed as a member of the pre-debut boy group OCJ NEWBIES (later XODIAC), going by the temporary name SM, on September 28, 2022. He was formally unveiled as a member of the group on October 23, 2022, performing under the stage name Sing. Concept photographs for Sing's pre-debut single 'Calling' were released on March 9, 2023, marking Sing's official confirmation as a member of XODIAC. They made their debut with the digital song 'Throw A Dice' on April 25, 2023.
SiO is a member of the korean boy group SUPERKIND in which he is the maknae and vocalist.
Kim Sion is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He is the maknae of the boy group YOUNITE.
Kim Sang Yeob, also known as Sion, is a South Korean singer. He is the lead vocalist and maknae of the boy group MVP.

Sion is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of NCT and the leader of Japanese-based sub-unit NCT Wish. On June 28, 2023, Sion and Yushi were announced as new members of SM Entertainment's trainee team SMROOKIES, and future members of NCT Wish. They debuted on February 21, 2024, with the single "Wish".
Park Sion is a South Korean idol trainee under Plasma Entertainment. He appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

maleIdols.description: Sirin is a Thai trainee and contestant in the SBS survival show "Universe League."
Siryu is a South Korean singer under Top Cloud Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Like A Movie and was a member of the boy group N2.
Siu is a South Korean singer and dancer. He is a former member of the boy group DUSTIN in which he debuted on January 6, 2020. Siu is also a former member of the groups Challenger and SAVE.

Siunn, formerly known as Byunghun, is a South Korean singer and model under NabiRey Entertainment. He was originally a member of the boy group Apeace and its sub-unit Lapis. However, he left the group on June 30, 2014. Currently he is based in Japan.

Yim Siwan is a South Korean singer and actor under Plum A&C. He began his entertainment career as a member of the boy group ZE:A and eventually debuted as an actor through the hit drama "The Moon Embracing the Sun," launching him to fame. After that, Siwan continued to star as supporting characters in dramas "Man From the Equator," "Standby," and "Triangle," until he landed his lead role in "Misaeng." Since then, Siwan has continued to take on lead roles and eventually became one of the most popular actors of his generation. He also played a prominent role as Lee Myung-gi (nicknamed “MG Coin”) in the second and third seasons of the globally acclaimed drama Squid Game, which aired in 2024 and 2025, respectively.

Choi Si Won is a South Korean singer, songwriter, model, and actor. He is famous for being the vocalist, visual, and face of the group Super Junior and its sub-unit Super Junior-M under SM Entertainment.

Siwoo is a South Korean singer under Black Bear Records. He is a member of the boy group DAYCHILD, former member of the boy group Black Level and a former pre-debut member of the boy group PLATINUM78.

Park Si Woo is a South Korean singer and actor under OAK Company. He is a former member of the boy group BLANK2Y and is also known for participating in the reality survival shows Produce X 101, Wild Idol, and Starlight Boys. He first appeared in 2019 on Produce X 101 as an independent trainee, where he was eliminated in the fifth episode after ranking 81st. In 2021, he competed as the 18th contestant on Wild Idol but was eliminated in the third episode. On February 1, 2022, Keystone Entertainment introduced him as the fourth member of its upcoming boy group BLANK2Y, which officially debuted on May 24, 2022, with the mini album K2Y I: Confidence [Thumbs Up]. In October 2022, he temporarily halted activities after being hospitalized due to poor health and physical exhaustion, following medical advice to rest. In 2024, he joined the cast of the Chinese–South Korean survival program Starlight Boys and was eliminated in episode 5, broadcast on November 23. The following year, on August 19, 2025, OAK Company announced that he had signed with the agency to promote as an actor.

Siwoo, formerly known as JM, is a South Korean singer under Bluedot Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group JUSTB on June 30, 2021 with their mini album "Just Burn". Prior to debuting, Siwoo was known for appearing on the survival show I-LAND. Born Chu Ji-min, he legally changed his name to Chu Si-woo in July 2024 and adopted the stage name Siwoo. That same month, Bluedot Entertainment announced his indefinite suspension from activities, excluding him from both The CrewOne and JUSTB. In November 2024, Bluedot confirmed that JUSTB would resume promoting as six members apart from The CrewOne, marking Siwoo’s return from hiatus.

Siwoo is a South Korean rapper under Wolfburn. He debuted in 2017 as a member of the now-disbanded boy group TRCNG. After the group's disbandment in 2022, he re-debuted on January 30, 2023, as a member of BXB.

Park Siyoung is a South Korean singer under DSP Media. He is a member of the boy group MIRAE. On October 25, 2018, Park Si Young was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the performance team. He was part of the top 19, but was eliminated in the final episode. He debuted as a member of MIRAE on March 17, 2021 with the mini album Killa.

Yun Siyun is a South Korean actor, dancer, and singer under FNC Entertainment. He made his official debut on November 15, 2023 as a member of the boy group AMPERS&ONE. Prior to his debut, he appeared on the YG survival show "YG Treasure Box".
Siyun is a rapper under Cube Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024 with the single album "NOWADAYS".
Skinny Brown, born Lee Chang-ho, is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2019. He hides his identity by wearing a face mask. On March 12, 2021, he joined Daytona Entertainment.
Skull, born Jo Sung-jin is a South Korean rapper who debuted as a member of Stony Skunk in 2003. He later debuted as a soloist in 2011.

Kinjo Sukai, more commonly known as Sky, is a Japanese singer and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Skyminhyuk, born Lee Min-hyuk, is a South Korean rapper who debuted in 2019 under Seed Media. His music blends trap-influenced beats with introspective, and sometimes aggressive lyricism. Beyond studio work, Skyminhyuk gained further recognition through his appearances on multiple seasons of Show Me The Money. Despite mixed reactions, his recent album Liberation was nominated for Hip Hop Album of the Year at the 2024 Korean Hip-hop Awards. He is now active as an independent artist under XXK.
slchld is a independent singer-songwriter. He officially debuted February 1, 2017 with the mixtape motel.
Kim Sung-won, also known as Sleepy, is a South Korean rapper and singer under PVO Entertainment.
Slevin is a South Korean singer and rapper who made his debut on February 5, 2023. His music focuses on hip-hop and RNB styles.
Snacky Chan, born Roy Kim is a Korean-American rapper who debuted under Dynasty Muzik in 2013.
Kim Sun Jae, also known as snzae, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Amoeba Culture in 2019.
So Geon is a Korean-Japanese singer and a member of the boy group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 4th in "Nizi Project Season 2."

So Soo Bin is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Peaches Label. He debuted as an artist on August 2, 2016, with his first digital single, "oh-i". He participated in JTBC 2023/2024 survival show Sing Again 3 and finished in 2nd place.
Sodam is a South Korean singer under DS Entertainment. He is the maknae of the upcoming boy group DV.OL and the former maknae of the boy group BLANK2Y.

Sohee is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a member of the boy group RIIZE. He made his debut on September 4, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar". Mnet announced, on January 5, 2025, that Sohee along with BOYNEXTDOOR's Jaehyun have been selected as MCs of "M Countdown" alongside ZEROBASEONE's Sung Hanbin. Their first appearance was on the January 11 broadcast. Sohee left his role as an MC of "M Countdown" on February 27, 2025. His departure was to allow him to focus on his group's activites.

Yang Seung-ho, known professionally as sokodomo, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Sony Music in 2019. Born to Korean father and Korean-Japanese mother, he lived in the United States when he was young and spent his teenage years in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. He first garnered public attention on High School Rapper 3, where he was well-received for his unique style and eventually went on to contend in Show Me the Money 10, advancing to the semi-finals. His stage name "Sokodomo" means "Korean child" as it is a portmanteau of "South Korea" and "kodomo", which means 'child' in Japanese.

Sol is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the group (M)IRROR under VT Entertainment. Sadly, the group disbanded sometime in 2023. Sol was also a member of the pre-debut group Be on new under Be the max Entertainment in 2022. He left the agency in December of the same year. He is now an acting instructor.
Son Ji-chang is a South Korean actor, singer & songwriter. He was part of the Musical duo The Blue

Son Jin Wook is a South Korean rock singer known for his wide vocal range, versatility, and incredibly powerful high notes. He is the vocalist of the five-member alternative rock/metal band DANGGISIO, which debuted in 2015 with the single “Rope”, followed by two EPs: “Moonlight” and “Last Dream" and the band FIRR that debuted in 2025 with the single "High ’n‘ Low". In 2021, Jinwook participated in the survival show Superband 2, but was controversially eliminated by the judges in the second round, sparking a strong backlash from viewers. Later that year, he joined another competition, Kookmin Singer (Tomorrow's National Singer), where he achieved much better results. Although the producers also appeared unfavorable to him, he once again captured the audience’s hearts, advanced to the finals, and finished in 7th place. This led to his official solo debut with the single “Paradigm”, and a long-term role as a regular performer on TV CHOSUN’s show The Nation Calls. Performing a wide variety of audience-requested songs helped him further refine his skills and expand his mastery across multiple genres. At the end of 2022, he also gained recognition by winning on the mystery music show King of Mask Singer (episodes 186–190). Alongside his solo career, Jinwook launched his official fan café At The Sparkling, and his fandom was officially named Klings. In 2023, he created an official YouTube channel, sharing both original songs and a wide range of vocal covers. At he end of the year started working for BTN RADIO’s as a DJ of Mate ON broadcast and a regular singer on live events. In 2024 he released four new original singles and made his musical theater debut in the lead role of Santiago in the rock musical "Natural Born Idiots", based on the popular manhwa of the same name. In 2025 he won the Best Vocals Award at the 15th Pyeongtaek Band Contest, where he competed with FIRR against 232 other bands from all around the South Korea.

Son Junyong is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the trainee team i-Teen.He is best known for participating in the survival show Stars Awakening. He debuted as a soloist on January 12, 2022, with the digital single “My Butterfly”.
Son Minseok is a South Korean trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

Song, formerly known as Yunhyeong, is the lead vocalist and visual center of boy group iKON, he is also a youtuber, chef and model. He originally auditioned at YG Entertainment as an actor, but due to his quick learning skills he was redirected to train as an idol. He participated in the survival show "WIN: Who Is Next" as part of Team B, then competed for a spot on iKON in "Mix and Match." He modeled for Nivea in 2016 and 2017 (with all members) and in the same year he had her first pictorial with DAZED KR magazine. In 2018 through iKON TV, he was recognized by the group as the "hidden leader" of the group for being the person who takes the most care of the members' health off-camera. He owns a YouTube channel called "Songchelin guide" where he has showcased his cooking skills. He has participated in variety show such as 'Law of the Jungle in Fuji", "Star Crews On Board" and "Sinsun Nolem", he has also appeared in Yu-ri's cooking channel (SNSD). He had his own content in collaboration with Korea Food Promotion Institute in 2021. His official fanbase is called "SONGNIM" and he named it himself through his youtube channel. As a solo artist, he has dedicated himself to the trot genre and has 1 unreleased song called "kilkippappa" and his 1st solo song released through iKON's 3rd full album, called "Fighting".

Song Baekyoung is a South Korean singer and rapper. He was a member of the South Korean hip hop boy group 1TYM under YG Entertainment in which he made his debut in 1998. Song Baekyoung has now his own family and he revealed that he left the industry. He and fellow 1TYM member Oh Jinhwan are business partners and own a restaurant together.

Song Hyungseok is a South Korean trainee and content creator. He gained public attention as a contestant on the 2024 survival reality show Project 7, where he represented the agency SHORTT. He was officially introduced as a participant on September 26, 2024, and competed until episode 8, which aired on November 29, where he was eliminated after placing 54th overall. Following his appearance on the show, Song Hyungseok transitioned into creative work and is currently active as a member of the collaborative content group Season House, where he participates in dance, lifestyle, and visual projects.
Song Namhyun became a member of Mandong in 2021, a year after the group's debut. Prior to joining, there is limited information available regarding his musical background.

Song Seungho is a South Korean singer under Hi-Hat Entertaiment and UNCORE. On September 26, 2024, he was announced as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which began airing in October 2024. He successfully secured a spot in the final lineup, placing 5th, and became a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.

Song Wongeun, previously known by the stage names Hangeul, Blanket, and RUN, is a South Korean singer, actor, and musical theatre actor under Management Run. He made his official debut, under the stage name Hangeul, in April of 2000 as a member of the boy group O.P.P.A. After the group's disbandment, he went on hiatus before returning as a solo artist in 2008 using the stage name Blanket. He later changed his stage name to RUN in 2009 ahead of the release of his first mini album "Face-Off".
Song Yeong Joo is a South Korean singer-songwriter under INHEART MUSIC. He debuted on the 2nd of April 2015 with the single "Alone".
Songho is a South Korean trainee under Think About Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut boy group DREAMER.

Soobin is a South Korean singer-songwriter, and composer under BIGHIT MUSIC and HYBE Labels. He is best known as the leader of the boy group TXT. On January 13, 2019, Soobin was revealed as the second member of TXT (Tomorrow X Together). He made his official debut with the group on March 4, 2019, through their mini-album "The Dream Chapter: STAR".
Soohyun is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.

Shin Soo Hyun is a South Korean singer and actor. He is best known as a member of the South Korean boy group, U-KISS under NH Media. On April 15, 2021, Soohyun announced that his contract with NH Media had expired after 10 years. He revealed that his name as U-KISS's Soohyun has not changed.
Soojin is a member Co-Ed group Messgram

Choi Soomin is a South Korean former singer and actor. He is best known for being a member of the boy group D.I.P. Originally planning to debut in a group called Lose Control alongside Taeha, Seungho, B.Nish and Hyeongseong, the group's debut plans fell through. The five later signed with Inter B.D Entertainment and debuted in the group D.I.P. The group disbanded after only 2 years of activity in November of 2018.
Nam Seunghyun is a South Korean dancer and singer under EZ Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group N.CUS under the name Soon.He is a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.
Soonwoo is the drummer of the Group 1/N
Sota is a Japanese trainee under YX LABELS. He placed third on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the upcoming boy group aoen.

Haku Shota, known under his stage name Soul, is a South Korean-Japanese dancer, rapper, songwriter, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group P1Harmony. On September 16, 2020, Soul was revealed as the second member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
Lee Chan-hee, better known as Soul Chan, is a South Korean singer and Youtuber. He used to be a member of the boy groups A.Cian and Fri.D.
Soul Fish is a South Korean rapper and producer, member of the hip-hop duo Pinodyne.
Iizuka Souma is a Japanese singer, dancer, and the youngest member of the boy group ONE OR EIGHT. He was the first member announced for the group.

Kim Sung Chan, also known as Spax, is a South Korean singer under Jackpot Entertainment. He used to be a member of the now-disbanded boy group Blanc7. He made his official solo debut on October 2019 with the digital single "Fresh Air."
SPICY NERD is a South Korean rapper under Talented. He debuted in 2023.
St. Van, born as Lee Geumhyuk, is a South Korean singer under. He is the leader and main vocalist of the group VAV (Very Awesome Voice).

Steve Lim, Also Known as Lim Do Hyun, is a American singer under Brand New Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group YOUNITE and pre-debut group BRANDNEWZ. Because of his language skills, he usually serves as the group's interpreter.

Steve Yoo, also known as his Korean name Yoo Seung Jun, is a Korean-American singer and actor who became one of South Korea's most popular K-pop singers after his debut in 1997. Yoo's singing career ended in 2002 when he was accused of evading South Korean mandatory military service by becoming a U.S. citizen. He was subsequently banned from entering South Korea, becoming the only person in history to be banned from the country for acquiring another citizenship.

Steven is a Korean-Australian singer and rapper under F&F Entertainment. Steven appeared in MNET' survival show Produce X 101 in 2019 as a trainee employed by DS Entertainment. Regretfully, he was eliminated in the fifth episode, finishing 72nd place overall. On September 9, 2021, he debuted in the group LUMINOUS with the mini album 'YOUTH'. The group unfortunately disbanded on February 9, 2025, after all four members terminated their exclusive contracts with Bareunson WIP. He was a contestant in SBS' survival show Universe League, where his team, the "Team Rhythm", won the prism cup, securing him a spot as a member of the final group AHOF.

Jung Su-bin is a South Korean singer under Echo Global Group. He used to be a Cube Entertainment trainee and was supposed to debut as a member of Pentagon, but things did not work out. With his current group, Victon, Subin aspires to become a recognized musician. Subin eventually debuted as the maknae of VICTON on November 9, 2016, with the mini album Voice To New World.

Suga (Min Yoongi) is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and music producer under Big Hit Music, a subsidiary of HYBE Labels. He is widely recognized as the lead rapper of the Kpop group BTS, one of the most influential acts in global pop music. Before his mainstream debut, Suga was active in the underground rap scene under the name Gloss. He began producing music at the age of 13, eventually joining BTS in 2013. As a soloist, he adopted the moniker Agust D and released his self-titled debut mixtape "Agust D" in 2016, earning critical attention for its raw and introspective themes. In 2020, Suga released his second solo mixtape, "D-2," which debuted at No. 11 on the Billboard 200, setting a new record at the time for the highest-charting release by a South Korean soloist. The mixtape was praised for its blend of social commentary and personal reflection. His first official solo album, "D-DAY," dropped in 2023 and peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200. The title track, "Haegeum," became his fourth solo entry on the Billboard Hot 100, while the album itself topped Billboard’s Top Album Sales Chart. Suga launched his "D-DAY" world tour under the Agust D name in April 2023. The tour concluded in August 2023 and became the highest-grossing concert tour by a South Korean soloist, generating $57.2 million from 28 sold-out shows across the U.S. and Asia, according to Touring Data.
Suhan is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group D.I.P. He left the group after their debut. He was a contestant on Boys24.

Kim Jun Myeon, better known by his stage name Suho (meaning "guardian" in Korean), is a South Korean singer and actor under SM Entertainment. He is the leader and lead vocalist of the boy group EXO and its sub-unit EXO-K. Suho trained for about 7 years before finally debuting in 2012 as the Leader and Guardian of EXO. Suho also worked as an actor in the movie "One Way Trip" and "Student A." Suho has also starred in a lead role in the drama "The Universe's Star" and "Rich Man." Suho debuted as a solo artist on March 30, 2020, with the mini-album "Self-Portrait." He enlisted in the military as a public service officer on May 14, 2020. He completed his service on February 13, 2022.

Choi Suhwan is a South Korean singer under LYNNA Entertainment. He was first known for appearing and finishing 28th on the hit survival program "Produce X 101". He was eliminated in the 11th episode ranking 28th overall. On July 23rd 2020, he announced he opened his own one-man agency called LYNNA Entertainment. On August 20th 2020, Suhwan released his pre-debut single "Starry Night".
Suhyeok s a South Korean trainee under YM Entertainment who is to debut in the boy group, UNNAME.

Su Hyun is a South Korean singer under WIDMAY Entertainment. He is the main vocalist and a member of the boy group SNUPER. In 2017, he participated on the idol rebooting project show The Unit. He was eliminated in the 11th episode and finished in 39th place. Suhyun enlisted as an active duty soldier on February 3, 2020.
Sui, also known as Eco Yard, is a South Korean rapper and producer who debuted under Team Yaya in 2016. He is a member of the co-ed hip-hop group Heartcore.
Suil is a South Korean singer. He was the lead rapper and lead dancer of the boy group LUMINOUS.
Suin is a South Korean singer under Hello!Artist. He is a member of the boy group CREZL.
Sukjun is a South Korean singer under J-Star Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ABLUE. He is also a former member of the boy group ANTARES (Limit).

Sumi Jo is a South Korean lyric coloratura soprano known for her Grammy award-winning interpretations of the bel canto repertoire. She received the Order of the Star of Italy in 2019. Jo is the cousin aunt of South Korean actor Yoo Gun, his father's cousin sister.

Sumin is a South Korean rapper under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as the main rapper of the boy group xikers, with their first mini-album, "House of Tricky: Doorbell Ringing".
Sun is a South Korean singer under All-S Company. He is a member of MAP6 and was previously a member of the boy group A-PRINCE, where he went by the stage name Si Yoon.
Sun,is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under New Planet Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BXK. He made his solo debut on February 13, 2020 with the EP Siren.
Sun Han Lin is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Sun Jia Yang is a Chinese trainee under JS Entertainment. He is best known for competing in the survival shows Starlight Boys and Boys II Planet.

Sun Ying Hao is a Chinese singer under Laoyu Vision Company. He is a former member of the project boy group IXFORM. He made his solo debut on February 15, 2023, with the digital single "You Are You." He is best known for his participation in the survival shows Youth With You 3 and Starlight Boys.

Sunburnkids is a singer-songwriter and visual director under T Cask Entertainment. He is known for his self-taught expertise in music production and visual arts. He has directed and styled music videos for various artists, including Giolpak. In October 2024, Sunburnkids released their first full-length album, "Elephant in the Room," which includes self-directed music videos that reflect their artistic vision.

Sung Hanbin is a South Korean singer under Studio GL1DE. In 2023, he participated in the hit survival show 'Boys Planet,' where he became an instant crowd-favorite and ultimately ranked 2nd place in the final episode, securing his spot in the group ZEROBASEONE. He made his official debut as the leader of ZEROBASEONE on July 10, 2023, with the mini album "Youth in the Shade," under the management of WAKEONE.

Sung Jun is a South Korean actor, singer and model born on July 10, 1990, in Seoul, South Korea. He began his career in the industry as a model before transitioning to acting. He made his acting debut in the 2011 television series "White Christmas". He has been active in various genres such as rom-coms and genre films, is an actor who is expanding his range with his constant acting transformations.
Sung Minseo is a South Korean model under Model Directors Korea. In 2019, he appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Sung Si-kyung is a South Korean singer, entertainer, and TV host. Since his debut in 2001, he has released eight Korean studio albums and two Japanese studio albums. Sung Si-kyung has also been a prominent figure on various South Korean variety shows, such as 2 Days & 1 Night, Witch Hunt, Non-Summit, Duet Song Festival, Vocal War: God's Voice, Battle Trip, The Voice of Korea 2020, and On & Off.
Sung Sub is the main rapper, vocalist, and dancer of the Boy Group, "N.CUS" under Kyuri Entertainment. He is the self-proclaimed charmer and stan-attractor of the group.
Sung Wook is a South Korean singer and guitarist. He was a member of the duo Rayin Tree.

Sungchan is a South Korean rapper under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group RIIZE and a former member of the boy group NCT and its sub-unit NCT U. In September of 2020, it was announced that Sungchan and Shotaro would debut in NCT with the Album NCT Resonance Pt. 1 on October 12. He was officially introduced in a V live broadcast on September 23. Three years later, SM announced Sungchan's departure from NCT to join their new boy group, RIIZE. Their debut single album "Get A Guitar" was released on September 4, 2023.
Sunggu is a former member of High4. After leaving the group in 2017 he debuted as a soloist under a stage name Reno. In 2021 he relesed his second signgle under the name Earth Kim (or Kim Ji-gu).
Jung Sunghak is a South Korean fitness trainer, model and former singer. He is a former member of the boy group BIGSTAR.
Son Sunghee is the guitarist and sub-vocalist of the rock-ballad group BUZZ under Long Play Music. Sunghee got married to his non-celebrity wife on May 13, 2017.
Sungho is a South Korean singer under KOZ Entertainment. He made his official debut on May 30th, 2023 as a member of the boy group BOYNEXTDOOR.
Sungho is a South Korean singer under J-vocal Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group Apeace and its sub-unit Apeace Onyx. He is best known for appearing on the show Mr. Trot 3.
Sunghoon is a South Korean singer under Black Bear Records. He is a former member of the boy group DAYCHILD.

Park Sunghoon is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as the visual of the boy group ENHYPEN. Sunghoon became a figure skater in 2010 and retired in 2020. Sunghoon is the 2016, 2017 junior silver medalist, and the 2015 novice gold medalist of the Asian Figure Skating Trophy, and the 2015 novice gold medalist of the Lombardia Trophy. He also won silver medals in the 2013 novice competition and at the 2014 junior competition of the South Korean Figure Skating Championships. On June 1, 2020, Sunghoon was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked 6th place by global votes and became a member of the boy group ENHYPEN. Sunghoon made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".
Sunghoon is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed trot group OUTLET. He’s also a solo singer. He debuted in 2012 with "For A Long Time".
Sunghoon was a member of the South Korean boy group NRG (New Radiancy Group).
Kang Sung-hoon is a South Korean solo artist and former member of group SECHSKIES, where he served as the main vocalist and visual. Sunghoon debuted as a solo artist on May 25, 2001.
Sunghwan is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group WeNU and a former member of the boy group N.CUS under the name Hwan.

Seo Sunghyuk is a South Korean singer under THINK ABOUT Entertainment. He participated in the second season of the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2." Despite getting eliminated in the 10th episode, Sunghyuk was still able to debut through the project boy group RAINZ. Following RAINZ' disbandment, Sunghyuk joined Think Entertainment and debuted as a soloist. In 2021, he then participated in the survival show "Wild Idol" where he finished fourth place, making him qualified to become a member of the boy group TAN.

Hong Sunghyun is a South Korean trainee under PLUS WIN Entertainment, he is currently a member of a pre-debut group called "Shooter-X". Sunghyun was first known for participating in the hit survival show "Produce X 101" where he ranked 85th,

Yook Sungjae is a South Korean singer and actor under IWill Media. He is the Lead Vocalist, Maknae, and Face of the BTOB. In 2019, he became the group's leader due to Eunkwang's Military Enlistment. He made his debut as a member of BTOB on March 21, 2012, with their first single "Insane". Sungjae enlisted on May 11, 2020, and was discharged on November 14, 2021.
Sungje is a member of the South Korean boy group Supernova.
Sungjin is a South Korean singer and rapper under K-Tigers E&C. He is a former member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO.
Sungjin was a member of the South Korean boy group NRG (New Radiancy Group).

Park Sungjin, or simply Sungjin, is a South Korean musician best known as the leader, main vocalist, and rhythm guitarist of the rock band DAY6 under JYP Entertainment. Sungjin debuted with DAY6 on September 7, 2015, with the EP "The Day" and it's lead single "Congratulations." Known for his distinctive vocal tone and strong stage presence, he has played a key role in shaping the band's musical direction.

Seong Jong is a South Korean singer, best known as the youngest member of the boy group INFINITE and its sub-unit, INFINITE F. He made his solo debut on March 13, 2023, with the release of his single album The One. In addition to his musical career, Seong Jong explored broadcasting as a radio DJ. He hosted his own program, Lee Sungjong's Midnight Black, on EBS for ten months, from August 27, 2018, to June 15, 2019. The show aired from Monday to Saturday at midnight and featured various guests, including his fellow INFINITE members Woo Hyun and Dong Woo, who appeared to promote their solo albums. On June 9, 2021, Seong Jong renewed his contract with Woollim Entertainment after 11 years with the company. Around the same time, he began actively engaging with fans through INFINITE’s official YouTube channel, launching a video series titled What is Sungjong doing?. He also hinted at the possibility of opening his own personal channel. After 13 years under Woollim Entertainment, Seong Jong departed from the agency on January 24, 2022, while remaining a member of INFINITE. Later that year, on September 5, he signed an exclusive contract with SPK Entertainment. His long-awaited solo debut was announced on March 8, 2023, with his single album The One officially released on March 13. In early 2024, Seong Jong faced contractual disputes with SPK Entertainment. On January 16, he announced that he had notified the company of his contract termination in late December 2023 due to a lack of proper support and unpaid earnings. He also stated his intention to take legal action. On March 30, it was confirmed that his exclusive contract with SPK Entertainment had been officially terminated. Regarding his personal life, Seong Jong enlisted for mandatory military service on July 29, 2019. He served as a public service worker and was discharged on May 8, 2021.

Kim Sungjoo is a South Korean Singer and Actor under YueHua Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group UNIQ, serving as the leader and visual during Korean promotions. Despite inactivity in domestic promotions, Sungjoo and his group are currently active in China where they are receiving immense love and recognition.
Park Sung-jun is a South Korean singer under Universal Music Korea. He debuted in 2013 as a member of the boy group "Boys Republic." He also participated in the survival show "The Unit."

Sungjun is a South Korean singer under DS Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group DV.OL and is a former member of the boy group BLANK2Y and a former member of the pre-debut rookie team Woollim Rookie.

Oh Sung Jun is a South Korean singer and dancer under P Nation and a member of the boy group TNX. He was a contestant of the SBS survival program "Loud". He made his official debut on May 17, 2022 as a member of the boy group TNX.

Sungkook, formerly known as Ahxian, is a South Korean singer and lyricist under KLAP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VANNER. On March 22, 2024, it was announced that Sungkook will be enlisting on May 7 as an active duty soldier.

Kim Sung Kyu, also known simply as Sung Kyu, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor under BILLIONS. He is the leader and main vocalist of the boy group INFINITE. He made his solo debut on November 19, 2012, with the release of his mini album Another Me. Sung Kyu debuted as a member of INFINITE on June 9, 2010, with their first mini album, First Invasion. Two years later, on November 19, 2012, he launched his solo career with Another Me, establishing himself as a versatile artist outside of group activities. After more than a decade with Woollim Entertainment, Sung Kyu departed from the agency on March 6, 2021, following the expiration of his contract. His final release under Woollim was the single album Won't Forget You. On June 14 of the same year, he signed a contract with Double H TNE, marking a new chapter in his career. Under his new agency, he released his fourth mini album, Savior, on April 22, 2022. Later that year, on November 7, he announced a special single album, Dear My Fan, in celebration of his 10th solo debut anniversary, which was officially released on November 13. Continuing his musical journey, he unveiled his fifth mini album, 2023 S/S Collection, on June 28, 2023. In mid-2024, Sung Kyu transitioned to a new agency, officially signing with BILLIONS on July 16. Regarding his personal life, Sung Kyu pursued his studies at Dae Kyung University. He enlisted for mandatory military service on May 14, 2018, where he participated in the military musical productions Shinheung Military Academy and Return: The Promise of the Day. During his service, he also recorded a special song alongside other enlisted idols, including Key, Xiumin, Jo Kwon, Jeon Jinwoon, Yoon Jisung, and Changsub. He completed his military service and was discharged on January 8, 2020, receiving an award of appreciation for his contributions.
Sungkyu is part of a group called 1/N
Sungmin is a south korean actor and singer under Management Air. He is a former member of Co-ed School and its male unit SPEED, under MBK Entertainment.
Sungmin is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group BIGFLO and was a member of Able. On December 21, 2021, he made his solo debut with the digital single "Lean On Me".
Sungmin was the main vocalist in the boy group A-Jax. However, he decided to leave the group in 2016 to further pursue his solo career.

Lee Sung Min is a South Korean singer and musical theatre actor. He is best known as the Lead Vocalist and Lead Dancer of SM Entertainment's boy group Super Junior. After 20 years, he officially parted ways with SM on April 30, 2025.
Sungmo was a member of the South Korean boy group Supernova. He left the group in 2019.

Sungoh is a South Korean singer under Choeun Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group 24K and its subunit 4K. In 2016, it was announced he will not participate in any more activities due to his unfinished treatment for his dislocated shoulder and then upcoming enlistment. On January 24, 2019, it was announced that after being discharged from the military, he has returned to Choeun Entertainment.
Park Sungwoo is a South Korean singer and actor under HIM Entertainment. Besides acting in dramas, he has also participated in survival program "Produce 101 Season 2"
Sung Woo is a South Korean singer and lyricist, known for being the vocalist of the boy band D.COY.

Lee Sungwoo is a retired South Korea singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group Apeace in August 2010 and was a member of its sub-unit Apeace Onyx. Sungwoo left the group in late 2011 due to chronic back pain and was replaced by Lee Myungeun.
Jo Sungwook is a South Korean actor and trainee under OUI Entertainment. He participated in the hit survival program "Produce 101 Season 2"

Sungwoong, formerly known as K-Jay, Nankang, and Seowoong, is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group NTB and a former member of the boy groups ESQ and PUREBOY. He first made his debut as a member of ESQ on August 1, 2013. After ESQ'S disbandment, he debuted in the group PUREBOY on November 19, 2014, and later in NTB (then known as Naughty Boys) on August 3, 2016.

Sung Yeol is a South Korean singer and actor under Management 2sang. He is a member of the boy group INFINITE and its sub-unit, INFINITE F. He made his acting debut in 2011 with the drama While You Were Sleeping. He debuted as a member of INFINITE on June 9, 2010, with the release of their mini album First Invasion. Over the years, he actively participated in group activities while also expanding his career into acting. On March 31, 2021, Woollim Entertainment announced that Sung Yeol, along with fellow member Dong Woo, had left the agency following the expiration of their contracts. A few months later, on June 7, it was confirmed that he had signed with Management 2sang. Regarding his personal life, Sung Yeol enlisted for his mandatory military service on March 26, 2019, as an active duty soldier in the 37th Division. His initial discharge date was set for October 27, 2020, but due to military policies aimed at preventing the spread of COVID-19, he was discharged early on October 4, 2020, without returning to his post.
Kim Sung Yeon is a South Korean trainee who participated in survival programs such as MIXNINE, YG Treasure Box, and Produce X 101. He used to be under YG Entertainment and iME Korea.
Sungyong is a South Korean former singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group TOUCH.
Sungyoon (formerly known as Kan) is a South Korean singer and an original member of boy group F.Cuz.

Jung Sungyun is a South Korean singer under n.CH Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group n.SSign on August 9, 2023. Prior to his debut, he participated in the 2022 survival show Stars Awakening, where he secured a spot in the debut group n.SSign.

Sunho, formerly known as Seonghun, and Howoo, is a South Korean rapper and singer under VT Entertainment. He is currently a member of the pre-debut boy group TRY=1. Sunho made his first debut on June 17, 2018, as a member of the group Like A Movie (now known as APEX) under Top Cloud Entertainment. He left the group in December of the same year for unknown reasons. He then, in the same month, joined the group CHAZE under the same agency, which disbanded in May 2020. In June 2020, he was announced as a member of the boy group ONE A DAY which has been inactive since 2020, meaning they probably have silently disbanded. On March 1, 2021, Sunho was revealed as a member of DUSTIN under Na Entertainment, which he probably left when they disbanded on May 24, 2021, as he wasn’t a part of the group when they reformed in December of the same year. He was revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group Be on new under Be the max Entertainment on September 6, 2022. Sadly, the group never debuted as almost all of the members, including Sunho, left the company in December 2022. On January 2, 2023, he was announced as a member of the pre-debut boy group (M)IRROR, under VT Entertainment. The group debuted on May 12, 2023, but presumably disbanded a few months later. Sunho was then revealed as a member of the upcoming boy group TRY1 on March 2, 2024. The debut date of the group is currently unknown but they are set to do pre-debut activities in Japan this year.

Park Sunho is a South Korean singer and actor under SidusHQ. He has acted in music videos, web and television dramas, and movies. He made his solo debut as a singer in 2019 following his appearance in the hit boy group survival program "Produce X 101".

Kim Sunwoo, known under his stage name Sunoo, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under Belift Lab. He is best known as a member of the boy group ENHYPEN. On June 1, 2020, Sunoo was introduced as a contestant in the CJ ENM and Big Hit Entertainment's reality survival show I-LAND. On September 18, 2020, he ranked as the 7th place and became a member of ENHYPEN. Sunoo made his debut as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020, with their first mini album "Border : Day One".

Kim Sun-woo is a South Korean singer, rapper, and songwriter under ONE HUNDRED. As a trainee, he participated in the 2017 reality show 'High School Rapper.' He made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the main rapper of the boy group "The Boyz."
Sunwoo is a South Korean singer. He is a leader of the boy group WeNU and a former member of the boy group VX.
Sunwoo is a South Korean singer under Happy Tribe Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Boys Republic and is a former member of the group TOUCH where he went by Dabin.
He was a member of LST
Kim Sunwoong is a Sourh Korean singer and actor. He was a member of the disbanded boy group TOUCH.

Seon Ye In, also known as Sunyoul, is a South Korean singer. He debuted in September 10, 2015 as the main vocalist of the boy group UP10TION under TOP Media. On December 4, 2023 Sunyoul took to social media to announce that he was picked up by Redstart ENM and would be working with them.

SUPERBEE, born Kim Hoon-gi, is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Super Music on October 26, 2015 with the single "Shark in a Pool". He’s currently under Yng & Rich Records, which he co-founded with fellow rapper UNEDUCATED KID.
