maleIdols.description: Suthaschai is a Thai trainee under DCT. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Jang Su Won is a South Korean singer, dancer, actor and member of the first generation idol boy groups SECHSKIES and J-Walk under YG Entertainment. After SECHSKIES' sudden disbandment in 2000, he and fellow member Jaeduck went on to re-debut in 2002 as a duo, J-Walk. In September of 2013, Suwon made his acting debut in the idol edition of popular drama "Love and War" but was criticised for his poor acting, which has earnt him the nickname of "robot acting". In 2014, people had stopped criticising him due to his nice attitude and good performances later and he has even regained fame with his imitations of his poor acting at variety shows, which gained him many CF opportunities. Suwon had also starred in the drama "Misaengmool", which was a parody version of the popular drama "Misaeng" as the main character Jang GeuRae. However, people were upset with his improved acting skills, and even missed his "robot-acting". After a few years of promotion with J-Walk and focusing on acting and variety shows, Suwon had reunited with SECHSKIES, having a reunion concert through the variety show Infinite Challenge. The group had later signed a contract with YG Entertainment to start promotions again. Suwon had later signed a solo contract with YG Entertainment on November 6, 2017.
Suwoong is a South Korean singer and actor under Studio Santa Claus Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group Boys Republic. He was also a member of the fictional project boy group SPARKLING.
Suzuki Kaira is a Japanese trainee under Starship Entertainment. He is currently a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.
Sviat is a Ukrainian trainee under JT Corea Entertainment. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024 but was eliminated.
Song Seok-hyun, better known under the stage name Sway D, born Song Seok-hyun, is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Jet World Wide Entertainment in 2015.
Sweet The Kid is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer who debuted in 2020. He currently is signed with THE VAULT.
Swings, born Moon Ji-hoon, is a South Korean rapper under P Nation. In 2009, he founded the label Just Music.
Lee Jun Young, better known by his stage name Sya, is a singer under Wuzo Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group Blitzers.
Syo is a Japanese-American trainee. He is known for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Syoma is a Japanese singer. He is set to debut as a member of the boy group I1IT on August 25, 2022.

Kimata Syoya, more commonly known as Syoya, is a Japanese singer, dancer, and rapper. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".
T.K made his official debut as a member of the now-disbanded boy group C-CLOWN. He also used to be a pre-debut member of BTOB.

Choi Seunghyun, popularly known under his stage name T.O.P, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, actor, and music producer under TOPSPOT PICTURES. He gained fame as one of the rappers of the legendary boy group BIGBANG, which became one of the best-selling groups in Asia and one of the best-selling boy bands in the world. In 2010, during BIGBANG's hiatus, T.O.P and G-Dragon formed a duo and released the number-one collaboration album GD & TOP. T.O.P also debuted as a solo artist with two digital singles: "Turn It Up" in 2010 and "Doom Dada" in 2013. On June 5, 2017, T.O.P was investigated for using marijuana following a tip from Han Seo Hee. He was transferred to a different police division and suspended from duty while awaiting prosecution. The following day, T.O.P was found unconscious in a police barracks after overdosing on anti-anxiety medication, leading to his hospitalization. His mother later confirmed that he had regained consciousness and was recovering. At his trial on June 29, T.O.P pleaded guilty to marijuana use in four instances in October 2016 and was given a two-year probation sentence. He was reassigned to complete his mandatory military service as a public service worker at the Yongsan Arts and Crafts Center, resuming service on January 26, 2018. T.O.P was discharged from military service on July 6, 2019. On February 7, 2022, YG Entertainment announced that T.O.P had left the company after his contract ended, though he would continue to be a part of BIGBANG. On May 31, 2023, T.O.P confirmed his departure from BIGBANG but expressed his intent to continue solo activities. T.O.P made a notable appearance in Squid Game 2 as the character Thanos, a rapper who finds himself deep in debt due to a crypto scam.
TA, formerly Rahyun is a South Korean drummer. She was a member of the girl band LA.G.

Kim Hyun-joon, better known as Tabber, is a South Korean alternative rapper and singer who debuted under You.will.knovv. Tabber first gained attention on YouTube with ‘3AM Freestyle’. Prior to his official debut, he worked with artists such as Punchnello, DEAN and APRO, which contributed to his notoriety within the industry. Tabber reached out to DEAN after hearing the latter’s 2015 single ‘Here & Now’. This led to his record deal with You.will.knovv. On August 13, 2020, Tabber released his debut project “Deep End Mixtape, which was well-received. His second EP ‘Madness Always Turns to Sadness’ came in 2023. In 2021, Tabber participated in season 10 of Show Me the Money, finishing eleventh. His appearance on the show captivated the producers due to his unique musicality. Tabber also participated in the HIPHOPLE compilation album ‘The:Rise Season 4’ alongside Northfacegawd, EXN, Oygli and Kwon Ki-baek.

Lee Seon Woong, also known for his stage name Tablo, is the leader and face of the trio Epik High. Aside from being a rapper and a vocalist, Tablo is also a producer. In 2009, Tablo married Actress Kang Hye Jung and they had a daughter named Haru on 2010. Tablo also appeared in the reality show "Superman Returns" with Haru.

Lee Tae Hwan is an actor under the agency Man of Creation (M.O.C) He is also known for being a model and a vocalist in the group 5urprise. His acting debut was in 2013 with After School Bokbulbok. He is best known for his roles in Pride and Prejudice (2014), W (2016), What’s Wrong With Secretary Kim (2018), and Touch (2020).

Tae-U is a South Korean singer and dance teacher. He is a member of the boy group FREE PASS and is a former member of B.HEART, BTL, and Road Boyz. He made his solo debut on November 9, 2017, with the digital single "Finish Talking."
Taebin was a member of now disbanded boy group BLK.

Taecyeon is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, actor and entrepreneur under 51K. He is the main rapper of the boy group 2PM. On July 25, 2018, it was announced that Taecyeon had signed with 51K following his contract expiration with JYP Entertainment after deciding to not renew, but will still be active as a member of 2PM. He made his acting debut in 2010 on KBS2 in the drama "Cinderella Sister".

Kim Tae Dong is a member of the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly part of the predebut group GIDONGDAE. He was a contestant in the popular survival show Produce 101 Season 2 where he placed 30th.
Taeeun is the leader of IM under MBK Enterainment. He was one of the first 4 members to debut before joining "The Unit"
Kwon Taeeun is a South Korean model and trainee under A.CONIC Entertainment. He is first known for appearing in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
Taegeon is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.

Taeha is a South Korean singer. He is best known as a member of the groups D.I.P and XENEX. Originally planning to debut in a group called Lose Control alongside B.Nish, Seungho, Soomin and Hyeongseong, the group's debut plans fell through. The five later signed with Inter B.D Entertainment and debuted in the group D.I.P. The group disbanded after only 2 years of activity in November of 2018. Later in 2019 he, B.Nish (now going by Bon), and Uhyeong debuted in the group XENEX.
Taehee is a member of the South Korean group M.Pire.
Taeheon is a South Korean singer under the group ZE:A. Taeheon made his debut as a member of ZE:A with their debut single album Nativity and lead single "Mazeltov" on January 7, 2010.

Taeho is a South Korean singer and songwriter currently signed under HAM. He is a member of the boy group IMFACT and made his solo debut on May 27, 2021, with the digital single Ggoma. Taeho debuted with IMFACT on January 27, 2016, with the single album Lollipop. After parting ways with Star Empire Entertainment in January 2022, he signed with HAM in 2024 and released the digital single For Your Brilliant Day on May 28. Later that year, he made his Japanese debut with the single I Like You on September 13, followed by a Korean version on October 2. Taeho also announced a duet concert with Hong Eunki, further showcasing his diverse talents as an artist.
Taeho is a South Korean singer who was previously signed with Star Empire Entertainment. He made his solo debut on May 27, 2021, with the single "GGOMA," featuring YEGNY.

Taeho, formerly known as Heechan and Doha, is a South Korean singer and former idol group leader. He was the leader of F.able in 2020 and a pre-debut member of both UTH (2019–2020) and AMBITION (2022–2024). He initially debuted under the name Heechan with the busking group Vierno, later promoting under different stage names throughout his career. Taeho gained recognition as a contestant on JTBC’s survival show Project 7 in 2024, where he was eliminated during the first evaluation round, and had previously auditioned for Fan Pick (2023) alongside Ryu and Daehyun. He departed AMBITION on January 25, 2024, for undisclosed reasons and has since been promoting as a soloist in Japan starting in August 2024.
Taehoon is a South Korean rapper and member of the Korean-Japanese boy group "NIK".

Daniel Bang also known as Taehoon is a Korean-Canadian singer under CLIMIX and Think Entertainment. He made his official debut in 2022 as a member of the boy group TAN. Moreover, Taehoon is a member of CLIMIX's unnamed pre-debut boy group. On September 21, 2020, Taehoon was announced as an upcoming contestant on the 2020 teen survival show, CAP-TEEN. He did not pass the first performance evaluation and was eliminated. On August 11, 2021, he was introduced as the 22nd contestant of the survival show Wild Idol, where he finished second place, making him qualified to debut as a member of the boy group TAN.

Lee Tae-hoon, better known as Taehun, is a South Korean singer under FirstOne Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Nine.i and he is in charge of being the leader when it comes to choreography and performances.

Choi Tae Hun is a South Korean singer and dancer under P Nation. He is a member of the boy group TNX. He was first known for appearing in the SBS survival show "Loud" where he was recruited to be a member of the boy group TNX. He made his official debut with the group on May 17, 2022.

Taehwan is a South Korean singer under KLAP Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group VANNER. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor. He made his solo debut on January 3, 2022, with the digital single "Frozen". Taehwan disclosed that he was exempted from serving in the military because he was designated as the only source of income for his home after his father passed away in 2017 due to an accident.

Nam Tae-hyun, also known as Taehyun, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, producer and actor. His own music label, "South Buyers Club", was founded in March 2017. Under the label, Nam introduced the band "South Club", in which he plays an active role of a leader, vocalist, guitarist, and main composer. He was previously the main vocalist, composer and producer of k-pop group Winner. On October 12, 2016 YGE announced Taehyun would be taking a break due to health problems, thus the rest of the Exit Movement series would be delayed indefinitely. On November 25, Nam's departure from the group was announced. On March 25, 2017 Taehyun, together with his rumored band, South Club, held a guerrilla show at Pet Sounds Bar in Korea. The 30-minute show was livestreamed on platforms such as Instagram, and popular China video-sharing platform Miaopai. South Club performed a total of four songs, including tracks from The Beatles and Foster the People. On April 11, Nam announced that his music label "South Buyers Club" has officially been registered as of March 30.

Roh Tae Hyun, formerly known as Kid Monster, is a South Korean singer, dancer and rapper under Star Crew Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group HOTSHOT and the project boy group JBJ. In March 2017, he entered the idol survival show Produce 101 Season 2, alongside his fellow group member Sungwoon. Tae Hyun made his solo debut on January 24, 2019 with his first mini album Birthday.

Kang Taehyun is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under Big Hit Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group TXT. On January 17, 2019, Taehyun was revealed as the fourth member of TXT. The group officially debuted on March 4, 2019 with their debut mini album "The Dream Chapter: STAR".

Moon Tae-il (Taeil), formerly a member of NCT under SM Entertainment, served as the group's main vocalist in the sub-units NCT U and NCT 127. He debuted in April 2016 and later joined NCT 127 in July the same year. On August 28, 2024, SM Entertainment officially announced his departure from NCT, citing his involvement in a criminal case related to a sexual offense. Legal proceedings revealed that in June 2024, Taeil and two others sexually assaulted a heavily intoxicated foreign tourist, a charge classified as aggravated quasi-rape under South Korean law. In October 2024, SM Entertainment formally terminated his exclusive contract with the company, stating that the situation had irreparably damaged trust. During the June 18, 2025 court hearing, Taeil admitted guilt, and prosecutors are seeking a sentence of up to seven years. His sentencing took place on July 10, 2025, where he was handed 3 years and 6 months in prison, along with additional penalties including a 40-hour sexual violence treatment program and a five-year prohibition on working with children or youth-related institutions.

Lee Tae Il is a South Korean singer and songwriter. He is best known as the main vocalist of the boy group Block B. In the group, he trained the shortest out of all the members, but had 6 years of vocal training. He thinks his eyes are his worst trait because they’re so small, so he often wears sunglasses and hats. He's also a part of the duo T2U with U-Kwon.

Taejoo is a South Korean singer, actor, and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a former member and the lead vocalist of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. He made his solo debut on September 15, 2020 with the EP, Life Train.
Taeju is a vocalist in the boy group B.I.T.
Taejun is a member of the dance team TIMT. He was a member of the South Korean boy group Lucente.

Jeong Taekhyeon is a South Korean rapper and actor under Management Air. He was a child actor before deciding to become an idol. He made his official debut in 2019 as a member of the project group 1THE9. On October 25, 2018, Jeong Taekhyeon was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the rap team. He finished in fifth place, thus becoming a member of the project group 1THE9. Following 1the9's disbandment, Taekhyeon has since focused on acting. He got to star in dramas such as "Flower of Evil," "Oh Master!" and "Racket Boys."

Taemin is a South Korean singer signed to BPM Entertainment. He is the youngest member of SM Entertainment's South Korean boy group SHINee . On May 25, 2008, he debuted as a member of SHINee with the group's first mini album, "Replay". He made his debut as a solo artist on August 18, 2014, with his first mini album, "Ace". On October 4, 2019, he joined SM Entertainment's supergroup, SuperM. Taemin has had great success with his solo activities, releasing both Korean and Japanese albums. As a solo artist, he is best known for his 2017 hit "Move". The song gained attention for its distinctive choreography, which went viral in South Korea, and Taemin received praise for his "genderless" performance style. In 2017, Taemin began his 1st solo concert tour in Seoul called 'Off-Sick', and later embarked on tours across Japan. Taemin is often nicknamed the "idol of idols" for his influence on younger idols.
Kim Taemin is a South Korean actor and singer under Hanahreum Company. Besides appearing in several dramas, Taemin has also competed in the reality survival program "Produce 101 Season 2"
Um Taemin is the vocalist of FNC Entertainment's boyband, Hi-Fi Un!corn.
Taeoh is a singer and part of the boy band THE T-BIRD

Taerae is a South Korean singer and rapper under Yue Hua Entertainment. On January 3, 2022, Taerae was revealed as the second member of Yue Hua Entertainment's upcoming boy group TEMPEST. He debuted as a member of the group on March 2, 2022, with the release of their first mini album titled "It's ME, It's WE".
Taesan is a South Korean singer under KOZ Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of BOYNEXTDOOR on May 30th, 2023.

Taeseok is a South Korean singer signed with Wannabe Entertainment. He is part of the pre-debut boy group VVS. On August 21, 2023, his individual concept photos were released through the group’s official SNS.

Taeseon is a South Korean singer and model under YM Entertainment and Eighty6. He was a member of the boy group TRCNG as well as a member of the pre-debut group UNNAME and pre-debut Japanese project group MY BOYZ. He has also been a contestant on the survival shows Peak Time and Fantasy Boys.

Lee Taesung is a South Korean Singer under Maroo Entertainment. He used to be a member of the boy group Ghost9 and its sub-unit TEEN TEEN. As a trainee, he appeared in the hit survival show "Produce X 101."

Lee Taevin is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under NS ENM. He first debuted as a member of the boy group MYTEEN in July 2017, under MUSICWORKS Company. In December 2018, it was announced that Taevin would leave the group to focus on acting. Since then, he appeared in dramas such as Rich Man (2018) and on the three seasons of PENTHOUSE: War in Life (2020-2021).

Kim Tae-Woo is a South Korean singer, musical actor and TV personality, he's best known for being the lead vocalist of the boy group g.o.d. He debuted as a member of g.o.d on January 13, 1999 under SidusHQ, and debuted as a solo artist in 2006 after g.o.d announced their indefinite hiatus. In 2022, he signed with IOK Company.

Taewoo is a South Korean former rapper. He debuted as a member of the boy group RION FIVE, under Narda Entertainment, on March 25, 2014, with the digital single "Rion Five", and was active with the group until his departure in September 2018. He also took part in the agency's project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018. Taewoo also participated in Mnet' survival show "Produce 101 Season 2", where he was eliminated after ranking 49th place. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Kang Tae Woo is a South Korean rapper and actor under Stardium. He is the maknae of the boy group THE MAN BLK.

Taewoo is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under MECHIVE. He made his solo debut on May 23, 2021 with his first digital single "Pause". In 2019, he was a contestant on Channel A's survival show Vocal Play 2 and finished in the top 16. In 2021 and 2022, he competed as SingAgain2 Singer No.42 on JTBC's survival show Sing Again 2 and finished in the top 26. In 2024, he was a contestant on Mnet's survival show Build Up : Vocal Boy Group Survivor and finished in the top 30. He performed "Thought of You" by John Park as V28, "Beautiful" by Crush, "Downpour" by I.O.I, and "Forest" by Choi Yuree during the show.
Taewoon, also known as Wuno, is a South Korean singer, rapper, and record producer. He used to be an original member of Co-ed School and boy group SPEED, both under MBK Entertainment.
Choi Tae Woong is a rapper under Chrome Entertainment.
Yoo Taewoong was born in Japan under the name "Yukimoto Yasuo" on the 24th of May, 1994. He is the former Leader and Main Rapper of SNUPER.

Dong Youngbae, known under his stage name Taeyang, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under The Black Label. He is best known as the main vocalist and main dancer of the boy group BIGBANG After appearing in Jinusean's music video "A-yo," Taeyang started his official training under YG Entertainment at the age of 12. Six years later, he made his official debut in 2006 as a member of the South Korean boy band BIGBANG. While the quintet's debut was met with lukewarm receptions, their follow-ups cemented their popularity, becoming one of the best-selling digital group of all-time in Asia and one of the best-selling boy bands in the world. On 22, May, 2008, Taeyang made his solo debut with the EP "Hot" with the title track "Only Look At Me". Taeyang began his 21 months of mandatory military service on March 12, 2018 by entering the 6th Infantry Division’s boot camp in Cheorwon, Gangwon Province as an active duty soldier and he was discharged on November 10, 2019. He has been in a relationship with actress Min Hyo Rin since 2013. On February 3, 2018, Taeyang and Min married in a private ceremony with family and friends, officiated by actor Ki Tae-young. On September 27, 2021 Min Hyorin's agency confirmed that she was pregnant and was going to give birth soon. On December 6, 2021, YG Entertainement confirmed that Min Hyorin had given birth and both were healthy.
Taeyang is a South Korean singer under Beat Interactive. He is a member of the boy group NEWBEAT.

Taeyeong, also known as Lee Taeyeong and formerly known as Huyu during his time in AQA, is a South Korean singer. He is the maknae of the boy group T:EV, and a former member of the boy group AQA, the trainee group Just COLOR, and the busking teams InnerS and D.O.B. In April 2025, Taeyeong and the other members of T:EV left Startree, the agency under which they debuted. As of now, he is not signed to any entertainment company.

Taeyong is a South Korean rapper under SM Entertainment. He is the leader of NCT and a member of its sub-units NCT U and NCT 127, as well as the supergroup SuperM. Formerly part of the trainee team SMROOKIES, he debuted on April 8, 2016 with NCT U's single "The 7th Sense", followed by NCT 127's debut in July 2016. In July 2019, he released his first solo track, “Long Flight”, which he co-wrote and co-composed. That same year, he joined SuperM, debuting with their self-titled mini-album in October. On June 5th of 2019, Taeyong made his official solo debut, with the mini album "SHALALA". Being the first NCT member to enlist, Taeyong enlisted in the Navy as an active-duty solder on April 15, 2024. He is expected to be discharged by December 14, 2025.
Taeyong is a South Korean actor and trainee under Belift Lab. He competed on the reality survival program "I-LAND".

Taeyoung is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group CRAVITY. On January 22, 2020, Taeyoung was introduced as a trainee under Starship. Months later, on March 18, he was revealed to be a member of Starship's upcoming boy group CRAVITY. He officially debuted with them on April 14, with the release of the mini album 'Hideout: Remember Who We Are'.
Taeyoung is a South Korean singer under Black Level Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group Black Level and a former member of the boy group Seven O'clock.
Taeyoung is a South Korean trainee under YM Entertainment who is to debut in the boy group, UNNAME. He joined UNNAME on October 12, 2024.

Yeom Tae-Gyun, also known as Tag, is a South Korean rapper under ARMADA Ent. He is a member of the boy group ONE PACT and a former member of CIIPHER. In 2021, Tag gained recognition after participating in the fourth season of "High School Rapper." Furthermore, he debuted as the main rapper of the boy group CIIPHER under Rain Company in March of the same year. On August 9, 2023, Rain Company announced that Tag, along with Tan, Won, and Dohwan, had left CIIPHER and the agency after a prolonged period of inactivity. On October 3, 2023, Armada Entertainment revealed Tag as the Third Member of their upcoming boy group ONE PACT.

Son Youngtaek is a South Korean rapper and singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group Golden Child with the stage name Tag, under Woollim Entertainment, on August 28, 2017. On August 27, 2024, Woollim Entertainment announced that Tag did not renew his contract and would be leaving the group and the agency.

Taichi (birth name Honda Taichi; Korean name Choo Tae Il) is a Japanese-Korean singer, vocalist, and rapper currently active as a member of the Japanese boy group MXV under Danmee. Taichi was formerly a member of the Japanese boy group IVVY, as well as the K-pop groups M.Crown and BLANC7. MXV consists of five members, all former IVVY members, and officially debuted on February 10, 2025, with the digital single “Oh My Gosh.” Taichi is known for his versatile talents, including vocal and rap skills, as well as his background in drumming and artistry.
Taichi is a Japanese trainee under Bill Entertainment. He is best known as a participant on the survival shows Nizi Project 2 and Boys II Planet.

Taichi is a Japanese rapper and former member of the project group NIK, formed by the survival show G-EGG. In 2020, he participated in the show and his final rank was #10, making him a place on the debut team. NIK finally debuted on September 27, 2021, with the single "Santa Monica". The group disbanded in 2023 after the termination of their contract.

Tanaguchi Taichi made his first appearance on the survival show World Klass, where he placed 8th in the live rankings, and didn't make it into the final lineup of 4. He made his debut as a member of DXTEEN on May 10, 2023, with the single album "Brand New Day".
Fujimaki Taiga, or simply Taiga, is a Japanese trainee under IX Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival shows Nizi Project 2 and Boys II Planet.

Taiki is a Japanese singer under DNA Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group SWEET:CH. On October 18, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's Project 7 but was unable to pass the survival round.

Takeru is a Japanese singer and member of the boy group 24K+. The group debuted in 2012 under Choeun Entertainment but underwent several lineup changes starting in 2014. He was revealed as a new member in April 2022, and he made his debut a few months later. In 2023, the current five members appeared on the show "Peak Time".

Goto Takeru was born on June 3rd, 1999, in Osaka, Japan. He is the sub-rapper, sub-vocalist, and visual of INI. He debuted in INI on November 3rd. 2021, with the single "A". His final rank in Produce 101 Japan (Season 2) was 11th.

Takeru is a Japanese singer and one of the original members of the boy group ONE OR EIGHT. He began dancing at just 3 years old and trained intensively through his childhood, eventually performing as a backup dancer for renowned artists like Miura Daichi, a celebrated Japanese R&B singer, and SHINee, the legendary K-pop group known for their powerful performances. Takeru later joined WARPs DIG, the group’s survival show, where he successfully earned his spot in the final lineup and officially debuted as part of ONE OR EIGHT.

Takayama Riki, known under his stage name Taki, is a Japanese singer and dancer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as one of the vocalists of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. Taki is known for participating in the survival program I-LAND–the same show were ENHYPEN was created. However, Taki was eliminated in episode 10. In 2022, he participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to become a member of the boy group &TEAM.
Takuma is a Japanese singer and actor under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS. He is also known for participating in the survival shows Stars Awakening and MAKE MATE 1.
Takuma is a singer under Fantagio. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group LUN8 on June 15, 2023.

Kawanishi Takumi, more commonly known as Takumi, is a Japanese singer and dancer. He is a member of the Japanese boy group JO1 formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, with whom he made his debut on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

Ozaki Takumi was born on June 14th, 1999, in Osaka, Japan. He is the lead vocalist and lead dancer in INI. He made his debut on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A". His final ranking on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2) was 5th.
Takuto is a Japanese singer. He is set to debut as a member of the boy group I1IT on August 25, 2022.

Takuto is a member of the boy group TOZ under YY Entertainment. They made their debut on September 27, 2023 with the mini album FLARE. He gained fame as a participant in the Korean reality show “Boys Planet”.
Takuwa, formerly known as Da Face, is a South Korean rapper under Passport Seoul. He debuted independently in 2018.

Terada Takuya, better known as Takuya, is a Japanese singer, musical theatre actor, TV personality, and actor under Different Entertainment. He is best known for being a former member of the boy group Cross Gene where he was the visual and one of the vocalists. He is also known for appearing in JTBC's variety show "Non-Summit." He announced that he would be leaving Cross Gene on December 10, 2018, after his contract with Amuse Korea ended.

Choi Seok-won, better known as Tan, is a South Korean singer under Rain Company. As a trainee, he appeared in the 2015 Starship survival program "No.Mercy" and competed to be a member of Monsta X. After being eliminated in the show, Tan went on to enlist in the military. After being discharged, he continued his journey as a trainee. In 2021, Tan made his official debut as the main vocalist of the boy group CIIPHER.
Tanaka is a singer from Japan, known for being one half of the musical duo ASMRZ.

Tanaka Koki is a Japanese trainee under P Nation. He was a contestant in the 2021 survival program Loud. He ranked sixth in the show's last episode, making him qualified to debut in P Nation's upcoming boy group. However, in January 2022, P Nation announced that Tanaka Koki will no longer be part of the group and will continue further training— a decision that both P Nation and Tanaka Koki's parents agreed upon.

Taro is a main vocalist and dancer in H.B.Y. He is considered the brains of the group, and placed in the top 1% of students in Incheon while in school. He is an official member of Oh My Girl's fanclub.
Tarzzan is a South Korean rapper, lyricist and model under The Black Label. He is the sub rapper of the co-ed group ALLDAY PROJECT.
Tatsuki is a Japanese trainee under WAKEONE. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Tatsuya is a Japanese trainee. He gained fame as a participant in the survival show Fan Pick.
Te Un is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Teddy Park is a Korean-American rapper, songwriter, and producer. He was a member of the South Korean hip-hop boy group 1TYM under YG Entertainment which debuted in 1998. He started working mainly as a producer under YG Entertainment when the group went on hiatus in January 2006. He notably produced for groups like BIGBANG, 2NE1, and BLACKPINK. Since September 2015, Teddy Park has been at the head of YG Entertainment's independent sub-label named The Black Label, which held artists like Jeon Somi, Taeyang, and Park Bo Gum. More recently, in April 2024, he and his agency even collaborated with MNET on their survival show "I-LAND2: N/a", which formed the group izna, for who he would produce the songs when they debut. It was also revealed that The Black Label was planning to make their first-ever girl group, MEOVV, which debuted on September 6, 2024. In June 2025, reports emmerged about the debut of The Black Label's first-ever coed group, All Day Project, which debuted on the 23rd of the same month.
Teen is a South Korean singer under Campus Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group RoaD-B.
Tei is a South Korean actor and singer. He was a member of Handsome People.

Tejong is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musician known for his emotive vocals and acoustic-driven sound. He made his official solo debut on August 3, 2021, with the digital single “Pervert”. Self-managed and distributing through Poclanos, Tejong gained broader attention as Contestant #47 on Sing Again 3, where his heartfelt performances and poetic lyricism captivated audiences. He continues to build a dedicated following in Korea’s indie and ballad scene.

names.native: เตนท์ ชิตพล ลี้ชัยพรกุล

maleIdols.description: Ten is a Thai singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT U and WayV. He is formerly a member of the pre-debut team SM Rookies. On October 4th, 2019, he debuted once more under SM Entertainment's supergroup, SuperM. Ten made his official solo debut on February 13, 2024, with the release of his first solo EP, titled TEN, the lead single being "Nightwalker".
Teng Chia Chun is a Taiwanese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Hwang Ui Jeong, better known as Teno, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He used to be the main rapper of the now-disbanded boy group Blanc7. He also used to be a member of the group M.Crown.

Teo is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He is a former member of the boy group DKB and a pre-debut member of OUIBOYS. On November 6, 2023, Brave Entertainment announced that Teo would be leaving DKB after getting caught by the police for DUI on October 30 and getting his license revoked.

Tey is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. He is the leader of the upcoming trot boy group MYTRO and a former member of the boy group MR.MR. Tey made his solo debut on January 30, 2015, with the digital single Dangerous. He gained further recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Mr. Trot 2.

Thad is a Filipino idol under MLD Entertainment. He is known for participating in Dream Maker, but eliminated in the finale. He and 4 other eliminated contetsants signed with MLD Entertainment to form New:ID.
Thama, born Jo Jung-min, is a South Korean singer under Amoeba Culture who debuted independently in 2014.

names.native: น้องธร ธนาทร เรืองสุวรรณ

maleIdols.description: Thanatorn is a Thai singer under With US Entertainment, a subsidiary of Around US Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group The Wind on May 15, 2023. They made their official debut, with the mini album "Beginning: The Wind Page". In 2025 he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
The One is a South Korean singer signed with IOK Company. He was part of the co-ed group Space A.

Shin Dong-gab, best known as The Quiett, is a South Korean rapper, producer, and entrepreneur widely regarded as a pioneer and "Godfather" of Korean hip-hop. Active since 2000, he began in the underground scene and co-founded several influential labels, including Soul Company (2004–2010), Illionaire Records (2011–2020), Ambition Musik (2016–), and Daytona Entertainment (2020–). Known for his sleek, laid-back rap style and sharp lyricism, he has released acclaimed albums such as Music (2005), Q Train (2006), and The Real Me (2007), while mentoring rising stars through shows like Show Me the Money and High School Rapper. Beyond music, he has championed rookie artists through projects like Rap House and Rap House on Air. A respected figure in both artistry and business, The Quiett continues to shape the Korean hip-hop scene as an artist, producer, and label head.

Xu Minghao, also known for his stage name The8, is a Chinese dancer, singer, songwriter and composer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the lead dancer, sub vocalist and sub rapper of the boy group SEVENTEEN. He is also a member of their group's performance unit SVT PERFORMANCE Team. The8 debuted as a member of SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015 with the mini-album 17 Carat. Years later, on June 9, 2019, The8 made his solo debut through the digital single "Dreams Come True".

Choi Taeyang, known under his stage name Theo, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as the oldest member and the lead vocalist of the boy group P1Harmony. On September 16, 2020, Theo was revealed as the sixth and last member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
Theo is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which operates under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 25, 2025.

Park Sang Hyun, popularly known as Thunder, is a South Korean singer and actor under Lighthouse Entertainment. He is best known for debuting as a member of the boy group MBLAQ under J.Tune Camp and for being the younger brother of Sandara Park. Following his departure in MBLAQ back in 2014, he made his solo debut in December 2016.

Tiger JK is a Korean-American rapper, record producer and entrepreneur best known as a founding member of Korean hip hop group Drunken Tiger. He has also founded two record labels, Jungle Entertainment and Feel Ghood Music. He is currently a member of hip hop trio MFBTY.

Kim Moon-gyu, popularly known as Timoteo, is a South Korean singer part of the boy group HOTSHOT. He used to be an SM Entertainment trainee, alongside Junhyuk, and was even part of the pre-debut lineup of EXO. However, he left the company due to the immense stress and pressure he received.
TIN, formerly known as Minseok, is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the disbanded boy group APL and a former member of the boy group TOUCH before leaving the group in early 2011.

Kim Taejo, better known as TJ, is a South Korean trainee under ChoCo Entertainment. He is a member of the trainee group ChoCo1&2 and its sub-unit, Choco1. He is best known for competing on the survival show Boys II Planet.
TK, born Kim Taekgyu, debuted as a member of the boy group DXMON under SSQ ENTERTAINMENT on January 17, 2024.

names.native: ตี๋ ธนกฤต ทรัพย์ทวีวศิน

maleIdols.description: TK is a Thai trainee under Studio Wabi Sabi. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show Fantasy Boys.

TOIL is a South Korean composer and producer who debuted under Wonderwall in 2020 with the single "Go". He majored in bass and is characterized by the beat of rock sound based on guitar. His production credits include Ash Island, Hash Swan, Heize, etc.
TOMMY YANG, formerly known as Tommy Strate, born Kim Tae-yang, is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Elevenandup in 2017.
Tomoya is a Japanese singer and a member of the boy group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 1st in "Nizi Project Season 2."
Tomoya is a Japanese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Tony is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

Tony An is a South Korean singer, actor, producer, and businessman under CMG Stars. He is a former member of the boy groups H.O.T. and jtL. He made his solo debut in October 2004 with the studio album Believe.

Tony Yu is a Canadian singer under CTDENM and Astro Music (China). He made his solo debut on July 29, 2024, with the EP "Spatial Recorder". He is also known for being a contestant on Mnet's survival show "Produce X 101" and the Chinese survival show "Youth With You 3".
Toori was apart of the was a South Korean rap group, Honey Family, which disbanded in 2012.
TopHyun is a South Korean singer-songwriter under RAVEX. He made his debut on September 25, 2020 with the digital single "Unfamiliar Farewell". He is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.
Toru is a South Korean rapper under Talented.
Touch The Sky, born Lee Sang-jae is a South Korean rapper and singer who debuted under Daytona Entertainment in 2021.
Toui is a Japanese trainee under FNC Entertainment. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."

Trade L, born Lee Seung-hoon is a South Korean rapper & singer. He signed with H1GHR Music in 2020 and won High School Rapper 4 in the following year. Under H1GHR, he collaborated with many artists, released numerous singles and three EPs before his contract expired. His his debut EP 'Time Table – The Trip', was released in November 25, 2021. After his contract expired in 2025 he has been releasing music independently, including his debut studio album 'Mr. Independent'.

Uneducated Kid, born Kim Sung-woo is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2018.

Kim Namhyung, also known as UNO BUCKX, is a South Korean singer and rapper under Kairos Entertainment. He is the other half of the duo AA. Namhyung has also participated in the reality survival show "Produce 101 Season 2".

Kwon Yonghyun, also known as UO, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and member of the boy group XD (formerly XEED). Originally debuting as a member of the boy group TST under KJ Music Entertainment on January 4, 2017 with the release of the single "Love Story". Usu is a South Korean drummer and former member of the band Se So Neon. He joined the band around 2019 along with Hyunjin to replace Fancy Moon and Gangto.

Kim Taehyung, known under his stage name V, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer, composer, producer, and actor under Big Hit Entertainment and HYBE Labels. He is best known as one of the vocalists and visuals of the worldwide sensation boy group BTS. When he was just fifteen years old, V accompanied his friend to audition at Big Hit Entertainment. He was only there to support his friend, but an executive noticed him and encouraged him to audition. Since V had no plans of auditioning, he had to call his parents to ask for permission. He ended up passing the audition and became an official trainee. In 2013, V made his official debut with BTS and went on to become one of the most popular and loved artists of his generation. Besides performing, V also took on acting projects. He debuted as an actor in late 2016 through the historical drama "Hwarang." On September 8, 2023, V made his official solo debut with the mini album "Layover." The album debuted at No. 2 spot on the Billboard 200 chart. Two songs from the album ”Love Me Again” and the title track ”Slow Dancing” debuted on Billboard’s Hot 100 Chart, while ”Slow Dancing” becoming his at the time, third and highest entry on the chart.
V-Hawk, formerly known as Master One, is a South Korean rapper and music video director. He was a member of the boy group Wonder Boyz.
Vaan is a member os Seven o'Clock.
Vahn is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and producer under Pan Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NINE.i and a former member of the pre-debut groups UTH, HNB, and YOURS.
Vangdale is a South Korean producer under KC who debuted under Million Market in 2019. He is also known by his producer tag GXXD (Girlnexxtdoor).
Vanilla Man is a South Korean singer under Sohaengsung Music, and a member of the co-ed duo Vanilla Acoustic.
Kim Jaehyun, better known as Vari, is a South Korean singer. He debuted on March 30, 2022 as a member of the boy group NINE.i.

Verbal Jint, born Kim Jin‑tae, is a South Korean rapper, producer, and musician. The origin of his stage name is a combination of the character Roger "Verbal" Kint from the 1995 film 'The Usual Suspects', and his birth name, Jin-tae. Verbal Jint first appeared in the late 90's, at a time when hip-hop was considered a dangerous trend in South Korea. He performed as a member of the underground hip‑hop crew Show N Prove (SNP), releasing solo tracks like “Big Brag” and “How High School”, which cemented his presence in the underground scene. Before his solo debut, Korean rap largely relied on fast delivery and repetitive rhythms without true rhyme schemes. Verbal Jint disrupted that norm by introducing grammatically precise rhymes in Korean, a move that revolutionized the genre and became the new standard. The EP Modern Rhymes (2001) is still considered to be the blueprint of Korean rap and because of this, he is referred to as the 'Godfather of Korean hip‑hop'. Academically, Verbal Jint holds an economics degree from Seoul National University, and later enrolled at Hanyang University School of Law, though he paused his legal studies to focus on music. He also served as an army sergeant through the KATUSA program despite being exempt, choosing to serve alongside U.S. forces. His 2008 album 'Framed' earned Best Hip‑Hop Album at the Korean Music Awards, marking his first major industry recognition. He signed with Brand New Music in 2010, and released the album 'Go Easy' the following year. Its single “You Look Good” became a major hit, climbing to No. 5 on the Gaon Digital Chart. In 2012, his album '10 Years of Misinterpretation' spawned hits like “Good Morning” (featuring 10 cm) and “Pretty Enough,” both landing in the Gaon top 10. Verbal Jint appeared on the very first season of Show Me the Money in 2012, returned as a mentor/producer in Show Me the Money 4 (2015), and also participated in the spin‑off Unpretty Rapstar, producing singles for contestants. In 2015, he released both the EP 'Yeoja' with Sanchez and the album 'GO HARD Pt. 1: The Other Side'. In 2010, he began releasing music under Brand New Stardom, a record label owned by rappers Cho PD and Rhymer. When the company split in two in 2011, Verbal Jint followed Rhymer to his new label Brand New Music. In November 2015, Brand New Music announced that he had launched his independent label OTHERSIDE under their umbrella, aiming to explore “the other side” of his artistry. Beyond music, Verbal Jint is also a sought‑after voiceover artist, lending his distinctive voice to commercials for brands like Vitamin Water, LG, and Hyundai. He has collaborated with many artists of various genres including Taeyeon ('I'), Davichi, Cho Yong-pil, Dynamic Duo, Ailee, Beenzino, 10cm and many more.

Hansol Vernon Chwe, also known for his stage name Vernon, is a South Korean-American rapper, dancer, songwriter, composer and producer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the main rapper, sub vocalist, visual, and face of the boy group SEVENTEEN. He is also a member of the group's Rap unit SVT HIPHOP Team. He made his debut on May 26, 2015 with the mini-album "17 Carat".
Verycoybunny is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer who debuted independently in 2019.

Vincent Blue is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Brand New A. He debuted as a drama OST singer in 2015 and made his official debut with the single "It's Raining" on March 24, 2019. He is a contestant on the survival show Undercover.

Choi Whee-Sung, known as Wheesung, and the new stage name Realslow, was a South Korean singer, actor, and record producer under his own independent label called Realslow Company. Wheesung signed under YG Entertainment in 2000 and went under 2 years' worth of vocal training. He made his solo debut on April 3rd, 2002 with his studio album, Like A Movie. Hwang Heewoo is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Park Sung Won, better known as Won, is a South Korean singer. After a year, the group disbanded and Sungwon continued to train. By March 15, 2021, Won officially debuted as the maknae of CIIPHER. On August 9, 2023, Rain Company announced that Tag, along with Tan, Won, and Dohwan, had left CIIPHER and the agency after a prolonged period of inactivity. On November 27, 2023, he announced that he would be making his solo debut on December 4, 2023, with the digital single "Even If It's a Lie ft. Dohwan"
Won is a South Korean singer. He is set to debut as a member of the Korean-Japanese boy group I1IT on August 25, 2022.
Won Cheon is a South Korean singer under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS. He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1.

Ryu , also known as Won Eunwoo, is a South Korean trainee and former member of the pre-debut boy group AMBITION under Wells Entertainment. Ryu was previously active with AMBITION during their Japanese promotions but left the group following its hiatus on July 21, 2024. Though once introduced as a member, he is no longer affiliated with the group's current lineup. In 2023, he auditioned for Fan Pick (MBC M) alongside Taeho and Daehyun, though none of them passed. He is known to have written an unreleased song titled "Make a Feel." Ryu completed his mandatory military service prior to his entertainment activities.
