Wonbin is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a member of the boy group RIIZE. He made his debut on September 4, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar".

Wonbin is a South Korean singer under IST Entertainment. When he was still a trainee, Wonbin joined the survival show “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?” but was eliminated in the fifth episode. However, he was eventually added to the debuting group ATBO after Yang Donghwa was disqualified.

Jung Woncheol (or simply Woncheol) is a South Korean singer under MYstar Entertainment and MY Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group MY.st and was a member of A6P under the stage name Ado. He was also a member of the pre-debut group HNB.

Won Dae is a South Korean singer under Dongyo Entertainment. He's a former member of the boy group DONGKIZ. Wondae debuted as a member of DONGKIZ with their single album Dongkiz on the Block on April 24, 2019. On August 24, 2021, a statement was posted to DONGKIZ's fan cafe stating that Won Dae would be going on hiatus due to a ruptured shoulder. On March 18, 2022, it was announced that Won Dae would be leaving the group following in-depth conversations with the agency and the opinion by his doctor for constant rehabilitation.
Joo Won Dae is a South Korean singer and DJ. He is currently a member of the pre-debut band A:FACT.

Wondior is a South Korean rapper and singer known for his vibrant style and genre-blending sound. He officially debuted in May 2022 with the EP "SEE ME UP" under the label 502. He's influenced by genres including trap, R&B, jazz, and even Chamorro music from his upbringing in Guam.
Wong Sik Hei is a Hong Kongese trainee under YS Group. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Wonho is a South Korean singer and dancer currently under Highline Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group MONSTA X and the project group Y TEEN. When Wonho was still a trainee under Starship Entertainment, he appeared as a contestant in the 2014 boy group survival show "No. Mercy" where he was able to showcase his talent and earn his spot in the boy group MONSTA X. He eventually debuted as lead vocalist and visual of MONSTA X on May 14, 2015, with their mini album 'TRESPASS.' On October 31, 2019, Starship Entertainment announced his departure from MONSTA X as he wished to not cause trouble to the group following recent allegations surrounding him. Following this, there was a large outcry from fans who protested the decision in multiple ways, trending hashtags on Twitter for weeks and funding billboards and fan projects in various countries. On March 10, 2020, Wonho was cleared of all charges by the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and Starship announced that they would support his career in the future. On April 10, Highline Entertainment, a subsidiary of Starship, announced that they had signed an exclusive contract with Wonho as a solo artist and a producer. On May 6, it was announced that he signed with U.S. label Maverick Management. Wonho made his highly-anticipated solo debut on September 4, 2020, with the first part of his first mini album Love Synonym #1 : Right for Me. On November 15, 2022, Wonho revealed through a handwritten letter announcing that he would be enlisting in the military on December 5 as a public service worker. He will be discharged on September 4, 2024.

Won Hyuk is a South Korean singer and rapper under E Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group E'LAST. In May, he participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101. He was eliminated on episode 8 after ranking 33rd place. On July 30, 2019, he was announced as a member of the upcoming boy group, then known as EBOYZ. Now called E'LAST, the group made their official debut on June 9, 2020.

Ham Wonjin, popularly known as Wonjin, is a South Korean singer and actor under Starship Entertainment. He is the lead vocalist and lead dancer of the boy group CRAVITY. In May 2019, he participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101, representing Starship Entertainment. He finished the show in 16th place, thus being eliminated in the final episode. By March 2020, he was revealed to be a member of Starship's new boy group CRAVITY. He officially debuted with them on April 14, with the release of the mini-album "Hideout: Remember Who We Are - Season1".
Wonjin, also known as Jin, is a South Korean trainee. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy groups VI'ENX and GIDONGDAE.
Wonjun, formerly known as Jongwon, is a South Korean trainee under ICE Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut group HALF&HALF and a former member of the project boy group Nonstop.

Wonjun is a South Korean singer and rapper under E Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group E'LAST and it's sub-unit E'LAST U. Prior to debuting, he participated in Produce X 101 but was eliminated after ranking 47th.
Wonjun is a member of the k pop group ABLUE, who are debuting on October 22, 2022. He was formerly a member of ZPZG, who debuted on September 25, 2014.

Wonjun is a trainee of CJes Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WHIB, whom he made his debut with on November 8, 2023. In 2025, he was revealed as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.

Kim Wonpil is a South Korean singer and musician under JYP Entertainment, best known as the lead vocalist, synthesizer, and keyboardist of the rock band DAY6. He debuted with DAY6 on September 7, 2015, with the EP "The Day" and the lead single "Congratulations." In addition to his role in the band, Wonpil has been actively involved in songwriting and production. He later made his solo debut on February 7, 2022, with his first full-length album, "Pilmography," further showcasing his musical versatility and artistry.
Jo Wonsang is the bassist, producer and vocalist of the South Korean band LUCY.
Won Shin is a South Korean singer and musician, known for being the bassist and sub-vocalist of the boy band D.COY and its subunit Lure.

Wonsik is a South Korean singer under Play Maker E&M. He is a member of the male duo TMC, the co-ed group ToTh6y, and the disbanded boy group Apeace. In 2020 he participated on the survival show C-EGG, but did not make it to the final.

Jeong Jiwon, popularly known as Wonstein, is a South Korean singer and rapper signed with Beautiful Noise. He made his debut in 2014 with “Replay”. He appeared on various shows namely Show Me the Money Season 4, Show Me the Money Season 777, Show Me the Money Season 8, and Show Me the Money Season 9. He gained attention for his unique soothing voice and was featured on various artists’ tracks. He is also a member of the groups X4 and MSG Wannabe.

Ju Won Tak is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group Underdog and project group RAINZ. He made his solo debut on November 26, 2018 with the single "In The Light". In 2016, Won Tak became a member of the boy group Underdog under the stage name Roel. In 2017, he participated in Mnet's survival show Produce 101 Season 2, representing 2ABLE Company, but was eliminated in episode 5 and finished in 62nd place. Following the program's conclusion, he, along with other former contestants, debuted as a member of the project group RAINZ in October 2017 before disbanding a year later. On November 26, 2018, he made his official solo debut with the digital single "In The Light".

Jeon Wonwoo is the lead rapper and sub-vocalist of the boy group SEVENTEEN under Pledis Entertainment. He is also a member of the group's rap unit. Wonwoo debuted as a member of SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015, with the mini-album 17 Carat. He also made his debut in the sub-unit JEONGHAN X WONWOO on June 17th, 2024 with their single "This Man"

Woo Won-jae, popularly known as Woo, is a South Korean rapper recognized for his moody, dark musical style, characterized by raw lyrics drawn from real-life experiences. He first gained recognition as a contestant on Show Me the Money 6, where he finished third. He released the single “We Are” featuring Gray and Loco on September 4, 2017. The song was initially meant to be his finale song on SMTM6. The track was a commercial success, topping multiple Korean charts. On October 31, 2017, it was announced that Woo has signed with AOMG. Following the signing, he released the single album “Anxiety” in November. The same month, he released his first EP “af”. Woo later released his first studio album “Black Out” on August 18, 2020. After his contract with AOMG expired, Woo, alongside Gray and Code Kunst co-founded the label Duover in 2024.

Seong Hyun Woo, also known as WOO, is a South Korean singer under GDHG. Woo was first known for appearing in the hit survival show "Produce 101 Season 2." Following the show's conclusion, he debuted as the leader, lead rapper, and main dancer of the boy group LIMITLESS, using the stage name A.M. Although there were no official announcements, LIMITLESS became inactive and was eventually presumed to have disbanded. In February 2021, he made his official solo debut with the digital single "I Still Love You" under his own company called GDHG, using the stage name Woo.

Jo Wooyeop is a South Korean singer and dancer, as well as a former member of TS Entertainment's boy group TRCNG. He was nicknamed "Sweet Caffeine" because of his love for coffee and his reputation as the sweetest member of the group.

Woobin is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. He is the main vocalist of the boy group CRAVITY. He debuted as a member of CRAVITY on April 14, 2020 with the mini album "HIDEOUT : REMEMBER WHO WE ARE".
Jung Woo Bin is a South Korean singer. He was the main vocalist and maknae of the boy group LUMINOUS.

Woochan is a South Korean rapper under The Black Label. He is the sub rapper of the co-ed group ALLDAY PROJECT, with whom he debuted on June 23, 2025, with the single "FAMOUS". Woochan is also known for being a part of the project boy group OG SCHOOL PROJECT, with whom he debuted on January 5, 2018, with the single "OGZ", as well as the pre-debut boy group Trainee A, which was active from 2021 until their debut was cancelled in 2022. He made his solo debut on July 13, 2019, with the release of the digital single "ID Schoolboy Pt.1".

Shin Woochul is the sub-vocalist of the boy group NewKidd under J-Flo Entertainment. Before debuting, Woochul first appeared in the survival show "The Unit" and even on Ailee's MV of "Thirst". He made his official debut as a member of Newkidd and its subunits on April 18, 2019; with the self-titled single album "Newkidd". He was revealed as a member of THE7 on April 11, 2022. Him, Yongkwon and Yunmin would appear on SEVEN STARS to help in finding the four remaining members of the group. THE7's contracts ended on March 20, 2024.
Park Woo Dam is a member of the boy group D1CE under HF Music Company. He was first known for appearing on survival shows, Boys24 and Produce 101.

Woodie Gochild, born Kwak Woo-jae is a South Korean rapper who debuted under H1GHR MUSIC. He gained recognition after participating in the popular rap competition show "Show Me The Money 6" where he was part of Jay Park and Dok2's team. He released his debut single ‘Let’s get it’ featuring mentors Jay Park and Dok2 on December 15, 2017.

Woody, formerly known as Sangwoo, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under GOLDEN MOON. He made his solo debut on January 23, 2019, with the digital single "Fire Up." Woody is also recognized for his participation as a contestant on the survival show Vocal Showdown. He was previously a member of the boy group N-Train.

WOODZ, formerly known as Seung Youn, is a South Korean singer under EDAM Entertainment. Using his name Seung Youn, he first made his official debut in 2014 as a member of the Chinese-South Korean boy group UNIQ. Following the group's indefinite break from activities, the singer pursued solo activities under the stage name Luizy until he eventually changed it to WOODZ. In 2019, he joined the survival show Produce X 101 where he finished 5th place, earning him a spot in the boy group X1. On August 27, 2019, he made his debut as a member of X1. However, X1's promotions were cut short and the group ultimately disbanded in January 2020 due to Produce X 101's voting controversy. Following this, he returned to solo promotions under Yuehua Entertainment. Upon the expiration of his exclusive contract with Yuehua Entertainment in October 2022, WOODZ left the agency. A few months later, it was announced that he had signed with EDAM Entertainment, home to IU and actress Shin Se Kyung. Under EDAM Entertainment, he released his fifth mini album O-Li in April 2023. On December 10, 2023, WOODZ announced through his fan café that he would enlist in the military on January 22, 2024, and is scheduled to be discharged on July 21, 2025.
Woogie, born Park Jae-wook is a South Korean producer who debuted under Jay Park & Cha Cha Malone's label H1GHR MUSIC in 2018.

Lim Woohyuk is a South Korean rapper and singer under PLATFY Entertainment. He participated in the survival program "Produce 101 Season 2" and debuted as half of the duo "UNLOCK". Woohyuk eventually made his official solo debut in August 29 with digital single "Time".
Woohyuk is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group Like A Movie (now known as APEX) under Top Cloud Entertainment.

Nam Woo Hyun is a South Korean singer and actor currently under BILLIONS and Jflex. He is best known as a member of the boy group INFINITE and was formerly part of the project unit Toheart. As a solo artist, he promotes under his full name and made his official solo debut on May 9, 2016, with the mini-album, "Write...". He began his career in the entertainment industry with his debut as a member of INFINITE on June 9, 2010, through the release of the group’s first mini-album, First Invasion. Over the years, he has gained recognition for his powerful vocals, emotional performances, and active participation in composing and producing music. After 14 years with Woollim Entertainment, Woo Hyun decided not to renew his contract, officially parting ways with the company on October 7, 2022. Despite his departure, he continues to be an active member of INFINITE. On March 20, 2023, he signed an exclusive contract with Jflex Entertainment to further his career as both a singer and actor. Regarding his military service, Woo Hyun enlisted as a public service worker on October 24, 2019, instead of serving as an active duty soldier due to a significant shoulder injury he sustained in 2014. He successfully completed his service and was discharged on August 4, 2021.
Yoon Woohyun is the Guitarist of the rock-ballad band BUZZ under Long Play Music. Woohyun got married to RUMBLE FISH's vocalist Choi Jin Yi on March 26, 2017, they also have a son together.

Park Woojin is a South Korean rapper, dancer, songwriter, and composer under Brand New Music. He is best known as the main rapper and main dancer of the boy group AB6IX. He is also a former member of the project boy group Wanna One. In 2017, Woojin participated in the second season of Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with four other trainees from his agency, Brand New Music. He and Daehwi were the only ones to make it to the final line-up, ranking 6th and 3rd, respectively, becoming members of the boy group Wanna One. On August 7, 2017, Woojin debuted in Wanna One with the mini album "1X1=1 (To Be One)" and its title track, "Energetic". After the disbandment of Wanna One on January 27, 2019, Woojin was revealed as a member of Brand New Music's new boy group, AB6IX, which consisted of all four trainees of Produce 101 and another trainee from the agency. The group debuted on May 22, 2019 with the mini album "B:COMPLETE" and its title track, "Breathe". Before their official debut, a performance video of the track "Hollywood" was released on April 25, 2019. On February 27, 2023, Woojin made his solo debut with the EP "Own".
Lee Woojin is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and producer under MEME Label. He is a former member of the boy group MY.st. As a producer, he goes by the name RealLee.
Woojin is a singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TARGET.
Lee Woo-jin is a South Korean singer. He used to be a member of the now-disbanded group The Eastlight. He first appeared in the second season of the hit survival show "Produce 101."

Lee Woojin is a South Korean K-POP Idol under Maroo Entertainment. He made his first debut on September 18th, 2019 as apart of the three-member unit project TEEN TEEN. On August 27, 2020, Maroo Entertainment announced the members would be transferred into the lineup of their upcoming boy group, effectively disbanding TEEN TEEN. Woojin would make his second debut in that group (GHOST9) on September 23rd, 2020 with the mini album "Pre Episode 1 : Door".
Woojoo is a South Korean model and former singer. He was a member of the boy group "Megamax".
Woojoo is a South Korean singer and rapper under INAKIST Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Y&W and a former member of ELVIN CREW and predebut member of Trigger.
Kim Sangyun, better known as Woojoo, is a South Korean singer and member of the now-disbanded boy group 14U.

Cho Woo Ju is a singer under Wuzo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BLITZERS. He was revealed as a member of Wuzo's new boy group, WUZOCIRCLE (now known as BLITZERS), on March 24, 2020. He was reintroduced as the first member of BLITZERS member on January 29, 2021. Then, on May 12, he debuted with the group's debut EP 'Check-In'.
Wooju is a South Korean singer and dancer. He was a member of the virtual group AEONIT before it disbanded.
Wooju is a South Korean singer signed with WEUS Entertainment. He is part of the boy group WEUS.
Woojung is a member of the upcoming group "DIOS." He was a backup dancer for Crayon Pop's "Uh-ee" performance on M Countdown, and he also released a solo song, "HAPPYDAY," on May 16, 2019.
Wooks also known as Wookey is a South Korean solo artist - song writer, singer and raper. He debuted in 2017 with a song 'Glisten'.

Jeon Woong, popularly known as Woong, is a South Korean singer and music producer from Brand New Music. He started off as a trainee under JYP, Woolim, and YG Entertainment before eventually joining his current label. After years of extensive training, Woong made his official debut in 2019 as the main vocalist of the boy group AB6IX.

Woongki is a South Korean singer and actor under F&F Entertainment. Woongki competed and finished 4th place in the survival show WORLD KLASS, thus being able to become a member of the boy group TO1. He debuted with them on April 1, 2020 with the release of their first mini album titled "Reason for Being: Benevolence". On June 17, 2022, WAKEONE announced that Woongki had left TO1 but was preparing for a new start. In 2023, Woongki participated in MNET' survival show Boys Planet, where he was sadly eliminated after ranking 20th place. Being a child actor from 2007 to 2010, playing in dramas such as 'Yi San', 'The Road Home', 'Green Coach', and 'Jejoongwon', Woongki took back this field of work in 2024 when he played a main role in the drama 'Love for Love's Sake'. He was a contestant in SBS' survival show Universe League, where he ranked 2nd place overall, securing his spot as a member of the final group AHOF.
Woonhak is a South Korean singer under KOZ Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of BOYNEXTDOOR on May 30th, 2023 with the single album "WHO!"
Hong Wonho is a South Korean singer under Brand New Music. He is a member of the boy group YOUNITE.
Ko Woorim is a South Korean singer. He is the youngest member of the crossover vocal quartet Forestella.

Woo Sang Soo, also known by his stage name Woosang, was the leader, vocalist, rapper, and choreographer of disbanded boy group AA He was one of two remaining members in the group up until they disbanded in 2015.
Wooseojun is a South Korean rapper and singer under PYRAT and is a member of 0WAVE.

Jung Wooseok is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and the main rapper, vocalist, and maknae of PENTAGON. Known for his deep voice and tall stature, he has collaborated with various artists, including Soyeon of (G)I-DLE and Lai Kuanlin. Wooseok debuted with PENTAGON on October 10, 2016, with the mini-album PENTAGON. On March 11, 2019, he debuted in the unit Wooseok X Kuanlin alongside former Wanna One member Lai Kuanlin, releasing the EP 9801 and the title track I'm A Star. In 2020, he participated in the rap competition show Show Me the Money 9 but was eliminated during the 60-Second Team Trials. Despite this, he remains active as a rapper and performer in the industry.

Wooseok is a South Korean singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show "Boys Planet." On March 2, he was eliminated from the show in episode 5 after ranking 67th place.

Kim Woo Seok, also known as Wooshin is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under TOP Media. He is a member of the boy group UP10TION and a former member of the project boy group X1. He made his solo debut on May 25, 2020 with the mini album 1st Desire [Greed]. In 2019, he, along with fellow member Wei, participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101. He finished in second place, thus becaming a member of X1. The group officially debuted on August 27, 2019 with the mini album, Quantum Leap. However, on January 6, 2020, the agencies representing the members announced the group has disbanded due to not being able to reach an unanimous agreement following the Produce 101 vote manipulation controversy. In February, it was announced by TOP Media that he would release his first solo album, it was released on May 25, with the mini album "1st Desire [Greed]". On March 5, 2024, TOP Media announced that Kim Woo Seok has left the agency after deciding not to renew his contract. The same day, Wooseok joined H&Entertainment, a subsidiary of Blitzway Entertainment.
Woosoo is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He is a former member of the boy groups MASC and E7.He made his solo debut on June 30, 2020 with the digital single "The Rain".
Kim Minseok, going by the stage name Woosu, is the drummer of the boy band IZ under Music K Entertainment.
Woo Sung is a South Korean singer under WIDMAY Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group SNUPER.

Woosung, also known as Sammy, is a South Korean-American singer-songwriter, producer, and musician. He is the leader, main vocalist, and guitarist of the boy band The Rose. In addition to his work with the group, he launched his solo career on July 25, 2019, with the release of his first mini-album, Wolf, under his independent label, Woolfpack. Before pursuing music, Woosung played American football throughout junior high and high school in the United States until a shoulder injury led him to focus on music instead. Known for his love of animals, he even created an Instagram account for his Pomsky, Woolfy. In 2022, he joined Epik High as a special guest during their Epik High Is Here North America Tour.
Wootae is a South Korean singer and member of the co-ed gospel group Diaconia.
Wooyeon is a member of the South Korean boy group MustB.

Wooyoung is a South Korean dancer, singer, and songwriter under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ, whom he debuted on October 24, 2018 with the release of their first mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero". Before debuting, Wooyoung appeared and competed on the survival show "MIXNINE" where he was eliminated after ranking 132nd. On May 8, 2023, KQ Entertainment announced that Wooyoung will be going on a temporary hiatus due to an ankle injury. On May 29, the hiatus ended.
Wooyoung is a South Korean singer under HYPER RHYTHM. He is a member of the boy group AIMERS and a former member of the pre-debut group DSP N.
Wooyoung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, and actor under JYP Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 2PM and made his solo debut on July 8, 2012 with the mini album 23, Male, Single.
Wooyoung is a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TST.

Lee Jihoon, better known by his stage name Woozi, is a South Korean singer, dancer, songwriter, composer, arranger, and producer under Pledis Entertainment. He is the main dancer, lead vocalist, and sub-rapper of the boy group SEVENTEEN. On January 3, 2022, Woozi released his first mixtape, titled Ruby. Within the group, Woozi is the leader of SVT VOCAL Team and is responsible for producing most of their songs. He has also taken part in writing songs for other artists, such as Ailee and Eric Nam. Woozi is also credited with writing "Downpour," which happens to be the last digital single of the project girl group I.O.I.

World, also known by his birthname Nam Hyunjoon, is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy groups D.BACE and SM☆SH. In 2008 Hyunjoon left D.BACE and debuted in SMASH. In 2018 he reunited with D.BACE where they performed one last time.
Han Junghoon, also known as Wormboy, is a South Korean rapper and former member of the disbanded group UglyPumpkin.
Woshi is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He made his solo debut on April 1, 2020 with the digital single "Cool". He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.

Wow is a South Korean rapper under Beat Interactive. He is the main rapper of the boy group A.C.E. In 2017, he, and his fellow members Kim Byeongkwan and Donghun, became a contestant on the JTBC's new survival show MIXNINE. He was eliminated in the episode 13 after achieving 11th place.
Wu Hao is a Chinese singer. He made his solo debut on June 25, 2025 with the digital single "Rise to the world". He was a contestant on the survival show Debut's Plan.

Wumuti is a Uyghur-Chinese singer. He is the leader of the boy group XLOV, a member of the project boy group WATERFIRE, and a former member of the Chinese boy group SWIN and its sub-unit SWIN-S. He left the group and the company in 2018. He debuted as a soloist under JPARK&COMPANY on January 16, 2023, with a song called "seOUL" in collaboration with fellow Under Nineteen contestant, Rose. He is best known for being a contestant on the Chinese survival show Super Idol, Korean survival shows Under Nineteen (left the show), Boys Planet (eliminated in episode 8), and Build Up (eliminated in episode 10). On December 17, 2024, it was revealed that he would be debuting in a group named XLOV.

Wuuslime, formelly known as Chillin Homie, is a South Korean rapper under Mine Field, who debuted under Dynasty Muzik on September 2, 2018. After leaving he joined VIXX's RAVI's label GROOVL1N, but left on March 26, 2021.

Wyatt is the Main Rapper and Dancer of the group ONF under WM Entertainment. Born as Shim Jae-young on Seoul South Korea, he lived for a few years in Kazakhstan where he learned how to speak in English. Wyatt went on to train for 7 years in Korea until he made his official debut with the group ONF. Wyatt is also a member of the OFF sub-unit. Furthermore, Wyatt appeared and competed in the Survival Show Mixnine. On November 2, 2021, Wyatt announced that he, alongside the other members of ONF, except U, will be enlisting in December. On December 27, Wyatt enlisted as an active duty soldier. He, along with J-Us, was officially discharged on June 26, 2023.
Xayden is a South Korean singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.
Xen (formerly Jin Woo) is a singer and lyricist of the boy group OMEGA X. He is signed with IPQ and was formerly part of the boy group 1TEAM.

Xero is a former member of the boy group ToppDogg and is currently a rapper in the reformed five-member group XENO-T. He participated in the idol rebooting show The Unit, but did not pass the auditions. It was announced that Xero would enlist in the military on February 11, 2019.
Xi:on is a South Korean singer and streamer under Familya Entertainment and a member of the virtual group ARRIVAL.

XIA (Kim Junsu) is a South Korean singer, musical actor, and entrepreneur known for his powerful vocals and commanding stage presence. Debuting as the main vocalist of TVXQ in 2003 and later as a member of JYJ, he has built a successful solo career since 2012, releasing multiple acclaimed albums across various genres. Beyond his music, XIA has made a name for himself in the musical theatre industry, starring in productions such as Mozart!, Elisabeth, and Dracula. In 2021, he established his own agency, PALMTREE ISLAND, where he serves as CEO, managing both his career and other musical actors. With his unwavering passion for music and theatre, XIA remains a highly respected and influential figure in the industry.
Xiao is a Chinese singer and dancer under A Team Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group VAV (Very Awesome Voice) but left in 2016.

Xiao dejun, known under his stage name Xiaojun, is a Chinese singer and is a main vocalist of NCT and its China-based subunit, WayV. Previously, he was a SM Entertainment trainee and was introduced as a member of SMROOKIES on July 17, 2018, until his debut with WayV on January 17, 2019.
Xie Jia Hui is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Xie Yuxin is a Chinese trainee under TOP CLASS Entertainment. He is best known for competing in the SBS survival show Universe League as well as Mnet's survival show Boys II Planet.
Xiha is a South Korean singer under Victory Company. He is a member of the boy group NTX. On January 22, 2025, Victory Company announced that Jaemin had changed his stage name to Xiha.

Sim Junghyun, better known under the stage name Xiho, is a South Korean singer under NineTwo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group 3WAY. On July 12, 2024, Xiho was announced as a member of 3WAY.
Xin is a Chinese member of Varsity.

Xin Che is a Chinese singer under UN24. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys. He made his solo debut on August 30, 2024, with the single "Romantic Guide".

Huang Xinchun, also known as Hwang Shin Chon and Ryder Huang, is a Chinese idol singer and member of the boy group NEX7 under Yue Hua Entertainment. He made his debut as a member of NEX7 on June 21, 2018 with the album ‘THE FIRST’ and later made his solo debut in 2019. He also participated in Idol Producer in 2018 but was eliminated, ranking 32nd.

Xinlong is the lead rapper, vocalist, and main dancer of the Chinese boy group BOY STORY under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China. He is also a member of the project group ALPHA DRIVE ONE. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet. During the show's finale, he ranked 3rd, securing his spot in the debut group.
Xion is a South Korean singer under RBW. He is a member of the boy group ONEUS. He debuted as a member of ONEUS on January 9, 2019 with the release of their first mini album "Light Us".

Kim Min-seok, better known by his stage name Xiumin is a South Korean singer and actor under INB100. He is a member of the boy group EXO and their sub-units EXO-M and EXO-CBX. Born on March 26, 1990, Xiumin is EXO's eldest member although he looks like one of the youngest. He became a trainee in 2008 and officially debuted with the group in 2012. In January 2015, Xiumin made his musical theatre debut, playing the character of Aquila in the SM Entertainment musical School OZ alongside labelmates Changmin, Key, Luna, Suho, and Seulgi. In October 2015, Xiumin played the leading role opposite actress Kim Soeun in the web drama Falling for Challenge. On October 31, 2016, Xiumin debuted as a group sub-unit EXO-CBX member with the mini-album "Hey Mama!" On September 26, 2022, Xiumin made his official solo debut through the mini album "Brand New." On June 1, 2023, Xiumin, Baekhyun, and Chen revealed the termination of their exclusive contracts with SM Entertainment.
Xiweol is a member of Varsity.
Xiwoo is a South Korean singer under Choeun Entertainment. He is a member of 24K+.

XngHan, formerly known as Seunghan, is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a former member of the boy group RIIZE. He was first introduced as part of the trainee group, SMROOKIES, on July 2, 2022, and debuted with RIIZE on September 4, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar". Due to leaked personal information, he was indefinitely withdrawn from the group on November 21, 2023. Although his return was briefly announced on October 10, 2024, SM retracted the statement three days later, confirming his departure from RIIZE. In June 2025, SM Entertainment announced that Seunghan would make his solo debut under the stage name XngHan, alongside the launch of creative project XngHan&Xoul. The “Xoul” part of the project refers to a rotating crew of collaborators. His debut single album "Waste No Time" was released on July 31, 2025, with the title track of the same name & b-side "Heavenly Blue".

Xu Shi Huan is a Chinese singer under Idol Youth Entertaiment. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys. He is recognized for his participation in the survival shows Fan Pick and Starlight Boys.
Xu Shifan is a Chinese trainee. He gained fame after appearing on the survival show Fan Pick.
Xuan Hao is a Chinese trainee under Beijing Stardyehot Entertainment. He is best known for competing on the survival shows "Boys Planet", where he ranked 54th, and "Boys II Planet".
Xue Su Ren is a Hong Kongese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival shows Under Nineteen and Boys II Planet.

Shin Seunghoon is a South Korean rapper, songwriter, and producer currently signed under LUK Factory. He is the former leader of the boy group NOIR and previously served as a member of ZEST. As a solo artist, he performs under the stage name XXIN and debuted on November 9, 2020, with the digital single "Don't Touch Me."

XXXY, formerly known as Yoon, is a South Korean singer and rapper. He was previously a part of the boy band Xing. In 2014, XXXY started his solo career with the release of his debut track titled “Flower”.

Park Chi-woong, widely known as Xydo, is an R&B South Korean singer who debuted under VIXX' Ravi's label GROOVL1N on August 14th, 2019. He has been releasing and producing a lot of albums and songs for himself and some fellow idols' as well including Ravi's 'PARADISE' in which he participated in composition. Another is OnlyOneOf's "a sOng Of Ice & Fire", "libidO", "skinz" and a lot more. He also participated in the composition of NCT 127's "Skyscraper". He also featured in a lot of songs including Ravi's "Still Nirvana" and "Limitless" On May 9th, 2024 Xydo took to Instagram to announce that he has left the company Groovl1n, and for fans to stay tuned!

Choi Seongyoon, popularly known as Y, is the main vocalist and visual of the boy group Golden Child under Woollim Entertainment. He originally joined Woollim in 2012 with the intention of becoming an actor but later changed his path and trained as a singer instead. On December 27, Woollim announced on Weverse that the exclusive contracts of Golden Child members Lee Daeyeol, Y, Bae Seungmin, Bong Jaehyun, and Kim Donghyun would expire on December 31.
Y is set to debut as a member of the boy group I1IT on August 25, 2022.
Yami Tommy is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2019.

Yanagi, formerly known as JD, is a South Korean trot singer. He is a former member of the kids' progressive metal band MetallateM, with whom he debuted on April 12, 2010, as well as the boy group Apeace and its sub-units Apeace Onyx and later Apeace Jade5. He was added to Apeace on April 23, 2013, and joined its sub-unit Onyx as a replacement for former member Hoyoung. After the group went through several lineup changes, the units were reorganized, and he was placed in Jade5. In addition to his activities as an idol, he also appeared on Mr. Trot Japan.

Yan An is a Chinese singer best known as the sub-vocalist and visual of PENTAGON. He debuted with the group on October 10, 2016, with the mini-album PENTAGON. On August 22, 2018, Cube Entertainment announced that Yan An would go on hiatus due to health reasons. He resumed group activities in September 2020.
Yang Chengxi is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Yang Chuan Zhou is a Chinese trainee under Banana Culture Music. He is a member of the trainee group TRAINEE18. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows Asia Super Young and SCOOL.
Yang Da Wit is a South Korean trainee under RBW. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Yang Donghwa is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Bluedot Entertainment. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys. He is a former pre-debut member of the boy group ATBO. He made his solo debut on February 18, 2024, with the digital single "Blackout". He is also known for participating in the survival shows “The Origin – A, B, OR What? and Starlight Boys.
Yang Hyeonbin is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show B:MY BOYZ.

Yang Hyun Suk is a South Korean entrepreneur, record executive, record producer, and former rapper. He is best known for being a member of the legendary group Seo Taiji and The Boys and co-founder of the agency YG Entertainment who produced globally sucessful groups such as BIGBANG, 2NE1, WINNER, IKON, and BLACKPINK. He made his official debut on 1992 as a member of the trio Seo Taiji and The Boys. Following the group's disbandment in 1996, he co-founded and spearheaded YG Entertainment which ultimately become one of the "big three" agencies of South Korea. In 2019, Yang Hyun Suk stepped down as the head of operations after being embroiled in drug and prostitution scandals.
Yang Jang Semin is a South Korean musician. He is the bassist of the rock band The Whales. He was also a contestant on SuperBand 2.
Yang Jia Peng is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Yang Jun is a trainee under ASE. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."
Yang Yan is a Singaporean trainee under Insight Entertainment. He is recognized for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Yangeop is a South Korean guitarist, member of the co-ed rock band 5but. He joined the band in January 2021 to replace Gitae.

YANGHONGWON, also known by his former stage name Young B is a South Korean hip-hop artist under INDIGO Music. He was a former member and leader of the underground hip-hop crew DiCKIDS before their 2019 disbandment. He was also a part of the crew D.O.G. Yang first made waves in the industry participating and winning High School Rapper 1, which led him to sign with INDIGO Music. He then went on to compete in multiple seasons of Show Me the Money and placed runner up in season 8. Prior to his major label debut, he released a mixtape titled ‘I'm The B From D’ in 2015. He released his debut EP ‘Sokonyuon’ August 17, 2018, followed by his debut album ‘Stranger’ in 2019. He is known for his musical style blending traditional sounds with alternative hip-hop & boom-bap. Since his debut he has explored other genres including rock and reggaeton. Yang’s music draws comparisons to the likes of Busta Rhymes and Bad Bunny due to the explosive delivery and unique beats. In November 2024, he and his long-term partner welcomed their daughter, Yang Ru-ah.

Liu Yangyang is a Taiwanese-German rapper, dancer, and songwriter under SM Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group NCT. He is also best known as the main rapper and lead dancer of the group's subunits WayV and NCT U. Previously, Yangyang was a trainee in SM Entertainment and has been introduced through SMROOKIES on July 17 , 2018.

Yao Mingming , also known as Yao Bonan , is a singer under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He is a former member of the groups UNINE and BLK. He debuted on October 23, 2020, with the single "Mirror Me". Mingming was a pre-debut member of SEVENTEEN and appeared on the reality show Seventeen TV. At some point in 2013 he left the group and agency.In 2017, Mingming joined the survival show MIXNINE. He ranked 10th in the finale, and hence did not make it into the winning lineup. He was confirmed to be a new member of BLK in April 2018, but never made his official debut with them as they disbanded a few months later. In 2019, he participated in the Chinese survival show Youth With You. He ranked third place, making him a member of the project group UNINE.

Yaochen is a Chinese singer and former trainee under JYP Entertainment. He first gained prominence through his participation in the Tencent audition reality show, which led to his debut as a member of the boy band ‘R1SE’, securing 5th place in the final rankings. Yaochen’s musical journey continued with the release of his debut digital single “NEVERMIND” in December 2020, marking the start of a vigorous solo career. On April 29, 2024, Yaochen expanded his discography with the release of “TURN UP” (Korean ver.), his first official Korean original track. He is currently signed with FANLING CULTURE, a subsidiary of JYP CHINA. He had his first physical album, further establishing his presence in the music industry. During his time at JYPE, Yaochen trained alongside the members of the South Korean boy group Stray Kids, with whom he maintains a close friendship.
