maleIdols.description: Yaya, better known as Sood Yacht, and formerly known as Surat, is a Thai actor currently managed by GMMTV. Yaya made his acting debut in Thailand in 2017 and progressively rose to stardom through multiple guest and support appearances on various dramas, notably BLs. He gained attention for his portrayal of "Pond" in the 2018 BL drama "Love By Chance". In 2023, Yaya was revealed to be one of the participants of the MBC survival show "Fantasy Boys". He eventually dropped out from the show due to health issues. On April 15, 2024, his contract was terminated with Studio Wabi Sabi due to the suspension of the artist management department. He was then revealed to have signed a new contract with GMMTV.

Shin Ye Chan, also known as Yechan, is a singer-songwriter under IPQ and Aria Group. He debuted with OMEGA X, a boy group, on June 30, 2021 with their first mini album Vamos. Before that, he was in 1THE9, a project group formed by the survival show Under Nineteen. He joined the show as a vocal team member and ranked fourth. 1THE9 disbanded on August 8, 2020 after releasing their final mini album Good Bye 1THE9.

Yechan is a singer under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ. Yechan debuted as a member of TRENDZ on January 5, 2022 with their first mini album "Blue Set Chapter 1. Tracks.".
Yechan is a vocalist, rapper, and dancer under Great M Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group 82MAJOR on October 11, 2023 with the single album "ON".

Yechan is a South Korean rapper under KQ Entertainment. He officially debuted on March 30, 2023, as the maknae, main rapper, and main dancer of the boy group xikers. As a trainee, he was known for participating in the survival show "Under Nineteen." He was the youngest contestant on the show at just 12 years old.

Lee Ye Dam is a South Korean Singer under ARMADA Ent. He is the Maknae of the boy group ONE PACT. Prior to this, he shot to fame after participating in the survival shows "Loud" in 2021, "Boys Planet" in 2022, and in the show "Show King Night" in 2023. On October 5, 2023, Armada Entertainment revealed Yedam as the Fourth Member of their upcoming boy group ONE PACT.
Yeeun was the second member revealed as part of Bunny.T's brand new lineup and is set to debut in the 4-member girl group in 2025.

Kim Ye Hyeon is a member of the South Korean boy group Gidongdae under 2Y Entertainment. Yehyeon was first known for appearing in the second season of Produce 101 where he ranked 32nd on the final episode.
Yehyun is a member of Group 1/N
Yejong is a South Korean singer under Black Bear Records. He is a member of the boy group DAYCHILD.
Yejun is a South Korean singer under VLAST. He is a member of the virtual boy group PLAVE.

Oh Yejun is a South Korean rapper under E Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group E'LAST. On March 28, 2020, he was announced as a member of the upcoming boy group, then known as EBOYZ. Now called E'LAST, the group made their official debut on June 9, 2020 with the mini album Day Dream.
Kim Yejun is the drummer for rock-ballad band BUZZ under Long Play Music. Yejun got married to his non-celebrity wife in 2013.
Yejun is a South Korean singer under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO. He joined the group in December 2020.
Yejun is a South Korean actor and trainee. He is best known for participating in the reality survival show &AUDITION - The Howling -.

Sim Yejun, known mononymously as Yejun, is a South Korean singer and songwriter currently signed under Warner Music Korea. He is best known as the youngest member of the boy group F.CUZ. In addition to his group activities, Yejun has pursued a solo career under his full name, showcasing a more personal and introspective musical style through various digital releases in both Korean and Japanese markets.
Yellow D is a South Korean rapper who debuted under M.B.A Crew as a member of MBA.
Yeo Gang Dong is a South Korean trainee who is currently participating in the SBS survival show "Universe League."

Yeo Changgu, better known as Yeo One, is a South Korean singer and actor best known as the lead vocalist of PENTAGON. Before debuting, he gained early recognition as a trainee by appearing in music videos such as G.NA’s Secret. Yeo One debuted with PENTAGON on October 10, 2016, with the mini-album PENTAGON. In January 2024, he joined Mnet’s reality survival show Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor as a contestant. On May 28, 2024, he announced that he had begun his mandatory military service.
Yeojeong is a South Korean singer under Beat Interactive. He is a member of the boy group NEWBEAT and was member of the disbanded boy group TO1.
Yeon is a South Korean rapper and producer. He was a member of the duo Team X and the project group D.A.N. He is a part of the studio 3^Def and is currently uploading songs to his SoundCloud.
Yeonggwang is a South Korean singer under KLAP Entertainment. He is the maknae of the boy group VANNER.
Youngjo is a South Korean dancer and singer. He is a former member of the boy group BEATWIN under Elen Entertainment, which he left on December 22, 2017.
Yeong Kyun is a South Korean singer and rapper. He was a member of the boy group Be.A, formerly known K-MUCH.

Ju Yeonho is a South Korean singer under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is currently the main vocalist of the boy group VERIVERY. Yeonho debuted as a member of VERIVERY on January 9, 2019 with their debut mini album Veri-Us.

Yeon is a South Korean singer and a member of the virtual boy group Psychode. He debuted with Psychode on February 23, 2024, with their debut digital single "Crazier", as the Sub Vocalist and Chief Secretary. His birthday is on March 2 of a unknown year.

Choi Yeonjun is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, dancer, and composer under Big Hit Entertainment and HYBE Labels. He is best known as the oldest member of the boy group TXT. Yeonjun made headlines when he was unveiled as the first member of Big Hit's newest boy group, TXT (Tomorrow X Together). Yeonjun trained for four years and was said to be a former trainee under Cube Entertainment. While training, he performed as a backup dancer on several stages. On March 4, 2019, Yeonjun officially debuted as a member of TXT through the first mini-album ‘The Dream Chapter: STAR’. On September 19, 2024, Yeonjun made his solo debut with the single album "GGUM".

Kim Yeonkuk, known as Yeonkuk, is a South Korean singer under LUK Factory and the lead dancer and vocalist of the boy group NOIR. Before debuting, he competed on Produce 101 Season 2 in 2017 and later performed alongside well-known idols in the Japanese musical Altar Boyz. Known for his laid-back personality, styling skills, and love for anime, Yeonkuk is currently enlisted in the military, with his enlistment date undisclosed.

Kim Yeonkyu, also known as Yeonkyu, is a member of the South Korean boy group ATBO under IST Entertainment. He was a contestant on “THE ORIGIN – A, B, OR What?" and debuted with ATBO by placing seventh place by the balancer's choice. He's also a former participant of YG Treasure Box but got eliminated on Episode 9.

Yeontae is a South Korean singer best known as a member of the boy group SKYE (originally IN2IT) and it's sub-unit CoA. Prior to debuting, he competed on the 2016 survival show BOYS24 which the group IN2IT was formed through. After placing 2nd, he debuted with the group on October 26, 2017 with their mini album "Carpe Diem".
Yeontae is a South Korean trainee under Pinnacle Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group YUHZ. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows Project 7 and B:MY BOYZ.
Yeonwoo is a singer under Cube Entertainment. He debuted in the upcoming boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024 with the single album "NOWADAYS".

Yeosang is a South Korean dancer, singer, rapper, and songwriter under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ, which he debuted on October 24, 2018, with the release of their first mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero". On March 2, 2021, Yeosang made his first appearance as an MC for SBS MTV's The Show. Despite initially leaving his position on December 14, 2021, it was revealed on January 18, 2022 that Yeosang would be coming back. On March 5, 2024, it was announced that he would be stepping down of his MC position.
Lee Kyeongbin, also known as Yeoun, is the Sub-Vocalist of the Boy Group Argon under MHS Entertainment.
Yeram is a South Korean singer under ASTORY Entertainment. He is a member and of the boy group ASTIN.

Kim Jong Woon, popularly known as Yesung, is a South Korean singer and actor. Yesung rose to fame for being the main vocalist of the legendary boy group Super Junior under SM Entertainment. Yesung made his first television appearance in 1999 and became a trainee under SM Entertainment when he auditioned for "Starlight Casting System 2001". He eventually made his official debut on November 6, 2005.
Yeung is a South Korean singer under Nature Space. He is a member of the boy group XONIK and a former pre-debut member of SUPERX. He is best known for participating in the survival show Project 7.
Yeung Yuk Him is a Hong Kongese trainee under Media Asia. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Yewang is a South Korean singer under C9 Entertainment. In 2021, he debuted as the main vocalist of the boy group EPEX.
Park Yejun, better known as Yey, is a South Korean singer and member of the now-disbanded boy group BLACK6IX.
Yichen is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for competing on the survival shows PROJECT7, where he ranked 12th, and Boys II Planet.
Lee Soo is the vocalist of the Korean band AboutU.

Zhou Yi Xuan is a Chinese singer and actor under Yue Hua Entertainment. He made his official debut in October 2014 as one of the leaders and rappers of the South Korean-Chinese boy group UNIQ. Following UNIQ's hiatus in Korean promotions, Yi Xuan focused on promoting in China. He also participated in the survival program "All For One" where he finished first place, making him a member of the project boy group New Storm.

Wang Yibo is an award-winning Chinese actor, singer, dancer, TV host, and professional motorcycle racer under Yuehua Entertainment. Born on August 5, 1997, in Luoyang, Henan, China, he rose to fame as a member of the South Korean-Chinese boy band UNIQ, debuting in 2014 with their single "Falling in Love." As UNIQ's maknae, main dancer, and main rapper, Wang demonstrated his multilingual talents, becoming fluent in Chinese and Korean after completing high school in South Korea. In 2016, Wang made his acting debut in the film MBA Partners and began hosting the variety show Day Day Up, which he continues to co-host. His breakout role came in 2019 with the drama The Untamed, propelling him to international fame. That year, he ranked 71st on Forbes China's Top 100 Celebrity List and was also named to their 30 Under 30 Asia list for his significant contributions to entertainment and dance. Wang's prowess extends beyond entertainment to motorsports. Competing as part of the Yamaha China Racing Team in 2019, he won first place in his division. As a solo artist, his 2019 single "No Sense" shattered records, becoming the fastest-selling digital single on NetEase Music with over 10 million yuan in sales within hours. His songwriting debut further showcased his versatility and creative talent. Recognized as a global cultural ambassador, Wang was appointed Promotional Ambassador for the Luoyang Museum in 2022. In 2023, he won Best Actor at the 20th China Movie Channel Media Awards for his performances in Hidden Blade and Born to Fly. Continuing to excel across multiple fields, Wang blends passion with discipline, solidifying his reputation as one of China's most influential stars.
YLN Foreign, born Lee Jung-woon is a South Korean rapper who debuted under 24Kid in 2019.

Yoel is a South Korean singer under HYPER RHYTHM. He is a member of the boy group AIMERS. Yoel was first revealed as a member of B301 Entertainment's trainee group B3o1z (later renamed AIMERS) on April 14, 2022. They made their debut with the compact album 'Stage 0. Betting Starts' on November 17, 2022.

Yohan was a South Korean singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group TST and a former member of the boy group NOM. On June 17, 2020, SPOTV News reported that he had passed away on the 16th. The cause of death was not revealed at the family's request.

Yohan Kim is a South Korean jazz pianist and singer. He is signed with SM Classics, a subsidiary SM Entertainment. Yohan marked his debut with the single “Hummingbird,” which was released on June 7, 2024.
Yong Hoon is a South Korean singer and musician under RBW. He is the leader of the boy band ONEWE.

Yong Junhyung is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and producer under his own independent label Black Made. He is a former member of the boy groups Highlight (formerly BEAST) and XING under the name Poppin Dragon. He made his solo debut on December 13, 2013, with his first mini-album Flower.
Yoon Yongbin is a South Korean actor and trainee under Banana Entertainment. He participated in several dramas and survival shows such as "MIXNINE" and "Produce 101 Season 2".

Yoo Yong Ha (or simply Yongha) is a South Korean rapper and singer under OUI Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WEi and a former member of the project group 1THE9. On October 25, 2018, Yoo Yong Ha was introduced as a contestant of Under Nineteen with his moving poster. The poster revealed that he was a part of the rap team. He finished in sixth place, thus becoming a member of the project group 1THE9. The group officially debuted on April 13, 2019, with the mini album 'XIX'. 1THE9 officially disbanded on August 8, 2020, following the release of their final mini album 'Good Bye 1THE9'. Yongha debuted as a member of WEi on October 5, 2020 with their first mini album 'IDENTITY:First Sight'.
Yonghee is a South Korean singer under C9 Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group CIX.

Jung Yonghwa is a South Korean musician, singer-songwriter, record producer, and actor. Besides starring in multiple internationally popular dramas, Yonghwa is also known as the leader and main vocalist of the band CNBLUE. He made his official solo debut as a singer in 2015 with the mini-album "One Fine Day". Yonghwa enlisted in the military in March 2018 and was discharged in November 2019.
Yongjae is a member of the South Korean R&B group 4Men.
Lee Yongjoon is a South Korean singer under RBW. He is the maknae of the boy group NXD.

Yongkwon was revealed as a member of THE7 on April 11, 2022. Him, Woochul and Yunmin would appear on the show Seven Stars to help in finding the four remaining members of the group. He was a contestant on the survival show Boys24.
Yongseok is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the co-ed group CHECKMATE.

Kim Yongseok is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group Cross Gene. On December 31, 2019, it was announced that he decided not to renew his contract because of his upcoming military service.
Byun Yongseok is a South Korean singer. He debuted in April 2017 as a member of the boy group BLACK6IX.

Yongseung is a South Korean singer currently under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VERIVERY. Yongseung debuted as a member of VERIVERY on January 9, 2019 with their first mini album Veri-Us.

Yongzoo is a South Korean singer, composer, and producer under MostWorks Entertainment. He debuted on May 22, 2018 with the single "In Your Eyes". He was formerly a trainee under SM Entertainment as part of SMROOKIES. He later left the company sometime in 2014.
Yoo Geunmin is a South Korean idol trainee under Million Market Entertainment. He first appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".

Yoo Hee Yeol is a South Korean singer, songwriter, host, and tv personality. He is first known as a member of the duo Toy, together with Yoon Jeong Oh. Following Yoon Jeong Oh's departure from the duo, Yoo Hee Yeol has since then been a one-man-band under the stage name Toy. Yoo He Yeol is considered as one of South Korea's brightest and most iconic stars. He was also able to establish his own label "Antenna Music" which is home to artists including Yoo Jae Suk, Sam Kim, and Kwon Jin Ah.
Han Yoo-Il, better known as Yoo Il, is a South Korean singer and actor. He first debuted as a member of the boy group 5URPRISE along with fellow actors under Fantagio Entertainment.

Yoo Jae-suk is a South Korean comedian, host and television personality currently signed to FNC Entertainment. He has hosted several variety television shows in South Korea, including Infinite Challenge, Running Man, and Happy Together. Known for his quick wit and appeal across a wide range of demographics, Yoo has established himself as one of South Korea's top comedians and TV personalities, arguably the most well-known and popular celebrity in South Korea.

Yoo Jinwoo, formerly known as Lee Eugene, is a South Korean actor and musician under Namoo Actors. Besides appearing in hit dramas like "Sky Castle", Jinwoo has also participated in the survival program "Produce X 101".
Yoo Ki Won is a South Korean trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Yoo Kyungmok is currently a trainee under Totalset Entertainment. He was a competitor on Produce 101 Season 2. However, he ranked #84 on episode 5 and was eliminated. Before Produce 101, in 2011, Kyungmok was a member of the group BoM alongside now idol, Song Mino from Winner. However, the group disbanded in 2013 due to their label closing down. In 2014 Kyungmok then debuted with the group BTL. However, Kyungmok left the group to pursue a solo career shortly after they debuted.

Yoo Seonho is a South Korean singer and actor under Cube Entertainment. He is currently one of the main casts of the hit variety show "2 Days and 1 Night." When he was still an idol trainee, Yoo Seonho participated in the hit survival show Produce 101 Season 2, where he finished 17th place. After the show, he continued to train and eventually made his official debut on April 11, 2018, with the EP "Spring, Seonho." Yoo Seonho appeared in dramas and eventually had a breakout role in the hit 2022 historical drama "Under the Queen's Umbrella." When the drama ended, he was announced as one of the newest cast members of "2 Days and 1 Night."
Yoo Seung Eon is a South Korean trainee signed with Yue Hua. He is a member of the boy group EVNNE under Jellyfish Entertainment. The group debuted on September 19, 2023.

Yoo Seung-Woo, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and guitarist signed under Starship Entertainment's subsidiary label, Highline Entertainment. Yoo Seung-Woo's television debut was in 2012, but his solo debut was on May 8th, 2013 with his first mini-album, 'The First Picnic'. He was nominated for the 2013 Mnet Asian Music Awards for "Best New Male Artist". In February 2015, Seung-Woo signed under Starship Entertainment acoustic sublabel, "Starship Y". However, in September 2020, it was officially announced that he moved to a different subsidiary label to renew his contract.

Yoo Taeyang is the lead vocalist and main dancer of the boy group SF9 under FNC Entertainment. Aside from singing and dancing, Taeyang is also good at playing the guitar and calligraphy. He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016, with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation".

Yoo Yongmin is a South Korean singer-songwriter. He is a member of the band Open Run!. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening. He debuted as a soloist on February 20, 2017 with the digital single “Unfamiliar”.
Yoo Young Hyun is a South Korean drummer. He was a member of the rock band Jannabi.

Yoo Young Jin is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under A2O Entertainment. He made his debut in September 1993 with the mini album "Blues In Rhythm Single 1". He was under SM Entertainment from his debut in 1993, were he continued to be a producer, and left on March 15, 2023 after the company's change in management. He then joined Lee Soo Man's new company A2O Entertainment as a producer.

Park Yu Chun, previously known as Micky Yoochun is a South Korean former singer, songwriter and actor. He is a former member of the boy groups JYJ and TVXQ!. He made his solo debut on January 18, 2016, with his first mini album "How Much Love Do You Have In Your Wallet". On April 24, 2019 Yu Chun announced his retirement from the entertainment industry after testing positive from drugs. On March 11, 2020 Yu Chun oppened new Instagram and Twitter accounts and on April 20, 2020, he launched an official fan site. He also released a photo book and has held several fan-related events. On July 31,2020 he announced that he is preparing for the release of a new album. On October 29, he announced his comeback with his second mini album "RE:mind" on November 19, 2020. On August 14, 2021, a Japanese media outlet reported that Yu Chun had signed with a new agency in Japan because of lack of payment from Re:Cielo. On August 18, Re:Cielo released a statement to deny the claims and explain their side of the story. In an interview, their lawyer explained that they are preparing a civil damages lawsuit against Yu Chun for the harm received by Re:Cielo and Re:Cielo's CEO as a result of his breach of contract as well as compensation for damages for defaming the agency's CEO. On August 24, Park Yu Chun released a statement on his Japanese website to deny the recent accusations and to announce that he is preparing to make a legal response.
Yoojun is a South Korean singer under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy groups BAE173 and Double 0ne.
Jung Min Hwan, also known by his stage name Yoojun, is a member of the boy group D1CE.
Lee Taeyeob, better known as YooJung, is a South Korean singer under 8D Entertainment. He debuted as a member of OnlyOneOf on May 28, 2019 with the mini album "Dot point jump'.
Yoomin was a member of the South Korean boy group NRG (New Radiancy Group) during the late 1900s and early 2000s.
Yoon is a singer under Cube Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024, with the single album "NOWADAYS".

Kang Seung-yoon, also known as Seungyoon or Yoon, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, actor, and leader of boy group Winner. In 2010, he participated in the reality television singing contest Superstar K2 and finished in fourth place. In January 2011, he became a trainee under YG Entertainment and went on to debut as a solo artist in July 2013. In 2013, Seungyoon was revealed to be a particpant in the boy group survival program "WIN: Who is Next" together with his group Team A. Following Team A's win on the show, the group eventually debuted as the five-member group "Winner". Besides performing on stage, Yoon has since then appeared in variety shows and has even starred in dramas such as "We Broke Up", "Prison Playbook", "Kairos", and "Voice 4".
Yoon Cheol Jong is a South Korean musician and songwriter, best known for being part of the duo 10cm. He officially left 10cm in 2017 due health concerns.
Yoon Daro is a South Korean singer and model under A.CONIC Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group WOW.
Yoon Eun O, formelly known as Chandong is a South Korean singer-songwriter and musical actor under Gleam Artist. He was a member of the male vocal group VROMANCE. He was a contestant on MIXNINE.
Yoon Ho Hyeon is a South Korean model and former trainee under Readyx. He was a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1 but was eliminated in episode 6 after ranking 31st.

Yoon Hye Sung is a South Korean trainee. He is a former pre-debut member of the boy group PICKUS. He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fan Pick. On April 17, 2024, it was announced that Yoon Hye Sung had left PICKUS and terminated his contract with TNK Entertainment.
Yoon Jae Yong is a South Korean trainee and actor. He is a participant in the reality survival program MAKE MATE 1.
Jayden is a Korean singer under PARKYOON Entertainment. He made his solo debut with the single "26" on July 30, 2021.He is a former pre-debut member of the group DS BOYS
Yoon Jong Shin is a South Korean singer, record producer, songwriter, and CEO of Mystic Story.
Yoon Joon Hyeop is a South Korean singer and model under ESteem Model Management. He is a contesant on Wild Idol.
Yoon Juhan is a South Korean trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Yoon Junho is a South Korean trainee. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Yoon Kye-Sang is a South Korean singer and actor under Just Entertainment. He made his debut on January 13, 1999, in the boy group g.o.d under SidusHQ.
Yoon Kyul is a South Korean musician. He is a past member of the rock band Jannabi.

Yoon Min, also known by the pseudonym M!N, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under howtouse. He is a former member of the pre-debut boy group JYPE LOUD. He made his solo debut on August 1, 2024, with his first digital single "Slob". He is best known for being a contestant on the survival shows LOUD, Vocal Showdown, and Boys II Planet.

Yoon Seobin is a South Korean singer and model under AndBut Company . He made his official debut in May 2022 with the digital single, "Beautiful." Before debuting, Yoon Seobin participated in "Produce X 101" as a trainee under JYP Entertainment. After being embroiled in bullying accusations, he left the show and was edited out. He soon left JYP and signed with Sublime Artist Agency. However, after a few activities, he left the agency and transferred to Peace Angels Company, after he went to AndBut Company

Yoon Suho, formerly known as Seungyeop, is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group E'LAST and its sub-unit E'LAST U. He was oficialy announced as a member of E Entertainment's boy group on August 21, 2019. Then known as EBOYZ, the group named was changed to E'LAST, with the group making their official debut on June 9, 2020 with the mini album "Day Dream". In January 2023, Seungyeop began his mandatory military service. Although he was discharged in July 2024, E Ent remained silent about his status, only acknowledging him publicly on his birthday. On June 20, 2025, Seungyeop posted a photo on his personal Instagram with the caption "fresh start." Two days later, he held a live stream where he confirmed that his exclusive contract with E Ent had ended and that he was no longer a member of E'LAST. Despite this, he reassured fans of his intention to pursue various solo activities. As of yet, E Ent has not released an official statement. He later changed his stage name to Yoon Suho in August 2025.
Yoon Youngwoong is a South Korean singer. He participated in the survival show Stars Awakening.
Kim Yoon Dong is a South Korean rapper. He is a member of Japanese-Korean boy group ORBIT and used to be a member of the now-disbanded boy group Halo. He also participated in Produce 101 Japan.
Yoonhak is a member of the South Korean boy group Supernova.

Yoon Sang Hyuk, better known by his stage name Yoonsan, is the Main Rapper and Vocalist of the boy group Hotshot, under Star Crew Entertainment. Before his debut, Yoonsan lived in France for eight years and majored in Design.

Yoonsang is a South Korean singer under HnA Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group IB147. Prior to this, he used to be a member of the boy groups AWEEK and ASTIN under the stage names Logan, and Mir, respectively. On August 4th, 2024, a Twitter account for the upcoming group L5ST was opened, revealing 4 of 5 members being former IB147 members and one being a former Daychild member. Yoonsang was one of the members listed.
Yoonsung is a South Korean singer under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023.
Kim Yoon-Won is a South Korean trainee under Belift Lab. He appeared on the survival program "I-LAND".

Yoonwoo is a singer under Interpark Music Plus. He is a member of the boy group TRENDZ. Yoonwoo debuted as a member of TRENDZ on January 5, 2022 with their first mini album "Blue Set Chapter 1. Tracks."
Lee Yunwoo debuted as a member of the co-ed rock band 11Degrees on the 7th of December 2018.
Yooseung is a member of the South Korean group M.Pire.
Yooshin is a South Korean singer. He was a contestant on Stars Awakening.
Yoosu is a South Korean singer.He participated on the survival show "NO.MERCY" but was ultimately eliminated in round 2.

names.native: ยงศิลป์ วงศ์พนิตนนท์

maleIdols.description: Yorch is a Thai singer and actor under GRID Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group POW and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A. He made his Thai solo debut on April 18th, 2023, with the digital single "Seven".

Yang Yoseop is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Around US Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Highlight (formerly BEAST).He made his solo debut on November 26, 2012 with his first mini album 'The First Collage'. He was formally drafted into the military on January 24, 2019, and was released from active duty on August 30, 2020.
Yosep is a South Korean vocalist, and member of the ballad group 4MEN. Yosep made his debut with the single album ‘B&W,’ performing under the name ‘Yunyo’ and collaborating with artist Casey.
Yoshi is a Japanese trainee. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.

Kanemoto Yoshinori, known better by his stage name Yoshi, is the main rapper of YG Entertainment's boy group TREASURE. In 2018, Yoshi participated in YG Entertainment's new survival show, YG Treasure Box. At first, he was not selected for the main group, TREASURE, however, on January 29, 2019, YGE announced that he would form a second group from the show, called MAGNUM, and he was one of the members. The groups would promote together as TREASURE 13, and also eventually separated as two units. Unfortunately, due to scandals surrounding the agency, the debut was postponed. On January 6, YGE posted a notice on their official website stating the group's future plans. This included re-organizing as a 12-member group and the integration of the two units, TREASURE and MAGNUM, into only one group named simply as TREASURE. Yoshi debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with their first single album "THE FIRST STEP: CHAPTER ONE".
Hwang Je-heon, better known as YOSI is a South Korean rapper who debuted under Luminant Entertainment in 2023.
Yosi is a South Korean producer who debuted under Groove Stone in 2013.

Kim Taeyu, also known as You, is a South Korean rapper and lyricist under J-Star Entertainment. Kim Taeyu was introduced as a member of BECZ under H&H Entertainment on November 27, 2019 and debuted with the group on March, 13, 2020, with the release of their first digital single "Into U". They sadly disbanded on September 10, 2020, and he left the agency. He then was announced as a member of the boy group ABLUE on September 16, 2021. He debuted with them on October 23, 2022 with the single album "Color The Start". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated from the show in episode 8 after ranking 36th place.

You Myeongjong, popularly known as YOU, is a South Korean songwriter, musician, and producer. He is a part of the co-ed band YUDABINBAND as the keyboardist. He debuted on February 1, 2021, with his first digital single "Someday".
You Chae Hoon is a South Korean singer under Studio JAMM. He is the leader of the boy group LA POEM.

YouJin, formerly known as Kangsan, is a Japanese-Korean singer. He debuted as a member of the boy group RION FIVE, under Narda Entertainment, on March 25, 2014, with the digital single "Rion Five", and was active with the group until his departure in March 2018. YouJin was also a member of the Japanese boy group B2takes!!, that he joined on June 19, 2019 and graduated from on August 31, 2020.

Youjin is a South Korean singer, best known as a former member of the boy group KNK. He was a trainee in TS Entertainment and trained along with the members of the boy group B.A.P. He debuted as a member of KNK on March 3, 2016 with the single "Knock". On September 10, 2018, it was announced that he had left the group due to his health.
Youmin is a South Korean singer signed with EDEN Entertainment. He debuted as a member of ALL(H)OURS on January 10, 2024 with the mini-album ALL OURS.

Young Cream is a South Korean rapper and producer. He is a former member of the Korean hip-hop group M.I.B. Before debuting in M.I.B he released a single as a part of a spin-off promotion to prove that each member is capable of standing alone. He made his official solo debut in 2017

Kang Young Hyun, popularly known by his stage name Young K, is the bassist, lead vocalist, and main rapper of the band DAY6 under JYP Entertainment. Young K was born and raised in Korea but moved to Canada in high school where he used his English name Brian Kang. On September 7, 2015, Young K made his debut as a member of Day6 and released their debut EP, The Day, with the lead single "Congratulations." Six years later, on September 6, 2022, he made his solo debut with the extended play "Eternal" and its title track "Guard You."
Young Poon is a South Korean rapper. He was a member of the hip hop group Honey Family.

Park Young-Tak is a South Korean trot singer, songwriter, actor, and television personality under ABYSS COMPANY. He made his debut as a ballad singer on May 3, 2007, with his first album, "Young Tak Disia". He transitioned to a trot career in 2016 with the release of the single album "Nuna You Are Perfect".
Young West, born Koo Young-woo was a South Korean rapper who debuted under MKIT Rain in 2017. He left the rap scene in Oct. of 2020.

Young Bin is a South Korean singer-songwriter and rapper under FNC Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SF9. Youngbin is considered the Dad of the group, often seen taking good care of maknae Chani. As a 1MILLION dance studio trainee, Youngbin's passion for performing led him to train and eventually debut. He debuted as the leader of SF9 on October 5, 2016, with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation". He acted in the drama “I Need Romance Season 3” (2014, Ep. 8, 11). “Click Your Heart” (2016) “Was it Love?” (2020, Ep. 6), “Bubble Up” (2022). Youngbin has 2 tattoos. One goes down his left side and says “Shine Forever.” The other is by his collarbone and says “sic parvis magna.”

Jung Youngbin is a South Korean singer. He was the leader, main dancer and lead vocalist of the boy group LUMINOUS. He was first known as a participant in the hit survival show Produce X 101 in 2019, however he was eliminated in episode 5 after ranking in 68th place. Youngbin made his official debut as the leader of the boy group LUMINOUS on September 9, 2021, with their first mini album "Youth".

Youngbin is a South Korean singer under Keystone Entertainment. Before debuting, he was first known for participating in the survival show I-LAND under the agency Belift Lab. After leaving the agency, Youngbin eventually debuted as a member of BLANK2Y in 2022. On February 25, 2023, a person only known as "B" came forward accusing an idol who was only known as "Y" of dating violence, that was later confirmed to be Youngbin. Later that day, KeyStone Entertainment also confirmed the rumors, and announced that Youngbin had left BLANK2Y effective immediately, and that the group would reorganize as eight members
Yeongbo is a member of the South Korean boy group NTB (Never Take A Break).
Younghan is a singer, actor, and leader of the boy band THE T-BIRD.
Noh Young Ho is a member of the boy group Signal under J Star Entertainment.

Kim Younghoon is a South Korean model, singer, and actor under ONE HUNDRED. Back then, Younghoon was an athlete who joined national swimming competitions until he was scouted while eating bread at a convenience store. Following this, he became a model and idol trainee. Younghoon appeared in several music videos, such as IOI's "Whatta Man" and Melody Day's "Colors" in 2016, until he eventually made his official debut in 2017 as the visual and one of the vocalists of the boy group THE BOYZ. In 2020, Younghoon made his acting debut through the romantic-comedy teen drama series "Love Revolution."

Jung Young Hoon, formerly known as Ooon, is a South Korean singer, dancer, and actor under Dream Passport Entertainment. He first debuted as the leader and main dancer of the boy group Halo until their disbandment in 2019. Younghoon then participated in the Japanese version of the hit survival program Produce 101, together with fellow Halo members Heecheon and Yoondong. However, the three had to leave the show due to personal reasons. In 2020, Younghoon became a member of the Japanese-South Korean boy group ORBIT.

Kim Younghoon is a retired South Korean singer-songwriter. He made his debut in December of 1997 as a member of the boy group O.P.P.A. He was one of two original members to stay in the group until their disbandment. He currently owns a coffee shop in his hometown.
Younghun is a South Korean model and former singer. He was a member of the boy group TOUCH but left in April 2012.

Youngjae is a South Korean singer and a member of the boy group TWS under Pledis Entertainment. He debuted with the group on January 22, 2024, with the release of their first mini album, "Sparkling Blue."

Youngjae is a South Korean singer and actor under Forstar Company. He is a member of the boy group B.A.P. On February 17, 2019, TS Entertainment stated that the four remaining members of B.A.P, after the departure of Bang Yong Guk in August 2018, and Zelo in December 2018, have all elected to not renew their contracts with the agency. Following his departure from TS, he signed with J WORLD Entertainment and debuted as a solo artist on April 19 with the mini album "Fancy". On August 29, 2019, Youngjae signed with Dmost Entertainment (later known as Starit Entertainment). On March 14, 2022, Youngjae signed with Forstar Company as an actor. On May 16, 2024, Youngjae took to social media to announce that he has left his current company, Forstar Company, and for fans to stay tuned for his future activities.

Youngjae is a South Korean singer-songwriter, composer, and actor under AndBut Company. He is best known as the main vocalist of GOT7, debuting with the group on January 16, 2014, with the single "Girls Girls Girls." Following the expiration of his contract with JYP Entertainment in 2021, Youngjae signed with Sublime Artist Agency on January 20. He made his solo debut on October 5, 2021, with the EP "Colors from Ars" and its title track "Vibin." On April 2, 2024, he mutually parted ways with Sublime, later signing an exclusive contract with AndBut Company on June 24, 2024.
Yim Young Jun is a South Korean rapper. He was the maknae (youngest member) and rapper of the boy group HIGH4 and its sub-unit HIGH4 20. He also participated in the survival show MIXNINE.
Youngki is a South Korean singer, member of the co-ed trot group OUTLET. He’s also a gagman. He made his TV debut in 2008.
Youngkwang is a South Korean singer and rapper under TM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group EASTSHINE and a former member of the boy group Kairos.
Youngmin is a South Korean singer and actor. He is best known for being a member of the boy group BF (formerly Boyfriend) and half of Jo Twins.

Youngseo is a South Korean singer under PocketDol Studio. He is a member of the boy groups BAE173 and Double 0ne, as well as the co-ed project group A-SIX. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7, which started in October 2024. He was eliminated in the final after ranking 17th place.
Youngung is a South Korean singer and taekwondo practitioner under K-Tigers E&C. He is a member of the co-ed group K-TIGERS ZERO.

Youngwon is a former member of the group F.able, he was the main vocalist and maknae. He left the group alongside Doha, and together they launched a lawsuit against their former agency, Haeirum Entertainment.

Choi Youngwon is a South Korean singer. He was the main vocalist and leader of the boy group Apeace (originally known as Double B 21) and its sub-unit, Apeace Jade. Following lineup changes within the group, Jade was reorganized into Jade5. Despite facing health issues, including an orbital fracture in 2013, he remained active and dedicated throughout his time in Apeace. After completing his military service in 2016, Youngwon returned to the group and continued performing until Apeace disbanded in December 2021. In June 2025, he re-debuted alongside former member Sehyeon as part of the duo YOKUNAI KANJI.
Younki is a South Korean trainee under C9 Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group NAZE.

maleIdols.description: Yoyo is a Thai singer and dancer. He was chosen by the Korean members to be part of the group THE7, which debuted on January 29, 2023. However, THE7's contract ended on March 20, 2024.
Yu is a Japanese singer and a member of the boy group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 5th in "Nizi Project Season 2."
Yoo Ju Sang is a South Korean musician and actor. He made his acting debut in 1995 and his music debut in 2013.

Yu Junwon is a South Korean trainee. He is known for participating in survival shows, such as HYBE's "&Audition - The Howling" and MBC's "Fantasy Boys." On August 23, 2023, Junwon left the group "FANTASY BOYS" before its debut, due to a disagreement over his contract with PocketDol Studio.
Yu Seongjun is a South Korean idol trainee under Yue Hua Entertainment. In 2019, he appeared in the hit survival program "Produce X 101".
Yuan is a South Korean producer, rapper and dancer. He was a member of the virtual group AEONIT before it disbanded.
Yuan Tsin is a Taiwanese trainee under TEN Entertainment. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.
Yuan Wei is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Yubin, born Jang Yubin, is a South Korean singer under DSP Media. He is a member of the boy group MIRAE. He debuted as a member of MIRAE on March 17, 2021 with the mini album Killa.
Yu Chan is a South Korean singer under Aube Moon Studio. He is the main dancer of the boy group NCHIVE. He made his debut on April 9th, with the single album "Drive".
Sano Yudai was born on October 10th, 2000, in Osaka, Japan. He is the sub-vocalist and visual of INI. He debuted in INI on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A".

Yuga, born Shibutani Yuga, is a Japanese singer and the main vocalist of the boy group ONE OR EIGHT. Yuga trained for seven years at Avex Artist Academy and was part of the pre-debut team WARPsROOTS. He joined the survival show WARPs DIG and was revealed as the sixth member to debut. His known skills include singing, dancing, rapping, beatboxing, and playing the guitar.

Yugyeom (born Kim Yu-gyeom) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and dancer. He debuted in 2014 as a member of GOT7 and later formed the duo sub-unit Jus2 with Jay B. Before his debut, he gained recognition as a competitive dancer, winning second place at the 2010 Adrenaline House Dance Battle and training under JYP Entertainment from late 2010 to early 2011. In January 2021, Yugyeom and his GOT7 bandmates left JYP Entertainment while continuing group activities. On February 19, 2021, he signed an exclusive contract with AOMG, marking his transition into the hip-hop and R&B scene. He made his solo debut with the EP "Point of View: U" in June 2021, featuring collaborations with Gray, Loco, DeVita, Jay Park, and Punchnello. Yugyeom contributed to the album's composition, lyrics, and production, with Gray and Cha Cha Malone overseeing production.
Yuho is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the upcoming co-ed band Re:Hearts.
Yuhwan is a south korean actor and singer under Just Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group SPEED under MBK Entertainment.

Yuito is a Japanese trainee under Sony Music Entertainment Japan. He is a member of the trainee group M:Rea1. He participated on the Japanese reality survival show Nizi Project 2 and is currently partcipating in South Korean survival show Universe League.

Yuju is a Japanese singer, actor, and trainee under YX LABELS. He placed second on the reality survival show Oen-High, making him a member of the debut lineup of the upcoming boy group aoen. He is a former member of the Japanese boy group VOYZ BOY and pre-debut boy group 24kumi.

Yujun is a South Korean singer under Future Idol Asia. He is a member of the project boy group Villain. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Yujun is a South Korean singer under KQ Entertainment. He made his official debut on March 30, 2023, as one of the vocalists of the boy group xikers. On August 20, 2022, he was introduced as the fifth member of KQ Fellaz 2. On February 24, 2023, KQ announced that KQ Fellaz 2 would debut under the name xikers along with the help of the launching of social media and identity film for the group. They debuted on March 30, 2023, with their first mini album, "House of Tricky: Doorbell Ringing"
Yuki is a Japanese singer and Member of the Pre-debut Boy Group NEXZ under JYP Entertainment. He ranked 3rd in the Nizi Project Season 2.
Yuki is a Japanese singer under Wolfburn. He is the maknae of the boy group BXB.
Yuki is a Japanese trainee. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."

Greg Yoo, also known as yukon, is a South Korean American rapper and singer who debuted under PYRAT and is a member of 0WAVE. He later debuted as a solo artist in 2023 with his EP, "my Imperfections".

Yuku is a Japanese singer and dancer under Brave Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group DKB. Yuku was introduced as a member of DKB on November 21, 2019. He officially made his debut with the group on February 3, 2020, with the mini album Youth.

Yul is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group JJCC. He is a former member of ATO with stage name Rihan. He was a participant in Produce 101 Season 2. He participated on MIXNINE, but he didn’t make it.
Yuleum is a South Korean rapper and producer under Just Music who debuted under Wedaplugg Records in 2021.
Yull is a member of the virtual group SKINZ, which operates under Bridge Entertainment. He was announced on their official social media accounts on March 25, 2025.

Yuma is a Japanese singer and member of the boy group 24K+. The group debuted in 2012 under Choeun Entertainment but underwent several lineup changes starting in 2014. He was revealed as a new member in April 2022 and made his debut a few months later. In 2023, the current five members appeared on the show "Peak Time".

Yuma is a Japanese singer under Fantagio. His addition to LUN8 was announced last February 6, 2025 and made his official debut on August 27, 2025 through the release of the group's Japanese full album "Elevation". He is best known for being a contestant on the survival show Fantasy Boys.

Yuma is a Japanese singer, dancer and actor under HYBE Labels Japan. He is best known as the main vocalist and one of the rappers of the Japanese boy group &TEAM. In 2022, Yuma participated in the survival show "&AUDITION - The Howling -" where he qualified to become a member of the Japanese boy group &TEAM.

YUMDDA, born Yeom Hyun-soo is a South Korean rapper and former VJ for MTV Korea, who debuted independantly in 2006. On November 25, 2020, he and former Illionaire Records artist The Quiett established their new record label, Daytona Entertainment, after the closure of Illionaire Records.

Kim Young-kyung, popularly known by the stage name Yume, is a South Korean singer and a former member of the boy band Xing. As one of the original members, he promoted with the group until his departure in January 2008.

Yumeki is a Japanese choreographer, dancer, and trainee under GRIGO Entertainment. He is best known for participating on the survival show Boys II Planet. He previously appeared in Team 1MILLION on Street Man Fighter, where his team placed fifth. He also appeared on Produce 101 Japan The Girls as a dance trainer.
Yumin is a South Korean rapper who debuted independently in 2018.
Yun Seo is a South Korean singer under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS. He was a contestant on the reality survival show Build Up: Vocal Boy Group Survivor.

David “Yungin” Kim is a Korean-American, x3 Grammy-winning mix engineer, producer & rapper known for his work on iconic projects like Kendrick Lamar’s 'To Pimp a Butterfly', Nipsey Hussle’s 'Racks in the Middle', and Nas’s 'King’s Disease'. He officially debuted in April 2024 under AimKorea with the single "No Lowkey" featuring Jessi & CAMO. Born in Seoul and trained at the Musicians Institute in Los Angeles, he began his career as an unpaid intern at Chalice Recording Studios, eventually becoming their head engineer. Kim later joined acclaimed producer Hit-Boy and has since worked with top artists including Ariana Grande, Post Malone, DJ Khaled, and Big Sean. Beyond his work in the US, he’s made major contributions to the Korean music industry, engineering for BTS members RM, Jimin, and j-hope, as well as Taeyang, Kai, and Zico. Operating between L.A. and Seoul, Kim has become a key figure in bridging Western and Korean music, shaping the global sound of modern pop and hip-hop.
Lee Yungyu is a South Korean rapper under MNH Entertainment. He made his official debut as a member of the boy group 8TURN on January 30, 2023.

Yunho is a South Korean dancer, singer, songwriter, and actor under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ, in which he debuted on October 24, 2018 with the release of their first mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero". In 2021, Yunho debuted as an actor through the KBS Drama 'Imitation', in which he played the leading role of Yoojin, a member of the fictional boy group SPARKLING.
Yunhu is a South Korean rapper and singer under Beat Interactive. He is a member of the boy group NEWBEAT.
Yunhyeok is a South Korean singer and rapper under Victory Company. He is a member of the boy group NTX.

Yunmin is a South Korean singer currently under J-FLO Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group Newkidd and its subunits Newkidd - Lemme Spoil U and Newkidd02. Yunmin was revealed to be a member of THE7 on April 11, 2022. He, Yongkwon and Woochul would appear on SEVEN STARS to help in finding the four remaining members of the group. They made their debut on January 29, 2023.
Jang Yun Seo is a South Korean trainee who participated on YG Treasure Box as a member of Team B.

Hwang Yun Seong is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 28, 2020, as the leader of the boy group DRIPPIN. When he was a trainee, Yunseong participated in the hit reality show Produce X 101 where he finished in 18th place.

Park Yunsol is a South Korean idol and youtube creator under NEST Entertainment. In 2019, he appeared and competed in the hit survival program "Produce X 101" and the survival show "G-EGG" in 2020, making this debut with the Japanese-Korean boy group NIK on September 27, 2021, which disbanded on July 2023.
Kim Yun Soo, or simply Yunsoo, is a South Korean musician and songwriter under Favor Entertainment. He is the guitarist of the boy band W24. He is also a member of the CCM band AGAPAO Worship.

Nam Yunsung, also known as Yunsung, is a former South Korean singer, rapper, and actor. He was a member of the disbanded boy group NOIR and gained recognition as a contestant on the reality survival show Produce 101 Season 2. In August 2022, Yunsung was sentenced to probation for breaking into his ex-girlfriend's home, threatening her with a weapon, and causing injuries. His sentence includes one year in prison if he reoffends within a two-year probationary period, along with 80 hours of community service.

Hwang Yoon-sung, better known as Yunsung, is a South Korean singer under Sky E&M. He is a member of the boy group Romeo and Mister T. He also appeared on television contests such as "Mixnine" and "Mr. Trot."
Yunyoung, also known as Y0ung, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer, and member of the disbanded boy group A-Jax.

Abe Yura is a Japanese singer under TNK Entertainment. On August 14, 2023, he was revealed as a contestant on MBC's survival show Fan Pick. He ranked 1st place overall, making him a member of the winning group PICKUS. He debuted with the group on April 23, 2024 with the release of the single album "Little Prince". On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.

Yuri is a Korean-Russian singer, rapper and model under ESteem. He is one half of the duo JxR. Born in Uzbekistan, Yuri later moved to Russia and was an athlete on the youth national team for swimming. He is now officially a Korean citizen after receiving his Korean citizenship on September 19th, 2019. He has already served under the Russian military, prior to his work in Korea. He was supposed to debut under NCT, but it didn’t work out and transferred to ESteem to start his modeling career instead. Yuri is also a member of Mensa, the largest and oldest high IQ society in the world. In mid-2019, he participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101 representing Vine Entertainment. He was eliminated in the 11th episode and ranked in 36th place.
Yusen is a Taiwanese-American trainee under P Nation. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Yuseong is a South Korean singer. He is the leader of the boy group T:EV, and a former member of the boy group AQA, the trainee group Just COLOR, and the busking team InnerS. In April 2025, Yuseong and the other members of T:EV departed from Startree, the agency under which they debuted. As of now, he is not signed to any entertainment company.
Yuseop is a South Korean singer under Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NouerA. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival shows Boys Planet and MAKE MATE 1.

Yushi is a Japanese singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of NCT and its Japan-based sub-unit NCT Wish. Prior to signing with SM, he was a member of the J-Pop boy group EBiDAN and its sub-unit EDAMAME BEANS.
Yushik is a member of the group Messgram (they are a Co-Ed group)

Nakamoto Yuta is a Japanese singer, actor, and radio host under SM Entertainment. He is best known for being a member of South Korean boy group NCT and it's sub-units NCT 127 and NCT U. In July 2016, he made his official debut in NCT 127 with their first EP NCT #127. Prior to debuting, Yuta was a member of SM's pre-debut rookie team SMROOKIES and was revealed to the public on December 24, 2013. Yuta's solo debut was on October 3, 2024, with the release of his first solo EP, Depth, the lead single being "Off the Mask".
Yutaka is a Japanese trainee. He was one of the contestants of the 2022 survival show "Boys Planet."

Yuto is a Japanese rapper, singer-songwriter, and the lead rapper of PENTAGON. He debuted with the group on October 10, 2016, with the mini-album PENTAGON. On October 9, 2023, Cube Entertainment announced that Yuto had ended his exclusive contract along with four other members of PENTAGON. Shortly after, on October 26, he signed with RINK Entertainment. On November 12, 2023, it was announced that Yuto would make his solo debut with the single Dat Girl on December 13, marking his first release as a solo artist.

Yuto is a member of the boy group TOZ under YY Entertainment. They made their debut on September 27, 2023 with the mini album FLARE. He gained fame as a participant in the Korean reality show “Boys Planet”.

Song Yuvin is a South Korean Singer and Actor under Tri-us Entertainment. He was the Main Vocalist of the boy group MYTEEN. Prior to his group debut, he debuted as a soloist in 2016 with the single "You Are The Only One". In 2019, Yuvin participated in the hit survival show Produce X 101 where he ranked #15 on the final episode. Despite not being able to debut as part of X1, Yuvin recieved immense love and support from viewers.
Yuya is a Japanese trainee under C9 Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group NAZE.
YY is a Chinese singer under CHITWN Music. He is a former member of the boy group UNVS.

Youngjun is in charge of keyboard in the group NND. Youngjun, who has been closely involved with music since childhood due to the influence of his mother, a guitar instructor, built a solid foundation with piano and drums and passed the audition to become a band trainee while preparing for the piano entrance exam to major in applied music. From then on, he felt himself expanding beyond the piano in terms of speed, quality, and quantity of music, and his views on music changed. Youngjun, who believes that the value of music is only realized when the public chooses and sings it, has reflected this in his [Wonder, I] album work to elicit a stable sympathy from listeners. Youngjun played keyboard for former member TraxX‘s Jungmo‘s song ‘Marionette‘ and also appeared in the music video. He was also featured as a keyboardist on Brown Eyed Girls‘ JeA‘s cover of ‘Love Wins All’ (original by IU). On February 26, 2025 Way Better announced Youngjun now going by YYJ as a new artist making fans believe that NND has silently disbanded.

Z-UK is a South Korean rapper, dancer, composer, and producer under PLUSWIN Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group WE:A and a former member of the groups SIGMA, BIGFLO, and the sub-unit Z-UK X HighTop. He made his solo debut on August 12, 2017 with the digital single “Push & Pull.” He departed BIGFLO alongside Kichun in December 2016 and later joined JN Entertainment, a company founded by Kichun, where he released “Push & Pull.” That same year, he competed on KBS 2TV’s idol rebooting show The Unit, ranking 56th before being eliminated in episode 8. In early 2018, he returned with the R&B single “Dreaming” and later released the hip-hop track “Hot Sauce.” In 2020, he participated in the SIGMA PROJECT, forming the Korean-Japanese boy group SIGMA. In March 2022, he was introduced as one of the original members of the then-upcoming group WE:A when their official social media accounts were launched. Alongside his performing career, Z-UK has been active behind the scenes: since 2020 he has worked as a Producer & Director at Madewell Music (Korea), and since 2021 he has also served as one of the operating managers and producers at KZ Entertainment (Japan), where he oversees artist activities and production while continuing his music career under PLUSWIN Entertainment.

Choi Hwan-Hee, best known by the stage name Z.flat, is a South Korean rapper signed under ROSCHILD Entertainment. He debuted on November 20th, 2020 with the digital single, "Designer" featuring HONDAM.
Z.Hoo is a member of the South Korean boy group Lucente.

Tao is a Chinese rapper, singer, actor, and martial artist. He is a former member of the boy group EXO and their subgroup EXO-M. He left the group in August 2015 after filing a lawsuit against SM Entertainment to terminate his contract citing health concerns, making him the third Chinese member to do so after Kris and Luhan who left EXO the previous year. Since leaving, he has been active in China as a soloist under the stage name Z.TAO.
Zai is a Taiwanese singer under Catwalk. He is a member of the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys.

Ahn Jung-Jae, best known by the stage name zai.ro, is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and musician under Chungchun Music. He debuted on May 30th, 2017 with the album, 'NEW GENERATION'. In 2014, zai.ro collaborated with the K-pop girl group, SISTAR on an acoustic version of the song, "Touch My Body." The same year, he collaborated with another K-pop girl group, 2NE1 in the show, "Yoo Heeyeol's Sketchbook". In 2014, before his official debut, he sang an OST for the drama, "It's okay, That's Love". zai.ro contributed to compositions, arrangements, and productions of songs for artists such as 3POP, Heartshake, and Kim Minseok.
Yoseb is a South Korean rapper and singer. He is a member of the boy group Xst and a former member of the group Herycle. When the group was known as M.FECT, his stage name was Zamong.
Zayyan is an Indonesian trainee under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. He debuted as a member of the boy group Xodiac on April 25, 2023.

ZE:After, also known as Moon Jun Young and formerly known as Lee Hoo is a South Korean singer under his own agency LAKE Entertainment. He is best known as the leader and main vocalist of the group ZE:A and its sub-unit ZE:A 4U. Apart from his group activities, he also made his debut as an actor and appeared in various television dramas Poseidon, Please Marry Me, Gloria, Vampire Idol and Poseidon, The Clinic for Married Couples: Love and War. He also appeared in films Ronin Pop and ZE:A Breathe. In 2017 his contract with Star Entertainment got expired. He signed with EXA Entertainment in 2017 and announced that he would focus on his acting. In 2022 he founded the entertainment agency Super Member's Entertainment. On February 1, 2024 he founded LAKE Entertainment, also known as LAKE Studio, as a reorganization of his former agencies Super Member's Entertainment and EXA Entertainment.
Zehan is a South Korean singer and dancer under A Team Entertainment. He was a member of the boy group VAV (Very Awesome Voice) but left in 2016.

Zelo is a South Korean rapper-songwriter under Uzu Rocks. He is a member of the boy group B.A.P and its subunit Bang & Zelo. He made his solo debut on June 21, 2019, with his first mini album "Distance." Zelo was introduced as Bang Yongguk's sub-unit partner, Bang & Zelo, by TS Entertainment on November 24, 2011. They debuted on December 2, 2011, with their self-titled digital single. He debuted in B.A.P on January 26, 2012, with their first single "Warrior." His contract with TS Entertainment ended in December 2018 and he chose not to renew it but did not leave the group. On June 7, 2019, he announced his debut mini album "Distance," released on June 21, 2019. Later, on August 17, 2022, he signed an exclusive contract with Uzu Rocks. In his personal life, Zelo announced through an Instagram post on October 15, 2023, that he would enlist in the military in December.

Seongjong is a member of the upcoming boygroup IB147, they have 2 pre-debut releases out and are currently promoting in Japan, their official debut date is unknown. Seongjong is a thin tenor and has a voice that is easy to listen to.
Zen is a Taiwanese trainee and actor under TVBS. He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show SCOOL.

maleIdols.description: Zen Zen is a Thai trainee under Bill Entertainment. He is currently participating in the SBS reality show Universe League.

Zene The Zilla, born Lee Sang-yong is a South Korean rapper who debuted under A.D.#.D in 2015. He gained attention with his 2016 single "HAWAII DREAM". He's known for his "zillamode" series and has released 5 studio albums and 8 extended plays. He appeared on "Show Me the Money 8" in 2019, and that same year, he signed with AMBITION MUSIK. In 2024, he released his fifth studio album "94-24", exploring themes of being in his thirties. It was nominated for Album of the Year at the 2025 Korean Hio-Hop Awards.
Zeng Shang Xuan is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zenon is a South Korean trainee under Startree Entertainment. He is a member of the upcoming boy group MY ONE and is currently preparing for his official debut alongside the rest of the group.
Zeo is a South Korean singer. He was a member of the boy group (M)IRROR under VT Entertainment which disbanded in 2023.

Ding Zeren, also known as Lee Ni is a Chinese idol singer, as a member of the group NEX7 under Yuehua Entertainment. He made his debut with NEX7 on June 21, 2018 with the album 'The First I', and made his solo debut in 2019 with the single 'Flawless'. In 2018, he participated on IQiYi's Chinese Idol survival show 'Idol Producer' but got eliminated, ranking 26th.
Zero (T02) was a Japanese rapper and singer under MLD Entertainment and he was a member of the boy group TFN.
Zeth is a singer under KJ Music Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TARGET.
Zett is a member of the South Korean boy group AFOS.
Yu Zeyu, popularly known as Zeyu, is the main vocalist, visual, and rapper of the Chinese boy group Boy Story under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China.
Zhang Hang Yi is a Chinese trainee associated with JS Entertainment. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.

Zhang Hao is a Chinese singer under Yuehua Entertainment. He ranked first overall in the 2023 survival show "Boys Planet," securing his spot in the boy group ZEROBASEONE. He is also the first non-Korean center in the history of Korean survival shows. He made his official debut with the group on July 10, 2023, with the mini album "Youth in the Shade", under the management of WAKEONE.
Zhang Ji Jun is a Chinese singer and actor under PC Entertainment. He is a member of the Chinese boy group AGEBOYS. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Zhang Jing He is a Chinese trainee. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Zhang Jinglong is a Chinese trainee. On September 26, 2024, he was revealed as a contestant on JTBC's survival show PROJECT7 starting in October 2024.
Zhang Shi Yi is a Chinese trainee under esee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zhang Shun Yu is a Chinese trainee under Dragon Team Film and Television Culture. He is best known as a contestant of the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zhang Yi Hua is a Chinese trainee under Top Class Entertainment. He is a member of the pre-debut group TOPTEENS. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zhang Yu Xi is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zhao Jia Yin is a Chinese trainee. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.

Zheng Han is a Chinese actor and singer. He was a member of the project boy group T.E.N, with whom he debuted on May 16, 2018, with the release of the single "Haeyo Haeyo". He is now more focused on his acting career.
Zheng Kun is a Chinese trainee. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Zheng Renyu is a Chinese singer under RYCE Entertainment. He was a member of the disbanded project boy group S.K.Y, with whom he debuted with on August 28, 2020. Besides his career as a singer, he has participated in the survival shows Super Idol: Season 3 (2017), We Are Young (2020), and Boys II Planet (2025).

Zhu ZhengTing, also known as Theo Zhu, is a Chinese singer and a member of the boy group NEX7 under Yue Hua Entertainment. In 2017, ZhengTing, along with fellow trainee and now groupmate Justin, participated in Mnet's Produce 101 Season 2 as part of the Yue Hua Entertainment trainees. He ranked 51st and was eliminated in episode 8. In early 2018, he took part in iQiYi's Idol Producer, where he achieved sixth place, securing a spot in the group Nine Percent. On June 21, 2018, he debuted as a member of Yue Hua Entertainment's new boy group NEX7. He made his solo debut on September 23, 2019, with the mini album titled 'Chapter Z'.

Zhong Xing, also known as Starry, is a Chinese singer and member of the Chinese boy group 1B1 (ONE BY ONE) under The Line Star Entertainment. He was revealed as a contestant of the survival show, "Boys II Planet", on June 7, 2025 with the release of the show's third round of visual posters. His company confirmed that he was the trainee in the visual poster #1.
Zhou Yan He is a Chinese trainee under Liancheng Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.
Zhou Zheng is a Chinese singer under Star Voyage Century and member of the Chinese boy group V.K Dream. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

Zhoumi is a Chinese singer, songwriter, actor, MC, and radio DJ under SM Entertainment. He is a member of SUPER JUNIOR-M and the project ballad group S.M. THE BALLAD. He made his solo debut on October 31, 2014, with his first mini album "Rewind".
Zhu En Hao is a Chinese trainee under JS Entertainment. He gained recognition for his participation in the survival show Starlight Boys.
Zica is a member of JJCC. He is a former member of ATO with stage name Noah. He participated in MIXNINE, but he didn’t make it.On 15 January 2018, Zica enlisted.

Zick Jasper (formerly known as 5Zic) is a South Korean rapper and producer. He is a former member of the hip-hop group M.I.B. Before debuting in M.I.B, he released the song "Beautiful Day" on October 7th, 2011. The song was released as a part of a spin-off promotion to prove that each member is capable of standing alone. He is currently working as a producer under the name 88kief.

Woo Ji-ho, better known under the stage name Zico, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, composer and producer under his own label, KOZ Entertainment. He is the leader of the boy group Block B, a member of the project boy group FANXY CHILD and a former member of the underground duo Harmonics. He made his solo debut on November 7, 2014 with the single "Tough Cookie". On November 23, 2018, it was announced that his contract with Seven Seasons had expired and he decided to not renew it. However, there was no decision about his future with Block B. On January 10, 2019, he officially opened his own label, titled KOZ Entertainment, which stands for stands for 'King of the Zungle'.

Li Zihao, popularly known as Zihao, is the lead rapper, vocalist, and lead dancer of the Chinese boy group BOY STORY under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
Ziki is a South Korean rapper and lyricist. He is a member of the upcoming boy group AWIN and a former member of the boy group BLACK6IX.

Zio, formerly known as Jiho, W-T, and G.O, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer and streamer. He is a member of the boy group NTB and a former member of the boy groups PURE and PUREBOY. He made his solo debut on August 7, 2019 with the digital single "I Like The Party". In 2021 he joined the music production team adeMade and began writing and producing songs under the name LaVit.
Lee Hang Seok, also known as Zion, is a South Korean singer. He used to be a member of the boy group N.SONIC.

Kim Hae-sol, known as Zion.T, is a South Korean hip hop and R&B singer signed to The Black Label, a subsidiary label of YG Entertainment managed by Teddy Park. He has released a studio album, Red Light (2013), and two extended plays. He has also been featured on tracks by well-known K-pop artists such as G-Dragon and Zico. Zion.T made his musical debut in 2011, collaborating with Korean hip hop artists such as Dok2, Crucial Star, Simon Dominic, Primary, and Gray. His first single, "Click Me", featuring Dok2, was released in April 2011. In an exclusive interview with Kpopeurope in 2014, Zion.T explained that he chose his stage name because "I am a Christian and so the “T” in my name is representative of the cross."

Zior Park (born Park Ji-won) is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer. He is well-known for his blend of R&B, hip-hop and his distinctive voice. His music explore themes like identity, youth, and emotion through highly surreal and thought-provoking visuals.
Ziu, born as Park Hee Jun, is the main vocalist and youngest member of the South Korean Boy Group VAV. He was added to the group in 2017.

Kim Jiwoo, known under his stage name Ziwoo, is a South Korean singer under MYSTIC Story. He is the main vocalist of the boy group ARrC. On July 8, 2024, MYSTIC STORY introduced their first boy group, ARrC. Ziwoo was unveiled as one of the seven members of this group. On January 22, it was announced that Ziwoo has left the group for personal reasons.
Zo Doo Hyun is a South Korean singer and dancer under JYP Entertainment. He is a contestant of the SBS survival program "Loud".

Baek Juho, also known as Zuho is a South Korean rapper, actor, and dancer under Haewadal Entertainment. He is also a member of the boy group SF9. He debuted as a member of SF9 on October 5, 2016, with the group's first single album "Feeling Sensation". On January 11th, it was announced that Zuho signed an exclusive contract with the agency Haewadal Entertainment for his solo activities as an actor however, Zuho will continue to serve as an active member of SF9.
Zune is a South Korean drummer, and former member of the co-ed duo Y&Z Project.

Zunon is a musician under UZUROCKS Entertainment and GOGO2020. He is the multiplayer of the boy band 2Z. Zunon was revealed as 2Z's newest member on July 5, 2020. He then made his official debut with them on August 1 with the digital "Let's Go For It".
